name: Aether
description: A traveler from another world who had their only kin taken away, forcing them to embark on a journey to find The Seven.
descriptionId: Seorang pengembara yang berasal dari dunia lain, saudara satu-satunya yang ia miliki dirampas dari hadapannya oleh sesosok dewa, dan kini ia mengembara untuk mencari The Seven.

name: Albedo
title: Kreideprinz
description: A genius known as the Kreideprinz, he is the Chief Alchemist and Captain of the Investigation Team of the Knights of Favonius.
descriptionId: Seorang jenius yang dikenal dengan julukan Kreideprinz, dia adalah Kepala Alkemis dan Kapten Tim Investigasi Knights of Favonius.

talents.name: Favonius Bladework - Weiss
talents.description:
Normal Attack
Performs up to 5 rapid strikes.

Charged Attack
Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to unleash 2 rapid sword strikes.

Plunging Attack
Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground below, damaging opponents along the path and dealing AoE DMG upon impact.
talents.descriptionId:
Normal Attack
Melancarkan hingga 5 tebasan pedang berturut-turut.

Charged Attack
Mengonsumsi sejumlah Stamina untuk melancarkan dua tebasan pedang ke depan.

Plunging Attack
Menerjang dari udara untuk menghantam tanah, menyerang musuh di jalur terjangan dan mengakibatkan DMG area saat mendarat.

talents.name: Abiogenesis: Solar Isotoma
talents.description:
Albedo creates a Solar Isotoma using alchemy, which deals AoE Geo DMG on appearance.

Solar Isotoma
has the following properties:
·When opponents within the Solar Isotoma field take DMG, the Solar Isotoma will generate Transient Blossoms which deal AoE Geo DMG. DMG dealt scales off Albedo's DEF. 
·Transient Blossoms can only be generated once every 2s.
·When a character is located at the locus of the Solar Isotoma, the Solar Isotoma will accumulate Geo power to form a crystallized platform that lifts the character up to a certain height. Only one crystallized platform can exist at a time.
·Solar Isotoma is considered a Geo construct. Only one Solar Isotoma created by Albedo himself can exist at a time. 

Hold to designate the location of the skill.
talents.descriptionId:
Albedo menciptakan Solar Isotoma yang mengakibatkan Geo DMG area.

Solar Isotoma
Mempunyai efek sebagai berikut:
·Saat musuh yang berada dalam area Solar Isotoma menerima DMG, Solar Isotoma akan menghasilkan Transient Blossom yang mengakibatkan Geo DMG area. DMG yang diakibatkan akan berdasarkan pada DEF Albedo.
·Transient Blossom hanya dapat muncul setiap 2 detik.
·Saat Karakter berada di atas Solar Isotoma, Solar Isotoma akan mengakumulasi kekuatan Geo dan mengangkat Karakter ke atas platform kristal. Hanya bisa terdapat satu platform kristal dalam waktu bersamaan.
·Hanya bisa terdapat satu Solar Isotoma yang diciptakan Albedo di waktu yang bersamaan. Solar Isotoma dianggap sebagai Geo Construct.

Tahan
Untuk mengatur lokasi skill.

talents.name: Rite of Progeniture: Tectonic Tide
talents.description:
Under Albedo's command, Geo crystals surge and burst forth, dealing AoE Geo DMG in front of him.
If a Solar Isotoma created by Albedo himself is on the field, 7 Fatal Blossoms will be generated in the Solar Isotoma field, bursting violently into bloom and dealing AoE Geo DMG.

Tectonic Tide DMG and Fatal Blossom DMG will not generate Transient Blossoms.
talents.descriptionId:
Di bawah perintah Albedo, kristal Geo melonjak dan meledak, mengakibatkan Geo DMG area di hadapan Albedo.
Jika Solar Isotoma yang dibuat oleh Albedo sendiri ada di sekitarnya, maka 7 Fatal Blossom akan muncul di area sekitar Solar Isotoma dan menyebabkan ledakan yang mengakibatkan Geo DMG area.

DMG Tectonic Tide dan DMG Fatal Blossom tidak akan menghasilkan Transient Blossom.

passives.name: Calcite Might
passives.description: Transient Blossoms generated by Abiogenesis: Solar Isotoma deal 25% more DMG to opponents whose HP is below 50%.
passives.descriptionId: Transient Blossom yang muncul karena Abiogenesis: Solar Isotoma mengakibatkan 25% DMG lebih besar kepada musuh dengan HP kurang dari 50%.

passives.name: Homuncular Nature
passives.description: Using Rite of Progeniture: Tectonic Tide increases the Elemental Mastery of nearby party members by 125 for 10s.
passives.descriptionId: Rite of Progeniture: Tectonic Tide akan meningkatkan 125 Elemental Mastery bagi anggota party di sekitarnya selama 10 detik.

passives.name: Flash of Genius
passives.description: When Albedo crafts Weapon Ascension Materials, he has a 10% chance to receive double the product.
passives.descriptionId: Saat membuat Material Ascension Senjata, memiliki 10% kemungkinan untuk mendapatkan hasil 2 kali lipat.

constellations.name: Flower of Eden
constellations.description: Transient Blossoms generated by Albedo's Abiogenesis: Solar Isotoma regenerate 1.2 Energy for Albedo.
constellations.descriptionId: Transient Blossom yang muncul dari skill Abiogenesis: Solar Isotoma akan memulihkan 1,2 Energy Albedo.

constellations.name: Opening of Phanerozoic
constellations.description:
Transient Blossoms generated by Abiogenesis: Solar Isotoma grant Albedo Fatal Reckoning for 30s:
·Unleashing Rite of Progeniture: Tectonic Tide consumes all stacks of Fatal Reckoning. Each stack of Fatal Reckoning consumed increases the DMG dealt by Fatal Blossoms and Rite of Progeniture: Tectonic Tide's burst DMG by 30% of Albedo's DEF.
·This effect stacks up to 4 times.
constellations.descriptionId:
Transient Blossom yang dihasilkan oleh Abiogenesis: Solar Isotoma memberikan Albedo Fatal Reckoning selama 30 detik:
·Melancarkan skill Rite of Progeniture: Tectonic Tide akan mengonsumsi seluruh lapisan Fatal Reckoning, meningkatkan DMG yang diakibatkan oleh Tectonic Tide dan Fatal Blossom berdasarkan jumlah lapisan yang dikonsumsi.
·Setiap lapis Fatal Reckoning akan meningkatkan DMG sebesar 30% DEF Albedo.
Efek ini dapat ditumpuk hingga 4 kali.

constellations.name: Grace of Helios
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Abiogenesis: Solar Isotoma by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.descriptionId:
Meningkatkan 3 level Abiogenesis: Solar Isotoma.
Maksimum: Lv. 15.

constellations.name: Descent of Divinity
constellations.description: Active party members within the Solar Isotoma field have their Plunging Attack DMG increased by 30%.
constellations.descriptionId: Solar Isotoma meningkatkan 30% DMG Plunging Attack untuk Karakter yang berada di dalam area Solar Isotoma.

constellations.name: Tide of Hadean
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Rite of Progeniture: Tectonic Tide by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.descriptionId:
Meningkatkan 3 level Rite of Progeniture: Tectonic Tide.
Maksimum: Lv. 15.

constellations.name: Dust of Purification
constellations.description: Active party members within the Solar Isotoma field who are protected by a shield created by Crystallize, or when Moondrifts are present within the Solar Isotoma field, have their DMG increased by 17%.
constellations.descriptionId: Solar Isotoma akan meningkatkan 17% DMG Karakter aktif yang berada dalam lingkup areanya dan dilindungi oleh Perisai yang tercipta dari reaksi Crystallize, atau saat ada Moondrift dalam lingkup area Solar Isotoma.

name: Alhaitham
title: Admonishing Instruction
description: The current scribe of the Sumeru Akademiya, a man endowed with extraordinary intelligence and talent. He lives free — free from the searching eyes of ordinary people, anyway.
descriptionId: Panitera Akademiya Sumeru saat ini, memiliki kecerdasan dan bakat yang luar biasa. Dia seseorang yang mencintai kebebasan, dan tidak bisa ditemukan kecuali bila dia sendiri ingin ditemukan.

talents.name: Abductive Reasoning
talents.description:
Normal Attack
Performs up to 5 rapid strikes.

Charged Attack
Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to unleash 2 rapid sword strikes.

Plunging Attack
Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground below, damaging opponents along the path and dealing AoE DMG upon impact.
talents.descriptionId:
Normal Attack
Melancarkan hingga 5 serangan pedang berturut-turut.

Charged Attack
Mengonsumsi sejumlah Stamina untuk melancarkan dua tebasan pedang.

Plunging Attack
Menerjang dari udara untuk menghantam tanah di bawahnya, menyerang musuh di jalurnya dan mengakibatkan DMG area saat mendarat.

talents.name: Universality: An Elaboration on Form
talents.description:
Rushes forward, dealing Dendro DMG to nearby opponents when the rush ends, causing a Chisel-Light Mirror to form.
Holding this skill will cause it to behave differently.

Hold
Enters Aiming Mode to adjust the direction of Alhaitham's rush attack.

Chisel-Light Mirror
When this skill is unleashed, Alhaitham will generate 1 Chisel-Light Mirror. If there are no Mirrors at this time, he will generate 1 additional Mirror. Chisel-Light Mirrors will have the following properties:
·When he possesses Chisel-Light Mirrors, Alhaitham's Normal, Charged, and Plunging Attacks will be converted to Dendro DMG. This cannot be overridden.
·When attacks of the aforementioned kind hit opponents, the Chisel-Light Mirrors will unleash a Projection Attack that deals AoE Dendro DMG based on the number of Mirrors on the field.
·A total of 3 Chisel-Light Mirrors can exist at once.
·The Chisel-Light Mirrors will disappear one after the other over time, and will all disappear when Alhaitham leaves the field.

talents.name: Particular Field: Fetters of Phenomena
talents.description:
Creates a Particular Binding Field and deals multiple instances of AoE Dendro DMG.
If Chisel-Light Mirrors exist when this ability is unleashed, all such Mirrors will be consumed and increase the number of DMG instances dealt.
2s after this ability is unleashed, if 0/1/2/3 Mirrors were consumed, Alhaitham will generate 3/2/1/0 new Mirrors in turn.
talents.descriptionId:
Menciptakan Particular Binding Field dan mengakibatkan Dendro DMG Area beberapa kali.
Saat dilancarkan, jika memiliki Chisel-Light Mirror, maka akan menggunakan seluruh Chisel-Light Mirror dan meningkatkan jumlah frekuensi DMG yang diakibatkan.
Dalam 2 detik setelah melancarkan skill ini, Alhaitham akan mendapatkan 3/2/1/0 buah Chisel-Light Mirror jika Alhaitham mengonsumsi 0/1/2/3 buah Chisel-Light Mirror saat skill ini dilancarkan.

passives.name: Four-Causal Correction
passives.description: When Alhaitham's Charged or Plunging Attacks hit opponents, they will generate 1 Chisel-Light Mirror. This effect can be triggered once every 12s.
passives.descriptionId: Saat Charged Attack atau Plunging Attack Alhaitham mengenai musuh, akan menghasilkan satu Chisel-Light Mirror. Efek ini bisa terpicu setiap 12 detik sekali.

passives.name: Mysteries Laid Bare
passives.description:
Each point of Alhaitham's Elemental Mastery will increase the DMG dealt by Projection Attacks and Particular Field: Fetters of Phenomena by 0.1%.
The DMG of both aforementioned abilities can be increased by a maximum of 100% this way.
passives.descriptionId:
Untuk setiap Elemental Mastery yang dimiliki Alhaitham, DMG Serangan Proyektil dan Particular Field: Fetters of Phenomena akan meningkat 0,1%.
Maksimum bonus DMG Serangan Proyektil dan Particular Field: Fetters of Phenomena yang bisa diperoleh dengan cara ini adalah 100%.

passives.name: Law of Reductive Overdetermination
passives.description: When Alhaitham crafts Weapon Ascension Materials, he has a 10% chance to receive double the product.
passives.descriptionId: Saat membuat Material Ascension Senjata, memiliki 10% kemungkinan untuk mendapatkan hasil 2 kali lipat.

constellations.name: Intuition
constellations.description: When a Projection Attack hits an opponent, Universality: An Elaboration on Form's CD is decreased by 1.2s. This effect can be triggered once every 1s.
constellations.descriptionId:
Saat Serangan Proyektil mengenai musuh, akan membuat CD Universality: An Elaboration on Form berkurang 1,2 detik.
Efek ini bisa terpicu 1 detik sekali.

constellations.name: Debate
constellations.description: When Alhaitham generates a Chisel-Light Mirror, his Elemental Mastery will be increased by 50 for 8 seconds, max 4 stacks. Each stack's duration is counted independently. This effect can be triggered even when the maximum number of Chisel-Light Mirrors has been reached.
constellations.descriptionId: Saat Alhaitham menghasilkan Chisel-Light Mirror, untuk setiap 1 Chisel-Light Mirror yang dihasilkan, Elemental Mastery-nya akan meningkat 50 poin selama 8 detik. Efek ini dapat ditumpuk sampai 4 lapis, dan durasi setiap tumpuknya akan dihitung secara terpisah. Efek ini tetap bisa terpicu saat jumlah Chisel-Light Mirror sudah mencapai batas maksimumnya.

constellations.name: Negation
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Universality: An Elaboration on Form by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.descriptionId:
Meningkatkan 3 level Universality: An Elaboration on Form.
Maksimum: Lv. 15.

constellations.name: Elucidation
constellations.description:
When Particular Field: Fetters of Phenomena is unleashed, the following effects will become active based on the number of Chisel-Light Mirrors consumed and created this time around:
·Each Mirror consumed will increase the Elemental Mastery of all other nearby party members by 30 for 15s.
·Each Mirror generated will grant Alhaitham a 10% Dendro DMG Bonus for 15s.

The pre-existing duration of the aforementioned effects will be cleared if you use Particular Field: Fetters of Phenomena again while they are in effect.
constellations.descriptionId:
Saat melancarkan Particular Field: Fetters of Phenomena, akan menghasilkan efek berikut berdasarkan jumlah Chisel-Light Mirror yang terpakai dan yang dihasilkan pada saat melancarkan skill kali ini:
·Untuk setiap 1 Chisel-Light Mirror yang terpakai, Elemental Mastery anggota party lain di sekitar meningkat 30 poin selama 15 detik;
·Untuk setiap 1 Chisel-Light Mirror yang dihasilkan, Alhaitham akan memperoleh 10% Dendro DMG Bonus selama 15 detik.

Jika melancarkan Particular Field: Fetters of Phenomena selama durasi efek di atas masih berlangsung, maka akan menghapus efek awal yang dimiliki.

constellations.name: Sagacity
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Particular Field: Fetters of Phenomena by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.descriptionId:
Meningkatkan 3 level Particular Field: Fetters of Phenomena.
Maksimum: Lv. 15.

constellations.name: Structuration
constellations.description:
Alhaitham gains the following effects:
· 2 seconds after Particular Field: Fetters of Phenomena is unleashed, he will generate 3 Chisel-Light Mirrors regardless of the number of mirrors consumed.
· If Alhaitham generates Chisel-Light Mirrors when their numbers have already maxed out, his CRIT Rate and CRIT DMG will increase by 10% and 70% respectively for 6s. If this effect is triggered again during its initial duration, the duration remaining will be increased by 6s.

name: Arataki Itto
title: Hanamizaka Heroics
description: The first and greatest head of the Arataki Gang, famed throughout Inazuma City's Hanamizaka... Wait, what? You've never heard of them? Are you trying to be funny here?
descriptionId: Ketua Geng Arataki yang Pertama dan yang Terhebat, dan terkenal di Hanamizaka, Kota Inazuma ... Apa katamu? Belum pernah dengar? Mau cari ribut ya?

talents.name: Fight Club Legend
talents.description:
Normal Attack
Performs up to 4 consecutive strikes.
When the 2nd and 4th strikes hit opponents, Itto will gain 1 and 2 stacks of Superlative Superstrength, respectively.
Max 5 stacks. Triggering this effect will refresh the current duration of any existing stacks.

Additionally, Itto's Normal Attack combo does not immediately reset after sprinting or using his Elemental Skill, "Masatsu Zetsugi: Akaushi Burst!"

Charged Attack
When holding to perform a Charged Attack, Itto unleashes a series of Arataki Kesagiri slashes without consuming Stamina. Instead, each Arataki Kesagiri slash consumes 1 stack of Superlative Superstrength. When the final stack is consumed, Itto delivers a powerful final slash.
If no stacks of Superlative Superstrength are available, Itto will perform a single Saichimonji Slash.

Plunging Attack
Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground, damaging opponents along the path and dealing AoE DMG upon impact.
talents.descriptionId:
Normal Attack
Melancarkan hingga 4 serangan berturut-turut.
Serangan ke-2 dan ke-4 yang mengenai musuh masing-masing akan menghasilkan 1 lapis dan 2 lapis efek Superlative Superstrength.
Maksimum dapat ditumpuk hingga 5 lapis. Setiap kali memicu efek ini akan memperbarui durasi Superlative Superstrength yang sudah dimiliki.

Selain itu, selama beberapa saat setelah melancarkan Elemental Skill Masatsu Zetsugi: Akaushi Burst! atau berlari, kombo Normal Attack Itto tidak akan di-reset.

Charged Attack
Bila Itto memiliki Superlative Superstrength saat menahan tombol serang untuk melancarkan Charged Attack, Itto akan melancarkan serangan Arataki Kesagiri tanpa mengonsumsi Stamina. Setiap serangan Arataki Kesagiri akan mengonsumsi 1 lapis Superlative Superstrength. Dan saat mengonsumsi lapisan terakhir, Itto akan melancarkan 1 tebasan akhir dengan DMG yang lebih kuat.
Bila tidak memiliki Superlative Superstrength, Itto akan mengonsumsi Stamina untuk melancarkan 1 tebasan Saichimonji yang kuat.

Plunging Attack
Menerjang dari udara untuk menghantam tanah, menyerang semua musuh di jalurnya dan mengakibatkan DMG Area saat mendarat.

talents.name: Masatsu Zetsugi: Akaushi Burst!
talents.description:
Hurls Ushi, the young akaushi bull and auxiliary member of the Arataki Gang, dealing Geo DMG to opponents on hit. When Ushi hits opponents, Arataki Itto gains 1 stack of Superlative Superstrength.

Ushi will remain on the field and provide support in the following ways:
· Taunts surrounding opponents and draws their attacks.
· Inherits HP based on a percentage of Arataki Itto's Max HP.
· When Ushi takes DMG, Arataki Itto gains 1 stack of Superlative Superstrength. Only 1 stack can be gained in this way every 2s.
· Ushi will flee when its HP reaches 0 or its duration ends. It will grant Arataki Itto 1 stack of Superlative Superstrength when it leaves.

Hold
Adjust throwing angle.

Ushi is considered a Geo construct. Arataki Itto can only deploy 1 Ushi on the field at any one time.
talents.descriptionId:
Melempar Ushi — seekor banteng akaushi muda yang juga adalah anggota tambahan dari Geng Arataki, untuk mengakibatkan Geo DMG pada musuh! Saat Ushi mengenai musuh, Arataki Itto akan memperoleh 1 lapis Superlative Superstrength.

Ushi akan tetap tinggal di medan pertempuran untuk memberikan bantuan:
·Terus menerus mengejek musuh di sekitar untuk menarik perhatiannya.
·HP Ushi mewarisi Max HP Arataki Itto berdasarkan persentase tertentu.
·Saat Ushi terkena DMG, Ushi akan memberikan 1 lapis Superlative Superstrength pada Arataki Itto sendiri. Itto hanya bisa mendapatkan 1 lapis Superlative Superstrength setiap 2 detik dengan cara ini.
·Saat HP-nya mencapai 0 atau durasinya berakhir, Ushi akan pergi meninggalkan medan pertempuran dan memberikan 1 lapis Superlative Superstrength kepada Itto sendiri.

Mode Tahan

Mengatur arah lemparan.

Ushi dianggap sebagai sebuah Geo Construct dan hanya bisa ada 1 Ushi ciptaan Itto sendiri saja di medan pertempuran pada saat bersamaan.

talents.name: Royal Descent: Behold, Itto the Evil!
talents.description:
Time to show 'em the might of the Arataki Gang! For a time, Itto lets out his inner Raging Oni King, wielding his Oni King's Kanabou in battle.
This state has the following special properties:
· Converts Itto's Normal, Charged, and Plunging Attacks to Geo DMG. This cannot be overridden.
· Increases Itto's Normal Attack SPD. Also increases his ATK based on his DEF.
· On hit, the 1st and 3rd strikes of his attack combo will each grant Arataki Itto 1 stack of Superlative Superstrength.
· Decreases Itto's Elemental and Physical RES by 20%.

The Raging Oni King state will be cleared when Itto leaves the field.
talents.descriptionId:
Waktunya untuk menunjukkan wibawa Geng Arataki! Selama beberapa saat, Itto akan berubah menjadi Raging Oni King dan menggunakan Oni King's Kanabou untuk bertarung.
Skill ini memiliki karakteristik berikut:
·DMG yang diakibatkan Normal, Charged, dan Plunging Attack dikonversi menjadi Geo DMG yang tidak bisa ditimpa Elemental Infusion lainnya.
·Meningkatkan Normal Attack SPD Itto, dan meningkatkan ATK Itto berdasarkan DEF miliknya.
·Akan memberikan Itto sendiri 1 lapis Superlative Superstrength saat serangan tahap ke-1 dan ke-3 mengenai musuh.
·Mengurangi 20% seluruh Elemental RES dan Physical RES Itto.

Status Raging Oni King akan lenyap saat Arataki Itto meninggalkan medan pertempuran.

passives.name: Arataki Ichiban
passives.description:
When Arataki Itto uses consecutive Arataki Kesagiri, he obtains the following effects:
· Each slash increases the ATK SPD of the next slash by 10%. Max ATK SPD increase is 30%.
· Increases his resistance to interruption.

These effects will be cleared once he stops performing consecutive slashes.
passives.descriptionId:
Saat melancarkan Arataki Kesagiri secara beruntun, Arataki Itto akan memperoleh efek-efek berikut:
·Setiap tebasan akan meningkatkan 10% ATK SPD untuk tebasan berikutnya. Dengan cara ini, ATK SPD dapat meningkat hingga 30%.
·Meningkatkan ketahanan terhadap interupsi.

Efek-efek ini akan menghilang saat Itto berhenti melancarkan tebasan beruntun.

passives.name: Bloodline of the Crimson Oni
passives.description: Arataki Kesagiri DMG is increased by 35% of Arataki Itto's DEF.
passives.descriptionId: Meningkatkan DMG Arataki Kesagiri sebesar 35% DEF Arataki Itto.

passives.name: Woodchuck Chucked
passives.description: When a party member uses attacks to obtain wood from a tree, they have a 25% chance to get an additional log of wood.
passives.descriptionId: Saat anggota party sendiri memperoleh kayu dengan menyerang pohon, ada 25% kemungkinan untuk memperoleh kayu tambahan.

constellations.name: Stay a While and Listen Up
constellations.description: After using Royal Descent: Behold, Itto the Evil!, Arataki Itto gains 2 stacks of Superlative Superstrength. After 1s, Itto will gain 1 stack of Superlative Superstrength every 0.5s for 1.5s.
constellations.descriptionId: Setelah melancarkan Royal Descent: Behold, Itto the Evil!, Arataki Itto akan mendapatkan 2 lapis efek Superlative Superstrength. Setelah 1 detik, Itto akan mendapatkan 1 lapis Superlative Superstrength setiap 0,5 detik, dan berlangsung selama 1,5 detik.

constellations.name: Gather 'Round, It's a Brawl!
constellations.description:
After using Royal Descent: Behold, Itto the Evil!, each party member whose Element is Geo will decrease that skill's CD by 1.5s and restore 6 Energy to Arataki Itto.
CD can be decreased by up to 4.5s in this manner. Max 18 Energy can be restored in this manner.
constellations.descriptionId:
Setelah melancarkan Royal Descent: Behold, Itto the Evil!, CD skill ini akan berkurang 1,5 detik untuk setiap Karakter Geo yang ada di dalam party, dan akan memulihkan 6 Energy Arataki Itto.
Dengan cara ini, CD dapat berkurang maksimum hingga 4,5 detik, dan Energy dapat pulih maksimum hingga 18 Energy.

constellations.name: Horns Lowered, Coming Through
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Masatsu Zetsugi: Akaushi Burst! by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.descriptionId:
Meningkatkan 3 level Masatsu Zetsugi: Akaushi Burst!.
Maksimum: Lv. 15.

constellations.name: Jailhouse Bread and Butter
constellations.description: When the Raging Oni King state caused by Royal Descent: Behold, Itto the Evil! ends, all nearby party members gain 20% DEF and 20% ATK for 10s.
constellations.descriptionId: Setelah status Raging Oni King yang didapatkan dari Royal Descent: Behold, Itto the Evil! berakhir, DEF dan ATK seluruh anggota party di sekitar meningkat 20% selama 10 detik.

constellations.name: 10 Years of Hanamizaka Fame
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Royal Descent: Behold, Itto the Evil! by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.descriptionId:
Meningkatkan 3 level Royal Descent: Behold, Itto the Evil!.
Maksimum: Lv. 15.

constellations.name: Arataki Itto, Present!
constellations.description: Arataki Itto's Charged Attacks deal +70% CRIT DMG. Additionally, when he uses Arataki Kesagiri, he has a 50% chance to not consume stacks of Superlative Superstrength.
constellations.descriptionId: Meningkatkan 70% Crit DMG untuk Charged Attack Arataki Itto. Selain itu, saat melancarkan Arataki Kesagiri, Itto memiliki 50% kemungkinan untuk tidak mengonsumsi lapisan Superlative Superstrength.

name: Arlecchino
title: Dire Balemoon
description: "The Knave," Fourth of the Fatui Harbingers. A poised, ruthless diplomat. To the children in the House of the Hearth, she is their feared yet dependable "Father."
descriptionId: Fatui Harbinger ke-4 "The Knave". Diplomat yang tenang dan kejam. Dikenal sebagai "Ayah" yang dihormati dan dapat diandalkan oleh anak-anak di House of the Hearth.

talents.name: Invitation to a Beheading
talents.description:
Normal Attack
Performs up to 6 consecutive spear strikes.

Charged Attack
Consumes a fixed amount of Stamina, dashing toward a nearby opponent and cleaving once.
Continuously holding this button will cause Arlecchino to consume Stamina and engage in up to 5s of high-speed movement.

Plunging Attack
Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground below, damaging opponents along the path and dealing AoE DMG upon impact.

Masque of the Red Death
When Arlecchino has a Bond of Life equal to or greater than 30% of her Max HP, she will enter the "Masque of the Red Death" state, where her Normal, Charged, and Plunging Attacks will be converted to deal Pyro DMG. This cannot be overridden.
When in the "Masque of the Red Death" state, Arlecchino's Normal Attacks will deal extra DMG to opponents on hit that scales off her ATK multiplied by a certain ratio of her current Bond of Life percentage. This will consume 7.5% of said current Bond of Life. Her Bond of Life can be consumed this way every 0.03s. When her Bond of Life is consumed in this manner, All Is Ash's CD will decrease by 0.8s.
talents.descriptionId:
Normal Attack
Melancarkan hingga 6 serangan tombak beruntun.

Charged Attack
Mengonsumsi sejumlah Stamina untuk menerjang ke arah musuh di sekitar dan melancarkan satu kali tebasan.
Saat terus ditahan, Arlecchino akan mengonsumsi Stamina untuk bergerak dengan kecepatan tinggi selama maksimum 5 detik.

Plunging Attack
Menerjang dari udara untuk menghantam tanah, menyerang musuh di jalur terjangan dan mengakibatkan DMG area saat mendarat.

Masque of the Red Death
Saat Bond of Life yang dimiliki Arlecchino lebih besar atau sama dengan 30% Max HP-nya, akan memasuki status "Masque of the Red Death": DMG yang disebabkan Normal Attack, Charged Attack, dan Plunging Attack Arlecchino akan dikonversi menjadi Pyro DMG yang tidak bisa ditimpa oleh Elemental Infusion lainnya.
Saat berada dalam status "Masque of the Red Death", saat Normal Attack Arlecchino mengenai musuh, DMG yang diakibatkan serangan kali ini meningkat sebesar ATK Arlecchino dikalikan sejumlah persentase Bond of Life saat ini. Serangan ini juga akan mengurangi 7,5% Bond of Life saat ini. Bond of Life bisa berkurang dengan cara ini maksimum sekali setiap 0,03 detik. Saat Bond of Life berkurang dengan cara ini, maka CD Elemental Skill "All is Ash" berkurang 0,8 detik.

talents.name: All Is Ash
talents.description:
Summons forth Balemoon Bloodfire, dealing Pyro DMG to multiple nearby opponents and performing a dash-cleave against one of them, dealing AoE Pyro DMG.
Opponents hit by the aforementioned attack will have a Blood-Debt Directive applied to them.

Blood-Debt Directive
·Lasts 30s. Every 5s, it will deal 1 instance of Pyro DMG to the opponent. Max 2 instances. This DMG will be considered Elemental Skill DMG.
·When Arlecchino uses a Charged Attack or her Elemental Burst, Balemoon Rising, she will absorb and clear nearby Blood-Debt Directives. Each Directive absorbed grants her a Bond of Life worth 65% of her Max HP.
·The maximum value of the Bond of Life she can be granted through Blood-Debt Directives within 35s after using her Elemental Skill is 145% of her Max HP. Using the Elemental Skill again during this duration will restart the count on duration and the limit on the value of Bond of Life she may gain from Blood-Debt Directives.

talents.name: Balemoon Rising
talents.description: Arlecchino's great wing of Balemoon Bloodfire beats as she absorbs and clears Blood-Debt Directives around her. She deals AoE Pyro DMG before clearing the CD of All Is Ash and healing herself. The healing is based on her Bond of Life value and ATK.
talents.descriptionId: Arlecchino mengepakkan sayap Balemoon Bloodfire, menyerap dan membersihkan Blood-Debt Directive di sekitar, serta mengakibatkan Pyro DMG Area. Setelahnya, juga akan menghapus CD Elemental Skill "All is Ash" dan memulihkan HP diri sendiri berdasarkan nilai Bond of Life dan ATK miliknya.

passives.name: Agony Alone May Be Repaid
passives.description:
Blood-Debt Directives have the following characteristics:
·Arlecchino will be granted a Bond of Life worth 130% of her Max HP when an opponent to which she herself applied a Directive is defeated.
·5s after a Directive is applied, it will be upgraded to a Blood-Debt Due. When absorbed, it will instead grant Arlecchino a Bond of Life worth 130%.
A Bond of Life created in the aforementioned ways cannot exceed the original limit on the value of Bonds of Life obtained through All Is Ash.
passives.descriptionId:
Blood-Debt Directives memiliki ciri khas sebagai berikut:
·Saat musuh yang memiliki Blood-Debt Directive yang diberikan oleh Arlecchino sendiri dikalahkan, Arlecchino akan mendapatkan Bond of Life sebesar 130% Max HP-nya;
·5 detik setelah diberikan, akan meningkat menjadi Blood-Debt Due. Saat diserap, akan memberikan Bond of Life kepada Arlecchino sebesar 130%.
Nilai pemulihan Bond of Life yang diciptakan dengan cara di atas tidak akan bisa melebihi batasan awal All is Ash.

passives.name: Strength Alone Can Defend
passives.description: Arlecchino gains 1% All Elemental and Physical RES for every 100 ATK she has in excess of 1,000. The maximum RES increase she can gain this way for each is 20%.
passives.descriptionId: Arlecchino mendapatkan 1% Elemental RES dari semua elemen dan Physical RES untuk setiap 100 poin ATK yang melebihi 1.000 poin. Peningkatan RES maksimum yang bisa didapatkan dengan cara ini adalah 20% untuk masing-masing RES.

passives.name: The Balemoon Alone May Know
passives.description: While in combat, Arlecchino gains a 40% Pyro DMG Bonus and can only be healed through Balemoon Rising.
passives.descriptionId: Saat bertempur, Arlecchino mendapatkan 40% Pyro DMG Bonus dan HP-nya hanya bisa dipulihkan melalui Balemoon Rising.

constellations.name: "All Reprisals and Arrears, Mine to Bear..."
constellations.description: Masque of the Red Death is further enhanced, the value of the increase is 100%. Additionally, Arlecchino's interruption resistance is increased when she performs Normal or Charged Attacks while affected by the Masque of the Red Death.
constellations.descriptionId: Kekuatan Masque of the Red Death ditingkatkan lagi dengan nilai peningkatan sebesar 100%. Selain itu, saat melancarkan Normal Attack atau Charged Attack dalam status Masque of the Red Death, ketahanan Arlecchino terhadap interupsi akan meningkat.

constellations.name: "All Rewards and Retribution, Mine to Bestow..."
constellations.description:
Blood-Debt Directives are now already Blood-Debt Due when first applied.
When Arlecchino absorbs such a Due, she unleashes Balemoon Bloodfire in front of her, dealing 900% of her ATK as AoE Pyro DMG and increasing her All Elemental RES and Physical RES by 20% for 15s. This effect can trigger once every 10s.
You must first unlock the Ascension Talent "Agony Alone May Be Repaid."
constellations.descriptionId:
Blood-Debt Directive akan langsung menjadi Blood-Debt Due saat diberikan.
Saat Arlecchino menyerap Blood-Debt Due, akan memanggil Balemoon Bloodfire di depannya yang mengakibatkan Pyro DMG Area sebesar 900% ATK Arlecchino dan meningkatkan Elemental RES dari semua elemen dan Physical RES miliknya sebesar 20% selama 15 detik. Efek ini dapat terpicu sekali setiap 10 detik.
Harus membuka Talenta Ascension "Agony Alone May Be Repaid" terlebih dahulu.

constellations.name: "You Shall Become a New Member of Our Family..."
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Normal Attack: Invitation to a Beheading by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.descriptionId:
Meningkatkan 3 level Normal Attack: Invitation to a Beheading.
Maksimum: Lv. 15.

constellations.name: "You Shall Love and Protect Each Other Henceforth..."
constellations.description: When Arlecchino successfully absorbs a Blood-Debt Directive, Balemoon Rising's CD will decrease by 2s and 15 Elemental Energy will be restored to her. This effect can occur once every 10s.
constellations.descriptionId: Saat Arlecchino berhasil menyerap Blood-Debt Directive, CD Balemoon Rising akan berkurang 2 detik dan memulihkan 15 Energy. Efek ini dapat terpicu sekali setiap 10 detik.

constellations.name: "For Alone, We Are as Good as Dead..."
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Balemoon Rising by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.descriptionId:
Meningkatkan 3 level Balemoon Rising.
Maksimum: Lv. 15.

constellations.name: "From This Day On, We Shall Delight in New Life Together."
constellations.description:
The DMG of Balemoon Rising is increased by Arlecchino's ATK multiplied by 700% of Arlecchino's current Bond of Life percentage.
For 20s after Arlecchino uses All Is Ash, both her Normal Attacks and Elemental Burst gain 10% increased CRIT Rate and 70% increased CRIT DMG. This effect can be triggered up to once every 15s.
constellations.descriptionId:
DMG Balemoon Rising meningkat sebesar ATK Arlecchino dikalikan 700% dari persentase Bond of Life Arlecchino saat ini.
Selama 20 detik setelah Arlecchino melancarkan All is Ash, Normal Attack dan Elemental Burst Arlecchino akan mendapatkan peningkatan 10% CRIT Rate dan 70% CRIT DMG. Efek ini dapat terpicu sekali setiap 15 detik.

name: Baizhu
title: Beyond Mortality
description: The owner of Bubu Pharmacy, who is rarely seen without the white snake named Changsheng. His medicinal knowledge is encyclopedic, and his personal intrigues subtle.
descriptionId: Pemilik Bubu Pharmacy. Dia sering membawa ular putih bernama Changsheng di pundaknya. Dia adalah seorang dokter yang terampil dan cerdas.
cvJapanese: 遊佐浩二 & 庄子裕衣

talents.name: The Classics of Acupuncture
talents.description:
Normal Attack
Performs up to 4 attacks that deal Dendro DMG to opponents in front of him.

Charged Attack
Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to deal AoE Dendro DMG to opponents in front of him after a short casting time.

Plunging Attack
Calling upon the might of Dendro, Baizhu plunges towards the ground from mid-air, damaging all opponents in his path. Deals AoE Dendro DMG upon impact with the ground.
talents.descriptionId:
Normal Attack
Melancarkan hingga 4 serangan ke arah depan dan mengakibatkan Dendro DMG.

Charged Attack
Mengonsumsi sejumlah Stamina untuk mengakibatkan Dendro DMG Area ke area di depannya setelah jeda singkat.

Plunging Attack
Mengumpulkan kekuatan Dendro dan menerjang tanah, menyerang musuh di jalur terjangan dan mengakibatkan Dendro DMG Area saat mendarat.

talents.name: Universal Diagnosis
talents.description:
Controls a Gossamer Sprite that cruises and attacks nearby opponents, dealing Dendro DMG.
After it performs 3 attacks or if there are no opponents nearby, the Sprite will return, healing all nearby party members based on Baizhu's Max HP.
talents.descriptionId:
Mengendalikan Gossamer Sprite yang melayang-layang dan bisa menyerang musuh di sekitar, mengakibatkan Dendro DMG.
Setelah menyerang maksimum sebanyak 3 kali atau saat tidak ada musuh di sekitar, Gossamer Sprite akan kembali dan memulihkan HP seluruh anggota party berdasarkan Max HP Baizhu.

talents.name: Holistic Revivification
talents.description:
Enters the Pulsing Clarity state, creating a Seamless Shield that absorbs Dendro DMG with 250% effectiveness.
While in this state, Baizhu will generate a new Seamless Shield every 2.5s.

The Seamless Shield will heal your own active character based on Baizhu's Max HP and attack opponents by unleashing Spiritveins, dealing Dendro DMG under the following circumstances:
·When a character is under the protection of a Seamless Shield and a new Seamless Shield is generated.
·When the Seamless Shield's effects expire, or when it is shattered.
talents.descriptionId:
Memasuki status Pulsing Clarity dan menciptakan Seamless Shield yang memiliki 250% pertahanan terhadap Dendro DMG.
Dalam status Pulsing Clarity, Baizhu akan menciptakan Seamless Shield baru setiap 2,5 detik.

Seamless Shield akan memulihkan HP Karakter aktifmu sendiri berdasarkan Max HP Baizhu, kemudian melancarkan Spiritvein untuk menyerang musuh dan mengakibatkan Dendro DMG dalam kondisi-kondisi berikut ini:
·Saat Karakter berada dalam perlindungan Seamless Shield dan tercipta sebuah Seamless Shield yang baru;
·Saat efek Seamless Shield berakhir atau saat Seamless Shield hancur terkena DMG.

passives.name: Five Fortunes Forever
passives.description:
Baizhu gains different effects according to the current HP of your current active character:
·When their HP is less than 50%, Baizhu gains 20% Healing Bonus.
·When their HP is equal to or more than 50%, Baizhu gains 25% Dendro DMG Bonus.

passives.name: All Things Are of the Earth
passives.description: Characters who are healed by Seamless Shields will gain the Year of Verdant Favor effect: Each 1,000 Max HP that Baizhu possesses that does not exceed 50,000 will increase the Burning, Bloom, Hyperbloom, and Burgeon reaction DMG dealt by these characters by 2%, their Lunar-Bloom DMG by 0.7%, and the DMG Bonus provided by Aggravate and Spread by 0.8%. This effect lasts 6s.
passives.descriptionId: Karakter yang menerima pemulihan HP dari Seamless Shield akan mendapatkan efek Year of Verdant Favor: Untuk setiap 1.000 poin Max HP Baizhu (maksimum 50.000 poin), Karakter tersebut akan mendapatkan peningkatan DMG untuk reaksi Burning, Bloom, Hyperbloom, dan Burgeon sebesar 2%, peningkatan Bonus DMG dari reaksi Aggravate dan Spread sebesar 0,8%, dan peningkatan Bonus DMG dari reaksi Lunar-Bloom sebesar 0,7%. Efek ini berlangsung selama 6 detik.

passives.name: Herbal Nourishment
passives.description: When Baizhu is in the party, interacting with certain harvestable items will heal your current active character for 2.5% of Baizhu's Max HP.
passives.descriptionId: Saat Baizhu berada di dalam party, berinteraksi dengan beberapa material yang bisa dikumpulkan akan memulihkan HP Karakter aktif sebesar 2,5% Max HP Baizhu.

constellations.name: Attentive Observation
constellations.description: Universal Diagnosis gains 1 additional charge.
constellations.descriptionId: Menambahkan 1 charge Universal Diagnosis.

constellations.name: Incisive Discernment
constellations.description:
When your own active character hits a nearby opponent with their attacks, Baizhu will unleash a Gossamer Sprite: Splice.
Gossamer Sprite: Splice will initiate 1 attack before returning, dealing 250% of Baizhu's ATK as Dendro DMG and healing for 20% of Universal Diagnosis's Gossamer Sprite's normal healing.
DMG dealt this way is considered Elemental Skill DMG.
This effect can be triggered once every 5s.
constellations.descriptionId:
Saat serangan Karakter aktif di dalam party sendiri mengenai musuh yang ada di sekitar, Baizhu akan melancarkan Gossamer Sprite: Splice.
Gossamer Sprite: Splice akan kembali setelah menyerang maksimum 1 kali, mengakibatkan Dendro DMG sebesar 250% ATK Baizhu dan memulihkan HP sebesar 20% berdasarkan jumlah pemulihan Gossamer Sprite dari Universal Diagnosis.
DMG yang diakibatkan dengan cara ini akan dianggap sebagai DMG Elemental Skill.
Efek ini dapat terpicu sekali setiap 5 detik.

constellations.name: All Aspects Stabilized
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Holistic Revivification by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.descriptionId:
Meningkatkan 3 level Holistic Revivification.
Maksimum: Lv. 15.

constellations.name: Ancient Art of Perception
constellations.description: For 15s after Holistic Revivification is used, Baizhu will increase all nearby party members' Elemental Mastery by 80.
constellations.descriptionId: Setelah melancarkan Holistic Revivification, Elemental Mastery seluruh anggota party di sekitar meningkat 80 poin selama 15 detik.

constellations.name: The Hidden Ebb and Flow
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Universal Diagnosis by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.descriptionId:
Meningkatkan 3 level Universal Diagnosis.
Maksimum: Lv. 15.

constellations.name: Elimination of Malicious Qi
constellations.description:
Increases the DMG dealt by Holistic Revivification's Spiritveins by 8% of Baizhu's Max HP.
Additionally, when a Gossamer Sprite or Gossamer Sprite: Splice hits opponents, there is a 100% chance of generating one of Holistic Revivification's Seamless Shields. This effect can only be triggered once by each Gossamer Sprite or Gossamer Sprite: Splice.
constellations.descriptionId:
DMG yang diakibatkan Spiritvein dari skill Holistic Revivification meningkat sebesar 8% Max HP Baizhu.
Selain itu, saat serangan Gossamer Sprite atau Gossamer Sprite: Splice mengenai musuh, ada 100% kemungkinan untuk menciptakan Perisai Seamless Shield dari skill Holistic Revivification. Efek ini hanya dapat terpicu satu kali untuk setiap Gossamer Sprite atau Gossamer Sprite: Splice.

name: Chasca
title: Skyborne Arbiter
description: The Peacemaker of the Tlalocan, the ender of all disputes.
descriptionId: "Penengah" Tlalocan yang sudah berhasil mengakhiri perselisihan yang tak terhitung jumlahnya.

talents.name: Phantom Feather Flurry
talents.description:
Normal Attack
Performs up to 4 consecutive shots with a bow.

Charged Attack
Performs a more precise Aimed Shot with increased DMG.
While aiming, mighty winds will accumulate on the arrowhead. A fully charged wind arrow will deal Anemo DMG.

Plunging Attack
Fires off a shower of arrows in mid-air before falling and striking the ground, hitting opponents along the path and dealing AoE DMG upon impact.
talents.descriptionId:
Normal Attack
Melancarkan hingga 4 tembakan panah berturut-turut menggunakan busur.

Charged Attack
Melancarkan sebuah Serangan Membidik yang lebih akurat untuk mengakibatkan DMG yang lebih besar.
Saat membidik, angin kuat akan berkumpul di ujung anak panah. Panah dengan angin kuat yang terkumpul penuh akan mengakibatkan Anemo DMG.

Plunging Attack
Melancarkan hujan panah dari udara, menerjang tanah dengan kecepatan tinggi, menyerang musuh di jalur terjangan, dan mengakibatkan DMG Area saat mendarat.

talents.name: Spirit Reins, Shadow Hunt
talents.description:
Chasca and the will residing in her weapon resonate, dealing Nightsoul-aligned AoE Anemo DMG.
After using this Skill, Chasca gains 80 Nightsoul points and enters the Nightsoul's Blessing state.

Nightsoul's Blessing: Chasca
Continually consume Nightsoul points. When Nightsoul points are fully depleted or the skill is used again, Chasca's Nightsoul's Blessing state will end. Her Nightsoul's Blessing has the following traits:
·Mounts "Soulsniper: Ritual Staff," increasing Chasca's Movement SPD and interruption resistance. In this state, Chasca will continually consume Nightsoul points to remain airborne. When Sprinting or increasing height, extra Nightsoul points will be consumed.
·When using Normal or Charged Attacks, Tap or Hold to switch between using "Multitarget Fire" in different ways.

Multitarget Fire
Tap
Deal Nightsoul-aligned Anemo DMG to opponents in front. This DMG is considered Normal Attack DMG.
Hold
Enter Aiming Mode and choose a certain number of opponents within a certain range, before loading up to 6 Shadowhunt Shells based on the duration for which the skill was charged. When 6 Shells have been loaded or charging is stopped, these Shells will be fired at the chosen opponents in sequence.

Shadowhunt Shells
·Deal Nightsoul-aligned Anemo DMG, which is considered Charged Attack DMG.
·The 4th, 5th, and 6th Shells loaded into the cylinder will undergo Elemental Conversion based on the Elemental Types of the other characters in the party: For each Pyro, Hydro, Cryo, or Electro character in the party, one Shadowhunt Shell will randomly be Converted into a "Shining Shadowhunt Shell" of one of these corresponding Elemental Types, dealing Nightsoul-aligned DMG corresponding to that Elemental Type. This DMG is considered Charged Attack DMG.
·The Shells loaded into the cylinder are fired starting from the last Shadowhunt Shell to be loaded, in a "last in, first out" order.

Additionally, when Chasca is in the Nightsoul's Blessing state, Holding her Elemental Skill Spirit Reins, Shadow Hunt will cause her to execute a Nightsoul-aligned Plunging Attack. Release the Elemental Skill to interrupt this Plunging Attack and maintain her airborne state. Should Chasca hit the ground with her Plunging Attack, her Nightsoul's Blessing state will end.
talents.descriptionId:
Chasca beresonansi dengan kehendak yang bermukim di dalam senjatanya untuk mengakibatkan Nightsoul-aligned Anemo DMG Area.
Setelah dilancarkan, Chasca akan mendapatkan 80 poin Nightsoul dan memasuki status Nightsoul's Blessing.

Nightsoul's Blessing: Chasca
Terus-menerus mengonsumsi poin Nightsoul. Saat seluruh poin Nightsoul dikonsumsi, atau saat Skill dilancarkan sekali lagi, status Nightsoul's Blessing Chasca akan berakhir. Status Nightsoul's Blessing memiliki karakteristik sebagai berikut:
·Chasca akan menunggangi "Soulsniper: Ritual Staff", meningkatkan kecepatan bergerak dan ketahanannya terhadap interupsi. Dalam kondisi ini, Chasca akan terus mengonsumsi poin Nightsoul untuk mempertahankan status melayangnya. Akan mengonsumsi poin Nightsoul tambahan saat menekan tombol Lari atau meningkatkan ketinggian.
·Saat melancarkan Normal Attack atau Charged Attack, Chasca akan melancarkan "Multitarget Fire" dengan cara yang berbeda berdasarkan Mode Tahan atau Mode Tekan.

Multitarget Fire
Mode Tekan
Mengakibatkan Nightsoul-aligned Anemo DMG terhadap musuh yang ada di depan. DMG ini akan dianggap sebagai DMG Normal Attack.
Mode Tahan
Memasuki status Membidik, lalu menargetkan sejumlah musuh dalam area tertentu dan mengisi hingga 6 buah Shadowhunt Shell sesuai durasi Charge-nya. Saat sudah mengisi enam peluru atau saat berhenti melakukan Charge, Chasca akan menembakkan peluru-peluru ini ke arah musuh yang ditargetkan sesuai urutan.

Shadowhunt Shell
·Mengakibatkan Nightsoul-aligned Anemo DMG, DMG ini dianggap sebagai DMG Charged Attack.
·Peluru Shadowhunt Shell keempat, kelima, dan keenam yang terisi akan dikonversi elemennya berdasarkan jenis elemen Karakter lain yang berada di dalam party. Untuk setiap satu Karakter berelemen Pyro, Hydro, Cryo, atau Electro di dalam party, satu Shadowhunt Shell acak akan dikonversi menjadi "Shining Shadowhunt Shell" dari salah satu jenis elemen yang sesuai dan mengakibatkan Nightsoul-aligned Elemental DMG dengan tipe elemen yang sesuai. DMG ini dianggap sebagai DMG Charged Attack.
·Peluru "Shadowhunt Shell" yang diisi terakhir akan ditembakkan lebih dulu.

Selain itu, saat dalam status Nightsoul's Blessing, menahan tombol Elemental Skill Spirit Reins, Shadow Hunt akan membuat Chasca melancarkan Nightsoul-aligned Plunging Attack. Saat melepaskan tombol Skill, Chasca akan menghentikan Plunging Attack-nya dan kembali melayang di udara. Jika Chasca melancarkan Plunging Attack ini hingga menyentuh tanah, maka status Nightsoul's Blessing-nya akan berakhir.

talents.name: Soul Reaper's Fatal Round
talents.description:
Chasca concentrates her will, firing a single "Galesplitting Soulseeker Shell" that deals Nightsoul-aligned AoE Anemo DMG. Afterward, the Galesplitting Soulseeker Shell will split into 6 Soulseeker Shells, which attack nearby opponents.

Soulseeker Shells
·Deal Nightsoul-aligned Anemo DMG.
·For each Pyro, Hydro, Cryo, or Electro character in the party, two Soulseeker Shells will undergo corresponding Elemental Conversions to become "Radiant Soulseeker Shells," which deal Nightsoul-aligned Elemental DMG from a randomly selected one of the corresponding Elemental Types.
talents.descriptionId:
Chasca mengumpulkan tekadnya dan menembakkan sebuah "Galesplitting Soulseeker Shell" untuk mengakibatkan Nightsoul-aligned Anemo DMG Area. Setelah ditembakkan, Galesplitting Soulseeker Shell akan terpecah menjadi enam Soulseeker Shell yang menyerang musuh di sekitar.

Soulseeker Shell
·Mengakibatkan Nightsoul-aligned Anemo DMG.
·Untuk setiap satu Karakter berelemen Pyro, Hydro, Cryo, atau Electro di dalam party, dua buah Soulseeker Shell acak akan dikonversi menjadi "Radiant Soulseeker Shell" dengan salah satu jenis elemen yang sesuai dan mengakibatkan Nightsoul-aligned Elemental DMG dengan tipe elemen tersebut.

passives.name: Bullet Trick
passives.description:
When the Elemental Skill Spirit Reins, Shadow Hunt's Multitarget Fire is being charged, if there are party members who meet the Elemental Conversion Type requirements, gain the following effects based on the number of different eligible Elemental Types present:
·There is a 33.3%/66.7%/100% chance for each Type to trigger "Spiritbinding Conversion" and cause the 3rd Shadowhunt Shell loaded into the cylinder to be randomly converted into a Shining Shadowhunt Shell from one of the corresponding Elemental Types.
·Each Elemental Type will grant Chasca 1 stack of Spirit of the Radiant Shadow, increasing the DMG of Shining Shadowhunt Shell by 15%/35%/65%. This effect lasts until the current Multitarget Fire ends. Max 3 stacks.
passives.descriptionId:
Saat melakukan charge Multitarget Fire dari Elemental Skill Spirit Reins, Shadow Hunt, jika di dalam party terdapat Karakter dengan jenis elemen yang memenuhi syarat konversi elemen, maka Chasca akan mendapatkan efek berikut berdasarkan jumlah jenis elemen yang berbeda:
·Untuk setiap jenis elemennya, ada 33,3%/66,7%/100% kemungkinan untuk memicu "Spiritbinding Conversion". Efek ini membuat peluru Shadowhunt Shell ketiga dikonversi menjadi Shining Shadowhunt Shell dengan salah satu jenis elemen acak yang sesuai.
·Setiap jenis elemen akan memberikan satu lapis efek Spirit of the Radiant Shadow bagi Chasca, sehingga DMG yang diakibatkan Shining Shadowhunt Shell meningkat 15%/35%/65%. Efek ini berlangsung sampai Multitarget Fire kali ini berakhir, dapat ditumpuk sampai 3 lapis.

passives.name: Intent to Cover
passives.description:
When a nearby party member triggers a Nightsoul Burst, Chasca will fire a "Burning Shadowhunt Shot" at a nearby opponent, dealing Nightsoul-aligned Anemo DMG equal to 150% of the Shadowhunt Shell DMG from her Elemental Skill Spirit Reins, Shadow Hunt. If the party has Pyro, Hydro, Cryo, or Electro characters, the Burning Shadowhunt Shot will be converted to deal Nightsoul-aligned Elemental DMG of the corresponding Elemental Type equal to 150% of the DMG dealt by Spirit Reins, Shadow Hunt's Shining Shadowhunt Shells.
The DMG done in this way is considered Charged Attack DMG.
passives.descriptionId:
Saat Karakter di sekitar memicu Nightsoul Burst, Chasca akan menembakkan "Burning Shadowhunt Shot" terhadap musuh di sekitar, mengakibatkan Nightsoul-aligned Anemo DMG yang setara dengan 150% DMG Shadowhunt Shell dari Elemental Skill Spirit Reins, Shadow Hunt miliknya. Jika ada Karakter berelemen Pyro, Hydro, Cryo, atau Electro di dalam party, maka Burning Shadowhunt Shot akan dikonversi elemennya dan mengakibatkan Nightsoul-aligned Elemental DMG dengan tipe elemen yang sesuai, DMG ini setara dengan 150% DMG yang diakibatkan oleh Shining Shadowhunt Shell dari skill Spirit Reins, Shadow Hunt.
DMG yang diakibatkan dengan cara ini dianggap sebagai DMG Charged Attack.

passives.name: Night Realm's Gift: Everburning Heart
passives.description:
After her Nightsoul points are exhausted, Chasca will switch to consuming Phlogiston to maintain her Nightsoul's Blessing.
While in an area with Phlogiston Mechanics within Natlan, she can use Nightsoul Transmission: Chasca. When the active character is in the air, the following will occur when switching to Chasca: Chasca will enter the Nightsoul's Blessing state and gain 32 Nightsoul points. Nightsoul Transmission can be triggered once every 10s by your own team.
passives.descriptionId:
Setelah poin Nightsoul habis terpakai, Chasca akan mengonsumsi Phlogiston untuk mempertahankan status Nightsoul's Blessing-nya.
Saat ada area dengan Phlogiston Mechanic di Natlan, dapat melancarkan Nightsoul Transmission: Chasca. Saat Karakter aktif melayang di ketinggian tertentu, dan mengganti Karakter menjadi Chasca, akan memicu efek berikut: Chasca akan memasuki status Nightsoul's Blessing dan mendapatkan 32 poin Nightsoul. Party sendiri dapat memicu Nightsoul Transmission sekali setiap 10 detik.

passives.name: Mediation's True Meaning
passives.description:
25 Phlogiston will be restored when your own party members defeat an opponent. This effect can trigger once every 12s.
This has no effect in Domains, Trounce Domains, or the Spiral Abyss.
passives.descriptionId:
Saat Karakter party sendiri mengalahkan musuh, akan memulihkan 25 poin Phlogiston. Efek ini dapat terpicu sekali setiap 12 detik.
Efek ini tidak aktif dalam Domain, Trounce Domain, atau Spiral Abyss.

constellations.name: Cylinder, the Restless Roulette
constellations.description:
When triggering the Ascension Talent "Bullet Trick"'s "Spiritbinding Conversion," the 2nd Shadowhunt Shell loaded into the cylinder will be additionally converted into a Shining Shadowhunt Shell.
The chance to trigger "Spiritbinding Conversion" is increased: If there are party members who meet the Elemental Conversion Type requirements, the chance to trigger "Spiritbinding Conversion" is increased by 33.3%, up to a maximum of 100%.

You must first unlock the Ascension Talent "Bullet Trick."
In addition, Chasca's Nightsoul point and Phlogiston consumption in her Nightsoul's Blessing state is decreased by 30% while out of combat.
constellations.descriptionId:
Memicu efek "Spiritbinding Conversion" dari Talenta Ascension "Bullet Trick" akan mengakibatkan Shadowhunt Shell kedua yang dimasukkan ke silinder peluru berubah menjadi Shining Shadowhunt Shell.
Kemungkinan untuk memicu "Spiritbinding Conversion" akan meningkat: jika terdapat Karakter dengan jenis elemen yang sesuai dengan syarat konversi elemen di dalam party, kemungkinan untuk memicu "Spiritbinding Conversion" meningkat 33,3%, hingga maksimum 100%.

Harus membuka Talenta Ascension "Bullet Trick" terlebih dahulu.
Selain itu, saat tidak berada dalam kondisi bertempur, konsumsi Phlogiston dan poin Nightsoul Chasca dalam status Nightsoul's Blessing akan berkurang 30%.

constellations.name: Muzzle, the Searing Smoke
constellations.description:
When Chasca takes the field, she will obtain 1 stack of "Spirit of the Radiant Shadow" from the Ascension Talent "Bullet Trick." You must first unlock the Ascension Talent "Bullet Trick" for this effect.
In addition, when the Shining Shadowhunt Shells from Spirit Reins, Shadow Hunt's Multitarget Fire hit opponents, they will deal AoE Elemental DMG of the corresponding Elemental Type of the Shining Shadowhunt Shells equal to 400% of Chasca's ATK. This DMG is considered Charged Attack DMG. This effect can be triggered once each time Chasca uses Multitarget Fire.
constellations.descriptionId:
Saat Chasca memasuki medan pertempuran, mendapatkan satu lapis "Spirit of the Radiant Shadow" dari Talenta Ascension "Bullet Trick".
Selain itu, saat Shining Shadowhunt Shell dari serangan Multitarget Fire milik Elemental Skill Spirit Reins, Shadow Hunt mengenai musuh, akan mengakibatkan Elemental DMG Area sebesar 400% ATK Chasca yang elemennya sesuai dengan jenis elemen dari Shining Shadowhunt Shell. DMG ini dianggap sebagai DMG Charged Attack. Efek ini dapat terpicu sekali setiap kali Chasca melancarkan Multitarget Fire.

constellations.name: Reins, Her Careful Control
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Spirit Reins, Shadow Hunt by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.descriptionId:
Meningkatkan 3 level Elemental Skill Spirit Reins, Shadow Hunt.
Maksimum: Lv. 15.

constellations.name: Sparks, the Sudden Shot
constellations.description:
When the Radiant Soulseeker Shells from Soul Reaper's Fatal Round hit opponents, they will restore 1.5 Elemental Energy to Chasca, and deal AoE Elemental DMG of the corresponding Elemental Type of the Radiant Soulseeker Shells equal to 400% of Chasca's ATK. This DMG is considered Charged Attack DMG.
The aforementioned corresponding elemental AoE DMG effect can be triggered once each time Chasca uses Soul Reaper's Fatal Round.
constellations.descriptionId:
Saat Radiant Soulseeker Shell dari Elemental Burst Soul Reaper's Fatal Round mengenai musuh, akan memulihkan 1,5 Energy untuk Chasca dan mengakibatkan DMG Elemental Area sebesar 400% ATK Chasca yang elemennya sesuai dengan jenis elemen dari Radiant Soulseeker Shell. DMG ini dianggap sebagai DMG Charged Attack.
DMG Elemental Area yang disebutkan di atas hanya dapat terpicu sekali setiap kali Chasca melancarkan Soul Reaper's Fatal Round.

constellations.name: Brim, the Sandshadow's Silhouette
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Soul Reaper's Fatal Round by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.descriptionId:
Meningkatkan 3 level Elemental Burst Soul Reaper's Fatal Round.
Maksimum: Lv. 15.

constellations.name: Showdown, the Glory of Battle
constellations.description:
Chasca's Multitarget Fire charge time is decreased, and after the Ascension Talent "Bullet Trick"'s "Spiritbinding Conversion" is triggered, Chasca will gain the "Fatal Rounds" state: For the next 3s, the next time Chasca uses Spirit Reins, Shadow Hunt's Multitarget Fire, the shots will finish charging instantly, and the CRIT DMG of that instance of Multitarget Fire's Shadowhunt Shells and Shining Shadowhunt Shells increases by 120%. 1 "Fatal Rounds" effect can be gained once every 3s.

You must first unlock the Ascension Talent "Bullet Trick" to gain access to the above effect.
constellations.descriptionId:
Durasi charge Multitarget Fire menjadi lebih singkat, dan setelah efek "Spiritbinding Conversion" dari Talenta Ascension "Bullet Trick" terpicu, Chasca akan memasuki status "Fatal Rounds": Dalam 3 detik berikutnya, saat Chasca melancarkan Multitarget Fire dari Elemental Skill Spirit Reins, Shadow Hunt kali berikutnya, tembakannya akan langsung selesai melakukan charge, dan CRIT DMG Shadowhunt Shell dan Shining Shadowhunt Shell dari Multitarget Fire tersebut meningkat sebesar 120%. Chasca bisa memasuki status "Fatal Rounds" sekali setiap 3 detik.

Efek di atas harus membuka Talenta Ascension "Bullet Trick" terlebih dahulu.

name: Chiori
title: The Thundering Seamstress
description: The owner of Chioriya Boutique. A tailor renowned throughout Fontaine.
descriptionId: Pemilik Chioriya Boutique. Penjahit yang namanya sangat terkenal di Fontaine.

talents.name: Weaving Blade
talents.description:
Normal Attack
Performs up to 4 rapid strikes.

Charged Attack
Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to unleash 2 rapid sword strikes.

Plunging Attack
Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground below, damaging opponents along the path and dealing AoE DMG upon impact.
talents.descriptionId:
Normal Attack
Melancarkan hingga 4 serangan berturut-turut.

Charged Attack
Mengonsumsi sejumlah Stamina untuk melancarkan dua tebasan pedang.

Plunging Attack
Menerjang dari udara untuk menghantam tanah, menyerang musuh di jalur terjangan dan mengakibatkan DMG area saat mendarat.

talents.name: Fluttering Hasode
talents.description:
Dashes nimbly forward with silken steps. Once this dash ends, Chiori will summon the automaton doll "Tamoto" beside her and sweep her blade upward, dealing AoE Geo DMG to nearby opponents based on her ATK and DEF.
Holding the Skill will cause it to behave differently.

Hold
Enter Aiming Mode to adjust the dash direction.

Tamoto
· Will slash at nearby opponents at intervals, dealing AoE Geo DMG based on Chiori's ATK and DEF.
· While active, if there are nearby Geo Construct(s) or Geo Construct(s) are created nearby, an additional Tamoto will be summoned next to your active character. Only 1 additional Tamoto can be summoned in this manner, and its duration is independently counted.
talents.descriptionId:
Menerjang dengan cepat dengan tarian selembut sutra. Saat terjangan berakhir, akan memanggil "Tamoto" si boneka automaton dan melancarkan serangan ke atas, mengakibatkan Geo DMG Area yang didasarkan pada ATK dan DEF Chiori.
Saat ditahan, akan melancarkan serangan dengan cara yang berbeda.

Mode Tahan
Memasuki mode membidik untuk menyesuaikan arah terjangan.

Tamoto
·Menebas musuh di sekitar secara bertahap, mengakibatkan Geo DMG Area yang didasarkan pada ATK dan DEF Chiori.
·Selama aktif, jika ada Geo Construct di sekitar, atau ada Geo Construct yang diciptakan di sekitar, maka akan memanggil satu Tamoto tambahan di sisi Karakter aktif saat ini. Maksimum satu Tamoto tambahan yang bisa dipanggil dengan cara ini, dan durasinya dihitung secara terpisah.

talents.name: Hiyoku: Twin Blades
talents.description: Twin blades leave their sheaths as Chiori slices with the clean cuts of a master tailor, dealing AoE Geo DMG based on her ATK and DEF.
talents.descriptionId: Chiori menghunuskan kedua pedang miliknya, kemudian mengayunkan sebuah tebasan tajam dengan gaya seorang ahli penjahit untuk mengakibatkan Geo DMG Area yang didasarkan pada ATK dan DEF Chiori.

passives.name: Tailor-Made
passives.description:
Gain different effects depending on the next action you take within a short duration after using Fluttering Hasode's upward sweep. If you Press the Elemental Skill, you will trigger the Tapestry effect. If you Press your Normal Attack, the Tailoring effect will be triggered instead.

Tapestry
· Switches to the next character in your roster.
· Grants all your party members "Seize the Moment": When your active party member's Normal Attacks, Charged Attacks, and Plunging Attacks hit a nearby opponent, "Tamoto" will execute a coordinated attack, dealing 100% of Fluttering Hasode's upward sweep DMG as AoE Geo DMG at the opponent's location. DMG dealt this way is considered Elemental Skill DMG.
· "Seize the Moment" lasts 8s, and 1 of "Tamoto"'s coordinated attack can be unleashed every 2s. 2 such coordinated attacks can occur per "Seize the Moment" effect duration.

Tailoring
· Chiori gains Geo infusion for 5s.

When on the field, if Chiori does not either Press her Elemental Skill or use a Normal Attack within a short time after using Fluttering Hasode's upward sweep, the Tailoring effect will be triggered by default.
passives.descriptionId:
Dalam waktu singkat setelah melancarkan serangan ke atas dari Fluttering Hasode, akan menghasilkan efek yang berbeda berdasarkan pengoperasian lanjutannya: Menekan tombol Elemental Skill akan memicu Tapestry. Sedangkan menekan tombol Normal Attack akan memicu Tailoring.

Tapestry
·Mengganti Karakter dan membuat Karakter selanjutnya memasuki medan pertempuran.
·Memberikan "Seize the Moment" kepada seluruh Karakter di dalam party: Saat Normal Attack, Charged Attack, atau Plunging Attack Karakter aktif di dalam party mengenai musuh di sekitar, maka "Tamoto" akan melancarkan serangan terkoordinasi dan mengakibatkan Geo DMG Area di posisi musuh yang setara dengan 100% DMG serangan ke atas dari Fluttering Hasode. DMG yang diakibatkan dengan cara ini dianggap sebagai DMG Elemental Skill.
·Seize the Moment berlangsung selama 8 detik, serangan terkoordinasi "Tamoto" dapat terpicu maksimum sekali setiap 2 detik. Maksimum dapat memicu serangan terkoordinasi ini 2 kali dalam satu durasi Seize the Moment.

Tailoring
·Chiori mendapatkan Geo Infusion selama 5 detik.

Saat Chiori berada di medan pertempuran, jika tidak menekan Normal Attack atau tombol Elemental Skill lagi dalam waktu singkat setelah melancarkan serangan ke atas dari Fluttering Hasode, maka efek lanjutan Tailoring yang akan terpicu.

passives.name: The Finishing Touch
passives.description: When a nearby party member creates a Geo Construct, Chiori will gain 20% Geo DMG Bonus for 20s.
passives.descriptionId: Saat Karakter di dalam party di sekitar menciptakan Geo Construct, Chiori mendapatkan 20% Geo DMG Bonus selama 20 detik.

passives.name: Brocaded Collar's Beauteous Silhouette
passives.description:
When any party member is wearing an outfit apart from their default outfit, or is wearing a wind glider other than the Wings of First Flight, your party members will obtain the Swift Stride effect: Movement SPD is increased by 10%.
This effect does not take effect in Domains, Trounce Domains, and the Spiral Abyss. Swift Stride does not stack.
passives.descriptionId:
Saat Karakter apa pun di dalam party mengenakan kostum selain kostum semula, atau saat wind glider yang dikenakan bukan merupakan Wings of First Flight, maka Karakter sendiri di dalam party akan mendapatkan efek Swift Stride: Movement SPD meningkat 10%.
Efek ini tidak aktif dalam Domain, Domain Trounce, atau Spiral Abyss. Efek Swift Stride tidak dapat ditumpuk.

constellations.name: Six Paths of Sage Silkcraft
constellations.description:
The AoE of the automaton doll "Tamoto" summoned by Fluttering Hasode is increased by 50%.
Additionally, if there is a Geo party member other than Chiori, Fluttering Hasode will trigger the following after the dash is completed:
· Summon an additional Tamoto. Only one additional Tamoto can exist at the same time, whether summoned by Chiori this way or through the presence of a Geo Construct.
· Triggers the Ascension Talent "The Finishing Touch." You must first unlock the Ascension Talent "The Finishing Touch."
constellations.descriptionId:
Radius serangan area milik "Tamoto" si boneka automaton yang dipanggil dari Fluttering Hasode meningkat 50%.
Selain itu, jika ada Karakter Geo selain Chiori di dalam party, setelah terjangan Fluttering Hasode berakhir, akan memicu efek sebagai berikut:
·Memanggil satu Tamoto tambahan. Hanya boleh ada satu Tamoto tambahan milik Chiori yang dipanggil dengan cara ini dan melalui Geo Construct yang bisa dipanggil secara bersamaan.
·Memicu Talenta Ascension "The Finishing Touch". Harus membuka Talenta Ascension "The Finishing Touch" terlebih dahulu.

constellations.name: In Five Colors Dyed
constellations.description:
For 10s after using Hiyoku: Twin Blades, a simplified automaton doll, "Kinu," will be summoned next to your active character every 3s. Kinu will attack nearby opponents, dealing AoE Geo DMG equivalent to 170% of Tamoto's DMG. DMG dealt this way is considered Elemental Skill DMG.
Kinu will leave the field after 1 attack or after lasting 3s.
constellations.descriptionId:
Setelah melancarkan Hiyoku: Twin Blades, selama 10 detik berikutnya "Kinu" si boneka automaton sederhana akan muncul di samping Karakter aktif milik sendiri setiap 3 detik sekali. Kinu akan menyerang musuh di sekitar dan mengakibatkan Geo DMG Area setara dengan 170% DMG Tamoto. DMG yang diakibatkan dengan cara ini akan dianggap sebagai DMG Elemental Skill.
Kinu akan hilang setelah menyerang satu kali atau setelah muncul selama 3 detik.

constellations.name: Four Brocade Embellishments
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Fluttering Hasode by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.descriptionId:
Meningkatkan 3 level Fluttering Hasode.
Maksimum: Lv. 15.

constellations.name: A Tailor's Three Courtesies
constellations.description:
For 8s after triggering either follow-up effect of the Ascension Talent "Tailor-Made," when your current active character's Normal, Charged, or Plunging Attacks hit a nearby opponent, a simplified automaton doll, "Kinu," will be summoned near this opponent. You can summon 1 Kinu every 1s in this way, and up to 3 Kinu may be summoned this way during each instance of "Tailor-Made"'s Seize the Moment or Tailoring effect. The above effect can be triggered up to once every 15s.
You must first unlock the Ascension Talent "Tailor-Made."
constellations.descriptionId:
Dalam 8 detik setelah memicu efek lanjutan dari Talenta Ascension Tailor-Made, saat Normal Attack, Charged Attack, atau Plunging Attack Karakter aktif sendiri di dalam party mengenai musuh di sekitar, akan memanggil satu "Kinu" si boneka automaton sederhana di sekitar musuh. Jumlah Kinu yang bisa dipanggil melalui cara di atas adalah maksimum satu setiap 1 detik. Maksimum bisa memanggil hingga 3 Kinu dalam satu durasi "Seize the Moment" atau selama efek "Tailoring" dari Talenta Ascension "Tailor-Made" berlangsung. Efek di atas dapat terpicu sekali setiap 15 detik.
Harus membuka Talenta Ascension "Tailor-Made" terlebih dahulu.

constellations.name: Two Silken Plumules
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Hiyoku: Twin Blades by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.descriptionId:
Meningkatkan 3 level Hiyoku: Twin Blades.
Maksimum: Lv. 15.

constellations.name: Sole Principle Pursuit
constellations.description:
After triggering a follow-up effect of the Ascension Talent "Tailor-Made," Chiori's own Fluttering Hasode's CD is decreased by 12s. You must first unlock the Ascension Talent "Tailor-Made.".
In addition, the DMG dealt by Chiori's own Normal Attacks is increased by an amount equal to 235% of her own DEF.
constellations.descriptionId:
Setelah memicu efek lanjutan Talenta Ascension "Tailor-Made", CD Fluttering Hasode Chiori sendiri berkurang 12 detik. Harus membuka Talenta Ascension "Tailor-Made" terlebih dahulu.
Selain itu, DMG yang diakibatkan Normal Attack Chiori meningkat setara dengan 235% DEF Chiori sendiri.

name: Citlali
title: Obsidian Opalstar
description: The great shaman from the Masters of the Night-Wind, the universally-revered Granny Itztli.
descriptionId: Shaman Agung dari Penguasa Angin Malam, Nenek Itztli yang dihormati oleh orang dari semua suku.

talents.name: Shadow-Stealing Spirit Vessel
talents.description:
Normal Attack
Calls upon secret arts passed down through the Masters of the Night-Wind from generation to generation, performing up to three strikes that deal Cryo DMG.

Charged Attack
Enters Aiming Mode, and after Holding, consumes a certain amount of Stamina to call forth a Frost Star that deals Cryo DMG to opponents in its path.

Plunging Attack
Gathers the power of Cryo and plunges towards the ground from mid-air, damaging all opponents in her path. Deals Aoe Cryo DMG upon impact with the ground.
talents.descriptionId:
Normal Attack
Memanggil upacara rahasia turun-temurun Penguasa Angin Malam, melancarkan hingga 3 serangan yang mengakibatkan Cryo DMG.

Charged Attack
Memasuki Mode Membidik dan mengonsumsi sejumlah Stamina setelah melepaskan tombol Tahan untuk mengonsumsi sejumlah Stamina dan melemparkan sebuah Frost Star ke arah bidikan, mengakibatkan Cryo DMG terhadap musuh di sepanjang jalurnya.

Plunging Attack
Mengumpulkan kekuatan Cryo, menerjang tanah, menyerang musuh di jalur terjangan, dan mengakibatkan Cryo DMG Area saat mendarat.

talents.name: Dawnfrost Darkstar
talents.description:
Invoking secret pacts passed down by her tribe over the millennia, Citlali deploys an Opal Shield and calls forth "Obsidian Tzitzimitl: Itzpapa," a creature that is (reputedly) terrifying beyond compare, dealing Nightsoul-aligned AoE Cryo DMG.
The Opal Shield's DMG absorption scales based on Citlali's Elemental Mastery, and absorbs Cryo DMG with 250% efficiency. When it is deployed, it will cause Citlali to briefly be affected by Cryo.
After using this skill, Citlali gains 24 Nightsoul points and enters the Nightsoul's Blessing state.

Nightsoul's Blessing: Citlali
When Itzpapa leaves the field, Citlali exits the Nightsoul's Blessing state.

Itzpapa
·Itzpapa will follow the character.
·If Citlali has at least 50 Nightsoul points, Itzpapa enters the Opal Fire state and continuously consumes Nightsoul points to whip up a Frostfall Storm that follows the character and attacks opponents within its AoE, dealing Nightsoul-aligned Cryo DMG.
·When Citlali's Nightsoul points are fully depleted, Itzpapa's Opal Fire state also ends.
talents.descriptionId:
Dengan landasan kontrak warisan ribuan tahun Penguasa Angin Malam, melancarkan Opal Shield dan memanggil "Obsidian Tzitzimitl: Itzpapa", makhluk yang (konon katanya) sangat menakutkan, mengakibatkan Nightsoul-aligned Cryo DMG Area.
Penyerapan DMG Oval Shield didasarkan pada Elemental Mastery Citlali, dan memiliki 250% pertahanan terhadap Cryo DMG, dan saat menghasilkan Perisai, akan memberikan efek Cryo singkat kepada Citlali.
Setelah dilancarkan, Citlali akan mendapatkan 24 poin Nightsoul dan memasuki status Nightsoul's Blessing.

Nightsoul's Blessing: Citlali
Saat Itzpapa meninggalkan medan pertempuran, Nightsoul's Blessing Citlali akan berakhir.

Itzpapa
·Itzpapa akan mengikuti pergerakan Karakter.
·Saat Citlali memiliki setidaknya 50 poin Nightsoul, Itzpapa akan memasuki status Opal Fire dan akan terus mengonsumsi poin Nightsoul, menghasilkan Frostfall Storm yang akan mengikuti Karakter dan menyerang musuh di dalam radius, mengakibatkan Nightsoul-aligned Cryo DMG.
·Saat poin Nightsoul habis terpakai, status Opal Fire Itzpapa juga akan berakhir.

talents.name: Edict of Entwined Splendor
talents.description: Summons "allies" from the starry skies and the vast earth, hurling forth an ice storm to bombard the area in front and deal Nightsoul-aligned AoE Cryo DMG. This restores a set amount of Nightsoul points for Citlali, and also summons a Spiritvessel Skull near a maximum of 3 opponents within the AoE, with 1 Skull for each opponent. Spiritvessel Skulls explode after some time, dealing Nightsoul-aligned AoE Cryo DMG and restoring a set amount of Nightsoul points for Citlali.
talents.descriptionId: Memanggil "sekutu" yang berasal dari langit berbintang dan tanah luas, menghasilkan badai es untuk menyerang area depan dan mengakibatkan Nightsoul-aligned Cryo DMG Area, dan memulihkan poin Nightsoul Citlali dalam jumlah tertentu, serta memanggil satu Spiritvessel Skull terhadap setiap musuh, dengan maksimum 3 musuh di sekitar dalam radius area. Spiritvessel Skull akan meledak setelah beberapa saat, mengakibatkan Nightsoul-aligned Cryo DMG Area, dan akan memulihkan poin Nightsoul Citlali dalam jumlah tertentu.

passives.name: Mamaloaco's Frigid Rain
passives.description: While Itzpapa is on the field, after nearby party members trigger the Frozen or Melt reactions, the Pyro and Hydro RES of opponents affected by that reaction decreases by 20% for 12s. Additionally, Citlali will regain 16 Nightsoul points. Nightsoul points can be restored this way once every 8s.
passives.descriptionId: Selama Itzpapa ada di medan pertempuran, setelah Karakter sekitar dalam party memicu reaksi Frozen atau Melt, Pyro dan Hydro RES musuh yang terkena reaksi kali ini akan berkurang 20% selama 12 detik. Selain itu, Citlali akan memulihkan 16 poin Nightsoul, efek pemulihan dengan cara ini dapat terpicu maksimum sekali setiap 8 detik.

passives.name: Itzpapalotl's Star Garments
passives.description:
During the Elemental Skill Dawnfrost Darkstar, Itzpapa's Frostfall Storm DMG is increased by 90% of Citlali's Elemental Mastery. During the Elemental Burst Edict of Entwined Splendor, Ice Storm DMG is increased by 1200% of Citlali's Elemental Mastery.
In addition, when nearby party members trigger Nightsoul Bursts, Citlali regains 4 Nightsoul points.
passives.descriptionId:
Selama Elemental Skill Dawnfrost Darkstar, DMG Frostfall Storm Itzpapa meningkat sebesar 90% Elemental Mastery Citlali. Selama Elemental Burst Edict of Entwined Splendor, DMG Ice Storm meningkat sebesar 1.200% Elemental Mastery Citlali.
Selain itu, saat Karakter party di sekitar memicu Nightsoul Burst, Citlali akan memulihkan 4 poin Nightsoul.

passives.name: Night Realm's Gift: Smoke, Mirrors, and the Flowing Winds
passives.description:
While in an area with Phlogiston Mechanics within Natlan, can use Nightsoul Transmission: Citlali. When the active character is currently high enough in the air, the following will trigger when switching to Citlali: Citlali will leap up high, and will deploy "White Obsidian Tzitzimitl: Citlalin" to float in the air. Nightsoul Transmission can be triggered once every 10s by your party.

Holding Aiming Mode will cause Citlali to enter the "Spiritspeaker" state, which will allow her to interact with "Nightspirit Graffiti" and "Nightspirit Sigils," extracting information and power from them. The rules for interacting with these objects follow the same rules as those governing Iktomisaurus interactions.

Additionally, holding the jump button will cause Citlali to consume 75 Stamina and leap. In areas within Natlan where Phlogiston mechanics are present, Citlali will prioritize consuming 5 Phlogiston to leap to a height higher still.
When in the air, Citlali can Hold her Normal Attack to consume Phlogiston or Stamina and enter Aiming Mode and trigger Charged Attacks. When initiating Charged Attacks in mid-air, Citlali will prioritize consuming 20 Phlogiston.
passives.descriptionId:
Saat ada area dengan Phlogiston Mechanic di Natlan, Citlali bisa melancarkan Nightsoul Transmission: Citlali. Saat Karakter aktif sedang berada di udara dalam ketinggian tertentu dan mengganti Karakter menjadi Citlali: Citlali akan melompat tinggi ke atas dan melayang di udara dengan meminjam kekuatan "White Obsidian Tzitzimitl: Citlalin". Nightsoul Transmission party sendiri dapat terpicu sekali setiap 10 detik.

Saat menggunakan Mode Membidik, Citlali akan memasuki status Spiritspeaker. Dalam status ini, Citlali bisa berinteraksi dengan "Nightspirit Graffiti" dan "Nightspirit Sigil" untuk mengambil informasi dan kekuatan dari dalamnya. Peraturan interaksi dengan objek-objek ini sama dengan peraturan interaksi Iktomisaurus.

Selain itu, saat menahan tombol Melompat, Citlali akan mengonsumsi 75 poin Stamina untuk melompat tinggi ke atas. Saat ada area dengan Phlogiston Mechanic di Natlan, Citlali akan terlebih dulu mengonsumsi 5 poin Phlogiston untuk melompat ke ketinggian yang lebih tinggi lagi.
Saat sedang berada di udara, Citlali bisa menahan Normal Attack dan mengonsumsi Phlogiston atau Stamina untuk memasuki Mode Membidik. Saat melakukan Charged Attack di udara, Citlali akan lebih dulu mengonsumsi 20 poin Phlogiston.

passives.name: Songs of Profound Mystery
passives.description:
While in an area with Phlogiston Mechanics within Natlan, triggering "Nightsoul Burst" restores 20 Phlogiston.
This cannot take effect in Domains, Trounce Domains, or the Spiral Abyss.
passives.descriptionId:
Saat ada area dengan Phlogiston Mechanic di Natlan, memicu Nightsoul Burst akan memulihkan 20 poin Phlogiston.
Efek ini tidak aktif dalam Domain, Trounce Domain, atau Spiral Abyss

constellations.name: Radiant Blades of Centzon Mimixcoah
constellations.description:
When she uses the Elemental Skill Dawnfrost Darkstar, Citlali gains the "Opalstar Vestments" effect until Itzpapa leaves the field. During this time, she will obtain 10 stacks of Stellar Blade. When a nearby active character other than Citlali deals DMG using Normal, Charged, or Plunging Attacks, or Elemental Skills and Bursts, 1 stack of Stellar Blade will be consumed to increase the DMG dealt by 200% of Citlali's Elemental Mastery.
After nearby party members trigger Frozen or Melt, Citlali will gain another 3 stacks of Stellar Blade. This effect can trigger once every 8s.

Using the Elemental Skill Dawnfrost Darkstar will reset Stellar Blade stacks.
