Maximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.descriptionId:
Meningkatkan 3 level Aromatic Explication.
Maksimum: Lv. 15.

constellations.name: Marcotte Sillage
constellations.description:
When using Fragrance Extraction or Aromatic Explication, Emilie will gain Abiding Fragrance for 5s.
While this is active, after Emilie uses Normal or Charged Attacks, she will generate 1 Scent, and her Normal and Charged Attack DMG will be converted into Dendro DMG that cannot be overridden, and the DMG dealt will be increased by 300% of Emilie's ATK.

The Abiding Fragrance effect will be removed after 4 Scents are created this way or after its duration expires. Abiding Fragrance can be triggered once every 12s.
constellations.descriptionId:
Saat melancarkan Fragrance Extraction atau Aromatic Explication, Emilie akan mendapatkan Abiding Fragrance yang berlangsung 5 detik.
Selama efek ini berlangsung, 1 Scent akan tercipta setelah Emilie melancarkan Normal Attack atau Charged Attack. Selain itu, Normal Attack dan Charged Attack Emilie akan dikonversi menjadi Dendro DMG yang tidak bisa ditimpa Elemental Infusion lainnya dan DMG yang diakibatkan juga akan meningkat sebesar 300% ATK Emilie.

Efek Abiding Fragrance akan hilang setelah menghasilkan 4 Scent melalui cara ini atau setelah durasinya berakhir. Efek Abiding Fragrance dapat terpicu sekali setiap 12 detik.

name: Escoffier
title: Tasteful Excellence
description: The ex-head chef of Hotel Debord, renowned throughout Fontaine as the Patissiere Supreme and vanguard of precision gastronomy. Has incomparably strict standards when it comes to cooking.
descriptionId: Mantan Koki Kepala di Hotel Debord, pelopor "Gastronomi Presisi" yang terkenal dan memiliki gelar Patissiere Supreme di Fontaine, memiliki standar memasak yang sangat ketat.

talents.name: Kitchen Skills
talents.description:
Normal Attack
Performs up to 3 consecutive spear strikes.

Charged Attack
Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to perform an upward thrust.

Plunging Attack
Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground below, damaging opponents along the path and dealing AoE DMG upon impact.
talents.descriptionId:
Normal Attack
Melancarkan hingga 3 serangan tombak berturut-turut.

Charged Attack
Mengonsumsi sejumlah Stamina untuk menyerang ke atas.

Plunging Attack
Menerjang dari udara untuk menghantam tanah, menyerang musuh di jalur terjangan dan mengakibatkan DMG area saat mendarat.

talents.name: Low-Temperature Cooking
talents.description:
Behold the true meaning of "cooking"! Escoffier will demonstrate different cooking techniques when you Tap or Hold this skill, but rest assured, each of them is Fontaine's pride and joy.

Tap
Activates her All-Spectrum Multi-Use Cooking Mek in its Cold Storage mode and deals AoE Cryo DMG to nearby opponents.

Cooking Mek: Cold Storage Mode
Follows the current active character and fires Frosty Parfaits at nearby opponents at intervals, dealing Cryo DMG.

Arkhe: Ousia
At intervals, Escoffier will summon a Surging Blade when activating her Cooking Mek in Cold Storage mode, dealing Ousia-aligned AoE Cryo DMG.

Hold
Activates her All-Spectrum Multi-Use Cooking Mek's **Off-the-Cuff Cookery Mode**.
talents.descriptionId:
Silakan saksikan makna "memasak" yang sebenarnya! Melancarkan keterampilan memasak Escoffier yang dibangga-banggakan berdasarkan Mode Tekan atau Mode Tahan.

Mode Tekan
Mengaktifkan All-Spectrum Multi-Use Cooking Mek dalam Cold Storage Mode dan mengakibatkan Cryo DMG Area ke musuh sekitar.

Cooking Mek: Cold Storage Mode
Akan mengikuti Karakter aktif dan menembakkan Frosty Parfait yang mengakibatkan Cryo DMG ke musuh di sekitar secara berkala.

Arkhe: Ousia
Setiap satu kurun waktu, saat Escoffier mengaktifkan Cooking Mek dalam Cold Storage Mode, akan menjatuhkan Surging Blade yang mengakibatkan Ousia-aligned Cryo DMG Area.

Mode Tahan
Mengaktifkan **Off-the-Cuff Cookery Mode** pada Cooking Mek miliknya.

talents.name: Scoring Cuts
talents.description: Displaying her exceptional knife skills, Escoffier deals AoE Cryo DMG and restores HP to all nearby party members based on her ATK.
talents.descriptionId: Escoffier menunjukkan keahlian pisaunya, mengakibatkan Cryo DMG Area dan memulihkan HP seluruh Karakter party di sekitar berdasarkan ATK Escoffier.

passives.name: Better to Salivate Than Medicate
passives.description: After using the Elemental Burst **Scoring Cuts**, Escoffier will obtain the Rehab Diet effect for 9s: Restores HP for nearby active characters every 1s based on 138.24% of Escoffier's ATK.
passives.descriptionId: Setelah melancarkan Elemental Burst **Scoring Cuts**, Escoffier akan mendapatkan efek Rehab Diet selama 9 detik: Memulihkan HP Karakter aktif di sekitar sebesar 138,24% ATK Escoffier setiap detiknya.

passives.name: Inspiration-Immersed Seasoning
passives.description: When there are 1/2/3/4 Hydro or Cryo characters in the party, Escoffier will decrease the Hydro RES and Cryo RES of any opponents hit by her Elemental Skill, **Low-Temperature Cooking**, or her Elemental Burst, **Scoring Cuts**, by 5%/10%/15%/55% for 12s.
passives.descriptionId: Saat ada 1/2/3/4 Karakter Hydro atau Cryo di dalam party, setelah Elemental Skill **Low-Temperature Cooking** atau Elemental Burst **Scoring Cuts** miliknya mengenai musuh, akan mengurangi Hydro RES dan Cryo RES musuh ini sebesar 5%/10%/15%/55% selama 12 detik.

passives.name: Constant Off-the-Cuff Cookery
passives.description:
When using the Hold form of her Elemental Skill **Low-Temperature Cooking**, Escoffier will activate her All-Spectrum Multi-Use Cooking Mek in its Off-the-Cuff Cookery mode.

Cooking Mek: Off-the-Cuff Cookery Mode
· Places the Cooking Mek on the field. The Cooking Mek can absorb elemental attacks. When the absorbed elemental energy hits a certain limit, Escoffier can convert the ingredients placed within it into wonderful food.
· Escoffier needs time to purchase new ingredients, so she can only make a certain number of dishes like this each week. The number of dishes Escoffier can make resets every Monday at 4:00 AM .
passives.descriptionId:
Saat menahan tombol Elemental Skill **Low-Temperature Cooking**, Escoffier akan mengaktifkan All-Spectrum Multi-Use Cooking Mek dalam Off-the-Cuff Cookery Mode.

Cooking Mek: Off-the-Cuff Cookery Mode
·Meletakkan Cooking Mek di medan pertempuran. Cooking Mek bisa menyerap serangan elemental. Saat energi elemental yang diserap mencapai batas tertentu, Escoffier akan mengonversi Bahan Masak yang sudah diletakkan sebelumnya menjadi makanan yang lezat.
·Escoffier membutuhkan waktu untuk membeli Bahan Masak yang baru. Setiap minggunya, dia hanya dapat menggunakan cara ini untuk menghasilkan Makanan dalam jumlah tertentu, jumlah ini akan di-reset setiap hari Senin pukul 04:00 ().

constellations.name: Pre-Dinner Dance for Your Taste Buds
constellations.description:
When 4 party members are Hydro or Cryo, all nearby party members will have their Cryo DMG CRIT DMG increased by 60% for 15s after Escoffier uses her Elemental Skill **Low-Temperature Cooking** or Elemental Burst **Scoring Cuts**.
You must first unlock the Ascension Talent "Inspiration-Immersed Seasoning."
constellations.descriptionId:
Saat 4 Karakter di dalam party berelemen Hydro atau Cryo, maka CRIT DMG Cryo DMG seluruh anggota party akan meningkat 60% selama 15 detik setelah Escoffier melancarkan Elemental Skill **Low-Temperature Cooking** atau Elemental Burst **Scoring Cuts**.
Harus membuka Talenta Ascension "Inspiration-Immersed Seasoning" terlebih dahulu.

constellations.name: Fresh, Fragrant Stew Is an Art
constellations.description:
When Escoffier activates her Cooking Mek in its **Cold Storage Mode**, she will gain the "Freshly-Prepped Delicacy" effect for 15s. During this time, Escoffier will gain 5 Cold Dish stacks. When nearby active characters apart from Escoffier deal Cryo DMG with a Normal, Charged, or Plunging Attack, or an Elemental Skill or Elemental Burst, they will expend 1 Cold Dish stack to increase their DMG dealt by 240% of Escoffier's ATK.
If you hit multiple opponents with a single instance of Cryo DMG, Cold Dish stacks will be consumed based on the number of opponents hit.
constellations.descriptionId:
Saat Escoffier mengaktifkan Cooking Mek dalam **Cold Storage Mode**, ia akan mendapatkan efek "Freshly-Prepped Delicacy" selama 15 detik. Selama durasi ini, Escoffier akan mendapatkan 5 lapis Cold Dish. Saat Karakter aktif di sekitar selain Escoffier mengakibatkan Cryo DMG dengan Normal, Charged, Plunging Attack, Elemental Skill, atau Elemental Burst, mereka akan mengonsumsi 1 lapis Cold Dish untuk meningkatkan DMG yang diakibatkan sebesar 240% ATK Escoffier.
Saat satu kali Cryo DMG mengenai beberapa musuh secara bersamaan, jumlah lapisan Cold Dish yang dikonsumsi dan efeknya akan disesuaikan dengan jumlah musuh yang terkena serangan.

constellations.name: The Bakery Magic of Caramel Browning
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of **Low-Temperature Cooking** by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.descriptionId:
Meningkatkan 3 level **Low-Temperature Cooking** dari Elemental Skill.
Maksimum: Lv. 15.

constellations.name: Secret Rosemary Recipe
constellations.description:
**Rehab Diet** lasts 6 more seconds. While it is active, you have a chance of healing 100% extra HP and restoring 2 Energy to Escoffier when you trigger healing through Rehab Diet. This chance corresponds to Escoffier's CRIT Rate. You can trigger this effect 7 times during any one Rehab Diet's duration.
You must first unlock the Ascension Talent "Better to Salivate Than Medicate."
constellations.descriptionId:
Durasi efek **Rehab Diet** diperpanjang 6 detik. Saat aktif, jika pemulihan HP Rehab Diet terpicu, ada kemungkinan untuk meningkatkan pemulihan sebesar 100% dan memulihkan 2 poin Energy Escoffier. Persentase kemungkinan ini didasarkan pada CRIT Rate Escoffier. Efek ini dapat terpicu maksimum 7 kali dalam satu kali durasi Rehab Diet.
Harus membuka Talenta Ascension "Better to Salivate Than Medicate" terlebih dahulu.

constellations.name: Symphony of a Thousand Sauces
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of **Scoring Cuts** by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.descriptionId:
Meningkatkan 3 level Elemental Burst **Scoring Cuts**.
Maksimum: Lv. 15.

constellations.name: Tea Parties Bursting With Color
constellations.description:
**Cooking Mek: Cold Storage Mode** is enhanced:
· When your party's active character's Normal, Charged, or Plunging Attacks hit opponents, Cooking Mek: Cold Storage Mode will fire off another Special-Grade Frosty Parfait, dealing 500% of Escoffier's ATK as AoE Cryo DMG. This DMG is considered Elemental Skill DMG.
This effect can be triggered once every 0.5s, and this effect can be triggered 6 times within the duration of one Cooking Mek: Cold Storage Mode.
constellations.descriptionId:
**Cooking Mek: Cold Storage Mode** mendapatkan penguatan berikut:
·Saat Normal Attack, Charged Attack, atau Plunging Attack Karakter aktif di dalam party mengenai musuh, Cooking Mek: Cold Storage Mode akan menembakkan sebuah Special-Grade Frosty Parfait tambahan, mengakibatkan Cryo DMG Area sebesar 500% ATK Escoffier. DMG ini dianggap sebagai DMG Elemental Skill.
Efek ini dapat terpicu sekali setiap 0,5 detik. Efek ini dapat terpicu maksimum 6 kali dalam satu kali durasi Cooking Mek: Cold Storage Mode.

name: Eula
title: Dance of the Shimmering Wave
description: The Spindrift Knight, a scion of the old aristocracy, and the Captain of the Knights of Favonius Reconnaissance Company. The reason for which a descendant of the ancient nobles might join the Knights remains a great mystery in Mondstadt to this very day.
descriptionId: Sang Spindrift Knight, keturunan keluarga bangsawan dan Kapten dari Pasukan Gerilya Knights of Favonius. Alasan kenapa seorang keturunan bangsawan kuno ingin bergabung dengan para Knight masih menjadi misteri di Mondstadt sampai saat ini.

talents.name: Favonius Bladework - Edel
talents.description:
Normal Attack
Performs up to 5 consecutive strikes.

Charged Attack
Drains Stamina over time to perform continuous slashes.
At the end of the sequence, performs a more powerful slash.

Plunging Attack
Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground, damaging opponents along the path and dealing AoE DMG upon impact.
talents.descriptionId:
Normal Attack
Melancarkan hingga 5 tebasan berturut-turut.

Charged Attack
Terus menguras Stamina untuk melancarkan tebasan berkelanjutan secara cepat.
Charged Attack akan diakhiri dengan sebuah tebasan yang lebih kuat.

Plunging Attack
Menerjang dari udara untuk menghantam tanah, menyerang semua musuh di jalurnya dan mengakibatkan DMG area saat mendarat.

talents.name: Icetide Vortex
talents.description:
Sharp frost, swift blade.

Press
Slashes swiftly, dealing Cryo DMG.
When it hits an opponent, Eula gains a stack of Grimheart that stacks up to 2 times. These stacks can only be gained once every 0.3s.

Grimheart
Increases Eula's resistance to interruption and DEF.

Hold
Wielding her sword, Eula consumes all the stacks of Grimheart and lashes forward, dealing AoE Cryo DMG to opponents in front of her.
If Grimheart stacks are consumed, surrounding opponents will have their Physical RES and Cryo RES decreased.
Each consumed stack of Grimheart will be converted into an Icewhirl Brand that deals Cryo DMG to nearby opponents.
talents.descriptionId:
Es yang tajam, pedang yang lincah.

Tekan
Menebas dengan cepat dan mengakibatkan Cryo DMG.
Saat mengenai musuh, Eula akan mendapatkan satu lapis Grimheart yang bisa ditumpuk hingga 2 lapis. Lapisan ini hanya bisa ditumpuk setiap 0,3 detik.

Grimheart
Meningkatkan DEF dan ketahanan Eula terhadap interupsi.

Tahan
Dengan mengonsumsi semua lapisan Grimheart yang ada, Eula menebas pedangnya ke arah depan dan mengakibatkan Cryo DMG area pada musuh di hadapannya.
Jika Eula mengonsumsi lapisan Grimheart, musuh di sekitar akan mengalami penurunan Physical RES dan Cryo RES.
Setiap lapis Grimheart akan berubah menjadi Icewhirl Brand yang mengakibatkan Cryo DMG pada musuh di sekitar.

talents.name: Glacial Illumination
talents.description:
Brandishes her greatsword, dealing Cryo DMG to nearby opponents and creating a Lightfall Sword that follows her around for a duration of up to 7s.
While present, the Lightfall Sword increases Eula's resistance to interruption. When Eula's own Normal Attack, Elemental Skill, and Elemental Burst deal DMG to opponents, they will charge the Lightfall Sword, which can gain an energy stack once every 0.1s.
Once its duration ends, the Lightfall Sword will descend and explode violently, dealing Physical DMG to nearby opponents.
This DMG scales on the number of energy stacks the Lightfall Sword has accumulated.
If Eula leaves the field, the Lightfall Sword will explode immediately.
talents.descriptionId:
Eula mengayunkan pedang besarnya dan mengakibatkan Cryo DMG terhadap musuh di sekitar, serta menciptakan Lightfall Sword yang mengikutinya selama hingga 7 detik.
Selama aktif, Lightfall Sword akan meningkatkan ketahanan Eula terhadap interupsi. Saat Normal Attack, Elemental Skill, dan Elemental Burst Eula mengakibatkan DMG terhadap musuh, energi Lightfall Sword akan terisi. 1 lapisan energi hanya dapat terisi setiap 0,1 detik.
Setelah durasinya berakhir, Lightfall Sword akan meledak hebat dan mengakibatkan Physical DMG terhadap musuh di sekitarnya.
DMG ini akan meningkat sesuai dengan jumlah lapisan energi yang berhasil dikumpulkan Lightfall Sword.
Lightfall Sword akan langsung meledak saat Eula meninggalkan medan pertempuran.

passives.name: Roiling Rime
passives.description: If 2 stacks of Grimheart are consumed upon unleashing the Holding Mode of Icetide Vortex, a Shattered Lightfall Sword will be created that will explode immediately, dealing 50% of the basic Physical DMG dealt by a Lightfall Sword created by Glacial Illumination.
passives.descriptionId: Jika 2 lapis Grimheart dikonsumsi saat menggunakan Mode Tahan dari Icetide Vortex, sebuah Shattered Lightfall Sword akan terbentuk dan langsung meledak, mengakibatkan Physical DMG sebesar 50% dari DMG dasar Lightfall Sword yang terbentuk dari skill Glacial Illumination.

passives.name: Wellspring of War-Lust
passives.description: When Glacial Illumination is cast, the CD of Icetide Vortex is reset and Eula gains 1 stack of Grimheart.
passives.descriptionId: Menggunakan Glacial Illumination akan langsung menyelesaikan CD Icetide Vortex dan memberikan Eula satu lapis Grimheart.

passives.name: Aristocratic Introspection
passives.description: When Eula crafts Character Talent Materials, she has a 10% chance to receive double the product.
passives.descriptionId: Saat membuat Material Talenta Karakter, Eula memiliki 10% kemungkinan untuk mendapatkan hasil 2 kali lipat.

constellations.name: Tidal Illusion
constellations.description:
Every time Icetide Vortex's Grimheart stacks are consumed, Eula's Physical DMG is increased by 30% for 6s.
Each stack consumed will increase the duration of this effect by 6s up to a maximum of 18s.
constellations.descriptionId:
Setiap kali lapisan Grimheart dari Icetide Vortex dikonsumsi, Physical DMG Eula akan meningkat 30% selama 6 detik.
Setiap lapis yang terkonsumsi akan meningkatkan durasi efek ini sebanyak 6 detik, hingga maksimum 18 detik.

constellations.name: Lady of Seafoam
constellations.description: Decreases the CD of Icetide Vortex's Holding Mode, rendering it identical to Press CD.
constellations.descriptionId: Mengurangi CD dari Mode Tahan Icetide Vortex, membuatnya sama dengan CD Mode Tekan.

constellations.name: Lawrence Pedigree
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Glacial Illumination by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.descriptionId:
Meningkatkan 3 level Glacial Illumination.
Maksimum: Lv. 15.

constellations.name: The Obstinacy of One's Inferiors
constellations.description: Lightfall Swords deal 25% increased DMG against opponents with less than 50% HP.
constellations.descriptionId: Meningkatkan 25% DMG Lightfall Sword terhadap musuh dengan HP kurang dari 50%.

constellations.name: Chivalric Quality
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Icetide Vortex by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.descriptionId:
Meningkatkan 3 level Icetide Vortex.
Maksimum: Lv. 15.

constellations.name: Noble Obligation
constellations.description: Lightfall Swords created by Glacial Illumination start with 5 stacks of energy. Normal Attacks, Elemental Skills, and Elemental Bursts have a 50% chance to grant the Lightfall Sword an additional stack of energy.
constellations.descriptionId: Lightfall Sword yang tercipta dari Glacial Illumination langsung memperoleh 5 lapis energi. Saat DMG yang diakibatkan Normal Attack, Elemental Skill, dan Elemental Burst mengakumulasi lapisan energi, Lightfall Sword memiliki 50% kemungkinan untuk memperoleh 1 lapis energi tambahan.

name: Flins
title: Shadowy Lights, Stranger Wights
description: A Lightkeeper of Nod-Krai, guardian of a lighthouse and graveyard on a northern isle. An enigmatic gentleman, cultured and courtly.
descriptionId: Lightkeeper dari Nod-Krai yang menjaga mercusuar dan kuburan di pulau kecil di utara. Seorang pria misterius dengan perilaku yang sangat sopan.

talents.name: Pocztowy Demonspear
talents.description:
Normal Attack
Performs up to 5 consecutive spear strikes.

Charged Attack
Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to perform a forward spear throw.

Plunging Attack
Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground below, damaging opponents along the path and dealing AoE DMG upon impact.
talents.descriptionId:
Normal Attack
Melancarkan hingga 5 serangan tombak berturut-turut.

Charged Attack
Mengonsumsi sejumlah Stamina untuk melemparkan tombak ke depan.

Plunging Attack
Menerjang dari udara untuk menghantam tanah di bawahnya, menyerang musuh di jalur terjangan dan mengakibatkan DMG area saat mendarat.

talents.name: Ancient Rite: Arcane Light
talents.description:
Flins summons forth the ancient power concealed within his lamp and switches to his Manifest Flame form. This form has the following characteristics:
· Flins's Normal and Charged Attacks deal Electro DMG that cannot be overridden by other Elemental infusions, and he is unable to perform Plunging Attacks.
· His interruption resistance is increased.
· His Elemental Skill Ancient Rite: Arcane Light is replaced with the special Elemental Skill Northland Spearstorm.

Northland Spearstorm
Flins summons a flurry of spears in front, dealing AoE Electro DMG and causing his Elemental Burst Ancient Ritual: Cometh the Night to be replaced with the special Elemental Burst **Thunderous Symphony** for the next 6s.
The base CD of Northland Spearstorm is 6s and will not be affected by other effects.
talents.descriptionId:
Flins memanggil kekuatan kuno dari dalam lenteranya dan berubah ke mode Manifest Flame. Mode ini memiliki karakteristik sebagai berikut:
·Normal Attack dan Charged Attack Flins akan berubah menjadi Electro DMG yang tidak bisa ditimpa Elemental Infusion lainnya, dan Flins tidak bisa melakukan Plunging Attack dalam mode ini.
·Meningkatkan ketahanan Flins terhadap interupsi.
·Elemental Skill Ancient Rite: Arcane Light akan diubah menjadi Elemental Skill khusus Northland Spearstorm.

Northland Spearstorm
Flins memanggil sekumpulan tombak di hadapannya dan mengakibatkan Electro DMG Area. Selama 6 detik ke depan, Elemental Burst Ancient Ritual: Cometh the Night Flins juga akan berubah menjadi Elemental Burst khusus **Thunderous Symphony**.
Cooldown dasar Northland Spearstorm adalah 6 detik, dan tidak akan terpengaruh oleh efek lain.

talents.name: Ancient Ritual: Cometh the Night
talents.description:
Flins unleashes the true power of his lamp, dealing AoE Electro DMG and, after a short delay, dealing 2 instances of middle-phase and 1 instance of final-phase AoE Electro DMG, all of which are considered Lunar-Charged DMG.
Moonsign: Ascendant Gleam: Flins's Skill is enhanced: If there are thunderclouds nearby, Flins will deal an additional 2 instances of middle-phase Lunar-Charged AoE Electro DMG.

After using the special Elemental Skill Northland Spearstorm, Flins's Elemental Burst Ancient Ritual: Cometh the Night will be replaced with the special Elemental Burst Thunderous Symphony for the next 6s.

Thunderous Symphony
Consume less Elemental Energy to unleash a special Elemental Burst. Flins deals a single instance of AoE Electro DMG that is considered Lunar-Charged DMG.
Moonsign: Ascendant Gleam: Flins's Skill is enhanced: If there are thunderclouds nearby, Flins will deal an additional instance of Lunar-Charged AoE Electro DMG.
talents.descriptionId:
Flins melepaskan kekuatan sejati lenteranya untuk mengakibatkan Electro DMG Area, dan setelah jeda sesaat, mengakibatkan 2 kali Electro DMG Area di fase tengah dan 1 kali Electro DMG Area di fase akhir yang dianggap sebagai DMG reaksi Lunar-Charged.
Moonsign: Ascendant Gleam: Skill akan diperkuat: Jika ada awan petir di sekitar, Flins akan mengakibatkan 2 kali Electro DMG Area tambahan di fase tengah dan 1 kali Electro DMG Area tambahan di fase akhir yang dianggap sebagai DMG reaksi Lunar-Charged.

Selama 6 detik setelah melancarkan Elemental Skill khusus Northland Spearstorm, Elemental Burst Flins Ancient Ritual: Cometh the Night akan diubah menjadi Elemental Burst khusus Thunderous Symphony.

Thunderous Symphony
Mengonsumsi Energy yang lebih sedikit untuk melancarkan Elemental Burst khusus. Flins mengakibatkan 1 kali Electro DMG Area yang dianggap sebagai DMG reaksi Lunar-Charged.
Moonsign: Ascendant Gleam: Skill akan akan diperkuat: Jika ada awan petir di sekitar, Flins akan mengakibatkan 1 kali Electro DMG Area tambahan yang dianggap sebagai DMG reaksi Lunar-Charged.

passives.name: Symphony of Winter
passives.description:
Flins will gain a corresponding buff effect based on the party's Moonsign.

Moonsign: Ascendant Gleam: Lunar-Charged reactions triggered by Flins will deal an additional 20% DMG.
passives.descriptionId:
Flins akan mendapatkan efek penguatan yang berbeda berdasarkan Moonsign milik party.

Moonsign: Ascendant Gleam: DMG reaksi Lunar-Charged yang dipicu oleh Flins +20%.

passives.name: Whispering Flame
passives.description: Flins's Elemental Mastery is increased by 8% of his ATK. The maximum increase obtainable this way is 160.
passives.descriptionId: Elemental Mastery Flins meningkat sebesar 8% dari ATK Flins. Peningkatan Elemental Mastery yang bisa diperoleh Flins dengan cara ini adalah maksimum 160 poin.

passives.name: Moonsign Benediction: Old World Secrets
passives.description:
When a party member triggers an Electro-Charged reaction, it will be converted into the Lunar-Charged reaction, with every 100 ATK that Flins has increasing Lunar-Charged's Base DMG by 0.7%, up to a maximum of 14%.

Additionally, when Flins is in the party, the party's Moonsign will increase by 1 level.
passives.descriptionId:
Saat Karakter di dalam party memicu reaksi Electro-Charged, reaksi ini akan diubah menjadi reaksi Lunar-Charged. DMG dasar reaksi Lunar-Charged meningkat: Untuk setiap 100 poin ATK Flins, DMG dasar meningkat 0,7%, dapat meningkat hingga maksimum 14% dengan cara ini.

Selain itu, saat Flins berada di dalam party, Moonsign party meningkat 1 level.

passives.name: A Light in the Dark
passives.description:
Displays the location of nearby resources unique to Nod-Krai on the mini-map.
Additionally, Flins appears to be able to decipher the whispers of the Wild Hunt...
passives.descriptionId:
Memperlihatkan lokasi produk khas Nod-Krai di sekitar pada peta kecil.
Selain itu, Flins sepertinya bisa mendengar bisikan dari Perburuan Liar ....

constellations.name: Part the Veil of Snow
constellations.description:
The basic cooldown of the special Elemental Skill Northland Spearstorm is reduced to 4s.
Additionally, when party members trigger Lunar-Charged reactions, Flins will recover 8 Elemental Energy. This effect can occur once every 5.5s.
constellations.descriptionId:
Cooldown dasar Elemental Skill khusus Northland Spearstorm berkurang menjadi 4 detik.
Selain itu, saat Karakter dalam party memicu reaksi Lunar-Charged, Flins akan mendapatkan 8 poin Energy. Efek ini dapat terpicu sekali setiap 5,5 detik.

constellations.name: The Devil's Wall
constellations.description:
For the next 6s after using the special Elemental Skill Northland Spearstorm, when Flins's next Normal Attack hits an opponent, it will deal an additional 50% of Flins's ATK as AoE Electro DMG. This DMG is considered Lunar-Charged DMG.
Moonsign: Ascendant Gleam: While Flins is on the field, after his Electro attacks hit an opponent, that opponent's Electro RES will be decreased by 25% for 7s.
constellations.descriptionId:
Dalam 6 detik setelah melancarkan Elemental Skill khusus Northland Spearstorm, saat Normal Attack Flins yang selanjutnya mengenai musuh, akan mengakibatkan Electro DMG Area sebesar 50% ATK Flins. DMG ini dianggap sebagai DMG Lunar-Charged.
Moonsign: Ascendant Gleam: Saat Flins berada di medan pertempuran, setelah serangan Electro Flins mengenai musuh, maka Electro RES musuh ini berkurang 25% selama 7 detik.

constellations.name: Stranger in the Night
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of **Ancient Ritual: Cometh the Night** by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.descriptionId:
Meningkatkan 3 level Elemental Burst **Ancient Ritual: Cometh the Night**.
Maksimum: Lv. 15.

constellations.name: Night on Bald Mountain
constellations.description:
Flins's ATK is increased by 20%.
Additionally, his Ascension Talent **Whispering Flame** is enhanced: Flins's Elemental Mastery is increased by 10% of his ATK. The maximum increase obtainable this way is 220.
constellations.descriptionId:
ATK Flins meningkat 20%.
Selain itu, Talenta Ascension **Whispering Flame** miliknya diperkuat: Elemental Mastery Flins meningkat sebesar 10% ATK Flins. Peningkatan Elemental Mastery yang dapat diperoleh dengan cara ini adalah maksimum 220 poin.

constellations.name: Exile's Shadow
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of **Ancient Rite: Arcane Light** by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.descriptionId:
Meningkatkan 3 level Elemental Skill **Ancient Rite: Arcane Light**.
Maksimum: Lv. 15.

constellations.name: Songs and Dances of Death
constellations.description:
The DMG dealt to opponents by Flins's Lunar-Charged reactions is **elevated** by 35%.
Moonsign: Ascendant Gleam: All nearby party members' Lunar-Charged DMG is elevated by 10%.
constellations.descriptionId:
DMG reaksi Lunar-Charged Flins terhadap musuh **bertumbuh** 35%.
Moonsign: Ascendant Gleam: DMG reaksi Lunar-Charged yang diakibatkan semua Karakter sekitar dalam party bertumbuh 10%.

name: Furina
title: Endless Solo of Solitude
description: The absolute focus of the stage of judgment, until the final applause sounds.
descriptionId: Pusat perhatian utama panggung pengadilan, hingga tepuk-tangan di penghujung acara terdengar.

talents.name: Soloist's Solicitation
talents.description:
Normal Attack
Performs up to 4 consecutive strikes.

Charged Attack
Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to unleash a solo dance, dealing Physical DMG to nearby opponents and changing her Arkhe alignment. If Salon Members or the Singer of Many Waters summoned by her Elemental Skill "Salon Solitaire" is present, their lineup will switch in response.

Arkhe: Seats Sacred and Secular
At intervals, when Furina's Normal Attacks hit, a Spiritbreath Thorn or a Surging Blade will descend based on her current Arkhe alignment, dealing Pneuma- or Ousia-aligned Hydro DMG.
When Furina takes the field, her starting Arkhe alignment will be Ousia.

Plunging Attack
Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground below, damaging opponents along the path and dealing AoE DMG upon impact.
talents.descriptionId:
Normal Attack
Melancarkan hingga 4 serangan berturut-turut.

Charged Attack
Mengonsumsi sejumlah Stamina, melancarkan tarian tunggal yang mengakibatkan Physical DMG terhadap musuh di sekitarnya, lalu mengganti Karakteristik Arkhe diri sendiri. Jika "Salon Members" atau "Singer of Many Waters" yang dipanggil oleh Elemental Skill "Salon Solitaires" miliknya berada di medan perang, barisan mereka juga akan turut berubah.

Arkhe: Seats Sacred and Secular
Setiap satu kurun waktu tertentu, saat Normal Attack Furina mengenai musuh, akan menurunkan Spiritbreath Thorn atau Surging Blade berdasarkan Karakteristiknya saat ini dan mengakibatkan Hydro DMG Pneuma-Aligned atau Ousia-Aligned.
Saat Furina berada di medan pertempuran, Arkhe awalnya adalah Ousia.

Plunging Attack
Menerjang dari udara untuk menghantam tanah, menyerang musuh di jalur terjangan dan mengakibatkan DMG Area saat mendarat.

talents.name: Salon Solitaire
talents.description:
Invites the guests of the Salon Solitaire to come forth and aid in Furina's performance. Will summon either the Salon Members or the Singer of Many Waters based on Furina's current Arkhe alignment.

Ousia
Foaming bubbles like celebrants shall dance, dealing AoE Hydro DMG based on Furina's Max HP and summoning 3 Salon Members: the Ball Octopus-shaped Gentilhomme Usher, the Bubbly Seahorse-shaped Surintendante Chevalmarin, and the Armored Crab-shaped Mademoiselle Crabaletta.
They will attack nearby opponents at intervals, prioritizing the target of the active character, dealing Hydro DMG based on Max HP.
When they attack, if character(s) with more than 50% HP are nearby, the Members will increase their current attack's power based on the number of such characters, and consume said characters' HP. If 1/2/3/4 (or more) characters meet these requirements, the Members' attacks will deal 110%/120%/130%/140% of their original DMG.

Pneuma
Summons the Singer of Many Waters, who will heal nearby active character(s) based on Max HP at intervals.

The Salon Members and Singer of Many Waters share a duration, and when Furina uses her Charged Attack to change the guest type, the new guests will inherit the remaining duration.
While the Salon Members or the Singer of Many Waters is on the field, Furina can move on the water's surface.
talents.descriptionId:
Mengundang tamu-tamu dari Salon Solitaire untuk bergabung ke dalam barisan dan membantu pertunjukan Furina. Tamu yang diundang termasuk "Salon Members" atau "Singer of Many Waters", ditentukan berdasarkan Karakteristik Arkhe Furina saat ini.

Ousia
Membentuk gelembung yang berpesta ria dan mengakibatkan Hydro DMG Area yang didasarkan pada Max HP Furina, dan memanggil tiga "Salon Members", yaitu: "Gentilhomme Usher" yang berbentuk Ball Octopus, "Surintendante Chevalmarin" yang berbentuk Bubbly Seahorse, dan "Mademoiselle Crabaletta" yang berbentuk Armored Crab.
Salon Members akan menyerang musuh di sekitar secara berkala, dengan prioritas menyerang target Karakter aktif lebih dulu, dan mengakibatkan Hydro DMG yang didasarkan pada Max HP.
Saat Salon Members menyerang, akan meningkatkan serangan tersebut berdasarkan jumlah anggota party di sekitar yang memiliki HP di atas 50%, dan akan mengonsumsi HP Karakter yang bersangkutan. Saat jumlah Karakter yang memenuhi syarat berjumlah 1/2/3/4 atau lebih, maka DMG serangan akan menjadi 110%/120%/130%/140% dari nilai awalnya.

Pneuma
Memanggil "Singer of Many Waters" untuk memulihkan HP Karakter aktif di sekitar setiap satu kurun waktu tertentu. Jumlah pemulihan didasarkan pada Max HP.

Salon Members dan Singer of Many Waters berbagi durasi yang sama. Saat Furina mengganti formasi tamu melalui Charged Attack, tamu baru akan melanjutkan sisa durasi awal.
Furina dapat bergerak di atas permukaan air selama Salon Members atau Singer of Many Waters berada di medan pertempuran.

talents.name: Let the People Rejoice
talents.description:
Rouses the impulse to revel, creating a stage of foam that will deal AoE Hydro DMG based on Furina's Max HP and cause nearby party members to enter the Universal Revelry state: During this time, when nearby party members' HP increases or decreases, 1 Fanfare point will be granted to Furina for each percentage point of their Max HP by which their HP changes.
At the same time, Furina will increase the DMG dealt by and Incoming Healing Bonus of all nearby party members based on the amount of Fanfare she has.
When the duration ends, Furina's Fanfare points will be cleared.
talents.descriptionId:
Mengumpulkan sukacita kebahagiaan dan membentuk panggung gelembung, mengakibatkan Hydro DMG Area yang didasarkan pada Max HP Furina, juga membuat anggota party di sekitar memasuki status Universal Revelry: Selama durasi berlangsung, saat HP Karakter tersebut bertambah atau berkurang, akan memberikan 1 Fanfare Point kepada Furina berdasarkan setiap persentase perubahan HP Karakter yang bersangkutan.
Selain itu, DMG yang diakibatkan dan bonus pemulihan yang diterima seluruh anggota party di sekitar akan meningkat berdasarkan jumlah Fanfare Point yang dimiliki Furina.
Saat durasinya berakhir, Fanfare Point yang dimiliki oleh Furina akan dihapus.

passives.name: Endless Waltz
passives.description: When the active character in your party receives healing, if the source of the healing is not Furina herself and the healing overflows, then Furina will heal nearby party members for 2% of their Max HP once every 2s for the next 4s.
passives.descriptionId: Saat Karakter aktif di dalam party menerima pemulihan, jika pemulihan tersebut bukan berasal dari Furina sendiri dan pemulihannya berlebih, maka dalam 4 detik selanjutnya, Furina akan memberikan satu kali pemulihan terhadap Karakter di dalam party yang berada sekitar setiap 2 detik. Jumlah pemulihan adalah 2% Max HP Karakter yang bersangkutan.

passives.name: Unheard Confession
passives.description:
Every 1,000 points of Furina's Max HP can buff the different Arkhe-aligned Salon Solitaire in the following ways:
Will increase Salon Members' DMG dealt by 0.7%, up to a maximum of 28%.
Will decrease the Singer of Many Waters' healing interval for nearby active characters by 0.4%, up to a maximum of 16%.
passives.descriptionId:
Untuk setiap 1.000 poin Max HP Furina, akan memberikan buff yang berbeda berdasarkan Salon Solitaire Furina yang berada dalam karakteristik Arkhe yang berbeda:
Meningkatkan 0,7% DMG yang diakibatkan oleh Salon Members. Maksimum peningkatan DMG yang dapat diperoleh Salon Members dengan cara ini adalah 28%.
Mengurangi jeda pemulihan Singer of Many Waters terhadap Karakter aktif di sekitar sebesar 0,4%. Maksimum pengurangan jeda yang dapat diperoleh dengan cara ini adalah 16%.

passives.name: The Sea Is My Stage
passives.description: Xenochromatic Fontemer Aberrant ability CD decreased by 30%.
passives.descriptionId: Cooldown kemampuan Xenochromatic Fontemer Aberrant berkurang 30%.

constellations.name: "Love Is a Rebellious Bird That None Can Tame"
constellations.description:
When using Let the People Rejoice, Furina will gain 150 Fanfare.
Additionally, Furina's Fanfare limit is increased by 100.
constellations.descriptionId:
Saat melancarkan Let the People Rejoice, Furina akan mendapatkan 150 poin Fanfare.
Selain itu, batas maksimum Fanfare Furina meningkat 100 poin.

constellations.name: "A Woman Adapts Like Duckweed in Water"
constellations.description: While Let the People Rejoice lasts, Furina's Fanfare gain from increases or decreases in nearby characters' HP is increased by 250%. Each point of Fanfare above the limit will increase Furina's Max HP by 0.35%. Her maximum Max HP increase is 140%.
constellations.descriptionId: Selama durasi Let the People Rejoice berlangsung, peningkatan Fanfare yang diperoleh Furina dari bertambah atau berkurangnya HP anggota party di sekitar meningkat 250%. Setiap poin Fanfare yang melebihi batas maksimum akan meningkatkan Max HP Furina sebesar 0,35%. Maksimum peningkatan Max HP yang dapat diperoleh Furina dengan cara ini adalah 140%.

constellations.name: "My Secret Is Hidden Within Me, No One Will Know My Name"
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Let the People Rejoice by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.descriptionId:
Meningkatkan 3 level Let the People Rejoice.
Maksimum: Lv. 15.

constellations.name: "They Know Not Life, Who Dwelt in the Netherworld Not!"
constellations.description: When the Salon Members from Salon Solitaire hit an opponent, or the Singer of Many Waters restores HP to nearby active characters, Furina will restore 4 Energy. This effect can be triggered once every 5s.
constellations.descriptionId: Saat serangan Salon Members dari Salon Solitaire mengenai musuh, atau saat Singer of Many Waters memulihkan HP Karakter aktif di sekitarnya, Furina akan mendapatkan 4 poin Energy. Efek ini dapat terpicu sekali setiap 5 detik.

constellations.name: "His Name I Now Know, It Is...!"
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Salon Solitaire by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.descriptionId:
Meningkatkan 3 level Salon Solitaire.
Maksimum: Lv. 15.

constellations.name: "Hear Me — Let Us Raise the Chalice of Love!"
constellations.description:
When using Salon Solitaire, Furina gains "Center of Attention" for 10s.
Throughout the duration, Furina's Normal Attacks, Charged Attacks, and Plunging Attacks are converted into Hydro DMG which cannot be overridden by any other elemental infusion. DMG is also increased by an amount equivalent to 18% of Furina's max HP.
Throughout the duration, Furina's Normal Attacks (not including Arkhe: Seats Sacred and Secular Attacks), Charged Attacks, and the impact of Plunging Attacks will cause different effects up to every 0.1s after hitting opponents depending on her current Arkhe alignment:

Arkhe: Ousia
Every 1s, all nearby characters in the party will be healed by 4% of Furina's max HP, for a duration of 2.9s. Triggering this effect again will extend its duration.
Arkhe: Pneuma
This Normal Attack (not including Arkhe: Seats Sacred and Secular Attacks), Charged Attack, or Plunging Attack ground impact DMG will be further increased by an amount equivalent to 25% of Furina's max HP. When any of the attacks mentioned previously hit an opponent, all nearby characters in the party will consume 1% of their current HP.

During the duration of each instance of "Center of Attention," the above effects can be triggered up to 6 times. "Center of Attention" will end when its effects have triggered 6 times or when the duration expires.
constellations.descriptionId:
Saat melancarkan Salon Solitaire, Furina akan mendapatkan "Center of Attention" yang berlangsung selama 10 detik.
Selama durasi ini berlangsung, Normal Attack, Charged Attack, dan Plunging Attack Furina akan dikonversi menjadi Hydro DMG yang tidak bisa ditimpa Elemental Infusion lainnya. DMG yang diakibatkan juga meningkat sebesar 18% Max HP Furina.
Setiap 0,1 detik selama efek ini berlangsung, Normal Attack (tidak termasuk serangan "Arkhe: Seats Sacred and Secular"), Charged Attack, dan Plunging Attack Furina yang mengenai musuh akan menghasilkan efek yang berbeda berdasarkan Karakteristik Arkhe Furina saat ini:

Arkhe: Ousia
Memulihkan HP seluruh anggota party di sekitar sebesar 4% Max HP Furina setiap detik selama 2,9 detik. Memicu efek ini lagi akan memperpanjang durasinya.
Arkhe: Pneuma
DMG yang diakibatkan Normal Attack (tidak termasuk serangan "Arkhe: Seats Sacred and Secular"), Charged Attack, dan Plunging Attack kali ini akan ditingkatkan lagi sebesar 25% Max HP Furina. Saat serangan-serangan yang disebutkan di atas mengenai musuh, seluruh anggota party di sekitar akan kehilangan 1% dari HP-nya saat ini.

Dalam satu durasi "Center of Attention", efek di atas dapat terpicu maksimum 6 kali. Efek ini akan hilang setelah terpicu 6 kali atau saat durasinya berakhir.

name: Ganyu
title: Plenilune Gaze
description: The secretary at Yuehai Pavilion. The blood of the qilin, an illuminated beast, flows within her veins.
descriptionId: Seorang sekretaris di Yuehai Pavilion. Darah hewan pusaka Qilin mengalir di dalam tubuhnya.

talents.name: Liutian Archery
talents.description:
Normal Attack
Performs up to 6 consecutive shots with a bow.

Charged Attack
Performs a more precise Aimed Shot with increased DMG.
While aiming, an icy aura will accumulate on the arrowhead before the arrow is fired. Has different effects based on how long the energy has been charged:
·Charge Level 1: Fires off an icy arrow that deals Cryo DMG.
·Charge Level 2: Fires off a Frostflake Arrow that deals Cryo DMG. The Frostflake Arrow blooms after hitting its target, dealing AoE Cryo DMG.

Plunging Attack
Fires off a shower of arrows in mid-air before falling and striking the ground, dealing AoE DMG upon impact.
talents.descriptionId:
Normal Attack
Melancarkan hingga 6 serangan berturut-turut dengan busur.

Charged Attack
Melancarkan sebuah Serangan Membidik yang lebih akurat untuk mengakibatkan DMG lebih besar.
Saat membidik, es akan berkumpul di ujung anak panah. Memiliki efek yang berbeda tergantung dari lama serangannya ditahan:
·Charge Tahap 1: Menembakkan panah es yang mengakibatkan Cryo DMG.
·Charge Tahap 2: Menembakkan Frostflake Arrow yang mengakibatkan Cryo DMG. Frostflake Arrow akan mengembang setelah mengenai target untuk mengakibatkan Cryo DMG area.

Plunging Attack
Melancarkan hujan panah dari udara dan menerjang tanah dengan kecepatan tinggi, mengakibatkan DMG area saat mendarat.

talents.name: Trail of the Qilin
talents.description:
Leaving a single Ice Lotus behind, Ganyu dashes backward, shunning all impurity and dealing AoE Cryo DMG.

Ice Lotus
·Continuously taunts surrounding opponents, attracting them to attack it.
·Endurance scales based on Ganyu's Max HP.
·Blooms profusely when destroyed or once its duration ends, dealing AoE Cryo DMG.
talents.descriptionId:
Dengan meninggalkan sebuah Ice Lotus, Ganyu meloncat mundur dengan cepat, membuang semua ketidakmurnian dan mengakibatkan Cryo DMG area.

Ice Lotus
·Terus menarik perhatian musuh di sekitar untuk menyerangnya.
·HP Ice Lotus mewarisi Max HP Ganyu berdasarkan persentase tertentu.
·Saat dihancurkan atau durasinya berakhir, Ice Lotus akan mengembang dengan hebat dan mengakibatkan Cryo DMG area.

talents.name: Celestial Shower
talents.description:
Coalesces atmospheric frost and snow to summon a Sacred Cryo Pearl that exorcises evil.
During its ability duration, the Sacred Cryo Pearl will continuously rain down shards of ice, striking opponents within an AoE and dealing Cryo DMG.
talents.descriptionId:
Mengumpulkan es dan salju di udara untuk memanggil Sacred Cryo Pearl yang membasmi iblis.
Selama durasi skill, Sacred Cryo Pearl akan terus menjatuhkan bongkahan es yang mengenai musuh dalam area dan mengakibatkan Cryo DMG.

passives.name: Undivided Heart
passives.description: After firing a Frostflake Arrow, the CRIT Rate of subsequent Frostflake Arrows and their resulting bloom effects is increased by 20% for 5s.
passives.descriptionId: Setelah menembakkan sebuah Frostflake Arrow, meningkatkan 20% CRIT Rate dari Frostflake Arrow berikutnya serta efek ledakan yang disebabkan olehnya selama 5 detik.

passives.name: Harmony Between Heaven and Earth
passives.description: Celestial Shower grants a 20% Cryo DMG Bonus to active party members in the AoE.
passives.descriptionId: Celestial Shower memberikan 20% Cryo DMG Bonus kepada anggota party yang berada di dalam lingkup areanya.

passives.name: Preserved for the Hunt
passives.description: Refunds 15% of the ore used when crafting Bow-type weapons.
passives.descriptionId: Mengembalikan 15% jumlah Ore yang digunakan saat membuat senjata tipe Bow.

constellations.name: Dew-Drinker
constellations.description:
Charge Level 2 Frostflake Arrows or Frostflake Arrow Blooms decrease opponents' Cryo RES by 15% for 6s upon hit.
A hit also regenerates 2 Energy for Ganyu. This effect can only occur once per Charge Level 2 Frostflake Arrow, regardless if Frostflake Arrow itself or its Bloom hits the target.
constellations.descriptionId:
Mengurangi 15% Cryo RES musuh yang terkena Frostflake Arrow Charge Tahap 2 atau Frostflake Arrow Bloom selama 6 detik.
Serangan ini juga akan memulihkan 2 Energy Ganyu. Efek pemulihan Energy terpicu maksimum 1 kali dalam 1 serangan, tak peduli musuh terkena Frostflake Arrow Charge Tahap 2 atau ledakan Frostflake Arrow Bloom.

constellations.name: The Auspicious
constellations.description: Trail of the Qilin gains 1 additional charge.
constellations.descriptionId: Meningkatkan 1 charge Trail of the Qilin.

constellations.name: Cloud-Strider
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Celestial Shower by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.descriptionId:
Meningkatkan 3 level Celestial Shower.
Maksimum: Lv. 15.

constellations.name: Westward Sojourn
constellations.description:
Opponents standing within the AoE of Celestial Shower take increased DMG. This effect strengthens over time.
Increased DMG taken begins at 5% and increases by 5% every 3s, up to a maximum of 25%.
The effect lingers for 3s after the opponent leaves the AoE.
constellations.descriptionId:
Meningkatkan DMG yang diterima musuh saat mereka berada di dalam area Celestial Shower. Semakin lama musuh berada di dalam area, semakin besar efek peningkatan DMG.
Peningkatan DMG mula-mula 5%, dan meningkat 5% setiap 3 detik, peningkatan DMG maksimum: 25%.
Efek ini bertahan selama 3 detik setelah musuh meninggalkan area.

constellations.name: The Merciful
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Trail of the Qilin by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.descriptionId:
Meningkatkan 3 level Trail of the Qilin.
Maksimum: Lv. 15.

constellations.name: The Clement
constellations.description: Using Trail of the Qilin causes the next Frostflake Arrow shot within 30s to not require charging.
constellations.descriptionId: Menggunakan Trail of the Qilin akan menyebabkan Frostflake Arrow yang ditembakkan dalam waktu 30 detik ke depan tidak memerlukan Charge.

name: Hu Tao
title: Fragrance in Thaw
description: The 77th Director of the Wangsheng Funeral Parlor. She took over the business at a rather young age.
descriptionId: Master ke-77 Wangsheng Funeral Parlor. Dia mengambil alih bisnis ini di umur yang cukup muda.

talents.name: Secret Spear of Wangsheng
talents.description:
Normal Attack
Performs up to 6 consecutive spear strikes.

Charged Attack
Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to lunge forward, dealing damage to opponents along the way.

Plunging Attack
Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground below, damaging opponents along the path and dealing AoE DMG upon impact.
talents.descriptionId:
Normal Attack
Melancarkan hingga 6 serangan berturut-turut.

Charged Attack
Mengonsumsi sejumlah Stamina untuk menerjang ke depan, mengakibatkan DMG pada musuh di jalur terjangan.

Plunging Attack
Menerjang dari udara untuk menghantam tanah, mengakibatkan DMG pada musuh di jalur terjangan dan mengakibatkan DMG area saat mendarat.

talents.name: Guide to Afterlife
talents.description:
Only an unwavering flame can cleanse the impurities of this world.
Hu Tao consumes a set portion of her HP to knock the surrounding enemies back and enter the Paramita Papilio state.

Paramita Papilio
·Increases Hu Tao's ATK based on her Max HP at the time of entering this state. ATK Bonus gained this way cannot exceed 400% of Hu Tao's Base ATK.
·Converts attack DMG to Pyro DMG, which cannot be overridden by any other elemental infusion.
·Charged Attacks apply the Blood Blossom effect to the enemies hit.
·Increases Hu Tao's resistance to interruption.

Blood Blossom
Enemies affected by Blood Blossom will take Pyro DMG every 4s. This DMG is considered Elemental Skill DMG.
Each enemy can be affected by only one Blood Blossom effect at a time, and its duration may only be refreshed by Hu Tao herself.

Paramita Papilio ends when its duration is over, or Hu Tao has left the battlefield or fallen.
talents.descriptionId:
Hanya kobaran api tak terpadamkan yang dapat memurnikan dunia.
Hu Tao mengonsumsi sejumlah HP untuk menyerang dan menghempas musuh di sekitar, kemudian masuk ke dalam kondisi Paramita Papilio.

Paramita Papilio
·Kondisi ini meningkatkan ATK Hu Tao berdasarkan Max HP. Tambahan bonus ATK tidak dapat melebihi 400% Base ATK Hu Tao.
·Mengonversi DMG serangan menjadi Pyro DMG, konversi ini tidak dapat ditimpa oleh Elemental Infusion lainnya.
·Musuh yang terkena Charged Attack akan terkena efek Blood Blossom.
·Meningkatkan ketahanan Hu Tao terhadap interupsi.

Blood Blossom
Musuh yang terkena efek Blood Blossom akan menerima Pyro DMG setiap 4 detik. DMG yang diakibatkan akan dihitung sebagai Elemental Skill DMG.
Setiap musuh hanya dapat dipengaruhi oleh satu efek Blood Blossom dalam satu waktu, dan durasi waktunya hanya bisa diperbarui oleh Hu Tao sendiri.

Paramita Papilio berhenti saat durasi waktunya berakhir, atau saat Hu Tao telah meninggalkan medan pertempuran/gugur.

talents.name: Spirit Soother
talents.description:
Commands a blazing spirit to attack, dealing Pyro DMG in a large AoE.
Upon striking the enemy, regenerates a percentage of Hu Tao's Max HP. This effect can be triggered up to 5 times, based on the number of enemies hit.
If Hu Tao's HP is below or equal to 50% when the enemy is hit, both the DMG and HP Regeneration are increased.
talents.descriptionId:
Memerintahkan roh yang membara untuk menyerang dan mengakibatkan Pyro DMG pada area yang besar.
Saat memukul musuh, akan memulihkan HP berdasarkan persentase Max HP Hu Tao. Efek ini dapat terpicu ke 5 musuh berbeda.
Jika HP Hu Tao sama dengan atau kurang dari 50% saat skill ini mengenai musuh, maka DMG dan pemulihan HP akan meningkat.

passives.name: Flutter By
passives.description: When a Paramita Papilio state activated by Guide to Afterlife ends, all allies in the party (excluding Hu Tao herself) will have their CRIT Rate increased by 12% for 8s.
passives.descriptionId: Saat kondisi Paramita Papilio yang diaktifkan oleh Guide to Afterlife telah berakhir, akan meningkatkan 12% CRIT Rate seluruh anggota party (tidak termasuk Hu Tao sendiri) selama 8 detik.

passives.name: Sanguine Rouge
passives.description: When Hu Tao's HP is equal to or less than 50%, her Pyro DMG Bonus is increased by 33%.
passives.descriptionId: Saat HP Hu Tao kurang dari atau sama dengan 50%, maka Hu Tao akan memperoleh 33% Pyro DMG Bonus.

passives.name: The More the Merrier
passives.description: When Hu Tao cooks a dish perfectly, she has an 18% chance to receive an additional "Suspicious" dish of the same type.
passives.descriptionId: Saat Hu Tao memasak makanan dengan sempurna, terdapat 18% kemungkinan mendapatkan hasil tambahan makanan "Suspicious" dari jenis makanan yang sama.

constellations.name: Crimson Bouquet
constellations.description: While in a Paramita Papilio state activated by Guide to Afterlife, Hu Tao's Charged Attacks do not consume Stamina.
constellations.descriptionId: Saat kondisi Paramita Papilio diaktifkan oleh Guide to Afterlife, Charge Attack Hu Tao tidak akan mengonsumsi Stamina.

constellations.name: Ominous Rainfall
constellations.description:
Increases the Blood Blossom DMG by an amount equal to 10% of Hu Tao's Max HP at the time the effect is applied.
Additionally, Spirit Soother will also apply the Blood Blossom effect.
constellations.descriptionId:
Meningkatkan DMG Blood Blossom sebesar 10% Max HP Hu Tao ketika efek diterapkan.
Selain itu, Spirit Soother juga menyebabkan efek Blood Blossom saat mengenai musuh.

constellations.name: Lingering Carmine
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Guide to Afterlife by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.descriptionId:
Meningkatkan 3 level Guide to Afterlife.
Maksimum: Lv. 15.

constellations.name: Garden of Eternal Rest
constellations.description: Upon defeating an enemy affected by a Blood Blossom that Hu Tao applied herself, all nearby allies in the party (excluding Hu Tao herself) will have their CRIT Rate increased by 12% for 15s.
constellations.descriptionId: Saat musuh yang terkena efek Blood Blossom yang disebabkan oleh Hu Tao sendiri dikalahkan, akan meningkatkan 12% CRIT Rate seluruh anggota party yang ada di sekitar (tidak termasuk Hu Tao sendiri) selama 15 detik.

constellations.name: Floral Incense
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Spirit Soother by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.descriptionId:
Meningkatkan 3 level Spirit Soother.
Maksimum: Lv. 15.

constellations.name: Butterfly's Embrace
constellations.description:
Triggers when Hu Tao's HP drops below 25%, or when she suffers a lethal strike:
Hu Tao will not fall as a result of the DMG sustained. Additionally, for the next 10s, her All Elemental and Physical RES is increased by 200%, her CRIT Rate is increased by 100%, and her resistance to interruption is greatly increased.
This effect triggers automatically when Hu Tao has 1 HP left.
Can only occur once every 60s.
constellations.descriptionId:
Efek ini akan terpicu saat HP Hu Tao berada di bawah 25% atau terkena serangan mematikan:
Hu Tao tidak akan gugur saat terkena serangan tersebut. Selama 10 detik ke depan, meningkatkan 200% Elemental dan Physical RES, meningkatkan 100% CRIT Rate dan meningkatkan ketahanan Hu Tao terhadap interupsi secara signifikan.
Efek ini akan terpicu otomatis saat HP Hu Tao tersisa 1.
Hanya dapat terpicu setiap 60 detik.

name: Ineffa
title: Boom Boom Thunderwave
description: A multifunctional robot containing integrated mechanical components from various nations. The Source Core in her chest has endured the passage of countless years.
descriptionId: Robot serba bisa yang dibuat dengan kombinasi komponen mekanisme dari berbagai bangsa. Inti Sumber yang terletak di dadanya telah ada sejak waktu yang lama sekali.

talents.name: Cyclonic Duster
talents.description:
Normal Attack
Performs up to 4 consecutive spear strikes.

Charged Attack
Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to perform a spinning attack.

Plunging Attack
Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground below, damaging opponents along the path and dealing AoE DMG upon impact.
talents.descriptionId:
Normal Attack
Melancarkan hingga 4 serangan tombak berturut-turut.

Charged Attack
Mengonsumsi sejumlah Stamina untuk melakukan serangan berputar.

Plunging Attack
Menerjang dari udara untuk menghantam tanah, menyerang musuh di jalur terjangan dan mengakibatkan DMG area saat mendarat.

talents.name: Cleaning Mode: Carrier Frequency
talents.description:
Ineffa engages her Enhanced Cleaning Module, dealing a single instance of AoE Electro DMG to nearby opponents, activating her Optical Flow Shield Barrier, and summoning the Multipurpose Smart Assistance Unit, **Birgitta**.
The Optical Flow Shield Barrier absorbs DMG based on Ineffa's ATK, and it will absorb Electro DMG with 250% effectiveness.
talents.descriptionId:
Ineffa mengaktifkan Modul Pembersihan Tingkat Lanjut miliknya untuk mengakibatkan Electro DMG Area satu kali ke musuh di sekitar, menciptakan Optical Flow Shield Barrier, dan memanggil Asisten Pintar Serbabisa bernama **Birgitta**.
Ketahanan Optical Flow Shield Barrier didasarkan pada ATK Ineffa dan memiliki 250% pertahanan terhadap Electro DMG.

talents.name: Supreme Instruction: Cyclonic Exterminator
talents.description:
Through Multipurpose Smart Assistance Unit, **Birgitta**, Ineffa can use Rocket Punches to quickly clean up opponents! Shoots Birgitta into the fray, dealing AoE Electro DMG and allowing Birgitta to remain on the field.

If Birgitta is already on the field, having been summoned by Ineffa, this Skill will re-summon Birgitta at the target's location and reset her duration.
talents.descriptionId:
Ineffa dapat melancarkan Rocket Punch berupa **Birgitta** si Asisten Pintar Serbabisa untuk membersihkan musuhnya! Ineffa akan menembakkan Birgitta ke medan pertempuran dan mengakibatkan Electro DMG Area, kemudian Birgitta akan terus berada di medan pertempuran.

Jika Birgitta yang dipanggil oleh Ineffa sudah ada di medan pertempuran, maka Skill ini akan memanggil ulang Birgitta di lokasi yang ditentukan dan mengulang durasinya.

passives.name: Overclocking Circuit
passives.description: If there are thunderclouds created by Lunar-Charged reactions nearby when **Birgitta** unleashes Discharge attacks, she will initiate an additional attack, dealing AoE Electro DMG equal to 65% of Ineffa's ATK. This DMG is considered Lunar-Charged DMG.
passives.descriptionId: Jika ada awan petir yang dihasilkan oleh reaksi Lunar-Charged di sekitar saat **Birgitta** melancarkan serangan setrumannya, maka ia akan melancarkan serangan tambahan yang mengakibatkan Electro DMG Area sebesar 65% ATK Ineffa. DMG ini dianggap sebagai DMG Lunar-Charged.

passives.name: Panoramic Permutation Protocol
passives.description: When using the Elemental Burst **Supreme Instruction: Cyclonic Exterminator**, all your party members will gain the Parameter Permutation effect: Increases Ineffa and your own active party member's Elemental Mastery by 6% of Ineffa's ATK for 20s.
passives.descriptionId: Saat melancarkan Elemental Burst **Supreme Instruction: Cyclonic Exterminator**, semua Karakter sendiri di dalam party akan mendapatkan efek Parameter Permutation. Parameter Permutation: Elemental Mastery Ineffa dan Karakter aktif sendiri meningkat sebesar 6% dari ATK Ineffa selama 20 detik.

passives.name: Moonsign Benediction: Assemblage Hub
passives.description:
When a party member triggers an Electro-Charged reaction, it will be converted into the Lunar-Charged reaction, with every 100 ATK that Ineffa has increasing Lunar-Charged's Base DMG by 0.7%, up to a maximum of 14%.

Additionally, when Ineffa is in the party, the party's Moonsign will increase by 1 level.
passives.descriptionId:
Saat Karakter di dalam party memicu reaksi Electro-Charged, reaksi ini akan diubah menjadi reaksi Lunar-Charged. DMG dasar reaksi Lunar-Charged meningkat: Untuk setiap 100 poin ATK Ineffa, DMG dasar meningkat 0,7%, hingga maksimum 14%.

Selain itu, saat Ineffa berada di dalam party, Moonsign party bertambah 1 level.

passives.name: Flavor Synthesis Unit
passives.description:
When Ineffa uses food, there is a 30% chance of gaining a seasoning ingredient.

Additionally, in Nod-Krai, it seems you'll be able to change Birgitta's appearance through certain means...
passives.descriptionId:
Saat Ineffa mengonsumsi makanan, ada 30% kemungkinan untuk mendapatkan Bahan Masak.

Selain itu, sepertinya ada cara tertentu untuk mengubah penampilan Birgitta di Nod-Krai ....

constellations.name: Rectifying Processor
constellations.description: When Ineffa activates her Optical Flow Shield Barrier, all nearby party members will gain the Carrier Flow Composite effect for 20s: Increases Lunar-Charged DMG by 2.5% for every 100 ATK that Ineffa has, up to a maximum of 50%.
constellations.descriptionId: Saat Ineffa mengaktifkan Optical Flow Shield Barrier miliknya, semua anggota party di sekitar akan mendapatkan efek Carrier Flow Composite yang berlangsung 20 detik. Carrier Flow Composite: Meningkatkan DMG Lunar-Charged sebesar 2,5% untuk setiap 100 ATK Ineffa, hingga maksimum 50%.

constellations.name: Support Cleaning Module
constellations.description:
After the Elemental Burst **Supreme Instruction: Cyclonic Exterminator** hits opponents, it will inflict the Punishment Edict status on one of those hit opponents: After a brief delay, or when this opponent is defeated, nearby opponents will take AoE Electro DMG equal to 300% of Ineffa's ATK. This DMG is considered Lunar-Charged DMG.
Additionally, when the Elemental Burst Supreme Instruction: Cyclonic Exterminator is unleashed, nearby party members will gain Optical Flow Shield Barriers.
constellations.descriptionId:
Setelah Elemental Burst **Supreme Instruction: Cyclonic Exterminator** mengenai musuh, akan memberikan status Punishment Edict pada salah satu musuh yang terkena serangan. Punishment Edict: Setelah jeda singkat atau saat musuh ini diserang, musuh di sekitarnya akan terkena Electro DMG Area sebesar 300% ATK Ineffa. DMG ini dianggap sebagai DMG Lunar-Charged.
Selain itu, saat Ineffa melancarkan Elemental Burst Supreme Instruction: Cyclonic Exterminator, Karakter aktif di sekitar akan mendapatkan Optical Flow Shield Barrier.

constellations.name: Enhanced Emotion Emulator
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of **Cleaning Mode: Carrier Frequency** by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.descriptionId:
Meningkatkan 3 level Elemental Skill **Cleaning Mode: Carrier Frequency**.
Maksimum: Lv. 15.

constellations.name: The Edictless Path
constellations.description: When your own party members trigger Lunar-Charged reactions, recover 5 Elemental Energy. This effect can occur once every 4s.
constellations.descriptionId: Saat anggota party sendiri memicu reaksi Lunar-Charged, akan memulihkan 5 poin Energy. Efek ini dapat dipicu sekali setiap 4 detik.

constellations.name: Mirror's Dream Transcension
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of **Supreme Instruction: Cyclonic Exterminator** by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.descriptionId:
Meningkatkan 3 level **Supreme Instruction: Cyclonic Exterminator**.
Maksimum: Lv. 15.

constellations.name: A Dawning Morn for You
constellations.description: When Ineffa is affected by the Carrier Flow Composite effect, she will deal AoE Electro DMG equal to 135% of her ATK to opponents in the current active character's vicinity after nearby thunderclouds release bursts of lightning at opponents. This DMG is considered Lunar-Charged DMG. The aforementioned effect can trigger once every 3.5s.
constellations.descriptionId: Saat Ineffa dalam pengaruh efek Carrier Flow Composite, ia akan mengakibatkan Electro DMG Area sebesar 135% ATK-nya terhadap musuh di sekitar Karakter aktif setelah awan petir di dekatnya melepaskan sambaran petir ke arah musuh. DMG ini dianggap sebagai DMG Lunar-Charged. Efek yang disebutkan di atas dapat terpicu sekali setiap 3,5 detik.

name: Jean
title: Dandelion Knight
description: The righteous and rigorous Dandelion Knight, and Acting Grand Master of Mondstadt's Knights of Favonius.
descriptionId: Dandelion Knight yang menjunjung tinggi keadilan dan kebenaran. Menjabat sebagai Grand Master Knights of Favonius di Mondstadt.

talents.name: Favonius Bladework
talents.description:
Normal Attack
Performs up to 5 consecutive strikes.

Charged Attack
Consumes a certain amount of stamina to launch an opponent using the power of wind.
Launched opponents will slowly fall to the ground.

Plunging Attack
Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground below, damaging opponents along the path and dealing AoE DMG upon impact.
talents.descriptionId:
Normal Attack
Melancarkan hingga 5 serangan berturut-turut.

Charged Attack
Mengonsumsi sejumlah Stamina untuk melancarkan serangan yang menghempas musuh ke udara dengan kekuatan angin.
Musuh yang terhempas akan terjatuh perlahan untuk sementara waktu.

Plunging Attack
Menerjang dari udara untuk menghantam tanah, menyerang musuh di jalur terjangan dan mengakibatkan DMG area saat mendarat.

talents.name: Gale Blade
talents.description:
Focusing the might of the formless wind around her blade, Jean releases a miniature storm, launching opponents in the direction she aims at, dealing massive Anemo DMG.

Hold
At the cost of continued stamina consumption, Jean can command the whirlwind to pull surrounding opponents and objects towards her front.
Direction can be adjusted.
Character is immobile during skill duration.
talents.descriptionId:
Jean mengerahkan badai kecil dengan memusatkan kekuatan angin di bilah pedangnya untuk menghempas musuh ke arah yang dia tunjuk. Mengakibatkan Anemo DMG yang besar.

Tahan
Dengan terus mengonsumsi Stamina, Jean dapat mengarahkan badai tersebut, yang menarik musuh dan obyek di sekitar ke depannya.
Arahnya dapat disesuaikan.
Karakter tidak dapat bergerak selama durasi skill.

talents.name: Dandelion Breeze
talents.description:
Calling upon the wind's protection, Jean creates a swirling Dandelion Field, launching surrounding opponents and dealing Anemo DMG.
At the same time, she instantly regenerates a large amount of HP for all party members. The amount of HP restored scales off Jean's ATK.

Dandelion Field
·Continuously regenerates HP of characters within the AoE and continuously imbues them with Anemo.
·Deals Anemo DMG to opponents entering or exiting the Dandelion Field.
talents.descriptionId:
Dengan memanggil perlindungan dari angin, Jean dapat menciptakan Dandelion Field yang menghempas musuh di sekitar dan mengakibatkan Anemo DMG.
Di saat yang sama, sejumlah besar HP untuk semua anggota party akan pulih secara langsung. Jumlah HP yang dipulihkan bergantung dari ATK Jean.

Dandelion Field
·Memulihkan HP karakter yang berada di dalam lingkup area secara berkelanjutan.
·Memengaruhi musuh yang berada di dalam lingkup area dengan elemen Anemo secara berkelanjutan.
·Mengakibatkan Anemo DMG kepada musuh yang memasuki atau keluar dari Dandelion Field.

passives.name: Wind Companion
passives.description: On hit, Jean's Normal Attacks have a 50% chance to regenerate HP equal to 15% of Jean's ATK for all party members.
passives.descriptionId: Saat Normal Attack Jean mengenai musuh, memiliki 50% kemungkinan untuk memulihkan HP seluruh anggota party sebesar 15% ATK Jean.

passives.name: Let the Wind Lead
passives.description: Using Dandelion Breeze will regenerate 20% of its Energy.
passives.descriptionId: Menggunakan Dandelion Breeze akan memulihkan 20% Energy.

passives.name: Guiding Breeze
passives.description: When a Perfect Cooking is achieved on a dish with restorative effects, there is a 12% chance to obtain double the product.
passives.descriptionId: Saat masakan jenis pemulihan dimasak dengan sempurna, memiliki 12% kemungkinan mendapatkan hasil 2 kali lipat.

constellations.name: Spiraling Tempest
constellations.description: Increases the pulling speed of Gale Blade after holding for more than 1s, and increases the DMG dealt by 40%.
constellations.descriptionId: Meningkatkan kecepatan menarik Gale Blade setelah ditahan lebih dari 1 detik, dan meningkatkan 40% DMG yang diakibatkan.

constellations.name: People's Aegis
constellations.description: When Jean picks up an Elemental Orb/Particle, all party members have their Movement SPD and ATK SPD increased by 15% for 15s.
constellations.descriptionId: Meningkatkan 15% Movement SPD dan ATK SPD seluruh anggota party selama 15 detik saat Jean mengambil Elemental Orb atau Particle.

constellations.name: When the West Wind Arises
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Dandelion Breeze by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.descriptionId:
Meningkatkan 3 level Dandelion Breeze.
Maksimum: Lv. 15.

constellations.name: Lands of Dandelion
constellations.description: Within the Field created by Dandelion Breeze, all opponents have their Anemo RES decreased by 40%.
constellations.descriptionId: Mengurangi 40% Anemo RES musuh yang berada di dalam lingkup area Dandelion Breeze.

constellations.name: Outbursting Gust
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Gale Blade by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.descriptionId:
Meningkatkan 3 level Gale Blade.
Maksimum: Lv. 15.

constellations.name: Lion's Fang, Fair Protector of Mondstadt
constellations.description: Incoming DMG is decreased by 35% within the Field created by Dandelion Breeze. Upon leaving the Dandelion Field, this effect lasts for 3 attacks or 10s.
constellations.descriptionId: Mengurangi 35% DMG yang diterima saat berada di dalam Dandelion Breeze. Efek ini masih bertahan selama 3 serangan atau 10 detik setelah meninggalkan lingkup area skill.

name: Kaedehara Kazuha
title: Scarlet Leaves Pursue Wild Waves
description: A wandering samurai from Inazuma who is currently with Liyue's Crux Fleet. A gentle and carefree soul whose heart hides a great many burdens from the past.
descriptionId: Seorang samurai pengembara dari Inazuma yang saat ini bergabung bersama dengan armada Crux Fleet Liyue. Di dalam jiwanya yang lembut dan riang, terdapat hati yang menyembunyikan banyak beban.

talents.name: Garyuu Bladework
talents.description:
Normal Attack
Performs up to 5 rapid strikes.

Charged Attack
Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to unleash 2 rapid sword strikes.

Plunging Attack
Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground below, damaging opponents along the path and dealing AoE DMG upon impact. If this Plunging Attack is triggered by Chihayaburu, it will be converted to Plunging Attack: Midare Ranzan.

Plunging Attack: Midare Ranzan
When a Plunging Attack is performed using the effects of the Elemental Skill Chihayaburu, Plunging Attack DMG is converted to Anemo DMG and will create a small wind tunnel via a secret blade technique that pulls in nearby objects and opponents.
talents.descriptionId:
Normal Attack
Melancarkan hingga 5 tebasan pedang berturut-turut.

Charged Attack
Mengonsumsi sejumlah Stamina untuk melancarkan dua tebasan pedang.

Plunging Attack
Menerjang dari udara untuk menghantam tanah, menyerang semua musuh di jalurnya dan mengakibatkan DMG area saat mendarat. Jika serangan Plunging Attack terpicu dengan menggunakan Chihayaburu, maka Plunging Attack akan berubah menjadi Plunging Attack: Midare Ranzan.

Plunging Attack: Midare Ranzan
Saat Plunging Attack dilakukan dengan menggunakan efek Elemental Skill Chihayaburu, maka DMG dari Plunging Attack akan berubah menjadi Anemo DMG dan akan menciptakan arus angin kecil yang menarik musuh dan benda di sekitarnya.

talents.name: Chihayaburu
talents.description:
Unleashes a secret technique as fierce as the rushing wind that pulls objects and opponents towards Kazuha's current position before launching opponents within the AoE, dealing Anemo DMG and lifting Kazuha into the air on a rushing gust of wind.
Within 10s of remaining airborne after casting Chihayaburu, Kazuha can unleash a powerful Plunging Attack known as Midare Ranzan.

Press
Can be used in mid-air.

Hold
Charges up before unleashing greater Anemo DMG over a larger AoE than Press Mode.

Plunging Attack: Midare Ranzan
When a Plunging Attack is performed using the effects of the Elemental Skill Chihayaburu, Plunging Attack DMG is converted to Anemo DMG. On landing, Kazuha creates a small wind tunnel via a secret blade technique that pulls in nearby objects and opponents.
Midare Ranzan's DMG is considered Plunging Attack DMG.
talents.descriptionId:
Melancarkan ilmu pedang rahasia seganas badai. Menarik musuh dan benda-benda ke posisi Kazuha lalu mementalkan musuh yang ada di dalam areanya, mengakibatkan Anemo DMG dan mengangkat Kazuha ke udara dengan arus angin yang tercipta.
Selama 10 detik setelah Kazuha terbang ke udara dengan menggunakan Chihayaburu, Kazuha dapat melancarkan Plunging Attack khusus yang kuat: Midare Ranzan.

Tekan
Dapat digunakan di udara.

Tahan
Setelah beberapa saat, melancarkan serangan Anemo DMG dengan area yang lebih luas dan DMG lebih besar dari mode Tekan.

Plunging Attack: Midare Ranzan
Saat Plunging Attack dilakukan dengan menggunakan efek Elemental Skill Chihayaburu, maka DMG dari Plunging Attack akan berubah menjadi Anemo DMG dan menciptakan arus angin kecil yang menarik musuh dan benda di sekitarnya.
DMG dari Midare Ranzan terhitung sebagai DMG Plunging Attack.

talents.name: Kazuha Slash
talents.description:
The signature technique of Kazuha's self-styled bladework — a single slash that strikes with the force of the first winds of autumn, dealing AoE Anemo DMG.
The blade's passage will leave behind a field named "Autumn Whirlwind" that periodically deals AoE Anemo DMG to opponents within its range.

Elemental Absorption
If Autumn Whirlwind comes into contact with Hydro/Pyro/Cryo/Electro, it will deal additional elemental DMG of that type.
Elemental Absorption may only occur once per use.
talents.descriptionId:
Ilmu pedang Garyu terkuat — sebuah tebasan pedang yang membawa badai dan mengakibatkan Anemo DMG Area.
Tebasan pedang ini akan menyisakan sebuah area yang disebut "Autumn Whirlwind" dan mengakibatkan Anemo DMG Area setiap beberapa saat ke musuh di dalamnya.

Elemental Absorption
Jika Autumn Whirlwind bersentuhan dengan Hydro/Pyro/Cryo/Electro, maka Autumn Whirlwind akan mengakibatkan DMG elemental tambahan yang sesuai dengan elemen tersebut.
Elemental Absorption hanya dapat terpicu sekali setiap penggunaan.

passives.name: Soumon Swordsmanship
passives.description:
If Chihayaburu comes into contact with Hydro/Pyro/Cryo/Electro when cast, this Chihayaburu will absorb that element and if Plunging Attack: Midare Ranzan is used before the effect expires, it will deal an additional 200% ATK of the absorbed elemental type as DMG. This will be considered Plunging Attack DMG.
Elemental Absorption may only occur once per use of Chihayaburu.
passives.descriptionId:
Jika Chihayaburu bersentuhan dengan Hydro/Pyro/Cryo/Electro saat digunakan, maka Chihayaburu mendapatkan efek Elemental Absorption dan Plunging Attack: Midare Ranzan akan mengakibatkan DMG tambahan sesuai elemen yang bersentuhan sebesar 200% ATK. DMG ini terhitung sebagai DMG Plunging Attack.
Elemental Absorption hanya dapat terpicu sekali setiap penggunaan Chihayaburu.

passives.name: Poetics of Fuubutsu
passives.description: Upon triggering a Swirl or Stellar Swirl reaction, Kaedehara Kazuha will grant all party members a 0.04% Elemental DMG Bonus to the element absorbed by Swirl for every point of Elemental Mastery he has for 8s. Bonuses for different elements obtained through this method can co-exist.
passives.descriptionId: Setelah Kaedehara Kazuha memicu reaksi Swirl atau Stellar Swirl, untuk setiap poin Elemental Mastery yang dimiliki olehnya, seluruh anggota party akan mendapatkan peningkatan 0,04% Bonus Elemental DMG untuk jenis elemen yang sesuai selama 8 detik. Bonus DMG untuk elemen berbeda yang didapatkan dengan cara ini dapat aktif secara bersamaan.

passives.name: Cloud Strider
passives.description:
Decreases sprinting Stamina consumption for your own party members by 20%.
Not stackable with Passive Talents that provide the exact same effects.
passives.descriptionId:
Mengurangi 20% konsumsi Stamina Karakter party sendiri saat berlari.
Efek ini tidak dapat ditumpuk dengan Talenta Pasif lain dengan efek yang sama persis.

constellations.name: Scarlet Hills
constellations.description:
Decreases Chihayaburu's CD by 10%.
Using Kazuha Slash resets the CD of Chihayaburu.
constellations.descriptionId:
Mengurangi 10% CD Chihayaburu.
Menggunakan Kazuha Slash akan langsung menyelesaikan CD Chihayaburu.

constellations.name: Yamaarashi Tailwind
constellations.description:
The Autumn Whirlwind field created by Kazuha Slash has the following effects:
· Increases Kaedehara Kazuha's own Elemental Mastery by 200 for its duration.
· Increases the Elemental Mastery of characters within the field by 200.

The Elemental Mastery-increasing effects of this Constellation do not stack.
constellations.descriptionId:
Area Autumn Whirlwind yang dibuat oleh Kazuha Slash memiliki efek berikut:
· Meningkatkan 200 Elemental Mastery Kaedehara Kazuha.
· Meningkatkan 200 Elemental Mastery Karakter di dalam area.

Efek peningkatan Elemental Mastery dari Konstelasi ini tidak bisa ditumpuk.

constellations.name: Maple Monogatari
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Chihayaburu by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.descriptionId: Meningkatkan 3 level Chihayaburu. Maksimum: Lv. 15.

constellations.name: Oozora Genpou
constellations.description:
When Kaedehara Kazuha's Energy is lower than 45, he obtains the following effects:
·Pressing or Holding Chihayaburu regenerates 3 or 4 Energy for Kaedehara Kazuha, respectively.
·When gliding, Kaedehara Kazuha regenerates 2 Energy per second.

constellations.name: Wisdom of Bansei
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Kazuha Slash by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.descriptionId: Meningkatkan 3 level Kazuha Slash. Maksimum: Lv. 15.

constellations.name: Crimson Momiji
constellations.description: After using Chihayaburu or Kazuha Slash, Kaedehara Kazuha gains an Anemo Infusion for 5s. Additionally, each point of Elemental Mastery will increase the DMG dealt by Kaedehara Kazuha's Normal, Charged, and Plunging Attacks by 0.2%.
constellations.descriptionId: Kaedehara Kazuha akan mendapatkan Anemo Infusion selama 5 detik setelah menggunakan Chihayaburu atau Kazuha Slash. Sebagai tambahan, setiap poin Elemental Mastery Kaedehara Kazuha akan meningkatkan 0,2% DMG Normal, Charged, dan Plunging Attack Kaedehara Kazuha.

name: Kamisato Ayaka
title: Frostflake Heron
description: Daughter of the Yashiro Commission's Kamisato Clan. Dignified and elegant, as well as wise and strong.
descriptionId: Putri dari Klan Kamisato di Yashiro Commission. Bermartabat dan elegan, cerdas dan tangguh.

talents.name: Kamisato Art: Kabuki
talents.description:
Normal Attack
Performs up to 5 rapid strikes.

Charged Attack
Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to unleash a flurry of sword ki.

Plunging Attack
Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground below, damaging enemies along the path and dealing AoE DMG upon impact.
talents.descriptionId:
Normal Attack
Melancarkan maks. 5 tebasan pedang.

Charged Attack
Mengonsumsi sejumlah Stamina untuk terus mengerahkan rentetan tebasan.

Plunging Attack
Menukik dari langit dan menghantam tanah, menyerang musuh di jalurnya dan mengakibatkan DMG Area saat mendarat.

talents.name: Kamisato Art: Hyouka
talents.description: Summons blooming ice to launch nearby opponents, dealing AoE Cryo DMG.
talents.descriptionId: Memanggil dan menerbangkan bunga es ke arah musuh di sekitar untuk mengakibatkan Cryo DMG Area.

talents.name: Kamisato Art: Soumetsu
talents.description:
Summons forth a snowstorm with flawless poise, unleashing a Frostflake Seki no To that moves forward continuously.

Frostflake Seki no To
·A storm of whirling icy winds that slashes repeatedly at every enemy it touches, dealing Cryo DMG.
