·The snowstorm explodes after its duration ends, dealing AoE Cryo DMG.
talents.descriptionId:
Memanggil es dengan ketenangan tanpa cela, lalu melepaskan Frostflake Seki no To yang terus bergerak maju.

Frostflake Seki no To
·Terus-menerus menebas musuh yang disentuhnya dengan angin dingin setajam pisau dan mengakibatkan Cryo DMG;
·Terbuka mekar setelah durasinya berakhir dan mengakibatkan Cryo DMG Area.

passives.name: Amatsumi Kunitsumi Sanctification
passives.description: After using Kamisato Art: Hyouka, Kamisato Ayaka's Normal and Charged Attacks deal 30% increased DMG for 6s.
passives.descriptionId: Setelah menggunakan Kamisato Art: Hyouka, meningkatkan 30% DMG Normal dan Charged Attack Kamisato Ayaka selama 6 detik.

passives.name: Kanten Senmyou Blessing
passives.description:
When the Cryo application at the end of Kamisato Art: Senho hits an opponent, Kamisato Ayaka gains the following effects:
·Restores 10 Stamina
·Gains 18% Cryo DMG Bonus for 10s.
passives.descriptionId:
Jika efek Cryo di akhir Kamisato Art: Senho mengenai musuh, Kamisato Ayaka akan mendapatkan efek berikut:
·Memulihkan 10 Stamina
·Mendapatkan 18% Cryo DMG Bonus selama 10 detik.

passives.name: Fruits of Shinsa
passives.description: When Ayaka crafts Weapon Ascension Materials, she has a 10% chance to receive double the product.
passives.descriptionId: Saat membuat Material Ascension Senjata, memiliki 10% kemungkinan untuk mendapatkan hasil 2 kali lipat.

constellations.name: Snowswept Sakura
constellations.description: When Kamisato Ayaka's Normal or Charged Attacks deal Cryo DMG to opponents, it has a 50% chance of decreasing the CD of Kamisato Art: Hyouka by 0.3s. This effect can occur once every 0.1s.
constellations.descriptionId: Saat Normal atau Charged Attack Kamisato Ayaka mengakibatkan Cryo DMG pada musuh, memiliki 50% kemungkinan untuk mengurangi 0,3 detik CD skill Kamisato Art: Hyouka. Efek ini dapat terpicu setiap 0,1 detik.

constellations.name: Blizzard Blade Seki no To
constellations.description: When casting Kamisato Art: Soumetsu, unleashes 2 smaller additional Frostflake Seki no To, each dealing 20% of the original storm's DMG.
constellations.descriptionId: Melancarkan Kamisato Art: Soumetsu akan menciptakan 2 Frostflake Seki no To tambahan yang lebih kecil. Masing-masing akan mengakibatkan DMG sebesar 20% dari Frostflake Seki no To asli.

constellations.name: Frostbloom Kamifubuki
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Kamisato Art: Soumetsu by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.descriptionId:
Meningkatkan 3 level Kamisato Art: Soumetsu.
Maksimum: Lv. 15.

constellations.name: Ebb and Flow
constellations.description: Opponents damaged by Kamisato Art: Soumetsu's Frostflake Seki no To will have their DEF decreased by 30% for 6s.
constellations.descriptionId: Mengurangi 30% DEF musuh yang terkena serangan Frostflake Seki no To dari skill Kamisato Art: Soumetsu selama 6 detik.

constellations.name: Blossom Cloud Irutsuki
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Kamisato Art: Hyouka by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.descriptionId:
Meningkatkan 3 level Kamisato Art: Hyouka .
Maksimum: Lv. 15.

constellations.name: Dance of Suigetsu
constellations.description: Kamisato Ayaka gains Usurahi Butou every 10s, increasing her Charged Attack DMG by 298%. This buff will be cleared 0.5s after Ayaka's Charged ATK hits an opponent, after which the timer for this ability will restart.
constellations.descriptionId: Setiap 10 detik, Kamisato Ayaka akan mendapatkan efek "Usurahi Butou" yang meningkatkan DMG Charged Attack Ayaka sebesar 298%. Efek Usurahi Butou ini akan hilang 0,5 detik setelah Charged Attack mengenai musuh dan perhitungan waktu akan diulang kembali.

name: Kamisato Ayato
title: Pillar of Fortitude
description: The young but highly accomplished head of the Yashiro Commission's Kamisato Clan. Cultured and polite, he is a man of many ways and means.
descriptionId: Kepala Klan Kamisato dari Yashiro Commission yang masih muda namun sangat berprestasi. Sangat berbudaya dan sopan, dia adalah seorang pria yang berbudi luhur dan mempunyai banyak cara.

talents.name: Kamisato Art: Marobashi
talents.description:
Normal Attack
Performs up to 5 rapid strikes.

Charged Attack
Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to dash forward and performs an iai.

Plunging Attack
Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground below, damaging opponents along the path and dealing AoE DMG upon impact.
talents.descriptionId:
Normal Attack
Melancarkan hingga 5 serangan berturut-turut menggunakan pedang.

Charged Attack
Mengonsumsi sejumlah Stamina untuk bergerak ke depan dan melancarkan tebasan iai.

Plunging Attack
Menerjang dari udara untuk menghantam tanah, menyerang musuh di jalur terjangan dan mengakibatkan DMG area saat mendarat.

talents.name: Kamisato Art: Kyouka
talents.description:
Kamisato Ayato shifts positions and enters the Takimeguri Kanka state.
After this shift, he will leave a watery illusion at his original location. After it is formed, the watery illusion will explode if opponents are nearby or after its duration ends, dealing AoE Hydro DMG.

Takimeguri Kanka
In this state, Kamisato Ayato uses his Shunsuiken to engage in blindingly fast attacks, causing DMG from his Normal Attacks to be converted into AoE Hydro DMG. This cannot be overridden.
It also has the following properties:
·After a Shunsuiken attack hits an opponent, it will grant Ayato the Namisen effect, increasing the DMG dealt by Shunsuiken based on Ayato's current Max HP. The initial maximum number of Namisen stacks is 4, and 1 stack can be gained through Shunsuiken every 0.1s. This effect will be dispelled when Takimeguri Kanka ends.
·Kamisato Ayato's resistance to interruption is increased.
·Unable to use Charged or Plunging Attacks.

Takimeguri Kanka will be cleared when Ayato leaves the field. Using Kamisato Art: Kyouka again while in the Takimeguri Kanka state will reset and replace the pre-existing state.
talents.descriptionId:
Kamisato Ayato menggeser posisinya dan memasuki kondisi Takimeguri Kanka.
Setelah berpindah posisi, Ayato akan meninggalkan ilusi air di posisi sebelumnya. Setelah terbentuk, ilusi air akan meledak saat ada musuh di sekitar atau setelah durasinya habis, mengakibatkan Hydro DMG Area.

Takimeguri Kanka
Dalam kondisi ini, Kamisato Ayato menggunakan Shunsuiken miliknya untuk melakukan serangan yang sangat cepat, mengakibatkan DMG Normal Attack berubah menjadi Hydro DMG Area yang tidak bisa ditimpa Elemental Infusion lainnya.
Lalu juga mempunyai efek berikut:
·Setelah serangan Shunsuiken mengenai musuh, Ayato akan mendapatkan efek Namisen, yang meningkatkan DMG yang diakibatkan oleh Shunsuiken berdasarkan dari Max HP Ayato saat ini. Namisen dapat ditumpuk hingga 4 lapis, dan setiap 0,1 detik bisa mendapatkan 1 lapis dari serangan Shunsuiken. Efek ini akan hilang saat Takimeguri Kanka berakhir.
·Meningkatkan ketahanan Kamisato Ayato terhadap interupsi.
·Tidak bisa melancarkan Charged dan Plunging Attack.

Takimeguri Kanka akan selesai saat Ayato meninggalkan medan pertempuran. Jika Kamisato Art: Kyouka dilancarkan lagi saat masih dalam kondisi Takimeguri Kanka, maka kondisi Takimeguri Kanka tersebut akan berakhir dan diganti dengan yang baru.

talents.name: Kamisato Art: Suiyuu
talents.description:
Unveils a garden of purity that silences the cacophony within.
While this space exists, Bloomwater Blades will constantly rain down and attack opponents within its AoE, dealing Hydro DMG and increasing the Normal Attack DMG of characters within.
talents.descriptionId:
Mengungkap sebuah taman penyucian yang menyingkirkan segala hiruk pikuk di dalamnya.
Saat taman tersebut ada, Bloomwater Blade akan terus menghujani dan menyerang musuh di dalam areanya, mengakibatkan Hydro DMG dan meningkatkan DMG Normal Attack Karakter di dalamnya.

passives.name: Kamisato Art: Mine Wo Matoishi Kiyotaki
passives.description:
Kamisato Art: Kyouka has the following properties:
·After it is used, Kamisato Ayato will gain 2 Namisen stacks.
·When the water illusion explodes, Ayato will gain a Namisen effect equal to the maximum number of stacks possible.
passives.descriptionId:
Kamisato Art: Kyouka memiliki karakteristik berikut:
·Kamisato Ayato akan mendapatkan 2 lapis Namisen saat melancarkan skill ini.
Setelah ilusi air meledak, Kamisato Ayato akan mendapatkan efek Namisen setara dengan jumlah tumpukan maksimum lapisan.

passives.name: Kamisato Art: Michiyuku Hagetsu
passives.description: If Kamisato Ayato is not on the field and his Energy is less than 40, he will regenerate 2 Energy for himself every second.
passives.descriptionId: Saat Kamisato Ayato ada di dalam party tapi tidak sedang aktif di medan pertempuran, dan jika jumlah Energy-nya kurang dari 40 poin, maka dia akan memulihkan 2 Energy-nya sendiri setiap detik.

passives.name: Kamisato Art: Daily Cooking
passives.description: When Ayato cooks a dish perfectly, he has an 18% chance to receive an additional "Suspicious" dish of the same type.
passives.descriptionId: Saat Ayato memasak makanan dengan sempurna, terdapat 18% kemungkinan mendapatkan hasil tambahan makanan "Suspicious" dari jenis makanan yang sama.

constellations.name: Kyouka Fuushi
constellations.description: Shunsuiken DMG is increased by 40% against opponents with 50% HP or less.
constellations.descriptionId: Meningkatkan 40% DMG Shunsuiken pada musuh dengan HP 50% atau kurang.

constellations.name: World Source
constellations.description: Namisen's maximum stack count is increased to 5. When Kamisato Ayato has at least 3 Namisen stacks, his Max HP is increased by 50%.
constellations.descriptionId: Tumpukan maksimum Namisen bertambah menjadi 5 lapis. Max HP Kamisato Ayato akan bertambah 50% saat memiliki setidaknya 3 lapis Namisen.

constellations.name: To Admire the Flowers
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Kamisato Art: Kyouka by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.descriptionId:
Meningkatkan 3 level Kamisato Art: Kyouka.
Maksimum: Lv. 15.

constellations.name: Endless Flow
constellations.description: After using Kamisato Art: Suiyuu, all nearby party members will have 15% increased Normal Attack SPD for 15s.
constellations.descriptionId: Setelah melancarkan Kamisato Art: Suiyuu, ATK SPD Normal Attack anggota party di sekitar akan meningkat 15% selama 15 detik.

constellations.name: Bansui Ichiro
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Kamisato Art: Suiyuu by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.descriptionId:
Meningkatkan 3 level Kamisato Art: Suiyuu.
Maksimum: Lv. 15.

constellations.name: Boundless Origin
constellations.description:
After using Kamisato Art: Kyouka, Ayato's next Shunsuiken attack will create 2 extra Shunsuiken strikes when they hit opponents, each one dealing 450% of Ayato's ATK as DMG.
Both these Shunsuiken attacks will not be affected by Namisen.
constellations.descriptionId:
Setelah menggunakan Kamisato Art: Kyouka, Serangan Shunsuiken milik Ayato selanjutnya akan membuat 2 serangan Shunsuiken tambahan saat mengenai musuh, setiap serangannya mengakibatkan DMG sebesar 450% ATK Ayato.
Kedua serangan Shunsuiken ini tidak akan terpengaruh oleh Namisen.

name: Keqing
title: Driving Thunder
description: The Yuheng of the Liyue Qixing. Keqing has much to say about Rex Lapis's unilateral approach to policymaking in Liyue — but in truth, gods admire skeptics such as her quite a lot.
descriptionId: Yuheng dari Liyue Qixing, dia punya banyak hal yang ingin dikatakan mengenai Rex Lapis yang memerintah Liyue- dan pada kenyataannya, para Dewa mengagumi orang-orang sepertinya.

talents.name: Yunlai Swordsmanship
talents.description:
Normal Attack
Performs up to 5 rapid strikes.

Charged Attack
Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to unleash 2 rapid sword strikes.

Plunging Attack
Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground below, damaging opponents along the path and dealing AoE DMG upon impact.
talents.descriptionId:
Normal Attack
Melancarkan hingga 5 serangan berturut-turut.

Charged Attack
Mengonsumsi sejumlah Stamina untuk melancarkan dua tebasan pedang.

Plunging Attack
Menerjang dari udara untuk menghantam tanah, menyerang musuh di jalur terjangan dan mengakibatkan DMG area saat mendarat.

talents.name: Stellar Restoration
talents.description:
Hurls a Lightning Stiletto that annihilates her opponents like the swift thunder.
When the Stiletto hits its target, it deals Electro DMG to opponents in a small AoE, and places a Stiletto Mark on the spot hit.

Hold
Hold to adjust the direction in which the Stiletto shall be thrown.
Stilettos thrown by the Hold attack mode can be suspended in mid-air, allowing Keqing to jump to them when using Stellar Restoration a second time.

Lightning Stiletto
 If Keqing uses Stellar Restoration again or uses a Charged Attack while its duration lasts, it will clear the Stiletto Mark and produce different effects:
·If she uses Stellar Restoration again, she will blink to the location of the Mark and unleash one slashing attack that deals AoE Electro DMG. When blinking to a Stiletto that was thrown from a Holding attack, Keqing can leap across obstructing terrain.
·If Keqing uses a Charged Attack, she will ignite a series of thundering cuts at the Mark's location, dealing AoE Electro DMG.
talents.descriptionId:
Dengan cepat menggunakan Lightning Stiletto untuk menghabisi musuh bagaikan kilat.
Saat Stiletto mengenai musuh, mengakibatkan Electro DMG kepada musuh dalam area yang kecil, dan menaruh Stiletto Mark di tempat.

Tahan
Tahan untuk menyesuaikan arah ke mana Stiletto akan dilemparkan.
Stiletto yang dilemparkan oleh tipe serangan yang ditahan dapat ditangguhkan di udara, memungkinkan Keqing untuk melompat ke arah stiletto saat menggunakan Stellar Restoration untuk kedua kalinya.

Lightning Stiletto
·Jika Keqing menggunakan Stellar Restoration kembali atau menggunakan Charged Attack saat durasinya masih berlangsung, maka akan menghapus Stiletto Mark dan menghasilkan efek berbeda:
·Jika dia menggunakan Stellar Restoration kembali, dia akan berpindah dengan cepat ke lokasi yang ditandai dan mengeluarkan satu serangan tebasan yang mengakibatkan Electro DMG area. Saat berpindah menuju Stiletto yang dilemparkan dari serangan tahan, Keqing dapat mengabaikan hambatan yang ada.
·Jika Keqing menggunakan Charged Attack, dia akan memicu beberapa tebasan petir di lokasi yang ditandai, mengakibatkan Electro DMG area.

talents.name: Starward Sword
talents.description:
Keqing unleashes the power of lightning, dealing Electro DMG in an AOE.
She then blends into the shadow of her blade, striking a series of thunderclap-blows to nearby opponents simultaneously that deal multiple instances of Electro DMG. The final attack deals massive AoE Electro DMG.
talents.descriptionId:
Keqing melepaskan kekuatan petir, menghasilkan Electro DMG pada area sekitar.
Lalu dia akan menyatu dengan bayangan pedangnya, menyerang dengan serangkaian pukulan petir kepada musuh di sekitarnya secara bersamaan yang menghasilkan beberapa Electro DMG. Serangan terakhir menghasilkan Electro DMG area yang luar biasa.

passives.name: Thundering Penance
passives.description: After recasting Stellar Restoration while a Lightning Stiletto is present, Keqing's weapon gains an Electro Infusion for 5s.
passives.descriptionId: Setelah melancarkan Stellar Restoration untuk kedua kalinya saat Lightning Stiletto masih aktif, Keqing akan mendapatkan Electro Infusion selama 5 detik.

passives.name: Aristocratic Dignity
passives.description: When casting Starward Sword, Keqing's CRIT Rate is increased by 15%, and her Energy Recharge is increased by 15%. This effect lasts for 8s.
passives.descriptionId: Meningkatkan 15% CRIT Rate dan Energy Recharge Keqing selama 8 detik ketika menggunakan skill Starward Sword.

passives.name: Land's Overseer
passives.description: When dispatched on an expedition in Liyue, time consumed is reduced by 25%.
passives.descriptionId: Ketika dikirim untuk melakukan ekspedisi di Liyue, waktu yang dibutuhkan berkurang 25%.

constellations.name: Thundering Might
constellations.description: Recasting Stellar Restoration while a Lightning Stiletto is present causes Keqing to deal 50% of her ATK as AoE Electro DMG at the start point and terminus of her Blink.
constellations.descriptionId: Saat Lightning Stiletto masih ada, dan Stellar Restoration diluncurkan kembali, akan menyebabkan 50% dari ATK Keqing menjadi Electro DMG area pada titik awal dan titik akhir Blink.

constellations.name: Keen Extraction
constellations.description:
When Keqing's Normal and Charged Attacks hit opponents affected by Electro, they have a 50% chance of producing an Elemental Particle.
This effect can only occur once every 5s.
constellations.descriptionId:
Saat Normal dan Charged Attack Keqing mengenai musuh yang terkena efek Electro, memiliki 50% persentase untuk menghasilkan Elemental Particle.
Efek ini terpicu setiap 5 detik

constellations.name: Foreseen Reformation
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Starward Sword by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.descriptionId:
Meningkatkan 3 level Starward Sword.
Maksimum: Lv. 15.

constellations.name: Attunement
constellations.description: For 10s after Keqing triggers an Electro-related Elemental Reaction, her ATK is increased by 25%.
constellations.descriptionId: Setelah Keqing memicu Reaksi Elemental yang berhubungan dengan elemen Electro, ATK Keqing meningkat 25% selama 10 detik.

constellations.name: Beckoning Stars
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Stellar Restoration by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.descriptionId:
Meningkatkan 3 level Stellar Restoration.
Maksimum: Lv. 15.

constellations.name: Tenacious Star
constellations.description:
When initiating a Normal Attack, a Charged Attack, Elemental Skill or Elemental Burst, Keqing gains a 6% Electro DMG Bonus for 8s.
Effects triggered by Normal Attacks, Charged Attacks, Elemental Skills and Elemental Bursts are considered independent entities.
constellations.descriptionId:
Saat memulai Normal Attack, Charged Attack, Elemental Skill atau Elemental Burst, Keqing mendapatkan 6% Electro DMG Bonus selama 8 detik.
Efek yang terpicu oleh Normal Attack, Charged Attack, Elemental Skill dan Elemental Burst aktif secara independen.

name: Kinich
title: Turnfire Hunt
description: A Huitztlan Saurian Hunter skilled at counting costs.
descriptionId: Pemburu Saurian dari Huitztlan, ahli dalam menghitung biaya.
cvJapanese: 杉山紀彰 & 竹内順子

talents.name: Nightsun Style
talents.description:
Normal Attack
Performs up to 3 rapid strikes.
After using his Elemental Skill "Canopy Hunter: Riding High"'s mid-air swing, he can perform a Normal Attack in mid-air before landing.

Charged Attack
Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to spin and throw his Claymore forward to attack opponents.

Plunging Attack
Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground below, damaging opponents along the path and dealing AoE DMG upon impact.
talents.descriptionId:
Normal Attack
Melancarkan hingga 3 serangan berturut-turut.
Setelah serangan putaran mengayun di udara melalui Elemental Skill "Canopy Hunter: Riding High", akan melancarkan satu kali Normal Attack di udara sebelum mendarat di tanah.

Charged Attack
Mengonsumsi sejumlah Stamina untuk berputar dan melemparkan Claymore-nya terhadap musuh.

Plunging Attack
Menerjang dari udara untuk menghantam tanah, menyerang musuh di jalur terjangan dan mengakibatkan DMG Area saat mendarat.

talents.name: Canopy Hunter: Riding High
talents.description:
Kinich uses his big-game hunting skills to either move swiftly or attack his opponent.
When there is an opponent or object that can be attacked nearby, he will attach a grappling hook to the target and enter Nightsoul's Blessing with 0 Nightsoul points. If neither is nearby, he fires a grappling hook forward and swings in mid-air, and this Skill's CD is decreased by 60%.
This skill can be Held to release. When it is Held, Kinich can aim the grappling hook.

Nightsoul's Blessing: Kinich
Kinich's Nightsoul's Blessing lasts 10s and generates 2 Nightsoul points every second.
In this state, Kinich will hook onto a nearby opponent and perform a variable attack:
·When using a Normal Attack, Kinich will fire Loop Shots as he loops around the grappled target based on his current movement direction, dealing Nightsoul-aligned Dendro DMG and generating 3 Nightsoul points. Loop Shot DMG is considered Elemental Skill DMG.
·When Nightsoul points are at max, he can use the Elemental Skill "Scalespiker Cannon": Consume all Nightsoul points to deal Nightsoul-aligned Dendro DMG. When "Scalespiker Cannon" is Held, Kinich can aim this shot. After firing the Cannon, Kinich will try to grapple to its target.
While in Nightsoul's Blessing, after grappling an opponent or firing "Scalespiker Cannon," a Blind Spot will be generated next to the opponent. When Kinich enters this Blind Spot, it will disappear and he will generate 4 Nightsoul points.
If the grapple connection should snap due to exceeding the maximum distance or some other reason, using a Normal Attack will establish a new connection with a nearby opponent before performing Loop Shots.
talents.descriptionId:
Berbekal pengalamannya dalam berburu, Kinich dapat bergerak atau menyerang musuhnya dengan cepat.
Jika ada musuh atau objek yang bisa diserang di sekitar, akan mengaitkan pengait ke tubuh target, dan memasuki status Nightsoul dengan biaya 0 poin Nightsoul. Jika tidak ada apa pun, akan menembakkan pengait ke arah depan dan mengayunkannya di udara, membuat CD Skill berkurang 60%.
Saat ditahan, akan membidik untuk menentukan arah lemparan pengait.

Nightsoul's Blessing: Kinich
Status Nightsoul's Blessing Kinich berlangsung 10 detik, dan akan menghasilkan 2 poin Nightsoul setiap detiknya.
Dalam status Nightsoul's Blessing, Kinich akan mengaitkan pengait ke musuh di sisinya, dan akan melancarkan berbagai pola serangan:
·Saat melancarkan Normal Attack: dengan arah pergerakannya saat ini sebagai landasannya, Kinich akan melakukan Loop Shot dengan target pengait sebagai pusat serangannya, mengakibatkan Dendro DMG dengan atribut Nightsoul, serta menghasilkan 3 poin Nightsoul. DMG yang diakibatkan oleh Loop Shot akan dianggap sebagai DMG Elemental Skill.
·Saat nilai Nightsoul mencapai batas maksimumnya, akan bisa melancarkan Elemental Skill "Scalespiker Cannon": Mengonsumsi seluruh poin Nightsoul dan mengakibatkan Dendro DMG dengan atribut Nightsoul. Saat "Scalespiker Cannon" dilancarkan dengan cara ditahan, akan bisa membidik untuk menentukan target serangan. Setelah Scalespiker Cannon dilancarkan, Kinich akan mencoba untuk mengait target.
Dalam status Nightsoul's Blessing, setelah musuh terkait atau setelah Scalespiker Cannon dilancarkan, akan membentuk sebuah Blind Spot di sisi musuh. Saat Kinich memasuki Blind Spot, 4 poin Nightsoul akan dipulihkan dan Blind Spot akan hilang.
Jika kaitan terputus karena melebihi jarak atau alasan lainnya, Normal Attack yang dilancarkan akan kembali membentuk hubungan yang baru dengan musuh di sekitar dan akan melancarkan Loop Shot.

talents.name: Hail to the Almighty Dragonlord
talents.description:
Unleashes the power of the Almighty Dragonlord, K'uhul Ajaw (on a limited, conditional, restricted, contractual, partial, temporary basis), dealing Nightsoul-aligned AoE Dendro DMG. Ajaw will unleash his Dragon Breath at intervals, dealing Nightsoul-aligned AoE Dendro DMG.
If Kinich is in Nightsoul's Blessing when this is used, this Blessing's duration is extended by 1.7s.
talents.descriptionId:
Melepaskan kekuatan Yang Mulia Raja Naga Ajaw (secara terbatas, bersyarat, tertentu, sesuai kontrak, sebagian, sementara) dan mengakibatkan Dendro DMG Area dengan atribut Nightsoul. Ajaw akan terus mengembuskan napas naga secara berkala yang mengakibatkan Dendro DMG Area dengan atribut Nightsoul.
Saat dilancarkan, jika Kinich sedang berada dalam status Nightsoul's Blessing, durasi Nightsoul's Blessing kali ini diperpanjang 1,7 detik.

passives.name: The Price of Desolation
passives.description: When Kinich is in Nightsoul's Blessing state, opponents hit by his Elemental Skill will enter the Desolation state, and when affected by Burning or Burgeon reaction DMG, they will restore 7 Nightsoul points to him. Nightsoul points can be gained this way once every 0.8s. The Desolation state will persist until this instance of Kinich's Nightsoul's Blessing state ends.
passives.descriptionId: Saat Kinich berada dalam status Nightsoul's Blessing, Elemental Skill Kinich yang mengenai musuh akan membuat musuh tersebut terkena status Desolation: Saat musuh ini terkena DMG dari reaksi Burning atau Burgeon, akan memulihkan 7 poin Nightsoul bagi Kinich. Maksimum pemulihan Nightsoul yang bisa diperoleh dengan cara ini adalah sekali setiap 0,8 detik. Status Desolation berlangsung hingga status Nightsoul's Blessing Kinich kali ini berakhir.

passives.name: Flame Spirit Pact
passives.description: After a nearby party member triggers a Nightsoul Burst, Kinich will gain 1 stack of Hunter's Experience that lasts 15s. Max 2 stacks. When Kinich uses Canopy Hunter: Riding High's Scalespiker Cannon, all stacks of Hunter's Experience will be consumed, with each stack consumed increasing the DMG dealt by this Cannon shot by 320% of Kinich's ATK.
passives.descriptionId: Setelah anggota party di sekitar memicu status Nightsoul Burst, Kinich akan mendapatkan 1 lapis Hunter's Experience yang berlangsung 15 detik, maksimum 2 lapis. Saat Kinich melancarkan Scalespiker Cannon dari Canopy Hunter: Riding High, seluruh lapisan Hunter's Experience akan dikonsumsi, dan setiap lapisnya akan meningkatkan DMG Scalespiker Cannon kali ini sebesar 320% ATK Kinich.

passives.name: Night Realm's Gift: Repaid in Full
passives.description:
When Kinich is in the air following Canopy Hunter: Riding High's mid-air swing, he can consume 10 Phlogiston points to perform another mid-air swing.
While in an area with Phlogiston Mechanics within Natlan, he can use Nightsoul Transmission: Kinich. When the current active character is sprinting, in movement states that result from specific Talents, or in the air, when you switch to Kinich: Kinich will perform one of the following actions depending on the conditions met:
·When facing a Coilgrass Sigil that can be interacted with: He will fire a grappling hook towards it to move;
·When there are nearby opponents and you are in combat: Kinich will use Canopy Hunter: Riding High in the direction of the opponents;
Otherwise, Kinich will fire a grappling hook and swing, prioritizing valid Coilgrass Sigils as grapple targets.
Nightsoul Transmission can be triggered once every 10s by your own party.

When interacting with Coilgrass Sigils and other items that Yumkasaurs can interact with, "Canopy Hunter: Riding High" will be converted to "Yumkasaur Mimesis," which causes interactions with such items to follow rules applicable to Yumkasaurs, and which will not put Canopy Hunter: Riding High on CD.
passives.descriptionId:
Saat Kinich sedang melayang setelah mengayun di udara melalui Canopy Hunter: Riding High, dia dapat mengonsumsi 10 poin Phlogiston untuk mengayun kembali di udara.
Saat berada di lokasi yang memiliki Phlogiston Mechanic di Natlan, bisa melancarkan Nightsoul Transmission: Kinich. Saat Karakter aktif sedang berlari atau sedang bergerak yang dikarenakan oleh Talenta tertentu, atau saat berada di udara, dan mengganti Karakter menjadi Kinich akan melakukan tindakan berikut berdasarkan syarat yang dipenuhi:
·Saat menghadap ke Coilgrass Sigil yang bisa berinteraksi, akan melemparkan pengait ke arahnya dan bergerak;
·Saat ada musuh di sekitar diri sendiri dan berada dalam kondisi bertempur: Melancarkan Canopy Hunter: Riding High ke arah musuh ini untuk bergerak;
Jika tidak, Kinich akan melemparkan pengait dan mengayun di udara. Kinich akan menjadikan Coilgrass Sigil yang memenuhi syarat untuk menjadi prioritas target kaitannya.
Nightsoul Transmission party sendiri dapat terpicu sekali setiap 10 detik.

Saat berinteraksi dengan Coilgrass Sigil dan item lain yang bisa berinteraksi dengan Yumkasaurus, "Canopy Hunter: Riding High" akan diganti menjadi "Yumkasaurus Mimesis" yang membuat interaksi terhadap item-item jenis tersebut mengikuti peraturan yang berlaku terhadap Yumkasaurus, dan tidak akan membuat Canopy Hunter: Riding High memasuki CD.

passives.name: Swift Envoy
passives.description: While in an area with Phlogiston Mechanics within Natlan, interacting with some harvestable items will increase your own party members' Movement SPD by 15% for 10s. Additionally, the location of nearby resources unique to Natlan will appear on your mini-map.
passives.descriptionId: Saat ada area dengan Phlogiston Mechanic di Natlan, berinteraksi dengan item tertentu yang bisa dikumpulkan, akan meningkatkan 15% Movement SPD Karakter sendiri yang berada di dalam party selama 10 detik. Selain ini, akan menunjukkan posisi Produk Khas Natlan yang ada di sekitar pada peta kecil.

constellations.name: Parrot's Beak
constellations.description:
After Kinich lands from Canopy Hunter: Riding High's mid-air swing, his Movement SPD will increase by 30% for 6s.
Additionally, Scalespiker Cannon's CRIT DMG is increased by 100%.
constellations.descriptionId:
Setelah Kinich mendarat melalui ayunan di udara Canopy Hunter: Riding High, Movement SPD meningkat 30% selama 6 detik.
Selain itu, CRIT DMG Scalespiker Cannon meningkat 100%.

constellations.name: Tiger Beetle's Palm
constellations.description:
When Kinich's Elemental Skill hits an opponent, it will decrease their Dendro RES by 30% for 6s.
Additionally, the first Scalespiker Cannon Kinich fires after entering Nightsoul's Blessing has increased AoE, and its DMG increases by 100%.
constellations.descriptionId:
Saat Elemental Skill Kinich mengenai musuh, akan membuat Dendro RES musuh yang bersangkutan berkurang 30% selama 6 detik.
Selain itu, radius serangan Scalespiker Cannon pertama yang ditembakkan Kinich setelah memasuki Nightsoul's Blessing akan meningkat, dan DMG-nya juga meningkat 100%.

constellations.name: Protosuchian's Claw
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Canopy Hunter: Riding High by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.descriptionId:
Meningkatkan 3 level Canopy Hunter: Riding High.
Maksimum: Lv. 15.

constellations.name: Hummingbird's Feather
constellations.description:
When in Nightsoul's Blessing, Kinich will restore 5 Energy after using his Loop Shots or after unleashing the Scalespiker Cannon. Energy can be regenerated this way once every 2.8s.
Additionally, Hail to the Almighty Dragonlord deals 70% more DMG.
constellations.descriptionId:
Saat dalam status Nightsoul's Blessing, setelah Kinich melancarkan Loop Shot atau setelah melancarkan Scalespiker Cannon, akan memulihkan 5 poin Energy baginya. Pemulihan Energy dengan cara ini dapat dilakukan maksimum sekali setiap 2,8 detik.
Selain itu, DMG Hail to the Almighty Dragonlord meningkat 70%.

constellations.name: Howler Monkey's Tail
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Hail to the Almighty Dragonlord by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.descriptionId:
Meningkatkan 3 level Hail to the Almighty Dragonlord.
Maksimum: Lv. 15.

constellations.name: Auspicious Beast's Shape
constellations.description:
After Scalespiker Cannon hits an opponent, it will bounce between opponents once, dealing 700% of Kinich's ATK as Dendro DMG.
If this Scalespiker Cannon triggers the buffs that Ascension Talent "Flame Spirit Pact" or the Constellation "Tiger Beetle's Palm" grant to the Cannon, the bouncing attack will also obtain the relevant buffs.
constellations.descriptionId:
Setelah Scalespiker Cannon mengenai musuh, akan melambung satu kali di antara musuh dan mengakibatkan Dendro DMG sebesar 700% ATK Kinich.
Jika Scalespiker Cannon kali ini memicu efek penguatan pada meriam dari Talenta Ascension "Flame Spirit Pact" atau Konstelasi "Tiger Beetle's Palm", maka seluruh serangan dari lambungan yang dihasilkan akan mendapatkan efek penguatan yang disebutkan di atas.

name: Klee
title: Fleeing Sunlight
description: An explosives expert and a regular at the Knights of Favonius's confinement room. Also known as Fleeing Sunlight.
descriptionId: Seorang ahli peledak yang sudah menjadi langganan di ruang tahanan Knights of Favonius. Juga dikenal dengan nama Fleeing Sunlight.

talents.name: Kaboom!
talents.description:
Normal Attack
Throws things that go boom when they hit things! Performs up to 3 explosive attacks, dealing AoE Pyro DMG.

Charged Attack
Consumes a certain amount of Stamina and deals AoE Pyro DMG to opponents after a short casting time.

Plunging Attack
Gathering the power of Pyro, Klee plunges towards the ground from mid-air, damaging all opponents in her path. Deals AoE Pyro DMG upon impact with the ground.
talents.descriptionId:
Normal Attack
Melempar benda yang akan meledak saat mengenai sesuatu! Melancarkan hingga 3 serangan ledakan yang mengakibatkan Pyro DMG Area.

Charged Attack
Mengonsumsi sejumlah Stamina dan mengakibatkan Pyro DMG Area kepada musuh setelah jeda singkat.

Plunging Attack
Mengumpulkan kekuatan Pyro dan menerjang tanah, menyerang musuh di jalur terjangan dan mengakibatkan Pyro DMG Area saat mendarat.

talents.name: Jumpy Dumpty
talents.description:
Jumpy Dumpty is tons of boom-bang-fun! 
When thrown, Jumpy Dumpty bounces thrice, igniting and dealing AoE Pyro DMG with every bounce.

On the third bounce, the bomb splits into many mines.
The mines will explode upon contact with opponents, or after a short period of time, dealing AoE Pyro DMG.

Starts with 2 charges.
talents.descriptionId:
Melemparkan bom Jumpy Dumpty yang membawa kesenangan tidak terbatas!
Saat dilempar, Jumpy Dumpty dapat memantul tiga kali, setiap pantulannya akan meledak dan mengakibatkan Pyro DMG Area.

Pada pantulan ke-3, bomnya akan terbagi menjadi banyak ranjau.
Ranjau-ranjau ini akan meledak saat menyentuh musuh, atau setelah jeda waktu yang singkat, kemudian mengakibatkan Pyro DMG Area.

Dimulai dengan 2 kali jumlah penggunaan.

talents.name: Sparks 'n' Splash
talents.description: Klee's Blazing Delight! For the duration of this ability, continuously summons Sparks 'n' Splash to attack nearby opponents, dealing AoE Pyro DMG.
talents.descriptionId: Kegembiraan Klee yang membara! Selama durasi skill, Sparks 'n' Splash yang muncul akan terus menyerang musuh-musuh di sekitar dan mengakibatkan Pyro DMG Area.

passives.name: Pounding Surprise
passives.description:
When Jumpy Dumpty and Normal Attacks deal DMG, Klee has a 50% chance to obtain an Explosive Spark.
This Explosive Spark is consumed by the next Charged Attack, which costs no Stamina and deals 50% increased DMG.
passives.descriptionId:
Saat Jumpy Dumpty atau Normal Attack Klee mengakibatkan DMG, Klee memiliki 50% kemungkinan untuk mendapatkan Explosive Spark.
Explosive Spark akan terkonsumsi saat Klee melancarkan Charged Attack dan membuatnya tidak mengonsumsi Stamina serta mengakibatkan 50% DMG lebih besar.

passives.name: Sparkling Burst
passives.description: When Klee's Charged Attack results in a CRIT Hit, all party members gain 2 Elemental Energy.
passives.descriptionId: Seluruh anggota party akan mendapatkan 2 Energy saat Charged Attack Klee mengakibatkan CRIT.

passives.name: All Of My Treasures!
passives.description: Displays the location of nearby resources unique to Mondstadt on the mini-map.
passives.descriptionId: Memperlihatkan lokasi produk khas Mondstadt di sekitar pada peta kecil.

constellations.name: Chained Reactions
constellations.description: Attacks and Skills have a certain chance to summon sparks that bombard opponents, dealing DMG equal to 120% of Sparks 'n' Splash's DMG.
constellations.descriptionId: Saat melancarkan serangan atau skill, Klee memiliki kemungkinan untuk menimbulkan percikan api yang mengakibatkan DMG sebesar 120% dari DMG Sparks 'n' Splash pada musuh.

constellations.name: Explosive Frags
constellations.description: Being hit by Jumpy Dumpty's mines decreases opponents' DEF by 23% for 10s.
constellations.descriptionId: DEF musuh berkurang 23% selama 10 detik saat terkena ranjau dari Jumpy Dumpty.

constellations.name: Exquisite Compound
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Jumpy Dumpty by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.descriptionId:
Meningkatkan 3 level Jumpy Dumpty.
Maksimum: Lv. 15.

constellations.name: Sparkly Explosion
constellations.description: If Klee leaves the field during the duration of Sparks 'n' Splash, her departure triggers an explosion that deals 555% of her ATK as AoE Pyro DMG.
constellations.descriptionId: Jika Klee meninggalkan medan pertempuran saat Sparks 'n' Splash sedang berlangsung, kepergian Klee akan memicu ledakan yang mengakibatkan Pyro DMG Area sebesar 555% ATK.

constellations.name: Nova Burst
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Sparks 'n' Splash by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.descriptionId:
Meningkatkan 3 level Sparks 'n' Splash.
Maksimum: Lv. 15.

constellations.name: Blazing Delight
constellations.description:
While under the effects of Sparks 'n' Splash, Klee will regenerate 3 Energy for all members of the party (excluding Klee) every 3s.
When Sparks 'n' Splash is used, all party members will gain a 10% Pyro DMG Bonus for 25s.
constellations.descriptionId:
Saat Sparks 'n' Splash aktif, Klee akan memulihkan 3 Energy setiap 3 detik untuk semua anggota party (tidak termasuk Klee sendiri).
Setelah melancarkan Sparks 'n' Splash, seluruh anggota party mendapatkan 10% Pyro DMG Bonus selama 25 detik.

name: Lauma
title: Evermoon's Sacrament Song
description: A Maiden blessed by moonlight and the grove alike, hope born to the Frostmoon Scions.
descriptionId: Seorang gadis suci yang diberkati oleh cahaya bulan dan hutan rimbun. Harapan yang lahir di antara Bani Bulan Embun.

talents.name: Peregrination of Linnunrata
talents.description:
Normal Attack
Performs up to 3 attacks that deal Dendro DMG.

Charged Attack
Lauma undergoes Spirit Envoy Metamorphosis, transforming into an envoy of the tranquil forest and consuming Stamina to charge forward for up to 10s. While in this state, Lauma's interruption resistance is increased, and she can consume additional Stamina to perform up to two consecutive jumps.
When exiting the Spirit Envoy state, Spirit Envoy Metamorphosis will enter cooldown, during which time, Lauma's Charged Attack will be transformed into Spiritcall Prayer: Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to deal AoE Dendro DMG to opponents in front of her after a short casting time.

Plunging Attack
Calling upon the might of Dendro, Lauma plunges towards the ground from mid-air, damaging all opponents in her path and dealing AoE Dendro DMG upon impact with the ground.
talents.descriptionId:
Normal Attack
Melancarkan hingga 3 serangan yang mengakibatkan Dendro DMG.

Charged Attack
Lauma melancarkan "Spirit Envoy Metamorphosis", berubah wujud menjadi roh penjaga hutan dan mengonsumsi Stamina untuk menerjang ke depan hingga maksimum 10 detik. Dalam status ini, ketahanan Lauma terhadap interupsi meningkat, dan Lauma dapat mengonsumsi Stamina tambahan untuk melompat hingga dua kali berturut-turut.
Saat keluar dari status Spirit Envoy, "Spirit Envoy Metamorphosis" akan memasuki cooldown. Selama cooldown ini, Charged Attack Lauma akan berubah menjadi "Spiritcall Prayer": Mengonsumsi sejumlah Stamina untuk mengakibatkan Dendro DMG Area ke area di depannya setelah jeda singkat.

Plunging Attack
Lauma mengumpulkan kekuatan Dendro dan menerjang tanah, menyerang musuh di jalur terjangannya dan mengakibatkan Dendro DMG Area saat mendarat.

talents.name: Runo: Dawnless Rest of Karsikko
talents.description:
Silently incants an ancient hymn, summoning a **Frostgrove Sanctuary** with different effects depending on whether you Tap or Hold.

Tap
Intone a Hymn of Hunting, dealing AoE Dendro DMG.

Hold
Can be unleashed when you have at least 1 **Verdant Dew**. Lauma consumes all Verdant Dew and intones a Hymn of Eternal Rest, dealing one regular instance of AoE Dendro DMG and another instance of AoE Dendro DMG that is considered Lunar-Bloom DMG. Each Verdant Dew consumed will give Lauma one stack of **Moon Song**. Each time you Hold to cast an Elemental Skill, a maximum of 3 Verdant Dew can be consumed in this way.

Additionally, when Lauma's Elemental Skill or attacks from Frostgrove Sanctuary hit an opponent, that opponent's Dendro RES and Hydro RES will be decreased for 10s.
talents.descriptionId:
Sambil merapalkan doa kuno dalam hati, Lauma mengaktifkan **Frostgrove Sanctuary** yang akan menghasilkan efek yang berbeda berdasarkan Mode Tekan atau Mode Tahan.

Mode Tekan
Membacakan Hymn of Hunting untuk mengakibatkan Dendro DMG Area.

Mode Tahan
Dapat dilancarkan saat memiliki setidaknya 1 **Verdant Dew**. Lauma akan mengonsumsi semua Verdant Dew untuk membacakan Hymn of Eternal Rest dan mengakibatkan satu kali Dendro DMG Area dan satu kali Dendro DMG Area yang dianggap sebagai DMG reaksi Lunar-Bloom. Setiap Verdant Dew yang dikonsumsi akan memberikan satu lapis **Moon Song** kepada Lauma. Setiap kali melancarkan Elemental Skill dalam Mode Tahan, Lauma dapat mengonsumsi maksimum 3 Verdant Dew dengan cara ini.

Selain itu, saat Elemental Skill Lauma atau serangan Frostgrove Sanctuary mengenai musuh, maka Dendro RES dan Hydro RES musuh tersebut akan berkurang selama 10 detik.

talents.name: Runo: All Hearts Become the Beating Moon
talents.description:
Let the wishes of all beings become as moonlight that bathes the earth. Lauma incants a sacred song of the far north, gaining 18 stacks of **Pale Hymn**.
Additionally, if Lauma uses her Elemental Burst while she has **Moon Song**, or she gains Moon Song within 15s of using her Elemental Burst, she will consume all Moon Song stacks and gain 6 stacks of Pale Hymn for every Moon Song stack consumed. This effect can only be triggered once for each Elemental Burst used, including the 15 seconds following its use.

Pale Hymn
When nearby party members deal Bloom, Hyperbloom, Burgeon, or Lunar-Bloom DMG, 1 stack of Pale Hymn will be consumed and the DMG dealt will be increased based on Lauma's Elemental Mastery. If this DMG hits multiple opponents at once, then multiple stacks of Pale Hymn will be consumed, depending on how many opponents are hit.
The duration for each stack of Pale Hymn is counted independently.
talents.descriptionId:
Biarlah keinginan semua makhluk hidup berubah menjadi cahaya bulan yang menerangi bumi. Lauma merapalkan lagu suci dari ujung utara dan mendapatkan 18 lapis **Pale Hymn**.
Selain itu, jika Lauma melancarkan Elemental Burst saat memiliki **Moon Song**, atau saat ia mendapatkan Moon Song dalam 15 detik setelah melancarkan Elemental Burst, maka Lauma akan mengonsumsi semua Moon Song dan mendapatkan 6 lapis Pale Hymn untuk setiap lapis Moon Song yang dikonsumsi. Efek ini hanya dapat terpicu sekali setiap kali Lauma melancarkan Elemental Burst, termasuk periode 15 detik setelah melancarkan Elemental Burst yang disebutkan di atas.

Pale Hymn
Saat Karakter di sekitar dalam party mengakibatkan DMG reaksi Bloom, Hyperbloom, Burgeon, atau Lunar-Bloom, maka satu lapis Pale Hymn akan dikonsumsi untuk meningkatkan DMG yang diakibatkan. Jumlah peningkatan DMG ini didasarkan pada Elemental Mastery Lauma. Saat DMG yang disebutkan di atas mengenai beberapa musuh secara bersamaan, maka jumlah lapisan Pale Hymn yang dikonsumsi juga disesuaikan berdasarkan jumlah musuh yang terkena serangan.
Durasi setiap lapis Pale Hymn akan dihitung secara terpisah.

passives.name: Light for the Frosty Night
passives.description:
For the next 20s after Lauma uses her Elemental Skill **Runo: Dawnless Rest of Karsikko**, corresponding differing buff effects will be granted depending on the party's Moonsign. The buffs provided by different Moonsign levels cannot stack.

Moonsign: Nascent Gleam
Bloom, Hyperbloom, and Burgeon DMG dealt by all nearby party members can score CRIT Hits, with CRIT Rate fixed at 15%, and CRIT DMG fixed at 100%. CRIT Rate from this effect stacks with CRIT Rate from similar effects that allow these Elemental Reactions to CRIT.

Moonsign: Ascendant Gleam
All nearby party members' Lunar-Bloom DMG CRIT Rate +10%, CRIT DMG +20%.
passives.descriptionId:
Setelah Lauma melancarkan Elemental Skill **Runo: Dawnless Rest of Karsikko**, akan mendapatkan efek penguatan yang berbeda selama 20 detik berdasarkan Moonsign milik party. Efek penguatan dari Level Moonsign yang berbeda tidak bisa ditumpuk.

Moonsign: Nascent Gleam
DMG reaksi Bloom, Hyperbloom, dan Burgeon yang dipicu oleh seluruh anggota party di sekitar dapat mengakibatkan CRIT. Dengan nilai CRIT Rate tetap sebesar 15%, dan CRIT DMG tetap sebesar 100%. CRIT Rate dari efek ini dapat ditumpuk dengan efek serupa lainnya yang membuat Reaksi Elemental dapat mengakibatkan CRIT juga.

Moonsign: Ascendant Gleam
DMG reaksi Lunar-Bloom yang diakibatkan seluruh anggota party di sekitar mendapatkan peningkatan 10% CRIT Rate dan 20% CRIT DMG.

passives.name: Cleansing for the Spring
passives.description:
Each point of Elemental Mastery Lauma has will give her the following bonuses:
· DMG dealt by her Elemental Skill is increased by 0.04%. The maximum increase obtainable this way is 32%.
· The cooldown of her Charged Attack Spirit Envoy Metamorphosis is reduced by 0.02%. The maximum reduction obtainable this way is 20%.
passives.descriptionId:
Setiap poin Elemental Mastery yang dimiliki Lauma akan memberikan efek buff berikut:
·DMG Elemental Skill meningkat 0,04%. Maksimum peningkatan DMG yang dapat diperoleh dengan cara ini adalah 32%.
·Cooldown untuk Charged Attack Spirit Envoy Metamorphosis berkurang 0,02%. Maksimum pengurangan Cooldown Spirit Envoy Metamorphosis yang dapat diperoleh dengan cara ini adalah 20%.

passives.name: Moonsign Benediction: Nature's Chorus
passives.description:
When a Bloom reaction is triggered by a party member, it will be converted into the Lunar-Bloom reaction, with every point of Elemental Mastery that Lauma has increasing Lunar-Bloom's Base DMG by 0.0175%, up to a maximum of 14%.

Additionally, when Lauma is in the party, the party's Moonsign will increase by 1 level.
passives.descriptionId:
Saat Karakter di dalam party memicu reaksi Bloom, akan dikonversi menjadi reaksi Lunar-Bloom. DMG dasar reaksi Lunar-Bloom meningkat berdasarkan Elemental Mastery Lauma. Setiap poin Elemental Mastery akan membuat DMG dasar reaksi Lunar-Bloom meningkat 0,0175%, hingga maksimum 14%.

Selain itu saat Lauma berada di dalam party, Moonsign party meningkat 1 level.

passives.name: Prayers for the Forest
passives.description:
Displays the location of nearby resources unique to Nod-Krai on the mini-map.
Additionally, Lauma appears to have a special affinity with some small animals affected by kuuvahki...
passives.descriptionId:
Memperlihatkan lokasi produk khas Nod-Krai di sekitar pada peta kecil.
Selain itu, Lauma sepertinya memiliki ikatan khusus dengan sebagian hewan kecil yang terpengaruh oleh kuuvahki ....

constellations.name: "O Lips, Weave Me Songs and Psalms"
constellations.description:
After Lauma uses her Elemental Skill **Runo: Dawnless Rest of Karsikko** or her Elemental Burst **Runo: All Hearts Become the Beating Moon**, she will gain Threads of Life for 20s.
During this time, when nearby party members trigger Lunar-Bloom reactions, nearby active characters will recover HP equal to 500% of Lauma's Elemental Mastery. This effect can be triggered once every 1.9s.
Additionally, the Stamina cost for Lauma's Spirit Envoy Form will be reduced by 40%, and its Max Duration will be extended by 5s.
constellations.descriptionId:
Setelah melancarkan Elemental Skill **Runo: Dawnless Rest of Karsikko** atau Elemental Burst **Runo: All Hearts Become the Beating Moon**, Lauma akan mendapatkan Threads of Life selama 20 detik.
Selama durasi ini, saat Karakter dalam party yang di sekitar memicu reaksi Lunar-Bloom, HP Karakter aktif di sekitar akan dipulihkan sebesar 500% Elemental Mastery Lauma. Efek ini dapat terpicu sekali setiap 1,9 detik.
Selain itu, konsumsi Stamina Lauma saat berada dalam wujud Spirit Envoy berkurang 40% dan durasi maksimumnya diperpanjang 5 detik.

constellations.name: "Twine Warnings and Tales From the North"
constellations.description:
The Elemental Burst **Runo: All Hearts Become the Beating Moon** is enhanced:
· **Pale Hymn** effects are increased: All nearby party members' Bloom, Hyperbloom, and Burgeon DMG is further increased by 500% of Lauma's Elemental Mastery, and their Lunar-Bloom DMG is further increased by 400% of Lauma's Elemental Mastery.

Moonsign: Ascendant Gleam: All nearby party members' Lunar-Bloom DMG is increased by 40%.
constellations.descriptionId:
Elemental Burst **Runo: All Hearts Become the Beating Moon** diperkuat:
·Efek **Pale Hymn** diperkuat: DMG reaksi Bloom, Hyperbloom, dan Burgeon, DMG yang dipicu oleh Karakter dalam party meningkat lagi sebesar 500% Elemental Mastery Lauma, sedangkan DMG reaksi Lunar-Bloom yang diakibatkan oleh Karakter dalam party meningkat lagi sebesar 400% Elemental Mastery Lauma.

Moonsign: Ascendant Gleam: DMG reaksi Lunar-Bloom yang diakibatkan Karakter dalam party meningkat 40%.

constellations.name: "Seek Not to Tread the Sly Fox's Path"
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of **Runo: All Hearts Become the Beating Moon** by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.descriptionId:
Meningkatkan 3 level Elemental Burst **Runo: All Hearts Become the Beating Moon**.
Maksimum: Lv. 15.

constellations.name: "Nor Yearn for the Great Bear's Might"
constellations.description: When attacks from the **Frostgrove Sanctuary** summoned by her Elemental Skill **Runo: Dawnless Rest of Karsikko** hit opponents, Lauma will regain 4 Elemental Energy. This effect can be triggered once every 5s.
constellations.descriptionId: Saat serangan **Frostgrove Sanctuary** dari Elemental Skill **Runo: Dawnless Rest of Karsikko** mengenai musuh, Lauma akan mendapatkan 4 poin Energy. Efek ini dapat terpicu sekali setiap 5 detik.

constellations.name: "If Truth May Be Subject to Witness"
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of **Runo: Dawnless Rest of Karsikko** by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.descriptionId:
Meningkatkan 3 level **Runo: Dawnless Rest of Karsikko**.
Maksimum: Lv. 15.

constellations.name: "I Offer Blood and Tears to the Moonlight"
constellations.description:
When the **Frostgrove Sanctuary** attacks opponents, it will deal 1 additional instance of AoE Dendro DMG equal to 185% of Lauma's Elemental Mastery. This DMG is considered Lunar-Bloom DMG. This instance of DMG will not consume any **Pale Hymn** stacks and will provide Lauma with 2 stacks of Pale Hymn, as well as refreshing the duration of Pale Hymn stacks gained in this manner.
This effect can occur up to 8 times during each Frostgrove Sanctuary. When using the Elemental Skill **Runo: Dawnless Rest of Karsikko**, all Pale Hymn stacks gained in this manner will be removed.

Additionally, when Lauma uses a Normal Attack while she has Pale Hymn stacks, she will consume 1 stack to convert this to deal Dendro DMG equal to 150% of her Elemental Mastery. This DMG is considered Lunar-Bloom DMG.

Moonsign: Ascendant Gleam: All nearby party members' Lunar-Bloom DMG is **elevated** by 25%.
constellations.descriptionId:
Saat **Frostgrove Sanctuary** menyerang musuh, akan mengakibatkan satu kali Dendro DMG Area tambahan sebesar 185% Elemental Mastery Lauma yang dianggap sebagai DMG Lunar-Bloom. DMG ini tidak akan mengonsumsi **Pale Hymn**, namun akan memberikan 2 lapis Pale Hymn bagi Lauma serta memperbarui durasi Pale Hymn yang diperoleh dengan cara ini.
Dalam satu kali durasi Frostgrove Sanctuary, efek ini dapat terpicu maksimum 8 kali. Saat melancarkan Elemental Skill **Runo: Dawnless Rest of Karsikko**, semua lapisan Pale Hymn yang diperoleh dengan cara ini akan dihapus.

Selain itu, jika Lauma melancarkan Normal Attack saat memiliki Pale Hymn, maka Lauma akan mengonsumsi satu lapis Pale Hymn dan mengonversi serangannya menjadi Dendro DMG sebesar 150% Elemental Mastery Lauma dan dianggap sebagai DMG Lunar-Bloom.

Moonsign: Ascendant Gleam: DMG reaksi Lunar-Bloom seluruh Karakter di sekitar dalam party **bertumbuh** sebesar 25%.

name: Linnea
title: Augur of Wonders
description: Naturalist and Advisor to the Nod-Krai Branch of the Adventurers' Guild.
descriptionId: Naturalis dan Konsultan Adventurers' Guild cabang Nod-Krai.

talents.name: Capture Protocol
talents.description:
Normal Attack
Performs up to 3 consecutive shots with a bow.

Charged Attack
Performs a more precise Aimed Shot with increased DMG.
While aiming, stone crystals will accumulate on the arrowhead. A fully charged crystalline arrow will deal Geo DMG.

Plunging Attack
Fires off a shower of arrows in mid-air before falling and striking the ground, dealing AoE DMG upon impact.
talents.descriptionId:
Normal Attack
Melancarkan hingga 3 serangan berturut-turut menggunakan busur.

Charged Attack
Melancarkan sebuah Serangan Membidik yang lebih akurat untuk mengakibatkan DMG lebih besar.
Saat membidik, kristal batu akan berkumpul di ujung anak panah. Setelah terkumpul penuh, anak panah yang diluncurkan akan mengakibatkan Geo DMG.

Plunging Attack
Melancarkan hujan panah dari udara dan menerjang tanah dengan kecepatan tinggi, mengakibatkan DMG Area saat mendarat.

talents.name: Countermeasure: Lumi's Battle Cry!
talents.description:
Adventure with Lumi! Depending on how you Tap, Lumi attacks in different forms.

Tap
Lumi strikes in a **Super Power Form**, attacking nearby enemies continuously, dealing AoE Geo DMG. If there are Moondrifts nearby, Lumi will also deal AoE Geo DMG to nearby enemies, which will be considered Lunar-Crystallize Reaction DMG.

Continuous Tapping
Time to show what we're really capable of! After using her Elemental Skill, Linnea will feed Lumi sparkling gemstones when her Elemental Skill or Normal Attack is Tapped repeatedly. A full-bellied Lumi will strike in her **Ultimate Power Form**, dealing an especially powerful instance of AoE Geo DMG that is considered Lunar-Crystallize Reaction DMG, switching to **Standard Power Form**.
Additionally, tapping the Elemental Skill increases Linnea's interruption resistance.
talents.descriptionId:
Bertualanglah bersama Lumi! Lumi akan melancarkan jenis serangan yang berbeda berdasarkan Mode Tekan yang berbeda.

Mode Tekan
Lumi akan menyerang musuh di sekitar dalam **Super Power Form**-nya tanpa henti, mengakibatkan Geo DMG Area. Jika ada Moondrift di sekitar, Lumi akan mengakibatkan Geo DMG Area yang dianggap sebagai DMG Lunar-Crystallize terhadap musuh di sekitar.

Mode Tekan Beruntun
Saatnya unjuk gigi! Setelah menggunakan Elemental Skill, saat menekan Elemental Skill atau Normal Attack secara terus-menerus, Linnea akan memberi Lumi makan permata-permata yang berkilauan. Lumi yang sudah kenyang akan menyerang dengan **Ultimate Power Form**-nya, mengakibatkan satu kali Geo DMG Area yang sangat kuat dan dianggap sebagai DMG Lunar-Crystallize terhadap musuh di sekitar, kemudian berganti ke **Standard Power Form**.
Selain itu, ketahanan Linnea terhadap interupsi akan meningkat saat menekan Elemental Skill terus-menerus.

talents.name: Memo: Survival Guide in Extreme Conditions
talents.description:
Even master adventurers need proper rest! Linnea summons Lumi to strike in **Super Power Form**, healing nearby party members. For a short duration, she will continuously heal nearby active party members based on Linnea's DEF.
If Lumi is already on the field when Linnea unleashes Elemental Burst, Lumi's active duration will be reset instead and her Strike Form will not change.
talents.descriptionId:
Bahkan petualang paling hebat pun perlu istirahat yang cukup! Linnea memanggil Lumi dalam bentuk **Super Power Form** untuk menyerang dan memulihkan HP seluruh anggota party di sekitar. Selama beberapa waktu berikutnya, Lumi akan terus memulihkan HP Karakter aktif di sekitarnya. Jumlah pemulihan ini didasarkan pada DEF Linnea.
Jika Lumi sudah menyerang saat Elemental Burst dilancarkan, maka durasi Lumi akan diulang dan Bentuk Serangan Lumi tidak akan berubah.

passives.name: Field Observation Notes
passives.description:
When Lumi is present on the field, the Geo RES of opponents near Lumi will decrease by 15%.

Moonsign: Ascendant Gleam: Linnea's Elemental Skill **Countermeasure: Lumi's Battle Cry!** and Elemental Burst **Memo: Survival Guide in Extreme Conditions** are enhanced. After summoning Lumi, the Geo RES of opponents near Lumi will be further decreased by 15%.
passives.descriptionId:
Saat Lumi berada di medan pertempuran, Geo RES musuh di sekitar Lumi berkurang 15%.

Moonsign: Ascendant Gleam: Elemental Skill Linnea **Countermeasure: Lumi's Battle Cry!** dan Elemental Burst Linnea **Memo: Survival Guide in Extreme Conditions** akan diperkuat: Setelah memanggil Lumi ke medan pertempuran, Geo RES musuh di sekitar berkurang 15% lagi.

passives.name: Universal Naturalist Archive
passives.description:
Linnea will increase the Elemental Mastery of certain characters in your party according to your current active character. Increase in Elemental Mastery is based on 5% of Linnea's DEF. If your current active character:
· Is a Moonsign character: Increase this character's Elemental Mastery.
· Is not a Moonsign character: Increase Linnea's own Elemental Mastery.
passives.descriptionId:
Linnea akan meningkatkan Elemental Mastery Karakter tertentu di dalam party berdasarkan Karakter aktif di dalam party. Jumlah peningkatannya adalah sebesar 5% DEF Linnea. Jika Karakter aktif dalam party sendiri adalah:
·Karakter Moonsign: Meningkatkan Elemental Mastery Karakter ini.
·Bukan Karakter Moonsign: Meningkatkan Elemental Mastery Linnea sendiri.

passives.name: Moonsign Benediction: Habitat Survey
passives.description:
When a party member triggers a Hydro Crystallize reaction, it will be converted into the Lunar-Crystallize reaction, with every 100 DEF that Linnea has increasing Lunar-Crystallize's Base DMG by 0.7%, up to a maximum of 14%.

Additionally, when Linnea is in the party, the party's Moonsign will increase by 1 level.
passives.descriptionId:
Saat Karakter dalam party memicu reaksi Hydro Crystallize, reaksi tersebut akan dikonversi menjadi Lunar-Crystallize. Untuk setiap 100 poin DEF Linnea, DMG dasar reaksi Lunar-Crystallize meningkat 0,7%, dengan maksimum 14% peningkatan yang bisa didapatkan dengan cara ini.

Selain itu, saat Linnea ada di dalam party, Moonsign party akan meningkat 1 level.

passives.name: Master Adventurer
passives.description:
When Linnea is not in combat, the charge time of her Aimed Shot is greatly decreased, and she will shoot an Ultra Convenient Quick Arrow instead. Different effects will occur depending on the targets hit:
· Specific animals: Ultra Convenient Quick Arrow will be transformed into a special "Net" that can capture the essence and form of these animals, using them as a medium to manifest the animal's physical form again. The "Net" can only be used for a limited number of times each week. 
· Ore veins used in forging: Linnea will dispatch Lumi, who will quickly strike at the ore marked by the Ultra Convenient Quick Arrow, then collect the dislodged ore. If Lumi is not on the field, Linnea will summon her for a short duration to help obtain the ore.

The DMG dealt to opponents by Linnea's Ultra Convenient Quick Arrow is reduced to 20% of her original Charged Arrow. Additionally, after firing a certain number of Ultra Convenient Quick Arrows within a short period of time, Linnea needs to take a temporary break before she can continue using them.
passives.descriptionId:
Saat tidak dalam kondisi bertempur, waktu yang diperlukan untuk melakukan charge Mode Membidik Linnea akan berkurang drastis, dan anak panahnya akan dikonversi menjadi Ultra Convenient Quick Arrow yang khusus. Tembakan ini akan menghasilkan efek yang berbeda berdasarkan jenis target yang terkena:
·Hewan tertentu: Ultra Convenient Quick Arrow akan dikonversi menjadi "jaring" khusus yang dapat menangkap bentuk ajaib hewan kecil dan menggunakannya sebagai media untuk mewujudkan kembali bentuk hewan tersebut. Jumlah "jaring" khusus yang dapat digunakan setiap minggu bersifat terbatas.
·Bijih bebatuan yang dipakai untuk menempa: Linnea akan mengutus Lumi untuk menghancurkan bijih yang ditandai oleh Ultra Convenient Quick Arrow dan mengumpulkan bijih yang terjatuh. Jika Lumi tidak ada di medan, maka Linnea akan memanggil Lumi sejenak untuk membantunya mengumpulkan bijih.

DMG yang diakibatkan Ultra Convenient Quick Arrow terhadap musuh berkurang menjadi 20% dari DMG Charged Arrow awalnya. Selain itu, setelah menembakkan Ultra Convenient Quick Arrow beberapa kali sekaligus dalam waktu singkat, Linnea harus beristirahat sejenak untuk dapat menggunakannya kembali.

constellations.name: Provisional Classification
constellations.description:
When unleashing Elemental Skill **Countermeasure: Lumi's Battle Cry!**, or when triggering Moondrift Harmony, Linnea gains 6 stacks of the Field Catalog effect for 10s. Max 18 stacks. When nearby party members deal Lunar-Crystallize Reaction DMG, consume 1 stack of Field Catalog to increase the DMG dealt. The increase in DMG is equal to 75% of Linnea's DEF.
Additionally, when Lumi uses Million Ton Crush in her **Ultimate Power Form**, Linnea can consume up to 5 stacks of Field Catalog. Each stack will increase the DMG dealt by 150% of Linnea's DEF.
constellations.descriptionId:
Saat melancarkan Elemental Skill **Countermeasure: Lumi's Battle Cry!**, atau saat memicu Moondrift Harmony, Linnea akan mendapatkan 6 lapis efek Field Catalog yang bertahan 10 detik dan dapat ditumpuk sampai 18 lapis. Saat Karakter sekitar di dalam party mengakibatkan DMG reaksi Lunar-Crystallize, akan mengonsumsi satu lapis efek Field Catalog untuk meningkatkan DMG yang diakibatkan sebesar 75% DEF Linnea.
Selain itu, saat Lumi menggunakan Million Ton Crush-nya dalam bentuk **Ultimate Power Form**, Linnea dapat mengonsumsi maksimum 5 lapis Field Catalog untuk meningkatkan DMG yang diakibatkan sebesar 150% DEF Linnea setiap lapisnya.

constellations.name: Tidings of Joy and Sorrow
constellations.description:
Within 8s after triggering Moondrift Harmony, all Hydro and Geo party members have their CRIT DMG increased by 40%. Additionally, when Lumi uses Million Ton Crush in her **Ultimate Power Form**, the CRIT DMG of that attack increases by an additional 150%. 

Moonsign: Ascendant Gleam: When Lumi uses Heavy Overdrive Hammer in her **Super Power Form**, or when she uses Million Ton Crush in her Ultimate Power Form, an instance of Moondrift Harmony will be triggered. For this instance of Moondrift Harmony, all Hydro and Geo characters in the party will be considered to have applied their Elements in the reaction.
constellations.descriptionId:
Dalam 8 detik setelah memicu Moondrift Harmony, CRIT DMG seluruh Karakter Hydro dan Geo di dalam party meningkat 40%. Selain itu CRIT DMG Lumi saat menggunakan Million Ton Crush dalam bentuk **Ultimate Power Form** akan meningkat 150% lagi.

Moonsign: Ascendant Gleam: Saat Lumi menggunakan Heavy Overdrive Hammer dalam bentuk **Super Power Form**, atau saat menggunakan Million Ton Crush dalam bentuk Ultimate Power Form, maka akan terpicu satu kali Moondrift Harmony. Moondrift Harmony yang terpicu kali ini akan menganggap semua Karakter dalam party dengan jenis elemen Hydro dan Geo telah mengaplikasikan elemen mereka ke dalam reaksinya.

constellations.name: Eventful Log Page
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of **Countermeasure: Lumi's Battle Cry!** by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.descriptionId:
Meningkatkan 3 level Elemental Skill **Countermeasure: Lumi's Battle Cry!**.
Maksimum: Lv. 15.

constellations.name: Expert Instinct
constellations.description: Within 5s after Moondrift Harmony is triggered, increase the DEF of Linnea and your current active character by 25% respectively. When Linnea is on field, the DEF-increasing effect can be stacked.
constellations.descriptionId: Setelah memicu Moondrift Harmony, DEF Linnea dan Karakter aktif sendiri dalam party meningkat 25% selama 5 detik. Saat Linnea ada di medan pertempuran, efek peningkatan DEF di atas dapat ditumpuk.

constellations.name: Fairyland's Farewell Gift
constellations.description:
Elemental Burst **Memo: Survival Guide in Extreme Conditions** increases by 3 Levels.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.descriptionId:
Meningkatkan 3 level Elemental Burst **Memo: Survival Guide in Extreme Conditions**.
Maksimum: Lv. 15.

constellations.name: Golden Beagle's Dream
constellations.description:
The effects of the Constellation, Provisional Classification, are enhanced: When unleashing Elemental Skill **Countermeasure: Lumi's Battle Cry!**, or when triggering Moondrift Harmony, Linnea will directly gain the maximum number of Field Catalog stacks. When consuming Field Catalog, consume twice the original number of stacks, such that the increase in DMG will be boosted to 150% of the original value.

Moonsign: Ascendant Gleam: Lunar-Crystallize Reaction DMG dealt by nearby party members is **elevated** by 25%.
constellations.descriptionId:
Efek Konstelasi Provisional Classification diperkuat: Saat melancarkan Elemental Skill **Countermeasure: Lumi's Battle Cry!** atau saat memicu Moondrift Harmony, Linnea akan langsung mendapatkan efek Field Catalog dengan jumlah lapisan maksimum. Saat mengonsumsi Field Catalog, akan mengonsumsi lapisan sebanyak 2 kali lapisan awalnya untuk membuat efek peningkatan DMG-nya menjadi 150% dari awalnya.

Moonsign: Ascendant Gleam: DMG yang diakibatkan reaksi Lunar-Crystallize Karakter party di sekitar **bertumbuh** 25%.

name: Lohen
title: Sharpened Arrowhead
description: Vice Captain of the Knights of Favonius Ranged Company, a knight known for his unorthodox approach and fondness for unconventional tactics.
descriptionId: Wakil Kapten Pasukan Jarak Jauh Knights of Favonius, seorang knight yang bertindak tanpa terikat aturan dan menyukai taktik yang tidak biasa.

talents.name: Spear of Favonius — Broken Oath
talents.description:
Normal Attack
Performs up to 5 consecutive strikes.

Charged Attack
Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to perform a forward thrust.

Plunging Attack
Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground below, damaging opponents along the path and dealing AoE DMG upon impact.
talents.descriptionId:
Normal Attack
Melancarkan hingga 5 serangan berturut-turut.

Charged Attack
Mengonsumsi sejumlah Stamina untuk menusuk ke arah depan.

Plunging Attack
Menerjang dari udara untuk menghantam tanah di bawahnya, menyerang musuh di jalur terjangan dan mengakibatkan DMG area saat mendarat.

talents.name: Unforeseen Strike
talents.description:
As he searches for weaknesses, Lohen switches to **Masterstroke** mode. While in this state:
· Lohen can actively accumulate **Joy**, using it to unleash the special Elemental Skill **Etched Into Bone and Soul**.
· Nearby party members can accumulate **Will to Win** for Lohen, increasing the DMG dealt by Etched Into Bone and Soul.
Lohen can unleash Etched Into Bone and Soul up to 3 times while in Masterstroke mode, after which, he will no longer be able to accumulate Joy.
talents.descriptionId:
Mencari kelemahan musuh, dan berganti ke mode **Masterstroke**. Saat dalam mode ini:
·Lohen bisa secara aktif mengakumulasi **Joy**, untuk melancarkan Elemental Skill khusus **Etched Into Bone and Soul**.
·Anggota party lain di sekitar bisa mengakumulasi **Will to Win** untuk Lohen, untuk meningkatkan DMG Etched Into Bone and Soul.
Lohen dapat melancarkan Etched Into Bone and Soul hingga 3 kali dalam mode Masterstroke. Setelah itu, Lohen tidak bisa lagi mendapatkan Joy.

talents.name: Manifest Judgment
talents.description: Performs a swift series of forward strikes, consuming all **Will to Win** and dealing Cryo DMG. This DMG will be increased based on the amount of Will to Win consumed. If Lohen is in **Masterstroke** mode when this is performed, the duration of Masterstroke will be extended by 1.65s.
talents.descriptionId: Melancarkan tebasan beruntun yang cepat ke arah depan, mengonsumsi seluruh **Will to Win**untuk mengakibatkan Cryo DMG. DMG ini akan ditingkatkan berdasarkan jumlah Will to Win yang dikonsumsi. Jika Lohen sedang berada dalam mode **Masterstroke** saat melancarkan Talenta ini, maka durasi mode Masterstroke kali ini akan diperpanjang 1,65 detik.

passives.name: Moratorium on Questioning
passives.description: When nearby party members accumulate **Will to Win** for Lohen by dealing DMG while he is in **Masterstroke** mode, if that DMG is not less than 3,000% of Lohen's Base ATK, it will accumulate an extra 60 Will to Win.
passives.descriptionId: Dalam mode **Masterstroke **, saat anggota party lain di sekitar mengakumulasi **Will to Win** untuk Lohen dengan cara mengakibatkan DMG, jika DMG yang diakibatkan kali ini tidak lebih rendah dari 3.000% Base ATK Lohen, maka akan mengakumulasi 60 poin Will to Win tambahan untuk Lohen.

passives.name: Flippant Masterpiece
passives.description: While in **Masterstroke** mode, for 8s after another nearby party member triggers a Cryo Reaction, that character's ATK is increased by 15%, while Lohen's ATK is increased by 15%.
passives.descriptionId: Saat dalam mode **Masterstroke**, selama 8 detik setelah anggota party lain di sekitar memicu reaksi terkait Cryo terhadap musuh, ATK Karakter tersebut meningkat 15% dan ATK Lohen meningkat 15%.

passives.name: When the Mood Strikes
passives.description:
Lohen gains "High Spirits" for 9s after he unleashes the Elemental Skill Unforeseen Strike: Increases the Skill Level of Unforeseen Strike by 1.
When unleashing an Elemental Skill, if the Level of any other party member's Normal Attack, Elemental Skill, or Elemental Burst is not lower than Lohen's Elemental Skill Level, the duration of this instance of High Spirits will be increased by an additional 6s.
High Spirits can be gained once every 18s.
passives.descriptionId:
Setelah melancarkan Elemental Skill Unforeseen Strike, Lohen akan mendapatkan efek High Spirits selama 9 detik. High Spirits: Selama durasinya, level Elemental Skill Unforeseen Strike meningkat 1 level.
Saat melancarkan Elemental Skill, jika level skill Normal Attack, Elemental Skill, atau Elemental Burst milik Karakter lain dalam party tidak lebih rendah dari level Elemental Skill Lohen, maka durasi efek High Spirits kali ini diperpanjang 6 detik lagi.
Efek High Spirits bisa diperoleh sekali setiap 18 detik.

constellations.name: O Breezes, That So Oft Bear Sorrowful Lament
constellations.description:
Lohen's maximum **Will to Win** limit is increased to 300% of its original value.
Additionally, when other nearby party members deal DMG while Lohen is in **Masterstroke** mode, they accumulate 500% as much Will to Win for him as they originally would have.
constellations.descriptionId:
Batas maksimum **Will to Win** Lohen meningkat menjadi 300% dari batas awalnya.
Selain itu, saat Lohen berada dalam mode **Masterstroke**, Will to Win yang diakumulasi anggota party lain di sekitar dengan cara mengakibatkan DMG akan bertambah menjadi 500% dari nilai awalnya.

constellations.name: In Flight, I Strike Whatever Flies
constellations.description: When in **Masterstroke** mode, after the special Elemental Skill **Etched Into Bone and Soul** hits an opponent or the Elemental Burst Manifest Judgment is unleashed, Lohen gains "Evilsbane Blade" for 4s: The next time Lohen hits an opponent with a Normal or Charged Attack while in Masterstroke mode, he will follow up with an additional strike that deals AoE Cryo DMG equal to 500% of his ATK, and increase the Elemental Mastery of other nearby party members by 200 for 8s. Evilsbane Blade can be triggered once every 4s.
constellations.descriptionId: Saat berada dalam mode **Masterstroke**, selama 4 detik setelah Elemental Skill Khusus **Etched Into Bone and Soul** mengenai musuh atau melancarkan Elemental Burst Manifest Judgment, Lohen akan mendapatkan efek Evilsbane Blade: Saat Lohen berada dalam mode Masterstroke dan Normal Attack atau Charged Attack Lohen berikutnya mengenai musuh, maka ia akan mengakibatkan satu kali lagi serangan tambahan yang mengakibatkan Cryo DMG Area sebesar 500% ATK Lohen dan meningkatkan 200 poin Elemental Mastery anggota party lain di sekitar selama 8 detik. Efek Evilsbane Blade dapat terpicu sekali setiap 4 detik.

constellations.name: Only the Spear That Wounds Can Heal
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of **Unforeseen Strike** by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.descriptionId:
Meningkatkan 3 level Elemental Skill **Unforeseen Strike**.
Maksimum: Lv. 15.

constellations.name: Radiant Love, Laughing Death
constellations.description:
When Lohen unleashes the Elemental Burst Manifest Judgment while in **Masterstroke** mode, his **Will to Win** will be maxed out, causing this instance of his Elemental Burst to gain the maximum possible DMG increase.

Additionally, when Lohen switches to Masterstroke mode, the following will occur depending on how much Elemental Energy he has:
· When Elemental Energy is not full: Lohen recovers 15 Elemental Energy.
· When Elemental Energy is full: If, during the next 15s, Lohen unleashes the Elemental Burst Manifest Judgment, he will recover 15 Elemental Energy.
constellations.descriptionId:
Saat Lohen melancarkan Elemental Burst Manifest Judgment dalam mode **Masterstroke**, ia akan langsung mengakumulasi **Will to Win** maksimum, lalu membuat Elemental Burst kali ini mendapatkan efek peningkatan DMG tertinggi.

Selain itu, saat Lohen berganti ke mode Masterstroke, jika Energy-nya:
·Belum terisi penuh: Akan memulihkan 15 poin Energy Lohen.
·Sudah terisi penuh: Melancarkan Elemental Burst Manifest Judgment dalam kurun waktu 15 detik akan memulihkan 15 poin Energy Lohen.

constellations.name: Never Ask, Nor Trouble You to Know
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of **Manifest Judgment** by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.descriptionId:
Meningkatkan 3 level Elemental Burst **Manifest Judgment**.
Maksimum: Lv. 15.

constellations.name: To Drown, to Sink, Unconscious — Supreme Joy
constellations.description:
Using the special Elemental Skill **Etched Into Bone and Soul** and hitting an opponent with it or, while **Masterstroke** mode is active, unleashing the Elemental Burst Manifest Judgment, will not consume any **Will to Win**. Instead, Lohen's **Joy** will be maxed out, and if he hits an opponent the next time he uses the special Elemental Skill Etched Into Bone and Soul, the duration of this instance of Masterstroke will be extended by 1.25s. This effect can be triggered once every 7s.
Additionally, the CRIT DMG of all the DMG described above is increased by 175%, and the number of times Lohen can unleash Etched Into Bone and Soul during this instance of Masterstroke is increased by 2.
constellations.descriptionId:
Saat Elemental Skill Khusus **Etched Into Bone and Soul** mengenai musuh atau saat melancarkan Elemental Burst Manifest Judgment dalam mode **Masterstroke**, Lohen tidak akan mengonsumsi **Will to Win** lagi dan akan memulihkan **Joy** Lohen hingga batas maksimum. Dan saat Elemental Skill Khusus Etched Into Bone and Soul berikutnya mengenai musuh, durasi Masterstroke kali ini diperpanjang 1,25 detik. Efek ini dapat terpicu sekali setiap 7 detik.
Selain itu, CRIT DMG dari seluruh DMG yang disebutkan di atas akan meningkat 175%, dan selama durasi Masterstroke kali ini, jumlah maksimum Etched Into Bone and Soul yang bisa dilancarkan Lohen bertambah 2 kali.

name: Lumine
description: A traveler from another world who had their only kin taken away, forcing them to embark on a journey to find The Seven.
descriptionId: Seorang pengembara yang berasal dari dunia lain, saudara satu-satunya yang ia miliki dirampas dari hadapannya oleh sesosok dewa, dan kini ia mengembara untuk mencari The Seven.

name: Lyney
title: Spectacle of Phantasmagoria
description: A famed Fontainian magician who possesses great stage presence as well as gift of the gab. Audiences are enthralled by his exquisite skills, and they hang on to his every clever word.
descriptionId: Pesulap terkenal dari Fontaine yang berotak encer dan bertangan gesit. Penonton selalu terpesona oleh kemampuannya dalam bermain sulap dan bertutur kata.

talents.name: Card Force Translocation
talents.description:
Normal Attack
Performs up to 4 consecutive shots with a bow.

Plunging Attack
Fires off a shower of arrows in mid-air before falling and striking the ground, dealing AoE DMG upon impact.

Charged Attack
Performs a more precise Aimed Shot with increased DMG.
While aiming, flames will run across the arrowhead before being fired. Different effects will occur based on the time spent charging.
·Charge Level 1: Fires off a Pyro-infused arrow, dealing Pyro DMG.
·Charge Level 2: Fires off a Prop Arrow that deals Pyro DMG, and upon hit, it will summon a Grin-Malkin Hat.
When firing the Prop Arrow, and when Lyney has more than 60% HP, he will consume a portion of his HP to obtain 1 Prop Surplus stack. Max 5 stacks. The effect will be removed after the character spends 30s out of combat.
The lowest Lyney can drop to through this method is 60% of his Max HP.

Grin-Malkin Hat
·Can taunt nearby opponents and attract their attacks. Each opponent can only be taunted by the Hat once every 5s.
·The Hat will inherit a percentage of Lyney's Max HP.
·If destroyed, or if its duration expires, it will fire off a Pyrotechnic Strike at 1 nearby opponent, dealing Pyro DMG.
Only 1 Hat can exist at any given time.

Arkhe: Pneuma
At certain intervals, the Prop Arrow will cause a Spiritbreath Thorn to descend upon its hit location, dealing Pneuma-aligned Pyro DMG.
talents.descriptionId:
Normal Attack
Melancarkan hingga 4 serangan berturut-turut menggunakan busur.

Plunging Attack
Melancarkan hujan panah dari udara dan menerjang tanah dengan kecepatan tinggi, mengakibatkan DMG Area saat mendarat.

Charged Attack
Mengerahkan sebuah Serangan Membidik yang lebih akurat untuk mengakibatkan DMG lebih besar.
Saat membidik, kekuatan api akan berkumpul di ujung anak panah sebelum ditembakkan. Memiliki efek yang berbeda tergantung dari lama serangannya ditahan:
·Charge Tahap 1: Menembakkan anak panah dengan efek Pyro dan mengakibatkan Pyro DMG;
·Charge Tahap 2: Menembakkan sebuah Prop Arrow yang mengakibatkan Pyro DMG dan memanggil Grin-Malkin Hat saat mengenai target.
Ketika Lyney memiliki 60% HP atau lebih saat menembakkan Prop Arrow, Lyney akan mengonsumsi sebagian HP-nya untuk mendapatkan satu lapis Prop Surplus. Efek ini dapat ditumpuk sampai 5 lapis dan akan dihapus setelah meninggalkan medan pertempuran selama 30 detik.
Angka terendah yang bisa dicapai oleh HP Lyney dengan cara ini adalah 60% HP.

Grin-Malkin Hat
·Dapat memprovokasi musuh di sekitar dan memancing serangan mereka. Setiap musuh dapat diprovokasi oleh Grin-Malkin Hat satu kali setiap 5 detik;
·HP Grin-Malkin Hat akan ditentukan berdasarkan persentasi dari nilai Max HP Lyney;
·Saat dihancurkan atau durasinya berakhir, akan melancarkan Pyrotechnic Strike terhadap salah satu musuh di sekitar dan mengakibatkan Pyro DMG.
Hanya 1 Grin-Malkin Hat yang dapat muncul di medan pertempuran dalam waktu yang bersamaan.

Arkhe: Pneuma
Setiap beberapa saat, Prop Arrow akan mendatangkan Spiritbreath Thorn di posisi target dan mengakibatkan Pneuma-aligned Pyro DMG.

talents.name: Bewildering Lights
talents.description:
Lyney does a flourish with his hat, unleashing a firework surprise!
