When used, he will clear all current Prop Surplus stacks and deal AoE Pyro DMG to opponents in front of him. DMG will be increased according to the stacks cleared, and this will also regenerate Lyney's HP based on his Max HP.

When a Grin-Malkin Hat created by Lyney is on the field, the fireworks will cause it to explode, dealing AoE Pyro DMG equal to that of a Pyrotechnic Strike.
The DMG dealt through the Grin-Malkin Hat in this way is considered Charged Attack DMG.
talents.descriptionId:
Lyney menggerakkan topinya dan meledakkan kembang api kejutan.
Saat dilancarkan, akan menghapus seluruh lapisan Prop Surplus yang sudah dimiliki dan mengakibatkan Pyro DMG Area terhadap musuh yang berada di depan. DMG akan meningkat berdasarkan jumlah lapisan Prop Surplus yang dihapus. Juga akan memulihkan HP Lyney berdasarkan Max HP-nya.

Saat ada Grin-Malkin Hat yang diciptakan oleh Lyney di medan perang, kembang api akan membuat Grin-Malkin Hat meledak dengan kuat dan mengakibatkan Pyro DMG Area yang setara dengan DMG Pyrotechnic Strike.
DMG yang dihasilkan oleh Grin-Malkin Hat dengan cara ini akan dianggap sebagai DMG Charged Attack.

talents.name: Wondrous Trick: Miracle Parade
talents.description:
Unleashing his magic, Lyney turns himself into a Grin-Malkin Cat that can move around quickly. (Not to be mistaken for the Grin-Malkin Hat. They're two different props!)
When the Grin-Malkin Cat gets close to opponents, it will send flames falling down on them, dealing at most 1 instance of Pyro DMG to each opponent. When the duration ends, he will dismiss the Grin-Malkin Cat and ignite fireworks that deal AoE Pyro DMG, summon 1 Grin-Malkin Hat, and grant himself 1 Prop Surplus stack.

Grin-Malkin Cat can be actively canceled.
talents.descriptionId:
Lyney melancarkan sulap dan berubah menjadi Grin-Malkin Cat yang dapat bergerak dengan cepat. (Bukan Grin-Malkin Hat ya. Ini dua alat sulap yang berbeda loh!)
Saat Grin-Malkin Cat mendekati musuh, akan menurunkan bara api terhadap musuh di sekitar, dan mengakibatkan maksimum satu kali Pyro DMG terhadap setiap musuh. Setelah durasinya berakhir, Lyney akan membatalkan bentuk Grin-Malkin Cat, dan menyalakan kembang api yang mengakibatkan Pyro DMG Area, serta memanggil satu Grin-Malkin Hat dan mendapatkan satu lapis Prop Surplus.

Grin-Malkin Cat bisa dibatalkan secara aktif.

passives.name: Perilous Performance
passives.description: If Lyney consumes HP when firing off a Prop Arrow, the Grin-Malkin hat summoned by the arrow will, upon hitting an opponent, restore 3 Energy to Lyney and increase DMG dealt by 80% of his ATK.
passives.descriptionId: Jika Lyney mengonsumsi HP saat menembakkan Prop Arrow, maka saat serangan Grin-Malkin Hat yang dipanggil dari Prop Arrow mengenai musuh, akan memulihkan 3 poin Energy Lyney dan meningkatkan DMG berdasarkan 80% ATK Lyney.

passives.name: Conclusive Ovation
passives.description:
The DMG Lyney deals to opponents affected by Pyro will receive the following buffs:
·Increases the DMG dealt by 60%.
·Each Pyro party member other than Lyney will cause the DMG dealt to increase by an additional 20%.
Lyney can deal up to 100% increased DMG to opponents affected by Pyro in this way.
passives.descriptionId:
DMG yang dihasilkan Lyney terhadap musuh yang berada dalam pengaruh Pyro akan mendapatkan peningkatan sebagai berikut:
·DMG dasar meningkat 60%.
·Setiap Karakter Pyro di dalam party selain Lyney akan memberikan tambahan peningkatan 20%.

Lyney bisa mendapatkan peningkatan DMG seperti yang disebutkan di atas hingga maksimum 100% terhadap musuh yang berada dalam pengaruh Pyro.

passives.name: Trivial Observations
passives.description: Displays the location of nearby resources unique to Fontaine on the mini-map.
passives.descriptionId: Memperlihatkan lokasi produk khas Fontaine di sekitar pada peta kecil.

constellations.name: Whimsical Wonders
constellations.description:
Lyney can have 2 Grin-Malkin Hats present at once.
Additionally, Prop Arrows will summon 2 Grin-Malkin Hats and grant Lyney 1 extra stack of Prop Surplus. This effect can occur once every 15s.
constellations.descriptionId:
Lyney dapat menciptakan maksimum 2 buah Grin-Malkin Hat yang dapat muncul di medan pertempuran dalam waktu yang bersamaan.
Selain itu, Prop Arrow akan memanggil 2 Grin-Malkin Hat saat mengenai target dan memberikan 1 lapis "Prop Surplus" tambahan. Efek ini dapat terpicu sekali setiap 15 detik.

constellations.name: Loquacious Cajoling
constellations.description: When Lyney is on the field, he will gain a stack of Crisp Focus every 2s. Each stack will increase his CRIT DMG by 20%. Max 3 stacks. This effect will be canceled when Lyney leaves the field.
constellations.descriptionId: Saat Lyney berada di medan pertempuran, akan mendapatkan efek Crisp Focus sekali setiap 2 detik. Efek ini akan meningkatkan 20% CRIT DMG-nya, dapat ditumpuk sampai 3 lapis. Efek ini akan hilang saat Lyney meninggalkan medan pertempuran.

constellations.name: Prestidigitation
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Normal Attack: Card Force Translocation by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.descriptionId:
Meningkatkan 3 level Normal Attack: Card Force Translocation.
Maksimum: Lv. 15.

constellations.name: Well-Versed, Well-Rehearsed
constellations.description: After an opponent is hit by Lyney's Pyro Charged Attack, this opponent's Pyro RES will be decreased by 20% for 6s.
constellations.descriptionId: Setelah Charged Attack Lyney yang berelemen Pyro mengenai musuh, Pyro RES musuh tersebut akan berkurang 20% selama 6 detik.

constellations.name: To Pierce Enigmas
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Wondrous Trick: Miracle Parade by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.descriptionId:
Meningkatkan 3 level Wondrous Trick: Miracle Parade.
Maksimum: Lv. 15.

constellations.name: Guarded Smile
constellations.description: When Lyney fires a Prop Arrow, he will fire a Pyrotechnic Strike: Reprised that will deal 80% of a Pyrotechnic Strike's DMG. This DMG is considered Charged Attack DMG.
constellations.descriptionId: Saat Lyney menembakkan Prop Arrow, dia akan menembakkan satu Pyrotechnic Strike: Reprised yang akan mengakibatkan 80% DMG Pyrotechnic Strike. DMG ini dianggap sebagai DMG Charged Attack.

name: Mavuika
title: Night-Igniting Flame
description: The leader of Natlan who inherited the Ancient Name of "Kiongozi." She made a vow to illuminate the future of the nation of war with the Sacred Flame.
descriptionId: Seorang pemimpin Natlan yang mewarisi Marga Kuno "Kiongozi". Dia bersumpah untuk menerangi masa depan bangsa peperangan dengan Api Keramat.

talents.name: Flames Weave Life
talents.description:
Normal Attack
Performs up to 4 consecutive claymore strikes.

Charged Attack
Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to perform an especially powerful Severing Splendor strike toward the front.

Plunging Attack
Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground below, damaging opponents along the path and dealing AoE DMG upon impact.
talents.descriptionId:
Normal Attack
Melancarkan maksimum hingga 4 serangan tebasan beruntun.

Charged Attack
Mengonsumsi sejumlah Stamina untuk melakukan 1 tebasan Severing Splendor yang sangat kuat ke arah depan.

Plunging Attack
Menerjang dari udara untuk menghantam tanah di bawahnya, menyerang musuh di jalurnya dan mengakibatkan DMG area saat mendarat.

talents.name: The Named Moment
talents.description:
Calling upon her authority over "conflict," Mavuika summons the All-Fire Armaments passed down through the line of human Archons, dealing Nightsoul-aligned Pyro DMG.
After using this, Mavuika's Nightsoul points are restored to max value, and she enters the Nightsoul's Blessing state.

All-Fire Armaments
Has different forms when Tapped or Held.

Tap
"Divine Name Unleashed": The All-Fire Armaments manifest as a Ring of Searing Radiance. The Ring follows the current active character and attacks nearby opponents at intervals, dealing Nightsoul-aligned Pyro DMG.

Hold
"Ancient Name Unbound": The All-Fire Armaments manifest as a Flamestrider. In this state, Mavuika can ride the Flamestrider at high speed, or activate its hidden backup propulsion module to temporarily cross various terrain types and glide in mid-air. Mavuika's Normal, Charged, and Plunging Attacks will also be converted to deal Nightsoul-aligned Pyro DMG which cannot be overridden. When sprinting, she also deals Nightsoul-aligned Pyro DMG to opponents along her path.

While in the Nightsoul's Blessing state, Tapping the Elemental Skill can switch the All-Fire Armaments' form. The Armaments will disappear once Mavuika's Nightsoul's Blessing state ends.

Nightsoul's Blessing: Mavuika
Continuously consumes Nightsoul points according to the All-Fire Armaments' form. Mavuika's Nightsoul's Blessing state ends once her Nightsoul points are exhausted.
talents.descriptionId:
Dengan menggunakan otoritasnya atas "konflik," Mavuika memanggil All-Fire Armaments yang diwariskan melalui garis keturunan Archon manusia, mengakibatkan Nightsoul-aligned Pyro DMG.
Setelah dilancarkan, poin Nightsoul Mavuika akan dipulihkan ke nilai maksimum, dan Mavuika akan memasuki status Nightsoul's Blessing.

All-Fire Armaments
Memiliki bentuk yang berbeda saat dilancarkan dengan Mode Tekan atau Mode Tahan.

Mode Tekan
"Divine Name Unleashed": All-Fire Armaments akan menampakkan wujudnya sebagai Ring of Searing Radiance. Ring of Searing Radiance akan mengikuti Karakter aktif dan menyerang musuh di sekitar secara berkala, mengakibatkan Nightsoul-aligned Pyro DMG.

Mode Tahan
"Ancient Name Unbound": All-Fire Armaments akan menampakkan wujudnya sebagai Flamestrider. Dalam kondisi ini, Mavuika akan bisa mengendarai Flamestrider dan bergerak dengan cepat, atau membuka modul propulsi tersembunyi cadangan di belakangnya, yang bisa membuatnya melewati berbagai medan dan bisa terbang di udara dalam waktu singkat. Selain itu, Normal Attack, Charged Attack, dan Plunging Attack Mavuika akan dikonversi menjadi Nightsoul-aligned Pyro DMG yang tidak bisa ditimpa Elemental Infusion lainnya. Saat menerjang, akan mengakibatkan Nightsoul-aligned Pyro DMG terhadap musuh yang berada di jalurnya.

Saat dalam status Nightsoul's Blessing, menekan Elemental Skill akan bisa mengubah bentuk All-Fire Armaments. All-Fire Armaments akan hilang setelah status Nightsoul's Blessing Mavuika berakhir.

Nightsoul's Blessing: Mavuika
Terus mengonsumsi poin Nightsoul berdasarkan bentuk All-Fire Armaments. Saat poin Nightsoul habis dikonsumsi, status Nightsoul's Blessing Mavuika berakhir.

talents.name: Hour of Burning Skies
talents.description:
Let the people's inner voices reach the divine throne in the heavens.
Mavuika's Elemental Burst is not reliant on Energy, but instead, on "Fighting Spirit."

Fighting Spirit
When Mavuika has at least 50% Fighting Spirit, she can consume it all to unleash her Elemental Burst.
Mavuika can obtain Fighting Spirit via the following methods:
· When in combat, Nightsoul points consumed by nearby party members are converted to Fighting Spirit.
· When nearby party members' Normal Attacks hit opponents, Mavuika gains 1.5 Fighting Spirit. This can trigger once every 0.1s.

After using this, Mavuika gains 10 Nightsoul points and enters the Nightsoul's Blessing state. Riding her Flamestrider high in the air, she uses a powerful Sunfell Slice against opponents on the ground, dealing Nightsoul-aligned AoE Pyro DMG and entering the "Crucible of Death and Life" state.

Crucible of Death and Life
During this time, Mavuika's various actions will no longer consume Nightsoul points, and her interruption resistance is increased. Also, the DMG dealt by Sunfell Slice and "Ancient Name Unbound"'s Normal and Charged Attacks is increased based on the amount of Fighting Spirit she has when using the Elemental Burst.
Crucible of Death and Life will be canceled when Mavuika leaves the field.
talents.descriptionId:
Bisikan hati anak manusia mencapai takhta suci di langit sana.
Elemental Burst Mavuika tidak bergantung kepada Energy, tetapi bergantung kepada "Fighting Spirit"

Fighting Spirit
Saat memiliki setidaknya 50% Fighting Spirit, Mavuika dapat mengonsumsi seluruh Fighting Spirit untuk melancarkan Elemental Burst.
Mavuika dapat memperoleh Fighting Spirit dengan cara berikut ini:
·Saat berada dalam kondisi bertempur, poin Nightsoul yang dikonsumsi oleh Karakter sekitar di dalam party akan dikonversi menjadi Fighting Spirit.
·Saat Normal Attack Karakter sekitar di dalam party mengenai musuh, Mavuika akan mendapatkan 1,5 Fighting Spirit, efek ini dapat terpicu sekali setiap 0,1 detik.

Setelah dilancarkan, Mavuika akan mendapatkan 10 poin Nightsoul dan memasuki status Nightsoul's Blessing, mengendarai Flamestrider dan melompat tinggi ke angkasa, lalu melancarkan satu kali Sunfell Slice yang kuat terhadap musuh di permukaan tanah, mengakibatkan Nightsoul-aligned Pyro DMG Area, juga memasuki status "Crucible of Death and Life".

Crucible of Death and Life
Selama berlangsung, berbagai tindakan Mavuika tidak akan mengonsumsi poin Nightsoul dan akan meningkatkan ketahanannya terhadap interupsi. Selain itu, saat melancarkan Elemental Burst maka akan meningkatkan DMG Sunfell Slice serta DMG Normal Attack dan Charged Attack dari "Ancient Name Unbound" berdasarkan Fighting Spirit yang dimiliki saat melancarkannya.
Crucible of Death and Life akan dihapus saat Mavuika meninggalkan medan pertempuran.

passives.name: Gift of Flaming Flowers
passives.description: When a nearby party member triggers a Nightsoul Burst, Mavuika's ATK increases by 30% for 10s.
passives.descriptionId: Saat anggota party di sekitar memicu Nightsoul Burst, ATK Mavuika meningkat 30% selama 10 detik.

passives.name: "Kiongozi"
passives.description: After using her Elemental Burst, Hour of Burning Skies, every point of Fighting Spirit present when it is used increases the DMG that the current active party member deals by 0.2%. The maximum increase obtainable this way is 40%, and this effect lasts 20s, decaying over this duration until it reaches 0.
passives.descriptionId: Setelah melancarkan Elemental Burst Hour of Burning Skies, DMG yang diakibatkan Karakter aktif dalam party akan meningkat 0,2% untuk setiap 1 poin Fighting Spirit yang dikonsumsi. Peningkatan DMG maksimum yang bisa didapatkan dengan cara ini adalah 40%. Efek ini berlangsung 20 detik dan akan berkurang perlahan selama durasinya hingga mencapai 0.

passives.name: Night Realm's Gift: Exhaust Mode
passives.description:
After Nightsoul points have been fully depleted, Mavuika will switch to using Phlogiston to maintain the All-Fire Armaments' Flamestrider form.
While in an area with Phlogiston Mechanics within Natlan, Nightsoul Transmission: Mavuika can be used. When the current active character is sprinting, climbing, swimming, in movement modes caused by certain Talents, or at a certain height in the air, switching to Mavuika will trigger the following: Mavuika enters the Nightsoul's Blessing state and obtains 50% of her maximum Nightsoul points. Nightsoul Transmission can be triggered once every 10s by your own party.
passives.descriptionId:
Setelah poin Nightsoul habis terpakai, Mavuika akan mengonsumsi Phlogiston untuk mempertahankan bentuk Flamestrider dari All-Fire Armaments.
Saat ada area dengan Phlogiston Mechanic di Natlan, dapat melancarkan Nightsoul Transmission: Mavuika. Saat Karakter aktif sedang berlari, memanjat, berenang, atau sedang bergerak yang dikarenakan oleh Talenta tertentu, atau saat melayang di ketinggian tertentu, dan mengganti Karakter menjadi Mavuika, akan memicu efek: Mavuika memasuki status Nightsoul's Blessing dan mendapatkan poin Nightsoul sebesar 50% poin Nightsoul maksimumnya. Party sendiri dapat memicu satu kali Nightsoul Transmission sekali setiap 10 detik.

passives.name: Night-Shattering Radiance
passives.description: The party's Nightsoul Transmission CD is decreased by 20%.
passives.descriptionId: CD Nightsoul Transmission party berkurang 20%.

constellations.name: The Night-Lord's Explication
constellations.description:
Mavuika's maximum Nightsoul points are increased to 120, and she gains Fighting Spirit 25% more efficiently.
Additionally, she gains 40% ATK for 8s after gaining Fighting Spirit.
constellations.descriptionId:
Meningkatkan batas poin Nightsoul Mavuika menjadi 120 poin, efisiensi perolehan Fighting Spirit meningkat 25%.
Selain itu, setelah mendapatkan Fighting Spirit, ATK Mavuika meningkat 40% selama 8 detik.

constellations.name: The Ashen Price
constellations.description:
When in the Nightsoul's Blessing State, Mavuika's Base ATK is increased by 200, and she obtains the following effects based on All-Fire Armaments' form:
· Ring of Searing Radiance: Nearby opponents' DEF is decreased by 20%.
· Flamestrider: Mavuika's Normal Attacks, Charged Attacks, and her Sunfell Slice from the Elemental Burst Hour of Burning Skies deal 60%, 90%, and 120% of her ATK as increased DMG respectively.
constellations.descriptionId:
Saat berada dalam status Nightsoul's Blessing, Base ATK Mavuika meningkat 200 poin. Memperoleh efek yang berbeda berdasarkan bentuk All-Fire Armaments:
·Ring of Searing Radiance: DEF musuh di sekitar berkurang 20%.
·Flamestrider: DMG yang disebabkan Normal Attack, Charged Attack, dan Sunfell Slice dari Elemental Burst Hour of Burning Skies milik Mavuika meningkat sebesar 60%/90%/120% berdasarkan dari ATK Mavuika.

constellations.name: The Burning Sun
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Hour of Burning Skies by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.descriptionId:
Meningkatkan 3 level Elemental Burst Hour of Burning Skies.
Maksimum: Lv. 15.

constellations.name: The Leader's Resolve
constellations.description:
Enhances the effects of the Ascension Talent "Kiongozi":
The DMG increase gained after using the Elemental Burst Hour of Burning Skies will not decay over time, and an additional 10% DMG Bonus will be gained.
You must first unlock the Ascension Talent "Kiongozi."
constellations.descriptionId:
Meningkatkan efek dari Talenta Ascension "Kiongozi":
Efek peningkatan DMG setelah melancarkan Elemental Burst Hour of Burning Skies tidak akan berkurang seiring waktu, dan akan mendapatkan 10% DMG Bonus tambahan.
Harus membuka Talenta Ascension "Kiongozi" terlebih dahulu.

constellations.name: The Meaning of Truth
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of The Named Moment by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.descriptionId:
Meningkatkan 3 level Elemental Skill The Named Moment.
Maksimum: Lv. 15.

constellations.name: "Humanity's Name" Unfettered
constellations.description:
The All-Fire Armaments from the Elemental Skill The Named Moment receive all-round improvements:
· Ring of Searing Radiance: When the Ring's attacks hit opponents, a Flamestrider will crash into the struck opponent, dealing 200% of ATK as Nightsoul-aligned AoE Pyro DMG.
· Flamestrider: When Mavuika is riding the Flamestrider, she will also summon a Scorching Ring of Searing Radiance to follow her, which will decrease nearby opponents' DEF by 20% and deal 500% of ATK as Nightsoul-aligned AoE Pyro DMG to nearby opponents once every 3s. Mavuika's terrain-crossing abilities will also be further improved.

Additionally, when Mavuika is riding her Flamestrider and is not in combat, when her Nightsoul points drop to 5, she will gain 80 Nightsoul points. This effect can trigger once every 15s.
constellations.descriptionId:
All-Fire Armaments dari Elemental Skill The Named Moment mendapatkan penguatan total:
·Ring of Searing Radiance: Saat serangan Ring of Searing Radiance mengenai musuh, satu Flamestrider akan menabrak musuh yang terkena dan mengakibatkan Nightsoul-aligned Pyro DMG Area sebesar 200% ATK.
·Flamestrider: Saat Mavuika mengendarai Flamestrider, akan bisa memanggil Scorching Ring of Searing Radiance yang akan terus mengikutinya, membuat DEF musuh di sekitar berkurang 20%, dan setiap 3 detiknya, mengakibatkan satu kali Nightsoul-aligned Pyro DMG Area sebesar 500% ATK terhadap musuh di sekitar. Kemampuan Mavuika untuk melewati berbagai medan juga akan meningkat lebih jauh.

Selain itu, saat Mavuika mengendarai Flamestrider dan tidak berada dalam kondisi bertempur, saat poin Nightsoul Mavuika turun menjadi 5 poin, akan mendapatkan 80 poin Nightsoul. efek ini dapat terpicu sekali setiap 15 detik.

name: Mona
title: Astral Reflection
description: A mysterious young astrologer who proclaims herself to be "Astrologist Mona Megistus," and who possesses abilities to match the title. Erudite, but prideful.
descriptionId: Seorang astrolog yang menyebut dirinya sendiri sebagai "Mona si Astrolog Hebat", dan memiliki kemampuan yang sesuai dengan julukannya. Kepandaiannya setara dengan keangkuhannya.

talents.name: Ripple of Fate
talents.description:
Normal Attack
Performs up to 4 water splash attacks that deal Hydro DMG.

Charged Attack
Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to deal AoE Hydro DMG after a short casting time.

Plunging Attack
Gathering the might of Hydro, Mona plunges towards the ground from mid-air, damaging all opponents in her path. Deals AoE Hydro DMG upon impact with the ground.
talents.descriptionId:
Normal Attack
Melancarkan hingga 4 serangan air yang mengakibatkan Hydro DMG.

Charged Attack
Mengonsumsi sejumlah Stamina untuk mengakibatkan Hydro DMG area setelah jeda singkat.

Plunging Attack
Mengumpulkan kekuatan Hydro dan menerjang tanah, menyerang musuh di jalur terjangan dan mengakibatkan Hydro DMG area saat mendarat.

talents.name: Mirror Reflection of Doom
talents.description:
Creates an illusory Phantom of Fate from coalesced waterspouts.

Phantom
Has the following special properties:
·Continuously taunts nearby opponents, attracting their fire.
·Continuously deals Hydro DMG to nearby opponents.
·When its duration expires, the Phantom explodes, dealing AoE Hydro DMG.

Hold
Utilizes water currents to move backwards swiftly before conjuring a Phantom.

Only one Phantom created by Mirror Reflection of Doom can exist at any time.
talents.descriptionId:
Menciptakan bayangan ilusi nasib dari bunga air.

Bayangan tersebut memiliki karakteristik sebagai berikut:
·Terus-menerus menarik perhatian musuh di sekitar.
Terus-menerus mengakibatkan Hydro DMG kepada musuh di sekitar.
·Saat durasinya habis, bayangan akan meledak, mengakibatkan Hydro DMG area.

Tahan
Memanfaatkan arus air untuk bergerak mundur dengan cepat sebelum memanggil bayangan.

Hanya satu bayangan saja yang dapat dibuat oleh Mirror Reflection of Doom kapan pun juga.

talents.name: Stellaris Phantasm
talents.description:
Mona summons the sparkling waves and creates a reflection of the starry sky, applying the Illusory Bubble status to opponents in a large AoE.

Illusory Bubble
Traps opponents inside a pocket of destiny and also makes them Wet. Renders weaker opponents immobile.
When an opponent affected by Illusory Bubble sustains DMG, it has the following effects:
·Applies an Omen to the opponent, which gives a DMG Bonus, also increasing the DMG of the attack that causes it.
·Removes the Illusory Bubble, dealing Hydro DMG in the process.

Omen
During its duration, increases DMG taken by opponents.
talents.descriptionId:
Mona menciptakan gelombang air yang memantulkan cahaya langit penuh bintang, menyebabkan efek Illusory Bubble pada musuh dalam area yang besar.

Illusory Bubble
Mengurung musuh di dalam gelembung bintang dan menyebabkan efek Wet. Musuh yang lebih lemah akan terkurung dan tidak bisa bergerak.
Saat musuh dalam gelembung terkena DMG, akan muncul efek berikut:
·Menyebabkan efek Omen pada musuh, yang akan meningkatkan DMG yang diterima, dan juga meningkatkan DMG serangan yang memicu efek ini;
·Illusory Bubble akan pecah dan mengakibatkan Hydro DMG.

Omen
Meningkatkan DMG yang diterima musuh selama durasi Omen.

passives.name: "Come 'n' Get Me, Hag!"
passives.description:
After she has used Illusory Torrent for 2s, if there are any opponents nearby, Mona will automatically create a Phantom.
A Phantom created in this manner lasts for 2s, and its explosion DMG is equal to 50% of Mirror Reflection of Doom.
passives.descriptionId:
Jika ada musuh di sekitar, Mona akan menciptakan sebuah bayangan setelah menggunakan Illusory Torrent selama 2 detik.
Bayangan yang dibuat dengan cara ini dapat bertahan selama 2 detik, dan DMG ledakannya setara dengan 50% DMG Mirror Reflection of Doom.

passives.name: Waterborne Destiny
passives.description: Increases Mona's Hydro DMG Bonus by a degree equivalent to 20% of her Energy Recharge rate.
passives.descriptionId: Meningkatkan Hydro DMG Bonus Mona sebesar 20% dari Energy Recharge.

passives.name: Principium of Astrology
passives.description: When Mona crafts Weapon Ascension Materials, she has a 25% chance to refund a portion of the crafting materials used.
passives.descriptionId: Mona memiliki 25% kemungkinan untuk mendapatkan kembali material yang digunakan saat membuat Material Ascension Senjata.

constellations.name: Prophecy of Submersion
constellations.description:
When any of your own party members hits an opponent affected by an Omen, the effects of Hydro-related Elemental Reactions are enhanced for 8s:
· Electro-Charged DMG increases by 15%, Lunar-Charged DMG increases by 15%, Vaporize DMG increases by 15%, Hydro Swirl DMG increases by 15%, Lunar-Crystallize DMG increases by 15%.
· Frozen duration is extended by 15%.
constellations.descriptionId:
Setelah serangan Karakter sendiri di dalam party mengenai musuh yang berada dalam status Omen, efek dari reaksi terkait Hydro diperkuat selama 8 detik:
·DMG Electro Charged meningkat 15%. ·DMG Lunar-Charged meningkat 15%. DMG Vaporize meningkat 15%. DMG Hydro Swirl meningkat 15%. DMG reaksi Lunar-Crystallize meningkat 15%.
·Durasi Frozen diperpanjang 15%.

constellations.name: Lunar Chain
constellations.description:
When a Normal Attack hits, there is a 20% chance that it will be automatically followed by a Charged Attack.
This effect can only occur once every 5s.
constellations.descriptionId:
Saat Normal Attack mengenai musuh, memiliki 20% persentase untuk melancarkan Charged Attack.
Dapat terpicu setiap 5 detik.

constellations.name: Restless Revolution
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Stellaris Phantasm by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.descriptionId:
Meningkatkan 3 level Stellaris Phantasm.
Maksimum: Lv. 15.

constellations.name: Prophecy of Oblivion
constellations.description: When any party member attacks an opponent affected by an Omen, their CRIT Rate is increased by 15%.
constellations.descriptionId: Saat anggota party menyerang musuh yang terkena efek Omen, CRIT Rate akan meningkat 15%.

constellations.name: Mockery of Fortuna
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Mirror Reflection of Doom by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.descriptionId:
Meningkatkan 3 level Mirror Reflection of Doom.
Maksimum: Lv. 15.

constellations.name: Rhetorics of Calamitas
constellations.description:
Upon entering Illusory Torrent, Mona gains a 60% increase to the DMG of her next Charged Attack per second of movement.
A maximum DMG Bonus of 180% can be achieved in this manner. The effect lasts for no more than 8s.
constellations.descriptionId:
Saat dalam kondisi Illusory Torrent setiap 1 detik gerakan, Charged Attack Mona meningkat 60%,
Bonus DMG maksimum yang bisa didapatkan dengan cara ini adalah 180%, efek ini berlangsung selama 8 detik.

name: Mualani
title: Splish-Splash Wavechaser
description: A well-known guide in Natlan who owns a watersports shop, and expert in all forms of wave-chasing.
descriptionId: Pemandu yang sudah terkenal di seantero Natlan, merupakan pemilik toko olahraga air, merupakan ahli dalam berbagai jenis berselancar ombak.

talents.name: Cooling Treatment
talents.description:
Normal Attack
Performs up to 3 attacks that deal Hydro DMG.

Charged Attack
Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to smack a Pufferball into the air that deals AoE Hydro DMG upon landing.

Plunging Attack
Gathers the power of Hydro and plunges towards the ground from mid-air, damaging all opponents in her path. Deals AoE Hydro DMG upon impact with the ground.
talents.descriptionId:
Normal Attack
Melancarkan hingga 3 serangan yang mengakibatkan Hydro DMG.

Charged Attack
Mengonsumsi sejumlah Stamina untuk melemparkan Pufferball ke udara yang bisa mengakibatkan Hydro DMG Area saat mendarat.

Plunging Attack
Mengumpulkan kekuatan Hydro dan menerjang tanah, menyerang musuh di jalur terjangan dan mengakibatkan Hydro DMG Area saat mendarat di tanah.

talents.name: Surfshark Wavebreaker
talents.description:
Combining her mastery of speed and the waves and water, Mualani can surf anytime, anywhere.
After using this skill, Mualani will gain 60 Nightsoul points and enter the Nightsoul's Blessing state.

Nightsoul's Blessing: Mualani
Continuously consume Nightsoul points. When they are depleted or when the skill is used again, Mualani's Nightsoul's Blessing will end. The state itself has the following traits:
·Mualani mounts her Sharky Surfboard, increasing Mualani's Movement SPD and interruption resistance. Mualani can move on water and liquid Phlogiston while this state is active, and she will take no DMG from the latter.
·Normal Attacks will be converted to Sharky's Bites, dealing Nightsoul-aligned Hydro DMG based on Mualani's Max HP. Sharky's Bites can be used in mid-air. DMG dealt this way is considered Normal Attack DMG.
·When she makes contact with opponents in this state, Mualani applies "Marked as Prey" to them and gains 1 Wave Momentum stack. Max 3 stacks. 1 stack can be gained from the same opponent every 0.7s.

Wave Momentum and Marked as Prey
When Mualani uses Sharky's Bite, her DMG dealt increases based on Wave Momentum stacks. When she has 3 stacks, Sharky's Bite will be converted to Sharky's Surging Bite, further increasing her DMG and removing all her stacks when hitting an opponent.
When Sharky's Bite hits an opponent Marked as Prey, that mark will be removed, and she will fire Shark Missiles at up to 5 nearby opponents Marked as Prey, dealing DMG to them equal to this Sharky's Bite instance and clearing their Marks. If more than 1 opponent is the target of Sharky's Bite and Shark Missiles, the DMG dealt will decrease, decreasing at most to 72% of the original DMG when 3 opponents are targeted.
talents.descriptionId:
Dengan kemampuan mengendalikan kecepatan dan mengendarai ombak, Mualani bisa berselancar kapan pun dan di mana pun.
Setelah dilancarkan, Mualani akan mendapatkan 60 poin Nightsoul dan memasuki status Nightsoul's Blessing.

Nightsoul's Blessing: Mualani
Terus mengonsumsi poin Nightsoul. Saat sudah habis dikonsumsi atau saat dilancarkan sekali lagi, Nightsoul's Blessing Mualani akan berakhir. Nightsoul's Blessing memiliki karakteristik sebagai berikut:
·Saat menaiki Sharky Surfboard, meningkatkan Movement SPD Mualani dan ketahanannya terhadap interupsi. Dalam status ini, Mualani akan bisa bergerak di atas permukaan air dan di dalam Phlogiston berwujud cairan, dalam kondisi ini Mualani tidak akan menerima DMG dari Phlogiston cair.
·Saat melancarkan Normal Attack, akan mengubahnya menjadi Sharky's Bites yang mengakibatkan Hydro DMG dengan atribut Nightsoul berdasarkan Max HP Mualani. Sharky's Bites bisa dilancarkan saat melayang di udara, dan DMG yang diakibatkan akan dianggap sebagai DMG Normal Attack.
·Saat menyentuh musuh dalam kondisi ini, Mualani akan memberikan "Marked as Prey" kepada musuh dan mendapatkan 1 lapis Wave Momentum. Wave Momentum dapat ditumpuk sampai 3 lapis. Setiap 0,7 detik, Mualani dapat memperoleh 1 lapis Momentum Wave dari 1 musuh yang sama.

Wave Momentum dan Marked as Prey
Saat melancarkan Sharky's Bite, DMG Mualani akan meningkat berdasarkan jumlah lapisan Wave Momentum yang dimiliki. Saat memiliki 3 lapis Wave Momentum, Normal Attack-nya akan dikonversi menjadi Sharky's Surging Bite yang mengakibatkan DMG yang lebih kuat; Saat mengenai musuh, akan menghapus semua lapisan Wave Momentum setelahnya.
Saat Sharky's Bite mengenai musuh yang terkena Marked as Prey, akan menghapus status tersebut dari musuh yang bersangkutan, dan menembakkan Shark Missile terhadap maksimum 5 musuh di sekitar yang berada dalam status Marked as Prey tersebut, mengakibatkan DMG yang sama dengan DMG Sharky's Bite kali ini, dan menghapus status Marked as Prey dari seluruh musuh-musuh tersebut. Jika musuh target Sharky's Bite dan Sharky Missile kali ini berjumlah lebih dari 1 target, maka DMG yang diakibatkan akan berkurang, dengan maksimum mengakibatkan 72% DMG awal jika ada 3 musuh yang menjadi target.

talents.name: Boomsharka-laka
talents.description: Fires a Super Shark Missile that can track opponents, dealing Nightsoul-aligned AoE Hydro DMG based on Mualani's Max HP.
talents.descriptionId: Menembakkan Super Shark Missile yang bisa mengejar musuh, mengakibatkan Hydro DMG Area dengan atribut Nightsoul berdasarkan Max HP Mualani.

passives.name: Heat-Resistant Freshwater Floater
passives.description: When Sharky's Surging Bite hits an opponent, a Puffer will be generated nearby. Mualani will restore 20 Nightsoul points when she picks up a Puffer. Only 2 such Puffers can be created in this way during a single instance of being in Nightsoul's Blessing.
passives.descriptionId: Saat Sharky's Surging Bite mengenai musuh, akan menghasilkan satu Puffer di sekitar. Saat mengambil Puffer, Mualani akan memulihkan 20 poin Nightsoul. Dalam satu kali durasi Nightsoul's Blessing, maksimum 2 Puffer yang bisa dihasilkan dengan cara seperti ini.

passives.name: Natlan's Greatest Guide
passives.description: After a nearby party member triggers a Nightsoul Burst, Mualani will gain 1 stack of Wavechaser's Exploits, which lasts for 20s. Max 3 stacks. When she uses Boomsharka-laka, Mualani will clear all Wavechaser's Exploits stacks and increase the DMG of this Boomsharka-laka by 15%/30%/45% of her Max HP based on the number of stacks cleared.
passives.descriptionId: Setelah anggota party di sekitar memicu Nightsoul Burst, Mualani mendapatkan 1 lapis Wavechaser's Exploits yang bertahan 20 detik dan dapat ditumpuk sampai 3 lapis. Saat melancarkan Boomsharka-laka, Mualani akan membersihkan seluruh lapisan Wavechaser's Exploit dan akan meningkatkan DMG yang diakibatkan Boomsharka-laka kali ini berdasarkan 15%/30%/45% Max HP Mualani.

passives.name: Night Realm's Gift: Crests and Troughs
passives.description:
After her Nightsoul points are depleted, Mualani will switch to consuming Phlogiston to maintain her Nightsoul's Blessing.
While in an area with Phlogiston Mechanics within Natlan, she can use Nightsoul Transmission: Mualani. When the active character is currently sprinting, swimming, in a movement mode caused by certain Talents, or at a certain height in the air, the following will trigger when switching to Mualani: Mualani will enter the Nightsoul's Blessing state and gain 40 Nightsoul points. Nightsoul Transmission can be triggered once every 10s by your own team.

Additionally, Mualani's Nightsoul point or Phlogiston consumption while moving on water and Liquid Phlogiston during Nightsoul's Blessing is decreased by 75% while in Natlan, and her Nightsoul point consumption is decreased by 35% while doing the same outside Natlan.
passives.descriptionId:
Setelah Nightsoul habis terkonsumsi, Mualani akan mengonsumsi Phlogiston untuk mempertahankan status Nightsoul's Blessing-nya.
Saat berada di lokasi yang memiliki Phlogiston Mechanic di Natlan, Mualani bisa melancarkan Nightsoul Transmission: Mualani. Saat Karakter aktif sedang berlari, berenang, atau sedang bergerak yang dikarenakan oleh Talenta tertentu, atau saat melayang di ketinggian tertentu, dan mengganti Karakter menjadi Mualani, akan memicu efek: Mualani akan memasuki status Nightsoul's Blessing dan mendapatkan 40 poin Nightsoul. Nightsoul Transmission party sendiri dapat terpicu sekali setiap 10 detik.

Selain itu, saat Mualani bergerak di permukaan air dan Phlogiston cair, dalam status Nightsoul's Blessing: Nightsoul atau Phlogiston yang dikonsumsi di area Natlan berkurang sebesar 75%, tapi di area selain Natlan akan berkurang sebesar 35%.

passives.name: The Trick Is to Keep Smiling!
passives.description: While in an area with Phlogiston Mechanics within Natlan, 15 Phlogiston will be restored when interacting with some harvestable items. Additionally, the location of nearby resources unique to Natlan will appear on your mini-map.
passives.descriptionId: Saat ada area dengan Phlogiston Mechanic di Natlan, berinteraksi dengan item tertentu yang bisa dikumpulkan, akan memulihkan 15 poin Phlogiston. Selain ini, akan menunjukkan posisi Produk Khas Natlan yang ada di sekitar pada peta kecil.

constellations.name: The Leisurely "Meztli"...
constellations.description:
The DMG dealt by the first Sharky's Surging Bite after Mualani enters Nightsoul's Blessing and the Shark Missiles it triggers is increased by 66% of Mualani's Max HP. This instance of increased DMG is subject to the diminishing DMG rules of Surfshark Wavebreaker.
In addition, while out of combat, Mualani's Nightsoul's Blessing state consumes 30% less Phlogiston and Nightsoul points.
constellations.descriptionId:
DMG yang disebabkan dari Sharky's Surging Bite pertama setelah Mualani memasuki Nightsoul's Blessing dan Shark Missile yang terpicu olehnya meningkat sebesar 66% Max HP Mualani. Peningkatan DMG kali ini mengikuti ketentuan pengurangan DMG Surfshark Wavebreaker.
Selain itu, saat tidak berada dalam kondisi bertempur, konsumsi poin Nightsoul dan Phlogiston Mualani saat berada dalam status Nightsoul's Blessing berkurang 30%.

constellations.name: Mualani, Going All Out!
constellations.description:
Mualani gains 2 of Surfshark Wavebreaker's Wave Momentum stacks when she enters Nightsoul's Blessing state. She will gain 1 stack when obtaining a Puffer.
In addition, whenever Mualani obtains 2 Puffers within a single instance of the Nightsoul's Blessing state, she will recover an additional 12 Nightsoul points over 2s. You must first unlock the Ascension Talent "Heat-Resistant Freshwater Floater."
constellations.descriptionId:
Saat dalam status Nightsoul's Blessing, Mualani mendapatkan 2 lapis Wave Momentum dari Surfshark Wavebreaker. Saat Mualani mendapatkan Puffer, akan mendapatkan 1 lapis Wave Momentum.
Selain itu, dalam 2 detik setelah Mualani mendapatkan 2 Puffer dalam satu kali status Nightsoul Blessing, dia akan memulihkan 12 poin Nightsoul. Efek ini harus membuka Talenta Ascension "Heat-Resistant Freshwater Floater" terlebih dahulu.

constellations.name: Surfing Atop Joyous Seas
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Surfshark Wavebreaker by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.descriptionId:
Meningkatkan 3 level Surfshark Wavebreaker.
Maksimum: Lv. 15.

constellations.name: Sharky Eats Puffies
constellations.description:
Mualani regenerates 8 Energy when obtaining a Puffer. You must first unlock the Ascension Talent "Heat-Resistant Freshwater Floater."
Additionally, Boomsharka-laka deals 75% increased DMG.
constellations.descriptionId:
Saat mendapatkan Puffer, Mualani akan memulihkan 8 poin Energy. Efek ini harus membuka Talenta Ascension "Heat-Resistant Freshwater Floater" terlebih dahulu.
Selain itu, DMG Boomsharka-laka meningkat 75%.

constellations.name: Same Style of Surfboard on Sale!
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Boomsharka-laka by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.descriptionId:
Meningkatkan 3 level Boomsharka-laka.
Maksimum: Lv. 15.

constellations.name: Spirit of the Springs' People
constellations.description: The DMG increase from the Constellation "The Leisurely 'Meztli'..." is no longer limited to being triggered once every Nightsoul's Blessing.
constellations.descriptionId: Efek peningkatan DMG Konstelasi "The Leisurely 'Meztli'..." tidak terbatas pada satu kali terpicu saja untuk setiap kali Nightsoul's Blessing.

name: Nahida
title: Physic of Purity
description: A caged bird secluded within the confines of the Sanctuary of Surasthana who can only see the world in her dreams.
descriptionId: Seorang gadis yang dikurung bak burung di dalam sangkar Sanctuary of Surasthana, hanya bisa melihat dunia dari dalam mimpi.

talents.name: Akara
talents.description:
Normal Attack
Performs up to 4 attacks that deal Dendro DMG to opponents in front of her.

Charged Attack
Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to deal AoE Dendro DMG to opponents in front of her after a short casting time.

Plunging Attack
Calling upon the might of Dendro, Nahida plunges towards the ground from mid-air, damaging all opponents in her path. Deals AoE Dendro DMG upon impact with the ground.
talents.descriptionId:
Normal Attack
Melancarkan hingga 4 serangan ke area depan, yang mengakibatkan Dendro DMG.

Charged Attack
Mengonsumsi sejumlah Stamina untuk mengakibatkan Dendro DMG area setelah jeda singkat.

Plunging Attack
Mengumpulkan kekuatan Dendro dan menerjang tanah, menyerang musuh di jalur terjangan dan mengakibatkan Dendro DMG area saat mendarat.

talents.name: All Schemes to Know
talents.description:
Sends forth karmic bonds of wood and tree from her side, dealing AoE Dendro DMG and marking up to 8 opponents hit with the Seed of Skandha.
When held, this skill will trigger differently.

Hold
Enters Aiming Mode, which will allow you to select a limited number of opponents within a limited area. During this time, Nahida's resistance to interruption will be increased.
When released, this skill deals Dendro DMG to these opponents and marks them with the Seed of Skandha.
Aiming Mode will last up to 5s and can select a maximum of 8 opponents.

Seed of Skandha
Opponents who have been marked by the Seed of Skandha will be linked to one another up till a certain distance.
After you trigger Elemental Reactions on opponents who are affected by the Seeds of Skandha or when they take DMG from Dendro Cores (including Burgeon and Hyperbloom DMG), Nahida will unleash Tri-Karma Purification on the opponents and all connected opponents, dealing Dendro DMG based on her ATK and Elemental Mastery.
You can trigger at most 1 Tri-Karma Purification within a short period of time.
talents.descriptionId:
Melepaskan belenggu karma dari kayu dan pepohonan di sekitarnya dan mengakibatkan Dendro DMG Area, serta memberikan status Seed of Skandha terhadap musuh yang terkena serangan, maksimal hingga 8 musuh.
Saat ditahan, akan melancarkan serangan dengan cara yang berbeda.

Tahan
Memasuki Mode Membidik untuk memilih sejumlah musuh dalam jarak tertentu dan meningkatkan ketahanan Nahida terhadap interupsi saat Nahida berada dalam status ini.
Saat Mode Tahan selesai, akan mengakibatkan Dendro DMG terhadap musuh yang terpilih dan menambahkan Seed of Skandha kepada mereka.
Mode Membidik bertahan maksimal selama 5 detik, dan bisa memilih hingga maksimal 8 musuh.

Seed of Skandha
Musuh yang berada dalam status ini akan saling terhubung jika berada di dalam jarak tertentu.
Setelah memicu reaksi elemental terhadap musuh yang berada dalam status ini, atau setelah musuh ini menerima DMG yang diakibatkan oleh Dendro Core (termasuk Burgeon dan Hyperbloom), Nahida akan melancarkan Tri-Karma Purification terhadap musuh ini dan semua musuh yang terhubung, dan mengakibatkan Dendro DMG berdasarkan ATK dan Elemental Mastery Nahida.
Tri-Karma Purification hanya bisa terpicu sekali dalam waktu singkat.

talents.name: Illusory Heart
talents.description:
Manifests the Court of Dreams and expands the Shrine of Maya.

When the Shrine of Maya field is unleashed, the following effects will be separately unleashed based on the Elemental Types present within the party.
·Pyro: While Nahida remains within the Shrine of Maya, the DMG dealt by Tri-Karma Purification from "All Schemes to Know" is increased.
·Electro: While Nahida remains within the Shrine of Maya, the interval between each Tri-Karma Purification from "All Schemes to Know" is decreased.
·Hydro: The Shrine of Maya's duration is increased.

If there are at least 2 party members of the aforementioned Elemental Types present when the field is deployed, the aforementioned effects will be increased further.

Even if Nahida is not on the field, these bonuses will still take effect so long as party members are within the Shrine of Maya.
talents.descriptionId:
Memanifestasikan Court of Dreams dan membentuk medan Shrine of Maya.

Saat medan Shrine of Maya dilancarkan, efek berikut akan diperoleh sesuai dengan jenis elemen Karakter di dalam party.
·Pyro: Saat Nahida berada di dalam Shrine of Maya, akan meningkatkan DMG Tri-Karma Purification dari Elemental Skill "All Schemes to Know";
·Electro: Saat Nahida berada di dalam Shrine of Maya, akan mengurangi jeda waktu terpicunya Tri-Karma Purification dari Elemental Skill "All Schemes to Know";
·Hydro: Meningkatkan durasi Shrine of Maya.

Saat membentuk medan, jika Karakter dengan elemen yang disebutkan di atas berjumlah 2 atau lebih, maka efek yang terpicu akan ditingkatkan lebih lanjut.

Saat Nahida ada di dalam party namun tidak berada di medan pertempuran, asalkan party ini berada dalam Shrine of Maya, akan tetap memperoleh peningkatan efek yang disebutkan di atas.

passives.name: Compassion Illuminated
passives.description:
When unleashing Illusory Heart, the Shrine of Maya will gain the following effects:
The Elemental Mastery of the active character within the field will be increased by 25% of the Elemental Mastery of the party member with the highest Elemental Mastery.
You can gain a maximum of 250 Elemental Mastery in this manner.
passives.descriptionId:
Saat melancarkan Illusory Heart, Shrine of Maya akan mendapatkan efek sebagai berikut:
Meningkatkan Elemental Mastery Karakter aktif yang berada di dalam medan Shrine of Maya sebesar 25% dari Karakter yang memiliki Elemental Mastery tertinggi di dalam party.
Elemental Mastery yang bisa diperoleh dengan cara ini maksimal hingga 250 poin Elemental Mastery.

passives.name: Awakening Elucidated
passives.description:
Each point of Nahida's Elemental Mastery beyond 200 will grant 0.1% Bonus DMG and 0.03% CRIT Rate to Tri-Karma Purification from All Schemes to Know.
A maximum of 80% Bonus DMG and 24% CRIT Rate can be granted to Tri-Karma Purification in this manner.
passives.descriptionId:
Untuk setiap 1 poin Elemental Mastery Nahida yang di atas 200 poin, akan membuat DMG Tri-Karma Purification yang diakibatkan oleh All Schemes to Know meningkat 0,1%, CRIT Rate meningkat 0,03%.
Peningkatan DMG Tri-Karma Purification yang bisa diperoleh dengan cara ini maksimal adalah 80% dan peningkatan CRIT Rate maksimal adalah 24%.

passives.name: On All Things Meditated
passives.description:
Nahida can use All Schemes to Know to interact with some harvestable items within a fixed AoE.
This skill may even have some other effects...
passives.descriptionId:
Nahida bisa berinteraksi dengan sebagian tanaman dalam area tertentu melalui All Schemes to Know.
Mungkin masih ada efek yang lain ....

constellations.name: The Seed of Stored Knowledge
constellations.description: When the Shrine of Maya is unleashed and the Elemental Types of the party members are being tabulated, the count will add 1 to the number of Pyro, Electro, and Hydro characters respectively.
constellations.descriptionId: Saat membentuk Shrine of Maya dan melakukan perhitungan terhadap jumlah Karakter berelemen tertentu di dalam party, akan menambahkan perhitungan Karakter berelemen Pyro, Electro, dan Hydro masing-masing sebanyak 1 orang.

constellations.name: The Root of All Fullness
constellations.description:
Opponents that are marked by Seeds of Skandha applied by Nahida herself will be affected by the following effects:
· Burning, Bloom, Hyperbloom, and Burgeon Reaction DMG they receive can score CRIT Hits. CRIT Rate and CRIT DMG are fixed at 20% and 100% respectively. CRIT Rate from this effect stacks with CRIT Rate from similar effects that allow these Elemental Reactions to CRIT.
· Within 8s of being affected by Quicken, Aggravate, or Spread, DEF is decreased by 30%.
· The CRIT Rate and CRIT DMG of Lunar-Bloom DMG received are increased by 10% and 20% respectively.
constellations.descriptionId:
Musuh yang berada dalam status Seed of Skandha yang diberikan oleh Nahida akan mendapatkan pengaruh efek sebagai berikut:
·DMG reaksi Burning, Bloom, Hyperbloom, dan Burgeon yang diterimanya akan bisa mengakibatkan CRIT, dengan nilai CRIT Rate tetap sebesar 20% dan CRIT DMG tetap sebesar 100%. CRIT Rate dari efek ini dapat ditumpuk dengan efek serupa lainnya yang membuat Reaksi Elemental dapat mengakibatkan CRIT juga.
·Setelah terkena efek reaksi Quicken, Aggravate, dan Spread terpicu, DEF berkurang 30% selama 8 detik.
·CRIT Rate untuk DMG dari reaksi Lunar-Bloom meningkat 10%, dan CRIT DMG meningkat sebesar 20%.

constellations.name: The Shoot of Conscious Attainment
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of All Schemes to Know by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.descriptionId:
Meningkatkan 3 level All Schemes to Know.
Maksimum: Lv. 15.

constellations.name: The Stem of Manifest Inference
constellations.description: When 1/2/3/4 (or more) nearby opponents are affected by All Schemes to Know's Seeds of Skandha, Nahida's Elemental Mastery will be increased by 100/120/140/160.
constellations.descriptionId: Saat jumlah musuh yang berada di dalam status Seed of Skandha dari All Schemes to Know adalah 1/2/3/4 atau lebih banyak, maka Elemental Mastery Nahida akan meningkat sebesar 100/120/140/160 poin.

constellations.name: The Leaves of Enlightening Speech
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Illusory Heart by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.descriptionId:
Meningkatkan 3 level Illusory Heart.
Maksimum: Lv. 15.

constellations.name: The Fruit of Reason's Culmination
constellations.description:
When Nahida hits an opponent affected by All Schemes to Know's Seeds of Skandha with Normal or Charged Attacks after unleashing Illusory Heart, she will use Tri-Karma Purification: Karmic Oblivion on this opponent and all connected opponents, dealing Dendro DMG based on 200% of Nahida's ATK and 400% of her Elemental Mastery.
DMG dealt by Tri-Karma Purification: Karmic Oblivion is considered Elemental Skill DMG and can be triggered once every 0.2s.
This effect can last up to 10s and will be removed after Nahida has unleashed 6 instances of Tri-Karma Purification: Karmic Oblivion.
constellations.descriptionId:
Setelah melancarkan Illusory Heart, saat Normal Attack atau Charged Attack Nahida mengenai musuh yang berada dalam status Seed of Skandha dari All Schemes to Know, akan melancarkan Tri-Karma Purification: Karmic Oblivion terhadap musuh ini dan seluruh musuh yang terhubung, mengakibatkan Dendro DMG sebesar 200% ATK dan 400% Elemental Mastery Nahida.
DMG yang diakibatkan Tri-Karma Purification: Karmic Oblivion akan dianggap sebagai DMG Elemental Skill dan dapat terpicu 0,2 detik sekali.
Efek ini bisa bertahan selama 10 detik, dan akan hilang setelah Nahida melancarkan 6 kali Tri-Karma Purification: Karmic Oblivion.

name: Navia
title: Helm of the Radiant Rose
description: The current President of Spina di Rosula, who is lovely, dutiful, and a great boss.
descriptionId: Ketua Spina di Rosula, bos yang cantik, baik, dan bertanggung jawab.

talents.name: Blunt Refusal
talents.description:
Normal Attack
Performs up to 4 consecutive strikes.

Charged Attack
Drains Stamina over time to perform continuous spinning attacks against all nearby opponents.
At the end of the sequence, performs a more powerful slash.

Plunging Attack
Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground below, damaging opponents along the path and dealing AoE DMG upon impact.
talents.descriptionId:
Normal Attack
Melancarkan hingga 4 tebasan berturut-turut.

Charged Attack
Terus menguras Stamina untuk melancarkan serangan berputar yang mengakibatkan DMG ke musuh di sekitar.
Diakhiri dengan sebuah tebasan yang kuat.

Plunging Attack
Menerjang dari udara untuk menghantam tanah, menyerang musuh di jalur terjangan dan mengakibatkan DMG Area saat mendarat.

talents.name: Ceremonial Crystalshot
talents.description:
When a character in the party obtains an Elemental Shard created from the Crystallize reaction, or when they trigger the Lunar-Crystallize reaction, Navia will gain 1 Crystal Shrapnel stack. Navia can have up to 6 stacks of Crystal Shrapnel at once. Each time Crystal Shrapnel gain is triggered, the duration of the Crystal Shrapnel stacks you already have will be reset. Through the Lunar-Crystallize reaction, Navia will gain up to 1 Crystal Shrapnel stack every second.
When she fires, Navia will consume all Crystal Shrapnel stacks and open her elegant yet lethal Gunbrella, firing multiple Rosula Shardshots that can penetrate opponents, dealing Geo DMG to opponents hit.
When 0/1/2/3 or more stacks of Crystal Shrapnel are consumed, 5/7/9/11 Rosula Shardshots will be fired respectively. The more Rosula Shardshots that strike a single opponent, the greater the DMG dealt to them. When all 11 Rosula Shardshots strike, 200% of the original amount of DMG is dealt.
In addition, when more than 3 stacks of Crystal Shrapnel are consumed, every stack consumed beyond those 3 will increase the DMG dealt by this Gunbrella attack by an additional 15%.

Hold
Enter Aiming Mode, continually collecting nearby Elemental Shards created by Crystallize reactions. When released, fire Rosula Shardshots with the same effect as when the skill is Tapped.

Two initial charges.

Arkhe: Ousia
Periodically, when Navia fires her Gunbrella, a Surging Blade will be summoned, dealing Ousia-aligned Geo DMG.
talents.descriptionId:
Saat Karakter dalam party mendapatkan shard dari reaksi Crystallize atau memicu reaksi Lunar-Crystallize, Navia akan mendapatkan 1 "Crystal Shrapnel", dan maksimum bisa mendapatkan hingga 6 Crystal Shrapnel. Setiap kali perolehan Crystal Shrapnel terpicu, durasi Crystal Shrapnel yang sudah dimiliki akan diulang. Maksimum 1 Crystal Shrapnel yang bisa didapatkan oleh Navia per detik melalui reaksi Lunar-Crystallize.
Saat dilancarkan, Navia akan mengonsumsi semua Crystal Shrapnel yang dimiliki dan membuka Gunbrella elegannya untuk menembakkan beberapa Rosula Shardshot yang dapat menembus musuh dan mengakibatkan Geo DMG.
Saat mengonsumsi 0/1/2/3 atau lebih "Crystal Shrapnel", maka 5/7/9/11 Rosula Shardshot akan ditembakkan sesuai dengan jumlah yang ditentukan. Semakin banyak Rosula Shardshot yang mengenai satu musuh, semakin tinggi pula DMG yang diakibatkan terhadap musuh tersebut. Saat semua 11 Rosula Shardshot mengenai satu target, akan mengakibatkan DMG sebesar 200% dari DMG awal.
Selain itu, saat mengonsumsi lebih dari 3 Crystal Shrapnel, setiap Crystal Shrapnel yang dikonsumsi selain 3 Crystal Shrapnel tersebut akan meningkatkan DMG tembakan kali ini lagi sebesar 15%. 

Mode Tahan
Memasuki Mode Membidik dan terus mendapatkan shard dari reaksi Crystallize di sekitar. Saat Mode Tahan selesai, akan menembakkan Rosula Shardshot yang sama dengan Mode Tekan.

Memiliki 2 kali jumlah penggunaan di awal.

Arkhe: Ousia
Setiap kurun waktu tertentu, Navia akan melancarkan Surging Blade saat menembak dengan Gunbrella-nya dan mengakibatkan Ousia-aligned Geo DMG.

talents.name: As the Sunlit Sky's Singing Salute
talents.description:
On the orders of the President of the Spina di Rosula, call for a magnificent Rosula Dorata Salute. Unleashes a massive cannon bombardment on opponents in front of her, dealing AoE Geo DMG and providing Cannon Fire Support for a duration afterward, periodically dealing Geo DMG to nearby opponents.
When cannon attacks hit opponents, Navia will gain 1 stack of Crystal Shrapnel. This effect can be triggered up to once every 2.4s.
talents.descriptionId:
Di bawah perintah Bos Spina di Rosula, memanggil "Rosula Dorata Salute" yang menawan untuk membombardir musuh di depan dengan ganas, mengakibatkan Geo DMG Area, dan dalam beberapa waktu setelahnya, akan terus melancarkan Cannon Fire Support yang mengakibatkan Geo DMG terhadap musuh di sekitar secara berkala.
Saat serangan meriam mengenai musuh, Navia akan mendapatkan 1 "Crystal Shrapnel". Efek ini dapat terpicu sekali setiap 2,4 detik.

passives.name: Undisclosed Distribution Channels
passives.description: For 4s after using Ceremonial Crystalshot, the DMG dealt by Navia's Normal Attacks, Charged Attacks, and Plunging Attacks will be converted into Geo DMG which cannot be overridden by other Elemental infusions, and the DMG dealt by Navia's Normal Attacks, Charged Attacks, and Plunging Attacks will be increased by 40%.
passives.descriptionId: Selama 4 detik setelah melancarkan Ceremonial Crystalshot, DMG yang diakibatkan dari Normal Attack, Charged Attack, dan Plunging Attack oleh Navia akan dikonversi menjadi Geo DMG yang tidak bisa ditimpa Elemental Infusion lainnya. DMG yang diakibatkan dari Normal Attack, Charged Attack, dan Plunging Attack oleh Navia akan meningkat 40%.

passives.name: Mutual Assistance Network
passives.description: For each Pyro/Electro/Cryo/Hydro party member, Navia gains 20% increased ATK. This effect can stack up to 2 times.
passives.descriptionId: Untuk setiap Karakter Pyro/Electro/Cryo/Hydro yang ada di dalam party, ATK Navia akan meningkat sebesar 20%. Efek ini dapat ditumpuk hingga 2 lapis.

passives.name: Painstaking Transaction
passives.description: Gains 25% more rewards when dispatched on a Fontaine Expedition for 20 hours.
passives.descriptionId: Ketika dikirim untuk melakukan ekspedisi di Fontaine selama 20 jam, hadiah yang didapatkan akan bertambah 25%.

constellations.name: A Lady's Rules for Keeping a Courteous Distance
constellations.description: Each stack of Crystal Shrapnel consumed when Navia uses Ceremonial Crystalshot will restore 3 Energy to her and decrease the CD of As the Sunlit Sky's Singing Salute by 1s. Up to 9 Energy can be gained this way, and the CD of "As the Sunlit Sky's Singing Salute" can be decreased by up to 3s.
constellations.descriptionId: Saat melancarkan Ceremonial Crystalshot, setiap "Crystal Shrapnel" yang dikonsumsi akan memulihkan 3 poin Energy Navia dan mengurangi cooldown As the Sunlit Sky's Singing Salute selama 1 detik. Maksimum pemulihan Energy yang bisa didapatkan dengan cara ini adalah 9 poin Energy, dan maksimum mengurangi cooldown "As the Sunlit Sky's Singing Salute" selama 3 detik.

constellations.name: The President's Pursuit of Victory
constellations.description:
Each stack of Crystal Shrapnel consumed will increase the CRIT Rate of this Ceremonial Crystalshot instance by 12%. CRIT Rate can be increased by up to 36% in this way.
In addition, when Ceremonial Crystalshot hits an opponent, one Cannon Fire Support shot from As the Sunlit Sky's Singing Salute will strike near the location of the hit. Up to one instance of Cannon Fire Support can be triggered each time Ceremonial Crystalshot is used, and DMG dealt by said Cannon Fire Support this way is considered Elemental Burst DMG.
constellations.descriptionId:
Saat melancarkan Ceremonial Crystalshot, setiap "Crystal Shrapnel" yang dikonsumsi akan meningkat CRIT Rate dari skill tersebut sebesar 12%. Maksimum peningkatan CRIT Rate yang dapat diperoleh dengan cara ini adalah 36%.
Selain itu, saat tembakan Ceremonial Crystalshot mengenai musuh, sebuah Cannon Fire Support dari As the Sunlit Sky's Singing Salute akan menghantam lokasi di sekitar musuh yang terkena tembakan. Setiap Ceremonial Crystalshot yang dilancarkan hanya dapat memicu satu kali Cannon Fire Support, dan DMG dari Cannon Fire Support yang diakibatkan dengan cara ini akan dianggap sebagai DMG Elemental Burst.

constellations.name: Businesswoman's Broad Vision
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Ceremonial Crystalshot by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.descriptionId:
Meningkatkan 3 level Ceremonial Crystalshot.
Maksimum: Lv. 15.

constellations.name: The Oathsworn Never Capitulate
constellations.description: When As the Sunlit Sky's Singing Salute hits an opponent, that opponent's Geo RES will be decreased by 20% for 8s.
constellations.descriptionId: Saat As the Sunlit Sky's Singing Salute mengenai musuh, Geo RES musuh tersebut akan berkurang 20% selama 8 detik.

constellations.name: Negotiator's Resolute Negotiations
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of As the Sunlit Sky's Singing Salute by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.descriptionId:
Meningkatkan 3 level As the Sunlit Sky's Singing Salute.
Maksimum: Lv. 15.

constellations.name: The Flexible Finesse of the Spina's President
constellations.description: If more than 3 stacks of Crystal Shrapnel are consumed when using Ceremonial Crystalshot, each stack consumed beyond the first 3 increases the CRIT DMG of that Ceremonial Crystalshot by 45%, and any stacks consumed beyond the first 3 are returned to Navia.
constellations.descriptionId: Saat melancarkan Ceremonial Crystalshot, jika mengonsumsi lebih dari 3 "Crystal Shrapnel", maka setiap "Crystal Shrapnel" yang terkonsumsi setelah "Crystal Shrapnel" yang ketiga akan meningkatkan CRIT DMG Ceremonial Crystalshot kali ini sebesar 45%, dan Crystal Shrapnel yang terkonsumsi setelah yang ketiga akan dikembalikan kepada Navia setelah skill dilancarkan.

name: Nefer
title: Secret Beneath the Sands
description: The remarkably resourceful owner of the Curatorium of Secrets.
descriptionId: Pemilik Curatorium of Secrets yang lihai dan penuh akal.

talents.name: Striking Serpent
talents.description:
Normal Attack
Performs up to 4 kicks that deal Dendro DMG with the ferocity and grace of a striking serpent.

Charged Attack
Nefer enters the Slither state, consuming Stamina to move rapidly forward for up to 2.5s. When the skill button is released, the duration ends, or Stamina runs out, Nefer will exit the Slither state and consume a certain amount of additional Stamina to deal Dendro DMG to opponents. When in the **Shadow Dance** state, additional Stamina consumption is decreased.
Additionally, unleashing the Elemental Skill **Senet Strategy: Dance of a Thousand Nights** or sprinting while Nefer is in the Slither state will not cause her to exit the state.

Plunging Attack
Calling upon the might of Dendro, Nefer plunges towards the ground from mid-air, damaging all opponents in her path and dealing AoE Dendro DMG upon impact with the ground.
talents.descriptionId:
Normal Attack
Melancarkan hingga 4 tendangan dengan keganasan dan keanggunan seekor ular untuk mengakibatkan Dendro DMG.

Charged Attack
Nefer memasuki status Slither dan mengonsumsi sejumlah Stamina untuk bergerak dengan cepat ke arah depan selama maksimum 2,5 detik. Saat tombol skill ini dilepas, durasinya berakhir, atau Stamina-nya habis, maka Nefer akan keluar dari status Slither dan mengonsumsi Stamina tambahan untuk mengakibatkan Dendro DMG terhadap musuh. Saat berada dalam status **Shadow Dance**, Stamina tambahan yang dikonsumsi akan berkurang.
Selain itu, saat Nefer berada dalam status Slither, melancarkan Elemental Skill **Senet Strategy: Dance of a Thousand Nights** atau berlari tidak akan membuat Nefer keluar dari status Slither.

Plunging Attack
Mengumpulkan kekuatan Dendro dan menerjang tanah, menyerang musuh di jalur terjangan dan mengakibatkan Dendro DMG Area saat mendarat.

talents.name: Senet Strategy: Dance of a Thousand Nights
talents.description:
A dance that dissolved dynasties, as chilling as a winter's night on the great sea of sand, yet lingering with the tenderness of moonlit gauze. Nefer charges forward, dealing AoE Dendro DMG and entering the **Shadow Dance** state.
While in the Shadow Dance state, if you have at least 1 **Verdant Dew**, Nefer's Charged Attacks will be replaced with the special Charged Attack **Phantasm Performance**, which will not consume Stamina. When in the Shadow Dance state, Nefer's resistance to interruption is increased.

Two initial charges.
talents.descriptionId:
Sebuah tarian memikat yang mampu meruntuhkan bangsa, lembut bagaikan kerudung cahaya bulan yang membelai mesra, juga bagaikan lautan pasir di malam dingin yang menusuk tulang. Nefer menerjang ke depan dengan jarak tertentu, mengakibatkan Dendro DMG Area, dan memasuki status **Shadow Dance**.
Saat dalam status Shadow Dance dan jika memiliki setidaknya 1 **Verdant Dew**, maka Charged Attack Nefer akan berubah menjadi Charged Attack Khusus yang tidak mengonsumsi Stamina, yaitu **Phantasm Performance**. Ketahanan Nefer terhadap interupsi juga akan meningkat saat berada dalam status Shadow Dance.

Jumlah penggunaan awal adalah 2 kali.

talents.name: Sacred Vow: True Eye's Phantasm
talents.description: Grant "revelation" to the mysteries of the false through Thoth's true sight, dealing AoE Dendro DMG to opponents ahead. When unleashed, Nefer will consume all **Veils of Falsehood** to increase the DMG dealt by the current Elemental Burst.
talents.descriptionId:
Memberikan "penglihatan" untuk misteri yang berdusta melalui penglihatan Thoth, mengakibatkan Dendro DMG Area terhadap musuh di depan.
Saat dilancarkan, Nefer akan mengonsumsi seluruh **Veil of Falsehood** yang dimilikinya untuk meningkatkan DMG Elemental Burst kali ini.

passives.name: A Wager of Moonlight
passives.description:
Nefer will be granted the corresponding buff effects based on the party's Moonsign.

Moonsign: Ascendant Gleam: When she unleashes her Elemental Skill **Senet Strategy: Dance of a Thousand Nights**, any Dendro Cores on the field will be converted to Seeds of Deceit, and any Lunar-Bloom reactions triggered by nearby characters in the following 15s that would create Dendro Cores or Bountiful Cores will instead create Seeds of Deceit. Seeds of Deceit cannot trigger Hyperbloom or Burgeon reactions and will not burst.
When Nefer unleashes a Charged Attack or **Phantasm Performance**, she can absorb Seeds of Deceit within a certain range, gaining 1 stack of **Veil of Falsehood** for every seed absorbed. When this effect reaches 3 stacks, or when the third stack's duration is refreshed, Nefer's Elemental Mastery will be increased by 100 for 8s.
passives.descriptionId:
Nefer mendapatkan efek penguatan berdasarkan Moonsign party.

Moonsign: Ascendant Gleam: Saat melancarkan Elemental Skill **Senet Strategy: Dance of a Thousand Nights**, Dendro Core di medan pertempuran akan dikonversi menjadi Seed of Deceit, dan reaksi Lunar-Bloom yang dipicu oleh seluruh Karakter di sekitar dalam 15 detik selanjutnya akan menghasilkan Seed of Deceit sebagai ganti Dendro Core dan Bountiful Core. Seed of Deceit tidak dapat memicu reaksi Hyperbloom dan Burgeon, juga tidak dapat meledak.
Saat Nefer melancarkan Charged Attack atau **Phantasm Performance**, ia akan menyerap Seed of Deceit yang ada di sekitar dalam jarak tertentu. Untuk setiap Seed of Deceit yang diserapnya, Nefer akan mendapatkan satu lapis efek **Veil of Falsehood**. Saat efek ini ditumpuk sampai 3 lapis atau saat durasi 3 lapis diperbarui, Elemental Mastery Nefer meningkat 100 poin selama 8 detik.

passives.name: Daughter of the Dust and Sand
passives.description: When Nefer is in the **Shadow Dance** state, for 5s after a party member triggers a Lunar-Bloom reaction, Nefer's **Slither** state will provide additional **Verdant Dew**. Every 100 points of Nefer's Elemental Mastery beyond 500 will strengthen this additional provision effect by 10%. The maximum increase that can be achieved this way is 50%.
passives.descriptionId: Saat Nefer berada dalam status **Shadow Dance**, dan jika Karakter di dalam party memicu reaksi Lunar-Bloom dalam kurun waktu 5 detik, maka status **Slither** Nefer akan memberikan **Verdant Dew** tambahan untuk party. Untuk setiap 100 poin Elemental Mastery Nefer di atas angka 500, efek pemberian Verdant Dew akan meningkat 10%, hingga maksimum 50%.

passives.name: Moonsign Benediction: Dusklit Eaves
passives.description:
When a party member triggers a Bloom reaction, it will be converted into the Lunar-Bloom reaction, with every point of Elemental Mastery that Nefer has increasing Lunar-Bloom's Base DMG by 0.0175%, up to a maximum of 14%.

Additionally, when Nefer is in the party, the party's Moonsign will increase by 1 level.
passives.descriptionId:
Saat Karakter di dalam party memicu reaksi Bloom, akan dikonversi menjadi reaksi Lunar-Bloom. DMG dasar reaksi Lunar-Bloom meningkat berdasarkan Elemental Mastery Nefer. Setiap poin Elemental Mastery akan membuat DMG dasar reaksi Lunar-Bloom meningkat 0,0175%, hingga maksimum 14%.

Selain itu saat Nefer berada di dalam party, Moonsign party meningkat 1 level.

passives.name: Conspiracy of the Golden Vault
passives.description: Gains 25% more rewards when dispatched on a Nod-Krai Expedition for 20 hours.
passives.descriptionId: Ketika dikirim untuk melakukan ekspedisi di Nod-Krai selama 20 jam, hadiah yang didapatkan akan bertambah 25%.

constellations.name: Planning Breeds Success
constellations.description: The Base DMG for Lunar-Bloom reactions caused by Nefer's **Phantasm Performance** is increased by 60% of her Elemental Mastery. This effect is also boosted by **Veil of Falsehood**.
constellations.descriptionId: DMG dasar reaksi Lunar-Bloom yang diakibatkan oleh **Phantasm Performance** meningkat sebesar 60% Elemental Mastery Nefer. Efek ini tetap terpengaruh oleh bonus **Veil of Falsehood**.

constellations.name: Observation Feeds Strategy
constellations.description:
Enhances the effects of the Ascension Talent **A Wager of Moonlight**: Extends **Veil of Falsehood**'s duration by 5s, and increases its stack limit to 5, as well as causing **Phantasm Performance** to deal up to 140% of its original DMG. When Nefer unleashes her Elemental Skill **Senet Strategy: Dance of a Thousand Nights**, she will instantly gain 2 stacks of Veil of Falsehood. Additionally, when Veil of Falsehood reaches 5 stacks, or when the fifth stack's duration is refreshed, Nefer's Elemental Mastery will be increased by 200 for 8s instead.
You must first unlock the Ascension Talent "A Wager of Moonlight."
constellations.descriptionId:
Talenta Ascension **A Wager of Moonlight** diperkuat: Durasi **Veil of Falsehood** diperpanjang 5 detik, batas lapisan meningkat menjadi 5 lapis, dan dapat mengakibatkan maksimum 140% DMG **Phantasm Performance** dari DMG awalnya. Saat melancarkan Elemental Skill **Senet Strategy: Dance of a Thousand Nights**, Nefer langsung mendapatkan 2 lapis Veil of Falsehood. Selain itu, saat Veil of Falsehood ditumpuk sampai 5 lapis atau saat durasi 5 lapis diperbarui, Elemental Mastery Nefer akan meningkat 200 poin selama 8 detik.
Harus membuka Talenta Ascension "A Wager of Moonlight" terlebih dahulu.

constellations.name: Deceit Cloaks the Truth
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of **Senet Strategy: Dance of a Thousand Nights** by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.descriptionId:
Meningkatkan 3 level Elemental Skill **Senet Strategy: Dance of a Thousand Nights**.
Maksimum: Lv. 15.

constellations.name: Delusion Ensnares Reason
constellations.description:
When Nefer is on the field and in the **Shadow Dance** state, you will gain Verdant Dew 25% faster.
Additionally, while Nefer is in the Shadow Dance state, nearby opponents will have their Dendro RES decreased by 20%. When Nefer exits the Shadow Dance state or after she strays a certain distance away from the opponents, this effect will be removed after 4.5s.
constellations.descriptionId:
Saat Nefer berada di medan pertempuran dan berada dalam status **Shadow Dance**, kecepatan memulihkan Verdant Dew meningkat 25%.
Selain itu, saat Nefer dalam status Shadow Dance, Dendro RES musuh di sekitar berkurang 20%. Saat Nefer tidak berada dalam status Shadow Dance atau setelah menjauh dari musuh dalam jarak tertentu, efek ini akan hilang 4,5 detik setelahnya.

constellations.name: Opportunity Hides in the Margins
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of **Sacred Vow: True Eye's Phantasm** by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.descriptionId:
Meningkatkan 3 level Elemental Burst **Sacred Vow: True Eye's Phantasm**.
Maksimum: Lv. 15.

constellations.name: Victory Flows from the Turning of Tides
constellations.description:
When Nefer unleashes **Phantasm Performance**, the second stage of DMG dealt by herself will be converted to deal AoE Dendro DMG equal to 85% of her Elemental Mastery. Additionally, when the attacks from Phantasm Performance end, an extra instance of AoE Dendro DMG equal to 120% of Nefer's Elemental Mastery will be dealt. All of the aforementioned DMG is considered Lunar-Bloom DMG dealt by Phantasm Performance.

Moonsign: Ascendant Gleam
Nefer's Lunar-Bloom DMG is **elevated** by 15%.
constellations.descriptionId:
Saat Nefer melancarkan **Phantasm Performance**, DMG tahap 2 milik dirinya sendiri akan dikonversi menjadi Dendro DMG Area sebesar 85% Elemental Mastery Nefer. Selain itu, saat serangan Phantasm Performance berakhir, akan mengakibatkan 1 kali Dendro DMG Area sebesar 120% Elemental Mastery Nefer. Semua DMG yang disebutkan di atas dianggap sebagai DMG Lunar-Bloom dari Phantasm Performance.

Moonsign: Ascendant Gleam: DMG reaksi Lunar-Bloom **bertumbuh** 15%.

name: Neuvillette
title: Ordainer of Inexorable Judgment
description: The Chief Justice of Fontaine, known as the Iudex, is renowned for his unassailable impartiality.
descriptionId: Hakim Agung Fontaine yang bergelar Iudex. Terkenal karena selalu adil dan tidak berpihak.

talents.name: As Water Seeks Equilibrium
talents.description:
Normal Attack
With light flourishes, Neuvillette commands the tides to unleash a maximum of 3 attacks, dealing Hydro DMG.

Charged Attack Empowerment: Legal Evaluation
While charging up, Neuvillette will gather the power of water, forming it into a Seal of Arbitration. In this state, Neuvillette can move and change facing, and also absorb any Sourcewater Droplets in a certain AoE.
Every Droplet he absorbs will increase the formation speed of the Seal, and will heal Neuvillette.
When the charging is stopped, if the Symbol has yet to be formed, then a Charged Attack will be unleashed. If it has been formed, then a Charged Attack: Equitable Judgment will be unleashed.

Charged Attack
Consumes a fixed amount of Stamina to attack opponents with a rupturing blast of water, dealing AoE Hydro DMG.

Charged Attack: Equitable Judgment
Unleashes surging torrents, dealing continuous AoE Hydro DMG to all opponents in a straight-line area in front of him.
Equitable Judgment will not consume any Stamina and lasts 3s.
If Neuvillette's HP is above 50%, he will continuously lose HP while using this attack.

Plunging Attack
Gathering the might of Hydro, Neuvillette plunges towards the ground from mid-air, damaging all opponents in his path. Deals AoE Hydro DMG upon impact with the ground.
talents.descriptionId:
Normal Attack
Mengayunkan tongkat dengan ringan dan memerintahkan ombak untuk melancarkan maksimum 3 serangan berturut-turut dan mengakibatkan Hydro DMG.

Charged Attack Empowerment: Legal Evaluation
Saat melakukan charge, Neuvillette akan mengumpulkan kekuatan air, dan membentuknya menjadi Seal of Arbitration secara perlahan. Saat berada dalam status ini, Neuvillette dapat bergerak dan mengubah arah pergerakannya, juga dapat menyerap Sourcewater Droplet dalam radius area tertentu.
Untuk setiap Sourcewater Droplet yang diserap, pembentukan Seal of Arbitration akan dipercepat dan akan memulihkan HP Neuvillette.
Setelah Charge dihentikan, jika Seal of Arbitration masih belum terbentuk secara sempurna, maka Neuvillette akan melancarkan Charged Attack; Jika sudah terbentuk sempurna, maka serangannya akan dikonversi menjadi Charged Attack: Equitable Judgment.

Charged Attack
Mengonsumsi sejumlah Stamina, menyerang musuh dengan cincin air ganas dan mengakibatkan Hydro DMG Area.

Charged Attack: Equitable Judgment
Melancarkan ombak ganas dan terus-menerus mengakibatkan Hydro DMG Area terhadap musuh yang berada di dalam area garis lurus di depan.
Charged Attack: Equitable Judgment tidak akan mengonsumsi Stamina dan berlangsung selama 3 detik.
Jika HP Neuvillette berada di atas 50%, maka akan terus-menerus mengonsumsi HP Neuvillette saat dilancarkan.

Plunging Attack
Mengumpulkan kekuatan Hydro dan menerjang dari udara untuk menghantam tanah di bawahnya, menyerang musuh di jalur terjangan dan mengakibatkan Hydro DMG Area saat mendarat.

talents.name: O Tears, I Shall Repay
talents.description:
Summons a Raging Waterfall that will deal AoE Hydro DMG to opponents in front of Neuvillette based on his Max HP. After hitting an opponent, this skill will generate 3 Sourcewater Droplets near that opponent.

Arkhe: Pneuma
At certain intervals, when the Raging Waterfall descends, a Spiritbreath Thorn will descend that will pierce opponents, dealing Pneuma-aligned Hydro DMG.
talents.descriptionId:
Memanggil Raging Waterfall yang mengakibatkan Hydro DMG Area berdasarkan Max HP Neuvillette terhadap musuh yang berada di depan. Setelah mengenai musuh, akan menciptakan 3 Sourcewater Droplet di sekitar musuh.

Arkhe: Pneuma
Setiap satu kurun waktu tertentu, setelah Raging Waterfall diturunkan, Spiritbreath Thorn yang dapat menembus musuh dan mengakibatkan Pneuma-aligned Hydro DMG akan diturunkan.

talents.name: O Tides, I Have Returned
talents.description: Unleashes waves that will deal AoE Hydro DMG based on Neuvillette's Max HP. After a short interval, 2 waterfalls will descend and deal Hydro DMG in a somewhat smaller AoE, and will generate 6 Sourcewater Droplets within an area in front.
talents.descriptionId: Melancarkan gelombang ganas yang mengakibatkan Hydro DMG Area berdasarkan Max HP Neuvillette. Setelah jeda singkat, 2 Waterfall akan turun di sekitar dan mengakibatkan Hydro DMG dengan radius area yang relatif kecil dan menciptakan 6 Sourcewater Droplet di dalam area di hadapan Neuvillette.

passives.name: Heir to the Ancient Sea's Authority
passives.description:
When a party member triggers a Vaporize, Frozen, Electro-Charged, Lunar-Charged, Bloom, Lunar-Bloom, Hydro Swirl, Hydro Crystallize or a Lunar-Crystallize reaction on opponents, 1 stack of Past Draconic Glories will be granted to Neuvillette for 30s. Max 3 stacks. Past Draconic Glories causes Charged Attack: Equitable Judgment to deal 110%/125%/160% of its original DMG.
The stacks of Past Draconic Glories created by each kind of Elemental Reaction exist independently.
passives.descriptionId:
Saat Karakter di dalam party memicu reaksi Vaporize, Frozen, Electro-Charged, Lunar-Charged, Bloom, Lunar-Bloom, Hydro Swirl, Hydro Crystallize, atau Lunar-Crystallize terhadap musuh, Neuvillette akan mendapat satu lapis efek "Past Draconic Glories" selama 30 detik, efek ini dapat ditumpuk sampai 3 lapis. Efek Past Draconic Glories akan meningkatkan DMG Charged Attack: Equitable Judgment menjadi 110%/125%/160% dari DMG awalnya.
Setiap lapis efek Past Draconic Glories yang dihasilkan oleh masing-masing Reaksi Elemental dihitung secara terpisah.

passives.name: Discipline of the Supreme Arbitration
passives.description: For each 1% of Neuvillette's current HP greater than 30% of Max HP, he will gain 0.6% Hydro DMG Bonus. A maximum bonus of 30% can be obtained this way.
passives.descriptionId: Untuk setiap 1% HP Neuvillette di atas 30% Max HP-nya saat ini, Neuvillette akan mendapatkan 0,6% Hydro DMG Bonus, maksimum 30% peningkatan yang bisa diperoleh dengan cara ini.

passives.name: Gather Like the Tide
passives.description:
Increases underwater Sprint SPD for your own party members by 15%.
Not stackable with Passive Talents that provide the exact same effects.
passives.descriptionId:
Meningkatkan 15% Movement SPD Karakter dalam party sendiri saat berenang cepat di bawah air.
Efek ini tidak dapat ditumpuk dengan Talenta Pasif lain dengan efek yang sama persis.

constellations.name: Venerable Institution
constellations.description:
