When Neuvillette takes the field, he will obtain 1 stack of Past Draconic Glories from the Ascension Talent "Heir to the Ancient Sea's Authority." You must first unlock the Ascension Talent "Heir to the Ancient Sea's Authority."
Additionally, his interruption resistance will be increased while using the Charged Attack Empowerment: Legal Evaluation and the Charged Attack: Equitable Judgment.
constellations.descriptionId:
Saat Neuvillette memasuki medan pertempuran, mendapatkan satu lapis Past Draconic Glories dari Talenta Ascension "Heir to the Ancient Sea's Authority". Harus membuka Talenta Ascension "Heir to the Ancient Sea's Authority" terlebih dahulu.
Selain itu, saat melancarkan Charged Attack Empowerment: Legal Evaluation dan Charged Attack: Equitable Judgment, ketahanan Neuvillette terhadap interupsi akan meningkat.

constellations.name: Juridical Exhortation
constellations.description:
The Ascension Talent "Heir to the Ancient Sea's Authority" will be enhanced: Each stack of Past Draconic Glories will increase the CRIT DMG of Charged Attack: Equitable Judgment by 14%. The maximum increase that can be achieved this way is 42%.
You must first unlock the Ascension Talent "Heir to the Ancient Sea's Authority."
constellations.descriptionId:
Talenta Ascension "Heir to the Ancient Sea's Authority" mendapatkan penguatan: Untuk setiap lapis Past Draconic Glories yang dimiliki, akan meningkatkan CRIT DMG Charged Attack: Equitable Judgment sebesar 14%, peningkatan maksimum yang bisa diperoleh dengan cara ini adalah 42%.
Harus membuka Talenta Ascension "Heir to the Ancient Sea's Authority" terlebih dahulu.

constellations.name: Ancient Postulation
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Normal Attack: As Water Seeks Equilibrium by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.descriptionId:
Meningkatkan 3 level Normal Attack: As Water Seeks Equilibrium.
Maksimum: Lv. 15.

constellations.name: Crown of Commiseration
constellations.description: When Neuvillette is on the field and is healed, 1 Sourcewater Droplet will be generated. This effect can occur once every 4s.
constellations.descriptionId: Saat Neuvillette menerima pemulihan di medan pertempuran, 1 Sourcewater Droplet akan terbentuk. Efek ini dapat terpicu sekali setiap 4 detik.

constellations.name: Axiomatic Judgment
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of O Tides, I Have Returned by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.descriptionId:
Meningkatkan 3 level O Tides, I Have Returned.
Maksimum: Lv. 15.

constellations.name: Wrathful Recompense
constellations.description:
When using Charged Attack: Equitable Judgment, Neuvillette can absorb nearby Sourcewater Droplets in an AoE. Each absorbed Droplet will increase the duration of Charged Attack: Equitable Judgment by 1s.
Additionally, when Equitable Judgment hits opponents, it will fire off 2 additional currents every 2s, each of which will deal 10% of Neuvillette's Max HP as Hydro DMG. DMG dealt this way will count as DMG dealt by Equitable Judgment.
constellations.descriptionId:
Saat melancarkan Charged Attack: Equitable Judgment, Neuvillette dapat menyerap Sourcewater Droplet yang berada di sekitarnya dalam radius tertentu. Untuk setiap Sourcewater Droplet yang diserap, akan meningkatkan durasi Charged Attack: Equitable Judgment selama 1 detik.
Selain itu, saat Charged Attack: Equitable Judgment mengenai musuh, akan melancarkan dua serangan gelombang air setiap 2 detik. Setiap gelombang airnya akan mengakibatkan Hydro DMG sebesar 10% Max HP Neuvillette. DMG yang diakibatkan dengan cara ini akan dianggap sebagai DMG Charged Attack: Equitable Judgment.

name: Nicole
title: Clamor Within
description: The Silent "Mage," the Voiceless "Angel."
descriptionId: "Penyihir" yang Membisu, "Malaikat" Tanpa Suara.

talents.name: Allegoria
talents.description:
Normal Attack
Proclaims a decree in the primordial tongue and performs up to 3 attacks that deal Pyro DMG.

Charged Attack
Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to deal AoE Pyro DMG to opponents in front of her after a short casting time.

Plunging Attack
Nicole plunges towards the ground from mid-air, damaging all opponents in her path. Also deals AoE Pyro DMG upon impact with the ground.
talents.descriptionId:
Normal Attack
Memberikan perintah dengan bahasa purba untuk melancarkan hingga 3 serangan dan mengakibatkan Pyro DMG.

Charged Attack
Mengonsumsi sejumlah Stamina untuk mengakibatkan Pyro DMG Area ke area di depannya setelah jeda singkat.

Plunging Attack
Menerjang tanah dan menyerang musuh di jalur terjangan dan mengakibatkan Pyro DMG Area saat mendarat.

talents.name: Revelation: Uncreated Light
talents.description:
Recreates a fleeting glimpse of an age long past, when the angels acted on the authority of the heavens, bestowing the **Grace of Kenosis****** effect on nearby party members. This increases their ATK and deals AoE Pyro DMG, as well as creates a Shield of Blazing Light.
The Shield of Blazing Light's DMG Absorption is based on Nicole's ATK, and it will absorb Pyro DMG at 250% effectiveness.
talents.descriptionId:
Memanifestasikan bayangan kekuasaan langit masa lalu, memberikan efek ******Grace of Kenosis** kepada seluruh anggota party di sekitar yang akan meningkatkan ATK Karakter-Karakter tersebut, mengakibatkan Pyro DMG Area, dan menciptakan Shield of Blazing Light.
Ketahanan DMG Shield of Blazing Light bergantung pada ATK Nicole dan memiliki 250% pertahanan terhadap Pyro DMG.

talents.name: Revelation: Ladder of Divine Ascent
talents.description:
As Nicole weaves the path of anchored fate with golden threads of light, she deals AoE Pyro DMG and switches to Silent Contemplation mode.
In this mode, when nearby active party members hit an opponent, an Arcane Projection is summoned to perform a Coordinated Attack against the opponent, dealing AoE Elemental DMG of the character's corresponding Elemental Type. This DMG scales based on the corresponding character's ATK and will be considered as having been dealt by them.
This effect can occur once every 3s, and can be triggered up to 4 times each time Nicole switches to Silent Contemplation mode.

It is worth noting that Hexerei characters' Arcane Projections appear to differ somehow in appearance from the others...
talents.descriptionId:
Menenun jalan takdir yang tertambat dengan benang emas dari langit, Nicole mengakibatkan Pyro DMG Area, dan beralih ke mode "Silent Contemplation".
Saat Nicole berada dalam mode ini, ketika serangan Karakter aktif di sekitar dalam party mengenai musuh, Arcane Projection akan dipanggil untuk melancarkan serangan terkoordinasi terhadap musuh. Serangan ini akan mengakibatkan Elemental DMG Area yang sesuai berdasarkan jenis elemen Karakter tersebut. DMG ini didasarkan pada ATK Karakter tersebut, dan juga dianggap sebagai DMG yang diakibatkan oleh Karakter tersebut.
Efek ini dapat terpicu maksimum sekali setiap 3 detik dan dapat terpicu hingga 4 kali setiap kali Nicole beralih ke mode Silent Contemplation.

Selain itu, Arcane Projection dari Karakter Hexerei sepertinya akan memiliki tampilan visual yang berbeda ....

passives.name: Methexis
passives.description:
For 20s after unleashing the Elemental Skill **Revelation: Uncreated Light**, Nicole will continuously "observe" the other current active party members. After the observed character has remained on the field for 3s, their **Grace of Kenosis** is upgraded to **Guidance of Theosis**, increasing their ATK by an additional 300. If the observed character is a Hexerei character, Grace of Kenosis is upgraded to Guidance of Theosis straight away.
When characters other than Nicole who have Guidance of Theosis leave the field, their effect reverts to Grace of Kenosis.
passives.descriptionId:
Selama 20 detik setelah melancarkan Elemental Skill **Revelation: Uncreated Light**, Nicole akan terus "mengobservasi" Karakter aktif lain dalam party. Setelah Karakter yang diobservasi berada di medan pertempuran selama 3 detik, efek **Grace of Kenosis** miliknya akan meningkat menjadi **Guidance of Theosis** dan memberikan tambahan 300 poin ATK. Jika Karakter yang diobservasi adalah Karakter Hexerei, maka efek Grace of Kenosis akan langsung ditingkatkan menjadi Guidance of Theosis.
Selain Nicole, Guidance of Theosis yang dimiliki Karakter lain akan langsung kembali menjadi Grace of Kenosis saat Karakter itu meninggalkan medan pertempuran.

passives.name: Philokalia
passives.description: When Elemental DMG from nearby active party members hits an opponent, Nicole's own **Grace of Kenosis** effect is upgraded to **Guidance of Theosis** for 8s.
passives.descriptionId: Saat Elemental DMG anggota party aktif di sekitar mengenai musuh, **Grace of Kenosis** yang dimiliki Nicole sendiri akan meningkat menjadi **Guidance of Theosis** selama 8 detik.

passives.name: Nepsis
passives.description:
When you are in Teyvat and not in combat, Nicole's Charged Attack becomes "Emissarial Guidance" if you have already obtained the current region's Treasure Compass. Emissarial Guidance: Calls upon nearby Seelie to show the way, triggering an effect similar to the region's Treasure Compass.
This effect has a cooldown time of 5 seconds and does not work in Domains, Trounce Domains, and the Spiral Abyss.
passives.descriptionId:
Saat tidak dalam kondisi bertempur dan sudah memperoleh Treasure Compass untuk area yang sedang dijelajahi di Teyvat, Charged Attack Nicole akan dikonversi menjadi "Emissarial Guidance": Memanggil Seelie terdekat untuk memberi petunjuk, memicu efek yang sama dengan Treasure Compass untuk area tersebut.
Efek ini memiliki cooldown selama 5 detik, dan tidak berlaku di Domain, Domain Trounce, dan Spiral Abyss.

constellations.name: "Do Not Be Afraid, Child Who Is Loved"
constellations.description:
When the current active character of your own in the party hits an opponent, an additional special "Arcane Projection: Unity" will be summoned to perform a Coordinated Attack against the opponent, dealing AoE Elemental DMG of the character's corresponding Elemental Type at 600% of their ATK. This DMG will be considered as having been dealt by the corresponding character.
This effect can trigger once every 6s.
constellations.descriptionId:
Saat serangan Karakter aktif sendiri di party mengenai musuh, akan memanggil "Arcane Projection: Unity" spesial tambahan untuk melancarkan serangan terkoordinasi terhadap musuh. Serangan ini akan mengakibatkan Elemental DMG Area yang sesuai dengan jenis elemen Karakter tersebut dan DMG-nya didasarkan pada 600% ATK Karakter tersebut, dan dianggap sebagai DMG yang diakibatkan oleh Karakter tersebut.
Efek ini dapat terpicu sekali setiap 6 detik.

constellations.name: "I Will Guide You and Show You the Path You Should Tread"
constellations.description:
Enhances the effects of the Elemental Skill **Revelation: Uncreated Light**: **Grace of Kenosis** increases ATK by an additional 300 (which does not count toward this effect's ATK Bonus limit), while **Guidance of Theosis** decreases nearby opponents' Elemental RES based on the corresponding character's Elemental Type by 25%. This effect does not stack for the same Element.
Additionally, when Nicole unleashes her Elemental Skill Revelation: Uncreated Light, nearby active party members will also gain a Shield of Blazing Light.
constellations.descriptionId:
Efek Elemental Skill **Revelation: Uncreated Light** diperkuat: **Grace of Kenosis** juga akan meningkatkan ATK sebesar 300 poin tambahan (tidak termasuk dalam batas maksimum peningkatan ATK efek ini), **Guidance of Theosis** juga akan mengurangi Elemental RES musuh di sekitar sebesar 25% berdasarkan jenis elemen Karakter, efek pengurangan Elemental RES dari jenis elemen yang sama tidak dapat ditumpuk.
Selain itu, saat Nicole melancarkan Elemental Skill Revelation: Uncreated Light, Karakter aktif di sekitar akan mendapatkan Shield of Blazing Light.

constellations.name: "A Lamp by Your Side, A Light to Shine the Way"
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of **Revelation: Uncreated Light** by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.descriptionId:
Meningkatkan 3 level Elemental Skill **Revelation: Uncreated Light**.
Maksimum: Lv. 15.

constellations.name: "Whether Left or Right, No Matter Which Way You Turn"
constellations.description:
When nearby party members have their **Grace of Kenosis** upgraded to **Guidance of Theosis**, Nicole also bestows upon them the Pathfinder's Blessing effect for 20s. Each character can gain this effect once every 16s.
The Normal Attack, Charged Attack, Plunging Attack, Elemental Skill, and Elemental Burst DMG of characters with Pathfinder's Blessing is increased by 70% of Nicole's ATK. This effect will be removed once it has taken effect 8 times or when its duration is over.
When multiple opponents are hit at once, instances of Pathfinder's Blessing are consumed equal to the number of opponents hit. Each character's Pathfinder's Blessing is counted independently.
constellations.descriptionId:
Saat efek **Grace of Kenosis** yang dimiliki Karakter party di sekitar Nicole meningkat menjadi **Guidance of Theosis**, Nicole juga akan memberikan efek "Pathfinder's Blessing" kepada mereka selama 20 detik. Setiap Karakter dapat memperoleh efek ini maksimum satu kali setiap 16 detik.
Saat memiliki Pathfinder's Blessing, DMG yang diakibatkan oleh Normal Attack, Charged Attack, Plunging Attack, Elemental Skill, dan Elemental Burst Karakter akan meningkat sebesar 70% dari ATK Nicole. Efek ini akan berakhir setelah terpicu 8 kali atau saat durasinya berakhir.
Saat mengenai beberapa musuh sekaligus, jumlah terpicunya efek akan mengikuti jumlah musuh yang terkena. Jumlah terpicunya efek Pathfinder's Blessing untuk setiap Karakter party dihitung secara terpisah.

constellations.name: "You Will Hear My Voice Beside You"
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of **Revelation: Ladder of Divine Ascent** by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.descriptionId:
Meningkatkan 3 level Elemental Burst **Revelation: Ladder of Divine Ascent**.
Maksimum: Lv. 15.

constellations.name: "This Is the Path, Walk It Without Delay"
constellations.description:
When Nicole's **Grace of Kenosis** is upgraded to **Guidance of Theosis**, all nearby party members' Grace of Kenosis will also be upgraded to Guidance of Theosis. Once upgraded, Guidance of Theosis will no longer revert to Grace of Kenosis.
Additionally, DMG dealt by characters with Guidance of Theosis will ignore 40% of opponents' DEF.
constellations.descriptionId:
Saat **Grace of Kenosis** yang dimiliki Nicole meningkat menjadi **Guidance of Theosis**, Grace of Kenosis yang dimiliki seluruh anggota party di sekitar juga akan meningkat menjadi Guidance of Theosis secara bersamaan. Seluruh Guidance of Theosis yang mengalami peningkatan tidak akan berubah kembali menjadi Grace of Kenosis.
Selain itu, Karakter yang memiliki Guidance of Theosis akan mengabaikan 40% DEF musuh saat mengakibatkan DMG.

name: Nilou
title: Dance of Lotuslight
description: The star of the Zubayr Theater. She is full of warmth and innocence, and her dances are lively and elegant.
descriptionId: Penari terkenal di Teater Zubayr. Tariannya elegan dan gemulai, pembawaannya ramah dan polos.

talents.name: Dance of Samser
talents.description:
Normal Attack
Performs up to 3 consecutive sword strikes.

Charged Attack
Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to perform a twirling slash.

Plunging Attack
Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground below, damaging opponents along the path and dealing AoE DMG upon impact.
talents.descriptionId:
Normal Attack
Melancarkan maksimum hingga 3 serangan pedang beruntun.

Charged Attack
Mengonsumsi sejumlah Stamina untuk melakukan 1 tebasan memutar.

Plunging Attack
Menerjang dari udara untuk menghantam tanah di bawahnya, menyerang musuh di jalurnya dan mengakibatkan DMG area saat mendarat.

talents.name: Dance of Haftkarsvar
talents.description:
Enters the Pirouette state, dealing Hydro DMG to nearby opponents based on Nilou's Max HP.
While she is in the Pirouette state, Nilou's Normal Attacks and Elemental Skill will cause her to enter the Sword Dance and Whirling Steps stances respectively, causing DMG she deals to be converted to Hydro DMG that cannot be overridden and that is considered Elemental Skill DMG.

In these stances, Nilou's third dance step will end Pirouette, and has the following effects based on the type of said dance step:
·Sword Dance: unleashes a Luminous Illusion that deals Hydro DMG to opponents it touches and grants Nilou the Lunar Prayer effect. This effect converts Nilou's Normal Attacks into Sword Dance techniques, and her final hit will unleash a Luminous Illusion.
·Whirling Steps: Nilou unleashes a Whirling Water Wheel that deals AoE Hydro DMG and creates a Tranquility Aura that follows your active character around and applies Wet to opponents within its AoE.

Nilou is unable to perform Charged Attacks when under the effect of Pirouette or Lunar Prayer. These effects will be removed once she leaves the field.
talents.descriptionId:
Nilou memasuki status Pirouette dan mengakibatkan Hydro DMG terhadap musuh di sekitarnya berdasarkan Max HP-nya.
Saat Nilou berada dalam status Pirouette dan melancarkan Normal Attack atau Elemental Skill, serangan tersebut akan dikonversi menjadi Sword Dance atau Whirling Steps sesuai jenis serangannya, DMG yang diakibatkan akan dikonversi menjadi Hydro DMG yang tidak bisa ditimpa Elemental Infusion lainnya, dan itu dianggap sebagai DMG Elemental Skill.

Dalam status ini, langkah tarian ketiga Nilou akan mengakhiri status Pirouette dan akan menghasilkan efek berikut sesuai dengan kategori langkah tarian ketiganya:
·Sword Dance: Melepaskan Luminous Illusion yang akan mengakibatkan Hydro DMG terhadap musuh yang menyentuhnya dan memberikan status Lunar Prayer kepada Nilou. Dalam status ini, Normal Attack Nilou akan dikonversi menjadi Sword Dance, dan akan melepaskan Luminous Illusion saat melakukan serangan yang terakhir;
·Whirling Steps: Melepaskan sebuah Whirling Water Wheel dan mengakibatkan Hydro DMG Area, juga akan menghasilkan sebuah Tranquility Aura yang akan bergerak mengikuti Karakter aktif dan memberikan status Wet terhadap musuh yang berada di dalamnya.

Saat berada dalam status Pirouette dan Lunar Prayer, Nilou tidak akan bisa melancarkan Charged Attack; Semua status ini akan hilang setelah Nilou meninggalkan medan pertempuran.

talents.name: Dance of Abzendegi: Distant Dreams, Listening Spring
talents.description:
Begins the dance of faraway dreams and springs that hear, causing a Lotus of Distant Waters to bloom, dealing AoE Hydro DMG based on Nilou's Max HP and applying the Lingering Aeon effect to all opponents hit.
After an interval, opponents affected by Lingering Aeon will take Hydro DMG.
talents.descriptionId:
Memulai tarian mimpi nan jauh dan sumber mata air yang bisa didengar dan menyebabkan sebuah Lotus of Distant Water mekar, mengakibatkan Hydro DMG Area berdasarkan Max HP Nilou dan memberikan status "Lingering Aeon" kepada musuh yang terkena.
Setelah waktu singkat, musuh yang berada dalam status Lingering Aeon akan menerima Hydro DMG.

passives.name: Court of Dancing Petals
passives.description:
When all characters in the party are all Dendro or Hydro, and there are at least one Dendro character and one Hydro character:
The completion of the third dance step of Nilou's Dance of Haftkarsvar will grant all nearby characters the Golden Chalice's Bounty for 30s.
Characters under the effect of Golden Chalice's Bounty will increase the Elemental Mastery of all nearby characters by 100 for 10s whenever they are hit by Dendro attacks. Also, triggering the Bloom or Lunar-Bloom reaction will create Bountiful Cores instead of Dendro Cores.
Such Cores will burst very quickly after being created, and they have larger AoEs.
Bountiful Cores cannot trigger Hyperbloom or Burgeon, and they share an upper numerical limit with Dendro Cores. Bountiful Core DMG is considered DMG dealt by Dendro Cores produced by Bloom.
Should the party not meet the conditions for this Ascension Talent, any existing Golden Chalice's Bounty effects will be canceled.
passives.descriptionId:
Saat seluruh anggota party adalah Karakter Dendro dan Hydro, serta memiliki minimal 1 Karakter Dendro dan 1 Karakter Hydro:
Saat Nilou menyelesaikan langkah tarian ketiga Dance of Haftkarsvar, Nilou akan memberikan status Golden Chalice's Bounty yang bertahan 30 detik kepada seluruh Karakter di sekitar.
Setelah Karakter yang berada dalam status Golden Chalice's Bounty terkenaserangan Dendro, Elemental Mastery seluruh Karakter di sekitar meningkat 100 poin selama 10 detik. Selain itu, saat memicu reaksi Bloom atau Lunar-Bloom, akan menghasilkan Bountiful Core yang akan menggantikan Dendro Core.
Jika dibandingkan dengan Dendro Core, Bountiful Core akan meledak dengan sangat cepat setelah diciptakan dan memiliki cakupan area yang lebih luas.
Bountiful Core tidak akan bisa memicu reaksi Hyperbloom atau Burgeon, dan memiliki batas jumlah yang sama dengan Dendro Core. Serangan Bountiful Core akan dianggap sebagai serangan Dendro Core dari reaksi Bloom.
Saat jenis elemen Karakter di dalam party tidak cukup untuk memicu Talenta Ascension, maka efek Golden Chalice's Bounty yang sudah dimiliki akan dihapus.

passives.name: Dreamy Dance of Aeons
passives.description:
Every 1,000 points of Nilou's Max HP above 30,000 will cause the DMG dealt by Bountiful Cores created by characters affected by Golden Chalice's Bounty to increase by 9%.
The maximum increase in Bountiful Core DMG that can be achieved this way is 400%.
passives.descriptionId:
Untuk setiap kelebihan 1.000 poin Max HP di atas 30.000 poin Max HP yang dimiliki Nilou, akan membuat DMG Bountiful Core yang diakibatkan Karakter yang berada dalam status Golden Chalice's Bounty meningkat 9%.
Batas maksimum peningkatan DMG yang diakibatkan Bountiful Core dengan cara ini adalah 400%.

passives.name: White Jade Lotus
passives.description: When Perfect Cooking is achieved on Food with Adventure-related effects, there is a 12% chance to obtain double the product.
passives.descriptionId: Saat masakan jenis petualangan dimasak dengan sempurna, terdapat 12% kemungkinan mendapatkan hasil 2 kali lipat.

constellations.name: Dance of the Waning Moon
constellations.description:
Dance of Haftkarsvar will be enhanced as follows:
·Luminous Illusion DMG is increased by 65%.
·The Tranquility Aura's duration is extended by 6s.

constellations.name: The Starry Skies Their Flowers Rain
constellations.description:
After characters affected by the Golden Chalice's Bounty deal Hydro DMG to an opponent, that opponent's Hydro RES will be decreased by 35% for 10s. After dealing Bloom or Lunar-Bloom DMG to opponents, their Dendro RES will be decreased by 35% for 10s.
You must first unlock the Ascension Talent "Court of Dancing Petals."
constellations.descriptionId:
Setelah Karakter yang berada dalam status "Golden Chalice's Bounty" mengakibatkan Hydro DMG kepada musuh, Hydro RES musuh tersebut akan berkurang 35% selama 10 detik. Setelah mengakibatkan DMG reaksi Bloom atau Lunar-Bloom terhadap musuh,Dendro RES musuh tersebut akan berkurang 35% selama 10 detik.
Harus membuka Talenta Ascension "Court of Dancing Petals" terlebih dahulu.

constellations.name: Beguiling Shadowstep
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Dance of Abzendegi: Distant Dreams, Listening Spring by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.descriptionId:
Meningkatkan 3 level Dance of Abzendegi: Distant Dreams, Listening Spring.
Maksimum: Lv. 15.

constellations.name: Fricative Pulse
constellations.description: After the third dance step of Dance of Haftkarsvar's Pirouette hits opponents, Nilou will gain 15 Elemental Energy, and DMG from her Dance of Abzendegi: Distant Dreams, Listening Spring will be increased by 50% for 8s.
constellations.descriptionId: Setelah langkah tarian ketiga dalam status Pirouette dari Dance of Haftkarsvar mengenai musuh, Nilou akan memulihkan 15 Energy, meningkatkan 50% DMG Dance of Abzendegi: Distant Dreams, Listening Spring-nya selama 8 detik.

constellations.name: Twirling Light
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Dance of Haftkarsvar by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.descriptionId:
Meningkatkan 3 level Dance of Haftkarsvar.
Maksimum: Lv. 15.

constellations.name: Frostbreaker's Melody
constellations.description:
For every 1,000 points of Max HP, Nilou's CRIT Rate and CRIT DMG will increase by 0.6% and 1.2% respectively.
The maximum increase in CRIT Rate and CRIT DMG via this method is 30% and 60% respectively.
constellations.descriptionId:
Untuk setiap 1.000 poin Max HP, akan meningkatkan CRIT Rate dan CRIT DMG Nilou masing-masing sebesar 0,6% dan 1,2%.
Kenaikan maksimum CRIT Rate dan CRIT DMG masing-masing adalah 30% dan 60%.

name: Odette
title: Swirling Snow
description: A famed Snezhnayan ballerina who blossoms against the frozen landscape with a beauty as sharp as frost.
descriptionId: Penari balet ternama dari Snezhnaya, bunga dingin yang mekar di tengah salju dan es.

talents.name: Snow Swan Variation
talents.description:
Normal Attack
Unleashes a sword attack of up to 5 consecutive strikes.

Charged Attack
Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to unleash a dazzling slash on opponents in front of her.

Plunging Attack
Attacks opponents in her path while plunging from mid-air, then deals AoE DMG upon landing.
talents.descriptionId:
Normal Attack
Melancarkan hingga 5 serangan berturut-turut.

Charged Attack
Mengonsumsi sejumlah Stamina untuk melepaskan tebasan memukau ke depan.

Plunging Attack
Menerjang dari udara untuk menghantam tanah, menyerang musuh di jalur terjangan dan mengakibatkan DMG area saat mendarat.

talents.name: Adagio: Phantom Night Dancers
talents.description:
With slow, graceful dance steps, Odette deals AoE Cryo DMG to the opponent, and also summons her **Solo Dance Double** to the field.
If a Dance Double summoned by Odette is already on the field, this will re-summon the Dance Double and reset its duration.

Solo Dance Double
Alternates between the Plume and Wing dance moves, periodically attacking nearby opponents and dealing to them AoE Cryo DMG.
Additionally, for 6s after unleashing the Elemental Skill Adagio: Phantom Night Dancers, Odette's Elemental Skill Adagio: Phantom Night Dancers will become the special Elemental Skill **Adagio: Coda at Dawn's Tolling****** instead, where a dance duet deals AoE Cryo DMG to nearby opponents over time. Then, when the duet ends, she deals another instance of AoE Cryo DMG that is considered Stellar-Conduct or Stellar Swirl DMG.
talents.descriptionId:
Sambil menampilkan gerakan tari yang lembut, Odette mengakibatkan Cryo DMG Area dan memanggil **Solo Dance Double** miliknya sendiri.
Jika Solo Dance Double yang dipanggil Odette sendiri sudah ada di medan, maka ia akan dipanggil ulang dengan durasi yang diperbarui.

Dance Double
Menampilkan dua jenis tarian secara bergantian, yaitu Plume dan Wing, untuk menyerang musuh di sekitar secara berkala dengan gerakan tarian yang anggun dan ringan, mengakibatkan Cryo DMG Area.
Selain itu, selama 6 detik setelah melancarkan Elemental Skill Adagio: Phantom Night Dancers, Elemental Skill Odette Adagio: Phantom Night Dancers akan berubah menjadi Elemental Skill khusus **Adagio: Coda at Dawn's Tolling****** yang terus-menerus mengakibatkan Cryo DMG Area terhadap musuh terdekat melalui tarian duet. Pada saat tarian duet ini berakhir, Odette akan mengakibatkan satu kali Cryo DMG Area lagi yang dianggap sebagai DMG reaksi Stellar-Conduct atau Stellar Swirl.

talents.name: Presto: Bluebird Finale
talents.description:
With quick, lively dance steps, Odette deals multiple instances of AoE Cryo DMG, and summons her **Solo Dance Double**. She also gains Snow Swan's Dream, which increases the Stellar Glimmer reaction DMG Odette deals.
Additionally, for 6s after unleashing the Elemental Burst Presto: Bluebird Finale, Odette's Elemental Skill Adagio: Phantom Night Dancers will be replaced with the special Elemental Skill **Adagio: Coda at Dawn's Tolling****** instead.

If there is a Solo Dance Double summoned by Odette on the field, it will be summoned to her side with its duration refreshed.
talents.descriptionId:
Sambil menampilkan gerakan tari yang gesit, Odette mengakibatkan Cryo DMG Area beberapa kali, kemudian memanggil **Solo Dance Double** dirinya sendiri. Odette juga akan mendapatkan efek Snow Swan's Dream: Meningkatkan DMG reaksi Stellar Glimmer yang diakibatkan oleh Odette.
Selain itu, selama 6 detik setelah melancarkan Elemental Burst Presto: Bluebird Finale, Elemental Skill Odette Adagio: Phantom Night Dancers akan berubah menjadi Elemental Skill khusus **Adagio: Coda at Dawn's Tolling******.

Jika ada Solo Dance Double yang dipanggil Odette sendiri di medan, maka akan memanggilnya ke sisinya dan mengulang durasinya.

passives.name: Spring Rite of the Chosen One
passives.description: When Odette summons her **Solo Dance Double**, she also obtains 4 stacks of **Marvelous Splendor**.
passives.descriptionId: Saat Odette memanggil **Solo Dance Double**, dia juga akan mendapatkan 4 lapis **Marvelous Splendor**.

passives.name: Pathetique of Pateticheskaya
passives.description: For every 100 ATK Odette has over 1,000, her Stellar Glimmer DMG is additionally increased by 1.5% of the original DMG. She can deal up to 30% more additional DMG in this way.
passives.descriptionId: Untuk setiap 100 poin ATK Odette yang melebihi 1.000 poin, DMG reaksi Stellar Glimmer yang diakibatkan Odette mendapatkan DMG tambahan sebesar 1,5% dari DMG awalnya. Maksimum bisa mendapatkan 30% DMG tambahan dari DMG aslinya melalui cara ini.

passives.name: Stellar Jubilee: Dance of Aurore
passives.description:
Odette will enter the Radiance: Stellar-Conduct state when she is inside a **Polestar Field**, or the Radiance: Stellar Swirl state for 8s after a nearby party member triggers a Stellar Swirl reaction.
When a party member triggers a Superconduct or Cryo Swirl reaction, it becomes a Stellar-Conduct or Stellar Swirl reaction instead, and the Base DMG of said reaction is also increased by 0.7% for every 100 points of Odette's ATK. A maximum increase of 14% can be obtained in this way.
passives.descriptionId:
Odette akan memasuki status Radiance: Stellar-Conduct saat berada di dalam **Polestar Field** atau Radiance: Stellar Swirl selama 8 detik setelah Karakter dalam party di sekitar memicu reaksi Stellar Swirl.
Ketika Karakter dalam party memicu reaksi Superconduct/Cryo Swirl, reaksi ini akan berubah menjadi reaksi Stellar-Conduct/Stellar Swirl dan DMG dasar dari reaksi yang disebutkan di atas akan meningkat berdasarkan ATK Odette: Setiap 100 poin ATK akan meningkatkan DMG dasar reaksi sebesar 0,7%. Peningkatan DMG maksimum yang bisa didapatkan dengan cara ini adalah 14%.

passives.name: Echo of Winter Daydreams
passives.description:
Shows the locations of Snezhnaya's Local Specialties on the mini-map, and this effect also applies in the Shadow Realm.
Practicing dance in one's spare time might even trigger other effects...
passives.descriptionId:
Memperlihatkan lokasi produk khas Snezhnaya di sekitar pada peta kecil, juga bisa memberikan efek bantuan yang sama di Alam Bayangan.
Saat latihan menari di saat senggang, mungkin ada efek lain yang bisa terpicu ....

constellations.name: "On This Danceless Morn, She Gazes at Her Reflection"
constellations.description:
After unleashing the special Elemental Skill **Adagio: Coda at Dawn's Tolling**, at the dance duet's end Odette will deal an additional instance of Cryo AoE DMG to nearby opponents that is considered:
Radiance: Stellar-Conduct or when not in a Radiance state: Stellar-Conduct reaction DMG at 300% of Odette's ATK;
Radiance: Stellar Swirl: Stellar Swirl reaction DMG at 450% of Odette's ATK.

Additionally, the Ascension Talent "Spring Rite of the Chosen One" is also enhanced: now, when the **Solo Dance Double** is summoned, Odette also gains 2 stacks of **Marvelous Splendor**. When Odette is off-field, the rate at which Marvelous Splendor is removed is sped up to 2 stacks per second.
constellations.descriptionId:
Setelah melancarkan Elemental Skill Khusus **Adagio: Coda at Dawn's Tolling**, saat tarian duetnya berakhir, Odette akan mengakibatkan satu kali Cryo DMG Area tambahan terhadap musuh di sekitarnya. DMG ini dianggap sebagai:
·Radiance: Stellar-Conduct atau saat tidak berada dalam status Radiance: DMG reaksi Stellar-Conduct sebesar 300% ATK Odette.
·Radiance: Stellar Swirl: DMG reaksi Stellar Swirl sebesar 450% ATK Odette.

Selain itu, Talenta Ascension "Spring Rite of the Chosen One" juga akan diperkuat: saat Odette memanggil **Solo Dance Double** miliknya, ia juga akan mendapatkan 2 lapis **Marvelous Splendor**. Dan saat Odette ada di dalam party namun sedang tidak berada di medan pertempuran, kecepatan penghapusan Marvelous Splendor meningkat menjadi 2 lapis per detik.

constellations.name: "I Must See the Snow Swan's Unseen Dream for Myself, She Thought"
constellations.description:
The Ascension Talent "Spring Rite of the Chosen One" is enhanced as follows: every stack of **Marvelous Splendor** active also increases the character's ATK by 7%.
Additionally, if Odette is in the **Radiance: Stellar Glimmer** state when there is a **Solo Dance Double** on the field, opponents near the Dance Double will also have their corresponding Elemental RES lowered by 20%.
·Radiance: Stellar-Conduct: Cryo and Electro.
·Radiance: Stellar Swirl: Cryo and Anemo.
constellations.descriptionId:
Talenta Ascension "Spring Rite of the Chosen One" diperkuat: Setiap lapisan **Marvelous Splendor** juga meningkatkan 7% ATK Karakter.
Selain itu, saat **Solo Dance Double** berada di medan pertempuran dan Odette sedang berada dalam status **Radiance: Stellar Glimmer**, maka Elemental RES musuh di sekitar Solo Dance Double akan berkurang 20% untuk elemen berikut:
·Radiance: Stellar-Conduct: Cryo dan Electro.
·Radiance: Stellar Swirl: Cryo dan Anemo.

constellations.name: "I'll Chase the Shouting Wind Along, Climbing Alone As I Go"
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of **Adagio: Phantom Night Dancers** by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.descriptionId:
Meningkatkan 3 level Elemental Skill **Adagio: Phantom Night Dancers** .
Maksimum: Lv. 15.

constellations.name: "Up, Up the Long, Delirious, Burning Blue"
constellations.description:
The Elemental Burst Presto: Bluebird Finale is enhanced as follows: when Odette obtains Snow Swan's Dream, Stellar Glimmer reaction DMG dealt by other nearby party members is increased by 50% of Snow Swan Dream's effects.

Additionally, when a party member deals Stellar Glimmer reaction DMG to an opponent, Odette will also join in with a coordinated attack, dealing an instance of AoE Cryo DMG. This effect, which can trigger once every 3.5s, will be considered:
·Radiance: Stellar-Conduct or when not in a Radiance state: Stellar-Conduct reaction DMG at 66% of Odette's ATK.
·Radiance: Stellar Swirl: Stellar Swirl reaction DMG at 99% of Odette's ATK.
constellations.descriptionId:
Elemental Burst Presto: Bluebird Finale diperkuat: Saat Odette mendapatkan efek Snow Swan's Dream, DMG reaksi Stellar Glimmer yang diakibatkan Karakter lain dalam party di sekitar juga akan meningkat sebesar 50% dari efek Snow Swan's Dream.

Selain itu, saat serangan Karakter dalam party mengakibatkan DMG reaksi Stellar Glimmer terhadap musuh, Odette juga akan melancarkan satu kali serangan terkoordinasi terhadap musuh tersebut, mengakibatkan satu kali Cryo DMG Area. Efek ini dapat terpicu sekali setiap 3,5 detik dan dianggap sebagai:
·Radiance: Stellar-Conduct atau saat tidak berada dalam status Radiance: DMG reaksi Stellar-Conduct sebesar 66% ATK Odette.
·Radiance: Stellar Swirl: DMG reaksi Stellar Swirl sebesar 99% ATK Odette.

constellations.name: "Oh! I Have Slipped the Surly Bonds of Earth"
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of **Presto: Bluebird Finale**  by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.descriptionId:
Meningkatkan 3 level Elemental Burst **Presto: Bluebird Finale** .
Maksimum: Lv. 15.

constellations.name: "Put Out My Hand, and Touched the Face of the Divine"
constellations.description:
The Ascension Talent "Spring Rite of the Chosen One" is enhanced as follows: When Odette grants **Marvelous Splendor** to all nearby party members, her own Marvelous Splendor stacks will no longer decrease.
Additionally, characters affected by Marvelous Splendor have their Stellar Glimmer reaction DMG dealt to opponents **elevated** by 25%, and Stellar Glimmer reaction DMG dealt by Odette is elevated by an additional 20%.
constellations.descriptionId:
Talenta Ascension "Spring Rite of the Chosen One" diperkuat: Saat Odette memberikan **Marvelous Splendor** kepada semua Karakter party di sekitar, maka Marvelous Splendor milik Odette sendiri tidak akan berkurang lagi.
Selain itu, untuk Karakter yang berada di bawah pengaruh Marvelous Splendor, DMG reaksi Stellar Glimmer yang diakibatkannya terhadap musuh akan **bertumbuh** 25%, dan DMG reaksi Stellar Glimmer yang diakibatkan Odette terhadap musuh akan bertumbuh lagi sebesar 20%.

name: Qiqi
title: Icy Resurrection
description: An apprentice and herb gatherer at Bubu Pharmacy. An undead with a bone-white complexion, she seldom has much in the way of words or emotion.
descriptionId: Seorang murid di Bubu Pharmacy yang bertugas untuk memetik tanaman obat-obatan. Seorang zombie yang kulitnya teramat putih dan pucat, dia teramat pendiam, dan jarang menunjukkan ekspresi apa pun.

talents.name: Ancient Sword Art
talents.description:
Normal Attack
Performs up to 5 rapid strikes.

Charged Attack
Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to unleash 2 rapid sword strikes.

Plunging Attack
Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground below, damaging opponents along the path and dealing AoE DMG upon impact.
talents.descriptionId:
Normal Attack
Melancarkan hingga 5 serangan berturut-turut.

Charged Attack
Mengonsumsi sejumlah Stamina untuk melancarkan dua tebasan pedang secara cepat.

Plunging Attack
Menerjang dari udara untuk menghantam tanah, mengakibatkan DMG pada musuh di jalur terjangan dan mengakibatkan DMG Area saat mendarat.

talents.name: Adeptus Art: Herald of Frost
talents.description:
Using the Icevein Talisman, Qiqi brings forth the Herald of Frost, dealing Cryo DMG to surrounding opponents.

Herald of Frost
·On hit, Qiqi's Normal and Charged Attacks regenerate HP for your own party members and nearby teammates. Healing scales based on Qiqi's ATK.
·Periodically regenerates your active character's HP.
·Follows the character around, dealing Cryo DMG to opponents in their path.

talents.name: Adeptus Art: Preserver of Fortune
talents.description:
Qiqi releases the adeptus power sealed within her body, marking nearby opponents with a Fortune-Preserving Talisman that deals Cryo DMG.

Fortune-Preserving Talisman
When opponents affected by this Talisman take DMG, the character that dealt this DMG regenerates HP.
talents.descriptionId:
Qiqi mengerahkan kekuatan Adeptus yang disegel di dalam tubuhnya dan menandai musuh di sekitar dengan Fortune-Preserving Talisman yang mengakibatkan Cryo DMG.

Fortune-Preserving Talisman
Saat musuh yang telah ditandai menerima DMG, maka Karakter yang mengakibatkan DMG tersebut akan menerima pemulihan HP.

passives.name: Life-Prolonging Methods
passives.description: When a character under the effects of Adeptus Art: Herald of Frost triggers an Elemental Reaction, their Incoming Healing Bonus is increased by 20% for 8s.
passives.descriptionId: Saat Karakter berada dalam efek Adeptus Art: Herald of Frost memicu Reaksi Elemental, Incoming Healing Bonus mereka meningkat sebesar 20% selama 8 detik.

passives.name: A Glimpse Into Arcanum
passives.description: When Qiqi hits opponents with her Normal and Charged Attacks, she has a 50% chance to apply a Fortune-Preserving Talisman to them for 6s. This effect can only occur once every 30s.
passives.descriptionId: Saat Qiqi menyerang musuh dengan Normal dan Charged Attack, Qiqi memiliki 50% kemungkinan untuk memberikan Fortune-Preserving Talisman kepada musuh selama 6 detik. Efek ini dapat terpicu setiap 30 detik.

passives.name: Former Life Memories
passives.description: Displays the location of nearby resources unique to Liyue on the mini-map.
passives.descriptionId: Memperlihakan lokasi produk khas Liyue di sekitar pada peta kecil.

constellations.name: Ascetics of Frost
constellations.description: When the Herald of Frost hits an opponent marked by a Fortune-Preserving Talisman, Qiqi regenerates 2 Energy.
constellations.descriptionId: Saat Herald of Frost mengenai musuh yang ditandai oleh Fortune-Preserving Talisman, Qiqi memulihkan 2 Energy.

constellations.name: Frozen to the Bone
constellations.description: Qiqi's Normal and Charged Attack DMG against opponents affected by Cryo is increased by 15%.
constellations.descriptionId: Meningkatkan 15% Normal dan Charged Attack Qiqi terhadap musuh yang terpengaruh Cryo.

constellations.name: Ascendant Praise
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Adeptus Art: Preserver of Fortune by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.descriptionId:
Meningkatkan 3 level Adeptus Art: Preserver of Fortune.
Maksimum: Lv. 15.

constellations.name: Divine Suppression
constellations.description: Targets marked by the Fortune-Preserving Talisman have their ATK decreased by 20%.
constellations.descriptionId: ATK dari musuh yang ditandai oleh Fortune-Preserving Talisman berkurang 20%.

constellations.name: Crimson Lotus Bloom
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Adeptus Art: Herald of Frost by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.descriptionId:
Meningkatkan 3 level Adeptus Art: Herald of Frost.
Maksimum: Lv. 15.

constellations.name: Rite of Resurrection
constellations.description:
Using Adeptus Art: Preserver of Fortune revives all fallen party members nearby and regenerates 50% of their HP.
This effect can only occur once every 15 mins.
constellations.descriptionId:
Menggunakan Adeptus Art: Preserver of Fortune akan menghidupkan kembali Karakter yang gugur di sekitar dan memulihkan 50% HP mereka.
Efek ini terpicu setiap 15 menit.

name: Raiden Shogun
title: Plane of Euthymia
description: Her Excellency, the Almighty Narukami Ogosho, who promised the people of Inazuma an unchanging Eternity.
descriptionId: Yang Mulia, Sang Narukami Ogosho Yang Mahakuasa. Dia menjanjikan para penduduk Inazuma keabadian yang tidak akan pernah berubah.

talents.name: Origin
talents.description:
Normal Attack
Performs up to 5 consecutive spear strikes.

Charged Attack
Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to perform an upward slash.

Plunging Attack
Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground below, damaging opponents along the path and dealing AoE DMG upon impact.
talents.descriptionId:
Normal Attack
Melancarkan hingga 5 serangan tombak berturut-turut.

Charged Attack
Mengonsumsi sejumlah Stamina untuk menebas ke atas.

Plunging Attack
Menerjang dari udara untuk menghantam tanah di bawahnya, menyerang musuh di jalur terjangan dan mengakibatkan DMG area saat mendarat.

talents.name: Transcendence: Baleful Omen
talents.description:
The Raiden Shogun unveils a shard of her Euthymia, dealing Electro DMG to nearby opponents, and granting nearby party members the Eye of Stormy Judgment.

Eye of Stormy Judgment
·When characters with this buff attack and deal DMG to opponents, the Eye will unleash a coordinated attack, dealing AoE Electro DMG at the opponent's position.
·Characters who gain the Eye of Stormy Judgment will have their Elemental Burst DMG increased based on the Energy Cost of the Elemental Burst during the Eye's duration.

The Eye can initiate one coordinated attack every 0.9s per party.
Coordinated attacks generated by characters not controlled by you deal 20% of the normal DMG.
talents.descriptionId:
Raiden Shogun membuka sebagian Euthymia-nya, mengakibatkan Electro DMG pada musuh di sekitar dan memberikan efek Eye of Stormy Judgment pada anggota party di sekitar.

Eye of Stormy Judgment
·Saat Karakter dengan efek ini mengakibatkan DMG pada musuh, Eye of Stormy Judgment akan melancarkan serangan terkoordinasi dan mengakibatkan Electro DMG Area di tempat musuh berada.
·Selama Eye of Stormy Judgment aktif, DMG Elemental Burst Karakter yang mendapatkan efek Eye of Stormy Judgment akan meningkat sesuai dengan Konsumsi Energy Elemental Burst tersebut.

Eye of Stormy Judgment di setiap party dapat melancarkan serangan terkoordinasi setiap 0,9 detik.
·Serangan terkoordinasi yang dipicu oleh Karakter yang bukan partymu sendiri dapat mengakibatkan 20% DMG aslinya.

talents.name: Secret Art: Musou Shinsetsu
talents.description:
Gathering truths unnumbered and wishes uncounted, the Raiden Shogun unleashes the Musou no Hitotachi and deals AoE Electro DMG, using Musou Isshin in combat for a certain duration afterward. The DMG dealt by Musou no Hitotachi and Musou Isshin's attacks will be increased based on the number of Chakra Desiderata's Resolve stacks consumed when this skill is used.

Musou Isshin
While in this state, the Raiden Shogun will wield her tachi in battle, while her Normal, Charged, and Plunging Attacks will be infused with Electro DMG, which cannot be overridden. When such attacks hit opponents, she will regenerate Energy for all nearby party members. Energy can be restored this way once every 1s, and this effect can be triggered 5 times throughout this skill's duration.
While in this state, the Raiden Shogun's resistance to interruption is increased, and she is immune to Electro-Charged reaction DMG.
While Musou Isshin is active, the Raiden Shogun's Normal, Charged, and Plunging Attack DMG will be considered Elemental Burst DMG.

The effects of Musou Isshin will be cleared when the Raiden Shogun leaves the field.

Chakra Desiderata
When nearby party members (excluding the Raiden Shogun herself) use their Elemental Bursts, the Raiden Shogun will build up Resolve stacks based on the Energy Cost of these Elemental Bursts.
The maximum number of Resolve stacks is 60.

The Resolve gained by Chakra Desiderata will be cleared 300s after the Raiden Shogun leaves the field.
talents.descriptionId:
Dengan mengumpulkan kebenaran dan harapan yang tak terhitung, Raiden Shogun mengeluarkan Musou no Hitotachi-nya dan mengakibatkan Electro DMG Area. Kemudian Raiden Shogun akan bertarung menggunakan Musou Isshin untuk sementara waktu. DMG yang diakibatkan Musou no Hitotachi dan Musou Isshin akan meningkat berdasarkan jumlah lapisan Resolve dari Chakra Desiderata yang dikonsumsi saat menggunakan skill ini.

Musou Isshin
Dalam kondisi ini, Raiden Shogun akan bertarung menggunakan pedang tachi miliknya. Normal, Charged, dan Plunging Attack Raiden Shogun dikonversi menjadi Electro DMG yang tidak bisa ditimpa oleh Elemental Infusion lainnya. Saat serangan yang berada dalam kondisi ini mengenai musuh, Raiden Shogun akan memulihkan Energy untuk anggota party di sekitar. Pemulihan Energy dengan cara ini hanya bisa terpicu setiap 1 detik, dan maksimum sebanyak 5 kali selama durasi skill.
Dalam kondisi ini, pertahanan Raiden Shogun terhadap interupsi akan meningkat dan menjadi kebal terhadap DMG dari reaksi Electro-Charged.
Saat berada dalam kondisi Musou Isshin, DMG dari Normal, Charged, dan Plunging Attack Raiden Shogun akan terhitung sebagai DMG Elemental Burst.

Efek Musou Isshin akan hilang saat Raiden Shogun meninggalkan medan pertempuran.

Chakra Desiderata
Saat anggota party di sekitar (kecuali Raiden Shogun sendiri) melancarkan Elemental Burst, Raiden Shogun akan mendapatkan lapisan Resolve berdasarkan jumlah Energy yang terkonsumsi dari Elemental Burst tersebut.
Jumlah maksimum lapisan Resolve adalah 60.

Lapisan Resolve yang didapatkan dari Chakra Desiderata akan hilang dalam 300 detik setelah Raiden Shogun meninggalkan medan pertempuran.

passives.name: Wishes Unnumbered
passives.description:
When nearby party members gain Elemental Orbs or Particles, Chakra Desiderata gains 2 Resolve stacks.
This effect can occur once every 3s.
passives.descriptionId:
Saat anggota party di sekitar memperoleh Elemental Orb atau Elemental Particle, Chakra Desiderata akan mendapatkan 2 lapis Resolve.
Efek ini dapat terpicu setiap 3 detik.

passives.name: Enlightened One
passives.description:
Each 1% above 100% Energy Recharge that the Raiden Shogun possesses grants her:
·0.6% greater Energy restoration from Musou Isshin
·0.4% Electro DMG Bonus.
passives.descriptionId:
Untuk setiap 1% Energy Recharge di atas 100% yang dimiliki Raiden Shogun, Raiden Shogun akan mendapatkan efek:
·Musou Isshin memberikan pemulihan Energy 0,6% lebih besar.
·0,4% Electro DMG Bonus.

passives.name: All-Preserver
passives.description: Mora expended when ascending Swords and Polearms is decreased by 50%.
passives.descriptionId: Mora yang terkonsumsi untuk melakukan Ascend Senjata Sword dan Polearm berkurang 50%.

constellations.name: Ominous Inscription
constellations.description: Chakra Desiderata will gather Resolve even faster. When Electro characters use their Elemental Bursts, the Resolve gained is increased by 80%. When characters of other Elemental Types use their Elemental Bursts, the Resolve gained is increased by 20%.
constellations.descriptionId: Chakra Desiderata dapat mengumpulkan Resolve dengan lebih cepat. Setelah Karakter dengan elemen Electro melancarkan Elemental Burst, jumlah Resolve yang didapatkan akan meningkat 80%. Setelah Karakter dengan elemen lain melancarkan Elemental Burst, jumlah Resolve yang didapatkan akan meningkat 20%.

constellations.name: Steelbreaker
constellations.description: While using Musou no Hitotachi and in the Musou Isshin state applied by Secret Art: Musou Shinsetsu, the Raiden Shogun's attacks ignore 60% of opponents' DEF.
constellations.descriptionId: Saat menggunakan Musou no Hitotachi dan berada dalam status Musou Isshin yang diperoleh dari skill Secret Art: Musou Shinsetsu, serangan Raiden Shogun akan mengabaikan 60% DEF musuh.

constellations.name: Shinkage Bygones
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Secret Art: Musou Shinsetsu by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.descriptionId:
Meningkatkan 3 level Secret Art: Musou Shinsetsu.
Maksimum: Lv. 15.

constellations.name: Pledge of Propriety
constellations.description: When the Musou Isshin state applied by Secret Art: Musou Shinsetsu expires, all nearby party members (excluding the Raiden Shogun) gain 30% bonus ATK for 10s.
constellations.descriptionId: Setelah status Musou Isshin yang diperoleh dari Secret Art: Musou Shinsetsu berakhir, seluruh anggota party di sekitar (kecuali Raiden Shogun sendiri) mendapatkan 30% bonus ATK selama 10 detik.

constellations.name: Shogun's Descent
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Transcendence: Baleful Omen by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.descriptionId:
Meningkatkan 3 level Transcendence: Baleful Omen.
Maksimum: Lv. 15.

constellations.name: Wishbearer
constellations.description:
While in the Musou Isshin state applied by Secret Art: Musou Shinsetsu, attacks by the Raiden Shogun that are considered part of her Elemental Burst will decrease all nearby party members' (not including the Raiden Shogun herself) Elemental Burst CD by 1s when they hit opponents.
This effect can trigger once every 1s and can trigger a total of 5 times during Musou Isshin's duration.
constellations.descriptionId:
Saat berada dalam status Musou Isshin yang diperoleh dari Secret Art: Musou Shinsetsu, DMG Elemental Burst Raiden Shogun yang mengenai musuh akan mengurangi 1 detik CD Elemental Burst seluruh anggota party di sekitar (kecuali Raiden Shogun sendiri).
Efek ini dapat terpicu setiap 1 detik, dan dapat terpicu maksimum 5 kali selama durasi status.

name: Sandrone
title: Mirrored Analysis
description: The Seventh of the Fatui Harbingers, "Marionette." Interprets all phenomena through the prism of mathematics, and is an elegant lady who is never absent from a tea party.
descriptionId: Harbinger Fatui ke-7, "Marionette". Sosok yang menafsirkan segala fenomena melalui sudut pandang matematika, sekaligus seorang wanita elegan yang tak pernah absen dari pesta teh.

talents.name: Formule Phenomenale: Self-Evident Proposition
talents.description:
Normal Attack
Generates threads that control her weapon using formulae, performing up to 3 consecutive strikes.

Charged Attack
Summons the Facilitatrice Automatisee Generaliste Interactive et Omnitache, or "Fagio," and switches it to **Decoding** mode: Unleashes a sweeping fire attack on enemies in front, as well as periodically fires condensed beams, dealing AoE Cryo DMG.
**Radiance: Stellar Glimmer**: The condensed beams will instead deal AoE Cryo DMG that is considered the corresponding Stellar Glimmer reaction DMG.
While in Decoding mode, Fagio's **Decoding Power** will continuously increase. Firing condensed beams will also further increase its Decoding Power.
When Fagio's Decoding Power reaches the maximum of 100 points, it switches to Power Overdrive mode, in which it fires at opponents with longer intervals, dealing Cryo DMG. It will be unable to switch to Decoding mode at this time.
When not in Decoding mode, Fagio's Decoding Power gradually decreases. When Sandrone is off-field, she will focus on maintaining Fagio, causing its Decoding Power to decrease at 300% the original rate.
Fagio exits Power Overdrive mode when its Decoding Power has decreased to under 50.

Plunging Attack
Plunges from midair to strike the ground below, dealing DMG to opponents along their path and causing AoE DMG on landing.
talents.descriptionId:
Normal Attack
Menenun benang untuk memanipulasi senjatanya dengan formula numerik dan melakukan hingga 3 serangan tebasan berturut-turut.

Charged Attack
Memanggil Facilitatrice Automatisee Generaliste Interactive et Omnitache, atau  "Fagio", dan mengalihkannya ke mode **Decoding**: Melancarkan tembakan beruntun ke musuh di depan, serta menembakkan sinar terkondensasi secara berkala, mengakibatkan Cryo DMG Area.
**Radiance: Stellar Glimmer**: DMG dari sinar terkondensasinya berubah menjadi Cryo DMG Area yang dianggap sebagai DMG reaksi Stellar Glimmer yang sesuai.
Dalam mode Decoding, jumlah **Decoding Power** Fagio akan terus bertambah. Decoding Power juga akan bertambah saat Fagio menembakkan sinar terkondensasinya.
Saat Decoding Power mencapai batas maksimum (100 poin), Fagio akan beralih ke mode Power Overdrive. Dalam mode ini, ia akan menembak musuh dengan jeda yang lebih panjang, mengakibatkan Cryo DMG, dan menjadi tidak bisa beralih ke mode Decoding.
Saat tidak berada dalam mode Decoding, Decoding Power Fagio akan terus berkurang secara perlahan. Saat Sandrone ada di dalam party namun sedang tidak berada di medan pertempuran, dia akan fokus memperbaiki Fagio dan mempercepat kecepatan pengurangan Decoding Power menjadi 300% dari kecepatan semulanya.
Fagio akan keluar dari mode Power Overdrive saat Decoding Power-nya menurun hingga di bawah 50 poin.

Plunging Attack
Menerjang ke tanah dari udara, menyerang musuh di jalur jatuhnya, dan mengakibatkan DMG Area saat mendarat.

talents.name: Formule Phenomenale: Differential Analysis
talents.description:
With her impeccable, ladylike poise, Sandrone boards the Tea Party Tactical Assault Hovermech and hovers forward for 6s. During this time, Sandrone can control the travel direction of the craft. Pressing Sprint consumes 10 Stamina and launches her into an elegant high-speed hover mode, in which she will move even faster at the cost of 15 Stamina per second.

When Sandrone starts hovering, if there are opponents nearby, she will also summon a Prismatic Resonance Cannon and fire 2 Prism Shots at any opponents who have yet to cool down, dealing Cryo DMG.
**Radiance: Stellar Glimmer**: The second Prism Shot will instead deal Cryo DMG that is considered the corresponding Stellar Glimmer reaction DMG.

When on the Tea Party Tactical Assault Hovermech, Sandrone will also elegantly and quietly repair Fagio, causing **Decoding Power** to swiftly decrease.
talents.descriptionId:
Dengan gerakannya yang elegan bak seorang wanita sejati, Sandrone akan duduk di atas Tea Party Tactical Assault Hovermech miliknya dan terus melayang maju selama 6 detik. Selama durasi ini, Sandrone juga dapat mengontrol arah terbangnya. Menekan tombol Lari akan mengonsumsi 10 Stamina untuk memasuki mode melayang berkecepatan tinggi yang anggun, tapi mengonsumsi 15 poin Stamina per detik untuk melayang dengan lebih cepat.

Jika ada musuh di sekitar Sandrone saat ia mulai melayang, maka Sandrone juga akan memanggil sebuah Prismatic Resonance Cannon untuk menembakkan dua Prism Shot ke musuh yang tidak bisa diam, mengakibatkan Cryo DMG.
**Radiance: Stellar Glimmer:** DMG Prism Shot kedua akan berubah menjadi Cryo DMG yang dianggap sebagai DMG reaksi Stellar Glimmer yang sesuai.

Saat sedang menaiki Tea Party Tactical Assault Hovermech, Sandrone juga akan dengan anggunnya memperbaiki Fagio secara diam-diam, sehingga **Decoding Power** Fagio akan berkurang dengan cepat.

talents.name: Formule Phenomenale: Q.E.D.
talents.description:
In line with established ladylike behavior, Sandrone summons a large number of Prismatic Resonance Cannons for a frontal bombardment before firing on her foes with a Convective Inhibition Ray, dealing AoE Cryo DMG.
**Radiance: Stellar Glimmer**: The Convective Inhibition Ray instead deals AoE Cryo DMG that is considered the corresponding Stellar Glimmer reaction DMG.
talents.descriptionId:
Masih sambil menjunjung tinggi etiket seorang wanita sejati, Sandrone memanggil sejumlah besar Prismatic Resonance Cannon untuk melakukan bombardir luas ke hadapannya, lalu menembakkan Convective Inhibition Ray bersuhu negatif untuk menghantam musuh dan mengakibatkan Cryo DMG Area.
**Radiance: Stellar Glimmer**: DMG Convective Inhibition Ray akan berubah menjadi Cryo DMG Area yang dianggap sebagai DMG reaksi Stellar Glimmer yang sesuai.

passives.name: Eternal Speculation Engine
passives.description:
**Radiance: Stellar Glimmer**: When using the Elemental Skill **Formule Phenomenale: Differential Analysis**, if Fagio's **Decoding Power** is greater than 50, the second Prism Shot fired by Fagio at nearby opponents will deal 400% of its original DMG as Fagio's Decoding Power is decreased.
Additionally, for every 10 points of Decoding Power Fagio loses, it gains 1 stack of Refined Tactics for 60s (max 10 stacks). When Sandrone uses the Elemental Burst **Formule Phenomenale: Q.E.D.** while in the Radiance: Stellar Glimmer state, all stacks of Refined Tactics are cleared, causing the Convective Inhibition Ray to deal 100% + (number of stacks cleared) × 10% of its original DMG.
passives.descriptionId:
**Radiance: Stellar Glimmer**: Saat melancarkan Elemental Skill **Formule Phenomenale: Differential Analysis**, jika **Decoding Power** Fagio melebihi 50 poin, maka Prism Shot kedua yang ditembakkan ke musuh di sekitar akan mengakibatkan 400% DMG dari DMG aslinya seiring berkurangnya Decoding Power Fagio.
Selain itu, setiap kali Decoding Power Fagio berkurang 10 poin, ia akan memperoleh 1 lapis efek Refined Tactics yang bertahan selama 60 detik. Efek ini dapat ditumpuk sampai 10 lapis. Saat Sandrone melancarkan Elemental Burst **Formule Phenomenale: Q.E.D** dalam status Radiance: Stellar Glimmer, semua lapisan Refined Tactics akan terhapus dan membuat Convective Inhibition Ray mengakibatkan DMG sebesar 100% + (jumlah lapisan yang dihapus ×10%) dari DMG aslinya.

passives.name: A Lady's Code of Conduct
passives.description: Increases Sandrone's Elemental Mastery based on her ATK. Every 100 ATK will increase her Elemental Mastery by 8. The maximum increase she can gain this way is 160.
passives.descriptionId: Meningkatkan Elemental Mastery Sandrone berdasarkan ATK-nya. Setiap 100 poin ATK akan meningkatkan Elemental Mastery Sandrone sebesar 8 poin. Maksimal dapat meningkatkan 160 poin Elemental Mastery dengan cara ini.

passives.name: Stellar Jubilee: Light of Rationalisme
passives.description:
Sandrone will enter the Radiance: Stellar-Conduct state when she is inside a **Polestar Field**, or the Radiance: Stellar Swirl state for 8s after a nearby party member triggers a Stellar Swirl reaction.
When a party member triggers a Superconduct or Cryo Swirl reaction, it becomes a Stellar-Conduct or Stellar Swirl reaction instead, and the Base DMG of the aforementioned reaction is also increased by 0.7% for every 100 points of Sandrone's ATK. A maximum increase of 14% can be obtained in this way.
passives.descriptionId:
Sandrone akan memasuki status Radiance: Stellar-Conduct saat berada di dalam **Polestar Field** atau Radiance: Stellar Swirl selama 8 detik setelah Karakter dalam party di sekitar memicu reaksi Stellar Swirl.
Ketika Karakter dalam party memicu reaksi Superconduct/Cryo Swirl, reaksi ini akan berubah menjadi reaksi Stellar-Conduct/Stellar Swirl dan DMG dasar dari reaksi yang disebutkan di atas akan meningkat berdasarkan ATK Sandrone: Setiap 100 poin ATK akan meningkatkan DMG dasar yang disebutkan di atas sebesar 0,7%. Peningkatan DMG maksimum yang bisa didapatkan dengan cara ini adalah 14%.

passives.name: A Caucus Prelude and a Long Tale
passives.description: When Sandrone is in the party, you will gain additional snack rewards after turning in your Daily Commissions with Katheryne.
passives.descriptionId: Saat Sandrone berada dalam party, kamu akan mendapatkan hadiah camilan tambahan saat menyerahkan Misi Harian ke Katheryne.

constellations.name: Morrow After the Golden Dusk
constellations.description: When in **Decoding** mode, Fagio's **Decoding Power** increases at a 50% lower rate, and all party members deal 30% increased Stellar Glimmer reaction DMG.
constellations.descriptionId: Saat berada dalam mode **Decoding**, kecepatan meningkatnya **Decoding Power** Fagio berkurang 50%, dan DMG reaksi Stellar Glimmer yang diakibatkan oleh seluruh Karakter dalam party meningkat 30%.

constellations.name: An Heiress Gazed Into the Looking-Glass
constellations.description: Radiance: Stellar Glimmer: Increases CRIT DMG from Charged Attack condensed beams by 40%. Also, each time a beam is fired, CRIT DMG dealt by all condensed beams fired during this **Decoding** mode period will be further increased by 20%. Max 3 stacks.
constellations.descriptionId: Radiance: Stellar Glimmer: CRIT DMG sinar terkondensasi dari Charged Attack meningkat 40%. Dan setiap kali sinar terkondensasi ini ditembakkan, CRIT DMG yang diakibatkan semua sinar terkondensasi yang ditembakkan selama mode **Decoding** kali ini akan meningkat lagi sebesar 20%. Efek ini dapat ditumpuk sampai 3 lapis.

constellations.name: Refuse the Wake of Dusk, the Moonlit Yoke
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of **Formule Phenomenale: Self-Evident Proposition** by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.descriptionId:
Meningkatkan 3 level Normal Attack **Formule Phenomenale: Self-Evident Proposition**.
Maksimum: Lv. 15.

constellations.name: In Knowledge Lies the World's True Ground
constellations.description: When Sandrone deals Stellar-Conduct or Stellar Swirl DMG to an opponent, she will also summon an extra Prismatic Resonance Cannon to fire off a coordinated attack which deals Cryo DMG at 125% or 187.5% of her ATK, respectively. This DMG is considered the corresponding Stellar Glimmer reaction DMG, and the effect can occur once every 4s.
constellations.descriptionId: Saat DMG reaksi Stellar-Conduct/Stellar Swirl Sandrone mengenai musuh, ia akan memanggil 1 Prismatic Resonance Cannon tambahan untuk melancarkan serangan terkoordinasi yang mengakibatkan Cryo DMG sebesar 125%/187,5% ATK Sandrone kepada musuh. DMG ini dianggap sebagai DMG reaksi Stellar Glimmer yang sesuai. Efek ini dapat terpicu sekali setiap 4 detik.

constellations.name: Of All Beside, She Takes No Part
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of **Formule Phenomenale: Q.E.D.** by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.descriptionId:
Meningkatkan 3 level Elemental Burst **Formule Phenomenale: Q.E.D**.
Maksimum: Lv. 15.

constellations.name: Narcissus Wakes, Her Eyes Upon the Dawn
constellations.description:
When Fagio fires a condensed beam for the third time while in **Decoding** mode, the beam becomes a more powerful Condensed Cluster Beam that fires continuously. This beam will deal up to 4 additional instances of AoE Cryo DMG at 100% of Sandrone's ATK on top of any subsequent original beam fired.
Radiance: Stellar Glimmer: The Condensed Cluster Beam attack deals 4 additional instances of AoE Cryo DMG. The DMG dealt with this attack, which is considered the corresponding Stellar Glimmer reaction DMG, is equal to:
Radiance: Stellar-Conduct: 80% of Sandrone's ATK.
Radiance: Stellar Swirl: 120% of Sandrone's ATK.
Additionally, all Stellar Glimmer reaction DMG dealt by Sandrone is **elevated** by 20%.
constellations.descriptionId:
Dalam mode **Decoding**, saat Fagio menembakkan sinar terkondensasi untuk ketiga kalinya, serangan ini akan berubah menjadi Condensed Cluster Beam yang terus-menerus dan lebih kuat. Serangan ini akan mengakibatkan hingga 4 kali Cryo DMG Area tambahan sebesar 100% ATK Sandrone di luar sinar terkondensasi dasar yang terus ditembakkan.
Radiance: Stellar Glimmer: Tembakan Condensed Cluster Beam berubah menjadi: mengakibatkan hingga 4 kali Cryo DMG Area tambahan yang akan dianggap sebagai DMG reaksi Stellar Glimmer yang sesuai, dan akan didasarkan pada ATK Sandrone sebesar:
Radiance: Stellar-Conduct: 80%;
Radiance: Stellar Swirl: 120%.
Selain itu, semua DMG reaksi Stellar Glimmer yang diakibatkan oleh Sandrone **bertumbuh** sebesar 20%.

name: Sangonomiya Kokomi
title: Pearl of Wisdom
description: The Divine Priestess of Watatsumi Island. All of the island's affairs are at this young lady's fingertips.
descriptionId: Sang Pemimpin Suci di Pulau Watatsumi. Segala urusan yang terjadi di pulau tersebut ada dalam genggaman nona muda ini.

talents.name: The Shape of Water
talents.description:
Normal Attack
Performs up to 3 consecutive attacks that take the form of swimming fish, dealing Hydro DMG.

Charged Attack
Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to deal AoE Hydro DMG after a short casting time.

Plunging Attack
Gathering the might of Hydro, Kokomi plunges towards the ground from mid-air, damaging all opponents in her path. Deals AoE Hydro DMG upon impact with the ground.
talents.descriptionId:
Normal Attack
Melancarkan hingga 3 serangan beruntun dalam wujud ikan yang berenang dan mengakibatkan Hydro DMG.

Charged Attack
Mengonsumsi sejumlah Stamina untuk mengakibatkan Hydro DMG area setelah jeda singkat.

Plunging Attack
Mengumpulkan kekuatan Hydro dan menghantam ke tanah dari udara, menyerang musuh di jalur terjangan dan mengakibatkan Hydro DMG Area saat mendarat.

talents.name: Kurage's Oath
talents.description:
Summons a "Bake-Kurage" created from water that can heal her allies.
Using this skill will apply the Wet status to Sangonomiya Kokomi.

Bake-Kurage
Deals Hydro DMG to surrounding opponents and heals nearby active characters at fixed intervals. This healing is based on Kokomi's Max HP.
talents.descriptionId:
Memanggil "Bake-Kurage" yang tercipta dari air untuk menyembuhkan rekan.
Ketika melancarkan skill ini, Sangonomiya Kokomi akan terkena status Wet.

Bake-Kurage
Setiap beberapa saat, Bake-Kurage akan mengakibatkan Hydro DMG pada musuh di sekitar dan memulihkan HP Karakter yang berada di medan pertempuran. Jumlah HP yang dipulihkan dihitung berdasarkan Max HP Sangonomiya Kokomi.

talents.name: Nereid's Ascension
talents.description:
Summons the might of Watatsumi, dealing Hydro DMG to surrounding opponents, before robing Kokomi in a Ceremonial Garment made from the flowing waters of Sangonomiya.

Ceremonial Garment
·Sangonomiya Kokomi's Normal Attack, Charged Attack and Bake-Kurage DMG are increased based on her Max HP.
·When her Normal and Charged Attacks hit opponents, Kokomi will restore HP for all nearby party members, and the amount restored is based on her Max HP.
·Increases Sangonomiya Kokomi's resistance to interruption and allows her to walk on the water's surface.

These effects will be cleared once Sangonomiya Kokomi leaves the field.
talents.descriptionId:
Memanggil kekuatan Watatsumi dan mengakibatkan Hydro DMG pada musuh di sekitar, kemudian menyelimuti Kokomi dengan Ceremonial Garment yang tercipta dari aliran air Sangonomiya.

Ceremonial Garment
·Meningkatkan DMG Normal dan Charged Attack, serta DMG Bake-Kurage berdasarkan Max HP Sangonomiya Kokomi.
·Saat Normal dan Charged Attack mengenai musuh, Sangonomiya Kokomi akan memulihkan HP seluruh anggota party yang berada di sekitar berdasarkan Max HP miliknya.
·Meningkatkan ketahanan Sangonomiya Kokomi terhadap interupsi dan membuat Kokomi dapat berjalan di atas permukaan air.

Efek ini akan hilang jika Kokomi meninggalkan medan pertempuran.

passives.name: Tamakushi Casket
passives.description: If Sangonomiya Kokomi's own Bake-Kurage is on the field when she uses Nereid's Ascension, the Bake-Kurage's duration will be refreshed.
passives.descriptionId: Saat Kokomi melancarkan Nereid's Ascension, jika Bake-Kurage milik Sangonomiya Kokomi sendiri masih berada di medan pertempuran, durasi Bake-Kurage tersebut akan diperbarui.

passives.name: Song of Pearls
passives.description: While donning the Ceremonial Garment created by Nereid's Ascension, the Normal and Charged Attack DMG Bonus Sangonomiya Kokomi gains based on her Max HP will receive a further increase based on 15% of her Healing Bonus.
passives.descriptionId: Saat mengenakan Ceremonial Garment dari skill Nereid's Ascension, Bonus DMG Normal dan Charged Attack yang didapatkan Sangonomiya Kokomi berdasarkan Max HP-nya akan meningkat lagi sebesar 15% dari Healing Bonus Kokomi.

passives.name: Princess of Watatsumi
passives.description:
Decreases swimming Stamina consumption for your own party members by 20%.
Not stackable with Passive Talents that provide the exact same effects.
passives.descriptionId:
Mengurangi 20% konsumsi Stamina Karakter party sendiri saat berenang.
Efek ini tidak dapat ditumpuk dengan Talenta Pasif lain dengan efek yang sama persis.

passives.name: Flawless Strategy
passives.description: Sangonomiya Kokomi has a 25% Healing Bonus, but a 100% decrease in CRIT Rate.
passives.descriptionId: Meningkatkan 25% Healing Bonus Sangonomiya Kokomi, tetapi CRIT Rate Kokomi berkurang 100%.

constellations.name: At Water's Edge
constellations.description:
While donning the Ceremonial Garment created by Nereid's Ascension, the final Normal Attack in Sangonomiya Kokomi's combo will unleash a swimming fish to deal 30% of her Max HP as Hydro DMG.
This DMG is not considered Normal Attack DMG.
constellations.descriptionId:
Saat mengenakan Ceremonial Garment dari skill Nereid's Ascension, serangan terakhir dari kombo Normal Attack Sangonomiya Kokomi akan memunculkan seekor ikan yang berenang dan mengakibatkan Hydro DMG sebesar 30% dari Max HP Kokomi.
DMG ini tidak dianggap sebagai DMG Normal Attack.

constellations.name: The Clouds Like Waves Rippling
constellations.description:
Sangonomiya Kokomi gains the following Healing Bonuses with regard to characters with 50% or less HP via the following methods:
·Kurage's Oath Bake-Kurage: 4.5% of Kokomi's Max HP.
·Nereid's Ascension Normal and Charged Attacks: 0.6% of Kokomi's Max HP.
constellations.descriptionId:
Saat memulihkan Karakter dengan HP kurang dari 50% dengan cara-cara di bawah, Sangonomiya Kokomi akan mendapatkan bonus pemulihan berdasarkan Max HP dirinya:
·Bake-Kurage dari Kurage's Oath: 4,5% dari Max HP Kokomi.
·Normal dan Charged Attack Nereid's Ascension: 0,6% dari Max HP Kokomi.

constellations.name: The Moon, A Ship O'er the Seas
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Nereid's Ascension by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.descriptionId:
Meningkatkan 3 level Nereid's Ascension.
Maksimum: Lv. 15.

constellations.name: The Moon Overlooks the Waters
constellations.description:
While donning the Ceremonial Garment created by Nereid's Ascension, Sangonomiya Kokomi's Normal Attack SPD is increased by 10%, and Normal Attacks that hit opponents will restore 0.8 Energy for her.
This effect can occur once every 0.2s.
constellations.descriptionId:
Saat mengenakan Ceremonial Garment dari skill Nereid's Ascension, Normal Attack SPD Sangonomiya Kokomi meningkat 10% dan Normal Attack yang mengenai musuh akan memulihkan 0,8 Energy.
Efek ini dapat terpicu setiap 0,2 detik.

constellations.name: All Streams Flow to the Sea
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Kurage's Oath by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.descriptionId:
Meningkatkan 3 level Kurage's Oath.
Maksimum: Lv. 15.

constellations.name: Sango Isshin
constellations.description: While donning the Ceremonial Garment created by Nereid's Ascension, Sangonomiya Kokomi gains a 40% Hydro DMG Bonus for 4s when her Normal and Charged Attacks heal, or would heal, any party member with 80% or more HP.
constellations.descriptionId: Saat mengenakan Ceremonial Garment dari skill Nereid's Ascension, dan ketika Normal atau Charged Attack Sangonomiya Kokomi melakukan pemulihan atau berusaha memulihkan HP Karakter di dalam party dengan HP 80% atau lebih, maka Sangonomiya Kokomi akan mendapatkan 40% Hydro DMG Bonus selama 4 detik.

name: Shenhe
title: Lonesome Transcendence
description: An adepti disciple with a most unusual air about her. Having spent much time cultivating in isolation in Liyue's mountains, she has become every bit as cool and distant as the adepti themselves.
descriptionId: Seorang murid Adeptus dengan temperamen yang sedikit unik. Karena sudah lama hidup terisolasi di pegunungan Liyue, sifatnya juga menjadi acuh tak acuh dan menjaga jarak seperti para Adeptus.

talents.name: Dawnstar Piercer
talents.description:
Normal Attack
Performs up to 5 consecutive spear strikes.

Charged Attack
Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to lunge forward, dealing damage to opponents along the way.

Plunging Attack
Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground below, damaging opponents along the path and dealing AoE DMG upon impact.
talents.descriptionId:
Normal Attack
Melancarkan hingga 5 serangan berturut-turut menggunakan tombak.

Charged Attack
Mengonsumsi sejumlah Stamina untuk menerjang ke depan, mengakibatkan DMG pada musuh di jalurnya.

Plunging Attack
Menerjang dari udara untuk menghantam tanah, menyerang musuh di jalur terjangan dan mengakibatkan DMG area saat mendarat.

talents.name: Spring Spirit Summoning
talents.description:
The frosted dew, silvery and dense, shall exorcise all demons.
Grants all nearby party members the Icy Quill effect and deals Cryo DMG in different ways based on whether it is pressed or held.

Press
Rushes forward together with a Talisman Spirit, dealing Cryo DMG to opponents along the path.

Hold
Commands the Talisman Spirit to deal AoE Cryo DMG.

Icy Quill
When Normal, Charged, and Plunging Attacks, Elemental Skills, and Elemental Bursts deal Cryo DMG to opponents, the DMG dealt is increased based on Shenhe's current ATK.

The Icy Quill's effects will be cleared once its duration ends or after being triggered a certain number of times. When held rather than pressed, the Icy Quill's effect lasts longer and can be triggered more times.
When one Cryo DMG instance strikes multiple opponents, the effect is triggered multiple times based on the number of opponents hit. The number of times the effect is triggered is calculated independently for each party member with the Icy Quill.
talents.descriptionId:
Memadatkan embun beku perak untuk mengusir semua iblis.
Memberikan efek "Icy Quill" pada seluruh anggota party di sekitar dan mengakibatkan Cryo DMG berdasarkan cara skill dilancarkan, yaitu ditekan atau ditahan.

Mode Tekan
Menerjang ke arah depan bersama "Talisman Spirit" dan mengakibatkan Cryo DMG pada musuh yang berada di jalur serangan.

Mode Tahan
Memerintahkan Talisman Spirit untuk mengakibatkan Cryo DMG Area.

Icy Quill
Saat Normal Attack, Charged Attack, Plunging Attack, Elemental Skill, dan Elemental Burst mengakibatkan Cryo DMG kepada musuh, DMG yang diakibatkan akan meningkat sesuai dengan ATK Shenhe saat ini.

Efek Icy Quill akan hilang setelah durasinya berakhir atau lapisannya terkonsumsi dalam jumlah tertentu. Icy Quill yang dilancarkan dengan Mode Tahan akan memiliki durasi lebih lama dan jumlah lapisan lebih banyak.
Saat satu serangan Cryo DMG mengenai beberapa musuh secara bersamaan, jumlah lapisan Icy Quill yang dikonsumsi akan disesuaikan dengan jumlah musuh yang terkena serangan. Efek dan jumlah lapisan Icy Quill untuk setiap Karakter dalam party akan dihitung secara terpisah.

talents.name: Divine Maiden's Deliverance
talents.description:
Unleashes the power of the Talisman Spirit, allowing it to roam free in this plane, dealing AoE Cryo DMG.
The Talisman Spirit then creates a field that decreases the Cryo RES and Physical RES of opponents within it. It also deals periodic Cryo DMG to opponents within the field.
talents.descriptionId:
Melepaskan kekuatan Talisman Spirit, membiarkannya bergerak bebas di dunia ini, dan mengakibatkan Cryo DMG Area.
Talisman Spirit akan menciptakan sebuah area yang mengurangi Cryo RES dan Physical RES musuh yang berada di dalamnya. Selama durasinya, area ini terus mengakibatkan Cryo DMG kepada musuh yang berada di dalamnya.

passives.name: Deific Embrace
passives.description: An active character within the field created by Divine Maiden's Deliverance gains 15% Cryo DMG Bonus.
passives.descriptionId: Karakter aktif yang berada di dalam area Divine Maiden's Deliverance akan mendapatkan 15% Cryo DMG Bonus.

passives.name: Spirit Communion Seal
passives.description:
After Shenhe uses Spring Spirit Summoning, she will grant all nearby party members the following effects:
· Press: Elemental Skill and Elemental Burst DMG increased by 15% for 10s.
· Hold: Normal, Charged, and Plunging Attack DMG increased by 15% for 15s.
passives.descriptionId:
Setelah Shenhe melancarkan Spring Spirit Summoning, anggota party di sekitar akan mendapatkan efek berikut:
·Mode Tekan: Meningkatkan 15% DMG Elemental Skill dan Elemental Burst selama 10 detik.
·Mode Tahan: Meningkatkan 15% DMG Normal Attack, Charged Attack, dan Plunging Attack selama 15 detik.

passives.name: Precise Comings and Goings
passives.description: Gains 25% more rewards when dispatched on a Liyue Expedition for 20 hours.
passives.descriptionId: Ketika dikirim untuk melakukan ekspedisi di Liyue selama 20 jam, hadiah yang didapatkan akan bertambah 25%.

constellations.name: Clarity of Heart
constellations.description: Spring Spirit Summoning can be used 1 more time.
constellations.descriptionId: Jumlah penggunaan Spring Spirit Summoning bertambah 1 kali.

constellations.name: Centered Spirit
constellations.description: Divine Maiden's Deliverance lasts for 6 seconds longer. Active characters within the skill's field deal 15% increased Cryo CRIT DMG.
constellations.descriptionId: Durasi Divine Maiden's Deliverance diperpanjang 6 detik. CRIT DMG dari Cryo DMG untuk Karakter aktif yang berada di dalam area meningkat 15%.

constellations.name: Seclusion
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Spring Spirit Summoning by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.descriptionId:
Meningkatkan 3 level Spring Spirit Summoning.
Maksimum: Lv. 15.

constellations.name: Insight
constellations.description:
When characters under the effect of Icy Quill applied by Shenhe trigger its DMG Bonus effects, Shenhe will gain a Skyfrost Mantra stack:
