· When Shenhe uses Spring Spirit Summoning, she will consume all stacks of Skyfrost Mantra, increasing the DMG of that Spring Spirit Summoning by 5% for each stack consumed.
· Max 50 stacks. Stacks last for 60s.
constellations.descriptionId:
Saat Karakter yang berada dalam status Icy Quill dari Shenhe sendiri memicu Bonus DMG dari Icy Quill, Shenhe akan mendapatkan 1 lapis Skyfrost Mantra:
·Saat Shenhe melancarkan Spring Spirit Summoning, dia akan mengonsumsi semua lapisan Skyfrost Mantra dan meningkatkan DMG yang diakibatkan oleh Spring Spirit Summoning sebesar 5% untuk setiap lapisan yang dikonsumsi.
·Efek ini dapat ditumpuk hingga 50 lapis dan berlangsung selama 60 detik.

constellations.name: Divine Attainment
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Divine Maiden's Deliverance by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.descriptionId:
Meningkatkan 3 level Divine Maiden's Deliverance.
Maksimum: Lv. 15.

constellations.name: Mystical Abandon
constellations.description: When characters trigger Icy Quill's effects using Normal and Charged Attack DMG, it does not count toward the Trigger Quota.
constellations.descriptionId: Saat Karakter memicu efek Icy Quill melalui DMG Normal Attack dan Charged Attack, jumlah lapisan Icy Quill tidak akan berkurang.

name: Sigewinne
title: Wondrous Dragonheir
description: A Melusine and the Fortress of Meropide's head nurse. She cares equally for every convict locked in the undersea prison.
descriptionId: Seorang Melusine sekaligus suster kepala di Benteng Meropide. Dia memperlakukan setiap tahanan di penjara bawah air dengan adil.

talents.name: Targeted Treatment
talents.description:
Normal Attack
Performs up to 3 consecutive attacks.

Charged Attack
Performs a more precise Aimed Shot with increased DMG.
While aiming, the power of Hydro will continually accumulate on the arrow. After fully charging, Sigewinne will periodically fire slow-moving Mini-Stration Bubbles toward the target, dealing Hydro DMG. When released, an arrow imbued with torrential energy will deal Hydro DMG to the opponent hit.

Plunging Attack
Fires off a shower of arrows in mid-air before falling and striking the ground, dealing AoE DMG upon impact.
talents.descriptionId:
Normal Attack
Melancarkan hingga 3 serangan berturut-turut.

Charged Attack
Melancarkan sebuah Serangan Membidik yang lebih akurat untuk mengakibatkan DMG lebih besar.
Saat membidik, kekuatan Hydro akan berkumpul di ujung anak panah. Setelah Charge selesai, setiap kurun waktu tertentu, Sigewinne akan menembakkan Mini-Stration Bubble yang bergerak perlahan ke arah musuh dan mengakibatkan Hydro DMG. Saat dilepaskan, anak panah yang dipenuhi arus air akan mengakibatkan Hydro DMG saat mengenai musuh.

Plunging Attack
Melancarkan hujan panah dari udara dan menerjang tanah dengan kecepatan tinggi, mengakibatkan DMG Area saat mendarat.

talents.name: Rebound Hydrotherapy
talents.description:
Blows a Bolstering Bubblebalm that can stimulate blood flow and help patients drift off to sleep using a bubblegun specially made in the Fortress of Meropide.
Bolstering Bubblebalms will bounce between nearby opponents, dealing Hydro DMG based on Sigewinne's max HP to opponents it hits. When it bounces, it will restore HP to all nearby party members except Sigewinne herself. The amount healed is based on Sigewinne's max HP.
After bouncing 5 times, the Bolstering Bubblebalm will disappear and restore HP to Sigewinne based on her max HP value.
When no opponents are present, the Bolstering Bubblebalm will bounce nearby. Only one Bolstering Bubblebalm created by a Sigewinne may exist at once.
When Held, the Bolstering Bubblebalm can be boosted to an even bigger size.

Hold
Enter Aiming Mode to begin blowing an even bigger, even more breathtaking Bolstering Bubblebalm!
The Bolstering Bubblebalm will grow bigger the longer the skill is Held, until it grows up to two tiers in size. Each tier it grows increases its DMG by 5% and healing by 5%. When a Bolstering Bubblebalm bounces, it will drop down a tier in size, until it returns to being a normal Bolstering Bubblebalm.
After weaker opponents are hit by big Bolstering Bubblebalms, they will be imprisoned and will be unable to move.

In addition, 2 Sourcewater Droplets will be created near Sigewinne when she uses this Skill. Each Sourcewater Droplet Sigewinne collects will grant her a Bond of Life worth 10% of her Max HP.
When Sigewinne's Bond of Life is cleared, she regains 1 Elemental Energy for every 2,000 HP worth of the Bond of Life that was cleared. Sigewinne can regain up to 5 Elemental Energy in this way.

Arkhe: Ousia
Bolstering Bubblebalms periodically call down a Surging Blade on the position they hit, dealing Ousia-aligned Hydro DMG based on Sigewinne's max HP.
talents.descriptionId:
Sigewinne menggunakan senapan gelembung yang dibuat khusus di Benteng Meropide untuk mengembuskan Bolstering Bubblebalm yang bisa merangsang peredaran darah dan membuat pasien tertidur pulas.
Bolstering Bubblebalm akan melambung di antara musuh-musuh sekitar. Saat mengenai musuh, akan mengakibatkan Hydro DMG yang didasarkan pada Max HP Sigewinne. Saat melambung, akan memulihkan HP seluruh anggota party di sekitar (selain Sigewinne sendiri) yang jumlah pemulihannya didasarkan pada Max HP Sigewinne. 
Setelah melambung 5 kali, Bolstering Bubblebalm akan hilang dan akan memulihkan HP Sigewinne berdasarkan Max HP-nya.
Saat tidak ada musuh, Bolstering Bubblebalm akan melambung di area sekitar. Maksimum hanya satu Bolstering Bubblebalm yang bisa diciptakan oleh Sigewinne sendiri pada waktu yang bersamaan.
Jika tombol Skill ditahan, Sigewinne akan melakukan Charge sebelum melancarkan Bolstering Bubblebalm.

Mode Tahan
Memasuki Mode Membidik dan melakukan Charge, lalu mengembuskan Bolstering Bubblebalm yang lebih besar dan lebih kuat!
Bolstering Bubblebalm akan menjadi semakin besar seiring durasi tombol Skill ditahan, dapat membesar hingga dua level. Untuk setiap peningkatan level, DMG saat mengenai musuh akan meningkat 5% dan jumlah pemulihan HP-nya meningkat 5%. Setiap kali melambung, Bolstering Bubblebalm besar ini akan mengecil 1 level sampai menjadi Bolstering Bubblebalm biasa.
Jika musuh yang relatif lemah terkena Bolstering Bubblebalm besar, musuh tersebut akan terperangkap dan tidak bisa bergerak.

Selain itu saat Skill ini dilancarkan, akan tercipta 2 Sourcewater Droplet di sekitar Sigewinne. Untuk setiap satu Sourcewater Droplet yang diserap, akan memberikan Bond of Life kepada Sigewinne sebesar 10% Max HP-nya.
Saat Bond of Life milik Sigewinne dihapus, setiap 2.000 poin Bond of Life yang dihapus akan memulihkan 1 poin Energy untuknya. Pemulihan Energy yang bisa diperoleh Sigewinne dengan cara ini adalah maksimum 5 poin Energy.

Arkhe: Ousia
Setiap satu kurun waktu tertentu, Bolstering Bubblebalm akan menjatuhkan Surging Blade di posisi target dan menyebabkan Ousia-aligned Hydro DMG yang didasarkan pada Max HP Sigewinne

talents.name: Super Saturated Syringing
talents.description:
Takes out a special Fortress of Meropide-made syringe and assault the area in front with waves of kindness and medicine, dealing AoE Hydro DMG based on Sigewinne's max HP.
In addition, Sigewinne absorbs up to 2 nearby Sourcewater Droplets within a certain range when she uses this skill.
talents.descriptionId:
Sigewinne mengeluarkan alat suntik yang khusus dibuat di Benteng Meropide kemudian menerjang ke depan dengan kekuatan kebaikan dan obat-obatan. Sigewinne akan terus-menerus mengakibatkan Hydro DMG Area yang didasarkan pada Max HP Sigewinne.
Selain itu, saat dilancarkan, Sigewinne akan menyerap maksimum 2 Sourcewater Droplet yang berada dalam radius tertentu di sekitarnya.

passives.name: Requires Appropriate Rest
passives.description: Sigewinne grants herself the "Semi-Strict Bedrest" effect for 18s after using Rebound Hydrotherapy: Sigewinne gains an 8% Hydro DMG Bonus and 10 stacks of Convalescence. When the Elemental Skills of your nearby off-field party members other than Sigewinne deal DMG, consume 1 stack of Convalescence, and increase the DMG dealt by this instance of Elemental Skill DMG. Every 1,000 Max HP Sigewinne has above 30,000 increases the DMG by 80. The maximum DMG increase for Elemental Skills that can be gained in this way is 2,800.
passives.descriptionId: Saat melancarkan Rebound Hydrotherapy, Sigewinne memberikan efek "Semi-Strict Bedrest" yang berlangsung 18 detik kepada dirinya sendiri: Selama berlangsung, Sigewinne mendapatkan 8% Hydro DMG Bonus dan 10 lapis Convalescence. Saat Elemental Skill Karakter yang ada di dalam party namun sedang tidak berada di medan pertempuran selain Sigewinne sendiri mengakibatkan DMG, akan mengonsumsi 1 lapis Convalescence dan meningkatkan DMG Elemental Skill kali ini: Untuk setiap 1.000 poin HP Sigewinne yang melebihi 30.000, DMG meningkat 80 poin. Maksimum peningkatan DMG Elemental Skill kali ini yang bisa diperoleh dengan cara ini adalah 2.800 poin.

passives.name: Detailed Diagnosis, Thorough Treatment
passives.description: When Sigewinne performs healing, the amount healed for this instance is increased based on the total current value of the Bonds of Life on all party members: For each 1,000 HP worth of Bonds of Life, the outgoing healing is increased by 3%. The amount of healing provided can be increased by up to 30% in this way.
passives.descriptionId: Saat Sigewinne memberikan pemulihan HP, akan meningkatkan jumlah pemulihan HP kali ini berdasarkan total Bond of Life yang dimiliki seluruh anggota party saat ini: Untuk setiap 1.000 poin Bond of Life, akan meningkatkan 3% jumlah pemulihan HP-nya. Peningkatan pemulihan HP yang bisa diperoleh dengan cara ini maksimum 30%.

passives.name: Emergency Dose
passives.description: While underwater, heals your active character over 2.5s when their HP falls under 50%. The amount healed is equal to 50% of their Max HP, and their All Elemental and Physical RES will be decreased by 10% for 10s. This effect can be triggered up to once every 20s.
passives.descriptionId: Saat berada di dalam air, jika HP Karakter aktif diri sendiri berada di bawah 50%, maka akan memulihkan HP-nya setiap 2,5 detik. Total HP yang dipulihkan sama dengan 50% Max HP-nya, tetapi selama 10 detik berikutnya, Elemental RES dari semua elemen dan Physical RES Karakter akan berkurang 10%. Efek ini dapat terpicu sekali setiap 20 detik.

constellations.name: "Can the Happiest of Spirits Understand Anxiety?"
constellations.description:
Rebound Hydrotherapy's Bolstering Bubblebalm can bounce 3 extra times, and the first 3 bounces will not cause big Bubblebalms to become smaller.
The Ascension Talent "Requires Appropriate Rest" is enhanced: Each Bubblebalm bounce adds 1 stack to her Convalescence tally, and the values for the Convalescence stacks' DMG bonus will be modified to: Every 1,000 max HP Sigewinne has above 30,000 increases the DMG by 100. The maximum DMG increase for Elemental Skills that can be gained in this way is 3,500. You must first unlock the Ascension Talent "Requires Appropriate Rest."
constellations.descriptionId:
Bolstering Bubblebalm dari Rebound Hydrotherapy bisa melambung 3 kali lebih banyak. Tiga lambungan pertama tidak akan membuat Bubblebalm besarnya mengecil.
Selain itu, efek Talenta Ascension "Requires Appropriate Rest" diperkuat: Setiap Bolstering Bubblebalm melambung, akan memberikan 1 lapis Convalescence untuk Sigewinne, dan mengubah efek Convalescence menjadi: Untuk setiap 1.000 poin HP Sigewinne yang melebihi 30.000, DMG meningkat 100 poin. Maksimum peningkatan DMG Elemental Skill yang bisa diperoleh dengan cara ini adalah 3.500 poin. Harus membuka Talenta Ascension "Requires Appropriate Rest" terlebih dahulu.

constellations.name: "Can the Most Merciful of Spirits Defeat Its Foes?"
constellations.description:
When using Rebound Hydrotherapy and Super Saturated Syringing, Sigewinne can create a Bubbly Shield worth 30% of her Max HP that absorbs Hydro DMG with 250% efficiency. The Bubbly Shield will persist until Sigewinne finishes using relevant skills.
Additionally, after Rebound Hydrotherapy's Bolstering Bubblebalm or Super Saturated Syringing hits an opponent, that opponent's Hydro RES will be decreased by 35% for 8s.
constellations.descriptionId:
Saat melancarkan Rebound Hydrotherapy dan Super Saturated Syringing, akan menghasilkan 1 Perisai gelembung yang bisa menyerap Hydro DMG sebesar 30% Max HP dan memiliki 250% efisiensi ketahanan, efek ini berlangsung sampai Skill ini selesai dilancarkan.
Selain itu, setelah Bolstering Bubblebalm dari Rebound Hydrotherapy melambung atau setelah Super Saturated Syringing mengenai musuh, Hydro RES musuh ini berkurang 35% selama 8 detik.

constellations.name: "Can the Healthiest of Spirits Cure Fevers?"
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Rebound Hydrotherapy by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.descriptionId:
Meningkatkan 3 level Rebound Hydrotherapy.
Maksimum: Lv. 15.

constellations.name: "Can the Loveliest of Spirits Keep Decay at Bay?"
constellations.description: The duration of Super Saturated Syringing is extended by 3s.
constellations.descriptionId: Durasi Super Saturated Syringing diperpanjang selama 3 detik.

constellations.name: "Can the Most Joyful of Spirits Alleviate Agony?"
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Super Saturated Syringing by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.descriptionId:
Meningkatkan 3 level Super Saturated Syringing.
Maksimum: Lv. 15.

constellations.name: "Can the Most Radiant of Spirits Pray For Me?"
constellations.description: When Sigewinne performs healing, she will increase the CRIT Rate and CRIT DMG of her Super Saturated Syringing based on her Max HP. Every 1,000 Max HP she has will increase CRIT Rate by 0.4% and CRIT DMG by 2.2% for 15s. The maximum increase achievable this way is 20% CRIT Rate and 110% CRIT DMG.
constellations.descriptionId: Saat Sigewinne memberikan pemulihan HP, akan meningkatkan CRIT Rate dan CRIT DMG dari Super Saturated Syringing berdasarkan Max HP-nya: Untuk setiap 1.000 poin Max HP, akan meningkatkan 0,4% CRIT Rate dan 2,2% CRIT DMG selama 15 detik. Maksimum peningkatan yang bisa diperoleh dengan cara ini adalah 20% CRIT Rate dan 110% CRIT DMG.

name: Skirk
title: Void Star
description: A visitor who once appeared in an Abyssal rift and the Primordial Sea, this solitary warrior mentored Tartaglia in the martial arts.
descriptionId: Seorang pengunjung yang pernah muncul di celah Abyss dan Lautan Primordial. Petarung yang selalu menyendiri ini adalah guru Tartaglia dalam ilmu bela diri.

talents.name: Havoc: Sunder
talents.description:
Normal Attack
Performs up to 5 consecutive attacks.

Charged Attack
Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to hurl a spinning crystal spear, dealing DMG to opponents ahead.

Plunging Attack
Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground below, damaging opponents along the path and dealing AoE DMG upon impact.
talents.descriptionId:
Normal Attack
Melancarkan hingga 5 serangan berturut-turut.

Charged Attack
Mengonsumsi sejumlah Stamina untuk melemparkan tombak kristal berputar dan mengakibatkan DMG pada musuh di depan.

Plunging Attack
Menerjang dari udara untuk menghantam tanah, menyerang musuh di jalur terjangan dan mengakibatkan DMG Area saat mendarat.

talents.name: Havoc: Warp
talents.description:
Imitates the combat style of "The Foul." Produces different effects depending on whether you Tap or Hold.

Tap
Skirk gains 45 **Serpent's Subtlety** and switches to **Seven-Phase Flash** mode.

Hold
Skirk gains 45 Serpent's Subtlety and will continuously move at high speed. Her interruption resistance is increased in this state.
During this time, Skirk can control her movement direction and move atop water. She can also use this Skill again to end rapid movement prematurely.
talents.descriptionId:
Meniru gaya pertempuran "The Foul", dan menghasilkan efek yang berbeda berdasarkan Mode Tekan atau Mode Tahan.

Mode Tekan
Skirk mendapatkan 45 poin **Serpent's Subtlety** dan beralih ke mode **Seven-Phase Flash**.

Mode Tahan
Skirk mendapatkan 45 poin Serpent's Subtlety dan terus bergerak dengan cepat. Dalam status ini, ketahanan Skirk terhadap interupsi juga akan meningkat.
Dalam status ini, Skirk dapat mengontrol arah pergerakannya dan bergerak di atas air. Lancarkan Elemental Skill sekali lagi untuk mengakhiri status bergerak cepat ini lebih awal.

talents.name: Havoc: Ruin
talents.description:
Skirk's Elemental Burst is not reliant on Elemental Energy but instead on **Serpent's Subtlety**.
When Skirk has at least 50 Serpent's Subtlety, she can expend all her Serpent's Subtlety to unleash her Elemental Burst, ripping the space before her apart and using rapid consecutive slashes that deal AoE Cryo DMG. At the same time, the DMG dealt by an instance of this Elemental Burst will be increased by every point of Serpent's Subtlety over 50 when it is unleashed. Up to 12 points can be counted for this purpose.

When Skirk is in **Seven-Phase Flash** mode, Havoc: Ruin will be replaced by Havoc: Extinction.

Havoc: Extinction
A special Elemental Burst that can be used even without consuming Serpent's Subtlety.
After using it, Skirk will gain the "All Shall Wither" effect, which will last until Seven-Phase Flash ends. After unlocking the Ascension Talent **Reason Beyond Reason**, she can also absorb nearby Void Rifts.
While "All Shall Wither" is active, every 0.1s, after Skirk's Normal Attack hits an opponent, that Normal Attack will deal increased DMG. If she absorbed any Void Rifts while using Havoc: Extinction, this Normal Attack's DMG will be further increased based on the number of Rifts absorbed.
This effect will be canceled when it has triggered 10 times.
talents.descriptionId:
Elemental Burst Skirk tidak menggunakan Energy, melainkan menggunakan **Serpent's Subtlety**.
Saat Skirk memiliki minimal 50 poin Serpent's Subtlety, Skirk dapat mengonsumsi seluruh Serpent's Subtlety untuk melancarkan Elemental Burst, mengoyak ruang di hadapannya dan melancarkan tebasan beruntun secara cepat yang mengakibatkan Cryo DMG Area. Di saat yang sama, DMG yang diakibatkan Elemental Burst kali ini akan meningkat berdasarkan jumlah poin Serpent's Subtlety yang melebihi 50 poin. Setiap 1 poinnya akan meningkatkan DMG Elemental Burst kali ini. Peningkatan DMG ini hanya bisa menghitung maksimum 12 poin Serpent's Subtlety.

Saat Skirk berada dalam mode **Seven-Phase Flash**, Havoc: Ruin akan berubah menjadi Havoc: Extinction.

Havoc: Extinction
Elemental Burst spesial yang bisa dilancarkan tanpa mengonsumsi Serpent's Subtlety.
Setelah dilancarkan, Skirk akan mendapatkan efek "All Shall Wither" yang berlangsung hingga mode Seven-Phase Flash berakhir. Setelah membuka Talenta Ascension **Reason Beyond Reason**, dia juga bisa menyerap Void Rift yang ada di sekitarnya dalam radius tertentu.
Selama efek "All Shall Wither" berlangsung, setiap 0,1 detik, Normal Attack Skirk yang mengenai musuh akan mendapatkan peningkatan DMG. Jika Skirk menyerap Void Rift saat melancarkan Havoc: Extinction, maka DMG Normal Attack kali ini akan meningkat lebih lanjut berdasarkan jumlah Void Rift yang diserap.
Efek ini akan hilang setelah terpicu 10 kali.

passives.name: Reason Beyond Reason
passives.description:
When nearby party members trigger Frozen, Superconduct, Stellar-Conduct, Cryo Swirl, Stellar Swirl, or Cryo Crystallize reactions against opponents, a Void Rift will be created near this opponent. This effect can be triggered once every 2.5s. 3 Void Rifts created by Skirk herself can exist on the field at once.

Skirk can use the following methods to absorb nearby Void Rifts:
· When she hits an opponent with a Charged Attack in her **Seven-Phase Flash** mode.
· When she uses the special Elemental Burst Havoc: Extinction while in Seven-Phase Flash mode.
· When she Holds her Elemental Skill Havoc: Warp to engage in rapid movement.

Each Rift absorbed will grant her 8 **Serpent's Subtlety** points.
passives.descriptionId:
Saat Karakter party di sekitar memicu reaksi Frozen, Superconduct, Stellar-Conduct, Cryo Swirl, Stellar Swirl, atau Cryo Crystallize terhadap musuh, akan tercipta sebuah Void Rift di sekitar musuh tersebut. Efek ini dapat terpicu sekali setiap 2,5 detik, dan Skirk sendiri hanya dapat menciptakan maksimum 3 Void Rift di medan pertempuran dalam waktu bersamaan.

Skirk bisa menyerap Void Rift di sekitarnya dengan cara berikut:
·Saat Charged Attack yang dilancarkan Skirk dalam mode **Seven-Phase Flash** mengenai musuh.
·Saat melancarkan Elemental Burst spesial Havoc: Extinction dalam mode Seven-Phase Flash.
·Saat menahan tombol Elemental Skill Havoc: Warp untuk bergerak dengan cepat.

Setiap Void Rift yang diserap akan memberikan Skirk 8 poin **Serpent's Subtlety**.

passives.name: Return to Oblivion
passives.description:
When nearby Hydro party members' Hydro attacks hit opponents, or when nearby Cryo party members apart from Skirk hit opponents with Cryo attacks, Skirk will gain the "Death's Crossing" effect for 20s. Max 3 stacks, each stack's duration is counted independently.
Each character can grant Skirk at most 1 "Death's Crossing" stack by this means.
Each "Death's Crossing" stack increases the Normal Attack DMG dealt by Skirk in **Seven-Phase Flash** mode to 110%/120%/170% of its original DMG and the DMG dealt when using her Elemental Burst Havoc: Ruin to 105%/115%/160% of its original DMG.
passives.descriptionId:
Saat serangan Hydro milik Karakter Hydro dalam party di sekitar mengenai musuh, atau saat serangan Cryo milik Karakter Cryo dalam party di sekitar mengenai musuh, maka Skirk akan mendapatkan satu lapis efek "Death's Crossing" selama 20 detik. "Death's Crossing" dapat ditumpuk hingga 3 lapis dan durasi setiap lapisannya dihitung terpisah.
Setiap Karakter hanya bisa memberikan efek Death's Crossing sebanyak 1 kali kepada Skirk dengan cara ini.
Setiap lapis Death's Crossing memberikan efek: Normal Attack Skirk dalam mode **Seven-Phase Flash** akan mengakibatkan 110%/120%/170% dari DMG awalnya, Elemental Burst Havoc: Ruin juga mengakibatkan 105%/115%/160% dari DMG awalnya.

passives.name: Mutual Weapons Mentorship
passives.description: When all party members are either Hydro or Cryo, and if there is at least 1 Hydro and 1 Cryo character, your own party members' Elemental Skill Level is increased by 1.
passives.descriptionId: Saat jenis elemen seluruh anggota party adalah Hydro atau Cryo, dan setidaknya ada 1 Karakter Hydro dan Cryo, maka level Elemental Skill milik Karakter sendiri di dalam party meningkat 1 level.

constellations.name: Far to Fall
constellations.description:
Enhances the effects of the Ascension Talent **Reason Beyond Reason**: Every Void Rift absorbed will summon a crystal blade to attack nearby opponents, dealing 500% of Skirk's ATK as Cryo DMG. This DMG is considered Charged Attack DMG.
You must first unlock the Ascension Talent Reason Beyond Reason.
constellations.descriptionId:
Efek Talenta Ascension **Reason Beyond Reason** diperkuat: Untuk setiap Void Rift yang diserap, Skirk akan memanggil pedang kristal untuk menyerang musuh di sekitarnya, mengakibatkan Cryo DMG sebesar 500% ATK Skirk. DMG ini dianggap sebagai DMG Charged Attack.
Harus membuka Talenta Ascension "Reason Beyond Reason" terlebih dahulu.

constellations.name: Into the Abyss
constellations.description:
After unleashing her Elemental Skill Havoc: Warp, Skirk will gain 10 additional **Serpent's Subtlety** points.
When using her Elemental Burst Havoc: Ruin, the DMG of this Elemental Burst instance will be increased by taking up to 10 more Serpent's Subtlety points into account.
Additionally, within 12.5s after Skirk unleashes the special Elemental Burst Havoc: Extinction while in her **Seven-Phase Flash** mode, her ATK is increased by 70%. This effect will be canceled when she leaves the Seven-Phase Flash mode.
constellations.descriptionId:
Setelah melancarkan Elemental Skill Havoc: Warp, Skirk akan mendapatkan 10 poin **Serpent's Subtlety** tambahan.
Saat melancarkan Elemental Burst Havoc: Ruin, efek peningkatan DMG berdasarkan jumlah Serpent's Subtlety untuk Elemental Burst kali ini dapat menghitung hingga 10 poin Serpent's Subtlety tambahan.
Selain itu, dalam 12,5 detik setelah Skirk melancarkan Elemental Burst spesial Havoc: Extinction dalam mode **Seven-Phase Flash**, ATK-nya akan meningkat 70%. Efek ini akan hilang saat Skirk meninggalkan mode Seven-Phase Flash.

constellations.name: Serendipitous Sin
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of **Havoc: Ruin** by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.descriptionId:
Meningkatkan 3 level **Havoc: Ruin**.
Maksimum: Lv. 15.

constellations.name: Fractured Flow
constellations.description:
Enhances the effects of the Ascension Talent **Return to Oblivion**: Each Death's Crossing stack also increases Skirk's ATK by 10%/20%/40%.
You must first unlock the Ascension Talent Return to Oblivion.
constellations.descriptionId:
Efek Talenta Ascension **Return to Oblivion** mendapatkan peningkatan: Setiap lapis efek Death's Crossing juga akan meningkatkan 10%/20%/40% ATK Skirk.
Harus membuka Talenta Ascension "Return to Oblivion" terlebih dahulu.

constellations.name: End of Wishes
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of **Havoc: Warp** by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.descriptionId:
Meningkatkan 3 level **Havoc: Warp**.
Maksimum: Lv. 15.

constellations.name: To the Source
constellations.description:
Each Void Rift Skirk absorbs via the effects of the Ascension Talent **Reason Beyond Reason** will grant her 1 Havoc: Sever stack. She can consume such stacks to initiate coordinated attacks and decrease the DMG she takes while in **Seven-Phase Flash** mode. These stacks last for 15s, and each stack's duration is counted independently (max 3 stacks).
You must first unlock the Ascension Talent "Reason Beyond Reason."

Havoc: Sever
· When Skirk uses the Elemental Burst Havoc: Ruin, she will consume all Havoc: Sever stacks to initiate a coordinated attack in which each Havoc: Sever stack will deal 750% of Skirk's ATK as Cryo DMG. This DMG is considered Elemental Burst DMG.
· When she uses Normal Attacks while in Seven-Phase Flash mode, 1 Havoc: Sever stack will be consumed when her third or fifth sequenced attacks hit an opponent to launch 3 coordinated attacks. Each coordinated attack deals 180% of Skirk's ATK as Cryo DMG. This damage is considered Normal Attack DMG.
· When Skirk takes DMG while in Seven-Phase Flash mode, 1 Havoc: Sever stack will be consumed to decrease this DMG instance by 80% and attack nearby opponents 3 times, with each attack dealing 180% of Skirk's ATK as Cryo DMG. This DMG is considered Charged Attack DMG.
constellations.descriptionId:
Skirk akan mendapatkan satu lapis efek "Havoc: Sever" setiap kali ia menyerap satu Void Rift yang tercipta dari efek Talenta Ascension **Reason Beyond Reason**. Skirk dapat mengonsumsi efek ini untuk melancarkan serangan terkoordinasi dan mengurangi DMG yang diterima saat sedang berada dalam mode **Seven-Phase Flash**. Efek ini berlangsung 15 detik dan dapat ditumpuk hingga 3 lapis, durasi setiap lapisnya dihitung terpisah.
Harus membuka Talenta Ascension Reason Beyond Reason terlebih dahulu.

Havoc: Sever
·Saat Skirk melancarkan Elemental Burst Havoc: Ruin, semua lapisan Havoc: Sever akan dikonsumsi untuk melancarkan serangan terkoordinasi. Setiap lapisan Havoc: Sever akan mengakibatkan Cryo DMG sebesar 750% ATK Skirk. DMG ini dianggap sebagai DMG Elemental Burst.
·Saat sedang berada dalam Mode Seven-Phase Flash dan melancarkan Normal Attack, satu lapisan Havoc: Sever akan terkonsumsi saat serangan Normal Attack tahap ke-3 atau ke-5 mengenai musuh, untuk melancarkan serangan terkoordinasi sebanyak 3 kali. Setiap serangan terkoordinasi ini akan mengakibatkan Cryo DMG sebesar 180% ATK Skirk. DMG ini dianggap sebagai DMG Normal Attack.
·Saat Skirk terkena DMG saat berada dalam mode Seven-Phase Flash, satu lapis Havoc: Sever akan terkonsumsi untuk mengurangi 80% DMG yang diterima kali ini, kemudian melancarkan 3 serangan terhadap musuh di sekitar. Setiap serangannya akan mengakibatkan Cryo DMG sebesar 180% ATK Skirk. DMG ini dianggap sebagai DMG Charged Attack.

name: Tartaglia
title: Childe
description: No. 11 of The Harbingers, also known as "Childe." His name is highly feared on the battlefield.
descriptionId: Fatui Harbinger ke-11, juga dikenal dengan nama "Childe". Ketenaran namanya saja dapat menghantar ketakutan di medan perang.

talents.name: Cutting Torrent
talents.description:
Normal Attack
Performs up to 6 consecutive shots with a bow.

Charged Attack
Performs a more precise Aimed Shot with increased DMG.
While aiming, the power of Hydro will accumulate on the arrowhead. An arrow fully charged with the torrent will deal Hydro DMG and apply the Riptide status.

Riptide
Opponents affected by Riptide will suffer from AoE Hydro DMG effects when attacked by Tartaglia in various ways. DMG dealt in this way is considered Normal Attack DMG.
·Riptide Flash: A fully-charged Aimed Shot that hits an opponent affected by Riptide deals consecutive bouts of AoE DMG. Can occur once every 0.7s.
·Riptide Burst: Defeating an opponent affected by Riptide creates a Hydro burst that inflicts the Riptide status on nearby opponents hit.

Plunging Attack
Fires off a shower of arrows in mid-air before falling and striking the ground, dealing AoE DMG upon impact.
When Tartaglia is in Foul Legacy: Raging Tide's Melee Stance, he cannot perform a plunging attack.
talents.descriptionId:
Normal Attack
Melancarkan hingga 6 serangan berturut-turut dengan menggunakan busur.

Charged Attack
Melancarkan sebuah Serangan Membidik yang lebih akurat untuk mengakibatkan DMG lebih besar.
Saat membidik, air akan berkumpul di ujung anak panah. Panah dengan air yang terkumpul penuh akan mengakibatkan Hydro DMG dan menyebabkan efek Riptide.

Riptide
Musuh yang terpengaruh Riptide akan menerima berbagai efek Hydro DMG area saat diserang oleh Tartaglia. Efek-efek ini dihitung sebagai Normal Attack.
Riptide Flash: Serangan Membidik yang terisi penuh dan mengenai musuh yang terpengaruh efek Riptide akan mengakibatkan DMG area berturut-turut. Riptide Flash dapat terpicu setiap 0,7 detik.
Riptide Burst: Mengalahkan musuh yang terkena efek Riptide akan menciptakan ledakan Hydro yang menyebabkan efek Riptide pada musuh di sekitar.

Plunging Attack
Melancarkan hujan panah dari udara dan menerjang tanah dengan kecepatan tinggi, mengakibatkan DMG area saat mendarat.
Saat Tartaglia sedang menggunakan mode jarak dekat Foul Legacy: Raging Tide, dia tidak bisa menggunakan Plunging Attack.

talents.name: Foul Legacy: Raging Tide
talents.description:
Unleashes a set of weaponry made of pure water, dealing Hydro DMG to surrounding opponents and entering Melee Stance.
In this Stance, Tartaglia's Normal and Charged Attacks are converted to Hydro DMG that cannot be overridden by any other elemental infusion and change as follows:

Normal Attack
Performs up to 6 consecutive Hydro strikes.

Charged Attack
Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to unleash a cross slash, dealing Hydro DMG.

Riptide Slash
Hitting an opponent affected by Riptide with a melee attack unleashes a Riptide Slash that deals AoE Hydro DMG. DMG dealt in this way is considered Elemental Skill DMG, and can only occur once every 1.5s.

After 30s, or when the ability is unleashed again, this skill will end. Tartaglia will return to his Ranged Stance and this ability will enter CD. The longer Tartaglia stays in his Melee Stance, the longer the CD.
If the return to a ranged stance occurs automatically after 30s, the CD is even longer.
talents.descriptionId:
Mengerahkan sejumlah senjata yang terbuat dari air untuk mengakibatkan Hydro DMG ke musuh di sekitar dan memasuki mode jarak dekat.
Dalam mode ini, Normal Attack dan Charged Attack milik Tartaglia berubah menjadi Hydro DMG yang tidak bisa ditimpa oleh Elemental Infusion lain dan efek berikut akan muncul:

Normal Attack
Melakukan hingga 6 serangan Hydro berturut-turut.

Charged Attack
Mengonsumsi sejumlah Stamina untuk melancarkan dua tebasan silang yang mengakibatkan Hydro DMG.

Riptide Slash
Memukul musuh yang terkena efek Riptide dengan serangan jarak dekat akan menimbulkan Riptide Slash yang mengakibatkan Hydro DMG area. DMG yang diakibatkan oleh Riptide Slash terhitung sebagai DMG Elemental Skill, dapat terpicu setiap 1,5 detik.

Setelah 30 detik atau saat skill ini digunakan lagi, efek skill ini akan berakhir dan Tartaglia kembali ke mode jarak jauh. Skill ini kemudian akan memasuki cooldown. Semakin lama Tartaglia menggunakan mode jarak dekat, waktu cooldown skill juga akan menjadi semakin panjang.
Bila Tartaglia kembali menjadi mode jarak jauh secara otomatis dalam waktu 30 detik, waktu cooldown skill akan menjadi semakin panjang lagi.

talents.name: Havoc: Obliteration
talents.description:
Performs different attacks based on what stance Tartaglia is in when casting.

Ranged Stance: Flash of Havoc
Swiftly fires a Hydro-imbued magic arrow, dealing AoE Hydro DMG and applying the Riptide status.
Returns a portion of its Energy Cost after use.

Melee Stance: Light of Obliteration
Performs a slash with a large AoE, dealing massive Hydro DMG to all surrounding opponents, which triggers Riptide Blast.

Riptide Blast
When the obliterating waters hit an opponent affected by Riptide, it clears their Riptide status and triggers a Hydro Explosion that deals AoE Hydro DMG.
DMG dealt in this way is considered Elemental Burst DMG.
talents.descriptionId:
Melancarkan serangan yang berbeda-beda sesuai dengan mode bertarung yang sedang digunakan Tartaglia:

Mode Jarak Jauh: Flash of Havoc
Menembakkan panah sihir yang mengandung elemen Hydro dengan cepat, mengakibatkan Hydro DMG area dan menyebabkan efek Riptide.
Mengembalikan sejumlah Energy yang dikonsumsi setelah skill ini digunakan.

Mode Jarak Dekat: Light of Obliteration
Menebas musuh dalam area yang luas dan mengakibatkan Hydro DMG  yang besar, juga dapat memicu Riptide Blast.

Riptide Blast
Saat skill Havoc Obliteration mengenai musuh dengan status Riptide, status Riptide tersebut akan dihapuskan dan memicu ledakan Riptide Blast yang mengakibatkan Hydro DMG area. DMG dari Riptide Blast terhitung sebagai DMG Elemental Burst.

passives.name: Never Ending
passives.description: Extends Riptide duration by 8s.
passives.descriptionId: Memperpanjang durasi Riptide selama 8 detik.

passives.name: Sword of Torrents
passives.description: When Tartaglia is in Foul Legacy: Raging Tide's Melee Stance, on dealing a CRIT hit, Normal and Charged Attacks apply the Riptide status effect to opponents.
passives.descriptionId: Saat Tartaglia berada dalam Mode Jarak Dekat Foul Legacy: Raging Tide, Normal atau Charged Attack akan menyebabkan efek Riptide saat CRIT.

passives.name: Master of Weaponry
passives.description: Increases your own party members' Normal Attack Level by 1.
passives.descriptionId: Meningkatkan 1 level Normal Attack anggota party sendiri.

constellations.name: Foul Legacy: Tide Withholder
constellations.description: Decreases the CD of Foul Legacy: Raging Tide by 20%.
constellations.descriptionId: Mengurangi 20% CD Foul Legacy: Raging Tide.

constellations.name: Foul Legacy: Understream
constellations.description: When opponents affected by Riptide are defeated, Tartaglia regenerates 4 Elemental Energy.
constellations.descriptionId: Saat musuh yang terkena efek Riptide dikalahkan, Tartaglia memulihkan 4 Energy.

constellations.name: Abyssal Mayhem: Vortex of Turmoil
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Foul Legacy: Raging Tide by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.descriptionId:
Meningkatkan 3 level Foul Legacy: Raging Tide.
Maksimum: Lv. 15.

constellations.name: Abyssal Mayhem: Hydrospout
constellations.description:
If Tartaglia is in Foul Legacy: Raging Tide's Melee Stance, triggers Riptide Slash against opponents on the field affected by Riptide every 4s, otherwise, triggers Riptide Flash.
Riptide Slashes and Riptide Flashes triggered by this Constellation effect are not subject to the time intervals that would typically apply to these two Riptide effects, nor do they have any effect on those time intervals.
constellations.descriptionId:
Bila ada musuh yang terkena efek Riptide milik Tartaglia dan Tartaglia sedang menggunakan mode jarak dekat dari Foul Legacy: Raging Tide, maka Tartaglia akan memicu Riptide Slash setiap 4 detik; Bila tidak, akan memicu Riptide Flash.
Riptide Slash dan Riptide Flash yang terpicu dari Konstelasi ini tidak dibatasi oleh jeda waktu masing-masing skill, juga tidak memengaruhi jeda waktu masing-masing skill.

constellations.name: Havoc: Formless Blade
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Havoc: Obliteration by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.descriptionId:
Meningkatkan 3 level Havoc - Obliteration.
Maksimum: Lv. 15.

constellations.name: Havoc: Annihilation
constellations.description:
When Havoc: Obliteration is cast in Melee Stance, the CD of Foul Legacy: Raging Tide is reset.
This effect will only take place once Tartaglia returns to his Ranged Stance.
constellations.descriptionId:
Saat Havoc: Obliteration dilancarkan dalam keadaan mode jarak dekat, maka CD dari Foul Legacy: Raging Tide akan direset.
Efek ini hanya akan terjadi begitu Tartaglia kembali ke mode jarak jauh.

name: Tighnari
title: Verdant Strider
description: A young researcher well-versed in botany who currently serves as a Forest Watcher in Avidya Forest. He is a straight shooter with a warm heart — and a dab hand at guiding even the dullest of pupils.
descriptionId: Peneliti muda yang berpengalaman di bidang botani yang saat ini menjabat sebagai Pelindung Hutan di Hutan Avidya. Seorang yang lurus dengan hati penuh kebajikan — dan juga seorang yang andal dalam membimbing bahkan murid yang paling bodoh sekalipun.

talents.name: Khanda Barrier-Buster
talents.description:
Normal Attack
Performs up to 4 consecutive shots with a bow.

Charged Attack
Performs a more precise Aimed Shot with increased DMG.
While aiming, the power of Dendro will accumulate on the arrowhead before the arrow is fired. Has different effects based on how long the energy has been charged:
·Charge Level 1: Fires off an arrow carrying the power of flora that deals Dendro DMG.
·Charge Level 2: Fires off a Wreath Arrow that deals Dendro DMG. Upon hit, the Wreath Arrow will create 4 Clusterbloom Arrows that will track nearby opponents automatically and deal Dendro DMG.

Plunging Attack
Fires off a shower of arrows in mid-air before falling and striking the ground, dealing AoE DMG upon impact.
talents.descriptionId:
Normal Attack
Melancarkan hingga 4 serangan berturut-turut dengan busur.

Charged Attack
Melancarkan sebuah Serangan Membidik yang lebih akurat untuk mengakibatkan DMG lebih besar.
Saat membidik, kekuatan Dendro akan berkumpul di ujung anak panah. Memiliki efek yang berbeda tergantung dari lama serangannya ditahan:
·Charge Tahap 1: Menembakkan panah berisi elemen Dendro dan mengakibatkan Dendro DMG;
·Charge Tahap 2: Menembakkan sebuah Wreath Arrow yang mengakibatkan Dendro DMG. Setelah mengenai target, Wreath Arrow akan menciptakan 4 Clusterbloom Arrow yang akan otomatis mengikuti musuh di sekitar dan mengakibatkan Dendro DMG.

Plunging Attack
Melancarkan hujan panah dari udara dan menerjang tanah dengan kecepatan tinggi, mengakibatkan DMG area saat mendarat.

talents.name: Vijnana-Phala Mine
talents.description:
Tighnari throws a Vijnana Stormheart ahead that deals AoE Dendro DMG, creating a Vijnana-Khanda Field that creates mysterious illusions that taunt opponents and draw their fire.
Additionally, Tighnari gains the Vijnana Suffusion effect, which will decrease the Wreath Arrow's charging time by 2.4s. This effect will dissipate once the skill duration ends or after Tighnari has fired 3 Wreath Arrows.
talents.descriptionId:
Tighnari melemparkan sebuah Vijnana Stormheart ke depan yang mengakibatkan Dendro DMG Area dan menciptakan sebuah Vijnana-Khanda Field. Bayangan-bayangan dalam area ini akan terus menarik perhatian musuh dan serangan mereka.
Selain itu, Tighnari memperoleh efek Vijnana Suffusion yang akan mengurangi waktu membidik Wreath Arrow selanjutnya sebesar 2,4 detik. Efek ini akan hilang setelah durasi skill berakhir atau setelah Tighnari menembakkan 3 Wreath Arrow.

talents.name: Fashioner's Tanglevine Shaft
talents.description:
Combines the power of all seeds to fire 6 Tanglevine Shafts that can track opponents and deal Dendro DMG.
After they hit, the Tanglevine Shafts will create a secondary wave of Tanglevine Shafts that can also track nearby opponents and deal Dendro DMG on hit.
talents.descriptionId:
Mengumpulkan kekuatan dari seluruh benih, dan menembakkan 6 Tanglevine Shaft yang akan mengejar musuh dan mengakibatkan Dendro DMG.
Setelah mengenai musuh, Tanglevine Shaft akan menciptakan Tanglevine Shaft gelombang kedua yang juga bisa mengejar musuh dan mengakibatkan Dendro DMG saat mengenai musuh.

passives.name: Keen Sight
passives.description: After Tighnari fires a Wreath Arrow, his Elemental Mastery is increased by 50 for 4s.
passives.descriptionId: Setelah Tighnari menembakkan Wreath Arrow, Elemental Mastery-nya akan meningkat 50 poin selama 4 detik.

passives.name: Scholarly Blade
passives.description:
For every point of Elemental Mastery Tighnari possesses, his Charged Attack and Fashioner's Tanglevine Shaft DMG are increased by 0.06%.
The maximum DMG Bonus obtainable this way is 60%.
passives.descriptionId:
Untuk setiap Elemental Mastery yang dimiliki Tighnari, DMG Charged Attack dan Fashioner's Tanglevine Shaft akan meningkat 0,06%.
Maksimum bonus DMG yang bisa diperoleh dengan cara ini adalah 60%.

passives.name: Encyclopedic Knowledge
passives.description: Displays the location of nearby resources unique to Sumeru on the mini-map.
passives.descriptionId: Memperlihatkan lokasi produk khas Sumeru di sekitar pada peta kecil.

constellations.name: Beginnings Determined at the Roots
constellations.description: Tighnari's Charged Attack CRIT Rate is increased by 15%.
constellations.descriptionId: Meningkatkan 15% CRIT Rate dari Charged Attack Tighnari.

constellations.name: Origins Known From the Stem
constellations.description:
When there are opponents within the Vijnana-Khanda Field created by Vijnana-Phala Mine, Tighnari gains 20% Dendro DMG Bonus.
The effect will last up to 6s if the field's duration ends or if it no longer has opponents within it.
constellations.descriptionId:
Saat ada musuh di dalam Vijnana-Khanda Field yang dihasilkan Vijnana-Phala Mine, Tighnari memperoleh 20% Dendro DMG Bonus.
Setelah durasi aktif Vijnana-Khanda Field berakhir atau sudah tidak ada musuh di dalamnya, efek ini akan bertahan hingga 6 detik.

constellations.name: Fortunes Read Amongst the Branches
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Fashioner's Tanglevine Shaft by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.descriptionId:
Meningkatkan 3 level  Fashioner's Tanglevine Shaft.
Maksimum: Lv. 15.

constellations.name: Withering Glimpsed in the Leaves
constellations.description: When Fashioner's Tanglevine Shaft is unleashed, all nearby party members gain 60 Elemental Mastery for 8s. If the Fashioner's Tanglevine Shaft triggers a Burning, Bloom, Lunar-Bloom, Quicken, or Spread reaction, their Elemental Mastery will be further increased by 60. This latter case will also refresh the buff state's duration.
constellations.descriptionId: Saat melancarkan Fashioner's Tanglevine Shaft, Elemental Mastery seluruh anggota party di sekitar akan meningkat 60 poin selama 8 detik. Jika Fashioner's Tanglevine Shaft memicu reaksi Burning, Bloom, Lunar-Bloom, Quicken, atau Spread, maka Elemental Mastery anggota party akan meningkat lagi sebesar 60 poin dan akan memperbarui durasi berlangsungnya buff ini.

constellations.name: Comprehension Amidst the Flowers
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Vijnana-Phala Mine by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.descriptionId:
Meningkatkan 3 level Vijnana-Phala Mine.
Maksimum: Lv. 15.

constellations.name: Karma Adjudged From the Leaden Fruit
constellations.description: Wreath Arrow's charging time is decreased by 0.9s, and will produce 1 additional Clusterbloom Arrow upon hit. This arrow deals 150% of Tighnari's ATK as DMG.
constellations.descriptionId: Waktu charge Wreath Arrow berkurang 0,9 detik dan akan menghasilkan 1 Clusterbloom Arrow tambahan setelah mengenai musuh, mengakibatkan DMG sebesar 150% ATK Tighnari.

name: Varesa
title: Strength in Serenity
description: A laid-back orchard manager and warrior of the Collective of Plenty. An aspiring hero who hungers for justice... and lots and lots of food!
descriptionId: Seorang pemilik kebun yang santai dan pejuang dari Berlimpah Jaya. Calon pahlawan yang mendambakan keadilan ... dan banyak makanan!

talents.name: By the Horns
talents.description:
Normal Attack
Gotta try... to do battle like the greatest champion luchadors do! Varesa launches up to 3 strikes, dealing Electro DMG.

Charged Attack
Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to headbutt opponents in front, dealing Nightsoul-aligned Electro DMG and using the momentum to leap into the air.

Plunging Attack
Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground below, damaging opponents along the path and dealing Nightsoul-aligned AoE Electro DMG upon impact. If Varesa is in a combat state upon landing, or if the shockwave from her plunging attack hits an opponent, she will gain 25 Nightsoul points. She enters the Fiery Passion state upon reaching maximum Nightsoul points through this method.

Fiery Passion
In this state, Varesa's Normal, Charged, and Plunging Attacks will gain corresponding buffs:

Normal Attack
Fight like a superstar champion luchador! Launches up to 3 fierce strikes, dealing greater Electro DMG.

Charged Attack
Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to slam into her opponents, dealing greater amounts of Nightsoul-aligned Electro DMG and using the momentum to leap into the air.

Plunging Attack
Consumes all her Nightsoul points and slams down on the ground from mid-air, dealing DMG to opponents in her path and dealing greater amounts of Nightsoul-aligned AoE Electro DMG upon hitting the ground.
talents.descriptionId:
Normal Attack
Aku harus ... bertarung seperti pegulat yang hebat! Varesa melancarkan maksimum 3 serangan, dan mengakibatkan Electro DMG.

Charged Attack
Mengonsumsi sejumlah Stamina dan menyeruduk musuh di depan, mengakibatkan Nightsoul-aligned Electro DMG, lalu melompat ke atas setelahnya.

Plunging Attack
Menerjang dari udara untuk menghantam tanah, menyerang musuh di jalur terjangan dan mengakibatkan Nightsoul-aligned Electro DMG Area. Jika Varesa berada dalam kondisi bertempur saat mendarat, atau jika serangannya mengenai musuh saat menghantam tanah, maka Varesa akan mendapatkan 25 poin Nightsoul. Saat poin Nightsoul mencapai nilai maksimum melalui cara ini, maka Varesa akan otomatis memasuki status Fiery Passion.

Fiery Passion
Dalam status ini, Normal Attack, Charged Attack, dan Plunging Attack Varesa akan mendapatkan buff yang berikut:

Normal Attack
Bertarung tanpa rasa takut seperti seorang pegulat juara! Melancarkan maksimum 3 serangan, dan mengakibatkan Electro DMG yang lebih kuat.

Charged Attack
Mengonsumsi sejumlah Stamina, dan menggunakan kepalanya untuk menyeruduk musuh di depan dengan kuat, mengakibatkan Nightsoul-aligned Electro DMG yang lebih kuat, lalu melompat ke atas setelahnya.

Plunging Attack
Mengonsumsi seluruh poin Nightsoul dan menghantam tanah dari udara untuk menyerang musuh di jalur terjangannya dan mengakibatkan Nightsoul-aligned Electro DMG Area saat mendarat.

talents.name: Riding the Night-Rainbow
talents.description:
With footwork swift as lightning and fierce as thunder, Varesa displays the true spirit of lucha libre, rushing forward a certain distance and dealing Nightsoul-aligned Electro DMG to opponents in her path.
After using this Skill, Varesa gains 20 Nightsoul points and gains the "Follow-Up Strike" effect: Varesa has increased interruption resistance during this time, and upon pressing her Normal Attack, she will quickly unleash a Charged Attack that does not consume Stamina. "Follow-Up Strike" will be canceled after Varesa uses a Charged Attack.
She will use different techniques based on whether the skill is Tapped or Held.

Tap
Quickly rush a certain distance forward.

Hold
Varesa enters the Nightsoul's Blessing state and switches to Sudden Onrush mode.

Sudden Onrush
Continuously consumes Nightsoul points. In this state, Varesa's Movement SPD and interruption resistance are increased. She can use terrain to execute flying leaps or consume additional Nightsoul points to traverse atop water or liquid Phlogiston while remaining immune to DMG from the latter.

Nightsoul's Blessing: Varesa
When she runs out of Nightsoul points, her Nightsoul's Blessing state will be canceled. When Varesa is in the Sudden Onrush state or Fiery Passion state, she will always be counted as being in the Nightsoul's Blessing state.

Has 2 charges. When Varesa enters the Fiery Passion state, she will obtain an additional Tap charge of her Elemental Skill and its DMG will be increased.

Fiery Passion
· While not in the Fiery Passion state, Varesa can use Plunging Attacks to gain Nightsoul points. She will enter Fiery Passion when she reaches maximum Nightsoul points via this method, or when she uses her Elemental Burst Guardian Vent!
· While in the Fiery Passion state, her Normal Attacks, Elemental Skill, and Elemental Burst will gain unique buffs. She can also use a special Elemental Burst shortly after using a Plunging Attack.
· The Fiery Passion state lasts for up to 15s and will end when she runs out of Nightsoul points or after she leaves combat for a period of time.
talents.descriptionId:
Dengan langkah secepat kilat dan gagah seperti petir, Varesa menunjukkan makna gulat yang sebenarnya. Varesa menerjang ke depan dan mengakibatkan Nightsoul-aligned Electro DMG pada musuh di sepanjang jalurnya.
Setelah melancarkan skill ini, Varesa akan mendapatkan 20 poin Nightsoul dan efek "Follow-Up Strike": Selama efek ini aktif, ketahanan Varesa terhadap interupsi akan meningkat. Saat menekan tombol Normal Attack, Varesa akan melakukan Charged Attack dengan cepat tanpa mengonsumsi Stamina. Efek Follow-Up Strike akan hilang setelah Varesa melakukan Charged Attack.
Varesa akan menunjukkan teknik bergulat yang berbeda saat melancarkan skill ini dengan Mode Tekan atau Mode Tahan.

Mode Tekan
Menerjang ke depan dengan cepat.

Mode Tahan
Varesa memasuki status Nightsoul's Blessing dan berganti ke mode Sudden Onrush.

Sudden Onrush
Terus mengonsumsi poin Nightsoul. Dalam status ini, Movement SPD dan ketahanan Varesa terhadap interupsi akan meningkat, dan ia bisa memanfaatkan perbedaan medan untuk melompat, atau mengonsumsi poin Nightsoul tambahan untuk bergerak di atas permukaan air dan Phlogiston cair, serta menjadi kebal terhadap DMG dari Phlogiston cair.

Nightsoul's Blessing: Varesa
Status Nightsoul's Blessing Varesa akan berakhir saat poin Nightsoul-nya habis. Saat Varesa berada dalam status Sudden Onrush atau Fiery Passion, ia akan dianggap berada dalam status Nightsoul's Blessing.

Elemental Skill Varesa memiliki jumlah penggunaan 2 kali. Saat Varesa memasuki status Fiery Passion, ia akan mendapatkan tambahan jumlah penggunaan Elemental Skill (Mode Tekan) sebanyak satu kali dan DMG Elemental Skill-nya akan meningkat.

Fiery Passion
·Saat tidak berada dalam status Fiery Passion, Varesa dapat memulihkan poin Nightsoul-nya dengan cara melancarkan Plunging Attack. Varesa akan otomatis memasuki status Fiery Passion saat poin Nightsoul-nya mencapai maksimum melalui cara ini, atau saat ia melancarkan Elemental Burst Guardian Vent!.

·Saat berada dalam status Fiery Passion, Normal Attack, Elemental Skill, dan Elemental Burst Varesa akan mendapat penguatan tertentu, dan dalam waktu singkat setelah melancarkan Plunging Attack, Varesa dapat melancarkan Elemental Burst yang spesial.
·Status Fiery Passion dapat berlangsung maksimum 15 detik dan akan menghilang jika poin Nightsoul habis atau Varesa keluar dari status bertempur selama beberapa saat.

talents.name: Guardian Vent!
talents.description:
Leaps into the air before using the momentum of the drop to unleash a powerful flying kick, dealing Nightsoul-aligned AoE Electro DMG to opponents — just like those heroes of justice in woven scrolls for kids!
After using this Skill, Varesa's Nightsoul points will be restored to maximum and she will enter the Fiery Passion state.

In the Fiery Passion state, Varesa's Elemental Burst will deal a greater amount of Nightsoul-aligned AoE Electro DMG.

Additionally, she will briefly activate Apex Drive after using a Plunging Attack while in her Fiery Passion state.

Apex Drive
Increases Varesa's interruption resistance. While affected by Apex Drive, Varesa can ignore her Elemental Burst CD and consume less Energy to use her special Elemental Burst, "Guardian Vent: Volcano Kablam": This causes her to use the especially powerful Plunging Attack, the "Thunderous Tornado Eruption," which deals Nightsoul-aligned AoE Electro DMG upon landing before causing her to exit Apex Drive. This DMG is considered Plunging Attack DMG.
Varesa will exit Apex Drive after using her Elemental Skill.
talents.descriptionId:
Layaknya pahlawan keadilan yang digambarkan di dalam gulungan cerita yang diperlihatkan kepada anak-anak, Varesa melompat tinggi dan menggunakan momentum jatuhnya untuk melancarkan tendangan melompat yang sangat kuat dan mengakibatkan Nightsoul-aligned Electro DMG Area.
Setelah melancarkan skill ini, Varesa akan memulihkan poin Nightsoul-nya hingga maksimum dan memasuki status Fiery Passion.

Dalam status Fiery Passion, Elemental Burst Varesa akan berubah menjadi serangan yang mengakibatkan Nightsoul-aligned Electro DMG Area yang lebih kuat.

Selain itu, jika Varesa melancarkan Plunging Attack dalam status Fiery Passion, maka Varesa akan memasuki status Apex Drive selama beberapa saat.

Apex Drive
Meningkatkan ketahanan Varesa terhadap interupsi. Saat berada dalam status ini, Varesa dapat mengabaikan CD Elemental Burst dan mengonsumsi Energy yang lebih sedikit untuk melancarkan Elemental Burst spesialnya "Guardian Vent: Volcano Kablam": Varesa akan melakukan Plunging Attack "Thunderous Tornado Eruption" yang sangat kuat dan mengakibatkan Nightsoul-aligned Electro DMG Area saat mendarat, dan akan keluar dari status Apex Drive. DMG ini dianggap sebagai DMG Plunging Attack.
Setelah melancarkan Elemental Skill, akan keluar dari status Apex Drive.

passives.name: Tag-Team Triple Jump!
passives.description:
After using the Elemental Skill Riding the Night-Rainbow, Varesa gains "Rainbow Crash" for 5s.
During this time, when Varesa uses a Plunging Attack, the shockwave DMG dealt when she hits the ground is increased by 50% of her ATK. If Varesa is in the Fiery Passion state, this ground impact DMG is increased by 180% of her ATK instead.

The Rainbow Crash effect will be canceled once a ground impact hits an opponent, or when its duration expires.
passives.descriptionId:
Setelah melancarkan Elemental Skill Riding the Night-Rainbow, Varesa akan mendapatkan efek "Rainbow Crash" selama 5 detik.
Jika Varesa melancarkan Plunging Attack selama durasi ini, maka ia akan mengakibatkan DMG tambahan sebesar 50% ATK saat menghantam tanah. Jika Varesa berada dalam status Fiery Passion, maka hantaman ini akan mengakibatkan DMG tambahan sebesar 180% ATK.

Efek "Rainbow Crash" akan hilang saat Plunging Attack mengenai musuh atau saat durasinya berakhir.

passives.name: The Hero Twice-Returned!
passives.description: When a nearby party member triggers a Nightsoul Burst, Varesa's ATK increases by 35% for 12s. Max 2 stacks. Each stack's duration is counted independently.
passives.descriptionId: Saat anggota party di sekitar memicu Nightsoul Burst, ATK Varesa meningkat 35% selama 12 detik. Efek ini dapat ditumpuk 2 kali, durasi setiap lapisnya dihitung terpisah.

passives.name: Night Realm's Gift: A Torch That Incinerates Evil
passives.description:
After Nightsoul points have been fully depleted, Varesa will switch to using Phlogiston to maintain the Sudden Onrush mode from her Nightsoul's Blessing.
While in an area with Phlogiston Mechanics within Natlan, Nightsoul Transmission: Varesa can be used. When the current active character is sprinting or in movement modes caused by certain Talents, or at a certain height in the air, switching to Varesa will trigger the following: Varesa enters the Nightsoul's Blessing state, switches to Sudden Onrush mode, and obtains 20 Nightsoul points. Nightsoul Transmission can be triggered once every 10s by your own party.
While in an area with Phlogiston Mechanics within Natlan, Varesa will not take fall DMG when using terrain differences to make leaps.
passives.descriptionId:
Setelah poin Nightsoul habis terpakai, Varesa akan mengonsumsi Phlogiston untuk mempertahankan status Nightsoul's Blessing dan mode Sudden Onrush.
Saat ada area dengan Phlogiston Mechanic di Natlan, dapat melancarkan Nightsoul Transmission: Varesa. Saat Karakter aktif sedang berlari, memanjat, atau sedang bergerak yang dikarenakan oleh Talenta tertentu, atau saat melayang di ketinggian tertentu, dan mengganti Karakter menjadi Varesa, akan memicu efek berikut: Varesa memasuki status Nightsoul's Blessing, berganti ke mode Sudden Onrush, dan mendapatkan 20 poin Nightsoul. Nightsoul Transmission party sendiri dapat terpicu sekali setiap 10 detik.
Selain itu, saat ada area dengan Phlogiston Mechanic di Natlan, Varesa tidak akan menerima DMG jatuh saat melompat dengan memanfaatkan perbedaan medan.

passives.name: Blazing Heart, Singular Advance!
passives.description:
Varesa's Sprint speed is increased. When she is not in combat, her Sprint Stamina consumption will also increase.
Additionally, while in an area with Phlogiston Mechanics within Natlan, your party members will restore 20 Phlogiston when consuming food. This effect can occur once every 10s and does not take effect in Domains, Trounce Domains, or the Spiral Abyss.
passives.descriptionId:
Kecepatan Varesa saat berlari meningkat. Saat tidak berada dalam kondisi bertempur, Stamina yang dikonsumsi saat berlari juga akan meningkat.
Selain itu, Saat ada area dengan Phlogiston Mechanic di Natlan, Makanan yang dikonsumsi oleh anggota party sendiri akan memulihkan 20 poin Phlogiston. Efek ini dapat terpicu sekali setiap 10 detik, tapi tidak aktif dalam Domain, Trounce Domain, atau Spiral Abyss.

constellations.name: Undying Passion
constellations.description:
The effects of the Ascension Talent "Tag-Team Triple Jump!" are enhanced:
When performing the Special Plunging Attack "Thunderous Tornado Eruption," Varesa will also gain "Rainbow Crash" for 5s.
When "Rainbow Crash" is in effect, Varesa's Plunging Attack ground impact DMG is increased by 180% of her ATK, whether she is in the Fiery Passion state or not. You must first unlock the Ascension Talent "Tag-Team Triple Jump!" to access the above effect.

Additionally, when Varesa is in the Sudden Onrush mode of her Nightsoul's Blessing, she consumes 30% less Nightsoul points or Phlogiston.
constellations.descriptionId:
Efek Talenta Ascension "Tag-Team Triple Jump!!" diperkuat:
Saat melakukan Plunging Attack Spesial "Thunderous Tornado Eruption", Varesa juga akan mendapatkan "Rainbow Crash" selama 5 detik.
Selama durasi "Rainbow Crash", terlepas dari Varesa berada dalam status Fiery Passion atau tidak, saat Varesa melakukan Plunging Attack, DMG tambahan saat Plunging Attack menghantam tanah akan mengakibatkan 180% ATK. Harus membuka Talenta Ascension "The Tag-Team Triple Jump!" terlebih dahulu agar efek ini bisa aktif.

Selain itu, saat Varesa berada dalam status Nightsoul's Blessing: Sudden Onrush, poin Nightsoul atau Phlogiston yang dikonsumsi berkurang 30%.

constellations.name: Beyond the Edge of Light
constellations.description:
Varesa will enter Apex Drive after using a Plunging Attack, regardless of whether she is in the Fiery Passion state or not.
When Apex Drive is active, Varesa's interruption resistance will also further increase.
Additionally, Varesa will restore 11.5 Energy when her Plunging Attack ground impact hits an opponent.
constellations.descriptionId:
Terlepas dari Varesa berada dalam status Fiery Passion atau tidak, Varesa tetap akan memasuki status Apex Drive setelah melancarkan Plunging Attack.
Saat dalam status Apex Drive, ketahanan Varesa terhadap interupsi juga akan meningkat lebih lanjut.
Selain itu, Varesa akan memulihkan 11,5 poin Energy saat melancarkan Plunging Attack dan hantamannya mengenai musuh.

constellations.name: Unbowed Resolve
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Guardian Vent! by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.descriptionId:
Meningkatkan 3 level Elemental Burst Guardian Vent!.
Maksimum: Lv. 15.

constellations.name: The Courage to Press On
constellations.description:
Varesa will receive various buffs based on her state when using her Elemental Burst Guardian Vent! If Varesa:
· Has neither Fiery Passion nor Apex Drive active, she will gain Diligent Refinement for 15s, which will increase her Plunging Attack ground impact DMG by 500% of her ATK, with a maximum increase of 20,000 DMG. This effect will be canceled once the ground impact hits an opponent, or if its duration ends.
· If she has either Fiery Passion or Apex Drive active, this instance of her Elemental Burst Guardian Vent! deals 100% increased DMG.
constellations.descriptionId:
Varesa akan mendapatkan efek penguatan yang berbeda berdasarkan status Varesa saat ia melancarkan Elemental Burst Guardian Vent!. Jika Varesa:
·Tidak berada dalam status Fiery Passion atau Apex Drive, maka Varesa akan mendapatkan efek Diligent Refinement selama 15 detik. Efek ini akan meningkatkan DMG yang diakibatkan Plunging Attack Varesa sebesar 500% ATK Varesa, dengan peningkatan DMG maksimum sebesar 20.000 poin. Efek ini akan hilang saat hantaman Plunging Attack mengenai musuh atau saat durasinya berakhir.
·Sedang berada dalam status Fiery Passion atau Apex Drive, maka DMG yang diakibatkan Elemental Burst Guardian Vent! kali ini meningkat sebesar 100%.

constellations.name: Thoughts Floating on the Warm Breeze
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Normal Attack: By the Horns by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.descriptionId:
Meningkatkan 3 level Normal Attack: By the Horns.
Maksimum: Lv. 15.

constellations.name: A Hero of Justice's Triumph
constellations.description:
Varesa restores 30 Energy when she enters Apex Drive.
Her Plunging Attacks and Elemental Burst Guardian Vent! gain 10% CRIT Rate and 100% CRIT DMG.
Additionally, when Varesa uses the Hold version of her Elemental Skill Riding the Night-Rainbow, or Taps her Elemental Skill while in the Sudden Onrush mode, she will restore Nightsoul points up to her maximum.
constellations.descriptionId:
Saat memasuki status Apex Drive, Varesa akan memulihkan 30 poin Energy.
Plunging Attack dan Elemental Burst Guardian Vent! Varesa akan mendapatkan peningkatan 10% CRIT Rate dan 100% CRIT DMG.
Selain itu, Varesa akan memulihkan poin Nightsoul-nya hingga batas maksimum saat melancarkan Elemental Skill Riding the Night-Rainbow dalam Mode Tahan, atau saat menekan Elemental Skill dalam mode Sudden Onrush.

name: Varka
title: Knight of Boreas
description: Grand Master of the Knights of Favonius. Knight of Boreas, protector of Mondstadt.
descriptionId: Grandmaster Knights of Favonius, Sang Knight of Boreas pelindung Mondstadt.

talents.name: Favonius Bladework: Dancing Radiance
talents.description:
Normal Attack
Imitating an ancient knightly war-dance, Varka wields dual claymores to perform up to 5 consecutive strikes.

Charged Attack
Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to charge forward and perform an especially powerful dual blade slash toward the front.

Plunging Attack
Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground below, damaging opponents along the path and dealing AoE DMG upon impact.
talents.descriptionId:
Normal Attack
Meniru tarian perang knight zaman dulu, Varka mengerahkan dua pedang claymore-nya untuk melancarkan hingga 5 serangan berturut-turut.

Charged Attack
Mengonsumsi sejumlah Stamina, menerjang ke arah depan dan melancarkan satu kali tebasan dua pedang yang sangat kuat.

Plunging Attack
Menerjang dari udara untuk menghantam tanah, menyerang musuh di jalur terjangan dan mengakibatkan DMG Area saat mendarat.

talents.name: Windbound Execution
talents.description:
Manifest the true essence of Favonius Bladework with absolute power. Produces different effects depending on whether the skill is Tapped or Held.

Tap
Leap forward and slash in one fluid motion, dealing AoE Anemo DMG and switching to **Sturm und Drang** mode.
While in Sturm und Drang, Varka's Normal Attack and Charged Attack DMG is increased, and he cannot perform Plunging Attacks. Also, when performing Normal or Charged Attacks, Varka's dual-wielded claymores will deal corresponding Elemental DMG based on the Elemental Types of the characters in the party, respectively. This Elemental DMG cannot be overridden by infusions.
Additionally, when in Sturm und Drang, if there are Pyro, Hydro, Electro or Cryo characters in the party, Varka's Elemental Skill Windbound Execution will be converted to the special Elemental Skill, **Four Winds' Ascension**, dealing corresponding Elemental DMG and Anemo DMG. Additionally, Varka can also expend uses of the special Elemental Skill Four Winds' Ascension to perform a special Charged Attack, Azure Devour, that does not consume stamina to deal corresponding Elemental DMG and Anemo DMG.

Hold
After charging for a while, leap forward. The duration of the charge will increase the distance of the leap.
talents.descriptionId:
Menampilkan esensi dari Favonius Bladework dengan kekuatan mutlaknya. Talenta ini akan menghasilkan efek yang berbeda berdasarkan Mode Tekan atau Mode Tahan.

Mode Tekan
Melompat ke arah depan dan melakukan tebasan dalam satu gerakan mulus, mengakibatkan Anemo DMG Area dan berganti ke mode **Sturm und Drang**.
Saat dalam mode Sturm und Drang, DMG Normal Attack dan Charged Attack Varka akan meningkat, tetapi tidak bisa melancarkan Plunging Attack. Saat melancarkan Normal Attack dan Charged Attack, pedang claymore di kedua tangan Varka akan mengakibatkan Elemental DMG dengan jenis elemen yang sesuai berdasarkan jenis elemen Karakter dalam party. Elemental DMG ini tidak bisa ditimpa Elemental Infusion lainnya.
Selain itu, saat berada dalam mode Sturm und Drang, jika ada Karakter Pyro, Hydro, Electro, atau Cryo di dalam party, maka Elemental Skill Varka Windbound Execution akan dikonversi menjadi Elemental Skill Khusus **Four Winds' Ascension** yang mengakibatkan Elemental DMG dengan jenis elemen yang sesuai dan juga Anemo DMG. Selain itu, Varka juga dapat mengonsumsi jumlah penggunaan Elemental Skill Khusus Four Winds' Ascension untuk melancarkan Charged Attack khusus yang tidak mengonsumsi Stamina, yaitu Azure Devour. Charged Attack khusus ini akan mengakibatkan Elemental DMG dengan jenis elemen yang sesuai dan juga Anemo DMG.

Mode Tahan
Melompat ke depan setelah mengisi energi. Jarak lompatannya akan bertambah seiring dengan waktu pengisian energi.

talents.name: Northwind Avatar
talents.description:
In the name of the mightiest Knight of Boreas, unleash a powerful double slash attack toward the front, dealing 2 instances of Anemo DMG.
If there are Pyro, Hydro, Electro or Cryo characters in the party, the first slash will be converted to deal corresponding Elemental DMG according to the aforementioned priority order of Elemental Types.
talents.descriptionId:
Dengan mengatasnamakan Knight of Boreas terkuat, Varka melancarkan dua kali tebasan beruntun yang kuat ke arah depan dan mengakibatkan Anemo DMG.
Jika ada Karakter Pyro, Hydro, Electro, atau Cryo di dalam party, maka tebasan pertama akan dikonversi menjadi Elemental DMG dengan jenis elemen yang sesuai berdasarkan urutan prioritas elemen yang disebutkan di atas.

passives.name: Dawn Wind's March
passives.description:
When there are Pyro, Hydro, Electro or Cryo characters in the party, according to the aforementioned priority order of Elemental Types, every 1,000 points of Varka's ATK will grant Varka a 10% Anemo DMG Bonus and corresponding Elemental DMG Bonus (among the aforementioned Elemental Types, only one element can gain bonus DMG this way). Up to 25% bonus DMG can be gained this way. 

Additionally, if there are at least 2 Anemo characters, or at least 2 characters of the same Element among Pyro, Hydro, Electro or Cryo in the party, the Normal Attacks, Charged Attacks, Special Charged Attack Azure Devour and the special Elemental Skill **Four Winds' Ascension** that Varka deals or unleashes while in the **Sturm und Drang** mode will deal 140% of their original DMG. If there are at least 2 Anemo characters and at least 2 other characters of the same element among Pyro, Hydro, Electro or Cryo present in the party at the same time, the aforementioned effect will be increased to 220%.
passives.descriptionId:
Saat ada Karakter Pyro, Hydro, Electro, atau Cryo dalam party, untuk setiap 1.000 poin ATK yang dimiliki Varka, ia akan mendapatkan 10% Anemo DMG Bonus dan Elemental DMG Bonus untuk jenis elemen yang sesuai berdasarkan urutan prioritas elemen yang disebutkan di atas (maksimum 1 jenis elemen dari elemen yang disebutkan di atas yang bisa diperoleh dengan cara ini), hingga maksimum 25%.

Selain itu, saat ada setidaknya 2 Karakter Anemo dalam party, atau ada setidaknya 2 Karakter Pyro, Hydro, Electro, atau Cryo dengan jenis elemen yang sama, maka Normal Attack, Charged Attack, Charged Attack Khusus Azure Devour, dan Elemental Skill Khusus **Four Winds' Ascension** Varka yang dilancarkan dalam mode **Sturm und Drang** akan mengakibatkan 140% dari DMG awalnya. Jika party memiliki setidaknya 2 Karakter Anemo dan setidaknya 2 Karakter Pyro, Hydro, Electro, atau Cryo dengan jenis elemen yang sama, maka efek di atas meningkat menjadi 220%.

passives.name: Wind's Vanguard
passives.description: When nearby party members trigger a Swirl or Stellar Swirl reaction, Varka gains 1 stack of Azure Fang's Oath, increasing the DMG dealt by his Normal Attacks, Charged Attacks, special Charged Attack Azure Devour and special Elemental Skill **Four Winds' Ascension** by 7.5% for 8s. Max 4 stacks. Each character can grant Varka with 1 stack of Azure Fang's Oath every second this way.
passives.descriptionId: Saat Karakter party di sekitar memicu reaksi Swirl atau Stellar Swirl, Varka mendapatkan 1 lapis Azure Fang's Oath yang akan meningkatkan DMG Normal Attack, Charged Attack, Charged Attack Khusus Azure Devour, dan Elemental Skill Khusus **Four Winds' Ascension** milik Varka sebesar 7,5% selama 8 detik. Efek ini dapat ditumpuk sampai 4 lapis. Setiap Karakter dapat memberikan 1 lapis Azure Fang's Oath untuk Varka sekali setiap detik dengan cara ini.

passives.name: Homebound Wind's Paean
passives.description:
For every party member from Mondstadt, the Hold version of Varka's Elemental Skill Windbound Execution's CD is decreased by 5%.
This effect does not trigger in Domains, Trounce Domains, or the Spiral Abyss.
passives.descriptionId:
Untuk setiap 1 Karakter Mondstadt dalam party, CD untuk Elemental Skill Mode Tahan Windbound Execution berkurang 5%.
Efek ini tidak aktif dalam Domain, Trounce Domain, atau Spiral Abyss.

constellations.name: "Come, Friend, Let Us Dance Beneath the Moon's Soft Glow"
constellations.description:
When Varka switches to **Sturm und Drang**, he will obtain an additional use of the special Elemental Skill **Four Winds' Ascension**.
Additionally, after switching to Sturm und Drang, Varka will gain the Lyrical Libation effect: When unleashing the special Elemental Skill Four Winds' Ascension, or when performing the special Charged Attack Azure Devour, Varka will consume this effect to deal 200% of the original DMG dealt by Four Winds' Ascension or Azure Devour.
constellations.descriptionId:
Saat Varka beralih ke mode **Sturm und Drang**, akan mendapatkan 1 kali kesempatan penggunaan Elemental Skill Khusus **Four Winds' Ascension**.
Selain itu, setelah berganti ke mode Sturm und Drang, Varka akan mendapatkan efek Lyrical Libation: Saat melancarkan Elemental Skill Khusus Four Winds' Ascension atau melancarkan Charged Attack khusus Azure Devour, Varka akan mengonsumsi efek ini dan membuat Four Winds' Ascension atau Azure Devour mengakibatkan 200% dari DMG awalnya.

constellations.name: "When Dawn Breaks, Our Journey Shall Take Flight"
constellations.description: When unleashing the special Elemental Skill **Four Winds' Ascension**, or when performing the special Charged Attack Azure Devour, Varka will perform an additional strike, dealing AoE Anemo DMG equal to 800% of Varka's ATK.
constellations.descriptionId: Saat melancarkan Elemental Skill Khusus **Four Winds' Ascension** atau Charged Attack Khusus Azure Devour, Varka akan melancarkan satu kali serangan tambahan yang mengakibatkan Anemo DMG Area sebesar 800% ATK-nya.

constellations.name: "O Friend, Quaff Not the Bitter Wine That Brings Tears of Woe"
constellations.description:
Increases Elemental Skill **Windbound Execution** Level by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.descriptionId:
Meningkatkan 3 level Elemental Skill **Windbound Execution**.
Maksimum: Lv. 15.

constellations.name: "For None May Take From Us Our Freedom of Song"
constellations.description: When Varka triggers a Swirl or Stellar Swirl reaction, based on the Elemental Types involved in the reaction, all nearby party members gain a 20% Anemo DMG Bonus and the corresponding Elemental DMG Bonus for 10s.
constellations.descriptionId: Saat Varka memicu reaksi Swirl atau Stellar Swirl, seluruh Karakter party di sekitar akan mendapatkan 20% Anemo DMG Bonus dan juga Elemental DMG Bonus untuk jenis elemen yang terlibat dalam reaksi tersebut, berlangsung selama 10 detik.

constellations.name: "Fill High the Cup With Fine Wine, for Tyrants Come and Go"
constellations.description:
Increases Elemental Burst **Northwind Avatar** Level by 3.
 Maximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.descriptionId:
Meningkatkan 3 level Elemental Burst **Northwind Avatar**.
Maksimum: Lv. 15.

constellations.name: "Beloved Mondstadt, Steadfast You Shall Shine"
constellations.description:
**Sturm und Drang** is enhanced:
· For a short time after unleashing the special Elemental Skill **Four Winds' Ascension**, Tapping on Varka's Elemental Skill or Holding his Normal Attack will not expend any uses of Four Winds' Ascension, and will perform one additional instance of the special Charged Attack, Azure Devour.
· For a short time after performing the special Charged Attack Azure Devour, tap on Varka's Elemental Skill to unleash an additional instance of Four Winds' Ascension without expending any uses of Four Winds' Ascension.
When triggering an additional special Charged Attack, Azure Devour, or unleashing an additional special Elemental Skill, Four Winds' Ascension, in this manner, the above effect cannot be triggered.

Additionally, the Azure Fang's Oath effect in Ascension Talent **Wind's Vanguard** is enhanced: Every stack of Azure Fang's Oath will increase Varka's CRIT DMG by 20%.
constellations.descriptionId:
Mode **Sturm und Drang** diperkuat:
·Selama beberapa saat setelah melancarkan Elemental Skill Khusus **Four Winds' Ascension**, Varka dapat menekan Elemental Skill atau menahan tombol Normal Attack untuk melancarkan satu kali Charged Attack Khusus Azure Devour tambahan tanpa mengonsumsi jumlah penggunaan Four Winds' Ascension.
·Selama beberapa saat setelah melancarkan Charged Attack Khusus Azure Devour, Varka bisa menekan Elemental Skill untuk melancarkan satu kali Four Winds' Ascension tambahan tanpa mengonsumsi jumlah penggunaan Four Winds' Ascension.
Charged Attack Khusus tambahan, Azure Devour, atau Elemental Skill Khusus tambahan, Four Winds' Ascension yang dilancarkan dengan cara di atas tidak akan dapat memicu efek di atas lagi.

Selain itu, efek Azure Fang's Oath dari Talenta Ascension **Wind's Vanguard** diperkuat: Setiap lapis Azure Fang's Oath akan meningkatkan 20% CRIT DMG Varka.

name: Venti
title: Windborne Bard
description: One of the many bards of Mondstadt, who freely wanders the city's streets and alleys.
descriptionId: Salah satu dari banyaknya penyair di Mondstadt yang bisa dengan bebasnya ke sana kemari di antara lorong-lorong dan gang-gang Mondstadt.

talents.name: Divine Marksmanship
talents.description:
Normal Attack
Performs up to 6 consecutive shots with a bow.

Charged Attack
Performs a more precise Aimed Shot with increased DMG.
While aiming, favorable winds will accumulate on the arrowhead. A fully charged wind arrow will deal Anemo DMG.

Plunging Attack
Fires off a shower of arrows in mid-air before falling and striking the ground, dealing AoE DMG upon impact.
talents.descriptionId:
Normal Attack
Melancarkan hingga 6 tembakan panah berturut-turut menggunakan busur.

Charged Attack
Melancarkan sebuah Serangan Membidik yang lebih akurat untuk mengakibatkan DMG yang lebih besar.
Saat membidik, angin akan berkumpul di ujung anak panah. Panah dengan angin yang terkumpul penuh akan mengakibatkan Anemo DMG.

Plunging Attack
Melancarkan hujan panah dari udara dan menerjang tanah dengan kecepatan tinggi, mengakibatkan DMG Area saat mendarat.

talents.name: Skyward Sonnet
talents.description:
O wind upon which all hymns and songs fly, bear these earth-walkers up into the sky!

Press
Summons a Wind Domain at the opponent's location, dealing AoE Anemo DMG and launching opponents into the air.

Hold
Summons an even larger Wind Domain with Venti as the epicenter, dealing AoE Anemo DMG and launching affected opponents into the air.
After unleashing the Hold version of this ability, Venti rides the wind into the air.

Opponents hit by Skyward Sonnet will fall to the ground slowly.
talents.descriptionId:
Wahai angin tempat semua nyanyian dan pujian dilantunkan, mampukan pejalan kaki bumi ini naik ke langit.

Tekan
Memanggil sebuah Wind Domain di lokasi musuh yang mengakibatkan Anemo DMG Area serta menghempaskan musuh ke udara.

Tahan
Memanggil Wind Domain yang lebih besar lagi dengan Venti berada di tengahnya. Mengakibatkan Anemo DMG Area dan menghempaskan musuh ke udara.
Setelah mengerahkan Wind Domain yang lebih besar, Venti mengendarai angin ke udara.

Musuh yang terhempas oleh Skyward Sonnet akan jatuh ke tanah perlahan-lahan dalam waktu singkat.

talents.name: Wind's Grand Ode
talents.description:
Fires off an arrow made of countless coalesced winds, creating a huge Stormeye that sucks in opponents and deals continuous Anemo DMG.

Elemental Absorption
If the Stormeye comes into contact with Hydro/Pyro/Cryo/Electro, it will deal additional elemental DMG of that type.
Elemental Absorption may only occur once per use.
talents.descriptionId:
Menembakkan panah yang terbuat dari angin gabungan yang tak terhitung jumlahnya. Membuat Stormeye raksasa yang menarik musuh; mengakibatkan Anemo DMG berkelanjutan.

Elemental Absorption
Jika Stormeye bersentuhan dengan elemen Hydro/Pyro/Cryo/Electro, ia akan mengakibatkan tambahan Elemental DMG dengan tipe tersebut.
Elemental Absorption hanya dapat terjadi sekali untuk setiap penggunaan skill.

passives.name: Embrace of Winds
passives.description: Holding Skyward Sonnet creates an upcurrent that lasts for 20s.
passives.descriptionId: Menahan tombol skill Skyward Sonnet akan menciptakan arus angin yang berlangsung selama 20 detik.

passives.name: Stormeye
passives.description:
Regenerates 15 Energy for Venti after the effects of Wind's Grand Ode end.
