If an Elemental Absorption occurred, this also restores 15 Energy to all characters of that corresponding element in the party.
passives.descriptionId:
Memulihkan 15 Energy Venti setelah Wind's Grand Ode berakhir.
Jika terjadi Elemental Absorption, juga akan memulihkan 15 Energy kepada seluruh anggota party dengan elemen yang sesuai.

passives.name: Windrider
passives.description:
Decreases gliding Stamina consumption for your own party members by 20%.
Not stackable with Passive Talents that provide the exact same effects.
passives.descriptionId:
Mengurangi 20% konsumsi Stamina Karakter party sendiri saat meluncur.
Efek ini tidak dapat ditumpuk dengan Talenta Pasif lain dengan efek yang sama persis.

constellations.name: Splitting Gales
constellations.description: Fires 2 additional arrows per Aimed Shot, each dealing 33% of the original arrow's DMG.
constellations.descriptionId: Menembakkan 2 anak panah tambahan setiap Serangan Membidik, yang masing-masing mengakibatkan 33% DMG dari panah utama.

constellations.name: Breeze of Reminiscence
constellations.description:
Skyward Sonnet decreases opponents' Anemo RES and Physical RES by 12% for 10s.
Opponents launched by Skyward Sonnet suffer an additional 12% Anemo RES and Physical RES decrease while airborne.
constellations.descriptionId:
Skyward Sonnet mengurangi 12% Anemo RES dan Physical RES musuh selama 10 detik.
Anemo RES dan Physical RES musuh yang terhempas oleh Skyward Sonnet berkurang lagi 12% saat di udara.

constellations.name: Ode to Thousand Winds
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Wind's Grand Ode by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.descriptionId:
Meningkatkan 3 level Wind's Grand Ode.
Maksimum: Lv. 15.

constellations.name: Hurricane of Freedom
constellations.description: When Venti picks up an Elemental Orb or Particle, he receives a 25% Anemo DMG Bonus for 10s.
constellations.descriptionId: Saat Venti mengambil sebuah Elemental Orb atau Particle, dia akan menerima 25% Anemo DMG Bonus selama 10 detik.

constellations.name: Concerto dal Cielo
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Skyward Sonnet by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.descriptionId:
Meningkatkan 3 level Skyward Sonnet.
Maksimum: Lv. 15.

constellations.name: Storm of Defiance
constellations.description:
Targets who take DMG from Wind's Grand Ode have their Anemo RES decreased by 20%.
If an Elemental Absorption occurred, then their RES towards the corresponding Element is also decreased by 20%.
constellations.descriptionId:
Musuh yang menerima DMG dari Wind's Grand Ode akan mendapat pengurangan Anemo RES sebanyak 20%.
Jika Elemental Absorption muncul, maka RES terhadap elemen yang bersangkutan juga berkurang 20%.

name: Vesna
title: Snowy Banquet's Sharp Blade
description: Commander of the Druzhna and the Tsaritsa's keen blade.
descriptionId: Komandan tertinggi Druzhna, sang mata pedang Tsaritsa.

talents.name: Vila Blade Dance
talents.description:
Normal Attack
Performs up to 6 consecutive strikes.

Charged Attack
Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to trample opponents in front of her.

Plunging Attack
Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground below, damaging opponents along her path and dealing AoE DMG upon impact.
talents.descriptionId:
Normal Attack
Melancarkan hingga 6 serangan berturut-turut.

Charged Attack
Mengonsumsi sejumlah Stamina untuk menginjak musuh di depan.

Plunging Attack
Menerjang dari udara untuk menghantam tanah, menyerang musuh di jalur terjangan dan mengakibatkan DMG area saat mendarat.

talents.name: The Art of Victory
talents.description:
Calls forth Spirit Blades passed down through generations of the Vila to deal AoE Anemo DMG, then switches to the **Armed for Action** mode and gains 2 stacks of **Sword Essence**.

Armed for Action
DMG dealt by Vesna with her Normal Attacks, Charged Attacks, and Plunging Attacks become Anemo DMG that cannot be overridden by another elemental infusion instead. She will also summon a wind pinion that attacks the opponent at the same time, dealing additional Anemo DMG. Each time the wind pinion is summoned, Vesna will regenerate a certain amount of Sword Essence.
Vesna can consume Sword Essence to unleash the special Elemental Skill **Windborne Sword**, which deals to the opponent Anemo DMG.
Each use of the special Elemental Skill Windborne Sword in the same instance of Armed for Action will increase the level of Windborne Sword, beginning from Lv. 1 to Lv. 3 max, for more Anemo DMG. Using Windborne Sword at Lv. 2 and Lv. 3 will also summon **Spirit Blades** which deal Anemo DMG.
Vesna will exit the mode when its duration ends or when she has used Windborne Sword at the highest level 3 times. Exiting will clear all remaining Sword Essence she has accrued.
Additionally, when in this mode, Vesna's resistance to interruption is increased.
Radiance: Stellar Swirl: DMG dealt with the Spirit Blades becomes Anemo DMG that is also considered Stellar Swirl reaction DMG.
talents.descriptionId:
Memanggil Spirit Blade yang diwariskan dari generasi-generasi Vila sebelumnya, mengakibatkan Anemo DMG Area, kemudian beralih ke mode **Armed for Action** dan mendapatkan 2 tumpukan **Sword Essence**.

Armed for Action
Saat Vesna melancarkan Normal Attack, Charged Attack, dan Plunging Attack, serangannya akan berubah menjadi Anemo DMG yang tidak bisa ditimpa Elemental Infusion lainnya. Vesna juga akan memanggil sebuah bulu angin untuk melakukan serangan terkoordinasi pada musuh, mengakibatkan Anemo DMG tambahan. Setiap kali bulu angin ini dipanggil, Vesna akan memulihkan sejumlah Sword Essence.
Vesna dapat mengonsumsi Sword Essence untuk melancarkan Elemental Skill Khusus **Windborne Sword** dan mengakibatkan Anemo DMG pada musuh.
Setelah setiap kali Elemental Skill Khusus Windborne Sword dilancarkan, selama satu kali durasi Armed for Action, level Windborne Sword akan meningkat dan mengakibatkan Anemo DMG yang lebih kuat. Level awal Windborne Sword adalah Level 1 dan dapat meningkat hingga Level 3. Menggunakan Windborne Sword di Lv. 2 dan Lv. 3 juga akan memanggil **Spirit Blade** yang mengakibatkan Anemo DMG terhadap musuh.
Vesna akan keluar dari mode ini saat durasinya berakhir atau setelah dia melancarkan Windborne Sword dengan level tertinggi sebanyak tiga kali, dan semua Sword Essence yang tersisa akan dihapus.
Selain itu, dalam mode ini, ketahanan Vesna terhadap interupsi akan meningkat.
Radiance: Stellar Swirl: DMG Spirit Blade dikonversi menjadi Anemo DMG yang dianggap sebagai DMG reaksi Stellar Swirl.

talents.name: For the Tsaritsa!
talents.description: Summons multiple **Spirit Blades**, dealing AoE Anemo DMG. Also gains a stack of **Sword Essence**.
talents.descriptionId: Memanggil beberapa **Spirit Blade** sekaligus dan mengakibatkan Anemo DMG Area, serta mendapatkan satu lapis **Sword Essence**.

passives.name: Rite of Spring's Procession
passives.description:
After Vesna uses the special Elemental Skill **Windborne Sword** or the Elemental Burst **For the Tsaritsa!**, she also gains 1 stack of Disciplinary Action which lasts 20s. Max 6 stacks, and the duration of each stack is independent of the others'.
When she has Disciplinary Action stacks active, the **Spirit Blades** summoned by Vesna will deal DMG equal to (100% + 10% × Disciplinary Action stack count) of the original DMG instead. All active stacks of Disciplinary Action are cleared when Vesna uses the Elemental Skill The Art of Victory or when she leaves the field.
passives.descriptionId:
Setelah Vesna melancarkan Elemental Skill Khusus **Windborne Sword** atau Elemental Burst **For the Tsaritsa!**, Vesna juga akan mendapatkan 1 lapis Disciplinary Action yang berlangsung selama 20 detik dan dapat ditumpuk sampai 6 lapis. Durasi setiap lapisnya dihitung terpisah.
Saat Vesna memiliki Disciplinary Action, **Spirit Blade** yang dipanggil olehnya akan mengakibatkan DMG sebesar 100% + (jumlah lapisan Disciplinary Action ×10%) dari DMG awalnya. Melancarkan Elemental Skill The Art of Victory atau meninggalkan medan pertempuran akan menghapus semua Disciplinary Action yang dimiliki Vesna.

passives.name: Truth Prevails
passives.description:
Radiance: Stellar Swirl: Vesna will gain the corresponding effect based on the Elemental Type of her party members: 
· For every Cryo or Anemo character in her current party, Vesna's ATK increases by 6%; and
· For every character of all other Elemental Types in her current party, Vesna's Elemental Mastery increases by 25 instead.

passives.name: Stellar Jubilee: Splendid Prelude
passives.description:
When party members trigger Cryo Swirl, it will be changed to a Stellar Swirl reaction, and party members' Base DMG for the Stellar Swirl will be increased based on Vesna's ATK. Every 100 ATK she has increases the Base Stellar Swirl DMG by 0.7%. The maximum DMG increase that can be gained this way is 14%.
After a party member triggers a Stellar Swirl reaction nearby, Vesna enters the Radiance: Stellar Swirl state for 8s.
passives.descriptionId:
Saat Karakter di dalam party memicu reaksi Cryo Swirl, reaksi ini akan diubah menjadi reaksi Stellar Swirl. DMG dasar reaksi Stellar Swirl Karakter di dalam party meningkat berdasarkan ATK Vesna: Untuk setiap 100 poin ATK, DMG dasar reaksi Stellar Swirl meningkat 0,7% dan dapat ditingkatkan hingga 14% dengan cara ini.
Setelah Karakter di dalam party memicu reaksi Stellar Swirl di dekatnya, Vesna akan memasuki status Radiance: Stellar Swirl selama 8 detik.

passives.name: The Grand Circuit
passives.description:
Holding on Sprint or Jump when Vesna is not in combat will cause her to enter the Coursing state.

Coursing
Continuously consumes Stamina to hover in mid-air. Sprinting or tapping Jump to go higher expends additional Stamina. Including the hold on Jump that triggers Coursing, Vesna can go higher up to 3 times in each instance of the Coursing state.

Additionally, in Snezhnaya (excluding Nod-Krai), when Vesna is switched onto the field while the currently active party member is in mid-air and not in combat, she will immediately enter the Coursing state and regenerate 50 Stamina. This effect can trigger once every 10s, and does not take effect in Domains, Trounce Domains, or the Spiral Abyss.
passives.descriptionId:
Saat tidak dalam kondisi bertempur, Vesna dapat memasuki status Coursing dengan cara menahan tombol Lari atau Lompat.

Coursing
Terus menghabiskan Stamina untuk mempertahankan kondisi melayang. Saat menekan tombol Lari atau Lompat untuk menaikkan ketinggian, Stamina-nya juga akan berkurang lebih banyak. Termasuk saat memasuki status Coursing dengan menahan tombol Lompat, Vesna dapat meningkatkan ketinggiannya hingga 3 kali di setiap status Coursing.

Selain itu, saat berada di wilayah Snezhnaya (kecuali Nod-Krai) dan tidak dalam kondisi bertempur, ketika Karakter aktif dalam party sedang berada di udara, mengganti Karakter ke Vesna akan membuatnya langsung memasuki status Coursing serta memulihkan 50 poin Stamina. Efek ini dapat terpicu sekali setiap 10 detik. Efek ini tidak aktif dalam Domain, Domain Trounce, atau Spiral Abyss

constellations.name: Winter's Farewell Feast
constellations.description:
When in the **Armed for Action** mode, Vesna can unleash **Windborne Sword** at the highest level 4 times instead of 3. Also, each time she enters the Armed for Action mode, she will not consume **Sword Essence** the first time she uses Windborne Sword at the highest level.
Additionally, Vesna deals 20% increased Stellar Swirl reaction DMG when in the Armed for Action mode.
constellations.descriptionId:
Dalam mode **Armed for Action**, Vesna dapat melancarkan **Windborne Sword** dengan level tertinggi hingga empat kali, bukan tiga kali. Dan setiap kali memasuki mode Armed for Action, melancarkan Windborne Sword dengan level tertinggi untuk pertama kalinya tidak mengonsumsi **Sword Essence**.
Selain itu, DMG reaksi Stellar Swirl yang diakibatkan Vesna dalam mode Armed for Action meningkat 20%.

constellations.name: Kolo of Spring's Arrival
constellations.description:
The Ascension Talent **Rite of Spring's Procession** is enhanced: Vesna gains the maximum number of Disciplinary Action stacks when she enters **Armed for Action** mode. Vesna's ATK is increased by 40% when she has maximum Disciplinary Action stacks.
You must unlock the Ascension Talent "Rite of Spring's Procession" to gain access to the above effects.
constellations.descriptionId:
Talenta Ascension **Rite of Spring's Procession** diperkuat: saat memasuki mode **Armed for Action**, Vesna akan mendapatkan Disciplinary Action dengan jumlah lapisan maksimum. Saat memiliki jumlah lapisan Disciplinary Action maksimum, ATK Vesna akan meningkat 40%.
Harus membuka Talenta Ascension "Rite of Spring's Procession" terlebih dahulu untuk memicu efek di atas.

constellations.name: Winter's Last Offering
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of the Elemental Skill **The Art of Victory** by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.descriptionId:
Meningkatkan 3 level Elemental Skill **The Art of Victory**.
Maksimum: Lv. 15.

constellations.name: Glory to Our Forebears
constellations.description: The Ascension Talent **Truth Prevails** is enhanced: Its ATK and Elemental Mastery bonuses increase to 3 times their original values.
constellations.descriptionId: Talenta Ascension **Truth Prevails** diperkuat: efek peningkatan ATK dan Elemental Mastery menjadi tiga kali lipat dari nilai awalnya.

constellations.name: The Nobleborn's Charge
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of the Elemental Burst **For the Tsaritsa!** by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.descriptionId:
Meningkatkan 3 level Elemental Burst **For the Tsaritsa!**.
Maksimum: Lv. 15.

constellations.name: Unwavering Ardor
constellations.description:
Tapping on Normal Attack or Elemental Skill in the 5s after Vesna uses **Windborne Sword** at its highest level will unleash the secret Vila ability Windborne Sword: Transpose, dealing Anemo DMG at 150% of Vesna's ATK as well as summoning **Spirit Blades** which deal an additional instance of Anemo DMG at 200% of Vesna's ATK. If Vesna is in the **Armed for Action** mode, she will also summon a wind pinion to perform Coordinated Attacks against opponents.
Additionally, Vesna's Stellar Swirl reaction DMG dealt is **elevated** by 20%.
constellations.descriptionId:
Selama 5 detik setelah melancarkan **Windborne Sword** level tertinggi, Vesna dapat menekan Normal Attack atau Elemental Skill untuk melancarkan Windborne Sword: Transpose yang merupakan ilmu rahasia turun-temurun ras Vila: Mengakibatkan Anemo DMG sebesar 150% ATK Vesna dan memanggil **Spirit Blade** yang mengakibatkan Anemo DMG tambahan sebesar 200% ATK Vesna. Jika Vesna berada dalam mode **Armed for Action**, ia juga akan memanggil bulu angin untuk melancarkan serangan terkoordinasi terhadap musuh.
Selain itu, DMG reaksi Stellar Swirl yang diakibatkan Vesna **bertumbuh** 20%.

name: Vodyanitsa
title: Lingering Siren-Song
description: Prima Donna of the Korolevskiy Troupe and a Water Imp who has parted from her kin.
descriptionId: Prima Donna Rombongan Teater Korolevskiy, sang Imp Air yang terpisahkan dari sesamanya.

talents.name: Psyshkhwe Arietta
talents.description:
Normal Attack
Sings an ancient song of the Water Imps, unleashing up to 4 strikes. This deals Hydro DMG to the opponent.

Charged Attack
Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to hurl a water ball forward, dealing Hydro DMG.

Plunging Attack
Plunges towards the ground from mid-air, damaging all opponents along the path. Deals AoE Hydro DMG upon impact with the ground.
talents.descriptionId:
Normal Attack
Menyanyikan lagu Imp Air kuno untuk melancarkan hingga 4 serangan yang mengakibatkan Hydro DMG.

Charged Attack
Mengonsumsi sejumlah Stamina untuk melemparkan bola air ke depan dan mengakibatkan Hydro DMG.

Plunging Attack
Menerjang dari udara untuk menghantam tanah, menyerang musuh di jalur terjangan dan mengakibatkan Hydro DMG Area saat mendarat.

talents.name: Rechitativ: Sonorous Dawn
talents.description:
Reveals her true Water Imp form, dealing AoE Hydro DMG and gaining the Song of Ages Past effect: While this effect is active, Vodyanitsa summons the ancient Horn of Spring's Call, periodically moving closer to an opponent in a swift movement to attack them, dealing Hydro DMG.
The above two types of attacks will also decrease the Hydro RES and Cryo RES of opponents hit. Additionally, while the Song of Ages Past effect is active, the party's active character gains increased resistance to interruption and periodically regenerates HP based on Vodyanitsa's Max HP.
talents.descriptionId:
Menampakkan wujud asli Imp Air-nya dan mengakibatkan Hydro DMG Area serta mendapatkan efek Song of Ages Past: Selama efek ini berlangsung, Vodyanitsa akan memanggil Horn of Spring's Call kuno yang akan secara berkala bergerak cepat untuk mendekati salah satu musuh dan menyerangnya, mengakibatkan Hydro DMG.
Saat kedua serangan yang disebutkan di atas mengenai musuh, Hydro RES dan Cryo RES musuh akan berkurang. Selain itu, selama efek Song of Ages Past berlangsung, ketahanan Karakter aktif sendiri dalam party terhadap interupsi juga akan meningkat, dan HP-nya akan dipulihkan secara berkala. Jumlah pemulihan ini didasarkan pada Max HP Vodyanitsa.

talents.name: Koda: Sink With Thee
talents.description:
Leads a song of the Water Imps which lures its listeners to their doom. This deals AoE Hydro DMG to the opponent.
When in the **Song of Ages Past** state, DMG dealt is further increased.
talents.descriptionId:
Memimpin lagu kuno para Imp Air yang memikat para pendengarnya menuju ajal dan mengakibatkan Hydro DMG Area.
Saat berada dalam status **Song of Ages Past**, DMG yang diakibatkan akan semakin meningkat.

passives.name: The Last Djeguako Songstress
passives.description:
When the Elemental Skill Rechitativ: Sonorous Dawn is used, any Stellar Vortex on the field will turn into a Wandering Vortex instead. While the **Song of Ages Past** effect is active, nearby party members' Stellar Swirl reactions will generate Wandering Vortex instead.
Generating or detonating a Wandering Vortex will also reduce nearby opponents' Anemo RES by 35% for 6s. 
Additionally, nearby party members who enter the Radiance: Stellar Swirl state while Song of Ages Past is in effect will have the Radiance: Stellar Swirl state extended by 4s.
passives.descriptionId:
Saat melancarkan Elemental Skill Rechitativ: Sonorous Dawn, Stellar Vortex yang ada di medan pertempuran saat ini akan dikonversi menjadi Wandering Vortex, dan Karakter party di sekitar yang memicu reaksi Stellar Swirl selama efek **Song of Ages Past** berlangsung akan menciptakan Wandering Vortex sebagai ganti Stellar Vortex.
Saat menciptakan atau meledakkan Wandering Vortex, Anemo RES musuh di sekitarnya juga akan berkurang 35% selama 6 detik.
Selain itu, selama Song of Ages Past berlangsung, saat Karakter party di sekitar memasuki status Radiance: Stellar Swirl, durasi status Radiance: Stellar Swirl tersebut akan diperpanjang 4 detik.

passives.name: Dirge of the Fandyr
passives.description:
When the Elemental Skill Rechitativ: Sonorous Dawn is used, Vodyanitsa will also gain 25 stacks of **Lead Vocal** as well as 10 stacks of **Chorus**.
The two effects above last 30s each, and the stack count is refreshed when the Elemental Skill is used.
passives.descriptionId:
Saat melancarkan Elemental Skill Rechitativ: Sonorous Dawn, Vodyanitsa juga akan mendapatkan 25 lapis **Lead Vocal** dan 10 lapis **Chorus**.
Kedua efek di atas masing-masing bertahan selama 30 detik, dan lapisannya akan diperbarui saat melancarkan Elemental Skill.

passives.name: Echoes Over the Frozen Lake
passives.description:
Holding the Elemental Skill outside of combat will cause Vodyanitsa to embody her true Water Imp form and swim for up to 10s at the cost of Stamina. Naturally, as a Water Imp, she can also move across the water's surface. Vodyanitsa will exit her Water Imp form when the Elemental Skill is used again, when the duration ends, or when all Stamina is depleted.
Additionally, while Vodyanitsa can swim faster, her Stamina consumption rate is also increased.
passives.descriptionId:
Saat tidak dalam kondisi bertempur dan menahan Elemental Skill, Vodyanitsa akan menampakkan wujud aslinya sebagai Imp Air dan berenang hingga 10 detik dengan terus mengonsumsi Stamina. Karena merupakan Imp Air, tentu saja ia juga dapat bergerak di atas permukaan air. Vodyanitsa akan keluar dari wujud Imp Air-nya saat melancarkan Elemental Skill sekali lagi, saat durasinya berakhir, atau saat Stamina-nya habis.
Selain itu, Vodyanitsa dapat berenang lebih cepat, tetapi konsumsi Stamina-nya juga menjadi lebih cepat.

passives.name: Heartless Siren Song
passives.description: As the Prima Donna of the Korolevskiy Troupe, Vodyanitsa sings in person in place of playing an instrument.
passives.descriptionId: Sebagai prima donna Rombongan Teater Korolevskiy, Vodyanitsa akan bernyanyi dengan suaranya sendiri alih-alih memainkan alat musik.

constellations.name: Waters in Full Splendor
constellations.description: Each time Vodyanitsa triggers the healing effect of **Song of Ages Past**, it also increases the ATK of all nearby party members by 0.8% of her Max HP for 5s.
constellations.descriptionId: Saat Vodyanitsa memicu efek pemulihan HP dari **Song of Ages Past**, ATK semua Karakter party di sekitar juga meningkat sebesar 0,8% dari Max HP Vodyanitsa selama 5 detik.

constellations.name: Echoes That Pierce the Snow
constellations.description:
When the Horn of Spring's Call from the Elemental Skill Rechitativ: Sonorous Dawn attacks the opponent, Vodyanitsa gains the "Two Voices in Black and White" effect which increases the CRIT DMG from Hydro DMG and Cryo DMG dealt by the currently active party member by 50% for 5s.
If there is a Wandering Vortex present on the field or in the 5s after a Wandering Vortex explodes, the effect changes to: increases the CRIT DMG from Stellar Swirl reaction DMG caused by the currently active party member by 60% for 5s.
Additionally, the Elemental Skill Rechitativ: Sonorous Dawn is enhanced as follows: the duration of the **Song of Ages Past** effect is extended by 9s.
constellations.descriptionId:
Saat Horn of Spring's Call dari Elemental Skill Rechitativ: Sonorous Dawn menyerang musuh, maka Vodyanitsa akan mendapatkan efek "Two Voices in Black and White" yang meningkatkan CRIT DMG untuk Hydro DMG dan Cryo DMG yang diakibatkan oleh Karakter aktif dalam party sebesar 50% selama 5 detik.
Jika terdapat Wandering Vortex di medan pertempuran saat ini, atau selama 5 detik setelah Wandering Vortex meledak, efek ini berubah menjadi: Meningkatkan CRIT DMG reaksi Stellar Swirl yang diakibatkan Karakter aktif dalam party sebesar 60% selama 5 detik.
Selain itu, Elemental Skill Rechitativ: Sonorous Dawn diperkuat: Durasi efek **Song of Ages Past** diperpanjang selama 9 detik.

constellations.name: Song Lingering on a Spring Morning
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of the Elemental Skill **Rechitativ: Sonorous Dawn** by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.descriptionId:
Meningkatkan 3 level Elemental Skill **Rechitativ: Sonorous Dawn** .
Maksimum: Lv. 15.

constellations.name: Melancholic Voice Upon the Gentle Waters
constellations.description:
When Vodyanitsa triggers the healing effect of **Song of Ages Past**, an additional effect will be triggered based on the healed character's HP.
· If the character's HP is below 40%: The healing is increased by 50%; and
· If the character's HP is 40% or above: Vodyanitsa's Max HP is increased by 20% for 6s. Max 3 stacks, and each stack's duration is counted independently.
constellations.descriptionId:
Saat Vodyanitsa memicu efek pemulihan HP dari **Song of Ages Past**, ia akan memicu efek berbeda berdasarkan HP Karakter yang dipulihkan. Jika HP Karakter yang dipulihkan:
·Kurang dari 40%: Jumlah pemulihan HP kali ini meningkat 50%.
·Tidak kurang dari 40%: Max HP Vodyanitsa meningkat 20% selama 6 detik, efek ini dapat ditumpuk sampai 3 lapis dan durasi setiap lapisnya dihitung terpisah.

constellations.name: Together, Down Into the Deep
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of the Elemental Burst **Koda: Sink With Thee** by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.descriptionId:
Meningkatkan 3 level Elemental Burst **Koda: Sink With Thee** .
Maksimum: Lv. 15.

constellations.name: Neverending Song of Revelry
constellations.description:
The Constellation Echoes That Pierce the Snow is enhanced: "Two Voices in Black and White" now applies to all nearby party members.
Additionally, while the **Song of Ages Past** effect is active, Stellar Swirl reaction DMG dealt by nearby party members is **elevated** by 25% while Hydro DMG and Cryo DMG dealt are increased by 60%.
constellations.descriptionId:
Efek Konstelasi Echoes That Pierce the Snow diperkuat: Efek "Two Voices in Black and White" berubah menjadi: Efeknya kini berlaku untuk seluruh Karakter dalam party di sekitar.
Selain itu, selama efek **Song of Ages Past** berlangsung, DMG reaksi Stellar Swirl yang diakibatkan Karakter party di sekitar **bertumbuh** 25%, dan Hydro DMG serta Cryo DMG yang diakibatkan meningkat 60%.

name: Wanderer
title: Eons Adrift
description: A wayfaring figure whose identity is a mystery. He dresses like a mountain ascetic, but he certainly does not act the part.
descriptionId: Seorang pengelana dengan identitas misterius. Berpakaian seperti "shugenja", tapi tutur kata dan perbuatannya malah tidak seperti "shugenja".

talents.name: Yuuban Meigen
talents.description:
Normal Attack
Performs up to 3 attacks using wind blades, dealing Anemo DMG.

Charged Attack
Consumes a certain amount of Stamina, gathers a build up of high wind pressure, and deals AoE Anemo DMG after a short casting time.

Plunging Attack
Calling upon the power of Anemo, the Wanderer plunges towards the ground from mid-air, damaging all opponents in his path. Deals AoE Anemo DMG upon impact with the ground.
talents.descriptionId:
Normal Attack
Melancarkan hingga 3 serangan dengan Wind Blade yang mengakibatkan Anemo DMG.

Charged Attack
Mengonsumsi sejumlah Stamina untuk mengumpulkan arus angin bertekanan tinggi di hadapan dan mengakibatkan Anemo DMG Area setelah jeda singkat.

Plunging Attack
Mengumpulkan kekuatan Anemo dan menerjang tanah, menyerang musuh di jalur terjangan dan mengakibatkan Anemo DMG area saat mendarat.

talents.name: Hanega: Song of the Wind
talents.description:
Concentrates the power of the winds to break free from the shackles of the earth, dealing AoE Anemo DMG before leaping into the air and entering the Windfavored state.

Windfavored
The Wanderer cannot perform Plunging Attacks in this state. When he uses Normal and Charged Attacks, they will be converted into Kuugo: Fushoudan and Kuugo: Toufukai respectively; the DMG they deal and their AoE will be increased, and their DMG will be considered Normal and Charged Attack DMG respectively. Kuugo: Toufukai will not consume Stamina.
The Wanderer will hover persistently during this time. While this state is active, the Wanderer's movements gain the following properties:
·Persistently consumes Kuugoryoku Points to maintain this hovering state.
·When sprinting, additional Kuugoryoku Points will be consumed for the Wanderer to accelerate mid-air. Holding sprint will cause persistent Kuugoryoku Point consumption to maintain speed. This effect will replace his default sprint.
·Jumping expends extra Kuugoryoku Points to increase hovering height. Holding jump will cause persistent Kuugoryoku Point consumption to keep increasing hovering height.

Running out of Kuugoryoku Points will end the Windfavored state.
A second cast during the duration of Windfavored will also end it.
talents.descriptionId:
Mengumpulkan kekuatan angin dan memanfaatkannya untuk terlepas dari cengkeraman tanah, mengakibatkan Anemo DMG di sekitarnya, melompat ke udara, dan memasuki status Windfavored.

Windfavored
Saat berada dalam status ini, Wanderer tidak akan bisa melancarkan Plunging Attack. Normal Attack dan Charged Attack akan berubah menjadi Kuugo: Fushoudan dan Kuugo: Toufukai, meningkatkan DMG dan efek serangan area yang diakibatkan, DMG yang diakibatkan akan dianggap sebagai DMG Normal Attack dan DMG Charged Attack untuk masing-masingnya. Melancarkan Kuugo: Toufukai, tidak akan lagi mengonsumsi Stamina.
Saat berada dalam status ini, Wanderer akan terus-menerus melayang di udara. Pada saat ini, gerakan Wanderer akan memiliki karakteristik sebagai berikut:
·Akan terus-menerus mengonsumsi Kuugoryoku Point dan mempertahankan status melayang;
·Saat berlari, akan mengonsumsi Kuugoryoku Point tambahan untuk akselerasi di udara; Pada saat menahan tombol berlari, akan terus-menerus mengonsumsi Kuugoryoku Point untuk mempertahankan kecepatan pergerakannya. Efek ini akan menggantikan mode Berlari bawaannya;
·Saat melompat, akan mengonsumsi Kuugoryoku Point tambahan untuk meningkatkan ketinggian posisi melayang. Pada saat menahan tombol melompat, akan terus-menerus mengonsumsi Kuugoryoku Point untuk terus meningkatkan ketinggiannya.

Status akan berakhir setelah Kuugoryoku Point habis dikonsumsi.
Status Windfavored akan berakhir jika dilancarkan lagi selama durasinya masih aktif.

talents.name: Kyougen: Five Ceremonial Plays
talents.description:
Compresses the atmosphere into a singular vacuum that grinds all troubles away, dealing multiple instances of AoE Anemo DMG.
If the character is in the Windfavored state due to the skill "Hanega: Song of the Wind," Windfavored state will end after casting.
talents.descriptionId:
Mengkompresi atmosfer di sekitar dan merubahnya menjadi sebuah lubang yang bisa memusnahkan seluruh kegelisahan, mengakibatkan beberapa kali Anemo DMG Area.
Saat Karakter berada dalam status Windfavored dari skill "Hanega: Song of the Wind", status Windfavored akan berakhir setelah dilancarkan.

passives.name: Jade-Claimed Flower
passives.description:
If Hanega: Song of the Wind comes into contact with Hydro/Pyro/Cryo/Electro when it is unleashed, this instance of the Windfavored state will obtain buffs according to the contacted element(s):
·Hydro: Kuugoryoku Point cap increases by 20.
·Pyro: ATK increases by 30%.
·Cryo: CRIT Rate increases by 20%.
·Electro: When Normal and Charged Attacks hit an opponent, 0.8 Energy will be restored. Energy can be restored this way once every 0.2s.

You can have up to 2 different kinds of these buffs simultaneously.

passives.name: Gales of Reverie
passives.description:
When the Wanderer hits opponents with Kuugo: Fushoudan or Kuugo: Toufukai in his Windfavored state, he has a 16% chance to obtain the Descent effect: The next time the Wanderer accelerates in mid-air while in this instance of the Windfavored state, this effect will be removed, this acceleration instance will not consume any Kuugoryoku Points, and he will fire off 4 wind arrows that deal 35% of his ATK as Anemo DMG each.
For each Kuugo: Fushoudan and Kuugo: Toufukai that does not produce this effect, the next attack of those types will have a 12% increased chance of producing it. The calculation of the effect production is done once every 0.1s.
passives.descriptionId:
Saat berada dalam status Windfavored, saat Kuugo: Fushoudan atau Kuugo: Toufukai Wanderer mengenai musuh, memiliki 16% kesempatan untuk mendapatkan efek Descent: Saat Wanderer melakukan akselerasi di udara dalam status Windfavored kali ini, efek ini akan hilang, namun akselerasi kali ini tidak akan mengonsumsi Kuugoryoku Point dan akan menembakkan 4 buah panah angin, masing-masingnya akan mengakibatkan Anemo DMG sebesar 35% ATK.
Saat Kuugo: Fushoudan atau Kuugo: Toufukai tidak menghasilkan efek Descent, kemungkinan efek untuk dihasilkan kali selanjutnya akan meningkat 12%; Perhitungan berhasil atau tidaknya efek ini terpicu akan dilakukan setiap 0,1 detik sekali.

passives.name: Strum the Swirling Winds
passives.description: Mora expended when ascending Bows and Catalysts is decreased by 50%.
passives.descriptionId: Mora yang terkonsumsi untuk melakukan Ascend Senjata Bow dan Catalyst berkurang 50%.

constellations.name: Shoban: Ostentatious Plumage
constellations.description:
When in the Windfavored state, the Attack SPD of the Wanderer's Kuugo: Fushoudan and Kuugo: Toufukai is increased by 10%.
Additionally, the wind arrows fired by the Ascension Talent "Gales of Reverie" will deal an additional 25% of his ATK as DMG. You must first unlock the Ascension Talent "Gales of Reverie."
constellations.descriptionId:
Saat dalam status Windfavored, ATK SPD Kuugo: Fushoudan dan Kuugo: Toufukai milik Wanderer meningkat 10%.
Selain itu, panah angin yang diciptakan oleh Talenta Ascension "Gales of Reverie" milik Wanderer mengakibatkan tambahan DMG sebesar 25% ATK. Kamu harus membuka Talenta Ascension "Gales of Reverie" terlebih dahulu.

constellations.name: Niban: Isle Amidst White Waves
constellations.description:
When in the Windfavored state, Kyougen: Five Ceremonial Plays will see its DMG increased by 4% per point of difference between the max amount of Kuugoryoku Points contrasted with Kuugoryoku's present capacity when using this skill.
Through this method, you can increase Kyougen: Five Ceremonial Plays's DMG by a maximum of 200%.
constellations.descriptionId:
Saat dalam status Windfavored, DMG yang diakibatkan Kyougen: Five Ceremonial Plays saat menggunakan skill ini akan meningkat sebesar 4% untuk setiap poin perbedaan antara jumlah maksimum Kuugoryoku Point dikurangi dengan jumlah Kuugoryoku Point yang dimilliki sekarang.
Peningkatan DMG yang diakibatkan Kyougen: Five Ceremonial Plays yang bisa diperoleh dengan cara ini adalah sebesar maksimum 200%.

constellations.name: Sanban: Moonflower Kusemai
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Kyougen: Five Ceremonial Plays by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.descriptionId:
Meningkatkan 3 level Kyougen: Five Ceremonial Plays.
Maksimum: Lv. 15.

constellations.name: Yonban: Set Adrift into Spring
constellations.description:
When casting Hanega: Song of the Wind, should the Ascension Talent "Jade-Claimed Flower" be triggered, the character will gain buffs in correspondence to the contacted Elemental Type(s), and also obtain a random untriggered buff. A maximum of 3 such corresponding elemental buffs can exist simultaneously.
You must first unlock the Ascension Talent "Jade-Claimed Flower."
constellations.descriptionId:
Saat melancarkan Hanega: Song of the Wind, jika memicu Talenta Ascension "Jade-Claimed Flower", Karakter akan mendapatkan efek peningkatan berdasarkan jenis elemennya, dan akan mendapatkan 1 jenis efek peningkatan acak yang belum terpicu kali ini. Maksimum efek peningkatan elemen yang bisa diperoleh bersamaan adalah 3 jenis elemen.
Harus sudah membuka Talenta Ascension "Jade-Claimed Flower" lebih dulu.

constellations.name: Matsuban: Ancient Illuminator From Abroad
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Hanega: Song of the Wind by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.descriptionId:
Meningkatkan 3 level Hanega: Song of the Wind.
Maksimum: Lv. 15.

constellations.name: Shugen: The Curtains' Melancholic Sway
constellations.description:
When the Wanderer actively hits an opponent with Kuugo: Fushoudan while in the Windfavored state, the following effects will occur:
·Deals an additional instance of Kuugo: Fushoudan at the position hit, dealing 40% of the attack's original DMG. This DMG will be considered Normal Attack DMG.
·When the Wanderer falls below 40 Kuugoryoku Points, restores 4 Points to him. Kuugoryoku Points can be restored in this manner once every 0.2s. This restoration can occur up to 5 times within one Windfavored duration.

name: Wriothesley
title: Emissary of Solitary Iniquity
description: Duke of the Fortress of Meropide, Lord Incognito of the murky depths.
descriptionId: Pemimpin Fortress of Meropide yang bergelar Duke. Penguasa di perairan keruh.

talents.name: Forceful Fists of Frost
talents.description:
Normal Attack
Coalescing frost about his fist, Wriothesley will unleash powerful Repelling Fists, performing up to 5 rapid attacks that deal Cryo DMG.
Apart from this, Normal Attack combo count will not reset for a short time after using Icefang Rush or sprinting.

Charged Attack
Consumes a fixed amount of Stamina to leap and unleash a Vaulting Fist, dealing AoE Cryo DMG.

Plunging Attack
Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground below, damaging opponents along the path and dealing AoE Cryo DMG upon impact.
talents.descriptionId:
Normal Attack
Mengumpulkan es di ujung kepalan tangannya, melancarkan Repelling Fist yang kuat dan cepat, melancarkan maksimum 5 pukulan berturut-turut dan mengakibatkan Cryo DMG.
Selain itu, jumlah kombo Normal Attack tidak akan diulang untuk waktu yang singkat setelah berlari atau setelah melancarkan Elemental Skill "Icefang Rush".

Charged Attack
Mengonsumsi sejumlah Stamina untuk melompat dan melancarkan Vaulting Fist yang mengakibatkan Cryo DMG Area.

Plunging Attack
Menerjang dari udara untuk menghantam tanah di bawahnya, menyerang musuh di jalur terjangan dan mengakibatkan Cryo DMG Area saat mendarat.

talents.name: Icefang Rush
talents.description:
Adjusting his breathing, rhythm, and pace, Wriothesley sprints forward a short distance, entering the Chilling Penalty state and unleashing more powerful attacks than before.

Chilling Penalty
·Increases Wriothesley's interruption resistance
·When his HP is above 50%, it will enhance the Repelling Fists of Normal Attack: Forceful Fists of Frost and increase its DMG. When such an attack hits, it will consume a fixed amount of Wriothesley's HP. HP can be lost this way once every 0.1s.
This effect will be canceled should Wriothesley leave the field.

talents.name: Darkgold Wolfbite
talents.description:
Activating his boxing gloves, Wriothesley strikes out with an icy straight, then uses Icicle Impact to cause multiple instances of AoE Cryo DMG in a frontal area.

Arkhe: Ousia
After Icicle Impact ends, a Surging Blade will descend upon the opponent's position, dealing Ousia-aligned Cryo DMG.
talents.descriptionId:
Mengaktifkan sarung tinjunya, menyerang dengan pukulan tinju embun beku, dan terus-menerus melancarkan Icicle Impact ke area depan dan mengakibatkan Cryo DMG Area berkali-kali.

Arkhe: Ousia
Setelah Icicle Impact berakhir, Surging Blade akan dijatuhkan ke posisi musuh berada dan mengakibatkan Ousia-aligned Cryo DMG.

passives.name: There Shall Be a Plea for Justice
passives.description:
When Wriothesley's HP is less than 60%, he will obtain a Gracious Rebuke. The next Charged Attack of his Normal Attack: Forceful Fists of Frost will be enhanced to become Rebuke: Vaulting Fist. It will not consume Stamina, will deal 50% increased DMG, and after hitting will restore HP for Wriothesley equal to 30% of his Max HP.
You can gain a Gracious Rebuke this way once every 5s.
passives.descriptionId:
Saat HP Wriothesley berada di bawah 60%, akan mendapatkan Gracious Rebuke. Charged Attack dari Normal Attack: Forceful Fists of Frost berikutnya akan diperkuat menjadi Rebuke: Vaulting Fist yang tidak mengonsumsi Stamina, meningkatkan DMG yang diakibatkan sebesar 50%, dan memulihkan HP Wriothesley setelah serangan mengenai musuh. Jumlah pemulihan adalah sebesar 30% Max HP Wriothesley.
Efek Gracious Rebuke yang dapat diperoleh dengan cara ini adalah sekali setiap 5 detik.

passives.name: There Shall Be a Reckoning for Sin
passives.description: When Wriothesley's current HP increases or decreases, if he is in the Chilling Penalty state conferred by Icefang Rush, Chilling Penalty will gain one stack of Prosecution Edict. Max 5 stacks. Each stack will increase Wriothesley's ATK by 6%.
passives.descriptionId: Saat HP Wriothesley meningkat atau berkurang, jika Wriothesley sedang berada dalam status Chilling Penalty dari Icefang Rush, Chilling Penalty akan mendapatkan satu lapis efek Prosecution Edict. Efek ini dapat ditumpuk sampai 5 lapis. Setiap lapisnya akan meningkatkan 6% ATK Wriothesley.

passives.name: The Duke's Grace
passives.description: When Wriothesley crafts Weapon Ascension Materials, he has a 10% chance to receive double the product.
passives.descriptionId: Saat membuat Material Ascension Senjata, memiliki 10% kemungkinan untuk mendapatkan hasil 2 kali lipat.

constellations.name: Terror for the Evildoers
constellations.description:
The Gracious Rebuke from the Ascension Talent "There Shall Be a Plea for Justice" is changed to this:
When Wriothesley's HP is less than 60% or while he is in the Chilling Penalty state caused by Icefang Rush, when the fifth attack of Repelling Fists hits, it will create a Gracious Rebuke. 1 Gracious Rebuke effect can be obtained every 2.5s.

Additionally, Rebuke: Vaulting Fist will obtain the following enhancement:
· The DMG Bonus gained will be further increased to 200%.
· When it hits while Wriothesley is in the Chilling Penalty state, that state's duration is extended by 4s. 1 such extension can occur per 1 Chilling Penalty duration.

You must first unlock the Ascension Talent "There Shall Be a Plea for Justice."
constellations.descriptionId:
Gracious Rebuke dari Talenta Ascension "There Shall Be a Plea for Justice" akan dikonversi menjadi:
Saat HP Wriothesley kurang dari 60% atau saat status Chilling Penalty dari Icefang Rush sedang berlangsung, akan mendapatkan "Gracious Rebuke" saat serangan Repelling Fist tahap ke-lima mengenai musuh. Efek "Gracious Rebuke" dapat diperoleh dengan cara ini satu kali setiap 2,5 detik.

Selain itu, Rebuke: Vaulting Fist akan mendapatkan penguatan sebagai berikut:
·DMG Bonus yang diakibatkan ditingkatkan lagi menjadi 200%;
·Saat mengenai musuh, jika sedang berada dalam status Chilling Penalty, durasi status ini akan bertambah 4 detik. Selama satu kali durasi Chilling Penalty berlangsung, hanya dapat menerima perpanjangan durasi satu kali.

Harus membuka Talenta Ascension "There Shall Be a Plea for Justice" terlebih dahulu.

constellations.name: Shackles for the Arrogant
constellations.description:
When using Darkgold Wolfbite, each Prosecution Edict stack from the Ascension Talent "There Shall Be a Reckoning for Sin" will increase said ability's DMG dealt by 40%.
You must first unlock the Ascension Talent "There Shall Be a Reckoning for Sin."
constellations.descriptionId:
Saat melancarkan Darkgold Wolfbite, setiap lapis Prosecution Edict dari Talenta Ascension "There Shall Be a Reckoning for Sin" akan memberikan peningkatan DMG sebesar 40%.
Harus membuka Talenta Ascension "There Shall Be a Reckoning for Sin" terlebih dahulu.

constellations.name: Punishment for the Frauds
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Normal Attack: Forceful Fists of Frost by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.descriptionId:
Meningkatkan 3 level Normal Attack: Forceful Fists of Frost.
Maksimum: Lv. 15.

constellations.name: Redemption for the Suffering
constellations.description:
The HP restored to Wriothesley through Rebuke: Vaulting Fist will be increased to 50% of his Max HP. You must first unlock the Ascension Talent "There Shall Be a Plea for Justice."
Additionally, when Wriothesley is healed, if the amount of healing overflows, the following effects will occur depending on whether he is on the field or not. If he is on the field, his ATK SPD will be increased by 20% for 4s. If he is off-field, all of your own party members' ATK SPD will be increased by 10% for 6s. These two methods of increasing ATK SPD cannot stack.
constellations.descriptionId:
Batas pemulihan yang diberikan Rebuke: Vaulting Fist kepada Wriothesley akan meningkat menjadi 50% Max HP-nya. Harus membuka Talenta Ascension "There Shall Be a Plea for Justice" terlebih dahulu.
Selain itu, saat Wriothesley menerima pemulihan, jika pemulihan kali ini ada yang berlebihan, maka akan menghasilkan efek berdasarkan ada atau tidaknya Wriothesley di medan pertempuran pada saat ini: Jika Wriothesley berada di medan pertempuran, maka ATK SPD Wriothesley meningkat 20% selama 4 detik; Saat Wriothesley ada di dalam party namun tidak berada di medan pertempuran, ATK SPD seluruh anggota party sendiri akan meningkat 10% selama 6 detik. Kedua efek peningkatan ATK SPD tersebut tidak dapat ditumpuk.

constellations.name: Mercy for the Wronged
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Darkgold Wolfbite by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.descriptionId:
Meningkatkan 3 level Darkgold Wolfbite.
Maksimum: Lv. 15.

constellations.name: Esteem for the Innocent
constellations.description:
The CRIT Rate of Rebuke: Vaulting Fist will be increased by 10%, and its CRIT DMG by 80%. When unleashed, it will also create an additional icicle that deals 100% of Rebuke: Vaulting Fist's Base DMG as Cryo DMG. DMG dealt this way is regarded as Charged Attack DMG.
You must first unlock the Ascension Talent "There Shall Be a Plea for Justice."
constellations.descriptionId:
CRIT Rate Rebuke: Vaulting Fist meningkat 10%, CRIT DMG Vaulting Fist meningkat 80%. Saat dilancarkan, akan menghasilkan duri es tambahan yang mengakibatkan Cryo DMG sebesar 100% DMG awal. DMG yang diakibatkan dengan cara ini akan dianggap sebagai DMG Charged Attack.
Harus membuka Talenta Ascension "There Shall Be a Plea for Justice" terlebih dahulu.

name: Xianyun
title: Passerine Herald
description: One of the Mighty and Illuminated Adepti of Jueyun, known as "Cloud Retainer." Expert in all kinds of mechanical contraptions, her heart now turns towards the affairs of the mortal world, through which she walks under the name "Xianyun."
descriptionId: Salah satu Adeptus yang agung dan mulia dari Jueyun, "Cloud Retainer". Ahli segala jenis mekanika, yang hatinya kini berpaling kepada dunia fana. "Xianyun" adalah nama yang digunakannya setelah turun gunung.

talents.name: Word of Wind and Flower
talents.description:
Normal Attack
Summons swirling winds to perform up to 4 attacks, dealing Anemo DMG.

Charged Attack
Consumes a certain amount of Stamina and launches a Breeze Bolt in a straight line that deals Anemo DMG to opponents along its path.

Plunging Attack
Gathers the power of Anemo and plunges towards the ground from mid-air, damaging all opponents in her path. Deals AoE Anemo DMG upon impact with the ground.
talents.descriptionId:
Normal Attack
Memanggil pusaran angin dan melancarkan hingga 4 serangan angin yang mengakibatkan Anemo DMG.

Charged Attack
Mengonsumsi sejumlah Stamina, melancarkan sebuah Breeze Bolt dalam garis lurus yang mengakibatkan Anemo DMG terhadap musuh di sepanjang jalurnya.

Plunging Attack
Mengumpulkan kekuatan Anemo, menerjang tanah, menyerang musuh di jalur terjangan, dan mengakibatkan Anemo DMG area saat mendarat.

talents.name: White Clouds at Dawn
talents.description:
Xianyun enters the Cloud Transmogrification state, in which she will not take Fall DMG, and uses Skyladder once.
In this state, her Plunging Attack will be converted into Driftcloud Wave instead, which deals AoE Anemo DMG and ends the Cloud Transmogrification state. This DMG is considered Plunging Attack DMG.
Each use of Skyladder while in this state increases the DMG and AoE of the next Driftcloud Wave used.

Skyladder
Can be used while in mid-air. Xianyun leaps forward, dealing Anemo DMG to targets along her path.
During each Cloud Transmogrification state Xianyun enters, Skyladder may be used up to 3 times and only 1 instance of Skyladder DMG can be dealt to any one opponent.
If Skyladder is not used again in a short period, the Cloud Transmogrification state will be canceled.

If Xianyun does not use Driftcloud Wave while in this state, the next CD of White Clouds at Dawn will be decreased by 3s.
talents.descriptionId:
Xianyun memasuki status Cloud Transmogrification, tidak akan menerima DMG saat terjatuh, dan akan melancarkan satu kali Skyladder.
Dalam status ini, Plunging Attack Xianyun akan dikonversi menjadi Driftcloud Wave, mengakibatkan Anemo DMG Area, dan akan mengakhiri status Cloud Transmogrification. DMG ini akan dianggap sebagai DMG Plunging Attack.
Setiap kali melancarkan Skyladder dalam status ini, akan meningkatkan DMG dan area serangan Driftcloud Wave yang selanjutnya.

Skyladder
Bisa dilancarkan di udara, Xianyun melompat maju ke depan, dan mengakibatkan Anemo DMG terhadap target di jalurnya.
Dalam satu kali status Cloud Transmogrification, hanya bisa melancarkan maksimum 3 kali Skyladder, dan hanya bisa mengakibatkan satu kali DMG Skyladder terhadap musuh yang sama.
Jika Skyladder tidak dilancarkan dalam waktu singkat, maka status Cloud Transmogrification akan dibatalkan.

Jika Driftcloud Wave tidak dilancarkan selama status Cloud Transmogrification, maka CD White Clouds at Dawn akan berkurang 3 detik.

talents.name: Stars Gather at Dusk
talents.description:
Brings forth a sacred breeze that deals AoE Anemo DMG and heals all nearby characters based on Xianyun's ATK. It will also summon the "Starwicker" mechanism.

Starwicker
·Continuously follows the active character and periodically heals all nearby party members based on Xianyun's ATK.
·Starts with 8 stacks of Adeptal Assistance. While Adeptal Assistance is active, nearby active characters in the party will have their jump height increased.
·When the active character completes a Plunging Attack, Starwicker will consume 1 stack of Adeptal Assistance and deal AoE Anemo DMG.
Only 1 Starwicker can exist simultaneously.
talents.descriptionId:
Memanggil angin suci yang mengakibatkan Anemo DMG Area dan memulihkan HP seluruh Karakter party di sekitar berdasarkan ATK Xianyun, serta memanggil mekanisme Starwicker.

Starwicker
·Terus-menerus mengikuti Karakter aktif dan memulihkan HP seluruh Karakter party di sekitar secara berkala, jumlah pemulihan didasarkan pada ATK Xianyun.
·Memiliki 8 lapis Adeptal Assistance pada awalnya. Saat memiliki Adeptal Assistance, akan meningkatkan ketinggian lompatan Karakter aktif di sekitar.
·Saat Karakter aktif selesai melakukan Plunging Attack, Starwicker akan mengonsumsi satu lapis Adeptal Assistance dan mengakibatkan Anemo DMG Area.
Hanya ada 1 Starwicker yang bisa ada di medan pertempuran dalam satu waktu.

passives.name: Galefeather Pursuit
passives.description:
Each opponent hit by Driftcloud Waves from White Clouds at Dawn will grant all nearby party members 1 stack of Storm Pinion for 20s. Max 4 stacks. These will cause the characters' Plunging Attack CRIT Rate to increase by 4%/6%/8%/10% respectively.
Each Storm Pinion created by hitting an opponent has an independent duration.
passives.descriptionId:
Untuk setiap satu musuh yang terkena Driftcloud Wave dari White Clouds at Dawn, akan menghasilkan satu lapis efek Storm Pinion untuk seluruh Karakter party di sekitar. Efek ini berlangsung selama 20 detik dan dapat ditumpuk hingga 4 lapis. Efek ini akan meningkatkan CRIT Rate Plunging Attack Karakter sebesar 4%/6%/8%/10%.
Durasi setiap Storm Pinion yang dihasilkan saat serangan mengenai musuh akan dihitung secara terpisah.

passives.name: Consider, the Adeptus in Her Realm
passives.description:
When the Starwicker created by Stars Gather at Dusk has Adeptal Assistance stacks, nearby active characters' Plunging Attack shockwave DMG will be increased by 200% of Xianyun's ATK. The maximum DMG increase that can be achieved this way is 9,000.
Each Plunging Attack shockwave DMG instance can only apply this increased DMG effect to a single opponent. Each character can trigger this effect once every 0.4s.
passives.descriptionId:
Saat Starwicker yang diciptakan oleh Stars Gather at Dusk memiliki lapisan Adeptal Assistance, DMG terjangan Plunging Attack Karakter aktif di sekitar meningkat sebesar 200% ATK Xianyun. Jumlah peningkatan DMG Plunging Attack Karakter aktif di sekitar yang bisa diperoleh dengan cara ini maksimum 9.000 poin.
Dalam satu kali DMG terjangan Plunging Attack, hanya satu musuh yang bisa menerima efek yang disebutkan di atas. Bisa terpicu maksimum sekali setiap 0,4 detik untuk setiap Karakter.

passives.name: Crane Form
passives.description:
Increases gliding SPD for your own party members by 15%.
Not stackable with Passive Talents that provide the exact same effects.
passives.descriptionId:
Meningkatkan 15% kecepatan meluncur Karakter dalam party sendiri.
Efek ini tidak dapat ditumpuk dengan Talenta Pasif lain dengan efek yang sama persis.

constellations.name: Purifying Wind
constellations.description: White Clouds at Dawn gains 1 additional charge.
constellations.descriptionId: White Clouds at Dawn bisa digunakan satu kali lagi.

constellations.name: Aloof From the World
constellations.description:
After using a Skyladder from White Clouds at Dawn, Xianyun's ATK will be increased by 20% for 15s.
Additionally, the effects of the Ascension Talent "Consider, the Adeptus in Her Realm" will be enhanced: When the Starwicker created by Stars Gather at Dusk has Adeptal Assistance stacks, nearby active characters' Plunging Attack shockwave DMG will be increased by 400% of Xianyun's ATK. The maximum DMG increase that can be achieved this way is 18,000.
Each Plunging Attack shockwave DMG instance can only apply this increased DMG effect to a single opponent. Each character can trigger this effect once every 0.4s.
You must first unlock the Ascension Talent "Consider, the Adeptus in Her Realm."
constellations.descriptionId:
Setelah menggunakan Skyladder dari White Clouds at Dawn, ATK Xianyun meningkat 20% selama 15 detik.
Selain itu, efek Talenta Ascension "Consider, the Adeptus in Her Realm" akan mendapatkan peningkatan: Saat Starwicker yang diciptakan oleh Stars Gather at Dusk memiliki lapisan Adeptal Assistance, DMG terjangan Plunging Attack Karakter aktif di sekitar meningkat sebesar 400% ATK Xianyun. Jumlah peningkatan Plunging Attack Karakter aktif yang bisa diperoleh dengan cara ini adalah maksimum 18.000 DMG.
Dalam satu kali terjangan Plunging Attack, hanya satu musuh yang bisa menerima efek yang disebutkan di atas. Bisa terpicu maksimum sekali setiap 0,4 detik untuk setiap Karakter.
Harus membuka Talenta Ascension "Consider, the Adeptus in Her Realm" terlebih dahulu.

constellations.name: Creations of Star and Moon
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Stars Gather at Dusk by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.descriptionId:
Meningkatkan 3 level Stars Gather at Dusk.
Maksimum: Lv. 15.

constellations.name: Mystery Millet Gourmet
constellations.description: After using Skyladder 1/2/3 times during one White Clouds at Dawn Cloud Transmogrification state, when a Driftcloud Wave unleashed during that instance hits an opponent, it will heal all nearby party members for 50%/80%/150% of Xianyun's ATK. This effect can be triggered once every 5s.
constellations.descriptionId: Setelah Cloud Transmogrification dari White Clouds at Dawn melancarkan 1/2/3 kali Skyladder, saat Driftcloud Wave yang dilancarkan pada Cloud Transmogrification kali ini mengenai musuh, akan memulihkan HP seluruh anggota party di sekitar sebesar 50%/80%/150% ATK Xianyun. Efek ini dapat terpicu sekali setiap 5 detik.

constellations.name: Astride Rose-Colored Clouds
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of White Clouds at Dawn by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.descriptionId:
Meningkatkan 3 level White Clouds at Dawn.
Maksimum: Lv. 15.

constellations.name: They Call Her Cloud Retainer
constellations.description:
After Xianyun uses 1/2/3 Skyladders within one Cloud Transmogrification caused by White Clouds at Dawn, the CRIT DMG of a Driftcloud Wave created in this instance of Cloud Transmogrification will be increased by 15%/35%/70%.
Within 16s after Xianyun has used Stars Gather at Dusk, White Clouds at Dawn will not enter CD. This effect will be canceled once she has used White Clouds at Dawn 8 times.
constellations.descriptionId:
Setelah Xianyun menggunakan 1/2/3 Skyladder dalam satu kali Cloud Transmogrification dari White Clouds at Dawn, CRIT DMG Driftcloud Wave selama Cloud Transmogrification kali ini meningkat 15%/35%/70%.
Selama 16 detik setelah Xianyun melancarkan Stars Gather at Dusk, White Clouds at Dawn tidak akan memasuki CD. Efek ini akan dihapus setelah Xianyun melancarkan 8 kali White Clouds at Dawn.

name: Xiao
title: Vigilant Yaksha
description: A yaksha adeptus who defends Liyue. Also heralded as the "Conqueror of Demons" and "Vigilant Yaksha."
descriptionId: Yaksha, sesosok Adeptus yang melindungi Liyue. Juga memiliki julukan "Conqueror of Demons" atau "Vigilant Yaksha".

talents.name: Whirlwind Thrust
talents.description:
Normal Attack
Performs up to 6 consecutive spear strikes.

Charged Attack
Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to perform an upward thrust.

Plunging Attack
Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground below, damaging opponents along the path and dealing AoE DMG upon impact.
Xiao does not take DMG from performing Plunging Attacks.
talents.descriptionId:
Normal Attack
Melancarkan hingga 6 serangan tombak berturut-turut.

Charged Attack
Mengonsumsi sejumlah Stamina untuk melakukan serangan ke arah atas.

Plunging Attack
Menerjang dari udara untuk menghantam tanah, menyerang musuh di jalur terjangan dan mengakibatkan DMG area saat mendarat.
Saat melakukan Plunging Attack, Xiao tidak akan terkena DMG karena terjatuh dari ketinggian.

talents.name: Lemniscatic Wind Cycling
talents.description:
Xiao lunges forward, dealing Anemo DMG to opponents in his path.
Can be used in mid-air.
Starts with 2 charges.
talents.descriptionId:
Xiao menerjang ke depan dan mengakibatkan Anemo DMG pada musuh di jalurnya.
Dapat digunakan di udara.
Memiliki 2 kali penggunaan (charge) dari awal.

talents.name: Bane of All Evil
talents.description:
Xiao dons the Yaksha Mask that set gods and demons trembling millennia ago.

Yaksha's Mask
·Greatly increases Xiao's jumping ability.
·Increases his attack AoE and attack DMG.
·Converts attack DMG into Anemo DMG, which cannot be overridden by any other elemental infusion.

In this state, Xiao will continuously lose HP.
The effects of this skill end when Xiao leaves the field.
talents.descriptionId:
Xiao mengenakan Yaksha Mask yang ditakuti oleh para iblis dan juga Archon pada ribuan tahun lalu.

Yaksha Mask
·Meningkatkan kekuatan melompat Xiao secara drastis.
·Meningkatkan DMG dan area serangan.
·Mengonversi DMG serangan menjadi Anemo DMG yang tidak dapat ditimpa oleh Elemental Infusion lainnya.

Dalam status ini, Xiao akan terus kehilangan HP.
Efek ini akan hilang saat Xiao keluar dari medan pertempuran.

passives.name: Conqueror of Evil: Tamer of Demons
passives.description:
While under the effects of Bane of All Evil, all DMG dealt by Xiao increases by 5%. DMG increases by a further 5% for every 3s the ability persists.
The maximum DMG Bonus is 25%.
passives.descriptionId:
Meningkatkan 5% DMG Xiao saat berada dalam status Bane of All Evil. Selama durasi skill, DMG Xiao akan terus meningkat sebesar 5% setiap 3 detik.
Batas maksimum peningkatan DMG adalah 25%.

passives.name: Dissolution Eon: Heaven Fall
passives.description:
Using Lemniscatic Wind Cycling increases the DMG of subsequent uses of Lemniscatic Wind Cycling by 15%.
This effect lasts for 7s, and has a maximum of 3 stacks. Gaining a new stack refreshes the effect's duration.
passives.descriptionId:
Menggunakan Lemniscatic Wind Cycling akan meningkatkan 15% DMG Lemniscatic Wind Cycling selanjutnya selama 7 detik.
Efek dapat ditumpuk hingga 3 lapis. Durasi akan diperbarui setiap mendapat tumpukan baru.

passives.name: Transcension: Gravity Defier
passives.description:
Decreases climbing Stamina consumption for your own party members by 20%.
Not stackable with Passive Talents that provide the exact same effects.
passives.descriptionId:
Mengurangi 20% konsumsi Stamina Karakter party sendiri saat memanjat.
Efek ini tidak dapat ditumpuk dengan Talenta Pasif lain dengan efek yang sama persis.

constellations.name: Dissolution Eon: Destroyer of Worlds
constellations.description: Increases Lemniscatic Wind Cycling's charges by 1.
constellations.descriptionId: Meningkatkan 1 charge Lemniscatic Wind Cycling.

constellations.name: Annihilation Eon: Blossom of Kaleidos
constellations.description: When in the party and not on the field, Xiao's Energy Recharge is increased by 25%.
constellations.descriptionId: Ketika Xiao berada di dalam party namun tidak sedang bertempur, Energy Recharge Xiao meningkat 25%.

constellations.name: Conqueror of Evil: Wrath Deity
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Lemniscatic Wind Cycling by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.descriptionId:
Meningkatkan 3 level Lemniscatic Wind Cycling.
Maksimum: Lv. 15.

constellations.name: Transcension: Extinction of Suffering
constellations.description: When Xiao's HP falls below 50%, he gains a 100% DEF Bonus.
constellations.descriptionId: Saat HP Xiao kurang dari 50%, DEF Xiao meningkat 100%.

constellations.name: Evolution Eon: Origin of Ignorance
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Bane of All Evil by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.descriptionId:
Meningkatkan 3 level Bane of All Evil.
Maksimum: Lv. 15.

constellations.name: Conqueror of Evil: Guardian Yaksha
constellations.description: While under the effects of Bane of All Evil, hitting at least 2 opponents with Xiao's Plunging Attack will immediately grant him 1 charge of Lemniscatic Wind Cycling, and for the next 1s, he may use Lemniscatic Wind Cycling while ignoring its CD.
constellations.descriptionId: Selama berada dalam status Bane of All Evil, Xiao akan mendapatkan 1 charge Lemniscatic Wind Cycling saat menyerang 2 musuh atau lebih dengan Plunging Attack. Selain itu, Xiao bisa menggunakan Lemniscatic Wind Cycling terus-menerus tanpa memedulikan waktu CD selama 1 detik berikutnya.

name: Xilonen
title: Ardent Flames Forge the Soul
description: A Name Engraver of the Nanatzcayan, she is especially skilled at finding a good balance between the heavy responsibilities of her job and living well.
descriptionId: Seorang Pengukir Marga Nanatzcayan yang sangat terampil dalam mencari keseimbangan antara beban kerja yang berat dan hidup dengan nyaman.

talents.name: Ehecatl's Roar
talents.description:
Normal Attack
Performs up to 3 rapid strikes.

Charged Attack
Consumes a fixed amount of Stamina and performs a forward kick.

Plunging Attack
Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground below, damaging opponents along the path and dealing AoE DMG upon impact, both based on Xilonen's DEF.

Nightsoul's Blessing: Blade Roller
When in the Nightsoul's Blessing state, Xilonen will enter the Blade Roller mode. While in this mode, Xilonen's Normal Attacks will allow her to perform up to 4 kicks using her roller blades, and she will be unable to use Charged Attacks.
When her Normal and Plunging Attacks are used in this mode, they will switch to being based on her DEF, and Xilonen will deal Nightsoul-aligned Geo DMG that cannot be overridden.
talents.descriptionId:
Normal Attack
Melancarkan hingga 3 serangan berturut-turut dengan pedang.

Charged Attack
Mengonsumsi sejumlah Stamina untuk menendang ke arah depan.

Plunging Attack
Menerjang dari udara untuk menghantam tanah di bawahnya, menyerang musuh-musuh di jalurnya dan mengakibatkan DMG Area berdasarkan DEF Xilonen saat mendarat.

Nightsoul's Blessing: Blade Roller
Dalam status Nightsoul's Blessing, Xilonen akan berganti ke Mode Blade Roller. Dalam status ini, Normal Attack Xilonen akan dikonversi menjadi tendangan 4 kali berturut-turut dengan sepatu roda Blade Roller, dan tidak akan bisa melancarkan Charged Attack.
Saat melancarkan Normal Attack atau Plunging Attack dalam status ini, akan mengakibatkan Nightsoul-aligned Geo DMG yang tidak bisa ditimpa Elemental Infusion lainnya berdasarkan DEF Xilonen.

talents.name: Yohual's Scratch
talents.description:
Let the rhythms of passion resound throughout the land! Xilonen switches to high-speed combat blading gear and rushes forward a certain distance before dealing Nightsoul-aligned Geo DMG based on her DEF.
After using this, Xilonen will gain 45 Nightsoul points and enter the Nightsoul's Blessing state. In this state, she will shift to the Blade Roller mode.

Source Samples
Xilonen has 3 Samplers with her that can generate different Soundscapes based on her other party members' Elemental Types, decreasing nearby opponents' corresponding Elemental RES while active.
The initial recorded Source Sample within each Sampler will be Geo, and for each party member who is Pyro/Hydro/Cryo/Electro, 1 Geo Sample will change to that corresponding Element.
While Xilonen is in the Nightsoul's Blessing state, the Geo Source Sample she carries will always be active. After unlocking her Ascension Talent, "Netotiliztli's Echoes," Xilonen can trigger said Ascension Talent's effects to regenerate Nightsoul points for herself. When her Nightsoul points hit the maximum, she will consume all her Nightsoul points and activate the 3 Source Samples she has on hand for 15s.
When the Source Samples are active, nearby opponents' corresponding Elemental RES will decrease. Source Sample effects of the same Elemental Type cannot stack. Xilonen can trigger these effects even when off-field.

Nightsoul's Blessing: Xilonen
Continuously consume Nightsoul points. When these points are depleted or if used again, this Nightsoul's Blessing state will end. This state has the following traits:
·Switches to the Blade Roller mode, increasing Xilonen's Movement SPD and climbing speed, and she can perform high-speed leaps in Ocelot Form while climbing.
·Xilonen's Nightsoul's Blessing has the following restrictions: When in this state, Xilonen's Nightsoul points have a 9s time limit. After this limit passes, her Nightsoul points will immediately expire.

After Xilonen's Nightsoul points have expired while she is in the Nightsoul's Blessing state, she will no longer be able to generate Nightsoul points via the Ascension Talent "Netotiliztli's Echoes."
talents.descriptionId:
Biarlah ritme antusiasme menggema ke seluruh daratan! Xilonen berganti ke perlengkapan tempur kecepatan tinggi, menerjang ke depan dalam jarak tertentu, dan mengakibatkan Nightsoul-aligned Geo DMG berdasarkan DEF Xilonen.
Setelah dilancarkan, Xilonen akan mendapatkan 45 poin Nightsoul dan memasuki status Nightsoul's Blessing. Dalam kondisi ini, Xilonen akan berganti ke Mode Blade Roller.

Source Sample
Xilonen memiliki 3 buah Sampler yang bisa memunculkan Soundscape yang berbeda berdasarkan jenis elemen Karakter lain yang ada di dalam party, dan saat diaktifkan, akan mengurangi Elemental RES dari elemen yang sesuai milik musuh di sekitar.
Source Sample yang tercatat oleh Sampler pada awalnya akan berelemen Geo. Untuk setiap satu Karakter berelemen Pyro, Hydro, Cryo, atau Electro, satu Sampler Geo akan dikonversi menjadi jenis elemen yang sesuai.
Saat berada dalam status Nightsoul's Blessing, Source Sample Geo yang dimiliki oleh Xilonen akan terus berada dalam status aktif; Setelah membuka Talenta Ascension "Netotiliztli's Echoes", Xilonen akan bisa memicu efek Talenta Ascension tersebut untuk memulihkan poin Nightsoul diri sendiri. Saat poin Nightsoul mencapai batas tertinggi, Xilonen akan mengonsumsi seluruh poin Nightsoul yang ada untuk akan mengaktifkan tiga Source Sample yang dimiliki Xilonen sendiri selama 15 detik.
Saat Source Sample aktif, Elemental RES elemen yang sesuai milik musuh di sekitar akan berkurang, efek Source Sample dengan elemen yang sama tidak dapat ditumpuk; Saat Xilonen ada di dalam party namun sedang tidak berada di medan pertempuran, efek ini tetap dapat terpicu.

Nightsoul's Blessing: Xilonen
Terus-menerus mengonsumsi poin Nightsoul. Setelah poin Nightsoul habis terkonsumsi atau saat dilancarkan sekali lagi, Nightsoul's Blessing Xilonen akan berakhir. Nightsoul's Blessing memiliki karakteristik sebagai berikut:
·Berganti ke Mode Blade Roller, meningkatkan kecepatan bergerak dan memanjat Xilonen, dan akan bisa melompat dengan kecepatan tinggi dalam wujud Ocelot saat sedang memanjat.
·Nightsoul's Blessing Xilonen memiliki batasan sebagai berikut: Saat berada dalam status Nightsoul's Blessing, poin Nightsoul Xilonen dibatasi selama 9 detik. Setelah melewati batasan ini, poin Nightsoul Xilonen akan langsung habis terpakai.

Saat berada dalam status Nightsoul's Blessing, Setelah poin Nightsoul mencapai batas maksimum, Xilonen tidak akan bisa menghasilkan poin Nightsoul melalui Talenta Ascension "Netotiliztli's Echoes".

talents.name: Ocelotlicue Point!
talents.description:
Activates the Phlogiston Stereo DJ Controller (Portable) at full power, dealing Nightsoul-aligned AoE Geo DMG based on Xilonen's DEF.

Additionally, she will trigger the following effects based on her different Source Samples:
·If she has at least 2 Source Samples that have had their Elemental Types changed, Xilonen will play an Ebullient rhythm, healing nearby active characters at intervals based on her DEF.
·If she has fewer than 2 Source Samples that have had their Elemental Types changed, Xilonen will start up an Ardent rhythm, which will play two additional beats that deal Nightsoul-aligned AoE Geo DMG based on her DEF.
talents.descriptionId:
Menyalakan Phlogiston Stereo DJ Controller (Edisi Portabel) berkekuatan penuh yang mengakibatkan Nightsoul-aligned Geo DMG Area berdasarkan DEF Xilonen.

Selain itu, akan memicu efek berikut berdasarkan jenis Source Sample yang berbeda:
·Memiliki minimum 2 Source Sample yang elemennya sudah dikonversi: Xilonen memainkan irama Ebullient, setiap satu kurun waktu, akan memulihkan HP Karakter aktif di sekitar berdasarkan DEF Xilonen;
·Memiliki kurang dari 2 Source Sample yang elemennya sudah dikonversi: Xilonen memainkan irama Ardent, melakukan dua ketukan tambahan, mengakibatkan Nightsoul-aligned Geo DMG Area yang didasarkan pada DEF Xilonen.

passives.name: Netotiliztli's Echoes
passives.description:
While in the Nightsoul's Blessing state:
·If Xilonen has at least 2 Source Samples that have had their Elemental Types changed, she gains 35 Nightsoul points when her Normal or Plunging Attacks hit opponents. Can be triggered once every 0.1s.
·If Xilonen has fewer than 2 Source Samples that have had their Elemental Types changed, her Normal and Plunging Attacks deal 30% increased DMG.

passives.name: Portable Armored Sheath
passives.description:
While in the Nightsoul's Blessing state, when Xilonen's Nightsoul points reach the maximum, she will trigger an effect equal to that of her Nightsoul Burst. This effect can be triggered once every 14s.
Additionally, when nearby party members trigger a Nightsoul Burst, Xilonen's DEF is increased by 20% for 15s.
passives.descriptionId:
Saat dalam status Nightsoul's Blessing, saat poin Nightsoul Xilonen mencapai batas maksimum, akan memicu satu kali efek yang setara dengan Nightsoul Burst miliknya, efek ini dapat terpicu sekali setiap 14 detik.
Selain itu, saat Karakter sekitar di dalam party memicu Nightsoul Burst, DEF Xilonen meningkat 20% selama 15 detik.

passives.name: Night Realm's Gift: Blessing of Forge-Fire
passives.description:
After her Nightsoul points are fully depleted, Xilonen will switch to consuming Phlogiston to maintain her Nightsoul's Blessing.
While in an area with Phlogiston Mechanics within Natlan, she can use Nightsoul Transmission: Xilonen. When the active character is currently sprinting, climbing, in a movement mode caused by certain Talents, or at a certain height in the air, the following will trigger when switching to Xilonen: Xilonen will enter the Nightsoul's Blessing state and gain 20 Nightsoul points. In this situation, Xilonen's Nightsoul points have a 4s time limit, after which her Nightsoul points will immediately expire. After she uses Yohual's Scratch within this time limit, her Nightsoul point time limit will be extended by 9s. Nightsoul Transmission can be triggered once every 10s by your own team.

Additionally, while in Natlan, Xilonen will not consume Stamina when climbing while in the Nightsoul's Blessing state.
passives.descriptionId:
Setelah poin Nightsoul habis terpakai, Xilonen akan mengonsumsi Phlogiston untuk mempertahankan status Nightsoul's Blessing-nya.
Saat ada area dengan Phlogiston Mechanic di Natlan, dapat melancarkan Nightsoul Transmission: Xilonen. Saat Karakter aktif sedang berlari, memanjat, atau sedang bergerak yang dikarenakan oleh Talenta tertentu, atau saat melayang di ketinggian tertentu, dan mengganti Karakter menjadi Xilonen, akan memicu efek: Xilonen akan memasuki status Nightsoul's Blessing dan mendapatkan 20 poin Nightsoul. Dalam kondisi ini, poin Nightsoul Xilonen memiliki batasan selama 4 detik. Setelah melewati batasan waktu ini, poin Nightsoul Xilonen akan langsung terkuras habis. Setelah melancarkan Yohual's Scratch selama durasi batasan ini, maka durasi batasan waktu poin Nightsoul akan diperpanjang 9 detik. Party sendiri dapat memicu satu kali Nightsoul Transmission sekali setiap 10 detik.

Selain itu, saat berada di Natlan dan dalam status Nightsoul's Blessing, Xilonen tidak akan mengonsumsi Stamina saat Memanjat.

passives.name: Tour of Tepeilhuitl
passives.description: Triggering Nightsoul Transmission restores 15 Phlogiston.
passives.descriptionId: Saat memicu Nightsoul Transmission akan memulihkan 15 poin Phlogiston.

constellations.name: Sabbatical Phrase
constellations.description:
Xilonen's Nightsoul point and Phlogiston consumption in her Nightsoul's Blessing state is decreased by 30%, and her Nightsoul point time limit is extended by 45%.
Additionally, when Xilonen's Source Samples are active, she can also increase nearby active characters' interruption resistance.
constellations.descriptionId:
Konsumsi poin Nightsoul dan Phlogiston Xilonen dalam status Nightsoul's Blessing berkurang 30%, dan batasan waktu poin Nightsoul diperpanjang 45%.
Selain itu, saat Source Sample Xilonen aktif, akan meningkatkan ketahanan Karakter aktif di sekitar terhadap interupsi.

constellations.name: Chiucue Mix
constellations.description:
Xilonen's Geo Source Samples will always remain active. Additionally, when her Source Samples activate, all nearby party members will gain effects corresponding to the active Source Sample that matches their Elemental Type:
·Geo: DMG dealt +50%.
·Pyro: ATK +45%.
·Hydro: Max HP +45%.
·Cryo: CRIT DMG +60%.
·Electro: Restore 25 Energy, decrease Elemental Burst CD by 6s.
constellations.descriptionId:
Source Sample Geo milik Xilonen akan tetap aktif. Selain itu, saat Source Sample-nya aktif, seluruh Karakter di sekitar dengan jenis elemen yang sama dengan Source Sample tersebut akan mendapatkan efek yang sesuai:
·Geo: DMG +50%.
·Pyro: ATK +45%.
·Hydro: Max HP +45%.
·Cryo: CRIT DMG +60%.
·Electro: Memulihkan 25 poin Energy, cooldown Elemental Burst berkurang 6 detik.

constellations.name: Tonalpohualli's Loop
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Yohual's Scratch by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.descriptionId:
Meningkatkan 3 level Yohual's Scratch.
Maksimum: Lv. 15.

constellations.name: Suchitl's Trance
constellations.description:
After Xilonen uses Yohual's Scratch, she will grant all nearby party members the Blooming Blessing effect for 15s.
Characters with Blooming Blessing deal 65% of Xilonen's DEF as increased Normal, Charged, and Plunging Attack DMG. This effect will be removed after triggering 6 times or when the duration ends.
When you hit more than one opponent, trigger counts will be consumed based on the number of opponents hit. The counts for each party member with Blooming Blessing are counted independently.
constellations.descriptionId:
Setelah Xilonen melancarkan Yohual's Scratch, akan memberikan efek Blooming Blessing terhadap seluruh Karakter di sekitar selama 15 detik.
DMG Normal Attack, Charged Attack, dan Plunging Attack Karakter yang memiliki Blooming Blessing akan meningkat sebesar 65% DEF Xilonen. Efek ini akan hilang setelah terpicu 6 kali atau setelah durasinya berakhir.
Saat serangannya mengenai beberapa musuh sekaligus, jumlah terpicu akan dikurangi berdasarkan jumlah musuh yang terkena serangan. Perhitungan kesempatan terpicu untuk setiap anggota party dihitung terpisah.

constellations.name: Tlaltecuhtli's Crossfade
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Ocelotlicue Point! by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.descriptionId:
Meningkatkan 3 level Ocelotlicue Point!.
Maksimum: Lv. 15.

constellations.name: Imperishable Night Carnival
constellations.description:
When Xilonen is in the Nightsoul's Blessing state, when she sprints, leaps, or uses Normal or Plunging Attacks, she will gain Imperishable Night's Blessing, ignoring the limitations of her Nightsoul's Blessing state and increasing the DMG dealt by her Normal and Plunging Attacks for 5s.
During this time:
·Her Nightsoul's Blessing time limit countdown will be paused. Xilonen's Nightsoul points, Phlogiston, and Stamina will not decrease, and when her Nightsoul points reach the maximum, her Nightsoul's Blessing state will not end either.
·Xilonen deals 300% of her DEF as increased Normal and Plunging Attack DMG while in the Nightsoul's Blessing state.
·She heals nearby party members for 120% of her DEF every 1.5s.
She can gain 1 Imperishable Night's Blessing once every 15s.
constellations.descriptionId:
Saat Xilonen sedang dalam status Nightsoul's Blessing, saat Xilonen berlari, melompat, melancarkan Normal Attack atau Plunging Attack, akan mendapatkan Imperishable Night's Blessing, mengabaikan batasan status Nightsoul's Blessing dan meningkatkan DMG Normal Attack dan Plunging Attack selama 5 detik.
Selama berlangsung:
Batasan waktu poin Nightsoul Xilonen akan dihentikan sementara, poin Nightsoul, Phlogiston, dan Stamina Xilonen tidak akan berkurang lagi, dan saat poin Nightsoul mencapai batas tertinggi, Nightsoul's Blessing Xilonen tidak akan berakhir.
DMG Normal Attack dan Plunging Attack Xilonen dalam status Nightsoul's Blessing meningkat sebesar 300% DEF Xilonen.
·Setiap 1,5 detik, akan memulihkan HP seluruh anggota party yang ada di sekitar sebesar 120% DEF Xilonen.
Imperishable Night's Blessing bisa didapatkan maksimum sekali setiap 15 detik.

name: Yae Miko
title: Astute Amusement
description: Lady Guuji of the Grand Narukami Shrine. Also serves as the editor-in-chief of Yae Publishing House. Unimaginable intelligence and cunning are hidden under her beautiful appearance.
descriptionId: Lady Guuji dari Kuil Agung Narukami ini juga menjabat sebagai pemimpin redaksi Yae Publishing House. Kecerdasan dan kelicikan yang tidak dapat dibayangkan tersembunyi di balik penampilannya yang cantik.

talents.name: Spiritfox Sin-Eater
talents.description:
Normal Attack
Summons forth kitsune spirits, initiating a maximum of 3 attacks that deal Electro DMG.

Charged Attack
Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to deal AoE Electro DMG after a short casting time.

Plunging Attack
Plunges towards the ground from mid-air, damaging all opponents in her path with thunderous might. Deals AoE Electro DMG upon impact with the ground.
talents.descriptionId:
Normal Attack
Memanggil roh kitsune untuk melancarkan hingga 3 serangan yang mengakibatkan Electro DMG.

Charged Attack
Mengonsumsi sejumlah Stamina dan mengakibatkan Electro DMG Area setelah jeda singkat.

Plunging Attack
Mengumpulkan kekuatan petir dan menerjang tanah, menyerang musuh di jalur terjangan dan mengakibatkan Electro DMG Area saat mendarat.

talents.name: Yakan Evocation: Sesshou Sakura
talents.description:
To Yae, such dull tasks as can be accomplished by driving spirits out need not be done personally.
Moves swiftly, leaving a Sesshou Sakura behind.

Sesshou Sakura
Has the following properties:
· Periodically strikes one nearby opponent with lightning, dealing Electro DMG
· When there are other Sesshou Sakura nearby, their level will increase, boosting the DMG dealt by these lightning strikes.

This skill has three charges.
