A maximum of 3 Sesshou Sakura can exist simultaneously. The initial level of each Sesshou Sakura is 1, and the initial highest level each sakura can reach is 3. If a new Sesshou Sakura is created too close to an existing one, the existing one will be destroyed.
talents.descriptionId:
Bagi Yae, urusan yang tidak penting bisa diselesaikan dengan menggunakan roh kitsune, sehingga dia sendiri tidak perlu turun tangan.
Bergerak cepat dan meninggalkan sebuah Sesshou Sakura.

Sesshou Sakura
Memiliki karakteristik sebagai berikut:
·Menyerang musuh yang ada di sekitar dengan sambaran petir secara berkala, mengakibatkan Electro DMG.
·Ketika ada Sesshou Sakura lain yang berdekatan, levelnya akan meningkat dan DMG yang diakibatkan juga turut meningkat.

Memiliki jumlah penggunaan 3 kali.
Maksimum dapat meninggalkan 3 Sesshou Sakura di waktu yang sama. Level awal dari setiap Sesshou Sakura adalah 1, dan levelnya dapat ditingkatkan hingga level 3. Jika ada dua Sesshou Sakura yang diciptakan terlalu berdekatan, maka Sesshou Sakura yang diciptakan lebih dulu akan hancur.

talents.name: Great Secret Art: Tenko Kenshin
talents.description:
Legends of "kitsunetsuki," or the manifestation of a kitsune's might, are common in Inazuma's folktales. One that particularly captures the imagination is that of the Sky Kitsune, said to cause lightning to fall down upon the foes of the Grand Narukami Shrine. Summons a lightning strike, dealing AoE Electro DMG.
When she uses this skill, Yae Miko will unseal nearby Sesshou Sakura, destroying their outer forms and transforming them into Tenko Thunderbolts that descend from the skies, dealing AoE Electro DMG. Each Sesshou Sakura destroyed in this way will create one Tenko Thunderbolt.
talents.descriptionId:
Salah satu cerita rakyat Inazuma disebut "kitsunetsuki", dan yang paling spesial di antaranya adalah kisah tentang Sky Kitsune yang turun menghanguskan musuh-musuh Kuil Agung Narukami. Memanggil sambaran petir dan mengakibatkan Electro DMG Area.
Saat melancarkan skill ini, Yae Miko akan membuka Sesshou Sakura yang ada di dekatnya, menghancurkan wujud luarnya, dan mengubahnya menjadi Tenko Thunderbolt yang turun dari langit, dan mengakibatkan Electro DMG Area. Setiap Sesshou Sakura yang dihancurkan dengan cara ini akan menciptakan satu Tenko Thunderbolt.

passives.name: The Shrine's Sacred Shade
passives.description: When casting Great Secret Art: Tenko Kenshin, each Sesshou Sakura destroyed resets the cooldown for 1 charge of Yakan Evocation: Sesshou Sakura.
passives.descriptionId: Saat melancarkan Great Secret Art: Tenko Kenshin, setiap kali menghancurkan sebuah Sesshou Sakura akan me-reset cooldown Yakan Evocation: Sesshou Sakura satu kali.

passives.name: Enlightened Blessing
passives.description: Every point of Elemental Mastery Yae Miko possesses will increase Sesshou Sakura DMG by 0.15%.
passives.descriptionId: Setiap poin Elemental Mastery yang dimiliki Yae Miko akan meningkatkan DMG yang diakibatkan Sesshou Sakura sebanyak 0,15%.

passives.name: Meditations of a Yako
passives.description: Has a 25% chance to get 1 regional Character Talent Material (base material excluded) when crafting. The rarity is that of the base material.
passives.descriptionId: Memberikan 25% peluang mendapat 1 tambahan Material Talenta acak yang sewilayah saat craft. Level dan material yang dibutuhkannya sama.

constellations.name: Yakan Offering
constellations.description: Each time Great Secret Art: Tenko Kenshin activates a Tenko Thunderbolt, Yae Miko will restore 8 Elemental Energy for herself.
constellations.descriptionId: Setiap kali Great Secret Art: Tenko Kenshin mengaktifkan Tenko Thunderbolt, Yae Miko akan memulihkan 8 Energy untuk dirinya sendiri.

constellations.name: Fox's Mooncall
constellations.description: Sesshou Sakura start at Level 2 when created, their max level is increased to 4, and their attack range is increased by 60%.
constellations.descriptionId: Level awal Sesshou Sakura yang tercipta meningkat menjadi level 2. Level tertinggi yang bisa dicapai menjadi level 4 dan jangkauan serangan meningkat 60%.

constellations.name: The Seven Glamours
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Yakan Evocation: Sesshou Sakura by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.descriptionId:
Meningkatkan 3 level Yakan Evocation: Sesshou Sakura.
Maksimum: Lv. 15.

constellations.name: Sakura Channeling
constellations.description: When Sesshou Sakura lightning hits opponents, the Electro DMG Bonus of all nearby party members is increased by 20% for 5s.
constellations.descriptionId: Setelah sambaran petir Sesshou Sakura mengenai musuh, Electro DMG Bonus seluruh anggota party di sekitar meningkat 20% selama 5 detik.

constellations.name: Mischievous Teasing
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Great Secret Art: Tenko Kenshin by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.descriptionId:
Meningkatkan 3 level Great Secret Art: Tenko Kenshin.
Maksimum: Lv. 15.

constellations.name: Forbidden Art: Daisesshou
constellations.description: The Sesshou Sakura's attacks will ignore 60% of the opponents' DEF.
constellations.descriptionId: Serangan Sesshou Sakura mengabaikan 60% DEF musuh.

name: Yelan
title: Valley Orchid
description: A mysterious person who claims to work for the Ministry of Civil Affairs, but is a "non-entity" on the Ministry of Civil Affairs' list.
descriptionId: Orang misterius yang mengaku bekerja di Bagian Urusan Sipil, tetapi "tidak terdaftar" di data Bagian Urusan Sipil.

talents.name: Stealthy Bowshot
talents.description:
Normal Attack
Performs up to 4 consecutive shots with a bow.

Charged Attack
Performs a more precise Aimed Shot with increased DMG.
While aiming, flowing water will accumulate on the arrowhead. A fully charged torrential arrow will deal Hydro DMG.

Breakthrough
Yelan will enter a "Breakthrough" state after spending 5s out of combat, which will cause her next Charged Aimed Shot to have 80% decreased charge time, and once charged, she can fire a "Breakthrough Barb" that will deal AoE Hydro DMG based on Yelan's Max HP.

Plunging Attack
Fires off a shower of arrows in mid-air before falling and striking the ground, dealing AoE DMG upon impact.
talents.descriptionId:
Normal Attack
Melancarkan hingga 4 serangan berturut-turut menggunakan busur.

Charged Attack
Melancarkan sebuah Serangan Membidik yang lebih akurat untuk mengakibatkan DMG lebih besar.
Saat membidik, air yang mengalir akan berkumpul di ujung anak panah. Setelah terkumpul penuh, anak panah yang diluncurkan akan mengakibatkan Hydro DMG.

Breakthrough
Setelah keluar dari status tempur selama 5 detik Yelan akan memasuki kondisi "Breakthrough", dalam kondisi ini waktu charge untuk Serangan Membidik-nya akan berkurang 80% dan saat dilancarkan, Yelan akan menembakkan "Breakthrough Barb" yang mengakibatkan Hydro DMG Area berdasarkan Max HP Yelan.

Plunging Attack
Melancarkan hujan panah dari udara dan menerjang tanah dengan kecepatan tinggi, mengakibatkan DMG Area saat mendarat.

talents.name: Lingering Lifeline
talents.description:
Fires off a Lifeline that allows her to move rapidly, entangling and marking opponents along its path.
When this rapid movement ends, the Lifeline will explode, dealing Hydro DMG to the marked opponents based on Yelan's Max HP.

Tap
Moves a certain distance forward swiftly.

Hold
Engages in continuous, swift movement, during which Yelan's resistance to interruption is increased.
During this time, Yelan can control this rapid movement and end it by using this Skill again.

Additionally, each opponent marked by the Lifeline when it explodes grants Yelan a 34% chance to reset her Breakthrough state.
talents.descriptionId:
Menembakkan Lifeline yang menariknya dengan cepat, menjerat dan menandai musuh di sepanjang jalurnya
Saat gerakannya yang cepat berakhir, Lifeline akan meledak, mengakibatkan Hydro DMG pada musuh yang telah ditandai berdasarkan Max HP Yelan.

Tekan
Pindah maju ke depan dalam jarak tertentu dengan cepat.

Tahan
Pindah maju ke depan dengan cepat secara terus menerus. Selama Yelan melakukan gerakan tersebut, ketahanannya terhadap interupsi akan meningkat.
Selama waktu tersebut juga, Yelan dapat mengontrol arah sprint-nya dan mengakhiri gerakan cepatnya dengan menggunakan Skill ini lagi.

Lalu, setiap musuh yang ditandai oleh Lifeline dan meledak, akan memberikan 34% kesempatan pada Yelan untuk memasuki kembali kondisi Breakthrough.

talents.name: Depth-Clarion Dice
talents.description:
Deals AoE Hydro DMG and creates an "Exquisite Throw," which aids her in battle.

Exquisite Throw
Follows the character around and will initiate a coordinated attack under the following circumstances, dealing Hydro DMG based on Yelan's Max HP:
·Can occur once every second when your active character uses a Normal Attack.
·Will occur each time Yelan's Lifeline explodes and hits opponents.
talents.descriptionId:
Mengakibatkan Hydro DMG Area dan membuat "Exquisite Throw" yang bisa membantunya dalam pertempuran.

Exquisite Throw
Mengikuti Karakter dan akan memulai serangan terkoordinasi dalam situasi berikut, mengakibatkan Hydro DMG berdasarkan Max HP Yelan:
·Dapat terpicu sekali dalam setiap detik saat Karakter aktif menggunakan Normal Attack.
·Akan muncul setiap kali Lifeline milik Yelan meledak dan mengenai musuh.

passives.name: Turn Control
passives.description: When the party has 1/2/3/4 Elemental Types, Yelan's Max HP is increased by 6%/12%/18%/30%.
passives.descriptionId: Saat party memiliki 1/2/3/4 Tipe Elemental, Max HP Yelan meningkat sebesar 6%/12%/18%/30%.

passives.name: Adapt With Ease
passives.description:
So long as an Exquisite Throw is in play, your own active character deals 1% more DMG. This increases by a further 3.5% DMG every second. The maximum increase to DMG dealt is 50%.
The pre-existing effect will be dispelled if Depth-Clarion Dice is recast during its duration.
passives.descriptionId:
Selama Exquisite Throw masih berjalan, maka Karakter aktif akan mengakibatkan 1% DMG lebih besar. Peningkatan ini berlangsung sebanyak 3,5% DMG setiap detik. Maksimum peningkatan DMG sampai 50%.
Jika Depth-Clarion Dice dilancarkan lagi saat durasinya masih berlangsung maka efek yang sudah ada sebelumnya akan hilang.

passives.name: Necessary Calculation
passives.description: Gains 25% more rewards when dispatched on a Liyue Expedition for 20 hours.
passives.descriptionId: Ketika dikirim untuk melakukan ekspedisi di Liyue selama 20 jam, hadiah yang didapatkan akan bertambah 25%.

constellations.name: Enter the Plotters
constellations.description: Lingering Lifeline gains 1 additional charge.
constellations.descriptionId: Lingering Lifeline mendapatkan 1 charge tambahan.

constellations.name: Taking All Comers
constellations.description:
When Exquisite Throw conducts a coordinated attack, it will fire an additional water arrow that will deal 14% of Yelan's Max HP as Hydro DMG.
This effect can trigger once every 1.8s.
constellations.descriptionId:
Saat Exquisite Throw menghasilkan serangan terkoordinasi, akan menghasilkan pula panah air tambahan yang menjadikan 14% Max HP Yelan sebagai Hydro DMG.
Efek ini terpicu setiap 1,8 detik.

constellations.name: Beware the Trickster's Dice
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Depth-Clarion Dice by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.descriptionId:
Meningkatkan 3 level Depth-Clarion Dice.
Maksimum: Lv. 15.

constellations.name: Bait-and-Switch
constellations.description: Increases all party members' Max HP by 10% for 25s for every opponent marked by Lifeline when the Lifeline explodes. A maximum increase of 40% Max HP can be attained in this manner.
constellations.descriptionId: Meningkatkan Max HP semua anggota party sebesar 10% selama 25 detik untuk setiap musuh yang ditandai oleh Lifeline saat Lifeline tersebut meledak. Peningkatan Max HP yang bisa didapatkan dengan cara ini maksimum 40%.

constellations.name: Dealer's Sleight
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Lingering Lifeline by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.descriptionId:
Meningkatkan 3 level Lingering Lifeline.
Maksimum: Lv. 15.

constellations.name: Winner Takes All
constellations.description:
After using Depth-Clarion Dice, Yelan will enter the Mastermind state.
In this state, all of Yelan's Normal Attacks will be special Breakthrough Barbs. These Breakthrough Barbs will have similar abilities to normal ones and the DMG dealt will be considered Charged Attack DMG, dealing 156% of a normal Breakthrough Barb's DMG.

The Mastermind state lasts 20s and will be cleared after Yelan fires 5 arrows.
constellations.descriptionId:
Setelah menggunakan Depth-Clarion Dice, Yelan akan memasuki kondisi Mastermind.
Dalam kondisi ini, semua Normal Attack Yelan akan menjadi Breakthrough Barb spesial. Breakthrough Barb ini akan memiliki semua kemampuan Breakthrough Barb biasa dan DMG yang diakibatkan akan dianggap sebagai DMG Charged Attack, mengakibatkan 156% dari DMG Breakthrough Barb normal.

Kondisi Mastermind berlangsung selama 20 detik dan akan berakhir setelah Yelan menembakkan 5 anak panah.

name: Yoimiya
title: Frolicking Flames
description: Owner of Naganohara Fireworks. Known as the "Queen of the Summer Festival," she excels in her craft of creating fireworks that symbolize people's hopes and dreams.
descriptionId: Pemilik Naganohara Fireworks. Juga dikenal sebagai "Ratu Festival Musim Panas", dia mahir membuat kembang api yang melambangkan harapan dan impian semua orang.

talents.name: Firework Flare-Up
talents.description:
Normal Attack
Performs up to 5 consecutive shots with a bow.

Charged Attack
Performs a more precise Aimed Shot with increased DMG.
While aiming, flames will accumulate on the arrowhead before being fired off as an attack. Has different effects based on how long the energy has been charged:
·Charge Level 1: Fires off a flaming arrow that deals Pyro DMG.
·Charge Level 2: Generates a maximum of 3 Kindling Arrows based on time spent charging, releasing them as part of this Aimed Shot. Kindling Arrows will home in on nearby opponents, dealing Pyro DMG on hit.

Plunging Attack
Fires off a shower of arrows in mid-air before falling and striking the ground, dealing AoE DMG upon impact.
talents.descriptionId:
Normal Attack
Melancarkan maks. 5 serangan berturut-turut dengan busur.

Charged Attack
Melancarkan Serangan Membidik yang lebih akurat dan mengakibatkan DMG lebih tinggi.
Saat membidik, kobaran api akan terus berkumpul di ujung panah dan mengikuti lesatan panah yang dilepas. Dapat menyebabkan beragam efek berikut berdasarkan durasi tombol serangan ditahan.
·Charge Tahap 1: Menembakkan panah api yang mengakibatkan Pyro DMG;
·Charge Tahap 2: Menghasilkan hingga 3 Kindling Arrow berdasarkan durasi tombol serangan ditahan, dan dilepas bersamaan seiring Serangan Membidik Yoimiya. Kindling Arrow akan memburu musuh di sekitar secara otomatis dan mengakibatkan Pyro DMG pada musuh yang terkena.

Plunging Attack
Melancarkan hujan panah yang menerjang tanah dengan kecepatan tinggi, mengakibatkan DMG Area saat mendarat.

talents.name: Niwabi Fire-Dance
talents.description:
Yoimiya waves a sparkler and causes a ring of saltpeter to surround her.

Niwabi Enshou
During this time, arrows fired by Yoimiya's Normal Attack will be Blazing Arrows, and their DMG will be increased and converted to Pyro DMG. During this time, Normal Attack: Firework Flare-Up will not generate Kindling Arrows at Charge Level 2.

This effect will deactivate when Yoimiya leaves the field.
talents.descriptionId:
Dengan sebuah kembang api, sebuah lingkaran yang mengandung bubuk mesiu muncul mengelilingi Yoimiya.

Niwabi Enshou
Selama durasi skill, panah dari Normal Attack Yoimiya akan menjadi Blazing Arrow dan DMG yang diakibatkan akan meningkat dan menjadi Pyro DMG; Charge Tahap 2 dari Normal Attack: Firework Flare-Up tidak akan menghasilkan Kindling Arrow selama durasi skill.

Efek ini akan menghilang ketika Yoimiya meninggalkan medan tempur.

talents.name: Ryuukin Saxifrage
talents.description:
Yoimiya leaps into the air along with her original creation, the "Ryuukin Saxifrage," and fires forth blazing rockets bursting with surprises that deal AoE Pyro DMG and mark one of the hit opponents with Aurous Blaze.

Aurous Blaze
All Normal/Charged/Plunging Attacks, Elemental Skills, and Elemental Bursts by any party member other than Yoimiya that hit an opponent marked by Aurous Blaze will trigger an explosion, dealing AoE Pyro DMG.
When an opponent affected by Aurous Blaze is defeated before its duration expires, the effect will pass on to another nearby opponent, who will inherit the remaining duration.

One Aurous Blaze explosion can be triggered every 2s. When Yoimiya is down, Aurous Blaze effects created through her skills will be deactivated.
talents.descriptionId:
Seiring "Ryuukin Saxifrage" ciptaannya melompat ke udara, Yoimiya melesatkan roket api penuh kejutan ke depan, mengakibatkan Pyro DMG Area, dan memberikan salah satu musuh yang terkena efek Aurous Blaze.

Aurous Blaze
Jika Normal/Charged/Plunging Attack, Elemental Skill, dan Elemental Burst dari anggota party selain Yoimiya mengenai musuh yang ditandai dengan Aurous Blaze, maka serangan tersebut akan memicu ledakan yang mengakibatkan Pyro DMG Area.
Jika musuh yang terkena pengaruh Aurous Blaze gugur selama durasi efek berlangsung, efek Aurous Blaze akan berpindah ke musuh lain di sekitarnya dan melanjutkan sisa durasi Aurous Blaze.

Satu ledakan Aurous Blaze dapat terpicu setiap 2 detik. Ketika Yoimiya gugur, efek Aurous Blaze yang tercipta dari skill Yoimiya akan menghilang.

passives.name: Tricks of the Trouble-Maker
passives.description: During Niwabi Fire-Dance, shots from Yoimiya's Normal Attack will increase her Pyro DMG Bonus by 2% on hit. This effect lasts for 3s and can have a maximum of 10 stacks.
passives.descriptionId: Selama durasi Niwabi Fire-Dance, saat Normal Attack Yoimiya mengenai musuh, Yoimiya akan memperoleh 2% Pyro DMG Bonus. Efek ini berlangsung selama 3 detik dan dapat ditumpuk hingga 10 lapis.

passives.name: Summer Night's Dawn
passives.description: Using Ryuukin Saxifrage causes nearby party members (not including Yoimiya) to gain a 10% ATK increase for 15s. Additionally, a further ATK Bonus will be added on based on the number of Ascension Talent "Tricks of the Trouble-Maker" stacks Yoimiya possesses when using Ryuukin Saxifrage. Each stack increases this ATK Bonus by 1%.
passives.descriptionId: Melancarkan Ryuukin Saxifrage akan meningkatkan 10% ATK seluruh anggota party di sekitar (tidak termasuk Yoimiya) selama 15 detik. Selain itu, Karakter juga akan mendapatkan peningkatan ATK tambahan berdasarkan jumlah lapisan Talenta Ascension "Tricks of the Trouble-Maker" yang dimiliki Yoimiya saat menggunakan Ryuukin Saxifrage. Setiap lapisan akan meningkatkan 1% peningkatan ATK.

passives.name: Blazing Match
passives.description: When Yoimiya crafts Decoration, Ornament, and Landscape-type Furnishings, she has a 100% chance to refund a portion of the materials used.
passives.descriptionId: Yoimiya memiliki 100% kemungkinan untuk mendapatkan kembali sebagian material yang digunakan dalam pembuatan dekorasi, perabot dan hiasan.

constellations.name: Agate Ryuukin
constellations.description:
The Aurous Blaze created by Ryuukin Saxifrage lasts for an extra 4s.
Additionally, when an opponent affected by Aurous Blaze is defeated within its duration, Yoimiya's ATK is increased by 20% for 20s.
constellations.descriptionId:
Durasi Aurous Blaze yang tercipta dari Ryuukin Saxifrage bertahan 4 detik lebih lama.
Selain itu, jika musuh yang terkena efek Aurous Blaze dikalahkan selama durasi masih berlangsung, ATK Yoimiya akan meningkat 20% selama 20 detik.

constellations.name: A Procession of Bonfires
constellations.description:
When Yoimiya's Pyro DMG scores a CRIT Hit, Yoimiya will gain a 25% Pyro DMG Bonus for 6s.
This effect can be triggered even when Yoimiya is not the active character.
constellations.descriptionId:
Saat Pyro DMG Yoimiya mengakibatkan serangan CRIT, Yoimiya akan mendapatkan 25% Pyro DMG Bonus selama 6 detik.
Efek ini tetap dapat terpicu meskipun Yoimiya tidak berada di medan pertempuran.

constellations.name: Trickster's Flare
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Niwabi Fire-Dance by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.descriptionId:
Meningkatkan 3 level Niwabi Fire-Dance.
Maksimum: Lv. 15.

constellations.name: Pyrotechnic Professional
constellations.description: When Yoimiya's own Aurous Blaze triggers an explosion, Niwabi Fire-Dance's CD is decreased by 1.2s.
constellations.descriptionId: Saat Aurous Blaze milik Yoimiya sendiri memicu ledakan, CD Niwabi Fire-Dance akan berkurang 1,2 detik.

constellations.name: A Summer Festival's Eve
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Ryuukin Saxifrage by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.descriptionId:
Meningkatkan 3 level Ryuukin Saxifrage.
Maksimum: Lv. 15.

constellations.name: Naganohara Meteor Swarm
constellations.description: During Niwabi Fire-Dance, Yoimiya's Normal Attacks have a 50% chance of firing an extra Blazing Arrow that deals 60% of its original DMG. This DMG is considered Normal Attack DMG.
constellations.descriptionId: Selama durasi Niwabi Fire-Dance, Normal Attack Yoimiya memiliki 50% kemungkinan menembakkan Blazing Arrow tambahan yang mengakibatkan 60% DMG aslinya. DMG ini terhitung sebagai Normal Attack DMG.

name: Yumemizuki Mizuki
title: Embrace of Enchanting Dreams
description: A shareholder of Aisa Bathhouse, a baku, and a clinical psychologist. Dedicated to the dispersal of nightmares, and to bringing people peace of mind.
descriptionId: Pemegang saham Aisa Bathhouse, psikolog klinis dari klan yumekui-baku yang berdedikasi untuk mengusir mimpi buruk dan membawa ketenangan batin bagi semua orang.

talents.name: Pure Heart, Pure Dreams
talents.description:
Normal Attack
Performs up to 3 attacks, dealing Anemo DMG.

Charged Attack
Consumes a certain amount of Stamina and deals AoE Anemo DMG after a short casting time.

Plunging Attack
Calling upon the power of Anemo, she plunges towards the ground from mid-air, damaging all opponents in her path. Deals AoE Anemo DMG upon impact with the ground.
talents.descriptionId:
Normal Attack
Melancarkan hingga 3 serangan dan mengakibatkan Anemo DMG.

Charged Attack
Mengonsumsi sejumlah Stamina untuk mengakibatkan Anemo DMG Area setelah jeda singkat.

Plunging Attack
Mengumpulkan kekuatan Anemo dan menerjang tanah, menyerang musuh di jalur terjangan dan mengakibatkan Anemo DMG Area saat mendarat.

talents.name: Aisa Utamakura Pilgrimage
talents.description:
Weaves memories of lovely dreams, entering a Dreamdrifter state where Yumemizuki Mizuki floats above the ground, and dealing 1 instance of AoE Anemo DMG to nearby opponents.

Dreamdrifter
·While in the Dreamdrifter state, Yumemizuki Mizuki will continuously drift forward, dealing AoE Anemo DMG to nearby opponents at regular intervals.
·During this time, Yumemizuki Mizuki can control her direction of drift, and the pick-up distance of Yumemi Style Special Snacks from the Elemental Burst Anraku Secret Spring Therapy will be increased.
·Increases the Swirl DMG and Stellar Swirl reaction DMG that nearby party members deal based on Yumemizuki Mizuki's Elemental Mastery.
·Dreamdrifter will end when Mizuki leaves the field or uses her Elemental Skill again.
talents.descriptionId:
Menenun kenangan mimpi indah, memasuki status Dreamdrifter yang bisa melayang di atas permukaan tanah, dan mengakibatkan satu kali Anemo DMG Area terhadap musuh di sekitar.

Dreamdrifter
·Saat berada dalam status Dreamdrifter, Yumemizuki Mizuki akan terus melayang ke arah depan dan mengakibatkan Anemo DMG Area secara berkala terhadap musuh di sekitar.
·Selama durasi ini, Yumemizuki Mizuki dapat mengontrol arah melayangnya, dan jarak pengambilan Yumemi Style Special Snacks dari Elemental Burst Anraku Secret Spring Therapy akan meningkat.
·Meningkatkan DMG reaksi Swirl dan Stellar Swirl yang dipicu oleh anggota party di sekitar berdasarkan Elemental Mastery Yumemizuki Mizuki.
·Status Dreamdrifter akan berakhir saat Yumemizuki Mizuki meninggalkan medan pertempuran atau melancarkan Elemental Skill-nya sekali lagi.

talents.name: Anraku Secret Spring Therapy
talents.description:
Summons forth countless lovely dreams and nightmares that pull in nearby objects and opponents, dealing AoE Anemo DMG and summoning a Mini Baku.

Mini Baku:
Follows the current active character. At regular intervals, the Mini Baku will create 1 Yumemi Style Special Snack nearby. After one of your own party members picks up a Special Snack, if their HP is higher than 70%, the Snack will explode and unleash a Munen Shockwave, dealing 1 instance of AoE Anemo DMG to nearby opponents. Otherwise, it will heal the character who picked it up based on Yumemizuki Mizuki's Elemental Mastery. When Yumemizuki Mizuki triggers healing by picking up a Yumemi Style Special Snack, the amount of healing is increased by 100%. If a Snack is not picked up after a period of time, it will explode and release a Munen Shockwave, dealing 1 instance of AoE Anemo DMG to surrounding opponents.
talents.descriptionId:
Membangunkan berbagai mimpi indah dan mimpi buruk yang akan menarik musuh dan objek di sekitar dan mengakibatkan Anemo DMG Area, serta memanggil Mini Baku untuk membantu.

Mini Baku:
Akan mengikuti Karakter aktif. Setiap beberapa saat, Mini Baku ini akan menghasilkan 1 buah Yumemi Style Special Snacks di sekitar. Saat salah satu Karakter di dalam party-mu mengambil Snack, jika HP Karakter yang bersangkutan di atas 70%, maka Snack tersebut akan meledak dan melancarkan Munen Shockwave, mengakibatkan Anemo DMG Area satu kali pada musuh di sekitar. Jika tidak, maka Snack ini akan memulihkan HP Karakter yang mengambilnya berdasarkan Elemental Mastery Yumemizuki Mizuki. Saat Yumemizuki Mizuki mengambil Yumemi Style Special Snacks dan memicu pemulihan HP, jumlah pemulihannya akan meningkat 100%. Jika tidak diambil setelah kurun waktu tertentu, maka Snack ini akan meledak dan melancarkan Munen Shockwave, mengakibatkan Anemo DMG Area satu kali pada musuh di sekitar.

passives.name: Bright Moon's Restless Voice
passives.description: When Yumemizuki Mizuki triggers a Swirl or Stellar Swirl reaction while in her Dreamdrifter state, Dreamdrifter's duration increases by 2.5s. This effect can trigger once every 0.3s for a maximum of 2 times per Dreamdrifter state.
passives.descriptionId: Setiap kali Yumemizuki Mizuki memicu reaksi Swirl atau Stellar Swirl saat dalam status Dreamdrifter, maka durasi Dreamdrifter akan bertambah 2,5 detik. Efek ini dapat terpicu sekali setiap 0,3 detik, dan dapat terpicu sebanyak 2 kali dalam satu kali status Dreamdrifter.

passives.name: Thoughts by Day Bring Dreams by Night
passives.description: While Yumemizuki Mizuki is in the Dreamdrifter state, when other nearby party members hit opponents with Pyro, Hydro, Cryo, or Electro attacks, her Elemental Mastery will increase by 100 for 4s.
passives.descriptionId: Saat Yumemizuki Mizuki berada dalam status Dreamdrifter, jika serangan anggota party lain di sekitar yang berelemen Pyro, Hydro, Cryo, atau Electro mengenai musuh, maka Elemental Mastery Yumemizuki Mizuki meningkat 100 poin selama 4 detik.

passives.name: All Ailments Banished
passives.description: When Yumemizuki Mizuki is in the party, party members have a chance to recover 30% additional HP when using healing foods that do not have reviving properties. The trigger chance for this effect increases with the corresponding character's Friendship Level. (This effect will always trigger if the Traveler is the character consuming healing food.)
passives.descriptionId: Saat Yumemizuki Mizuki berada di dalam party, anggota party memiliki kemungkinan untuk mendapatkan 30% pemulihan HP tambahan saat mengonsumsi makanan pemulihan HP yang tidak memiliki fungsi menghidupkan kembali Karakter gugur. Kemungkinan terpicunya efek ini didasarkan pada Level Persahabatan Karakter yang bersangkutan. (Efek ini akan selalu terpicu jika Pengembara yang mengonsumsi makanan pemulihan.)

constellations.name: In Mist-Like Waters
constellations.description: When Yumemizuki Mizuki is in the Dreamdrifter state, she will continuously apply the "Twenty-Three Nights' Awaiting" effect to nearby opponents for 3s every 3.5s. When an opponent has a Swirl or Stellar Swirl reaction triggered against them by Anemo DMG while the aforementioned effect is active, the effect will be canceled, and this Swirl or Stellar Swirl instance deals DMG against this opponent increased by 1,100% and 550% of Mizuki's Elemental Mastery, respectively.
constellations.descriptionId: Saat Yumemizuki Mizuki berada dalam status Dreamdrifter, ia akan memberikan efek "Twenty-Three Nights' Awaiting" pada musuh di sekitar setiap 3,5 detik dan bertahan selama 3 detik. Saat musuh yang berada dalam status "Twenty-Three Nights' Awaiting" terkena Anemo DMG dan memicu reaksi Swirl/Stellar Swirl, maka efek ini terhapus dan membuat DMG reaksi Swirl atau Stellar Swirl pada musuh yang bersangkutan kali ini masing-masing meningkat sebesar 1.100%/550% dari Elemental Mastery Yumemizuki Mizuki.

constellations.name: Your Echo I Meet in Dreams
constellations.description: When Yumemizuki Mizuki enters the Dreamdrifter state, every Elemental Mastery point she has will increase all nearby party members' Pyro, Hydro, Cryo, and Electro DMG Bonuses by 0.04% until the Dreamdrifter state ends.
constellations.descriptionId: Saat memasuki status Dreamdrifter, setiap poin Elemental Mastery Yumemizuki Mizuki akan memberikan 0,04% Pyro, Hydro, Cryo, dan Electro DMG Bonus terhadap seluruh Karakter lain dalam party yang ada di sekitar dan berlangsung hingga status Dreamdrifter berakhir.

constellations.name: Till Dawn's Moon Ends Night
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Aisa Utamakura Pilgrimage by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.descriptionId:
Meningkatkan 3 level Elemental Skill Aisa Utamakura Pilgrimage.
Maksimum: Lv. 15.

constellations.name: Buds Warm Lucid Springs
constellations.description: Picking up a Yumemi Style Special Snack from the Elemental Burst Anraku Secret Spring Therapy will both deal DMG and heal, and will restore 5 Energy to Yumemizuki Mizuki. Energy can be restored this way 4 times per Anraku Secret Spring Therapy duration.
constellations.descriptionId: Saat mengambil Yumemi Style Special Snacks dari Elemental Burst Anraku Secret Spring Therapy, Snack ini akan mengakibatkan DMG dan memulihkan HP di waktu yang bersamaan, juga memulihkan 5 poin Energy untuk Yumemizuki Mizuki. Dalam satu durasiAnraku Secret Spring Therapy, maksimum 4 kali pemulihan Energy yang bisa diperoleh dengan cara ini.

constellations.name: As Setting Moon Brings Year's End
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Anraku Secret Spring Therapy by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.descriptionId:
Meningkatkan 3 level Elemental Burst Anraku Secret Spring Therapy.
Maksimum: Lv. 15.

constellations.name: The Heart Lingers Long
constellations.description: While Yumemizuki Mizuki is in the Dreamdrifter state, Swirl reaction DMG dealt by nearby party members can score CRIT Hits, with CRIT Rate fixed at 30%, and CRIT DMG fixed at 100%. Any Stellar Swirl reaction DMG dealt by these characters will also have its CRIT Rate and CRIT DMG increased by 10% and 20%, respectively.
constellations.descriptionId: Saat Yumemizuki Mizuki berada dalam status Dreamdrifter, DMG reaksi Swirl yang dipicu oleh Karakter party di sekitar dapat mengakibatkan CRIT, dengan nilai CRIT Rate tetap sebesar 30% dan CRIT DMG tetap sebesar 100%, serta meningkatkan 10% CRIT Rate dan 20% CRIT DMG Stellar Swirl yang diakibatkan oleh Karakter tersebut.

name: Zhongli
title: Vago Mundo
description: A mysterious expert contracted by the Wangsheng Funeral Parlor. Extremely knowledgeable in all things.
descriptionId: Seorang konsultan misterius yang terikat kontrak dengan Wangsheng Funeral Parlor. Dia memiliki pengetahuan yang mendalam tentang segala sesuatu.

talents.name: Rain of Stone
talents.description:
Normal Attack
Performs up to 6 consecutive spear strikes.

Charged Attack
Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to lunge forward, causing stone spears to fall along his path.

Plunging Attack
Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground below, damaging opponents along the path and dealing AoE DMG upon impact.
talents.descriptionId:
Normal Attack
Melancarkan hingga 6 serangan tombak beruntun.

Charged Attack
Mengonsumsi sejumlah Stamina untuk menyerang maju, dan menyebabkan tombak batu berjatuhan di sepanjang jalur serangan.

Plunging Attack
Menerjang dari udara untuk menghantam tanah, menyerang musuh di jalur terjangan dan mengakibatkan DMG area saat mendarat.

talents.name: Dominus Lapidis
talents.description:
Every mountain, rock and inch of land is filled with the power of Geo, but those who can wield such powers freely are few and far between.

Press
Commands the power of earth to create a Stone Stele.

Hold
Causes nearby Geo energy to explode, causing the following effects:
·If their maximum number hasn't been reached, creates a Stone Stele.
·Creates a shield of jade. The shield's DMG Absorption scales based on Zhongli's Max HP.
·Deals AoE Geo DMG.
·If there are nearby targets with the Geo element, it will drain a large amount of Geo element from a maximum of 2 such targets. This effect does not cause DMG.

Stone Stele
When created, deals AoE Geo DMG.
Additionally, it will intermittently resonate with other nearby Geo constructs, dealing Geo DMG to nearby opponents.
The Stone Stele is considered a Geo construct that can both be climbed and used to block attacks.
Only one Stele created by Zhongli himself may initially exist at any one time.

Jade Shield
Possesses 150% DMG Absorption against all Elemental and Physical DMG.
Characters protected by the Jade Shield will decrease the Elemental RES and Physical RES of opponents in a small AoE by 20%. This effect cannot be stacked.
talents.descriptionId:
Gunung, tanah, batu, semuanya mengandung kekuatan Geo. Namun, cuma sedikit saja yang bisa mengerahkan kekuatan itu sesuai kehendaknya.

Tekan
Memerintahkan elemen Geo di permukaan tanah untuk berkumpul dan membentuk sebuah Stone Stele.

Tahan
Mengakibatkan elemen Geo di sekitar meledak, menyebabkan efek berikut:
·Bila jumlah Stone Stele yang terbentuk belum mencapai batas maksimum, Stone Stele akan terbentuk.
·Menciptakan sebuah Jade Shield yang dapat menyerap DMG sesuai dengan Max HP Zhongli.
·Mengakibatkan Geo DMG Area.
·Bila di sekeliling karakter terdapat musuh dengan elemen Geo, maka Zhongli dapat mengonsumsi sejumlah besar elemen Geo, maksimum dari 2 musuh. Efek ini tidak mengakibatkan DMG.

Stone Stele
Ketika terbentuk, pilar ini akan mengakibatkan Geo DMG Area.
Selain itu, Stone Stele akan beresonansi dengan Geo Construct di sekitarnya, mengakibatkan Geo DMG ke musuh di sekitar.
Stone Stele terhitung sebagai Geo Construct, yang dapat digunakan untuk menghalangi serangan dan juga dapat dipanjat.
Awalnya, Stone Stele yang diciptakan oleh Zhongli, hanya bisa ada satu dalam satu waktu.

Jade Shield
Memiliki bonus 150% efek penyerapan terhadap semua Elemental DMG dan Physical DMG.
Karakter yang berada dalam perlindungan Jade Shield akan menyebabkan semua Elemental RES dan Physical RES musuh di area kecil sekitarnya berkurang 20%. Efek tersebut tidak dapat ditumpuk.

talents.name: Planet Befall
talents.description:
Brings a falling meteor down to earth, dealing massive Geo DMG to opponents caught in its AoE and applying the Petrification status to them.

Petrification
Opponents affected by the Petrification status cannot move.
talents.descriptionId:
Menjatuhkan sebuah meteor ke bumi, mengakibatkan Geo DMG yang besar serta menyebabkan efek Petrification kepada musuh di dalam area skill.

Petrification
Musuh yang terkena efek Petrification tidak dapat bergerak.

passives.name: Resonant Waves
passives.description:
When the Jade Shield takes DMG, it will Fortify:
·Fortified characters have 5% increased Shield Strength.
Can stack up to 5 times, and lasts until the Jade Shield disappears.
passives.descriptionId:
Jade Shield akan menjadi lebih kuat setelah menerima DMG:
·Meningkatkan 5% Kekuatan Perisai milik karakter yang dilindungi Jade Shield.
·Efek ini dapat ditumpuk sebanyak 5 kali dan akan bertahan sampai Jade Shield hilang.

passives.name: Dominance of Earth
passives.description:
Zhongli deals bonus DMG based on his Max HP:
·Normal Attack, Charged Attack, and Plunging Attack DMG is increased by 1.39% of Max HP.
·Dominus Lapidis' Stone Stele, resonance, and hold DMG is increased by 1.9% of Max HP.
·Planet Befall's DMG is increased by 33% of Max HP.
passives.descriptionId:
Zhongli menghasilkan bonus DMG berdasarkan Max HP miliknya:
·Meningkatkan DMG Normal Attack, Charged Attack, dan Plunging Attack sebesar 1,39% dari Max HP Zhongli.
·Meningkatkan DMG Dominus Lapidis Stone Stele, resonansi, dan DMG tekan sebesar 1,9% Max HP Zhongli.
·Meningkatkan DMG Planet Befall sebesar 33% Max HP Zhongli.

passives.name: Arcanum of Crystal
passives.description: Refunds 15% of the ore used when crafting Polearm-type weapons.
passives.descriptionId: Mengembalikan 15% jumlah Ore yang digunakan saat membuat senjata tipe Polearm.

constellations.name: Rock, the Backbone of Earth
constellations.description: Increases the maximum number of Stone Steles created by Dominus Lapidis that may exist simultaneously to 2.
constellations.descriptionId: Jumlah Stone Stele yang dapat diciptakan oleh Dominus Lapidis meningkat menjadi 2.

constellations.name: Stone, the Cradle of Jade
constellations.description: Planet Befall grants nearby characters on the field a Jade Shield when it descends.
constellations.descriptionId: Saat Planet Befall dilancarkan, sebuah Jade Shield akan tercipta untuk Karakter yang berada di dekatnya.

constellations.name: Jade, Shimmering through Darkness
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Dominus Lapidis by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.descriptionId:
Meningkatkan 3 level Dominus Lapidis.
Maksimum: Lv. 15.

constellations.name: Topaz, Unbreakable and Fearless
constellations.description: Increases Planet Befall's AoE by 20% and increases the duration of Planet Befall's Petrification effect by 2s.
constellations.descriptionId: Meningkatkan radius Planet Befall sebesar 20% dan meningkatkan durasi dari efek Petrification Planet Befall sebanyak 2 detik.

constellations.name: Lazuli, Herald of the Order
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Planet Befall by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.descriptionId:
Meningkatkan 3 level Planet Befall.
Maksimum: Lv. 15.

constellations.name: Chrysos, Bounty of Dominator
constellations.description:
When the Jade Shield takes DMG, 40% of that incoming DMG is converted to HP for the current character.
A single instance of regeneration cannot exceed 8% of that character's Max HP.
constellations.descriptionId:
Saat Jade Shield aktif, 40% DMG yang diterima akan dikonversi menjadi pemulihan HP.
Jumlah pemulihan yang diterima dalam satu kali konversi tidak dapat melebihi 8% dari Max HP karakter tersebut.

name: Zibai
title: White Horse's Fleeting Spring
description: The White Horse Adeptus from Liyue's legends, known as Zibai. The most mysterious figure in Liyue's myths.
descriptionId: Adeptus kuda putih dalam legenda Liyue yang dikenal dengan nama Zibai, sosok paling misterius di dalam mitologi Liyue.

talents.name: Golden Blade's Petaled Touch
talents.description:
Normal Attack
Performs up to 4 rapid strikes.

Charged Attack
Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to unleash 2 rapid sword strikes.

Plunging Attack
Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground below, damaging opponents along the path and dealing AoE DMG upon impact.
talents.descriptionId:
Normal Attack
Melancarkan hingga 4 serangan berturut-turut.

Charged Attack
Mengonsumsi sejumlah Stamina untuk melancarkan dua tebasan pedang.

Plunging Attack
Menerjang dari udara untuk menghantam tanah, menyerang musuh di jalur terjangan dan mengakibatkan DMG Area saat mendarat.

talents.name: Heaven and Earth Made Manifest
talents.description:
Summoning a shadow of her former powers, she switches to the **Lunar Phase Shift** mode.
In this mode, Zibai's Normal Attacks and Charged Attacks will deal Geo DMG that cannot be overridden by other infusions, and she can accrue special Phase Shift Radiance through different methods. Zibai can consume Phase Shift Radiance to unleash the special Elemental Skill Spirit Steed's Stride.

Moonsign: Ascendant Gleam
While in the Lunar Phase Shift mode, when Zibai performs Normal Attacks, the fourth attack will deal an additional instance of Geo DMG, which is considered Lunar-Crystallize Reaction DMG.
talents.descriptionId:
Memanggil bayangan dari kekuasaan masa lalu dan berganti ke mode **Lunar Phase Shift**.
Dalam mode ini, Normal Attack dan Charged Attack Zibai akan dikonversi menjadi Geo DMG yang tidak bisa ditimpa Elemental Infusion lainnya, dan akan mengakumulasi Phase Shift Radiance yang khusus dengan berbagai cara. Zibai dapat mengonsumsi Phase Shift Radiance untuk melancarkan Elemental Skill khusus Spirit Steed's Stride.

Moonsign: Ascendant Gleam
Saat berada dalam mode Lunar Phase Shift dan Zibai melancarkan Normal Attack, maka serangan tahap keempat akan mengakibatkan satu kali Geo DMG tambahan. DMG ini dianggap sebagai DMG reaksi Lunar-Crystallize.

talents.name: Tri-Sphere Eminence
talents.description:
Zibai operates the Jadelight Canopy, dealing two instances of Geo DMG, with the second damage instance being considered Lunar-Crystallize Reaction DMG.
When cast, if Zibai is in the **Lunar Phase Shift**, the duration of the current Lunar Phase Shift will extend by an additional 1.7s.
talents.descriptionId:
Zibai memanggil Jadelight Canopy untuk mengakibatkan dua kali Geo DMG. DMG tahap kedua dianggap sebagai DMG reaksi Lunar-Crystallize.
Jika Zibai melancarkan skill ini saat berada dalam mode **Lunar Phase Shift**, maka durasi Lunar Phase Shift ini akan diperpanjang 1,7 detik.

passives.name: The Selenic Adeptus Descends
passives.description: When casting the Elemental Skill **Heaven and Earth Made Manifest**, or when nearby party members trigger Moondrift Harmony, Zibai gains the Selenic Descent effect for 4s: The DMG dealt by the 2nd hit of **Spirit Steed's Stride** is increased by 60% of Zibai's DEF.
passives.descriptionId: Saat melancarkan Elemental Skill **Heaven and Earth Made Manifest**, atau saat Karakter party di sekitar memicu Moondrift Harmony, Zibai akan mendapatkan efek Selenic Descent yang bertahan 4 detik: DMG serangan tahap 2 **Spirit Steed's Stride** meningkat sebesar 60% DEF Zibai.

passives.name: Layered Peaks Pierce the Clouds
passives.description: Other Geo party members increase Zibai's DEF by 15% each. Hydro party members increase her Elemental Mastery by 60 each.
passives.descriptionId: Untuk setiap 1 Karakter Geo lain di party, DEF Zibai akan meningkat 15%. Untuk setiap Karakter Hydro lain di party, Elemental Mastery Zibai akan meningkat 60 poin.

passives.name: Moonsign Benediction: The Coursing Sun and Moon
passives.description:
When a party member triggers a Hydro Crystallize reaction, it will be converted into the Lunar-Crystallize reaction, with every 100 DEF that Zibai has increasing Lunar-Crystallize's Base DMG by 0.7%, up to a maximum of 14%.

Additionally, when Zibai is in the party, the party's Moonsign will increase by 1 level.
passives.descriptionId:
Saat Karakter dalam party memicu reaksi Hydro Crystallize, reaksi tersebut akan dikonversi menjadi Lunar-Crystallize. Untuk setiap 100 poin DEF Zibai, DMG dasar reaksi Lunar-Crystallize meningkat 0,7%, dengan maksimum 14% peningkatan yang bisa didapatkan dengan cara ini.

Selain itu, saat Zibai ada di dalam party, Moonsign party akan meningkat 1 level.

passives.name: Moonlit Flower Forest
passives.description:
At night (18:00 – 06:00), when not in combat, restore 1 Elemental Energy to Zibai every 2 seconds.
This effect does not work in Domains, Trounce Domains, or the Spiral Abyss.
passives.descriptionId:
Saat tidak dalam kondisi bertempur di malam hari (pukul 18:00 - 06:00), Zibai akan memulihkan 1 Energy setiap 2 detik.

Efek ini tidak aktif dalam Domain, Trounce Domain, atau Spiral Abyss

constellations.name: Burst Forth With Vigor, But Enter in Silence
constellations.description:
After using the Elemental Skill **Heaven and Earth Made Manifest**, Zibai will immediately gain 100 **Phase Shift Radiance**, and the max number of Spirit Steed's Stride usages per Lunar Phase Shift mode is increased to 5 times.
Additionally, each time you switch to the Lunar Phase Shift mode, the first Spirit Steed's Stride's 2nd-hit Lunar-Crystallize Reaction DMG is increased by 220%.
constellations.descriptionId:
Setelah melancarkan Elemental Skill **Heaven and Earth Made Manifest**, Zibai akan langsung mengakumulasi 100 poin **Phase Shift Radiance**, dan jumlah penggunaan maksimum Spirit Steed's Stride di setiap mode Lunar Phase Shift meningkat menjadi 5 kali.
Selain itu, saat pertama kali memicu Spirit Steed's Stride setiap berganti ke mode Lunar Phase Shift, DMG reaksi Lunar-Crystallize yang diakibatkan oleh serangan tahap kedua Spirit Steed's Stride akan meningkat 220%.

constellations.name: At Birth Are Souls Born, and in Death Leave But Husks
constellations.description:
When in the **Lunar Phase Shift** mode, all nearby party members' Lunar-Crystallize Reaction DMG is increased by 30%.

Moonsign: Ascendant Gleam: Ascension Talent **The Selenic Adeptus Descends** is enhanced: the DMG dealt by the 2nd hit of Spirit Steed's Stride is further increased by 550% of Zibai's DEF. You must first unlock the Ascension Talent "The Selenic Adeptus Descends."
constellations.descriptionId:
Saat dalam mode **Lunar Phase Shift**, DMG reaksi Lunar-Crystallize yang diakibatkan seluruh anggota party di sekitar meningkat 30%.

Moonsign: Ascendant Gleam: Talenta Ascension **The Selenic Adeptus Descends** mendapatkan peningkatan: DMG serangan tahap 2 Spirit Steed's Stride meningkat lagi sebesar 550% DEF Zibai. Harus membuka Talenta Ascension "The Selenic Adeptus Descends" terlebih dahulu.

constellations.name: Free From Constraints and Worldly Ties
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Elemental Skill **Heaven and Earth Made Manifest** by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.descriptionId:
Meningkatkan 3 level Elemental Skill **Heaven and Earth Made Manifest**.
Maksimum: Lv. 15.

constellations.name: The Spirit Passes, Then Form Follows
constellations.description: While in the **Lunar Phase Shift** mode, Zibai's Normal Attack sequence will not reset, and when Spirit Steed's Stride hits opponents, Zibai will gain the "Scattermoon Splendor" effect: The next time she uses Normal Attacks, the additional attack from her 4th hit will deal 250% of the original damage as Lunar-Crystallize Reaction DMG.
constellations.descriptionId: Saat berada dalam mode **Lunar Phase Shift**, urutan serangan Normal Attack Zibai tidak akan direset, dan saat Spirit Steed's Stride mengenai musuh, Zibai akan mendapatkan efek Scattermoon Splendor: Saat melancarkan Normal Attack berikutnya, serangan tambahan di tahap ke-4 akan mengakibatkan DMG Lunar-Crystallize sebesar 250% DMG awal.

constellations.name: Perceive the Worthless and Debate It Not
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of **Tri-Sphere Eminence** by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.descriptionId:
Meningkatkan 3 level Elemental Burst **Tri-Sphere Eminence**.
Maksimum: Lv. 15.

constellations.name: The World, A Journey in Passing
constellations.description:
While Zibai is in the **Lunar Phase Shift** mode, her Phase Shift Radiance gain rate is increased by 50%.
Additionally, Spirit Steed's Stride will change such that it will consume all Phase Shift Radiance. This will **elevate** the DMG dealt by this instance of Spirit Steed's Stride and the Lunar-Crystallize Reaction DMG dealt by Zibai within the next 3s by 1.6% for every point consumed above 70. This effect cannot stack.
constellations.descriptionId:
Saat berada dalam mode **Lunar Phase Shift**, efisiensi pengumpulan Phase Shift Radiance Zibai akan meningkat 50%.
Selain itu, Spirit Steed's Stride akan langsung mengonsumsi seluruh Phase Shift Radiance yang dimiliki. Untuk setiap 1 poin Phase Shift Radiance di atas 70 poin yang terkonsumsi, DMG Spirit Steed's Stride dan DMG reaksi Lunar-Crystallize yang diakibatkan oleh Zibai selama 3 detik ke depan akan **bertumbuh** 1,6%. Efek ini tidak dapat ditumpuk.

name: Aino
title: Clinky-Clank Gadgets-A-Gogo
description: A genius mechanic and inventor from Nod-Krai who loves interesting machines and sweet treats.
descriptionId: Mekanik Jenius Nod-Krai yang suka makanan manis dan mesin-mesin menarik.

talents.name: Bish-Bash-Bosh Repair
talents.description:
Normal Attack
Performs up to 3 consecutive strikes.

Charged Attack
Drains Stamina over time to perform continuous spinning attacks against all nearby opponents.
At the end of the sequence, performs a more powerful slash. 

Plunging Attack
Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground below, damaging opponents along the path and dealing AoE DMG upon impact.
talents.descriptionId:
Normal Attack
Melancarkan hingga 3 serangan berturut-turut.

Charged Attack
Terus menguras Stamina untuk melancarkan serangan berputar yang mengakibatkan DMG ke musuh di sekitar.
Diakhiri dengan sebuah tebasan yang kuat.

Plunging Attack
Menerjang dari udara untuk menghantam tanah, menyerang musuh di jalur terjangan, dan mengakibatkan DMG Area saat mendarat.

talents.name: Musecatcher
talents.description:
Aino throws a Musecatcher forward, dealing Hydro DMG and dragging her along behind it. When the dragging stops, Aino deals AoE Hydro DMG to nearby opponents.
Holding the Skill will cause it to behave differently.

Hold
Enter Aiming Mode to adjust the Musecatcher's throwing direction.
talents.descriptionId:
Aino melemparkan Musecatcher yang menarik dirinya sendiri ke arah depan dan mengakibatkan Hydro DMG. Saat gerakannya berakhir, Aino akan mengakibatkan Hydro DMG Area terhadap musuh di sekitar.
Saat ditahan, akan melancarkan serangan dengan cara yang berbeda.

Tahan
Memasuki Mode Membidik untuk menyesuaikan arah pelemparan Musecatcher.

talents.name: Precision Hydronic Cooler
talents.description:
Aino deploys a custom water-spraying device, the Cool Your Jets Ducky to establish a Focused Hydronic Cooling Zone.
While active, the Cool Your Jets Ducky will periodically fire water balls at nearby opponents, dealing Hydro DMG.
talents.descriptionId:
Melemparkan mekanisme penembak air super Cool Your Jets Ducky untuk menghasilkan Focused Hydronic Cooling Zone.
Selama durasi ini, Cool Your Jets Ducky akan terus menembakkan peluru air ke musuh di sekitar secara berkala dan mengakibatkan Hydro DMG.

passives.name: Modular Efficiency Protocol
passives.description:
Aino will be granted the corresponding buff effects based on the party's Moonsign.

Moonsign: Ascendant Gleam: Her Elemental Burst **Precision Hydronic Cooler** is enhanced: The Cool Your Jets Ducky will fire water balls more frequently, and the water balls will deal AoE Hydro DMG over a larger area of effect.
passives.descriptionId:
Aino mendapatkan efek penguatan yang berbeda berdasarkan Moonsign milik party:

Moonsign: Ascendant Gleam: Elemental Burst **Precision Hydronic Cooler** akan mendapatkan penguatan: Cool Your Jets Ducky akan menembakkan Water Ball dengan jeda waktu lebih singkat dan mengakibatkan Hydro DMG Area dengan radius yang lebih luas.

passives.name: Structured Power Booster
passives.description: Aino's Elemental Burst DMG is increased by 50% of her Elemental Mastery.
passives.descriptionId: DMG Elemental Burst Aino meningkat sebesar 50% dari Elemental Mastery Aino.

passives.name: Moonsign Benediction: Force Limit Analysis
passives.description: When Aino is in the party, the party's Moonsign will increase by 1 level.
passives.descriptionId: Saat Aino berada di dalam party, Moonsign party meningkat 1 level.

passives.name: Miniaturized Detection Sensor
passives.description:
Displays the location of nearby resources unique to Nod-Krai on the mini-map.
Additionally, Aino appears to be able to alter the Cool Your Jets Ducky's appearance in some way...
passives.descriptionId:
Memperlihatkan lokasi produk khas Nod-Krai di sekitar pada peta kecil.
Selain itu, Aino sepertinya dapat mengubah penampilan "Cool Your Jets Ducky" dengan cara tertentu ....

constellations.name: The Theory of Ash—Field Equilibrium
constellations.description:
After Aino uses her Elemental Skill **Musecatcher** or her Elemental Burst **Precision Hydronic Cooler**, her Elemental Mastery will be increased by 80. The Elemental Mastery of other nearby active party members will be increased by 80 for 15s.

The Elemental Mastery-increasing effects of this Constellation do not stack.
constellations.descriptionId:
Setelah Aino melancarkan Elemental Skill **Musecatcher** atau Elemental Burst **Precision Hydronic Cooler**, Elemental Mastery Aino dan Karakter aktif lainnya di sekitar meningkat 80 poin selama 15 detik.

Efek peningkatan Elemental Mastery dari Konstelasi ini tidak dapat ditumpuk.

constellations.name: The Principle of Transference in Gear Differentials
constellations.description: If Aino is off-field while the Focused Hydronic Cooling Zone of her Elemental Burst **Precision Hydronic Cooler** is active, when your active party member hits a nearby opponent with an attack, the Cool Your Jets Ducky will fire an additional water ball at that opponent, dealing AoE Hydro DMG equal to 25% of Aino's ATK and 100% of her Elemental Mastery. This DMG is considered Elemental Burst DMG. This effect can be triggered once every 5s.
constellations.descriptionId: Selama durasi **Focused Hydronic Cooling Zone** dari Elemental Burst Precision Hydronic Cooler aktif, jika Aino ada di dalam party namun sedang tidak berada di medan pertempuran, saat serangan Karakter aktif party sendiri mengenai musuh, Cool Your Jets Ducky akan menembakkan satu Water Ball tambahan terhadap musuh ini, mengakibatkan Hydro DMG Area sebesar 25% ATK Aino dan 100% Elemental Mastery Aino. Efek ini dapat terpicu sekali setiap 5 detik, dan dianggap sebagai DMG Elemental Burst.

constellations.name: Cake and the Art of Mechanism Repair
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of **Precision Hydronic Cooler** by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.descriptionId:
Meningkatkan 3 level Elemental Burst **Precision Hydronic Cooler**.
Maksimum: Lv. 15.

constellations.name: Butter and Cats and the Law of Energy Supply
constellations.description: When the Elemental Skill **Musecatcher** hits an opponent, it will restore 10 Elemental Energy for Aino. Energy can be restored to her in this manner once every 10s.
constellations.descriptionId: Saat Elemental Skill **Musecatcher** mengenai musuh, akan memulihkan 10 poin Energy Aino. Pemulihan Energy dengan cara ini dapat terpicu sekali setiap 10 detik.

constellations.name: Perpetual Turbine of Metal and Light
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of **Musecatcher** by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.descriptionId:
Meningkatkan 3 level Elemental Skill **Musecatcher**.
Maksimum: Lv. 15.

constellations.name: The Burden of Creative Genius
constellations.description:
For the next 15s after using the Elemental Burst **Precision Hydronic Cooler**, DMG from nearby active characters' Electro-Charged, Bloom, Lunar-Charged, Lunar-Bloom, and Lunar-Crystallize reactions is increased by 15%.
Moonsign: Ascendant Gleam: DMG from the aforementioned reactions will be further increased by 20%.
constellations.descriptionId:
Setelah melancarkan Elemental Burst **Precision Hydronic Cooler**, DMG reaksi Electro-Charged, Bloom, Lunar-Charged, Lunar-Bloom, Lunar-Crystallize yang dipicu Karakter aktif di sekitar meningkat 15% selama 15 detik.
Moonsign: Ascendant Gleam: Peningkatan DMG reaksi dari efek di atas meningkat 20% lagi.

name: Alyosha
title: Swift-Striding Hound
description: A "professional hunter" and master of the Snezhnayan snowfields. A fierce, distinct "idealism" burns beneath his calm demeanor.
descriptionId: Seorang "pemburu profesional" yang mahir menjelajah hamparan salju Snezhnaya. Di balik sikapnya yang tenang, berkobar sebuah "idealisme" yang membara.

talents.name: Skirmishing Spear
talents.description:
Normal Attack
Performs up to 4 consecutive spear strikes and applies the **Hunter's Mark** to the opponent hit by the final strike.

Charged Attack
Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to lunge forward, dealing damage to opponents in his path.

Plunging Attack
Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground below, damaging opponents along the path and dealing AoE DMG upon impact.
talents.descriptionId:
Normal Attack
Melancarkan hingga 4 serangan tombak berturut-turut dan memberikan efek **Hunter's Mark** terhadap musuh yang terkena serangan terakhir.

Charged Attack
Mengonsumsi sejumlah Stamina dan menerjang ke depan, mengakibatkan DMG terhadap musuh di sepanjang jalur.

Plunging Attack
Menerjang dari udara untuk menghantam tanah, menyerang musuh di jalur terjangan dan mengakibatkan DMG area saat mendarat.

talents.name: Thunderbolt Strike
talents.description:
Follows his hunter's instincts. Tap or hold to produce different effects as well as apply the **Hunter's Mark** effect to the hit opponents.

Tapping
Fires at opponents in front of him, dealing AoE Electro DMG.

Holding
Enters aiming mode, then targets opponents within a certain area in front of him. Alyosha's Interruption RES is enhanced when in this mode.
At the end of the button hold, he deals Electro DMG to the targeted opponents.
talents.descriptionId:
Dengan mengikuti naluri pemburu, efek yang dihasilkan akan berbeda berdasarkan Mode Tekan atau Mode Tahan, dan akan memberikan efek **Hunter's Mark** terhadap musuh yang terkena.

Mode Tekan
Menembak ke depan dan mengakibatkan Electro DMG Area.

Mode Tahan
Memasuki mode membidik dan memilih musuh dalam jangkauan tertentu di arah depan, meningkatkan ketahanan terhadap interupsi Alyosha selama mode ini berlangsung.
Saat Mode Tahan berakhir, mengakibatkan Electro DMG terhadap musuh yang dipilih.

talents.name: Hunter's Advance
talents.description:
Summons his trusted companion Tugarin to fight alongside him on the field. This also turns an area in front of him into a Fulgurite Hunting Field for a short time.

Fulgurite Hunting Field
· Continuously taunts nearby opponents to incite them to attack.
· Every 2s, deals an instance of AoE Electro DMG to any opponent that enters the field.

Tugarin
· If there are any opponents nearby, Tugarin will quickly move close to an opponent and maul them every 2s, dealing Electro DMG.
· If an opponent affected by the Hunter's Mark effect is hit, the Hunter's Mark will also be activated.
· Where there are multiple opponents, Tugarin will attack those affected by the Hunter's Mark effect first.
talents.descriptionId:
Memanggil sahabat setianya Tugarin untuk bertarung bersama dan mengubah area di depan menjadi Fulgurite Hunting Field untuk sementara.

Fulgurite Hunting Field
·Terus-menerus memprovokasi musuh di sekitarnya untuk menarik serangan musuh.
·Setiap 2 detik, mengakibatkan Electro DMG Area terhadap musuh yang memasuki area tersebut.

Tugarin
·Jika ada musuh di sekitar, Tugarin akan bergerak cepat untuk mendekati salah satu musuh dan menggigitnya setiap 2 detik, mengakibatkan Electro DMG.
·Jika musuh yang diserang sedang berada dalam efek Hunter's Mark, maka efek Hunter's Mark ini juga akan diaktifkan.
·Tugarin akan memprioritaskan serangan pada musuh yang sedang dalam efek Hunter's Mark.

passives.name: Awakened by the Baying Hounds
passives.description: When **Tugarin** attacks, it will also restore HP to nearby active characters at 120% of Alyosha's ATK.
passives.descriptionId: Saat **Tugarin** menyerang, ia juga akan memulihkan HP Karakter aktif party di sekitar sebesar 120% dari ATK Alyosha.

passives.name: Suffer the Winter Wheat Will
passives.description: Increases the DMG Alyosha deals with his Elemental Skill and Elemental Burst by 0.35% for every 1% of his Energy Recharge. Up to a 70% increase can be obtained in this way.
passives.descriptionId: Meningkatkan DMG yang diakibatkan oleh Elemental Skill dan Elemental Burst Alyosha berdasarkan Energy Recharge Alyosha: Setiap 1% Energy Recharge akan meningkatkan DMG ini sebesar 0,35% hingga maksimum 70%.

passives.name: Into the Fray
passives.description:
Alyosha will enter the Radiance: Stellar-Conduct state when inside a **Polestar Field**.
Radiance: Stellar-Conduct: The Hunter's Precision effect obtained when the **Hunter's Mark** is activated will also increase Stellar-Conduct reaction DMG dealt by the character when on the field by 20%.
passives.descriptionId:
Alyosha akan memasuki status Radiance: Stellar-Conduct saat berada di dalam **Polestar Field**.
Radiance: Stellar-Conduct: Efek Hunter's Precision yang diperoleh saat mengaktifkan **Hunter's Mark** juga akan meningkatkan 20% DMG reaksi Stellar-Conduct yang diakibatkan Karakter yang berada di medan pertempuran.

passives.name: Treetop Watch
passives.description: Displays the location of nearby resources unique to Snezhnaya on the mini-map, and this effect also applies in the Shadow Realm.
passives.descriptionId: Memperlihatkan lokasi produk khas Snezhnaya di sekitar pada peta kecil, juga bisa memberikan efek bantuan yang sama di Alam Bayangan.

constellations.name: Frostvale Thunderclap
constellations.description: Alyosha regenerates 15 Elemental Energy when nearby party members trigger an Electro-related reaction on an opponent. This effect can trigger once every 18s.
constellations.descriptionId: Setelah Karakter party di sekitar memicu reaksi terkait Electro terhadap musuh, akan memulihkan 15 poin Energy untuk Alyosha. Efek ini dapat terpicu maksimal sekali setiap 18 detik.

constellations.name: Howl From Afar
constellations.description:
The duration of the Elemental Burst Hunter's Advance is extended by 6s.
Additionally, each time **Tugarin** attacks the opponent, he will also apply the **Hunter's Mark** to a target. This effect does not activate existing Hunter's Marks.
constellations.descriptionId:
Durasi Elemental Burst Hunter's Advance diperpanjang 6 detik.
Selain itu, sebelum setiap kali **Tugarin** menyerang musuh, ia juga akan memberikan efek **Hunter's Mark** terhadap satu target. Efek ini tidak akan mengaktifkan Hunter's Mark yang sudah ada.

constellations.name: Friendly Call
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of the Elemental Skill Thunderbolt Strike by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.descriptionId:
Meningkatkan 3 level Elemental Skill Thunderbolt Strike.
Maksimum: Lv. 15.

constellations.name: Harvest the Spoils
constellations.description: When **Tugarin** attacks, he will also restore 60% of Alyosha's ATK as HP to the nearby party member with the lowest HP by percentage.
constellations.descriptionId: Saat **Tugarin** menyerang, ia juga akan memulihkan HP anggota party terdekat dengan persentase HP terendah sebesar 60% ATK Alyosha.

constellations.name: When the Nightbird Falls Silent
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of the Elemental Burst Hunter's Advance by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.descriptionId:
Meningkatkan 3 level Elemental Burst Hunter's Advance.
Maksimum: Lv. 15.

constellations.name: Standard Reclaimed
constellations.description: The Hunter's Precision effect obtained from activating a **Hunter's Mark** can now stack, max 2 stacks. When the stack count reaches 2, characters affected by Hunter's Precision will also have their Elemental Mastery increased by 100 if they are on the field.
constellations.descriptionId: Efek Hunter's Precision yang diperoleh saat mengaktifkan **Hunter's Mark** kini dapat ditumpuk, hingga 2 lapis. Saat ditumpuk hingga 2 lapis, Elemental Mastery Karakter aktif yang terpengaruh Hunter's Precision akan meningkat 100 poin.

name: Amber
title: Gliding Champion
description: Always energetic and full of life, Amber's the best — albeit only — Outrider of the Knights of Favonius.
descriptionId: Gadis periang yang selalu penuh semangat. Amber adalah Outrider terbaik (dan juga satu-satunya) di Knights of Favonius.

talents.name: Sharpshooter
talents.description:
Normal Attack
Performs up to 5 consecutive shots with a bow.

Charged Attack
Performs a more precise Aimed Shot with increased DMG.
While aiming, flames will accumulate on the arrowhead. A fully charged flaming arrow will deal Pyro DMG.

Plunging Attack
Fires off a shower of arrows in mid-air before falling and striking the ground, dealing AoE DMG upon impact.
talents.descriptionId:
Normal Attack
Melancarkan hingga 5 serangan berturut-turut menggunakan busur.

Charged Attack
Melancarkan sebuah Serangan Membidik yang lebih akurat dengan DMG lebih besar.
Saat membidik, api akan berkumpul di ujung anak panah. Panah dengan api yang terkumpul penuh akan mengakibatkan Pyro DMG.

Plunging Attack
Melancarkan hujan panah dari udara dan menerjang tanah dengan kecepatan tinggi, mengakibatkan DMG Area saat mendarat.

talents.name: Explosive Puppet
talents.description:
The ever-reliable Baron Bunny takes the stage.

Baron Bunny
·Continuously taunts the enemy, drawing their fire.
·Baron Bunny's HP scales with Amber's Max HP.
·When destroyed or when its timer expires, Baron Bunny explodes, dealing AoE Pyro DMG.

Hold
Adjusts the throwing direction of Baron Bunny.
The longer the button is held, the further the throw.
talents.descriptionId:
Memanggil si Baron Bunny yang selalu dapat diandalkan.

Baron Bunny
·Terus menarik perhatian musuh dan mengalihkan serangan mereka.
·HP Baron Bunny didasarkan pada persentase tertentu dari Max HP Amber.
·Saat dihancurkan atau durasi skill habis, Baron Bunny akan meledak dan mengakibatkan Pyro DMG Area.

Mode Tahan
Mengatur arah lemparan Baron Bunny.
Semakin lama tombolnya ditahan, semakin jauh juga jarak lemparannya.

talents.name: Fiery Rain
talents.description: Fires off a shower of arrows, dealing continuous AoE Pyro DMG.
talents.descriptionId: Menembakkan hujan panah untuk mengakibatkan Pyro DMG Area.

passives.name: Every Arrow Finds Its Target
passives.description: Increases the CRIT Rate of Fiery Rain by 10% and widens its AoE by 30%.
passives.descriptionId: Meningkatkan 10% CRIT Rate skillFiery Rain dan memperluas area efek skill sebesar 30%.

passives.name: Precise Shot
passives.description: Aimed Shot hits on weak points increase ATK by 15% for 10s.
passives.descriptionId: Meningkatkan 15% ATK selama 10 detik saat Serangan Membidik mengenai titik lemah musuh.

passives.name: Gliding Champion
passives.description:
Decreases gliding Stamina consumption for your own party members by 20%.
Not stackable with Passive Talents that provide the exact same effects.
passives.descriptionId:
Mengurangi 20% konsumsi Stamina Karakter party sendiri saat meluncur.
Efek ini tidak dapat ditumpuk dengan Talenta Pasif lain dengan efek yang sama persis.

constellations.name: One Arrow to Rule Them All
constellations.description: Fires 2 arrows per Aimed Shot. The second arrow deals 20% of the first arrow's DMG.
constellations.descriptionId: Amber akan menembakkan 2 anak panah saat menggunakan Serangan Membidik. Anak panah kedua mengakibatkan DMG sebesar 20% dari DMG anak panah pertama.

constellations.name: Bunny Triggered
constellations.description:
Baron Bunny, new and improved! Hitting Baron Bunny's foot with a fully-charged Aimed Shot manually detonates it.
Explosion via manual detonation deals 200% additional DMG.
constellations.descriptionId:
Baron Bunny, kini hadir dengan lebih canggih! Menyerang kaki Baron Bunny dengan Serangan Membidik yang terisi penuh akan langsung meledakkan Baron Bunny.
Meledakkan Baron Bunny dengan cara ini akan mengakibatkan 200% DMG tambahan.

constellations.name: It Burns!
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Fiery Rain by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.descriptionId:
Meningkatkan 3 level Fiery Rain.
Maksimum: Lv. 15.

constellations.name: It's Not Just Any Doll...
constellations.description: Decreases Explosive Puppet's CD by 20%. Adds 1 additional charge.
constellations.descriptionId: Mengurangi 20% waktu cooldown skill Explosive Puppet dan menambah jumlah penggunaannya 1 kali.

constellations.name: It's Baron Bunny!
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Explosive Puppet by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.descriptionId:
Meningkatkan 3 level Explosive Puppet.
Maksimum: Lv. 15.

constellations.name: Wildfire
constellations.description: Fiery Rain increases all party members' Movement SPD by 15% and ATK by 15% for 10s.
constellations.descriptionId: Melancarkan Fiery Rain akan meningkatkan 15% Movement SPD dan 15% ATK milik seluruh anggota party selama 10 detik.

name: Barbara
title: Shining Idol
description: Every citizen of Mondstadt adores Barbara. She learned the word "idol" from a magazine.
descriptionId: Setiap penduduk Mondstadt mendambakan Barbara. Tetapi kata "idola" yang melekat padanya, dia hanya melihatnya dari majalah.

talents.name: Whisper of Water
talents.description:
Normal Attack
Performs up to 4 water splash attacks that deal Hydro DMG.

Charged Attack
Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to deal AoE Hydro DMG after a short casting time.

Plunging Attack
Gathering the might of Hydro, Barbara plunges towards the ground from mid-air, damaging all opponents in her path. Deals AoE Hydro DMG upon impact with the ground.
talents.descriptionId:
Normal Attack
Melancarkan hingga 4 serangan air yang mengakibatkan Hydro DMG.

Charged Attack
Mengonsumsi sejumlah Stamina untuk mengakibatkan Hydro DMG Area setelah jeda singkat.

Plunging Attack
Mengumpulkan kekuatan Hydro dan menerjang tanah, menyerang musuh di jalur terjangan dan mengakibatkan Hydro DMG Area saat mendarat.

talents.name: Let the Show Begin♪
talents.description:
Summons water droplets resembling musical notes that form a Melody Loop, dealing Hydro DMG to surrounding opponents and applying the Wet status to them.

Melody Loop
·On hit, Barbara's Normal Attacks heal your own party members and nearby teammates for a certain amount of HP, which scales with Barbara's Max HP.
·On hit, Barbara's Charged Attack generates 4 times the amount of healing.
·Periodically regenerates your own active character's HP.
·Applies the Wet status to the character and to opponents who come in contact with them.

talents.name: Shining Miracle♪
talents.description: Heals your own party members and nearby teammates for a large amount of HP that scales with Barbara's Max HP.
talents.descriptionId: Memulihkan HP Karakter teman dan seluruh anggota party dalam jumlah besar, jumlah HP yang dipulihkan berdasarkan pada Max HP Barbara.

passives.name: Glorious Season
passives.description: The Stamina Consumption of characters within Let the Show Begin♪'s Melody Loop is reduced by 12%.
passives.descriptionId: Mengurangi 12% konsumsi Stamina Karakter yang berada dalam Melody Loop dari skill Let the Show Begin♪.

passives.name: Encore
passives.description:
When your active character gains an Elemental Orb/Particle, the duration of the Melody Loop of Let the Show Begin♪ is extended by 1s.
The maximum extension is 5s.
passives.descriptionId:
Setiap kali karakter yang sedang digunakan mengambil Elemental Orb/Particle, akan memperpanjang durasi Melody Loop dari skill Let the Show Begin♪ selama 1 detik.
Penambahan durasi maksimum adalah 5 detik.

passives.name: With My Whole Heart♪
passives.description: When a Perfect Cooking is achieved on a dish with restorative effects, there is a 12% chance to obtain double the product.
passives.descriptionId: Saat masakan jenis pemulihan dimasak dengan sempurna, memiliki 12% kemungkinan mendapatkan hasil 2 kali lipat.

constellations.name: Gleeful Songs
constellations.description: Barbara regenerates 1 Energy every 10s.
constellations.descriptionId: Memulihkan 1 Energy Barbara setiap 10 detik.

constellations.name: Vitality Burst
constellations.description:
Decreases the CD of Let the Show Begin♪ by 15%.
During the ability's duration, your active character gains a 15% Hydro DMG Bonus.
constellations.descriptionId:
Mengurangi 15% CD Let the Show Begin♪.
Selama durasi skill, Karakter aktif akan mendapatkan 15% Hydro DMG Bonus.

constellations.name: Star of Tomorrow
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Shining Miracle♪ by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.descriptionId:
Meningkatkan 3 level Shining Miracle♪.
Maksimum: Lv. 15.

constellations.name: Attentiveness Be My Power
constellations.description:
Every opponent Barbara hits with her Charged Attack regenerates 1 Energy for her.
A maximum of 5 energy can be regenerated in this manner with any one Charged Attack.
constellations.descriptionId:
Setiap kali Barbara menyerang musuh dengan Charged Attack akan memulihkan 1 Energy.
Paling banyak dapat memulihkan 5 Energy dengan cara ini setiap kalinya.

constellations.name: The Purest Companionship
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Let the Show Begin♪ by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.descriptionId:
Meningkatkan 3 level Let the Show Begin♪.
Maksimum: Lv. 15.

constellations.name: Dedicating Everything to You
constellations.description:
When Barbara is in the party but not on the field, and one of your own party members falls:
·Automatically revives the fallen character.
·Fully restores the revived character's HP to 100%.
This effect can only occur once every 15 mins.
constellations.descriptionId:
Ketika Barbara ada dalam party namun sedang tidak berada di medan pertempuran, dan salah seorang anggota party gugur:
Secara otomatis akan menghidupkan kembali Karakter gugur tersebut;
·Dan memulihkan HP Karakter tersebut hingga 100%.
Efek ini dapat terpicu setiap 15 menit.

name: Beidou
title: Uncrowned Lord of the Ocean
description: Captain of her crew, The Crux. She's quite an unbound and forthright woman.
descriptionId: Pemimpin dari armada laut Crux Fleet. Bos wanita yang tegas dan berpendirian teguh.

talents.name: Oceanborne
talents.description:
Normal Attack
Performs up to 5 consecutive strikes.

Charged Attack
Drains Stamina over time to perform continuous slashes.
At the end of the sequence, performs a more powerful slash.

Plunging Attack
Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground, damaging opponents along the path and dealing AoE DMG upon impact.
talents.descriptionId:
Normal Attack
Melancarkan hingga 5 serangan berturut-turut.

Charged Attack
Terus menguras Stamina untuk melancarkan tebasan berkelanjutan.
Diakhiri dengan sebuah tebasan yang kuat.

Plunging Attack
Menerjang dari udara untuk menghantam tanah, menyerang semua musuh di jalurnya dan mengakibatkan DMG area saat mendarat.

talents.name: Tidecaller
talents.description:
Nothing to worry about. Should anyone raise a hand against her or her men, she will avenge it ten-fold with sword and thunder.

Press
Accumulating the power of lightning, Beidou swings her blade forward fiercely, dealing Electro DMG.

Hold
Lifts her weapon up as a shield. Max DMG absorbed scales off Beidou's Max HP.
Attacks using the energy stored within the greatsword upon release or once this ability's duration expires, dealing Electro DMG. DMG dealt scales with the number of times Beidou is attacked in the skill's duration. The greatest DMG Bonus will be attained once this effect is triggered twice.
The shield possesses the following properties:
·Has 250% Electro DMG Absorption Efficiency.
·Applies the Electro element to Beidou upon activation.
talents.descriptionId:
Tidak ada yang perlu dikhawatirkan. Jika ada yang berani mengganggu Beidou atau anak buahnya, maka dia akan membalasnya sepuluh kali lipat dengan pedang dan petir.

Mode Tekan
Beidou mengumpulkan kekuatan petir dan mengayunkan pedangnya dengan garang, mengakibatkan Electro DMG.

Mode Tahan
Beidou mengangkat dan menggunakan senjatanya sebagai Perisai. Jumlah DMG maksimum yang bisa ditahan akan didasarkan pada Max HP Beidou.
Saat tombol skill dilepas atau saat durasinya selesai, Beidou akan menyerang dengan energi yang tersimpan di dalam pedang dan mengakibatkan Electro DMG.
DMG dari serangan ini akan meningkat berdasarkan jumlah serangan yang diterima selama skill berlangsung. Beidou akan mendapatkan Bonus DMG maksimum saat efek ini terpicu dua kali.
Perisai Beidou memiliki efek berikut:
·Memiliki 250% ketahanan terhadap Electro DMG.
·Memberikan efek elemen Electro kepada Beidou saat skill diaktifkan.

talents.name: Stormbreaker
talents.description:
Recalling her slaying of the great beast Haishan, Beidou calls upon that monstrous strength and the lightning to create a Thunderbeast's Targe around herself, dealing Electro DMG to nearby opponents.

Thunderbeast's Targe
·When Normal and Charged Attacks hit, they create a lightning discharge that can jump between opponents, dealing Electro DMG.
·Increases the character's resistance to interruption, and decreases DMG taken.

A maximum of 1 lightning discharge can be triggered per second.
talents.descriptionId:
Beidou mengingat kembali semangat bertarungnya saat dia menumpas monster buas Haishan, kemudian memanggil petir dan kekuatan yang luar biasa untuk menciptakan Thunderbeast's Targe di sekelilingnya, mengakibatkan Electro DMG kepada musuh di sekitarnya.

Thunderbeast's Targe
·Saat Normal dan Charged Attack mengenai musuh, akan muncul 1 sambaran petir yang dapat memantul di antara musuh-musuh dan mengakibatkan Electro DMG.
·Meningkatkan ketahanan Beidou terhadap interupsi dan mengurangi DMG yang diterima.

Sambaran petir dapat terpicu maksimum sekali setiap detik.

passives.name: Retribution
passives.description: Counterattacking with Tidecaller at the precise moment when the character is hit grants the maximum DMG Bonus.
passives.descriptionId: Membalas serangan menggunakan Tidecaller tepat saat serangan mengenai Karakter akan memberikan Bonus DMG maksimum.

passives.name: Lightning Storm
passives.description:
Gain the following effects for 10s after unleashing Tidecaller with its maximum DMG Bonus: 
·DMG dealt by Normal and Charged Attacks is increased by 15%. ATK SPD of Normal and Charged Attacks is increased by 15%.
·Greatly reduced delay before unleashing Charged Attacks.
passives.descriptionId:
Setelah melancarkan skill Tidecaller dengan Bonus DMG maksimum, Beidou akan mendapatkan efek berikut selama 10 detik:
·Meningkatkan 15% DMG yang diakibatkan oleh Normal Attack dan Charged Attack. Meningkatkan 15% ATK SPD dari Normal Attack dan Charged Attack.
·Mengurangi waktu persiapan Charged Attack secara signifikan.

passives.name: Conqueror of Tides
passives.description:
Decreases swimming Stamina consumption for your own party members by 20%.
Not stackable with Passive Talents that provide the exact same effects.
passives.descriptionId:
Mengurangi 20% konsumsi Stamina Karakter party sendiri saat berenang.
Efek ini tidak dapat ditumpuk dengan Talenta Pasif lain dengan efek yang sama persis.

constellations.name: Sea Beast's Scourge
constellations.description:
When Stormbreaker is used:
Creates a shield that absorbs up to 16% of Beidou's Max HP for 15s.
This shield absorbs Electro DMG 250% more effectively.
constellations.descriptionId:
Saat melancarkan Stormbreaker:
Membentuk Perisai yang menahan DMG sebesar 16% dari Max HP Beidou selama 15 detik.
Perisai ini juga menahan Electro DMG 250% lebih efektif.

constellations.name: Upon the Turbulent Sea, the Thunder Arises
constellations.description: Stormbreaker's arc lightning can jump to 2 additional targets.
