constellations.descriptionId: Sambaran listrik dari Stormbreaker akan memantul ke 2 musuh lebih banyak.

constellations.name: Summoner of Storm
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Tidecaller by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.descriptionId:
Meningkatkan 3 level Tidecaller.
Maksimum: Lv. 15.

constellations.name: Stunning Revenge
constellations.description: Upon being attacked, Beidou's Normal Attacks gain an additional instance of 20% Electro DMG for 10s.
constellations.descriptionId: Setelah terkena serangan, Normal Attack Beidou mendapatkan 20% Electro DMG tambahan selama 10 detik.

constellations.name: Crimson Tidewalker
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Stormbreaker by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.descriptionId:
Meningkatkan 3 level Stormbreaker.
Maksimum: Lv. 15.

constellations.name: Bane of Evil
constellations.description: During the duration of Stormbreaker, the Electro RES of surrounding opponents is decreased by 15%.
constellations.descriptionId: Selama durasi Stormbreaker, Electro RES musuh di sekitar berkurang 15%.

name: Bennett
title: Trial by Fire
description: A good-natured adventurer from Mondstadt who's unfortunately extremely unlucky.
descriptionId: Seorang petualang yang berhati baik, tetapi kerap dihantui oleh nasib yang tidak mujur.

talents.name: Strike of Fortune
talents.description:
Normal Attack
Performs up to 5 rapid strikes.

Charged Attack
Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to unleash 2 rapid sword strikes.

Plunging Attack
Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground below, damaging opponents along the path and dealing AoE DMG upon impact.
talents.descriptionId:
Normal Attack
Melancarkan hingga 5 serangan berturut-turut.

Charged Attack
Mengonsumsi sejumlah Stamina untuk melancarkan dua tebasan pedang.

Plunging Attack
Menerjang dari udara untuk menghantam tanah, menyerang musuh di jalur terjangan dan mengakibatkan DMG area saat mendarat.

talents.name: Passion Overload
talents.description:
Bennett puts all his fire and passion for adventuring into his sword. Results may vary based on how fired up he is...

Press
A single, swift flame strike that deals Pyro DMG.

Hold (Short)
Charges up, resulting in different effects when unleashed based on the Charge Level.
·Level 1: Strikes twice, dealing Pyro DMG and launching opponents.
·Level 2: Unleashes 3 consecutive attacks that deal impressive Pyro DMG, but the last attack triggers an explosion that launches both Bennett and the enemy.
Bennett takes no damage from being launched.
talents.descriptionId:
Bennett memusatkan seluruh gairah dan impiannya bertualang ke dalam pedang miliknya. Hasilnya berbeda-beda tergantung dari seberapa bersemangatnya dia...

Tekan
Sebuah ayunan berapi yang cepat, mengakibatkan Pyro DMG.

Tahan (Sesaat)
Saat ditahan, menghasilkan efek berbeda saat dilepaskan berdasarkan Level Charge.
·Charge Tahap 1: Mengayun dua kali, mengakibatkan Pyro DMG dan menghempas musuh.
·Charge Tahap 2: Mengayunkan pedang 3 kali untuk mengakibatkan Pyro DMG yang besar, tapi serangan terakhir akan memicu ledakan yang menghempas musuh dan Bennett.
Bennett tidak menerima DMG dari hempasan.

talents.name: Fantastic Voyage
talents.description:
Bennett performs a jumping attack that deals Pyro DMG, creating an Inspiration Field.

Inspiration Field
·If the health of a character within the AoE is equal to or falls below 70%, their health will continuously regenerate. The amount of HP restored scales off Bennett's Max HP.
·If the health of a character within the AoE is higher than 70%, they gain an ATK Bonus that is based on Bennett's Base ATK.
·Imbues characters within the AoE with Pyro.
talents.descriptionId:
Bennett melakukan serangan melompat, mengakibatkan Pyro DMG dan menciptakan sebuah Inspiration Field.

Inspiration Field
·Jika HP karakter di dalam lingkaran kurang dari 70%, maka HP mereka akan terus pulih. Jumlah pemulihan tergantung dari Max HP Bennett.
·Jika HP karakter di dalam lingkaran di atas 70%, dia akan mendapat Bonus ATK berdasarkan Base ATK Bennett.
·Memberikan elemen Pyro kepada karakter di dalam Inspiration Field.

passives.name: Rekindle
passives.description: Decreases Passion Overload's CD by 20%.
passives.descriptionId: Mengurangi 20% CD Passion Overload.

passives.name: Fearnaught
passives.description:
Within the area created by Fantastic Voyage, Passion Overload takes on the following effects:
·CD is reduced by 50%.
·Bennett will not be launched by the effects of Charge Level 2.
passives.descriptionId:
Saat berada di dalam area Fantastic Voyage, Passion Overload mempunyai efek berikut:
·CD berkurang 50%.
·Bennet tidak akan terlempar karena efek Charge Level 2.

passives.name: It Should Be Safe...
passives.description: When dispatched on an expedition in Mondstadt, time consumed is reduced by 25%.
passives.descriptionId: Ketika dikirim untuk melakukan ekspedisi di Mondstadt, waktu yang dibutuhkan berkurang 25%.

constellations.name: Grand Expectation
constellations.description: Fantastic Voyage's ATK increase no longer has an HP restriction, and gains an additional 20% of Bennett's Base ATK.
constellations.descriptionId: Efek peningkatan ATK dari Fantastic Voyage tidak lagi dibatasi HP, dan memiliki 20% ATK lebih besar.

constellations.name: Impasse Conqueror
constellations.description: When Bennett's HP falls below 70%, his Energy Recharge is increased by 30%.
constellations.descriptionId: Saat HP Bennett kurang dari 70%, meningkatkan 30% Energy Recharge.

constellations.name: Unstoppable Fervor
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Passion Overload by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.descriptionId:
Meningkatkan 3 level Passion Overload.
Maksimum: Lv. 15.

constellations.name: Unexpected Odyssey
constellations.description:
Using a Normal Attack as the second attack of Passion Overload's Charge Level 1 will perform a follow-up attack.
This additional attack does 135% of the second attack's DMG.
constellations.descriptionId:
Mendapatkan serangan tambahan dengan menggunakan Normal Attack saat Bennett melakukan serangan kedua dari skill Passion Overload Charge Level 1.
Serangan tambahan menghasilkan 135% dari DMG serangan kedua.

constellations.name: True Explorer
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Fantastic Voyage by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.descriptionId:
Meningkatkan 3 level Fantastic Voyage.
Maksimum: Lv. 15.

constellations.name: Fire Ventures With Me
constellations.description: Sword, Claymore, or Polearm-wielding characters inside Fantastic Voyage's radius gain a 15% Pyro DMG Bonus and their weapons are infused with Pyro.
constellations.descriptionId: Memberikan 15% Pyro DMG Bonus dan Pyro Infusion pada karakter yang menggunakan Sword, Claymore dan Polearm di dalam radius Fantastic Voyage.

name: Candace
title: Golden Vow
description: A descendant of King Deshret with an amber left eye. The defender of Aaru Village.
descriptionId: Keturunan Raja Deshret yang memiliki mata kiri berwarna kuning keemasan. Pelindung Desa Aaru.

talents.name: Gleaming Spear - Guardian Stance
talents.description:
Normal Attack
Performs up to 4 consecutive spear strikes.

Charged Attack
Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to lunge forward, dealing damage to opponents along the way.

Plunging Attack
Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground below, damaging opponents along the path and dealing AoE DMG upon impact.
talents.descriptionId:
Normal Attack
Melancarkan hingga 4 serangan tombak berturut-turut.

Charged Attack
Mengonsumsi sejumlah Stamina untuk menerjang ke depan, mengakibatkan DMG pada musuh di jalur terjangan.

Plunging Attack
Menerjang dari udara untuk menghantam tanah, menyerang musuh di jalur terjangan dan mengakibatkan DMG area saat mendarat.

talents.name: Sacred Rite: Heron's Sanctum
talents.description:
Candace's fighting style is capable of warding off an entire tide of foes.

Tap
Rushes forward with her shield, dealing Hydro DMG to opponents in front of her.

Hold
Raises her shield to block incoming attacks from nearby opponents, forming a barrier that absorbs DMG based on her Max HP and absorbs Hydro DMG 250% more effectively. This barrier lasts until the Elemental Skill is unleashed.
After holding for a certain period of time, Candace will finish charging, and when the skill button is released, the skill duration expires, or when the barrier is broken, she will perform a leaping strike that deals Hydro DMG to opponents in front of her.
talents.descriptionId:
Gaya bertempur Candace mampu menahan gelombang serbuan musuh.

Mode Tekan
Menerjang ke depan dengan tamengnya dan mengakibatkan Hydro DMG.

Mode Tahan
Mengangkat tameng untuk menahan serangan musuh di sekitar dan membuat Perisai yang dapat menyerap DMG berdasarkan Max HP Candace, Perisai juga memiliki 250% pertahanan terhadap Hydro DMG. Perisai akan terus aktif hingga Elemental Skill selesai dilancarkan.
Candace akan selesai mengisi energi setelah tombol skill ditahan sampai waktu tertentu, dan ketika tombol skill dilepaskan, durasi skill selesai, atau Perisainya hancur, Candace akan melakukan sebuah serangan melompat yang mengakibatkan Hydro DMG terhadap musuh di depannya.

talents.name: Sacred Rite: Wagtail's Tide
talents.description:
Raising her weapon on high, Candace calls upon a divine blessing that deals AoE Hydro DMG based on her Max HP and continuously confers the Prayer of the Crimson Crown on your active character.

Prayer of the Crimson Crown
This effect has the following properties:
·Characters deal increased Elemental DMG with their Normal Attacks.
·Whenever a character takes the field, they will unleash a rippling wave of water that deals Hydro DMG to nearby opponents. There is a limited number of waves that can be triggered in the duration of this skill.
·Sword, Claymore, and Polearm-wielding characters under this effect will obtain a Hydro Infusion.

passives.name: Aegis of Crossed Arrows
passives.description: If Candace is hit by an attack in the Hold duration of Sacred Rite: Heron's Sanctum, that skill will finish charging instantly.
passives.descriptionId: Jika Candace terkena serangan ketika dalam durasi Mode Tahan Skill Sacred Rite: Heron's Sanctum, maka durasi Charge Skill tersebut akan langsung selesai.

passives.name: Celestial Dome of Sand
passives.description: Characters affected by the Prayer of the Crimson Crown caused by Sacred Rite: Wagtail's Tide will deal 0.5% increased DMG to opponents for every 1,000 points of Candace's Max HP when they deal Elemental DMG with their Normal Attacks.
passives.descriptionId: Ketika Karakter berada dalam pengaruh Prayer of the Crimson Crown dari Skill Sacred Rite: Wagtail's Tide, maka untuk setiap 1000 poin Max HP yang dimiliki Candace, Elemental DMG yang diakibatkan oleh Normal Attack Karakter tersebut akan meningkat sebanyak 0.5%.

passives.name: To Dawn's First Light
passives.description:
Decreases climbing Stamina consumption for your own party members by 20%.
Not stackable with Passive Talents that provide the exact same effects.
passives.descriptionId:
Mengurangi 20% konsumsi Stamina Karakter party sendiri saat memanjat.
Efek ini tidak dapat ditumpuk dengan Talenta Pasif lain dengan efek yang sama persis.

constellations.name: Returning Heiress of the Scarlet Sands
constellations.description: The duration of Prayer of the Crimson Crown effect triggered by Sacred Rite: Wagtail's Tide is increased by 3s.
constellations.descriptionId: Durasi Prayer of the Crimson Crown yang terpicu oleh skill Sacred Rite: Wagtail's Tide bertambah 3 detik.

constellations.name: Moon-Piercing Brilliance
constellations.description: When Sacred Rite: Heron's Sanctum hits opponents, Candace's Max HP will be increased by 20% for 15s.
constellations.descriptionId: Saat Sacred Rite: Heron's Sanctum mengenai musuh, akan meningkatkan 20% Max HP Candace selama 15 detik.

constellations.name: Hunter's Supplication
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Sacred Rite: Wagtail's Tide by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.descriptionId:
Meningkatkan 3 level Sacred Rite: Wagtail's Tide.
Maksimum: Lv. 15.

constellations.name: Sentinel Oath
constellations.description: Shortens the Hold CD of Sacred Rite: Heron's Sanctum to be the same as that of the Tapping CD.
constellations.descriptionId: Mengurangi CD Mode Tahan Sacred Rite: Heron's Sanctum, menjadikannya sama dengan CD Mode Tekan.

constellations.name: Heterochromatic Gaze
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Sacred Rite: Heron's Sanctum by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.descriptionId:
Meningkatkan 3 level Sacred Rite: Heron's Sanctum.
Maksimum: Lv. 15.

constellations.name: The Overflow
constellations.description:
When characters (excluding Candace herself) affected by the Prayer of the Crimson Crown caused by Sacred Rite: Wagtail's Tide deal Elemental DMG to opponents using Normal Attacks, an attack wave will be unleashed that deals AoE Hydro DMG equal to 15% of Candace's Max HP.
This effect can trigger once every 2.3s and is considered Elemental Burst DMG.
constellations.descriptionId:
Saat Karakter (kecuali Candace sendiri) yang terpengaruh efek Prayer of the Crimson Crown yang disebabkan oleh Sacred Rite: Wagtail's Tide mengakibatkan Elemental DMG terhadap musuh dengan menggunakan Normal Attack, sebuah serangan gelombang yang mengakibatkan Hydro DMG Area yang setara dengan 15% Max HP Candace akan dilancarkan.
Efek ini dapat terpicu setiap 2,3 detik, dan DMG yang diakibatkan akan dianggap sebagai DMG Elemental Burst.

name: Charlotte
title: Lens of Verity
description: Indefatigable reporter of The Steambird, constantly on the hunt for the "truth."
descriptionId: Seorang reporter dari The Steambird yang selalu terlihat sangat bersemangat. Ia tidak pernah berhenti berlari ke sana kemari untuk mencari "kebenaran".

talents.name: Cool-Color Capture
talents.description:
Normal Attack
Taking aim at targets using Monsieur Verite, her custom Kamera, Charlotte performs up to 3 consecutive attacks, dealing Cryo DMG.

Charged Attack
Consumes a fixed amount of Stamina, and after a moment's preparation, will deploy Monsieur Verite to deal AoE Cryo DMG.

Plunging Attack
Gathering the power of Cryo, Charlotte plunges toward the ground, dealing DMG to all opponents in her path and dealing AoE Cryo DMG upon landing.

Arkhe: Pneuma
At certain intervals, upon using a Charged Attack, Charlotte will cause a Spiritbreath Thorn to descend and pierce opponents, dealing Pneuma-aligned AoE Cryo DMG.
talents.descriptionId:
Normal Attack
Menggunakan Kamera buatan khusus, "Monsieur Verite", untuk membidik target dan melancarkan maksimum 3 serangan berturut-turut dan mengakibatkan Cryo DMG.

Charged Attack
Mengonsumsi sejumlah Stamina untuk melancarkan Monsieur Verite yang mengakibatkan Cryo DMG Area setelah persiapan yang singkat.

Plunging Attack
Mengumpulkan kekuatan Cryo, menerjang dari udara untuk menghantam tanah, menyerang musuh di jalur terjangan dan mengakibatkan Cryo DMG Area saat mendarat.

Arkhe: Pneuma
Setiap satu kurun waktu tertentu, setelah Charlotte menggunakan Charged Attack, akan menurunkan Spiritbreath Thorn yang dapat menembus musuh dan mengakibatkan Pneuma-aligned Cryo DMG Area.

talents.name: Framing: Freezing Point Composition
talents.description:
Using the keen instincts of an ace reporter, Charlotte uses her photography skills to produce different effects based on whether the ability is Tapped or Held.

Tap
Takes a snapshot using Monsieur Verite, dealing AoE Cryo DMG to opponents in front of her and applying Snappy Silhouette to a maximum of 5 opponents. During this effect's duration, it will deal Cryo DMG to affected opponents at intervals.

Hold
Popping Monsieur Verite's viewfinder open, Charlotte enters Composition Mode, and during this time, the viewfinder will expand as you hold until you reach a Finisher Frame state. In this state, Charlotte can move and change direction freely.
When the hold state ends, Monsieur Verite will deal Cryo DMG to all opponents locked on within the viewfinder, and apply the same Snappy Silhouette as Tap Mode does to them. If you unleash this ability only after reaching Finisher Frame, you will instead apply Focused Impression, which lasts longer and deals more DMG, although the Skill CD will be longer.
Composition Mode lasts a maximum of 15s and allows a maximum of 5 opponents to be selected.
talents.descriptionId:
Mengumpulkan ketajaman insting dari jurnalis kondang dan melancarkan kemampuan fotografi yang menghasilkan efek yang berbeda berdasarkan cara skill dilancarkan, yaitu ditekan atau ditahan.

Mode Tekan
Mengambil foto cepat menggunakan Monsieur Verita dan mengakibatkan Cryo DMG Area terhadap musuh di depan, lalu memberikan Snappy Silhouette terhadap maksimum 5 musuh yang terkena. Selama durasi berlangsung, Snappy Silhouette akan mengakibatkan Cryo DMG terhadap musuh secara berkala.

Mode Tahan
Membuka jendela bidik Monsieur Verite dan memasuki status Composition. Selama tombol skill ditahan, jendela bidik Monsieur Verite akan terus membesar sampai mencapai status Finisher Frame. Saat berada dalam status ini, Charlotte dapat bergerak dan mengubah arah pergerakannya dengan bebas.
Saat Mode Tahan selesai, Monsieur Verite akan mengakibatkan Cryo DMG terhadap semua musuh yang terkunci di dalam jendela bidiknya, dan memberikan Snappy Silhouette yang sama dengan Mode Tekan. Jika kamu melancarkan skill ini setelah jendela bidik mencapai Finisher State, maka Snappy Silhouette akan dikonversi menjadi Focused Impression yang dapat bertahan lebih lama dan memiliki DMG yang lebih tinggi, namun Cooldown skill kali ini akan menjadi lebih lama.
Status Composition dapat berlangsung maksimum 15 detik dan dapat mengunci maksimum 5 musuh.

talents.name: Still Photo: Comprehensive Confirmation
talents.description:
Condensing ice to create The Steambird's signature, Charlotte creates a Newsflash Field that will deal AoE Cryo DMG and restores HP for all nearby party members based on Charlotte's ATK.
Newsflash Field
·While the ability is active, Monsieur Verite will deal Cryo DMG at intervals to opponents within its AoE.
·Will continuously restore HP to active character(s) within its AoE based on Charlotte's ATK.
talents.descriptionId:
Mengumpulkan embun es untuk menciptakan karakteristik The Steambird, Charlotte akan menciptakan Newsflash Field yang mengakibatkan Cryo DMG Area dan memulihkan HP seluruh anggota party di sekitar, jumlah pemulihan didasarkan pada ATK Charlotte.

Newsflash Field
·Selama durasinya berlangsung, Monsieur Verite akan menyerang musuh secara berkala dan mengakibatkan Cryo DMG.
·Selama durasinya berlangsung, akan memulihkan HP Karakter aktif yang berada di dalam jangkauannya, jumlah pemulihan didasarkan pada ATK Charlotte.

passives.name: Moment of Impact
passives.description: When opponents marked by "Focused Impression" are defeated, Framing: Freezing Point Composition's CD will be decreased by 2s. This CD decrease can be triggered 4 times every 12s.
passives.descriptionId: Saat musuh yang memiliki tanda "Focused Impression" dikalahkan, cooldown Framing: Freezing Point Composition akan berkurang 2 detik. Pengurangan cooldown Elemental Skill melalui cara ini dapat terpicu 4 kali setiap 12 detik.

passives.name: Diversified Investigation
passives.description: When the party contains 1/2/3 Fontainians other than herself, Charlotte gains a 5%/10%/15% Healing Bonus. When the party contains 1/2/3 non-Fontainians, Charlotte gains a 5%/10%/15% Cryo DMG Bonus.
passives.descriptionId: Untuk setiap 1/2/3 Karakter di dalam party yang berasal dari Fontaine (selain Charlotte sendiri), Charlotte akan mendapatkan 5%/10%/15% Bonus Pemulihan; Untuk setiap 1/2/3 Karakter di dalam party yang bukan berasal dari Fontaine, Charlotte mendapatkan 5%/10%/15% Cryo DMG Bonus.

passives.name: First-Person Shutter
passives.description: After activating the Special Analysis Zoom Lens, Charlotte's "Framing: Freezing Point Composition" Hold Mode cannot trigger its original effects, but instead enables her to take photos in a rather unique manner...
passives.descriptionId: Setelah menggunakan "Special Analysis Zoom Lens", Mode Tahan dari Elemental Skill "Framing: Freezing Point Composition" milik Charlotte tidak dapat memicu efek awalnya, tapi dapat mengambil foto dengan cara yang lebih istimewa ....

constellations.name: A Need to Verify Facts
constellations.description: After Still Photo: Comprehensive Confirmation heals a character, it will mark them with Verification, which will heal them once every 2s for 80% of Charlotte's ATK. This effect lasts 6s.
constellations.descriptionId: Setelah Still Photo: Comprehensive Confirmation memulihkan Karakter, akan memberikan tanda Verification yang akan memulihkan HP Karakter setiap 2 detik sekali. Jumlah pemulihan didasarkan pada 80% ATK Charlotte. Efek berlangsung selama 6 detik.

constellations.name: A Duty to Pursue Truth
constellations.description: When using Framing: Freezing Point Composition, when Monsieur Verite hits 1/2/3 (or more) opponents, Charlotte's own ATK will be increased by 10%/20%/30% for 12s.
constellations.descriptionId: Saat melancarkan Framing: Freezing Point Composition, saat Monsieur Verite menyerang musuh berjumlah 1/2/3 atau lebih, ATK Charlotte meningkat sebesar 10%/20%/30% selama 12 detik.

constellations.name: An Imperative to Independence
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Still Photo: Comprehensive Confirmation by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.descriptionId:
Meningkatkan 3 level Still Photo: Comprehensive Confirmation.
Maksimum: Lv. 15.

constellations.name: A Responsibility to Oversee
constellations.description: When Still Photo: Comprehensive Confirmation hits an opponent marked by Snappy Silhouette or Focused Impression, it will deal 10% more DMG and restore 2 Energy to Charlotte. This restoration can be triggered 5 times every 20s.
constellations.descriptionId: Saat Still Photo: Comprehensive Confirmation mengenai musuh yang memiliki tanda Snappy Silhouette atau Focused Impression, DMG yang diakibatkan meningkat 10%, dan akan memulihkan 2 poin Energy untuk Charlotte. Pemulihan Energy yang dapat diperoleh dengan cara ini adalah maksimum 5 kali setiap 20 detik.

constellations.name: A Principle of Conscience
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Framing: Freezing Point Composition by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.descriptionId:
Meningkatkan 3 level Framing: Freezing Point Composition.
Maksimum: Lv. 15.

constellations.name: A Summation of Interest
constellations.description: When the active character's Normal and Charged Attacks hit an opponent marked by Framing: Freezing Point Composition's Focused Impression, Monsieur Verite will initiate a coordinated attack that deals 180% of Charlotte's ATK as AoE Cryo DMG and heals active character(s) within the AoE for 42% of Charlotte's ATK. This effect can be triggered once every 6s and both DMG and healing dealt in this way will be considered as having been done by Charlotte's Elemental Burst.
constellations.descriptionId: Saat Normal Attack dan Charged Attack Karakter aktif mengenai musuh yang memiliki Focused Impression dari Framing: Freezing Point Composition, Monsieur Verite akan melancarkan serangan terkoordinasi dan mengakibatkan Cryo DMG Area sebesar 180% ATK Charlotte, lalu memulihkan HP Karakter aktif yang berada di dalam radius serangan sebesar 42% ATK Charlotte. Efek ini dapat terpicu sekali setiap 6 detik, DMG yang diakibatkan dan pemulihan yang diberikan dengan cara ini akan dianggap sebagai DMG dan pemulihan dari Elemental Burst Charlotte.

name: Chevreuse
title: Executor of Justice
description: The captain of the Special Security and Surveillance Patrol, who wears justice as an ever-present seal upon her heart. Her musket shall only ever point at the guilty.
descriptionId: Kapten Pasukan Patroli Khusus, yang telah mengukirkan "keadilan" di dalam lubuk hatinya. Senjata di tangannya hanya akan ditodongkan kepada orang yang bersalah.

talents.name: Line Bayonet Thrust EX
talents.description:
Normal Attack
Performs up to 4 consecutive spear strikes.

Charged Attack
Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to lunge forward, dealing damage to opponents along the way.

Plunging Attack
Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground below, damaging opponents along the path and dealing AoE DMG upon impact.
talents.descriptionId:
Normal Attack
Melancarkan hingga 4 serangan tombak berturut-turut.

Charged Attack
Mengonsumsi sejumlah Stamina untuk menerjang ke depan, mengakibatkan DMG pada musuh di jalur terjangan.

Plunging Attack
Menerjang dari udara untuk menghantam tanah di bawahnya, menyerang musuh di jalur terjangan dan mengakibatkan DMG area saat mendarat.

talents.name: Short-Range Rapid Interdiction Fire
talents.description:
Chevreuse quickly shoulders her musket and fires at her opponent(s), dealing AoE Pyro DMG.
For a short duration after Chevreuse fires a shot, she will continuously restore HP to your active character on the field. The amount healed is based on her Max HP.
Hold to fire in a different fashion.

Hold
Enter Aiming Mode, locking a target in her sights to fire a precise interdiction shot. If Chevreuse has an Overcharged Ball, then she will fire the Overcharged Ball instead, dealing greater Pyro DMG in a larger area.
Chevreuse gains 1 Overcharged Ball every time a nearby character in the party triggers an Overloaded reaction, and can have up to 1 Overcharged Ball at a time.

Arkhe: Ousia
Periodically, after Chevreuse's Short-Range Rapid Interdiction Fire hits, a Surging Blade will be called forth that deals Ousia-aligned Pyro DMG.
talents.descriptionId:
Chevreuse mengangkat senapannya dengan cepat untuk menembak musuh dan mengakibatkan Pyro DMG Area.
Beberapa saat setelah Chevreuse menembak, dia akan terus memulihkan HP Karakter aktif sendiri. Jumlah pemulihan didasarkan pada Max HP Chevreuse.
Saat ditahan, akan melancarkan serangan dengan cara yang berbeda.

Mode Tahan
Memasuki Mode Membidik dan mengunci target dalam bidang penglihatannya untuk menembakkan tembakan pencegat dengan akurat. Jika Chevreuse memiliki "Overcharged Ball", maka akan menembakkan "Overcharged Ball" dan mengakibatkan Pyro DMG yang memiliki radius serangan yang lebih luas dan DMG yang lebih tinggi.
Chevreuse akan mendapatkan 1 Overcharged Ball saat Karakter dalam party di sekitar memicu Reaksi Overloaded. Hanya 1 Overcharged Ball yang dapat tercipta dalam waktu bersamaan.

Arkhe: Ousia
Setiap beberapa saat setelah "Short-Range Rapid Interdiction Fire" mengenai musuh, Chevreuse akan melancarkan Surging Blade yang mengakibatkan Ousia-aligned Pyro DMG.

talents.name: Ring of Bursting Grenades
talents.description:
Chevreuse fires an explosive grenade at opponents with her musket, dealing AoE Pyro DMG. After the projectile hits, it will split into many secondary explosive shells.
The secondary explosive shells will burst after a short interval, dealing Pyro DMG to nearby opponents.
talents.descriptionId:
Chevreuse menggunakan senapannya untuk menembakkan Explosive Grenade terhadap musuh dan mengakibatkan Pyro DMG Area. Setelah mengenai musuh, Explosive Grenade akan terpecah menjadi beberapa Secondary Explosive Shell.
Secondary Explosive Shell akan meledak setelah jeda singkat dan mengakibatkan Pyro DMG terhadap musuh di sekitar.

passives.name: Vanguard's Coordinated Tactics
passives.description:
When all party members are Pyro and Electro characters and there is at least one Pyro and one Electro character each in the party:
Chevreuse grants "Coordinated Tactics" to nearby party members: After a character triggers the Overloaded reaction, the Pyro and Electro RES of the opponent(s) affected by this Overloaded reaction will be decreased by 40% for 6s.
The "Coordinated Tactics" effect will be removed when the Elemental Types of the characters in the party do not meet the basic requirements for the Ascension Talent.
passives.descriptionId:
Saat seluruh anggota party adalah Karakter Pyro dan Electro, serta terdapat minimal 1 Karakter Pyro dan 1 Karakter Electro:
Chevreuse akan memberikan "Coordinated Tactics" kepada Karakter dalam party di sekitarnya: Setelah Karakter memicu reaksi Overloaded, Pyro dan Electro RES milik target tersebut akan berkurang 40% selama 6 detik.
Saat jenis elemen Karakter di dalam party tidak cukup untuk memicu Talenta Ascension, maka efek Coordinated Tactics yang sudah dimiliki akan dihapus.

passives.name: Vertical Force Coordination
passives.description: After Chevreuse fires an Overcharged Ball using Short-Range Rapid Interdiction Fire, nearby Pyro and Electro characters in the party gain 1% increased ATK for every 1,000 Max HP Chevreuse has for 30s. ATK can be increased by up to 40% in this way.
passives.descriptionId: Setelah Chevreuse menembakkan "Overcharged Ball" dari Short-Range Rapid Interdiction Fire, ATK semua Karakter dalam party berelemen Pyro dan Electro di sekitar akan meningkat 1% untuk setiap 1.000 poin Max HP Chevreuse selama 30 detik. Peningkatan ATK maksimum yang bisa didapatkan dengan cara ini adalah 40%.

passives.name: Double Time March
passives.description:
Decreases sprinting Stamina consumption for your own party members by 20%.
Not stackable with Passive Talents that provide the exact same effects.
passives.descriptionId:
Mengurangi 20% konsumsi Stamina Karakter party sendiri saat berlari.
Efek ini tidak dapat ditumpuk dengan Talenta Pasif lain dengan efek yang sama persis.

constellations.name: Stable Front Line's Resolve
constellations.description:
When the active character with the "Coordinated Tactics" status (not including Chevreuse herself) triggers the Overloaded reaction, they will recover 6 Energy. This effect can be triggered once every 10s.
You must first unlock the Ascension Talent "Vanguard's Coordinated Tactics."
constellations.descriptionId:
Saat Karakter aktif yang berada dalam status "Coordinated Tactics" (tidak termasuk Chevreuse sendiri) memicu Reaksi Overloaded, akan memulihkan 6 Energy. Efek ini dapat terpicu sekali setiap 10 detik.
Harus membuka Talenta Ascension "Vanguard's Coordinated Tactics" terlebih dahulu.

constellations.name: Sniper Induced Explosion
constellations.description: After Holding Short-Range Rapid Interdiction Fire and hitting a target, 2 chain explosions will be triggered near the location where said target is hit. Each explosion deals Pyro DMG equal to 120% of Chevreuse's ATK. This effect can be triggered up to once every 10s, and DMG dealt this way is considered Elemental Skill DMG.
constellations.descriptionId: Setelah tembakan Short-Range Rapid Interdiction Fire dalam Mode Tahan mengenai musuh, akan memicu 2 ledakan berantai di sekitar lokasi musuh yang terkena. Setiap ledakan akan mengakibatkan Pyro DMG sebesar 120% ATK Chevreuse. Efek ini bisa terpicu sekali setiap 10 detik, dan DMG yang diakibatkan dengan cara ini akan dianggap sebagai DMG Elemental Skill.

constellations.name: Practiced Field Stripping Technique
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Short-Range Rapid Interdiction Fire by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.descriptionId:
Meningkatkan 3 level Short-Range Rapid Interdiction Fire.
Maksimum: Lv. 15.

constellations.name: The Secret to Rapid-Fire Multishots
constellations.description: After using Ring of Bursting Grenades, the Hold mode of Short-Range Rapid Interdiction Fire will not go on cooldown when Chevreuse uses it. This effect is removed after Short-Range Rapid Interdiction Fire has been fired twice using Hold or after 6s.
constellations.descriptionId: Setelah melancarkan Ring of Bursting Grenades, Mode Tahan Short-Range Rapid Interdiction Fire Chevreuse tidak akan memasuki Cooldown. Efek ini berlangsung selama 6 detik, dan akan hilang setelah melancarkan Short-Range Rapid Interdiction Fire Mode Tahan 2 kali.

constellations.name: Enhanced Incendiary Firepower
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Ring of Bursting Grenades by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.descriptionId:
Meningkatkan 3 level Ring of Bursting Grenades.
Maksimum: Lv. 15.

constellations.name: In Pursuit of Ending Evil
constellations.description:
After 12s of the healing effect from Short-Range Rapid Interdiction Fire, all nearby party members recover HP equivalent to 10% of Chevreuse's Max HP once.
After a party member is healed by Short-Range Rapid Interdiction Fire, they gain a 20% Pyro DMG Bonus and Electro DMG Bonus for 8s. Max 3 stacks. Each stack's duration is counted independently.
constellations.descriptionId:
Setelah efek pemulihan Short-Range Rapid Interdiction Fire berlangsung selama 12 detik, akan memulihkan HP seluruh anggota party di sekitar satu kali, berdasarkan 10% Max HP Chevreuse.
Karakter dalam party yang menerima pemulihan dari "Short-Range Rapid Interdiction Fire", akan mendapatkan 20% Pyro DMG Bonus dan Electro DMG Bonus selama 8 detik. Efek ini dapat ditumpuk hingga 3 lapis. Durasi setiap lapisannya terhitung secara terpisah.

name: Chongyun
title: Frozen Ardor
description: A young exorcist from a family of exorcists. He does everything he can to suppress his abundance of yang energy.
descriptionId: Anak muda pewaris klan pembasmi iblis. Dia telah melakukan segalanya yang bisa dia lakukan untuk menahan "Luapan Energi Yang" yang ada dalam dirinya.

talents.name: Demonbane
talents.description:
Normal Attack
Performs up to 4 consecutive strikes.

Charged Attack
Drains Stamina over time to perform continuous spinning attacks against all nearby opponents.
At the end of the sequence, performs a more powerful slash. 

Plunging Attack
Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground below, damaging opponents along the path and dealing AoE DMG upon impact.
talents.descriptionId:
Normal Attack Melancarkan hingga 4 tebasan berturut-turut.

Charged Attack
Terus menguras Stamina untuk melancarkan serangan berputar yang mengakibatkan DMG ke musuh di sekitar.
Diakhiri dengan sebuah tebasan yang kuat.

Plunging Attack
Menerjang dari udara untuk menghantam tanah, menyerang musuh di jalur terjangan dan mengakibatkan DMG area saat mendarat.

talents.name: Spirit Blade: Chonghua's Layered Frost
talents.description:
Chongyun strikes the ground with his greatsword, causing a Cryo explosion in a circular AoE in front of him that deals Cryo DMG.
After a short delay, the cold air created by the Cryo explosion will coalesce into a Chonghua Frost Field, within which all Sword, Claymore and Polearm-wielding characters' weapons will be infused with Cryo.
talents.descriptionId:
Chongyun menghantam tanah dengan pedangnya dan mengakibatkan ledakan Cryo dalam area melingkar di depannya, mengakibatkan Cryo DMG.
Setelah jeda singkat, udara dingin yang diciptakan oleh ledakan Cryo akan bersatu menjadi sebuah Chonghua Frost Field, dan karakter lain yang menggunakan Sword, Claymore, dan Polearm akan menerima Cryo Infusion.

talents.name: Spirit Blade: Cloud-Parting Star
talents.description:
Performing the secret hand seals, Chongyun summons 3 giant spirit blades in mid-air that fall to the earth one by one after a short delay, exploding as they hit the ground.
When the spirit blades explode, they will deal AoE Cryo DMG and launch opponents.
talents.descriptionId:
Melepas segel, Chongyun memanggil 3 pedang raksasa di tengah udara yang jatuh ke tanah dan meledak satu per satu setelah jeda pendek.
Pedangnya mengakibatkan Cryo DMG area dan menghempas musuh saat meledak.

passives.name: Steady Breathing
passives.description: Sword, Claymore, or Polearm-wielding characters within the field created by Spirit Blade: Chonghua's Layered Frost have their Normal ATK SPD increased by 8%.
passives.descriptionId: Meningkatkan 8% Normal ATK SPD karakter yang bertarung menggunakan Sword, Claymore, atau Polearm di dalam area Spirit Blade: Chonghua's Layered Frost.

passives.name: Rimechaser Blade
passives.description: When the field created by Spirit Blade: Chonghua's Layered Frost disappears, another spirit blade will be summoned to strike nearby opponents, dealing 100% of Chonghua's Layered Frost's Skill DMG as AoE Cryo DMG. Opponents hit by this blade will have their Cryo RES decreased by 10% for 8s.
passives.descriptionId: Setelah area dari Spirit Blade: Chonghua's Layered Frost menghilang, sebilah Spirit Blade baru akan muncul dan menyerang musuh di dekatnya, mengakibatkan Cryo DMG area sebesar 100% DMG Skill Chonghua's Layered Frost. Serangan ini juga akan mengurangi 10% Cryo RES musuh selama 8 detik.

passives.name: Gallant Journey
passives.description: When dispatched on an expedition in Liyue, time consumed is reduced by 25%.
passives.descriptionId: Ketika dikirim untuk melakukan ekspedisi di Liyue, waktu yang dibutuhkan berkurang 25%.

constellations.name: Ice Unleashed
constellations.description: The last attack of Chongyun's Normal Attack combo releases 3 ice blades. Each blade deals 50% of Chongyun's ATK as Cryo DMG to all opponents in its path.
constellations.descriptionId: Serangan terakhir kombo Normal Attack Chongyun akan menghasilkan 3 pedang es. Setiap pedang membuat 50% dari ATK Chongyun menjadi Cryo DMG kepada semua musuh di jalurnya.

constellations.name: Atmospheric Revolution
constellations.description: Elemental Skills and Elemental Bursts cast within the Frost Field created by Spirit Blade: Chonghua's Layered Frost have their CD time decreased by 15%.
constellations.descriptionId: CD Elemental Skill dan Elemental Burst yang digunakan di dalam Frost Field yang dibuat oleh Spirit Blade: Chonghua's Layered Frost berkurang 15%.

constellations.name: Cloudburst
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Spirit Blade: Cloud-Parting Star by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.descriptionId:
Meningkatkan 3 level Spirit Blade: Cloud-parting Star.
Maksimum: Lv. 15.

constellations.name: Frozen Skies
constellations.description:
Chongyun regenerates 1 Energy every time he hits an opponent affected by Cryo.
This effect can only occur once every 2s.
constellations.descriptionId:
Chongyun mendapatkan 1 Energy setiap kali memukul musuh yang terkena efek Cryo.
Efek ini terpicu setiap 2 detik.

constellations.name: The True Path
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Spirit Blade: Chonghua's Layered Frost by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.descriptionId:
Meningkatkan 3 level Spirit Blade: Chonghua's Layered Frost.
Maksimum: Lv. 15.

constellations.name: Rally of Four Blades
constellations.description:
Spirit Blade: Cloud-Parting Star deals 15% more DMG to opponents with a lower percentage of their Max HP remaining than Chongyun.
This skill will also summon 1 additional spirit blade.
constellations.descriptionId:
Spirit Blade: Cloud-parting Star mengakibatkan 15% DMG lebih banyak kepada musuh dengan persentase sisa HP lebih rendah dari Chongyun.
Skill ini juga akan memanggil 1 spirit blade tambahan.

name: Collei
title: Sprout of Rebirth
description: A trainee ranger active in Avidya Forest. Behind her enthusiastic words and actions hides a slightly introverted personality.
descriptionId: Seorang Penjaga Hutan Pemula yang aktif di Hutan Avidya. Tutur kata dan perbuatannya sangat lembut, namun kepribadiannya sedikit tertutup.

talents.name: Supplicant's Bowmanship
talents.description:
Normal Attack
Performs up to 4 consecutive shots with a bow.

Charged Attack
Performs a more precise Aimed Shot with increased DMG.
While aiming, Dendro energy will accumulate on the arrowhead. A fully charged arrow will deal Dendro DMG.

Plunging Attack
Fires off a shower of arrows in mid-air before falling and striking the ground, dealing AoE DMG upon impact.
talents.descriptionId:
Normal Attack
Melancarkan hingga 4 serangan berturut-turut menggunakan busur.

Charged Attack
Mengerahkan sebuah Serangan Membidik yang lebih akurat untuk mengakibatkan DMG lebih besar.
Saat membidik, elemen Dendro akan berkumpul di ujung anak panah. Panah dengan elemen Dendro yang terkumpul penuh akan mengakibatkan Dendro DMG.

Plunging Attack
Melancarkan hujan panah dari udara dan menerjang tanah dengan kecepatan tinggi, mengakibatkan DMG area saat mendarat.

talents.name: Floral Brush
talents.description:
Throws out a Floral Ring that deals 1 instance of Dendro DMG to targets it comes into contact with.
The Floral Ring will return after a set time, dealing Dendro DMG once again.
talents.descriptionId:
Melemparkan Floral Ring yang mengakibatkan 1 kali Dendro DMG pada target yang terkena.
Floral Ring akan kembali setelah dilemparkan dalam kurun waktu tertentu, dan akan mengakibatkan Dendro DMG lagi.

talents.name: Trump-Card Kitty
talents.description:
Trusty Cuilein-Anbar comes to save the day!
Throws the doll named Cuilein-Anbar, causing an explosion that deals AoE Dendro DMG, creating a Cuilein-Anbar Zone. Cuilein-Anbar will bounce around within this zone, dealing AoE Dendro DMG.
talents.descriptionId:
Mengundang Cuilein-Anbar yang bisa diandalkan untuk membantu di medan pertempuran.
Melemparkan boneka Cuilein-Anbar yang saat meledak akan mengakibatkan Dendro DMG Area dan akan menghasilkan Zona Cuilein-Anbar. Cuilein-Anbar akan terus memantul-mantul di dalam areanya dan mengakibatkan Dendro DMG Area.

passives.name: Floral Sidewinder
passives.description:
If one of your party members has triggered Burning, Quicken, Aggravate, Spread, Bloom, Hyperbloom, Burgeon, or Lunar-Bloom reactions before the Floral Ring returns, it will grant the character the Sprout effect upon return, which will continuously deal Dendro DMG equivalent to 40% of Collei's ATK to nearby opponents for 3s.
If another Sprout effect is triggered during its initial duration, the initial effect will be removed. DMG dealt by Sprout is considered Elemental Skill DMG.
passives.descriptionId:
Sebelum Floral Ring kembali, jika ada Karakter di dalam party yang memicu reaksi Burning, Quicken, Aggravate, Spread, Bloom, Hyperbloom, Lunar-Bloom, atau Burgeon, maka Karakter akan mendapatkan efek Sprout saat Floral Ring kembali. Efek ini akan mengakibatkan Dendro DMG sebesar 40% dari ATK Collei secara terus-menerus kepada musuh di sekitar selama 3 detik.
Jika efek Sprout terpicu lagi selama durasinya masih berlangsung, maka efek yang awal akan dihapus. DMG yang diakibatkan oleh efek Sprout dianggap sebagai DMG Elemental Skill.

passives.name: The Languid Wood
passives.description:
When a character within the Cuilein-Anbar Zone triggers Burning, Quicken, Aggravate, Spread, Bloom, Hyperbloom, Burgeon, or Lunar-Bloom reactions, the Zone's duration will be increased by 1s.
A single Trump-Card Kitty can be extended this way by up to 3s.
passives.descriptionId:
Saat Karakter yang berada di dalam Zona Cuilein-Anbar memicu efek Burning, Quicken, Aggravate, Spread, Bloom, Hyperbloom, Lunar-Bloom, atau Burgeon, maka durasi area akan diperpanjang 1 detik.
Dalam 1 kali Trump-Card Kitty, perpanjangan durasi yang bisa didapatkan dengan cara ini maksimum sebanyak 3 kali.

passives.name: Gliding Champion of Sumeru
passives.description:
Decreases gliding Stamina consumption for your own party members by 20%.
Not stackable with Passive Talents that provide the exact same effects.
passives.descriptionId:
Mengurangi 20% konsumsi Stamina Karakter party sendiri saat meluncur.
Efek ini tidak dapat ditumpuk dengan Talenta Pasif lain dengan efek yang sama persis.

constellations.name: Deepwood Patrol
constellations.description: When in the party and not on the field, Collei's Energy Recharge is increased by 20%.
constellations.descriptionId: Ketika Collei ada dalam party namun sedang tidak berada di medan pertempuran, Energy Recharge Collei meningkat 20%.

constellations.name: Through Hill and Copse
constellations.description:
The Ascension Talent Floral Sidewinder is changed to this:
The Floral Ring will grant the character the Sprout effect from Floral Sidewinder upon return, dealing 40% of Collei's ATK as Dendro DMG to nearby opponents for 3s.
From the moment of using Floral Brush to the moment when this instance of Sprout effect ends, if any of your party members triggers Burning, Quicken, Aggravate, Spread, Bloom, Hyperbloom, Lunar-Bloom, or Burgeon reactions, the Sprout effect will be extended by 3s.
The Sprout effect can only be extended this way once. If another Sprout effect is triggered during its initial duration, the initial effect will be removed. DMG dealt by Sprout is considered Elemental Skill DMG.
You must first unlock the Ascension Talent "Floral Sidewinder."
constellations.descriptionId:
Talenta Ascension "Floral Sidewinder" akan berubah menjadi:
Saat Floral Ring kembali, Talenta Ascension "Floral Sidewinder" akan memberikan status "Sprout" untuk Karakter, yang akan mengakibatkan Dendro DMG sebesar 40% dari ATK Collei secara terus-menerus kepada musuh di sekitar selama 3 detik.
Sejak melancarkan Floral Brush dan sebelum status Sprout kali ini hilang, jika ada Karakter di dalam party yang memicu reaksi Burning, Quicken, Aggravate, Spread, Bloom, Hyperbloom, Lunar-Bloom, atau Burgeon, maka durasi efek Sprout kali ini diperpanjang 3 detik.
Perpanjangan durasi efek Sprout yang bisa didapatkan dengan cara ini adalah 1 kali. Jika efek Sprout terpicu lagi selama durasinya berlangsung, maka efek yang awal akan dihapus. DMG yang diakibatkan oleh efek Sprout dianggap sebagai DMG Elemental Skill.
Harus membuka Talenta Ascension Floral Sidewinder terlebih dahulu.

constellations.name: Scent of Summer
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Floral Brush by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.descriptionId:
Meningkatkan 3 level Floral Brush.
Maksimum: Lv. 15.

constellations.name: Gift of the Woods
constellations.description: Using Trump-Card Kitty will increase all nearby characters' Elemental Mastery by 60 for 12s (not including Collei herself).
constellations.descriptionId: Saat melancarkan Trump-Card Kitty, akan meningkatkan 60 poin Elemental Mastery seluruh anggota party di sekitar (tidak termasuk Collei) selama 12 detik.

constellations.name: All Embers
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Trump-Card Kitty by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.descriptionId:
Meningkatkan 3 level Trump-Card Kitty.
Maksimum: Lv. 15.

constellations.name: Forest of Falling Arrows
constellations.description:
When the Floral Ring hits, it will create a miniature Cuilein-Anbar that will deal 200% of Collei's ATK as Dendro DMG.
Each Floral Brush can only create one such miniature Cuilein-Anbar.
constellations.descriptionId:
Saat Floral Ring mengenai target, akan menghasilkan 1 miniatur Cuilein-Anbar dan mengakibatkan Dendro DMG sebesar 200% dari ATK Collei.
Hanya 1 miniatur Cuilein-Anbar yang bisa dihasilkan setiap kali melancarkan Floral Brush.

name: Dahlia
title: Ode and Oblation
description: Deacon of the Church of Favonius and the Anemo Archon's representative in the church.
descriptionId: Diakon Church of Favonius dan perwakilan Archon Anemo di Gereja.

talents.name: Favonius Bladework - Ritual
talents.description:
Normal Attack
Performs up to 4 rapid strikes.

Charged Attack
Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to unleash 2 rapid sword strikes.

Plunging Attack
Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground below, damaging opponents along the path and dealing AoE DMG upon impact.
talents.descriptionId:
Normal Attack
Melancarkan hingga 4 serangan berturut-turut.

Charged Attack
Mengonsumsi sejumlah Stamina untuk melancarkan dua tebasan pedang.

Plunging Attack
Menerjang dari udara untuk menghantam tanah, menyerang musuh di jalur terjangan dan mengakibatkan DMG Area saat mendarat.

talents.name: Immersive Ordinance
talents.description:
Time for a fun little trick! Summons the Sacramental Shower in different ways depending on whether you Tap or Hold it.

Tap
After a short prayer, summons the Sacramental Shower in front.

Hold
Engages in continuous prayer, and when done, summons forth a Sacramental Shower in the designated position.

Sacramental Shower
When opponents or nearby party members touch the Sacramental Shower, different effects will occur depending on the one who touches it:
If an opponent touches the Shower, it will explode and deal AoE Hydro DMG to nearby opponents.
If a nearby party member touches it, it will bounce the one who touches it high in the air.

Only 1 Sacramental Shower summoned by Dahlia himself can be on the field at once.
talents.descriptionId:
Saatnya memainkan sebuah trik! Dahlia akan memanggil Sacramental Shower dengan cara berbeda berdasarkan Mode Tekan atau Mode Tahan.

Mode Tekan
Setelah doa singkat, Dahlia akan memanggil Sacramental Shower di hadapannya.

Mode Tahan
Dahlia akan terus berdoa, dan saat berakhir, ia akan memanggil Sacramental Shower di posisi yang ditentukan.

Sacramental Shower
Setelah musuh atau Karakter di dalam party menyentuh Sacramental Shower, akan muncul efek yang berbeda berdasarkan subjek yang menyentuhnya:
Jika musuh yang menyentuh, maka Sacramental Shower akan meledak dan mengakibatkan Hydro DMG Area pada musuh di sekitar.
Jika Karakter di dalam party yang menyentuh, maka Sacramental Shower akan mementalkan Karakter tersebut ke udara.

Hanya bisa ada satu Sacramental Shower yang bisa dipanggil oleh Dahlia dalam satu waktu.

talents.name: Radiant Psalter
talents.description:
Appeals to the divine with earnestness and song, dealing AoE Hydro DMG to nearby opponents and granting his party members Favonian Favor, summoning a Shield of Sacred Favor.
The Shield of Sacred Favor's DMG absorption is based on Dahlia's Max HP, and it will absorb Hydro DMG with 250% effectiveness.

Favonian Favor
While this effect is active, 1 Benison stack may be consumed to summon a new Shield of Sacred Favor when an existing Shield is broken via DMG.

Dahlia can obtain Benison via the following methods:
· He will gain 1 Benison stack when his own active party member hits opponents 4 times with Normal Attacks while affected by Favonian Favor.
· After triggering the effect of his Ascension Talent, "The Wind's Gentle Grace" (You must first unlock this Ascension Talent.)
Dahlia can gain a maximum of 4 Benison stacks per Favonian Favor duration.
talents.descriptionId:
Berdoa kepada yang suci dengan niat dan suara yang tulus, mengakibatkan Hydro DMG Area ke musuh di sekitar, memberikan Favonian Favor terhadap Karakter di dalam party, dan menciptakan Shield of Sacred Favor.
DMG yang dapat ditahan Shield of Sacred Favor didasarkan pada Max HP Dahlia, dan memiliki 250% pertahanan terhadap Hydro DMG.

Favonian Favor
Selama aktif, jika Perisai Shield of Sacred Favor hancur terkena DMG, Dahlia akan mengonsumsi satu lapis efek Benison untuk menciptakan Shield of Sacred Favor baru.

Dahlia bisa mendapatkan efek Benison dengan cara berikut:
·Dahlia akan mendapatkan 1 lapis efek Benison saat Karakter aktif di dalam party yang terpengaruh efek Favonian Favor menyerang musuh dengan Normal Attack sebanyak 4 kali.
·Setelah efek Talenta Ascension "The Wind's Gentle Grace" terpicu (Harus membuka Talenta Ascension "The Wind's Gentle Grace" terlebih dahulu).
Dahlia bisa mendapatkan maksimum 4 lapis Benison untuk setiap durasi Favonian Favor.

passives.name: The Wind's Gentle Grace
passives.description: When characters affected by the Favonian Favor effect of the Elemental Burst **Radiant Psalter** trigger Frozen reactions on opponents, they will grant Dahlia 2 Benison stacks. This effect can trigger once every 8s.
passives.descriptionId: Saat Karakter yang berada dalam pengaruh Favonian Favor dari Elemental Burst **Radiant Psalter** memicu reaksi Frozen pada musuh, akan memberikan 2 lapis efek Benison kepada Dahlia. Efek ini dapat terpicu sekali setiap 8 detik.

passives.name: Prayer of Well-Wrought Joy
passives.description: When your active party member is affected by the Favonian Favor effect of the Elemental Burst **"Radiant Psalter,"** their ATK SPD will increase based on Dahlia's Max HP: Every 1,000 Max HP will cause an increase of 0.5%, up to a maximum of 20%.
passives.descriptionId: Saat Karakter aktif di dalam party sendiri berada dalam pengaruh Favonian Favor dari Elemental Burst **Radiant Psalter**, ATK SPD-nya akan meningkat berdasarkan Max HP Dahlia: Setiap 1.000 poin Max HP Dahlia akan meningkatkan 0,5% ATK SPD. ATK SPD Karakter dapat meningkat hingga 20% dengan cara ini.

passives.name: Pilgrimage Upon Returning Winds
passives.description:
During the day (06:00 – 18:00), your party members gain the Swift Stride effect: Movement SPD increased by 10%.
Does not take effect in Domains, Trounce Domains, or the Spiral Abyss. Swift Stride does not stack.
passives.descriptionId:
Saat siang hari (06:00 - 18:00), anggota party sendiri mendapatkan efek Swift Stride: meningkatkan 10% Movement SPD.
Efek ini tidak aktif dalam Domain, Domain Trounce, atau Spiral Abyss. Efek Swift Stride tidak dapat ditumpuk.

constellations.name: Infallible Procession
constellations.description: Each time Dahlia gains 1 of his Elemental Burst **Radiant Psalter**'s Benison stacks, he will regain 2.5 Elemental Energy.
constellations.descriptionId: Setiap kali Dahlia mendapatkan satu lapis efek Benison dari Elemental Burst **Radiant Psalter**, ia akan memulihkan 2,5 poin Energy.

constellations.name: Revelation of Mercy
constellations.description: After Dahlia consumes his Elemental Burst **Radiant Psalter**'s Benison stacks to summon a Shield of Sacred Favor, the character protected by said Shield will gain 25% increased Shield Strength for 12s.
constellations.descriptionId: Setelah Dahlia mengonsumsi efek Benison dari Elemental Burst **Radiant Psalter** untuk memanggil Shield of Sacred Favor, Karakter yang dilindungi oleh Shield of Sacred Favor akan mendapatkan 25% peningkatan Kekuatan Perisai selama 12 detik.

constellations.name: Windblume Offertory
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of **Radiant Psalter** by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.descriptionId:
Meningkatkan 3 level **Radiant Psalter**.
Maksimum: Lv. 15.

constellations.name: Collect of the Assembly
constellations.description: The Favonian Favor from Dahlia's Elemental Burst **Radiant Psalter** lasts 3 more seconds.
constellations.descriptionId: Durasi efek Favonian Favor dari Elemental Burst **Radiant Psalter** diperpanjang 3 detik.

constellations.name: Let It Be Subtly So
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of **Immersive Ordinance** by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.descriptionId:
Meningkatkan 3 level **Immersive Ordinance**.
Maksimum: Lv. 15.

constellations.name: You Shall Go Out With Joy
constellations.description:
The current active character affected by the Elemental Burst **Radiant Psalter**'s Favonian Favor has their ATK SPD increased by 10%.
Additionally, when an active character affected by Favonian Favor falls, immediately:
· Revive them.
· Restore their HP to 100%.
This effect can trigger once every 15 minutes.
constellations.descriptionId:
ATK SPD Karakter aktif yang berada dalam pengaruh Favonian Favor dari Elemental Burst **Radiant Psalter** akan meningkat 10%.
Selain itu, saat Karakter aktif yang berada dalam pengaruh Favonian Favor gugur, maka akan langsung:
·Dihidupkan kembali.
·HP-nya dipulihkan hingga 100%.
Efek ini dapat terpicu sekali setiap 15 menit.

name: Diona
title: Kätzlein Cocktail
description: A young lady who has inherited trace amounts of non-human blood. She is the incredibly popular bartender of the Cat's Tail tavern.
descriptionId: Seorang wanita muda yang mewarisi darah yang bukan manusia. Dia adalah bartender terkenal di Cat's Tail.

talents.name: Kätzlein Style
talents.description:
Normal Attack
Performs up to 5 consecutive shots with a bow.

Charged Attack
Performs a more precise Aimed Shot with increased DMG.
While aiming, biting frost will accumulate on the arrowhead. A fully charged frost arrow will deal Cryo DMG.

Plunging Attack
Fires off a shower of arrows in mid-air before falling and striking the ground, dealing AoE DMG upon impact.
talents.descriptionId:
Normal Attack
Melancarkan hingga 5 serangan berturut-turut menggunakan busur.

Charged Attack
Mengerahkan sebuah Serangan Membidik yang lebih akurat untuk mengakibatkan DMG lebih besar.
Saat membidik, es akan berkumpul di ujung anak panah. Panah dengan es yang terkumpul penuh akan mengakibatkan Cryo DMG.

Plunging Attack
Melancarkan hujan panah dari udara dan menerjang tanah dengan kecepatan tinggi, mengakibatkan DMG area saat mendarat.

talents.name: Icy Paws
talents.description:
Fires an Icy Paw that deals Cryo DMG to opponents and forms a shield on hit.
The shield's DMG Absorption scales based on Diona's Max HP, and its duration scales off the number of Icy Paws that hit their target.

Press
Rapidly fires off 2 Icy Paws.

Hold
Dashes back quickly before firing 5 Icy Paws.
The shield created by a Hold attack will gain a 75% DMG Absorption Bonus.

The shield has a 250% Cryo DMG Absorption Bonus, and will cause your active character to become affected by Cryo at the point of formation for a short duration.
talents.descriptionId:
Menembakkan Icy Paws yang mengakibatkan Cryo DMG dan membentuk Perisai saat Icy Paws mengenai musuh.
Jumlah DMG yang dapat ditahan Perisai ditentukan berdasarkan Max HP Diona, dan durasinya ditentukan berdasarkan jumlah musuh yang terkena Icy Paws.

Tekan
Menembakkan 2 Icy Paws dengan cepat

Tahan
Bergerak mundur dengan cepat, kemudian menembakkan 5 Icy Paws.
Perisai yang terbentuk setelah tombol skill ditahan, akan memperoleh bonus 75% penyerapan DMG.

Perisai ini memiliki bonus 250% penyerapan Cryo DMG. Saat Perisai terbentuk, karakter yang sedang digunakan akan terpengaruh Cryo dalam waktu singkat.

talents.name: Signature Mix
talents.description:
Tosses out a special cold brew that deals AoE Cryo DMG and creates a Drunken Mist in an AoE.

Drunken Mist
·Deals continuous Cryo DMG to opponents within the AoE.
·Continuously regenerates the HP of characters within the AoE.
talents.descriptionId:
Melemparkan minuman dingin spesial yang mengakibatkan Cryo DMG area dan menciptakan Drunken Mist dalam area tersebut.

Drunken Mist
·Mengakibatkan Cryo DMG berkelanjutan terhadap semua musuh yang berada di dalam area.
·Memulihkan HP karakter yang berada di dalam lingkup area secara terus-menerus.

passives.name: Cat's Tail Secret Menu
passives.description: Characters shielded by Icy Paws have their Movement SPD increased by 10% and their Stamina Consumption decreased by 10%.
passives.descriptionId: Meningkatkan 10% Movement SPD dan mengurangi 10% konsumsi Stamina untuk Karakter yang dilindungi oleh Perisai dari skill Icy Paws.

passives.name: Drunkards' Farce
passives.description: Opponents who enter the AoE of Signature Mix have 10% decreased ATK for 15s.
passives.descriptionId: Mengurangi 10% ATK musuh yang masuk ke area skill Signature Mix selama 15 detik.

passives.name: Complimentary Bar Food
passives.description: When a Perfect Cooking is achieved on a dish with restorative effects, there is a 12% chance to obtain double the product.
passives.descriptionId: Saat masakan jenis pemulihan dimasak dengan sempurna, memiliki 12% kemungkinan mendapatkan hasil 2 kali lipat.

constellations.name: A Lingering Flavor
constellations.description: Regenerates 15 Energy for Diona after the effects of Signature Mix end.
constellations.descriptionId: Memulihkan 15 Energy Diona setelah efek Signature Mix berakhir.

constellations.name: Shaken, Not Purred
constellations.description:
Increases Icy Paws' DMG by 15%, and increases its shield's DMG Absorption by 15%.
Additionally, when paws hit their targets, creates a shield for other nearby characters on the field with 50% of the Icy Paws shield's DMG Absorption for 5s.
constellations.descriptionId:
Meningkatkan 15% DMG Icy Paws, dan meningkatkan 15% kemampuan menahan DMG;
Selain itu, ketika skill ini mengenai musuh, akan menciptakan sebuah Perisai untuk karakter lain di sekitarnya yang dapat menahan hingga 50% dari penahanan DMG Perisai Icy Paws selama 5 detik.

constellations.name: A—Another Round?
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Signature Mix by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.descriptionId:
Meningkatkan 3 level Signature Mix.
Maksimum: Lv. 15.

constellations.name: Wine Industry Slayer
constellations.description: Within the radius of Signature Mix, Diona's charge time for aimed shots is reduced by 60%
constellations.descriptionId: Dalam area Signature Mix, waktu bagi Diona untuk melakukan Serangan Membidik berkurang 60%.

constellations.name: Double Shot, on the Rocks
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Icy Paws by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.descriptionId:
Meningkatkan 3 level Icy Paws.
Maksimum: Lv. 15.

constellations.name: Cat's Tail Closing Time
constellations.description:
Characters within Signature Mix's radius will gain the following effects based on their HP amounts:
·Increases Incoming Healing Bonus by 30% when HP falls below or is equal to 50%.
·Elemental Mastery increased by 200 when HP is above 50%.
constellations.descriptionId:
Karakter dalam area Signature Mix akan mendapatkan efek berikut berdasarkan jumlah HP mereka:
·Meningkatkan 30% Bonus Pemulihan HP saat HP sama dengan atau kurang dari 50%.
·Elemental Mastery +200 ketika HP di atas 50%.

name: Dori
title: Treasure of Dream Garden
description: An elusive merchant who has a fondness for glittering Mora.
descriptionId: Pedagang keliling yang sulit dipahami dan paling suka dengan Mora yang berkilauan.

talents.name: Marvelous Sword-Dance (Modified)
talents.description:
Normal Attack
Performs up to 3 consecutive strikes.

Charged Attack
Drains Stamina over time to perform continuous spinning attacks against all nearby opponents.
At the end of the sequence, performs a more powerful slash. 

Plunging Attack
Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground below, damaging opponents along the path and dealing AoE DMG upon impact.
talents.descriptionId:
Normal Attack Melancarkan hingga 3 tebasan berturut-turut.

Charged Attack
Terus menguras Stamina untuk melancarkan serangan berputar yang mengakibatkan DMG ke musuh di sekitar.
Saat berhenti berputar, akan melancarkan sebuah tebasan yang sangat kuat.

Plunging Attack
Menerjang dari udara untuk menghantam tanah, menyerang musuh di jalur terjangan dan mengakibatkan DMG Area saat mendarat.

talents.name: Spirit-Warding Lamp: Troubleshooter Cannon
talents.description:
Directs a Spirit-Warding Lamp to fire off a Troubleshooter Shot at opponents, dealing Electro DMG.
After the Troubleshooter Shot hits, it will create 2 After-Sales Service Rounds that will automatically track nearby opponents and deal Electro DMG.
talents.descriptionId:
Memerintahkan Spirit-Warding Lamp untuk menembakkan Troubleshooter Shot terhadap musuh, mengakibatkan Electro DMG.
Setelah Troubleshooter Shot mengenai target, akan menghasilkan 2 buah After-Sales Service Round yang akan otomatis mengikuti musuh di sekitar dan mengakibatkan Electro DMG.

talents.name: Alcazarzaray's Exactitude
talents.description:
Summons forth the Jinni within the lamp to give the client various kinds of aid.

Jinni
Connects to a nearby character. The connected character will:
· Continuously restore HP based on Dori's Max HP.
· Continuously regenerate Energy.
· Be affected by Electro.
When the connector between the Jinni and the character touches opponents, it will deal one instance of Electro DMG to them every 0.4s.

Only one Jinni can exist at one time.
talents.descriptionId:
Memanggil Jinni yang berada di dalam lampu dan menyediakan bantuan yang beragam kepada klien.

Jinni

Akan bisa terhubung dengan Karakter di sekitar. Karakter yang terhubung dengan Jinni akan:
·Terus-menerus memulihkan HP berdasarkan Max HP Dori;
·Terus menerus memulihkan Energy Karakter;
·Berada dalam status terpengaruh oleh efek Electro.

Selain itu, saat penghubung antara Karakter dan Jinni menyentuh musuh, akan mengakibatkan satu kali Electro DMG terhadap musuh setiap 0,4 detik.

Hanya satu Jinni yang bisa muncul dalam waktu bersamaan.

passives.name: An Eye for Gold
passives.description:
After a character connected to the Jinni triggers an Electro-Charged, Lunar-Charged, Superconduct, Stellar-Conduct, Overloaded, Quicken, Aggravate, Hyperbloom, Electro Swirl, or Electro Crystallize reaction, the CD of Spirit-Warding Lamp: Troubleshooter Cannon is decreased by 1s.
This effect can be triggered once every 3s.
passives.descriptionId:
Setelah Karakter yang terhubung dengan Jinni memicu Electro-Charged, Lunar-Charged, Superconduct, Stellar-Conduct, Overloaded, Quicken, Aggravate, Hyperbloom, atau reaksi Swirl atau Crystallize dari Electro, maka CD Spirit-Warding Lamp: Troubleshooter Cannon berkurang 1 detik.
 Efek ini dapat terpicu sekali setiap 3 detik.

passives.name: Compound Interest
passives.description:
When the Troubleshooter Shots or After-Sales Service Rounds from Spirit-Warding Lamp: Troubleshooter Cannon hit opponents, Dori will restore 5 Elemental Energy for every 100% Energy Recharge possessed.
Per Spirit-Warding Lamp: Troubleshooter Cannon, only one instance of Energy restoration can be triggered and a maximum of 15 Energy can be restored this way.
passives.descriptionId:
Saat Troubleshooter Shot atau After-Sales Service Round dari Spirit-Warding Lamp: Troubleshooter Cannon mengenai musuh, Dori akan memulihkan 5 Energy untuk setiap 100% Energy Recharge yang dimiliki Dori.
Untuk setiap Spirit-Warding Lamp: Troubleshooter Cannon, hanya satu pemulihan Energi yang dapat terpicu dan maksimal 15 Energy yang bisa dipulihkan dengan cara ini.

passives.name: Unexpected Order
passives.description: Has a 25% chance to recover some of the materials used when crafting Character and Weapon Materials.
passives.descriptionId: Saat membuat Material Penguatan Senjata dan Karakter, memiliki 25% persentase untuk mendapatkan kembali sebagian material yang digunakan.

constellations.name: Additional Investment
constellations.description: The number of After-Sales Service Rounds created by Troubleshooter Shots is increased by 1.
constellations.descriptionId: Jumlah After Sales Service Round yang diciptakan dari Troubleshooter Shot bertambah 1.

constellations.name: Special Franchise
constellations.description: When you are in combat and the Jinni heals the character it is connected to, it will fire a Jinni Toop from that character's position that deals 50% of Dori's ATK DMG.
constellations.descriptionId: Saat berada dalam status pertempuran, saat Jinni memulihkan HP Karakter yang terhubung, maka akan menembakkan Jinni Toop dari posisi berdiri Karakter tersebut dan mengakibatkan DMG setara dengan 50% dari ATK Dori.

constellations.name: Wonders Never Cease
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Alcazarzaray's Exactitude by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.descriptionId:
Meningkatkan 3 level Alcazarzaray's Exactitude.
Maksimum: Lv. 15.

constellations.name: Discretionary Supplement
constellations.description:
The character connected to the Jinni will obtain the following buffs based on their current HP and Energy:
·When their HP is lower than 50%, they gain 50% Incoming Healing Bonus.
·When their Energy is less than 50%, they gain 30% Energy Recharge.

constellations.name: Value for Mora
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Spirit-Warding Lamp: Troubleshooter Cannon by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.descriptionId:
Meningkatkan 3 level Spirit-Warding Lamp: Troubleshooter Cannon.
Maksimum: Lv. 15.

constellations.name: Sprinkling Weight
constellations.description:
Dori gains the following effects for 3s after using Spirit-Warding Lamp: Troubleshooter Cannon:
·Electro Infusion.
·When Normal Attacks hit opponents, all nearby party members will heal HP equivalent to 4% of Dori's Max HP. This type of healing can occur once every 0.1s.

name: Faruzan
title: Enigmatic Machinist
description: A researcher from "one hundred years ago." She enjoys self-identifying as everyone's senior, and has significant knowledge of ancient scripts and machines of all kinds.
descriptionId: Peneliti dari "seratus tahun lalu". Dia suka mengaku diri sebagai seniornya semua orang dan punya pengetahuan luas tentang berbagai naskah kuno dan segala jenis mesin.

talents.name: Parthian Shot
talents.description:
Normal Attack
Performs up to 4 consecutive shots with a bow.

Charged Attack
Performs a more precise Aimed Shot with increased DMG.
While aiming, mighty winds will accumulate on the arrowhead. A fully charged wind arrow will deal Anemo DMG.

Plunging Attack
Fires off a shower of arrows in mid-air before falling and striking the ground, hitting opponents along the path and dealing AoE DMG upon impact.
talents.descriptionId:
Normal Attack
Melancarkan hingga 4 tembakan panah berturut-turut menggunakan busur.

Charged Attack
Melancarkan sebuah Serangan Membidik yang lebih akurat untuk mengakibatkan DMG yang lebih besar.
Saat membidik, angin kuat akan berkumpul di ujung anak panah. Panah dengan angin kuat yang terkumpul penuh akan mengakibatkan Anemo DMG.

Plunging Attack
Melancarkan hujan panah dari udara, menerjang tanah dengan kecepatan tinggi, menyerang musuh di jalur terjangan, dan mengakibatkan DMG Area saat mendarat.

talents.name: Wind Realm of Nasamjnin
talents.description:
Faruzan deploys a polyhedron that deals AoE Anemo DMG to nearby opponents. She will also enter the Manifest Gale state.
While in the Manifest Gale state, Faruzan's next fully charged shot will consume this state and will become a Hurricane Arrow that contains high-pressure currents. This arrow deals Anemo DMG based on the DMG of a fully charged Aimed Shot from "Normal Attack: Parthian Shot."

Pressurized Collapse
The Hurricane Arrow will apply a Pressurized Collapse effect to the opponent or character hit. This effect will be removed after a short delay, creating a vortex that deals AoE Anemo DMG and pulls nearby objects and opponents in. If the Hurricane Arrow does not hit any opponent or character, it will create a Pressurized Collapse effect at its point of impact.
The vortex DMG is considered Elemental Skill DMG.
talents.descriptionId:
Faruzan mengerahkan Polyhedron dan menyebabkan Anemo DMG Area terhadap musuh di sekitar dan mendapatkan efek Manifest Gale.
Saat berada dalam status Manifest Gale, charge penuh Serangan Membidik Faruzan kali selanjutnya akan mengonsumsi efek Manifest Gale ini dan akan menjadi Hurricane Arrow dengan pusaran angin bertekanan tinggi, mengakibatkan Anemo DMG berdasarkan DMG Membidik Penuh Normal Attack: Parthian Shot.

Pressurized Collapse
Hurricane Arrow akan menambahkan efek Pressurized Collapse terhadap musuh atau Karakter yang terkena. Efek ini akan hilang dalam waktu singkat, lalu menghasilkan pusaran angin yang mengakibatkan Anemo DMG Area, dan akan menarik objek atau musuh yang berada di sekitar; Jika belum mengenai musuh atau Karakter, maka akan menghasilkan efek Pressurized Collapse di posisi target yang terkena.
DMG yang diakibatkan pusaran angin akan dianggap sebagai DMG Elemental Skill.

talents.name: The Wind's Secret Ways
talents.description:
Faruzan deploys a Dazzling Polyhedron that unleashes a Whirlwind Pulse and deals AoE Anemo DMG.
While the Dazzling Polyhedron persists, it will continuously move along a triangular path. Once it reaches each corner of that triangular path, it will unleash 1 more Whirlwind Pulse.

Whirlwind Pulse
·When the Whirlwind Pulse is unleashed, it will apply Perfidious Wind's Bale to nearby opponents, decreasing their Anemo RES.
·The Whirlwind Pulse will also apply Prayerful Wind's Benefit to all nearby party members when it is unleashed, granting them an Anemo DMG Bonus.
talents.descriptionId:
Faruzan mengerahkan "Dazzling Polyhedron" dengan cepat, melancarkan satu kali Whirlwind Pulse dan mengakibatkan Anemo DMG Area.
Selama Dazzling Polyhedron aktif, akan terus-menerus bergerak dalam jalur berbentuk segitiga. Setiap kali menyentuh sudut segitiga, Dazzling Polyhedron akan melancarkan satu kali Whirlwind Pulse tambahan.

Whirlwind Pulse
·Saat Whirlwind Pulse dilancarkan, akan memberikan efek Perfidious Wind's Bale terhadap musuh di sekitar: Mengurangi Anemo RES musuh;
·Saat melancarkan Whirlwind Pulse, akan memberikan efek Prayerful Wind's Benefit terhadap seluruh anggota party: Mendapatkan Anemo DMG Bonus.

passives.name: Impetuous Flow
passives.description: When Faruzan is in the Manifest Gale state created by Wind Realm of Nasamjnin, the amount of time taken to charge a shot is decreased by 60%, and she can apply The Wind's Secret Ways' Perfidious Wind's Bale to opponents who are hit by the vortex created by Pressurized Collapse.
passives.descriptionId: Saat Faruzan berada dalam status Manifest Gale dari Wind Realm of Nasamjnin, waktu charge Serangan Membidik berkurang 60%; Akan bisa menambahkan efek Perfidious Wind's Bale dari The Wind's Secret Ways terhadap musuh yang terkena pusaran angin yang dihasilkan oleh Pressurized Collapse.

passives.name: Lost Wisdom of the Seven Caverns
passives.description: When characters affected by The Wind's Secret Ways' Prayerful Wind's Benefit deal Anemo DMG using Normal, Charged, Plunging Attacks, Elemental Skills, or Elemental Bursts to opponents, they will gain the Hurricane Guard effect: This DMG will be increased based on 32% of Faruzan's Base ATK. 1 instance of Hurricane Guard can occur once every 0.8s. This DMG Bonus will be cleared after Prayerful Wind's Benefit expires or after the effect is triggered once.
passives.descriptionId: Pada saat Normal Attack, Charged Attack, Plunging Attack, Elemental Skill atau Elemental Burst Karakter yang berada dalam status Prayerful Wind's Benefit dari The Wind's Secret Ways mengakibatkan Anemo DMG terhadap musuh, akan menghasilkan efek Hurricane Guard: DMG yang diakibatkan akan ditingkatkan berdasarkan 32% Base ATK Faruzan. Hurricane Guard bisa terpicu setiap 0,8 detik sekali. Efek ini akan hilang setelah durasi Prayerful Wind's setelah efeknya terpicu satu kali.

passives.name: Tomes Light the Path
passives.description: Gains 25% more rewards when dispatched on a Sumeru Expedition for 20 hours.
passives.descriptionId: Ketika dikirim untuk melakukan ekspedisi di Sumeru selama 20 jam, hadiah yang didapatkan akan bertambah 25%.

constellations.name: Truth by Any Means
constellations.description: Faruzan can fire off a maximum of 2 Hurricane Arrows using fully charged Aimed Shots while under the effect of a single Manifest Gale created by Wind Realm of Nasamjnin.
constellations.descriptionId: Saat berada dalam satu kali efek Manifest Gale dari Wind Realm of Nasamjnin, Faruzan bisa melepaskan maksimum sebanyak 2 buah Hurricane Arrow dalam satu kali charge penuh Serangan Membidik.

constellations.name: Overzealous Intellect
constellations.description: The duration of the Dazzling Polyhedron created by The Wind's Secret Ways is increased by 6s.
constellations.descriptionId: Durasi Dazzling Polyhedron dari The Wind's Secret Ways meningkat 6 detik.

constellations.name: Spirit-Orchard Stroll
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Wind Realm of Nasamjnin by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.descriptionId:
Meningkatkan 3 level Wind Realm of Nasamjnin.
Maksimum: Lv. 15.

constellations.name: Divine Comprehension
constellations.description:
The vortex created by Pressurized Collapses will restore Energy to Faruzan based on the number of opponents hit: If it hits 1 opponent, it will restore 2 Energy for Faruzan. Each additional opponent hit will restore 0.5 more Energy for Faruzan.
A maximum of 4 Energy can be restored to her per vortex.
constellations.descriptionId:
Pusaran angin dari Pressurized Collapse akan bisa mengembalikan Energy Faruzan berdasarkan jumlah musuh yang terkena: Saat mengenai satu musuh, akan bisa memulihkan 2 poin Energy untuk Faruzan; Untuk setiap penambahan satu musuh yang terkena, akan memulihkan 0,5 poin Energy untuk Faruzan.
Dengan cara ini, satu kali pusaran angin bisa memulihkan Energy Faruzan sebanyak maksimum 4 poin Energy.

constellations.name: Wonderland of Rumination
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of The Wind's Secret Ways by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.descriptionId:
Meningkatkan 3 level The Wind's Secret Ways.
Maksimum: Lv. 15.

constellations.name: The Wondrous Path of Truth
constellations.description: Characters affected by The Wind's Secret Ways' Prayerful Wind's Benefit have 40% increased CRIT DMG when they deal Anemo DMG. When the active character deals DMG while affected by Prayerful Wind's Benefit, they will apply Pressurized Collapse to the opponent damaged. This effect can be triggered once every 3s. This CD is shared between all party members.
constellations.descriptionId: CRIT DMG Anemo DMG yang diakibatkan Karakter yang berada dalam status Prayerful Wind's Benefit dari The Wind's Secret Ways meningkat 40%; Saat Karakter aktif yang berada dalam status Prayerful Wind's Benefit menghasilkan DMG, akan memberikan Pressurized Collapse terhadap musuh ini. Efek ini bisa terpicu setiap 3 detik sekali, CD ini berlaku bagi seluruh anggota party.

name: Fischl
title: Prinzessin der Verurteilung!
description: A mysterious girl who calls herself "Prinzessin der Verurteilung" and travels with a night raven named Oz.
descriptionId: Seorang gadis misterius yang menyebut dirinya sendiri "Prinzessin der Verurteilung", dia selalu terlihat bersama dengan seekor gagak hitam yang bernama Oz.
cvJapanese: 内田真礼 & 増谷康紀

talents.name: Bolts of Downfall
talents.description:
Normal Attack
Performs up to 5 consecutive shots with a bow.

Charged Attack
Performs a more precise Aimed Shot with increased DMG.
While aiming, the dark lightning spirits of Immernachtreich shall heed the call of their Prinzessin and indwell the enchanted arrowhead. When fully indwelt, the Rachsüchtig Blitz shall deal immense Electro DMG.

Plunging Attack
Fires off a shower of arrows in mid-air before falling and striking the ground, dealing AoE DMG upon impact.
talents.descriptionId:
Normal Attack
Melancarkan hingga 5 serangan berturut-turut menggunakan busur.

Charged Attack
Melancarkan sebuah Serangan Membidik yang lebih akurat untuk mengakibatkan DMG lebih besar. Saat membidik, jiwa petir hitam dari Immernachtreich akan menjawab panggilan Prinzessin dan kekuatannya berkumpul pada ujung anak panah. Saat terkumpul penuh, Rachsüchtig Blitz akan mengakibatkan Electro DMG.

Plunging Attack
Melancarkan hujan panah dari udara dan menerjang tanah dengan kecepatan tinggi, mengakibatkan DMG area saat mendarat.

talents.name: Nightrider
talents.description:
Summons Oz. The night raven forged of darkness and lightning descends upon the land, dealing Electro DMG in a small AoE.
For the ability's duration, Oz will continuously attack nearby opponents with Freikugel.

Hold to adjust the location Oz will be summoned to.
Press again any time during the ability's duration to once again summon him to Fischl's side.
talents.descriptionId:
Memanggil Oz. Gagak malam yang tercipta dalam kegelapan dan halilintar turun ke bumi untuk mengakibatkan Electro DMG dalam area kecil.
Selama durasi skill, Oz akan terus menyerang musuh di sekitar dengan Freikugel.

Tahan tombol skill untuk mengatur lokasi di mana Oz akan dipanggil.
Tekan skill lagi selama durasi skill untuk memanggil Oz kembali ke sisi Fischl.

talents.name: Midnight Phantasmagoria
talents.description:
Summons Oz to spread his twin wings of twilight and defend Fischl.
Has the following properties during the ability's duration:
·Fischl takes on Oz's form, greatly increasing her Movement Speed.
·Strikes nearby opponents with lightning, dealing Electro DMG to opponents she comes into contact with. Each opponent can only be struck once.
