·Once this ability's effects end, Oz will remain on the battlefield and attack his Prinzessin's foes. If Oz is already on the field, then this will reset the duration of his presence.
talents.descriptionId:
Memanggil Oz untuk membentangkan kedua sayap kegelapan dan melindungi Fischl.
Memiliki efek berikut selama durasi skill:
·Fischl mengambil bentuk Oz, meningkatkan kecepatan geraknya secara drastis.
·Menyambar musuh terdekat dengan menggunakan petir dan mengakibatkan Electro DMG. Setiap musuh hanya dapat tersambar satu kali.
·Saat efeknya berakhir, Oz akan tetap berada di medan tempur dan menyerang musuh Prinzessin. Jika Oz sudah berada di medan tempur, maka durasi keberadaan Oz akan diperbarui.

passives.name: Stellar Predator
passives.description: When Fischl hits Oz with a fully-charged Aimed Shot, Oz brings down Thundering Retribution, dealing AoE Electro DMG equal to 152.7% of the arrow's DMG.
passives.descriptionId: Saat Fischl mengenai Oz dengan Serangan Membidik yang telah di-Charge penuh, maka Oz akan memanggil Thundering Retribution yang mengakibatkan Electro DMG Area sebesar 152,7% DMG panah.

passives.name: Undone Be Thy Sinful Hex
passives.description: If your current active character triggers an Electro-related Elemental Reaction when Oz is on the field, the opponent shall be stricken with Thundering Retribution that deals Electro DMG equal to 80% of Fischl's ATK.
passives.descriptionId: Jika Karakter aktif saat ini memicu Reaksi Elemental yang berhubungan dengan Electro saat Oz berada di medan pertempuran, musuh akan terkena Thundering Retribution yang mengakibatkan Electro DMG sebesar 80% ATK Fischl.

passives.name: Mein Hausgarten
passives.description: When dispatched on an expedition in Mondstadt, time consumed is reduced by 25%.
passives.descriptionId: Ketika dikirim untuk melakukan ekspedisi di Mondstadt, waktu yang dibutuhkan berkurang 25%.

constellations.name: Gaze of the Deep
constellations.description: Even when Oz is not present in combat, he can still watch over Fischl through his raven eyes. When Fischl performs a Normal Attack against an opponent, Oz fires a coordinated attack, dealing DMG equal to 22% of Fischl's ATK.
constellations.descriptionId: Saat Oz tidak di dalam medan pertarungan, dia masih tetap bisa melindungi Fischl melalui mata burung gagaknya. Saat Fischl menyerang musuh dengan Normal Attack, Oz akan melancarkan serangan terkoordinasi melalui mata burung gagaknya dan mengakibatkan DMG sebesar 22% ATK.

constellations.name: Devourer of All Sins
constellations.description: When Nightrider is used, it deals an additional 200% ATK as DMG, and its AoE is increased by 50%.
constellations.descriptionId: Menggunakan Nightrider akan mengakibatkan serangan tambahan sebesar 200% ATK, dan meningkatkan 50% area serangan.

constellations.name: Wings of Nightmare
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Nightrider by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.descriptionId:
Meningkatkan 3 level Nightrider.
Maksimum: Lv. 15.

constellations.name: Her Pilgrimage of Bleak
constellations.description:
When Midnight Phantasmagoria is used, it deals 222% of ATK as Electro DMG to surrounding opponents.
When the skill duration ends, Fischl regenerates 20% of her HP.
constellations.descriptionId:
Saat menggunakan Midnight Phantasmagoria, mengakibatkan Electro DMG ke musuh di sekitar sebesar 222% ATK ke musuh di sekitar.
Saat skill berakhir, memulihkan 20% HP Fischl.

constellations.name: Against the Fleeing Light
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Midnight Phantasmagoria by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.descriptionId:
Meningkatkan 3 level Midnight Phantasmagoria.
Maksimum: Lv. 15.

constellations.name: Evernight Raven
constellations.description: Extends the duration of Oz's presence on the field by 2s. Additionally, Oz performs coordinated attacks with your active character when present, dealing 30% of Fischl's ATK as Electro DMG.
constellations.descriptionId: Memperpanjang durasi keberadaan Oz selama 2 detik. Selama di medan pertempuran, Oz akan menyerang bersama Karakter aktif dan mengakibatkan Electro DMG sebesar 30% ATK Fischl.

name: Freminet
title: Yearning for Unseen Depths
description: A reserved young man who is well-versed in diving. Beneath his distant, icy demeanor lies a pure heart bereft of all flaws.
descriptionId: Anak muda pendiam yang jago menyelam. Di balik pembawaannya yang dingin dan tidak ramah, tersembunyi hati yang murni penuh ketulusan.

talents.name: Flowing Eddies
talents.description:
Normal Attack
Performs up to 4 consecutive strikes.

Charged Attack
Drains Stamina over time to perform continuous spinning attacks against all nearby opponents.
At the end of the sequence, performs a more powerful slash. 

Plunging Attack
Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground below, damaging opponents along the path and dealing AoE DMG upon impact.
talents.descriptionId:
Normal Attack
Melancarkan hingga 4 serangan berturut-turut.

Charged Attack
Terus menguras Stamina untuk melancarkan serangan berputar yang mengakibatkan DMG ke musuh di sekitar.
Diakhiri dengan sebuah tebasan yang kuat.

Plunging Attack
Menerjang dari udara untuk menghantam tanah, menyerang musuh di jalur terjangan dan mengakibatkan DMG Area saat mendarat.

talents.name: Pressurized Floe
talents.description:
Performs an upward thrust that deals Cryo DMG and causes Freminet to enter Pers Timer for 10s.
While Pers Timer is active, his Elemental Skill will turn into Shattering Pressure.

Shattering Pressure
Executes different sorts of attacks based on the Pressure Level of Pers Timer, and then cancels Pers Timer.
·Level 0: Unleashes a vertical cut, dealing Cryo DMG.
·Levels 1 to 3: Unleashes a vertical cut alongside Pers, dealing Cryo DMG and Physical DMG. DMG dealt scales based on Pressure Level.
·Level 4: Borrows the power of a fully-pressurized Pers to deal Physical DMG. Meanwhile, Normal Attack: Flowing Eddies will be replaced by Shattering Pressure.

Pers Timer
When Freminet uses Normal Attacks, he will also unleash waves of frost that deal Cryo DMG and increase Pers's Pressure Level.
The accompanying Cryo DMG dealt this way is considered Elemental Skill DMG.

Arkhe: Pneuma
At certain intervals, after using the upward thrust, a Spiritbreath Thorn in the form of another upward thrust will be created, dealing Pneuma-aligned Cryo DMG.
talents.descriptionId:
Melancarkan serangan ke atas dan mengakibatkan Cryo DMG, lalu memasuki status Pers Timer selama 10 detik.
Saat Freminent berada dalam status Pers Timer, Elemental Skill-nya akan berubah menjadi Shattering Pressure.

Shattering Pressure
Melancarkan serangan yang berbeda berdasarkan level Pressure dari status Pers Timer, lalu menghapus status Pers Timer:
·Level 0: Melancarkan tebasan vertikal yang mengakibatkan Cryo DMG.
·Level 1-3: Melancarkan tebasan vertikal bersamaan dengan Pers yang mengakibatkan Cryo DMG dan Physical DMG. DMG yang dihasilkan juga akan berbeda berdasarkan level Pressure.
·Level 4: Meminjam kekuatan Pers yang penuh dengan tekanan untuk mengakibatkan Physical DMG. Saat ini, "Normal Attack: Flowing Eddies" akan diubah menjadi Shattering Pressure.

Pers Timer
Saat Freminet melancarkan Normal Attack, akan melancarkan gelombang Frost yang mengakibatkan Cryo DMG dan juga akan meningkatkan level Pressure Pers.
Cryo DMG yang dihasilkan di saat yang bersamaan akan dianggap sebagai DMG Elemental Skill.

Arkhe: Pneuma
Setiap kurun waktu tertentu, setelah melancarkan serangan ke atas, Spiritbreath Thorn akan tercipta dalam bentuk serangan ke atas tambahan, yang mengakibatkan Pneuma-aligned Cryo DMG.

talents.name: Shadowhunter's Ambush
talents.description:
Unleashes a wave of untouchable cold, dealing AoE Cryo DMG, resetting the CD of the Elemental Skill "Pressurized Floe," and causing Freminet to enter the Subnautical Hunter mode for 10s.

While in Subnautical Hunter mode, Freminet's resistance to interruption will increase, and his Elemental Skill "Pressurized Floe" will obtain the following buffs:
·CD is decreased by 70%.
·Normal Attacks will increase the Pers Timer by 1 additional Pressure Level, and the frost released by his Normal Attacks deal 200% of their original DMG.

These effects will be canceled when Freminet leaves the field.
talents.descriptionId:
Melancarkan aura dingin yang tidak dapat disentuh dan mengakibatkan Cryo DMG Area, memulihkan kembali Cooldown Elemental Skill "Pressurized Floe" dan membuat Freminet memasuki status Subnautical Hunter selama 10 detik.

Selama berada dalam status Subnautical Hunter, ketahanan Freminet terhadap interupsi meningkat dan Elemental Skill "Pressurized Floe" akan mendapatkan buff berikut:
·Cooldown berkurang 70%.
·Saat melancarkan Normal Attack, akan meningkatkan satu level Pressure dari Pers Timer dan DMG gelombang Frost yang dihasilkan oleh Normal Attack-nya menjadi 200% dari nilai awalnya.

Efek ini akan dihapus jika Freminet meninggalkan medan pertempuran.

passives.name: Saturation Deep Dive
passives.description: When Freminet unleashes Pressurized Floe: Shattering Pressure, if Pers Timer has yet to reach Pressure Level 4, the CD of Pressurized Floe will be decreased by 1s.
passives.descriptionId: Saat melancarkan Pressurized Floe: Shattering Pressure, jika level Pressure milik Pers Timer di bawah level 4, maka durasi Cooldown Pressurized Floe berkurang 1 detik.

passives.name: Parallel Condensers
passives.description: When Freminet triggers Shatter against opponents, the DMG dealt by Pressurized Floe: Shattering Pressure will be increased by 40% for 5s.
passives.descriptionId: Setelah Freminet memicu reaksi Shatter terhadap musuh, DMG yang diakibatkan Pressurized Floe: Shattering Pressure akan meningkat 40% selama 5 detik.

passives.name: Deepwater Navigation
passives.description:
Decreases Aquatic Stamina consumption for your own party members by 35%.
Not stackable with Passive Talents that provide the exact same effects.
passives.descriptionId:
Mengurangi 35% konsumsi Aquatic Stamina Karakter party sendiri di dalam air.
Efek ini tidak dapat ditumpuk dengan Talenta Pasif lain dengan efek yang sama persis.

constellations.name: Dreams of the Foamy Deep
constellations.description: The CRIT Rate of Pressurized Floe: Shattering Pressure will be increased by 15%.
constellations.descriptionId: CRIT Rate Pressurized Floe: Shattering Pressure meningkat 15%.

constellations.name: Penguins and the Land of Plenty
constellations.description: Unleashing Pressurized Floe: Shattering Pressure will restore 2 Energy to Freminet. If a Pressure Level 4 Shattering Pressure is unleashed, this will restore 3 Energy.
constellations.descriptionId: Melancarkan Pressurized Floe: Shattering Pressure akan memulihkan 2 poin Energy Freminet. Jika yang dilancarkan adalah Shattering Pressure Level 4, maka akan memulihkan 3 poin Energy.

constellations.name: Song of the Eddies and Bleached Sands
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Normal Attack: Flowing Eddies by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.descriptionId:
Meningkatkan 3 level Normal Attack: Flowing Eddies.
Maksimum: Lv. 15.

constellations.name: Dance of the Snowy Moon and Flute
constellations.description: After Freminet triggers Frozen, Shatter, Superconduct, or Stellar-Conduct against opponents, his ATK will be increased by 9% for 6s. Max 2 stacks. This can be triggered once every 0.3s.
constellations.descriptionId: Setelah Freminet memicu reaksi Frozen, Shatter, Superconduct, atau Stellar-Conduct terhadap musuh, ATK-nya meningkat 9% selama 6 detik. Efek ini dapat ditumpuk sampai 2 lapis dan dapat terpicu sekali setiap 0,3 detik.

constellations.name: Nights of Hearth and Happiness
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Pressurized Floe by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.descriptionId:
Meningkatkan 3 level Pressurized Floe.
Maksimum: Lv. 15.

constellations.name: Moment of Waking and Resolve
constellations.description: After Freminet triggers Frozen, Shatter, Superconduct, or Stellar-Conduct against opponents, his CRIT DMG will be increased by 12% for 6s. Max 3 stacks. This can be triggered once every 0.3s.
constellations.descriptionId: Setelah Freminet memicu reaksi Frozen, Shatter, Superconduct, atau Stellar-Conduct terhadap musuh, CRIT DMG-nya meningkat 12% selama 6 detik. Efek ini dapat ditumpuk sampai 3 lapis dan dapat terpicu sekali setiap 0,3 detik.

name: Gaming
title: Leonine Vanguard
description: Guard of the Sword and Strongbox Secure Transport Agency, and the head of the "Mighty Mythical Beasts" Wushou troupe.
descriptionId: Pengawal dari Kantor Pengawal "Sword and Strongbox", sekaligus ketua grup Wushou "Wahana Dewata Kencana".
affiliation: Sword and Strongbox Secure Transport Agency

talents.descriptionId:
Normal Attack
Melancarkan hingga 4 serangan berturut-turut.

Terus menguras Stamina untuk melancarkan serangan berputar yang mengakibatkan DMG ke musuh di sekitar.
Diakhiri dengan sebuah tebasan yang kuat.

Plunging Attack
Menerjang dari udara untuk menghantam tanah, menyerang musuh di jalur terjangan, dan mengakibatkan DMG Area saat mendarat.

talents.name: Bestial Ascent
talents.description:
Pounces forward using the Wushou arts, leaping high into the air after coming into contact with a target or surface.
After Gaming has used Bestial Ascent to rise into the air, if he immediately uses a Plunging Attack, he will use the especially powerful Plunging Attack: Charmed Cloudstrider instead.

Plunging Attack: Charmed Cloudstrider
The DMG from Plunging Attacks caused by Bestial Ascent is converted to Pyro DMG that cannot be overridden by other elemental infusions. Upon landing, Gaming will consume a fixed amount of HP. Gaming's HP cannot be reduced below 10% by this method.
Charmed Cloudstrider DMG is considered Plunging Attack DMG.
talents.descriptionId:
Menerjang ke depan dengan teknik Wushou, setelah menyentuh musuh atau permukaan medan maka Gaming akan meloncat tinggi ke udara.
Gaming menggunakan Elemental Skill Bestial Ascent untuk naik ke udara, jika langsung melancarkan Plunging Attack, maka Gaming akan melancarkan Plunging Attack: Charmed Cloudstrider yang sangat kuat.

Plunging Attack: Charmed Cloudstrider
DMG dari Plunging Attack yang dilancarkan melalui Elemental Skill Bestial Ascent akan dikonversi menjadi Pyro DMG yang tidak bisa ditimpa Elemental Infusion lainnya, dan akan mengonsumsi sejumlah HP Gaming saat dia mendarat. HP Gaming tidak bisa berkurang hingga di bawah 10% Max HP-nya melalui cara ini.
DMG Charmed Cloudstrider dianggap sebagai DMG Plunging Attack.

talents.name: Suanni's Gilded Dance
talents.description:
Gaming enters Wushou Stance, briefly applying Pyro to him, recovering a fixed amount of HP, and summons his companion, the Suanni Man Chai, to smash into his target, dealing AoE Pyro DMG.
After bashing its target, Man Chai will roll to a nearby location before moving towards Gaming. When it links up with Gaming, Man Chai will leave the field and reset the CD for Gaming's Elemental Skill, Bestial Ascent.
While Wushou Stance is active, his resistance to interruption is increased, and when Gaming lands with Charmed Cloudstrider attack or completes the forward pounce attack from Bestial Ascent with over 50% HP, he will summon Man Chai again.
Each Gaming can only have 1 Man Chai on the field simultaneously.
This effect will be canceled once Gaming leaves the field.
talents.descriptionId:
Gaming memasuki Wushou Stance, lalu terpengaruh oleh Pyro selama waktu singkat, memulihkan HP dalam jumlah tertentu, dan memanggil rekannya yang bisa diandalkan yakni Suanni Man Chai untuk menghantam targetnya dan mengakibatkan Pyro DMG Area.
Setelah Man Chai menghantam targetnya, dia akan berguling ke sekitarnya, lalu bergerak kembali ke arah Gaming. Saat berkumpul kembali dengan Gaming, Suanni Man Chai akan meninggalkan medan pertempuran, dan CD Elemental Skill Bestial Ascent akan diperbarui.
Selama Wushou Stance berlangsung, ketahanan Gaming terhadap interupsi meningkat. Saat Plunging Attack: Charmed Cloudstrider menyentuh tanah atau terjangan ke depan Bestial Ascent berakhir, jika HP Gaming lebih dari 50%, maka dia akan memanggil Suanni Man Chai lagi.
Maksimum hanya satu Suanni Man Chai milik Gaming sendiri yang bisa ada di medan pertempuran dalam waktu yang bersamaan.
Efek ini akan hilang saat Gaming meninggalkan medan pertempuran.

passives.name: Dance of Amity
passives.description: After Bestial Ascent's Plunging Attack: Charmed Cloudstrider hits an opponent, Gaming will regain 1.5% of his Max HP once every 0.2s for 0.8s.
passives.descriptionId: Setelah Plunging Attack: Charmed Cloudstrider dari Bestial Ascent mengenai musuh, Gaming akan memulihkan HP setara dengan 1,5% Max HP Gaming sekali setiap 0,2 detik selama 0,8 detik.

passives.name: Air of Prosperity
passives.description: When Gaming has less than 50% HP, he will receive a 20% Incoming Healing Bonus. When Gaming has 50% HP or more, Plunging Attack: Charmed Cloudstrider will deal 20% more DMG.
passives.descriptionId: Saat HP Gaming di bawah 50%, mendapatkan 20% Bonus Pemulihan. Saat HP Gaming sama dengan atau di atas 50%, DMG yang diakibatkan Plunging Attack: Charmed Cloudstrider meningkat 20%.

passives.name: The Striding Beast
passives.description:
During the day (06:00 – 18:00), your party members gain the Swift Stride effect: Movement SPD increased by 10%.
Does not take effect in Domains, Trounce Domains, or Spiral Abyss. Swift Stride does not stack.
passives.descriptionId:
Saat siang hari (06:00 - 18:00), anggota party sendiri mendapatkan efek Swift Stride: meningkatkan 10% Movement SPD.
Efek ini tidak aktif dalam Domain, Domain Trounce, atau Spiral Abyss. Efek Swift Stride tidak dapat ditumpuk.

constellations.name: Bringer of Blessing
constellations.description: When the Suanni Man Chai from Suanni's Gilded Dance meets back up with Gaming, it will heal 15% of Gaming's HP.
constellations.descriptionId: Saat Suanni Man Chai dari Suanni's Gilded Dance berkumpul kembali dengan Gaming, akan memulihkan 15% HP Gaming.

constellations.name: Plum Blossoms Underfoot
constellations.description: When Gaming receives healing and this instance of healing overflows, his ATK will be increased by 20% for 5s.
constellations.descriptionId: Saat Gaming menerima pemulihan, jika jumlah pemulihan kali ini berlebih, ATK Gaming akan meningkat 20% selama 5 detik.

constellations.name: Awakening Spirit
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Bestial Ascent by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.descriptionId:
Meningkatkan 3 level Bestial Ascent.
Maksimum: Lv. 15.

constellations.name: Soar Across Mountains
constellations.description: When Bestial Ascent's Plunging Attack: Charmed Cloudstrider hits an opponent, it will restore 2 Energy to Gaming. This effect can be triggered once every 0.2s.
constellations.descriptionId: Saat Plunging Attack: Charmed Cloudstrider dari Bestial Ascent mengenai musuh, akan memulihkan 2 poin Energy Gaming. Efek ini dapat terpicu sekali setiap 0,2 detik.

constellations.name: Evil-Daunting Roar
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Suanni's Gilded Dance by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.descriptionId:
Meningkatkan 3 level Suanni's Gilded Dance.
Maksimum: Lv. 15.

constellations.name: To Tame All Beasts
constellations.description: Bestial Ascent's Plunging Attack: Charmed Cloudstrider CRIT Rate increased by 20% and CRIT DMG increased by 40%, and its attack radius will be increased.
constellations.descriptionId: Plunging Attack: Charmed Cloudstrider dari Bestial Ascent mendapatkan peningkatan 20% CRIT Rate dan 40% CRIT DMG, radius serangannya juga meningkat.

name: Gorou
title: Canine Warrior
description: The great general of Watatsumi Island's forces. He is deeply trusted by his subordinates.
descriptionId: Jenderal pasukan di Pulau Watatsumi. Dia sangat dipercaya anak buahnya.

talents.name: Ripping Fang Fletching
talents.description:
Normal Attack
Performs up to 4 consecutive shots with a bow.

Charged Attack
Performs a more precise Aimed Shot with increased DMG.
While aiming, stone crystals will accumulate on the arrowhead. A fully charged crystalline arrow will deal Geo DMG.

Plunging Attack
Fires off a shower of arrows in mid-air before falling and striking the ground, dealing AoE DMG upon impact.
talents.descriptionId:
Normal Attack
Melancarkan hingga 4 serangan berturut-turut menggunakan busur.

Charged Attack
Melancarkan sebuah Serangan Membidik yang lebih akurat untuk mengakibatkan DMG lebih besar.
Saat membidik, kristal batu akan berkumpul di ujung anak panah. Setelah terkumpul penuh, anak panah yang diluncurkan akan mengakibatkan Geo DMG.

Plunging Attack
Melancarkan hujan panah dari udara dan menerjang tanah dengan kecepatan tinggi, mengakibatkan DMG Area saat mendarat.

talents.name: Inuzaka All-Round Defense
talents.description:
Deals AoE Geo DMG and sets up a General's War Banner.

General's War Banner
Provides up to 3 buffs to active characters within the skill's AoE based on the number of Geo characters in the party at the time of casting:
· 1 Geo character: Adds "Standing Firm" - DEF Bonus.
· 2 Geo characters: Adds "Impregnable" - Increased resistance to interruption.
· 3 Geo characters: Adds "Crunch" - Geo DMG Bonus.

Gorou can deploy only 1 General's War Banner on the field at any one time. Characters can only benefit from 1 General's War Banner at a time. When a party member leaves the field, the active buff will last for 2s.

Hold
Adjust the location of the skill.
talents.descriptionId:
Mengakibatkan Geo DMG Area dan mendirikan General's War-Banner.

General's War-Banner
Memberikan buff berikut kepada Karakter aktif di dalam area skill, berdasarkan jumlah Karakter Geo di dalam party saat Banner didirikan:
·Satu Karakter — memberikan efek "Standing Firm": Bonus DEF.
·Dua Karakter — memberikan efek "Impregnable": Bonus DEF dan meningkatkan pertahanan terhadap interupsi.
·Tiga Karakter — memberikan efek "Crunch": Bonus DEF, peningkatan pertahanan terhadap interupsi, dan memberikan Bonus Geo DMG.

Hanya bisa ada 1 General's War-Banner ciptaan Gorou yang ada di medan pertempuran dalam waktu bersamaan. Karakter hanya dapat memperoleh buff dari 1 General's War-Banner. Setelah Karakter meninggalkan area General's War-Banner, efek buff tersebut akan berlanjut selama 2 detik.

Mode Tahan
Dapat menyesuaikan posisi skill.

talents.name: Juuga: Forward Unto Victory
talents.description:
Displaying his valor as a general, Gorou deals AoE Geo DMG and creates a field known as General's Glory to embolden his comrades.

General's Glory
This field has the following properties:
· Like the General's War Banner created by Inuzaka All-Round Defense, provides buffs to active characters within the skill's AoE based on the number of Geo characters in the party. Also moves together with your active character.
· Generates 1 Crystal Collapse every 1.5s that deals AoE Geo DMG to 1 opponent within the skill's AoE.
· Pulls 1 elemental shard in the skill's AoE to your active character's position every 1.5s (elemental shards are created by Crystallize reactions).

If a General's War Banner created by Gorou currently exists on the field when this ability is used, it will be destroyed. In addition, for the duration of General's Glory, Gorou's Elemental Skill "Inuzaka All-Round Defense" will not create the General's War Banner.
 If Gorou falls, the effects of General's Glory will be cleared.
talents.descriptionId:
Dengan menunjukkan kewibawaan sebagai jenderal, Gorou mengakibatkan Geo DMG Area dan menciptakan area General's Glory untuk menyalakan semangat rekan-rekannya.

General's Glory
Memiliki karakteristik berikut:
·Area ini memiliki efek yang persis seperti efek General's War Banner dari Elemental Skill Gorou, Inuzaka All-Round Defense, yang memberikan buff pada Karakter aktif di dalam area skill sesuai dengan jumlah Karakter Geo dalam party. Area ini juga akan mengikuti pergerakan Karakter aktif.
·Menciptakan 1 Crystal Collapse setiap 1,5 detik yang mengakibatkan Geo DMG Area pada 1 musuh di lingkup area.
·Crystal Collapse juga akan menarik 1 Elemental Shard yang terbentuk dari Reaksi Crystallize dalam area tersebut ke posisi Karakter aktif setiap 1,5 detik.

Bila General's War-Banner ciptaan Gorou sendiri berada di medan pertempuran saat melancarkan skill ini, maka General's War-Banner tersebut akan hancur. Selain itu, selama durasi General's Glory berlangsung, General's War-Banner tidak akan tercipta saat Gorou sendiri melancarkan Elemental Skill "Inuzaka All-Round Defense".
Efek General's Glory milik Gorou sendiri akan hilang ketika Gorou gugur.

passives.name: Heedless of the Wind and Weather
passives.description: After using Juuga: Forward Unto Victory, all nearby party members' DEF is increased by 25% for 12s.
passives.descriptionId: Meningkatkan 25% DEF seluruh anggota party di sekitar selama 12 detik setelah melancarkan Juuga: Forward Unto Victory.

passives.name: A Favor Repaid
passives.description:
Gorou receives the following DMG Bonuses to his attacks based on his DEF:
· Inuzaka All-Round Defense: Skill DMG increased by 156% of DEF
· Juuga: Forward Unto Victory: Skill DMG and Crystal Collapse DMG increased by 15.6% of DEF
passives.descriptionId:
Berdasarkan DEF-nya, Gorou memperoleh Bonus DMG berikut:
·Meningkatkan DMG skill Inuzaka All-Round Defense sebesar 156% DEF Gorou.
·Meningkatkan DMG skill Juuga: Forward Unto Victory dan DMG Crystal Collapse sebesar 15,6% DEF Gorou.

passives.name: Seeker of Shinies
passives.description: Displays the location of nearby resources unique to Inazuma on the mini-map.
passives.descriptionId: Memperlihatkan lokasi produk khas Inazuma di sekitar pada peta kecil.

constellations.name: Rushing Hound: Swift as the Wind
constellations.description:
When characters (other than Gorou) within the AoE of Gorou's General's War Banner or General's Glory deal Geo DMG to opponents, the CD of Gorou's Inuzaka All-Round Defense is decreased by 2s.
This effect can occur once every 10s.
constellations.descriptionId:
Setelah Karakter aktif (selain Gorou sendiri) mengakibatkan Geo DMG saat berada dalam Area General's War-Banner atau General's Glory ciptaan Gorou sendiri, durasi CD Inuzaka All-Round Defense milik Gorou akan berkurang 2 detik.
Efek ini dapat terpicu sekali setiap 10 detik.

constellations.name: Sitting Hound: Steady as a Clock
constellations.description:
While General's Glory is in effect, its duration is extended by 1s when a nearby active character obtains an Elemental Shard from a Crystallize reaction, or triggers a Lunar-Crystallize reaction. 
This effect can occur once every 0.1s. Max extension is 3s.
constellations.descriptionId:
Selama durasi General's Glory berlangsung, setelah Karakter aktif di sekitar memperoleh Elemental Shard dari reaksi Crystallize atau memicu reaksi Lunar-Crystallize, maka durasi General's Glory milik Gorou sendiri akan bertambah 1 detik.
Efek ini dapat terpicu sekali setiap 0,1 detik dan durasi General's Glory dapat bertambah hingga 3 detik dengan cara ini.

constellations.name: Mauling Hound: Fierce as Fire
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Inuzaka All-Round Defense by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.descriptionId:
Meningkatkan 3 level Inuzaka All-Round Defense.
Maksimum: Lv.15.

constellations.name: Lapping Hound: Warm as Water
constellations.description: When General's Glory is in the "Impregnable" or "Crunch" states, it will also heal active characters within its AoE by 50% of Gorou's own DEF every 1.5s.
constellations.descriptionId: Saat General's Glory berada dalam status "Impregnable" atau "Crunch", maka HP Karakter aktif yang berada di dalam area General's Glory akan dipulihkan sebesar 50% DEF Gorou sendiri setiap 1,5 detik.

constellations.name: Striking Hound: Thunderous Force
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Juuga: Forward Unto Victory by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.descriptionId:
Meningkatkan 3 level Juuga: Forward Unto Victory.
Maksimum: Lv. 15.

constellations.name: Valiant Hound: Mountainous Fealty
constellations.description:
For 12s after using Inuzaka All-Round Defense or Juuga: Forward Unto Victory, increases the CRIT DMG of all nearby party members' Geo DMG based on the buff level of the skill's field at the time of use:
· "Standing Firm": +10%
· "Impregnable": +20%
· "Crunch": +40%

This effect cannot stack and will take reference from the last instance of the effect that is triggered.
constellations.descriptionId:
Dalam 12 detik setelah menggunakan Inuzaka All-Round Defense atau Juuga: Forward Unto Victory, Gorou akan meningkatkan CRIT DMG untuk Geo DMG milik seluruh anggota party di sekitar sesuai dengan level area Gorou saat skill ini dilancarkan:
·Standing Firm: Meningkatkan 10%.
·Impregnable: Meningkatkan 20%.
·Crunch: Meningkatkan 40%.

Efek ini tidak bisa ditumpuk, yang terhitung adalah yang terakhir kali aktif.

name: Iansan
title: Tempered in Molten Stone
description: Head coach of the fitness club at the Collective of Plenty, and a renowned Natlanese nutritionist.
descriptionId: Kepala pelatih di klub fitnes suku Berlimpah Jaya, merupakan seorang ahli gizi yang terkenal di Natlan.

talents.name: Weighted Spike
talents.description:
Normal Attack
Performs up to 3 consecutive spear strikes.

Charged Attack
Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to lunge forward, dealing damage to opponents along the way.

Plunging Attack
Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground below, damaging opponents along the path and dealing AoE DMG upon impact.

Nightsoul State: Swift Stormflight
While in the Nightsoul's Blessing state: Iansan's Charged Attack will be transformed into the formidable Swift Stormflight, consuming a certain amount of Stamina to stomp fiercely down, dealing Nightsoul-aligned AoE Electro DMG.
talents.descriptionId:
Normal Attack
Melancarkan hingga 3 serangan tombak berturut-turut.

Charged Attack
Mengonsumsi sejumlah Stamina untuk menerjang ke depan, mengakibatkan DMG pada musuh di jalur terjangan.

Plunging Attack
Menerjang dari udara untuk menghantam tanah di bawahnya, menyerang musuh di jalur terjangan dan mengakibatkan DMG area saat mendarat.

Nightsoul State: Swift Stormflight
Saat berada dalam status Nightsoul's Blessing: Charged Attack Iansan akan berubah menjadi Swift Stormflight yang kuat, mengonsumsi sejumlah Stamina untuk menginjak tanah dengan kuat dan mengakibatkan Nightsoul-aligned Electro DMG Area.

talents.name: Thunderbolt Rush
talents.description:
Iansan charges forward a certain distance, dealing Nightsoul-aligned Electro DMG to all opponents in her path.
After this Skill is used, Iansan will regain 54 Nightsoul points and enter the Nightsoul's Blessing state. Within 5s after this is done, using a Normal Attack will trigger 1 quick Swift Stormflight stomp from Iansan that will not consume Stamina.

Nightsoul's Blessing: Iansan
Continuously consumes Nightsoul points. If she runs out, or uses this Skill again, her Nightsoul's Blessing state will end. It has the following properties:
· Increases Iansan's Movement SPD.
· Holding sprint will switch Iansan to Rushing Thunderbolt mode, greatly increasing her Movement SPD temporarily. In this mode, Iansan can make flying leaps using terrain, or consume additional Nightsoul points to move on water or liquid Phlogiston while being immune to DMG from the latter.
talents.descriptionId:
Iansan menerjang maju dan mengakibatkan Nightsoul-aligned Electro DMG terhadap seluruh musuh dalam jalur terjangannya.
Setelah dilancarkan, Iansan akan memulihkan 54 poin Nightsoul dan memasuki status Nightsoul's Blessing. Menekan Normal Attack dalam kurun waktu 5 detik setelah terjangannya berakhir akan membuat Iansan melancarkan satu injakan Swift Stormflight yang tidak mengonsumsi Stamina.

Nightsoul's Blessing: Iansan
Terus mengonsumsi poin Nightsoul. Saat poin Nightsoul habis dikonsumsi atau saat skill ini dilancarkan sekali lagi, maka Nightsoul's Blessing Iansan akan berakhir. Status Nightsoul's Blessing memiliki karakteristik berikut:
·Meningkatkan Movement SPD Iansan.
·Menahan tombol "Lari" akan membuat Iansan memasuki mode Rushing Thunderbolt yang meningkatkan Movement SPD Iansan secara signifikan dalam waktu singkat. Dalam mode ini, Iansan dapat menggunakan perbedaan medan untuk melompat, atau mengonsumsi poin Nightsoul tambahan untuk bergerak di atas permukaan air atau Phlogiston cair, dan kebal terhadap DMG dari Phlogiston cair.

talents.name: The Three Principles of Power
talents.description:
Iansan's stomping foot shatters the very earth with "Power," dealing Nightsoul-aligned AoE Electro DMG. She then whips out her "Limited-Edition Kinetic Energy Scale (For Workouts)."
When this Skill is used, Iansan will gain 15 Nightsoul points and enter the Nightsoul's Blessing state.
When the Kinetic Energy Scale leaves the field, Iansan's Nightsoul's Blessing state will end.

Kinetic Energy Scale
The Kinetic Energy Scale will follow the character around, boosting the ATK of your current active party member in different ways based on Iansan's Nightsoul points.
· If Iansan has less than 42 Nightsoul points, the ATK bonus will be based on her Nightsoul points and ATK.
· If Iansan has at least 42 Nightsoul points, the Kinetic Energy Scale will switch to the "Ardent Support!" state, in which the ATK bonus will be stronger and based on her ATK alone.
Additionally, the Scale will log the distance your current active character (excluding Iansan) has moved so long as it is active, restoring Nightsoul points to Iansan every second based on the distance moved in the previous second.
The Scale will disappear once her Nightsoul's Blessing state ends. It will also disappear after 1 second when you are not in a state of combat. While it is active, Iansan's Nightsoul's Blessing state will not end even if she is not on the field.
talents.descriptionId:
Iansan menginjakkan kakinya ke tanah atas nama "Kekuatan" untuk mengakibatkan Nightsoul-aligned Electro DMG Area, lalu mengeluarkan "Kinetic Energy Scale Edisi Terbatas (Khusus Fitnes)" miliknya.
Saat dilancarkan, Iansan akan mendapatkan 15 poin Nightsoul dan memasuki status Nightsoul's Blessing.
Status Nightsoul's Blessing Iansan akan berakhir saat Kinetic Energy Scale keluar dari medan pertempuran.

Kinetic Energy Scale
Kinetic Energy Scale akan mengikuti gerakan Karakter dan meningkatkan ATK Karakter aktifmu dengan cara yang berbeda-beda berdasarkan poin Nightsoul Iansan:
·Jika poin Nightsoul Iansan kurang dari 42 poin, akan mendapatkan bonus ATK berdasarkan poin Nightsoul dan ATK Iansan.
·Jika Iansan memiliki setidaknya 42 poin Nightsoul, Kinetic Energy Scale akan beralih ke mode "Ardent Support!", lalu memberikan bonus ATK yang lebih tinggi berdasarkan ATK Iansan.
Selain itu, selama Kinetic Energy Scale aktif, ia akan mencatat jarak gerakan Karakter aktif di dalam party (selain Iansan). Kemudian Kinetic Energy Scale akan memulihkan poin Nightsoul Iansan setiap detik berdasarkan jarak gerakan yang tercatat pada detik sebelumnya.
Kinetic Energy Scale akan hilang saat status Nightsoul's Blessing Iansan berakhir. Kinetic Energy Scale akan hilang jika Karakter tidak berada dalam kondisi bertempur selama lebih dari 1 detik. Selama Kinetic Energy Scale masih ada, status Nightsoul's Blessing tidak akan berakhir meskipun Iansan tidak berada di medan pertempuran.

passives.name: Enhanced Resistance Training
passives.description:
After Swift Stormflight hits opponents, Iansan will gain the Precise Movement effect for 15s.
During this time, her ATK is increased by 20%, and whenever she regains Nightsoul points through the Kinetic Energy Scale in her Elemental Burst, The Three Principles of Power, she will gain 1 extra Nightsoul point. Additionally, when your current active party member consumes or restores Nightsoul points, the extra Nightsoul points Iansan gains the next time she restores Nightsoul points via the Scale will be increased to 4. This effect can occur once every 2.8s.
"Precise Movement" will expire when Iansan's Nightsoul's Blessing state ends.
passives.descriptionId:
Setelah Swift Stormflight mengenai musuh, akan mendapatkan efek Precise Movement selama 15 detik.
Selama durasi ini, ATK Iansan meningkat 20%. Setiap kali Kinetic Energy Scale dari Elemental Burst The Three Principles of Power memulihkan poin Nightsoul, maka dia akan memulihkan 1 poin Nightsoul tambahan. Selain itu, setelah Karakter aktif di dalam party mengonsumsi atau memulihkan poin Nightsoul, maka poin Nightsoul tambahan yang didapat saat Kinetic Energy Scale memulihkan poin Nightsoul berikutnya akan bertambah menjadi 4 poin. Efek ini dapat terpicu sekali setiap 2,8 detik.
Efek "Precise Movement" juga akan hilang setelah Nightsoul's Blessing Iansan berakhir.

passives.name: Kinetic Energy Gradient Test
passives.description:
When a nearby party member triggers a Nightsoul Burst, Iansan will obtain the Warming Up effect for 10s.
During this time, when Iansan restores at least 1 Nightsoul point, she will heal your current active character for 60% of her ATK. This effect can be triggered once every 2.8s.
passives.descriptionId:
Saat anggota party di sekitar memicu Nightsoul Burst, Iansan akan mendapatkan efek Warming Up selama 10 detik.
Selama durasi ini, saat Iansan memulihkan setidaknya 1 poin Nightsoul, ia akan memulihkan HP Karakter aktif sebesar 60% ATK Iansan. Efek ini dapat terpicu sekali setiap 2,8 detik.

passives.name: Night Realm's Gift: Hard Work and Drive
passives.description:
After Nightsoul points have been fully depleted and Iansan is on the field, she will switch to using Phlogiston to maintain her Nightsoul's Blessing.
While in an area with Phlogiston Mechanics within Natlan, Nightsoul Transmission: Iansan can be used. When the current active character is sprinting or in movement modes caused by certain Talents, or at a certain height in the air, switching to Iansan will trigger the following: Iansan enters the Nightsoul's Blessing state and obtains 25 Nightsoul points. Nightsoul Transmission can be triggered once every 10s by your own party.
While in an area with Phlogiston Mechanics within Natlan, Iansan will not take fall DMG when using terrain differences to make leaps.
passives.descriptionId:
Setelah poin Nightsoul habis terpakai, Iansan akan mengonsumsi Phlogiston untuk mempertahankan status Nightsoul's Blessing-nya.
Saat ada area dengan Phlogiston Mechanic di Natlan, dapat melancarkan Nightsoul Transmission: Iansan. Saat Karakter aktif sedang berlari atau bergerak yang dikarenakan oleh Talenta tertentu, atau saat melayang di ketinggian tertentu, dan mengganti Karakter menjadi Iansan, akan memicu efek: Iansan akan memasuki status Nightsoul's Blessing dan mendapatkan 25 poin Nightsoul. Nightsoul Transmission party sendiri dapat terpicu sekali setiap 10 detik.
Selain itu, saat ada area dengan Phlogiston Mechanic di Natlan, Iansan tidak akan menerima DMG jatuh saat melompat dengan memanfaatkan perbedaan medan.

passives.name: Caloric Balancing Plan
passives.description: While in an area with Phlogiston Mechanics within Natlan, regain 10 Phlogiston when Phlogiston levels drop below 50%. This can occur once every 10s.
passives.descriptionId: Saat berada di area dengan Phlogiston Mechanic di Natlan, Iansan akan memulihkan 10 poin Phlogiston saat nilai Phlogiston berkurang dari lebih dari 50% ke kurang dari 50%. Efek ini dapat terpicu sekali setiap 10 detik.

constellations.name: Starting's Never Easy
constellations.description: When Iansan is in combat and is in the Nightsoul's Blessing state, she will restore 15 Elemental Energy for every 6 Nightsoul points she consumes. This effect can trigger once every 18s.
constellations.descriptionId: Saat Iansan berada dalam kondisi bertempur dan dalam status Nightsoul's Blessing, Iansan akan memulihkan 15 poin Energy ke dirinya sendiri untuk setiap 6 poin Nightsoul yang dikonsumsi. Efek ini dapat terpicu sekali setiap 18 detik.

constellations.name: Laziness is the Enemy!
constellations.description: When using the Elemental Burst The Three Principles of Power, Iansan will also gain the Precise Movement effect from her Ascension Talent "Enhanced Resistance Training" for 15s. Additionally, if Iansan is off-field while Precise Movement is active, she will also increase your current active character's ATK by 30%. You must first unlock the Ascension Talent "Enhanced Resistance Training" to access the above effect.
constellations.descriptionId: Saat melancarkan Elemental Burst The Three Principles of Power, Iansan juga akan mendapatkan efek Precise Movement dari Talenta Ascension "Enhanced Resistance Training" selama 15 detik. Selain itu, saat Iansan ada di dalam party namun sedang tidak berada di medan pertempuran, efek Precise Movement juga akan meningkatkan 30% ATK Karakter aktif. Harus membuka Talenta Ascension "Enhanced Resistance Training" terlebih dahulu untuk mendapatkan efek di atas.

constellations.name: Scientific Diet Planning
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Thunderbolt Rush by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.descriptionId:
Meningkatkan 3 level Elemental Skill Thunderbolt Rush.
Maksimum: Lv. 15.

constellations.name: Slow and Steady Wins the Race
constellations.description:
When the Kinetic Energy Scale is present, Iansan will gain 2 stacks of Surging Force after your current active character (excluding herself) uses their Elemental Burst. The stacks last until the Scale leaves the field, and Surging Force can be gained once per Scale summoning. Whenever Iansan restores Nightsoul points via the Scale, she will consume 1 Surging Force stack and restore 4 additional Nightsoul points.
Additionally, if her Nightsoul restoration from the Scale overflows, Iansan will gain 50% of the overflow the next time she restores Nightsoul points via the Scale.
constellations.descriptionId:
Saat Kinetic Energy Scale aktif, Iansan akan mendapatkan 2 lapis Surging Force setelah Karakter aktif party sendiri (selain Iansan) melancarkan Elemental Burst. Surging Force akan bertahan hingga Kinetic Energy Scale meninggalkan medan pertempuran dan hanya bisa didapatkan satu kali setiap kali memanggil Kinetic Energy Scale. Setiap kali Iansan memulihkan poin Nightsoul melalui Kinetic Energy Scale, maka ia akan mengonsumsi 1 lapis Surging Force untuk memulihkan 4 poin Nightsoul tambahan.
Selain itu, jika pemulihan poin Nightsoul dari Kinetic Energy Scale berlebih, maka pemulihan poin Nightsoul dari Kinetic Energy Scale yang selanjutnya akan bertambah 50% sebesar jumlah yang berlebihan kali ini.

constellations.name: We Can Push It Further!
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of The Three Principles of Power by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.descriptionId:
Meningkatkan 3 level Elemental Burst The Three Principles of Power.
Maksimum: Lv. 15.

constellations.name: Teachings of the Collective of Plenty
constellations.description:
The Kinetic Energy Scale's duration is increased by 3s.
Additionally, when Iansan triggers Nightsoul point restoration, if there is any overflow, she will gain the Extreme Force effect, which increases the DMG dealt by your current active character by 25% for 3s.
constellations.descriptionId:
Durasi Kinetic Energy Scale diperpanjang 3 detik.
Selain itu, ketika Iansan memicu efek pemulihan poin Nightsoul dan pemulihannya melebihi batas maksimum poin Nightsoul, maka Iansan akan mendapatkan efek Extreme Force: meningkatkan 25% DMG yang diakibatkan Karakter aktif milik sendiri di dalam party selama 3 detik.

name: Ifa
title: In the Wake of Wandering Winds
description: A vet from the Flower-Feather Clan who cherishes the life he leads alongside all manner of living things — people, animals, you name it.
descriptionId: Dokter hewan dari suku Bunga Bersayap, yang sangat menyukai kehidupan bersama manusia, hewan, dan makhluk hidup lainnya.

talents.name: Rite of Dispelling Winds
talents.description:
Normal Attack
Performs up to 3 attacks, dealing Anemo DMG.

Charged Attack
Consumes a certain amount of Stamina and fires off a shot, dealing AoE Anemo DMG.

Plunging Attack
Plunges towards the ground from mid-air, damaging all opponents along the path. Deals AoE Anemo DMG upon impact with the ground.
talents.descriptionId:
Normal Attack
Melancarkan hingga 3 serangan dan mengakibatkan Anemo DMG.

Charged Attack
Mengonsumsi sejumlah Stamina dan menembak ke arah depan, mengakibatkan Anemo DMG Area setelah jeda singkat.

Plunging Attack
Menerjang dari udara untuk menghantam tanah, menyerang musuh di jalur terjangan dan mengakibatkan Anemo DMG Area saat mendarat.

talents.name: Airborne Disease Prevention
talents.description:
It's time for the real bash bros to step up! Ifa calls Cacucu in as backup.
After using this skill, Ifa gains 80 Nightsoul points and enters the **Nightsoul's Blessing** state. In the Nightsoul's Blessing state, Ifa will hover with Cacucu's help. When he uses Normal Attacks in this state, he will use different kinds of **Supporting Fire** depending on whether you Tap or Hold, firing Tonicshots that are capable of healing all party members.

Additionally, Holding the Elemental Skill Airborne Disease Prevention while Ifa is in Nightsoul's Blessing will cause him to use a Nightsoul-aligned Plunging Attack. Letting go of the skill button will interrupt this Plunging Attack to maintain his hover. If Ifa lands due to this Plunging Attack, his Nightsoul's Blessing state will end.
talents.descriptionId:
Waktunya memanggil bala bantuan! Maju, bos! Ifa memanggil Cacucu untuk bertempur bersama.
Setelah dilancarkan, Ifa memulihkan 80 poin Nightsoul-nya dan memasuki status **Nightsoul's Blessing**. Selama durasi Nightsoul's Blessing, Ifa akan melayang dengan bantuan Cacucu. Saat melancarkan Normal Attack dalam status ini, serangannya akan dikonversi menjadi **Supporting Fire** yang berbeda berdasarkan Mode Tekan dan Mode Tahan, untuk menembakkan Tonicshot yang dapat memulihkan HP seluruh anggota party.

Selain itu, saat berada dalam status Nightsoul's Blessing dan Ifa melancarkan Elemental Skill Airborne Disease Prevention dalam Mode Tahan, maka Ifa akan melancarkan Nightsoul-aligned Plunging Attack. Melepaskan tombol skill akan menghentikan Plunging Attack ini agar Ifa tetap melayang di udara. Jika Ifa menyentuh tanah saat melancarkan Plunging Attack, maka status Nightsoul's Blessing-nya akan berakhir.

talents.name: Compound Sedation Field
talents.description:
Fires a Therapeutic Sedative at a (temporarily aggressive) opponent. The sedative will explode on impact, creating a restraining wind current that pulls nearby objects and opponents in while dealing Nightsoul-aligned AoE Anemo DMG.
When the Therapeutic Sedative hits an opponent affected by Hydro/Pyro/Cryo/Electro, it will apply a **Sedation Mark** to them.
talents.descriptionId:
Menembakkan sebuah obat penenang kepada musuh (yang masih belum bisa tenang). Obat penenang ini akan meledak setelah mengenai musuh, dan akan menghasilkan pusaran angin pengikat yang dapat menarik item dan musuh di sekitar sambil mengakibatkan Nightsoul-aligned Anemo DMG Area.
Saat obat penenang ini mengenai musuh yang sedang terpengaruh elemen Hydro/Pyro/Cryo/Electro, maka akan memberikan efek **Sedation Mark** kepada musuh-musuh ini.

passives.name: Field Medic's Vision
passives.description: When Ifa is in the Nightsoul's Blessing state, every 1 Nightsoul point out of the current total in his entire party will grant him 1 **Rescue Essentials** point. Rescue Essentials will increase the Swirl, Stellar Swirl, Electro-Charged, and Lunar-Charged reaction DMG dealt by nearby party members.
passives.descriptionId: Saat Ifa berada dalam status Nightsoul's Blessing, setiap poin Nightsoul dari jumlah total yang dimiliki oleh seluruh anggota party akan memberikan Ifa 1 poin **Rescue Essentials**. Rescue Essentials ini akan meningkatkan DMG reaksi Swirl, Stellar Swirl, Electro-Charged, dan Lunar-Charged yang diakibatkan seluruh anggota party di sekitar.

passives.name: Mutual Aid Agreement
passives.description: When nearby party members trigger Nightsoul Bursts, Ifa's Elemental Mastery increases by 80 for 10s.
passives.descriptionId: Saat anggota party di sekitar memicu Nightsoul Burst, Elemental Mastery Ifa meningkat 80 poin selama 10 detik.

passives.name: Night Realm's Gift: Focused Emergency Rescue
passives.description:
After his Nightsoul points are exhausted, Ifa will switch to consuming Phlogiston to maintain his Nightsoul's Blessing.
While in an area with Phlogiston Mechanics within Natlan, he can use Nightsoul Transmission: Ifa. When the active character is a certain height in the air, the following will occur when switching to Ifa: Ifa will enter the Nightsoul's Blessing state and gain 32 Nightsoul points. Nightsoul Transmission can be triggered once every 10s by your own team.
passives.descriptionId:
Setelah poin Nightsoul habis terpakai, Ifa akan mengonsumsi Phlogiston untuk mempertahankan status Nightsoul's Blessing-nya.
Saat ada area dengan Phlogiston Mechanic di Natlan, Ifa bisa melancarkan Nightsoul Transmission: Ifa. Saat Karakter aktif melayang di ketinggian tertentu, dan mengganti Karakter menjadi Ifa, akan memicu efek berikut: Ifa akan memasuki status Nightsoul's Blessing dan mendapatkan 32 poin Nightsoul. Nightsoul Transmission party sendiri dapat terpicu sekali setiap 10 detik.

passives.name: Tactical Warm Compress Bandaging
passives.description: While in an area with Phlogiston Mechanics within Natlan, when the current active party member or indwelt saurian has less than 40% HP, Ifa will consume 10 Phlogiston and restore 40% of their HP. This effect can trigger once every 10s, and does not take effect in Domains, Trounce Domains, or the Spiral Abyss.
passives.descriptionId: Saat ada area dengan Phlogiston Mechanic di Natlan, dan HP Karakter aktif sendiri atau HP Saurian yang menyatu kurang dari 40%, Ifa akan mengonsumsi 10 poin Phlogiston untuk memulihkan 40% HP mereka. Efek ini dapat terpicu setiap 10 detik. Efek ini tidak aktif dalam Domain, Trounce Domain, atau Spiral Abyss.

constellations.name: Vitiferous Elixir's Concoction
constellations.description: When **Supporting Fire** hits an opponent, it will restore 6 Energy for Ifa. One such Energy restoration can be triggered once every 8s.
constellations.descriptionId: Saat **Supporting Fire** mengenai musuh, akan memulihkan 6 poin Energy Ifa. Pemulihan Energy dengan cara ini dapat terpicu sekali setiap 8 detik.

constellations.name: Guiding Spirit of Ballistic Prayer
constellations.description:
When Ifa is in the Nightsoul's Blessing state, every Nightsoul point the party has above a total of 60 will grant Ifa 4 additional **Rescue Essentials** points.
Additionally, Ifa's Rescue Essentials limit is increased by 50.
You must first unlock the Ascension Talent **Field Medic's Vision**.
constellations.descriptionId:
Saat Ifa berada dalam status Nightsoul's Blessing, dari total jumlah poin Nightsoul yang dimiliki seluruh anggota party, untuk setiap poin di atas 60 poin, maka Ifa akan mendapatkan 4 poin **Rescue Essentials** tambahan.
Selain itu, batas Rescue Essentials milik Ifa bertambah 50 poin.
Harus membuka Talenta Ascension **Field Medic's Vision** terlebih dahulu.

constellations.name: Rebuttal in Negotiations With the Night
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of **Airborne Disease Prevention** by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.descriptionId:
Meningkatkan 3 level Elemental Skill **Airborne Disease Prevention**.
Maksimum: Lv. 15.

constellations.name: Decayed Vessel's Permutation
constellations.description:
The restraining wind current created by the Elemental Burst **Compound Sedation Field** has its duration extended to 3s.
Additionally, Ifa gains 100 Elemental Mastery for 15s after using his Elemental Burst Compound Sedation Field.
constellations.descriptionId:
Durasi pusaran angin pengikat yang dihasilkan Elemental Burst **Compound Sedation Field** diperpanjang menjadi 3 detik.
Selain itu, setelah melancarkan Elemental Burst Compound Sedation Field, Elemental Mastery Ifa meningkat 100 poin selama 15 detik.

constellations.name: Vow of Universal Coexistence
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of **Compound Sedation Field** by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.descriptionId:
Meningkatkan 3 level Elemental Burst **Compound Sedation Field**.
Maksimum: Lv. 15.

constellations.name: Oath on a Feathered Knot
constellations.description:
When Ifa uses the Hold version of his **Supporting Fire**, there is a 50% chance that he will fire an additional Tonicshot that deals 120% of Ifa's ATK as Anemo DMG. This DMG is considered Normal Attack DMG.
Additionally, when he is not in combat, Ifa will consume 20% less Nightsoul points and Phlogiston in his Nightsoul's Blessing state.
constellations.descriptionId:
Saat Ifa menggunakan **Supporting Fire** dalam Mode Tahan, ada 50% kemungkinan untuk menembakkan satu Tonicshot tambahan yang mengakibatkan Anemo DMG sebesar 120% ATK Ifa. DMG ini dianggap sebagai DMG Normal Attack.
Selain itu, saat tidak dalam kondisi bertempur, konsumsi poin Nightsoul dan Phlogiston Ifa dalam status Nightsoul's Blessing berkurang 20%.

name: Illuga
title: Nightmare's Burning Heart
description: Member of the investigation squad, the Nightmare Orioles. The youngest squad leader among the Lightkeepers.
descriptionId: Anggota tim penyelidik "Nightmare Orioles", kapten paling muda di satuan Lightkeeper.

talents.name: Oathkeeper's Spear
talents.description:
Normal Attack
Performs up to 4 consecutive spear strikes.

Charged Attack
Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to lunge forward, dealing damage to opponents along the way.

Plunging Attack
Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground below, damaging opponents along the path and dealing AoE DMG upon impact.
talents.descriptionId:
Normal Attack
Melancarkan hingga 4 serangan tombak berturut-turut.

Charged Attack
Mengonsumsi sejumlah Stamina untuk menerjang ke depan, mengakibatkan DMG pada musuh di jalur terjangan.

Plunging Attack
Menerjang dari udara untuk menghantam tanah di bawahnya, menyerang musuh di jalur terjangan dan mengakibatkan DMG area saat mendarat.

talents.name: Dawnbearing Songbird
talents.description:
Summons the trusty messenger bird, "Aedon." Different effects are produced depending on whether the skill is Tapped or Held.

Tap
Aedon dashes towards enemies in front, dealing Geo DMG to enemies it comes into contact with.

Hold
Enter aiming mode, and command Aedon to dash towards opponents being aimed at, dealing Geo DMG to opponents it comes into contact with.
talents.descriptionId:
Memanggil burung pembawa pesan bernama "Aedon" untuk bertempur bersama. Skill ini akan menghasilkan efek yang berbeda berdasarkan Mode Tekan atau Mode Tahan.

Mode Tekan
Aedon menerjang ke musuh di depannya dan mengakibatkan Geo DMG terhadap musuh yang dikenainya.

Mode Tahan
Memasuki Mode Membidik, dan memerintahkan Aedon untuk menerjang ke arah musuh yang dibidik, mengakibatkan Geo DMG terhadap musuh yang dikenainya.

talents.name: Shadowless Reflection
talents.description:
Light the lamp, dealing AoE Geo DMG, and gain Haunted Night's Oriole-Song effect for 20s. When this effect is active, Illuga gains 21 stacks of **Nightingale's Song**. When Normal Attacks, Charged Attacks, Plunging Attacks, Elemental Skills, and Elemental Bursts of nearby active party members deal Geo DMG to opponents, 1 stack of Nightingale's Song is consumed to increase the DMG dealt. Increase in DMG is based on Illuga's Elemental Mastery. If DMG is inflicted by Lunar-Crystallize, DMG dealt will increase further.
When Geo DMG dealt in this manner hits multiple opponents, multiple stacks of Nightingale's Song will be consumed, depending on how many opponents are hit.

Additionally, if there are Geo Constructs created by nearby party members on the battlefield while Illuga unleashes his Elemental Burst, or when nearby party members create Geo Constructs while Haunted Night's Oriole-Song is active, every Geo Construct on the battlefield will allow Illuga to gain 5 additional stacks of Nightingale's Song. Within 20s after unleashing his Elemental Burst, Illuga can gain a maximum of 15 additional stacks of Nightingale's Song this way.

When all stacks of Nightingale's Song have been consumed, or when the state's duration ends, the Haunted Night's Oriole-Song effect will end.
talents.descriptionId:
Menyalakan api lentera untuk mengakibatkan Geo DMG Area dan mendapatkan efek "Haunted Night's Oriole-Song" yang bertahan selama 20 detik. Selama durasi ini, Illuga mendapatkan 21 lapis **Nightingale's Song**. Saat Karakter aktif dalam party mengakibatkan Geo DMG terhadap musuh melalui Normal Attack, Charged Attack, Plunging Attack, Elemental Skill, atau Elemental Burst, maka Illuga akan mengonsumsi 1 lapis Nightingale's Song untuk meningkatkan DMG yang diakibatkan berdasarkan Elemental Mastery Illuga. Jika DMG-nya diakibatkan oleh reaksi Lunar-Crystallize, maka peningkatan DMG-nya akan menjadi semakin besar.
Jika Geo DMG yang diakibatkan dengan cara di atas mengenai beberapa musuh sekaligus, maka jumlah lapisan Nightingale's Song akan dikonsumsi akan disesuaikan dengan jumlah musuh yang terkena serangan.

Selain itu, jika Illuga melancarkan Elemental Burst saat ada Geo Construct yang diciptakan oleh Karakter party di sekitar, atau saat Karakter party di sekitar menciptakan Geo Construct selama Haunted Night's Oriole-Song aktif, maka setiap Geo Construct yang ada akan memberikan Illuga 5 lapis Nightingale's Song tambahan. Illuga hanya bisa mendapatkan maksimum 15 lapis Nightingale's Song tambahan dengan cara ini dalam 20 detik setelah melancarkan Elemental Burst.

Efek Haunted Night's Oriole-Song akan berakhir saat seluruh lapisan Nightingale's Song habis atau saat durasi efeknya berakhir.

passives.name: Torchforger's Covenant
passives.description:
After unleashing Elemental Skill **Dawnbearing Songbird** or Elemental Burst **Shadowless Reflection**, other nearby party members will gain the Lightkeeper's Oath effect for 20s: For Geo DMG dealt to opponents, CRIT Rate increases by 5% and CRIT DMG increases by 10%.

Moonsign: Ascendant Gleam 
Party members affected by the Lightkeeper's Oath effect have their Elemental Mastery increased by 50.
passives.descriptionId:
Setelah melancarkan Elemental Skill **Dawnbearing Songbird** atau Elemental Burst **Shadowless Reflection**, anggota party lain di sekitar akan mendapatkan efek "Lightkeeper's Oath" selama 20 detik: Geo DMG yang diakibatkan pada musuh akan mendapatkan CRIT Rate +5% dan CRIT DMG +10%.

Moonsign: Ascendant Gleam
Karakter yang berada dalam pengaruh efek Lightkeeper's Oath akan mendapatkan peningkatan 50 poin Elemental Mastery.

passives.name: Demonhunter's Dusk
passives.description: **Nightingale's Song**'s effects are enhanced: When there are 1/2/3 Hydro or Geo characters in the party, Nightingale's Song will further increase DMG. Increase in DMG is equal to 7%/14%/24% of Illuga's Elemental Mastery. If this aforementioned DMG is inflicted by a Lunar-Crystallize reaction, increase in DMG is equal to 48%/96%/160% of Illuga's Elemental Mastery.
passives.descriptionId: Efek **Nightingale's Song** diperkuat: Saat ada 1/2/3 Karakter Hydro atau Geo di dalam party, Nightingale's Song akan meningkatkan DMG lagi sebesar 7%/14%/24% Elemental Mastery Illuga. Jika DMG yang disebutkan di atas merupakan DMG reaksi Lunar-Crystallize, maka peningkatannya menjadi sebesar 48%/96%/160% Elemental Mastery Illuga.

passives.name: Moonsign Benediction: Unwithering in Winter
passives.description: When Illuga is in the party, the party's Moonsign will increase by 1 level.
passives.descriptionId: Saat Illuga berada di dalam party, Moonsign party meningkat 1 level.

passives.name: Night Warden's Stride
passives.description:
At night (18:00 – 06:00), your party members gain the Swift Stride effect: Movement SPD increased by 10%.
Does not take effect in Domains, Trounce Domains, or Spiral Abyss. Swift Stride does not stack.
Additionally, Illuga appears to be able to decipher the whispers of the Wild Hunt...
passives.descriptionId:
Saat malam hari (18:00 - 06:00), anggota party sendiri mendapatkan efek Swift Stride: meningkatkan 10% Movement SPD.
Efek ini tidak aktif dalam Domain, Domain Trounce, atau Spiral Abyss. Efek Swift Stride tidak dapat ditumpuk.
Selain itu, Illuga sepertinya dapat memahami bisikan Perburuan Liar ....

constellations.name: Vigilant Sentinel
constellations.description: After Illuga triggers a Geo-related Reaction on the field, he will regain 12 Elemental Energy. This effect can be triggered at most once every 15s.
constellations.descriptionId: Setelah Illuga yang berada di medan pertempuran memicu reaksi terkait Geo, dia akan mendapatkan 12 poin Energy. Efek ini dapat terpicu sekali setiap 15 detik.

constellations.name: Elk With Fanged Antlers
constellations.description: When Elemental Burst **Shadowless Reflection**'s Haunted Night's Oriole-Song effect is active, for every 7 stacks of **Nightingale's Song** consumed, Illuga will summon Aedon, dealing a single instance of Geo DMG to 1 nearby opponent. The DMG dealt is based on 400% of Illuga's Elemental Mastery and 200% of his DEF. This DMG is considered Elemental Burst DMG.
constellations.descriptionId: Selama durasi efek Haunted Night's Oriole-Song dari Elemental Burst **Shadowless Reflection** berlangsung, untuk setiap 7 lapis **Nightingale's Song** yang dikonsumsi, Illuga akan memanggil Aedon untuk menyerang satu musuh di sekitar, mengakibatkan satu kali Geo DMG sebesar 400% Elemental Mastery Illuga dan 200% DEF Illuga. DMG ini dianggap sebagai DMG Elemental Burst.

constellations.name: Earthshaking Maw
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Elemental Burst **Shadowless Reflection** by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.descriptionId:
Meningkatkan 3 level Elemental Burst **Shadowless Reflection**.
Maksimum: Lv. 15.

constellations.name: Solarhunting Wolf
constellations.description: When Elemental Burst **Shadowless Reflection**'s Haunted Night's Oriole-Song effect is active, nearby active party members will have their DEF increased by 200.
constellations.descriptionId: Selama efek Haunted Night's Oriole-Song dari Elemental Burst **Shadowless Reflection** aktif, DEF Karakter aktif party di sekitar meningkat 200 poin.

constellations.name: Hurricane Steed
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Elemental Skill **Dawnbearing Songbird** by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.descriptionId:
Meningkatkan 3 level Elemental Skill **Dawnbearing Songbird**.
Maksimum: Lv. 15.

constellations.name: Nightmare Orioles
constellations.description:
Enhances the Lightkeeper's Oath effect of the Ascension Talent **Torchforger's Covenant**: For Geo DMG dealt to opponents, CRIT Rate is increased by 10%, CRIT DMG is increased by 30%.

Moonsign: Ascendant Gleam:
When characters are affected by Lightkeeper's Oath, Elemental Mastery is increased by 80.
You must first unlock the Ascension Talent "Torchforger's Covenant."
constellations.descriptionId:
Efek Lightkeeper's Oath dari Talenta Ascension **Torchforger's Covenant** diperkuat: Geo DMG yang diakibatkan terhadap musuh mendapatkan peningkatan CRIT Rate sebesar 10% dan CRIT DMG sebesar 30%.

Moonsign: Ascendant Gleam
Karakter dalam efek "Lightkeeper's Oath" mendapatkan peningkatan 80 poin Elemental Mastery.
Harus membuka Talenta Ascension Torchforger's Covenant terlebih dahulu.

name: Jahoda
title: Windthreading Shadow
description: The Curatorium of Secrets' extremely reliable, do-it-all super employee (or so she claims).
descriptionId: Karyawan Curatorium of Secrets yang sangat andal dan (mengaku) serba bisa!

talents.name: Strike While the Arrow's Hot
talents.description:
Normal Attack
Performs up to 3 consecutive shots with a bow.

Charged Attack
Performs a more precise Aimed Shot with increased DMG.
While aiming, mighty winds will accumulate on the arrowhead. A fully charged wind arrow will deal Anemo DMG.

Plunging Attack
Fires off a shower of arrows in mid-air before falling and striking the ground, hitting opponents along the path and dealing AoE DMG upon impact.
talents.descriptionId:
Normal Attack
Melancarkan hingga 3 tembakan panah berturut-turut menggunakan busur.

Charged Attack
Melancarkan sebuah Serangan Membidik yang lebih akurat untuk mengakibatkan DMG yang lebih besar.
Saat membidik, angin kuat akan berkumpul di ujung anak panah. Panah dengan angin kuat yang terkumpul penuh akan mengakibatkan Anemo DMG.

Plunging Attack
Melancarkan hujan panah dari udara, menerjang tanah dengan kecepatan tinggi, menyerang musuh di jalur terjangan, dan mengakibatkan DMG Area saat mendarat.

talents.name: Savvy Strategy: Splitting the Spoils
talents.description:
Jahoda dashes toward her opponent, entering the Shadow Pursuit state upon contact. While in this state, Jahoda moves continuously and swiftly: If nearby opponents are affected by Pyro, Hydro, Electro, or Cryo, she will quietly convert her **Purr-loined Treasure Flask** to that element, gradually filling it. When the duration ends or the skill is used again, Jahoda drains the Purr-loined Treasure Flask and deals a single instance of Anemo DMG to nearby opponents. When the Purr-loined Treasure Flask is full, Jahoda immediately drains it, exiting the Shadow Pursuit state and dealing a more powerful instance of Anemo DMG.
If her dash fails to make contact with an opponent, Jahoda instead drops a Smoke Bomb at her location, dealing a single instance of Anemo DMG to nearby opponents.

Moonsign: Ascendant Gleam: When the Purr-loined Treasure Flask becomes full, Jahoda will not immediately discharge it. Instead, for a short duration, she steadily consumes the stored element inside and periodically fires Fluffy Meowballs at nearby opponents, dealing DMG of the corresponding element stored in the Purr-loined Treasure Flask. When a Fluffy Meowball hits an opponent, Jahoda regenerates 2 Elemental Energy. This effect can be triggered once every 3.5s.
talents.descriptionId:
Jahoda menerjang ke arah musuh, dan memasuki status Shadow Pursuit saat menyentuh musuh. Dalam status ini, Jahoda akan terus bergerak cepat. Jika musuh di sekitar sedang terpengaruh oleh Pyro, Hydro, Electro, atau Cryo, maka Jahoda akan diam-diam mengonversi **Purr-loined Treasure Flask** yang dibawanya menjadi jenis elemen yang sesuai dan akan terus mengisinya. Saat durasi skill ini berakhir atau saat dilancarkan sekali lagi, Jahoda akan mengosongkan Purr-loined Treasure Flask ini dan mengakibatkan satu kali Anemo DMG terhadap musuh-musuh di sekitar. Saat Purr-loined Treasure Flask sudah penuh, Jahoda juga akan langsung mengosongkannya, keluar dari status Shadow Pursuit, dan mengakibatkan satu kali Anemo DMG yang lebih kuat terhadap musuh di sekitar.
Jika terjangannya tidak mengenai musuh, Jahoda akan melemparkan sebuah bom asap di posisi berdirinya dan mengakibatkan satu kali Anemo DMG terhadap musuh di sekitar.

Moonsign: Ascendant Gleam: Saat Purr-loined Treasure Flask penuh, Jahoda tidak akan langsung mengosongkannya, melainkan akan terus mengonsumsi elemen yang terkumpul dalam botol selama beberapa waktu, dan secara berkala menembakkan Fluffy Meowball terhadap musuh di sekitar, mengakibatkan DMG dengan jenis elemen yang tersimpan di Purr-loined Treasure Flask. Fluffy Meowball yang mengenai musuh akan memulihkan 2 poin Energy Jahoda. Efek ini hanya dapat terpicu sekali setiap 3,5 detik.

talents.name: Hidden Aces: Seven Tools of the Hunter
talents.description: Time to reveal those pocket aces! Jahoda retrieves 2 **Purrsonal Coordinated Assistance Robots** and deals a single instance of Anemo DMG to nearby opponents.
talents.descriptionId: Saatnya mengeluarkan senjata pamungkas! Jahoda mengeluarkan dua buah **Purrsonal Coordinated Assistance Robot** dan mengakibatkan satu kali Anemo DMG terhadap musuh di sekitar.

passives.name: Plan to Get Paid
passives.description:
When your team has at least one Pyro, Hydro, Electro, or Cryo character, the **Purrsonal Coordinated Assistance Robots** from the Elemental Burst Hidden Aces: Seven Tools of the Hunter will be enhanced based on the number of characters of each corresponding element.
Jahoda secretly keeps track of these characters. Among them, the element with the highest number of characters determines the enhancement effect:
· Pyro: Purrsonal Coordinated Assistance Robots deal 130% of their original DMG.
· Hydro: Purrsonal Coordinated Assistance Robots heal for 120% of their original healing amount.
· Electro: The number of Purrsonal Coordinated Assistance Robots increases by one.
· Cryo: The attack interval of Purrsonal Coordinated Assistance Robots is reduced by 10%.

If there's a tie between elements, the order of priority that determines which enhancement takes effect is: Pyro, Hydro, Electro, then Cryo. Only one elemental effect can initially be triggered.
passives.descriptionId:
Saat terdapat setidaknya 1 Karakter dengan jenis elemen Pyro, Hydro, Electro, atau Cryo dalam party, **Purrsonal Coordinated Assistance Robots** dari Elemental Burst Hidden Aces: Seven Tools of the Hunter akan diperkuat berdasarkan jumlah Karakter dengan jenis elemen yang sesuai dalam party.

Jahoda akan diam-diam mencatat Karakter party dengan jenis elemen yang disebutkan di atas. Di antara Karakter tersebut, jika jumlah Karakter terbanyak adalah:
·Pyro: DMG Purrsonal Coordinated Assistance Robots meningkat menjadi 130% DMG awalnya.
·Hydro: Pemulihan HP Purrsonal Coordinated Assistance Robots menjadi 120% jumlah awalnya.
·Electro: Jumlah Purrsonal Coordinated Assistance Robots bertambah satu.
·Cryo: Jeda antar serangan Purrsonal Coordinated Assistance Robots berkurang 10%.

Jika jumlah Karakter dengan jenis elemen di atas berjumlah sama, maka prioritas buff yang didapat akan mengikuti sesuai urutan berikut: Pyro, Hydro, Electro, kemudian Cryo. Pada awalnya, paling banyak hanya efek dari satu jenis elemen yang dapat aktif.

passives.name: Sweet Berry Bounty
passives.description: When a **Purrsonal Coordinated Assistance Robot** from the Elemental Burst Hidden Aces: Seven Tools of the Hunter triggers healing on an active team member, if that character's HP is above 70%, their Elemental Mastery will be increased by 100 for 6s.
passives.descriptionId: Saat **Purrsonal Coordinated Assistance Robot** dari Elemental Burst Hidden Aces: Seven Tools of the Hunter memicu pemulihan HP terhadap Karakter aktif di dalam party dan jika HP Karakter yang dipulihkan lebih tinggi dari 70%, maka Elemental Mastery Karakter ini meningkat 100 poin selama 6 detik.

passives.name: Moonsign Benediction: Rooftop Dash
passives.description: When Jahoda is in the party, the party's Moonsign will increase by 1 level.
passives.descriptionId: Saat Jahoda berada di dalam party, Moonsign party meningkat 1 level.

passives.name: Backstreet Guile
passives.description: When dispatched on an expedition in Nod-Krai, time consumed is reduced by 25%.
passives.descriptionId: Ketika dikirim untuk melakukan ekspedisi di Nod-Krai, waktu yang dibutuhkan berkurang 25%.

constellations.name: One More Flask!
constellations.description: When a Fluffy Meowball fired by the **Purr-loined Treasure Flask** from the Elemental Skill Savvy Strategy: Splitting the Spoils hits an enemy, there is a 50% chance for it to bounce, dealing the corresponding Elemental DMG to nearby opponents.
constellations.descriptionId: Saat Fluffy Meowball yang ditembakkan oleh **Purr-loined Treasure Flask** dari Elemental Skill Savvy Strategy: Splitting the Spoils mengenai musuh, ada 50% kemungkinan untuk memantul satu kali dan mengakibatkan Elemental DMG dengan jenis elemen yang sesuai kepada musuh di sekitarnya.

constellations.name: Rogue's Quick Thinking
constellations.description: Moonsign: Ascendant Gleam: In the Ascension Talent **"Plan to Get Paid,"** Jahoda can secretly track, in addition to the element with the highest number of characters, the element with the next highest number of characters among the remaining types. This allows up to two elemental effects to be active at once. You must first unlock the Ascension Talent "Plan to Get Paid."
constellations.descriptionId: Moonsign: Ascendant Gleam: Dalam Talenta Ascension **"Plan to Get Paid"**, selain jumlah Karakter dengan jenis elemen terbanyak, Jahoda juga bisa mencatat Karakter dengan jenis elemen terbanyak kedua secara diam-diam. Sehingga maksimum dua efek jenis elemen bisa aktif di saat yang bersamaan. Harus membuka Talenta Ascension "Plan to Get Paid" terlebih dahulu.

constellations.name: Desperate Gamble
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of **Hidden Aces: Seven Tools of the Hunter** by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.descriptionId:
Meningkatkan 3 level Elemental Burst **Hidden Aces: Seven Tools of the Hunter**.
Maksimum: Lv. 15.

constellations.name: Wild Berry Amid the Dust
constellations.description: When a **Purrsonal Coordinated Assistance Robot** from the Elemental Burst Hidden Aces: Seven Tools of the Hunter undergoes an Elemental Conversion, Jahoda will recover 4 Elemental Energy.
constellations.descriptionId: Saat **Purrsonal Coordinated Assistance Robot** dari Elemental Burst Hidden Aces: Seven Tools of the Hunter mengalami konversi elemen, akan memulihkan 4 poin Energy Jahoda.

constellations.name: The Greatest Treasure
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of **Savvy Strategy: Splitting the Spoils** by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.descriptionId:
Meningkatkan 3 level Elemental Skill **Savvy Strategy: Splitting the Spoils**.
Maksimum: Lv. 15.

constellations.name: The Littlest Luck
constellations.description: Moonsign: Ascendant Gleam: After the **Purr-loined Treasure Flask** from the Elemental Skill Savvy Strategy: Splitting the Spoils is full, nearby Moonsign characters in your party have their CRIT Rate increased by 5% and CRIT DMG increased by 40% for 20s.
constellations.descriptionId: Moonsign: Ascendant Gleam: Setelah **Purr-loined Treasure Flask** dari Elemental Skill Savvy Strategy: Splitting the Spoils terisi penuh, Karakter Moonsign sekitar di dalam party mendapatkan peningkatan CRIT Rate sebesar 5% dan peningkatan CRIT DMG sebesar 40% selama 20 detik.

name: Kachina
title: Mottled Gold Yet Unsmelted
description: A young warrior of the Nanatzcayan, given the Ancient Name of "Uthabiti." Kind-hearted and insatiably persistent, she grows stronger and more capable with each setback she faces.
descriptionId: Pejuang muda Nanatzcayan yang menyandang Marga Kuno "Uthabiti". Baik hati dan pantang menyerah, dia tumbuh lebih kuat acap kali berhasil melewati rintangan yang menghadang.

talents.name: Cragbiter
talents.description:
Normal Attack
Performs up to 4 consecutive spear strikes.

Charged Attack
Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to lunge forward, dealing damage to opponents along the way.

Plunging Attack
Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground below, damaging opponents along the path and dealing AoE DMG upon impact.
talents.descriptionId:
Normal Attack
Melancarkan hingga 4 serangan tombak berturut-turut.

Charged Attack
Mengonsumsi sejumlah Stamina untuk menerjang ke depan, mengakibatkan DMG pada musuh di jalur terjangan.

Plunging Attack
Menerjang dari udara untuk menghantam tanah di bawahnya, menyerang musuh di jalur terjangan dan mengakibatkan DMG area saat mendarat.

talents.name: Go, Go Turbo Twirly!
talents.description:
Fight alongside the turbo trusty Turbo Twirly!
Summons Turbo Twirly. When the skill is Held and released, Kachina will summon and ride Turbo Twirly.
After the Skill is used, Kachina will gain 60 Nightsoul points and enter the Nightsoul's Blessing state.

Nightsoul's Blessing: Kachina
Turbo Twirly's various actions consume Kachina's Nightsoul points.
The Nightsoul's Blessing state will end when these points have been depleted.

Turbo Twirly
Can exist independently or be ridden and operated by Kachina. When Turbo Twirly is present, Kachina's Elemental Skill, "Go, Go Turbo Twirly!", will change to an option to Mount/Dismount Turbo Twirly.
·When present independent of Kachina, it will slam the ground at intervals, dealing Nightsoul-aligned AoE Geo DMG based on Kachina's DEF.
·When Kachina is riding Turbo Twirly, she can control it to move and climb swiftly, and use Normal Attacks to slam the ground, dealing Nightsoul-aligned AoE Geo DMG based on Kachina's DEF.

Turbo Twirly will disappear once Kachina's Nightsoul's Blessing state ends, and it is considered a Geo Construct. Only 1 Turbo Twirly created by Kachina herself can exist on the field at any one time.
talents.descriptionId:
Bertempurlah bersama Turbo Twirly yang bisa diandalkan!
Memanggil Turbo Twirly: Saat dilancarkan dalam Mode Tahan dan dilepaskan, Kachina akan memanggil dan menaiki Turbo Twirly.
Setelah dilancarkan, Kachina akan mendapatkan 60 poin Nightsoul dan memasuki status Nightsoul's Blessing.

Nightsoul's Blessing: Kachina
Berbagai tindakan dari Turbo Twirly akan mengonsumsi poin Nightsoul Kachina.
Nightsoul's Blessing Kachina akan terus berlangsung sampai poin Nightsoul Kachina habis terkonsumsi.

Turbo Twirly
Bisa eksis secara independen atau bisa dinaiki dan dikendalikan oleh Kachina. Saat Turbo Twirly eksis secara independen, Elemental Skill "Go, Go Turbo Twirly!" Kachina akan diubah menjadi pilihan menaiki atau turun dari Turbo Twirly.
·Saat Turbo Twirly eksis secara independen, akan menghantam permukaan tanah secara berkala dan mengakibatkan Geo DMG Area dengan atribut Nightsoul berdasarkan DEF Kachina.
·Saat Kachina menaiki Turbo Twirly, dia bisa mengontrol Turbo Twirly untuk bisa bergerak dan memanjat dengan cepat, lalu Normal Attack yang dilancarkan akan menghantam permukaan tanah, dan mengakibatkan Geo DMG Area dengan atribut Nightsoul berdasarkan DEF Kachina.

Turbo Twirly akan hilang saat status Nightsoul's Blessing Kachina berakhir, dan akan dianggap sebagai Geo Construct. Selain itu, hanya satu Turbo Twirly yang boleh ada dalam waktu yang sama.

talents.name: Time to Get Serious!
talents.description:
Striking the ground, Kachina deals AoE Geo DMG based on her DEF and creates a Turbo Drill Field.
The Field increases Turbo Twirly's attack AoE and its Movement SPD when Kachina is riding it.

If Kachina's own Turbo Twirly is present when this is used, the Turbo Twirly will be summoned to her side.
talents.descriptionId:
Menghantam tanah dan mengakibatkan Geo DMG Area berdasarkan DEF Kachina, serta menghasilkan Turbo Drill Field.
Turbo Drill Field akan meningkatkan radius serangan Turbo Twirly dan kecepatan gerakan Turbo Twirly saat dinaiki.

Saat dilancarkan, jika ada Turbo Twirly milik Kachina sendiri, maka akan memanggil Turbo Twirly tersebut ke sisinya.

passives.name: Mountain Echoes
passives.description: After nearby party members trigger a Nightsoul Burst, Kachina's Geo DMG Bonus increases by 20% for 12s.
passives.descriptionId: Setelah anggota party di sekitar memicu Nightsoul Burst, Geo DMG Bonus Kachina meningkat 20% selama 12 detik.

passives.name: The Weight of Stone
passives.description: Turbo Twirly's DMG is increased by 20% of Kachina's DEF.
passives.descriptionId: DMG yang diakibatkan Turbo Twirly meningkat sebesar 20% DEF Kachina.

passives.name: Night Realm's Gift: Heart of Unity
passives.description:
After her Nightsoul points are depleted, Kachina will switch to consuming Phlogiston to maintain her Nightsoul's Blessing.
While in an area with Phlogiston Mechanics within Natlan, she can use Nightsoul Transmission: Kachina.
