When the active character is currently sprinting, climbing, in a movement mode caused by certain Talents, or at a certain height in the air, the following will trigger when switching to Kachina: Kachina will enter the Nightsoul's Blessing state and ride Turbo Twirly when taking the field while gaining 30 Nightsoul points. Nightsoul Transmission can be triggered once every 10s by your own team.

Additionally, while in Natlan, Kachina will consume 90% less Stamina when climbing while riding Turbo Twirly.
passives.descriptionId:
Setelah Nightsoul habis terkonsumsi, Kachina akan mengonsumsi Phlogiston untuk mempertahankan status Nightsoul's Blessing-nya.
Saat berada di lokasi yang memiliki Phlogiston Mechanic di Natlan, Kachina bisa melancarkan Nightsoul Transmission: Kachina. Saat Karakter aktif sedang berlari, memanjat, atau sedang bergerak yang dikarenakan oleh Talenta tertentu, atau saat melayang di ketinggian tertentu, dan mengganti Karakter menjadi Kachina, akan memicu efek: Kachina akan memasuki status Nightsoul's Blessing dan menaiki Turbo Twirly, serta mendapatkan 30 poin Nightsoul. Nightsoul Transmission party sendiri dapat terpicu sekali setiap 10 detik.

Selain itu, saat berada di Natlan, Stamina yang dikonsumsi Kachina saat memanjat sambil mengendarai Turbo Twirly akan berkurang 90%.

passives.name: Boon of Crystal Flame
passives.description: While in an area with Phlogiston Mechanics within Natlan, 20 Stamina will be restored when interacting with some harvestable items. Additionally, the location of nearby resources unique to Natlan will appear on your mini-map.
passives.descriptionId: Saat ada area dengan Phlogiston Mechanic di Natlan, berinteraksi dengan item tertentu yang bisa dikumpulkan, akan memulihkan 20 poin Stamina. Selain ini, akan menunjukkan posisi Produk Khas Natlan yang ada di sekitar pada peta kecil.

constellations.name: Shards Are Gems Too
constellations.description:
When Kachina mounts or dismounts Turbo Twirly, she will absorb nearby Elemental Shards created by Crystallize.
Additionally, when a party member picks up such a Shard, or triggers Lunar-Crystallize reactions, 3 Energy will be restored to Kachina. Energy can be restored this way once every 5s.
constellations.descriptionId:
Saat Kachina menaiki atau turun dari Turbo Twirly, akan menyerap Elemental Shard di sekitar yang dihasilkan oleh Crystallize.
Selain itu, saat anggota party mendapatkan Elemental Shard ini atau memicu reaksi Lunar-Crystallize, akan memulihkan 3 poin Energy Kachina. Pemulihan Energy yang bisa diperoleh dengan cara ini adalah maksimum sekali setiap 5 detik.

constellations.name: Never Leave Home Without... Turbo Twirly
constellations.description: When Kachina uses "Time to Get Serious!", she will regain 20 Nightsoul points. If there is no Turbo Twirly belonging to her on the field, she will enter Nightsoul's Blessing and summon one.
constellations.descriptionId: Saat Kachina melancarkan "Time to Get Serious!", akan memulihkan 20 poin Nightsoul. Jika saat dilancarkan, tidak ada Turbo Twirly milik Kachina sendiri, maka akan memasuki status Nightsoul's Blessing dan memanggil Turbo Twirly.

constellations.name: Improved Stabilizer
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Go, Go Turbo Twirly! by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.descriptionId:
Meningkatkan 3 level Go, Go Turbo Twirly!.
Maksimum: Lv. 15.

constellations.name: More Foes, More Caution
constellations.description: When there are 1/2/3/4 (or more) opponents within the Turbo Drill Field created by "Time to Get Serious!", the active character within the field gains 8%/12%/16%/20% increased DEF.
constellations.descriptionId: Saat jumlah musuh yang berada dalam Turbo Drill Field yang dihasilkan oleh "Time to Get Serious!" berjumlah 1/2/3/4 musuh atau lebih, maka Karakter aktif anggota party di dalam area mendapatkan peningkatan DEF sebesar 8%/12%/16%/20%.

constellations.name: All I've Collected Till Now
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Time to Get Serious! by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.descriptionId:
Meningkatkan 3 level Time to Get Serious!.
Maksimum: Lv. 15.

constellations.name: This Time, I've Gotta Win
constellations.description: When your active character's Shield is replaced or destroyed for any reason, Kachina will deal 200% of her DEF as AoE Geo DMG. This effect can be triggered once every 5s.
constellations.descriptionId: Saat Perisai Karakter aktif di dalam party digantikan atau hancur karena alasan apa pun, maka Kachina akan mengakibatkan Geo DMG Area sebesar 200% DEF Kachina saat ini. Efek ini dapat terpicu sekali setiap 5 detik.

name: Kaeya
title: Frostwind Swordsman
description: An accomplished swordsman and a strategic thinker in the Knights of Favonius, rumored to hail from beyond Mondstadt.
descriptionId: Seorang kesatria pedang yang ulung dan ahli strategi di dalam Knights of Favonius, dikabarkan berasal dari luar Mondstadt.

talents.name: Ceremonial Bladework
talents.description:
Normal Attack
Performs up to 5 rapid strikes.

Charged Attack
Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to unleash 2 rapid sword strikes.

Plunging Attack
Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground below, damaging opponents along the path and dealing AoE DMG upon impact.
talents.descriptionId:
Normal Attack
Melancarkan hingga 5 serangan berturut-turut.

Charged Attack
Mengonsumsi sejumlah Stamina untuk melancarkan dua tebasan pedang.

Plunging Attack
Menerjang dari udara untuk menghantam tanah, menyerang musuh di jalur terjangan dan mengakibatkan DMG area saat mendarat.

talents.name: Frostgnaw
talents.description: Unleashes a frigid blast, dealing Cryo DMG to opponents in front of Kaeya.
talents.descriptionId: Mengerahkan sebuah ledakan dingin yang mengakibatkan Cryo DMG ke musuh di depan Kaeya.

talents.name: Glacial Waltz
talents.description:
Coalescing the frost in the air, Kaeya summons 3 icicles that revolve around him.
These icicles will follow the character around and deal Cryo DMG to opponents in their path for the ability's duration.
talents.descriptionId:
Dengan menggabungkan es di udara, Kaeya membuat 3 pilar es di sekitar dia.
Pilar-pilar ini akan mengikuti karakter dan mengakibatkan Cryo DMG ke musuh di jalurnya.

passives.name: Cold-Blooded Strike
passives.description: Every hit with Frostgnaw regenerates HP for Kaeya equal to 15% of his ATK.
passives.descriptionId: Setiap kali skill Frostgnaw mengenai satu musuh, memulihkan HP Kaeya sebesar 15% ATK.

passives.name: Glacial Heart
passives.description:
Opponents Frozen by Frostgnaw will drop additional Elemental Particles.
Frostgnaw may only produce a maximum of 2 additional Elemental Particles per use.
passives.descriptionId:
Musuh yang terkena efek Frozen dari skill Frostgnaw akan menjatuhkan Elemental Particle tambahan.
Maksimum menjatuhkan 2 Elemental Particle tambahan setiap kalinya.

passives.name: Hidden Strength
passives.description:
Decreases sprinting Stamina consumption for your own party members by 20%.
Not stackable with Passive Talents that provide the exact same effects.
passives.descriptionId:
Mengurangi 20% konsumsi Stamina semua Karakter di party sendiri saat berlari.
Efek ini tidak dapat ditumpuk dengan Talenta Pasif lain dengan efek yang sama persis.

constellations.name: Excellent Blood
constellations.description: The CRIT Rate of Kaeya's Normal and Charge Attacks against opponents affected by Cryo is increased by 15%.
constellations.descriptionId: CRIT Rate dari Normal dan Charged Attack milik Kaeya terhadap musuh yang terkena efek Cryo meningkat sebesar 15%.

constellations.name: Never-Ending Performance
constellations.description: While Glacial Waltz is in effect, for each opponent defeated, its duration is increased by 2.5s, up to a maximum of 15s.
constellations.descriptionId: Setiap kali sebuah musuh dikalahkan dalam durasi Glacial Waltz, durasinya meningkat 2,5 detik, sampai maksimum 15 detik.

constellations.name: Dance of Frost
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Frostgnaw by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.descriptionId:
Meningkatkan 3 level Frostgnaw.
Maksimum: Lv. 15.

constellations.name: Frozen Kiss
constellations.description:
Triggers automatically when Kaeya's HP falls below 20%:
Creates a shield that absorbs damage equal to 30% of Kaeya's Max HP. Lasts for 20s.
This shield absorbs Cryo DMG with 250% efficiency.
Can only occur once every 60s.
constellations.descriptionId:
Terpicu secara otomatis saat HP Kaeya kurang dari 20%:
Membuat Perisai yang menahan DMG setara dengan 30% Max HP Kaeya. Berlangsung selama 20 detik.
Perisai ini memiliki 250% pertahanan terhadap Cryo DMG.
Terpicu setiap 60 detik.

constellations.name: Frostbiting Embrace
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Glacial Waltz by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.descriptionId:
Meningkatkan 3 level Glacial Waltz.
Maksimum: Lv. 15.

constellations.name: Glacial Whirlwind
constellations.description: Glacial Waltz will generate 1 additional icicle, and will regenerate 15 Energy when cast.
constellations.descriptionId: Glacial Waltz mengeluarkan 1 es tambahan, dan memulihkan 15 Energy saat skill digunakan.

name: Kaveh
title: Empyrean Reflection
description: A renowned architect from Sumeru who perhaps cares a bit too much about too many things. He is an aesthete troubled by reality.
descriptionId: Seorang arsitek terkenal dari Sumeru yang memedulikan terlalu banyak hal. Pecinta estetika yang terganggu oleh realita.

talents.name: Schematic Setup
talents.description:
Normal Attack
Uses Mehrak to perform up to 4 consecutive attacks.

Charged Attack
Drains Stamina over time to perform continuous slashes.
At the end of the sequence, performs a more powerful slash.

Plunging Attack
Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground, damaging opponents along the path and dealing AoE DMG upon impact.
talents.descriptionId:
Normal Attack
Melancarkan hingga 4 serangan berturut-turut menggunakan Mehrak.

Charged Attack
Terus menguras Stamina untuk melancarkan tebasan berkelanjutan.
Diakhiri dengan sebuah tebasan yang sangat kuat.

Plunging Attack
Menerjang dari udara untuk menghantam tanah, menyerang semua musuh di jalurnya dan mengakibatkan DMG Area saat mendarat.

talents.name: Artistic Ingenuity
talents.description: Uses Mehrak's mapping ability for offensive purposes, initiating a radial scan that deals AoE Dendro DMG. It will also scan all Dendro Cores in its AoE and cause them to immediately burst.
talents.descriptionId: Menggunakan kemampuan pemetaan Mehrak untuk menyerang. Mehrak akan melakukan pindaian berbentuk lingkaran dan mengakibatkan Dendro DMG Area. Seluruh Dendro Core yang berada di dalam area pemindaiannya juga akan langsung meledak.

talents.name: Painted Dome
talents.description:
Completely unleashes Mehrak's energy and creates a cubic scanned space, dealing AoE Dendro DMG to all opponents within it, causing all Dendro Cores in its AoE to immediately burst, and granting Kaveh the following enhanced combat abilities for a specific duration:
· Increases Kaveh's Normal, Charged, and Plunging Attack AoE, and converts his attack DMG to Dendro DMG that cannot be overridden.
· All Dendro Cores created by all your own party members through Bloom and Lunar-Bloom reactions will deal additional DMG when they burst.
· Increases Kaveh's resistance to interruption.
These effects will be canceled once Kaveh leaves the field.
talents.descriptionId:
Melepaskan seluruh energi Mehrak untuk menciptakan sebuah ruang pemetaan berbentuk kubus dan mengakibatkan Dendro DMG Area pada semua musuh di dalamnya, juga akan membuat seluruh Dendro Core dalam area jangkauan serangan ini langsung meledak. Selain itu, kemampuan bertarung Kaveh juga akan meningkat untuk jangka waktu tertentu:
·Area serangan Normal Attack, Charged Attack, dan Plunging Attack milik Kaveh meningkat, dan DMG serangan Kaveh dikonversi menjadi Dendro DMG yang tidak bisa ditimpa Elemental Infusion lainnya.
·Dendro Core dari reaksi Bloom atau Lunar-Bloom yang dipicu oleh Karakter sendiri di dalam party akan mengakibatkan DMG lebih besar saat meledak.
·Ketahanan Kaveh terhadap interupsi meningkat.
Efek-efek ini akan hilang saat Kaveh meninggalkan medan pertempuran.

passives.name: An Architect's Undertaking
passives.description: When DMG dealt by a Dendro Core (including DMG from Burgeon and Hyperbloom) hits Kaveh, Kaveh will regain HP equal to 300% of his Elemental Mastery. This effect can be triggered once every 0.5s.
passives.descriptionId: Saat DMG yang diakibatkan Dendro Core (termasuk DMG dari Burgeon dan Hyperbloom) mengenai Kaveh, maka Kaveh akan memulihkan HP sebesar 300% Elemental Mastery Kaveh. Efek ini dapat terpicu sekali setiap 0,5 detik.

passives.name: A Craftsman's Curious Conceptions
passives.description:
During Painted Dome, after Kaveh's Normal, Charged, or Plunging Attacks hit opponents, his Elemental Mastery will increase by 25. This effect can be triggered once every 0.1s. Max 4 stacks.
This effect will be canceled when Painted Dome's effects end.
passives.descriptionId:
Selama Painted Dome berlangsung, Elemental Mastery Kaveh akan meningkat 25 poin setelah Normal Attack, Charged Attack, atau Plunging Attack Kaveh mengenai musuh. Efek ini dapat terpicu sekali setiap 0,1 detik dan dapat ditumpuk hingga 4 lapis.
Efek ini akan hilang setelah efek Painted Dome berakhir.

passives.name: The Art of Budgeting
passives.description: When Kaveh crafts Landscape, Building, and Courtyard-type Furnishings, he has a 100% chance to refund a portion of the materials used.
passives.descriptionId: Saat membuat Perabotan jenis Hiasan, Bangunan, dan Taman, Kaveh memiliki 100% kemungkinan untuk mendapatkan kembali sebagian materialnya.

constellations.name: Sublime Salutations
constellations.description: Within 3s after using Artistic Ingenuity, Kaveh's Dendro RES and Incoming Healing Bonus will be increased by 50% and 25% respectively.
constellations.descriptionId: Selama 3 detik setelah melancarkan Artistic Ingenuity, Dendro RES Kaveh akan meningkat 50% dan Bonus Pemulihan yang diterima Kaveh meningkat 25%.

constellations.name: Grace of Royal Roads
constellations.description: Kaveh's Normal Attack SPD increases by 15% during Painted Dome.
constellations.descriptionId: Selama Painted Dome berlangsung, Normal ATK SPD Kaveh meningkat 15%.

constellations.name: Profferings of Dur Untash
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Painted Dome by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.descriptionId:
Meningkatkan 3 level Painted Dome.
Maksimum: Lv. 15.

constellations.name: Feast of Apadana
constellations.description: Dendro Cores created from Bloom and Lunar-Bloom reactions Kaveh triggers will deal 60% more DMG when they burst.
constellations.descriptionId: DMG ledakan Dendro Core dari reaksi Bloom atau Lunar-Bloom yang dipicu oleh Kaveh meningkat 60%.

constellations.name: Treasures of Bonkhanak
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Artistic Ingenuity by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.descriptionId:
Meningkatkan 3 level Artistic Ingenuity.
Maksimum: Lv. 15.

constellations.name: Pairidaeza's Dreams
constellations.description: When Kaveh's Normal, Charged, or Plunging Attacks hit opponents during Painted Dome, they will unleash Pairidaeza's Light upon the opponent's position, dealing 61.8% of Kaveh's ATK as AoE Dendro DMG and causing all Dendro Cores within that AoE to burst. This effect can be triggered once every 3s.
constellations.descriptionId: Saat Normal Attack, Charged Attack, atau Plunging Attack Kaveh mengenai musuh selama Painted Dome berlangsung, serangan Kaveh akan melancarkan Pairidaeza's Light di posisi musuh berada, mengakibatkan Dendro DMG Area sebesar 61,8% ATK Kaveh dan meledakkan semua Dendro Core di dalam area serangan tersebut. Efek ini dapat terpicu sekali setiap 3 detik.

name: Kirara
title: Cat Upon the Eaves
description: A courier for Komaniya Express, a delivery company in Inazuma. A nekomata who loves her job and human society.
descriptionId: Seorang kurir di Komaniya Express, sebuah perusahaan jasa ekspedisi yang ada di Inazuma. Seekor Nekomata yang mencintai pekerjaannya dan juga komunitas manusia.

talents.name: Boxcutter
talents.description:
Normal Attack
Performs up to 4 rapid strikes.

Charged Attack
Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to unleash 3 rapid claw strikes.

Plunging Attack
Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground below, damaging opponents along the path and dealing AoE DMG upon impact.
talents.descriptionId:
Normal Attack
Melancarkan hingga 4 serangan berturut-turut.

Charged Attack
Mengonsumsi sejumlah Stamina untuk melancarkan 3 serangan cakar yang cepat.

Plunging Attack
Menerjang dari udara untuk menghantam tanah, menyerang musuh di jalur terjangan dan mengakibatkan DMG Area saat mendarat.

talents.name: Meow-teor Kick
talents.description:
Press
Leaps into the air with all the agility of a cat passing through the bushes, and thwacks her foes with a flying kick that deals AoE Dendro DMG while creating a Shield of Safe Transport. This will also briefly apply Dendro to Kirara. The shield will absorb Dendro DMG with 250% effectiveness. The shield's DMG absorption will be based on Kirara's Max HP and will not exceed a certain percentage of that Max HP. The remaining DMG absorption on a Shield of Safe Transport will stack on a new one when it is created, and its duration will reset.

Hold
Out of her desire to "deliver within half a day," Kirara deploys a Shield of Safe Transport identical to the one that can be created by pressing the skill. She will also curl up into a special express delivery box, entering the Urgent Neko Parcel state in order to move and fight more swiftly.

Urgent Neko Parcel
· Deals Dendro DMG to opponents she crashes into. This effect can be triggered once on each opponent every 0.5s.
· When in this state, Kirara's movement speed, climbing speed, and jumping power are all increased, and her Stamina Consumption from climbing is increased.
· When the duration ends or the skill is used again, a Flipclaw Strike more powerful than the attack in the Press Mode will be unleashed, dealing AoE Dendro DMG.
· The Urgent Neko Parcel state lasts a maximum of 10s. When the state ends, the skill will enter CD. The longer Kirara spends in this state, the longer the CD will be.
· Sprinting or actively canceling climbing will end this state early.
talents.descriptionId:
Mode Tekan
Melompat ke udara dengan lincah layaknya seekor kucing yang berlari di antara semak-semak, dan menggunakan tendangan jungkir baliknya untuk menghantam musuhnya dengan keras dan mengakibatkan Dendro DMG Area sambil menciptakan sebuah Perisai Shield of Safe Transport. Perisai ini juga akan memberikan efek Dendro singkat terhadap Kirara untuk sesaat. Perisai Shield of Safe Transport memiliki 250% pertahanan terhadap Dendro DMG. Ketahanan Perisai Shield of Safe Transport akan didasarkan pada Max HP Kirara dan tidak bisa melebihi persentase tertentu dari Max HP Kirara. Sisa ketahanan DMG dari Perisai Shield of Safe Transport akan ditumpuk ke Perisai yang baru saat Perisai ini diciptakan kembali, durasi Perisainya juga akan diperbarui.

Mode Tahan
Kirara membentuk sebuah Perisai yang sama persis dengan Shield of Safe dari Mode Tekan skill ini karena keinginannya untuk "mengantar paket dalam setengah hari". Dia juga akan berubah menjadi sebuah kotak pengantaran ekspres spesial dan memasuki status Urgent Neko Parcel agar bisa bergerak dan bertarung dengan lebih lincah.

Status Urgent Neko Parcel
·Mengakibatkan Dendro DMG pada musuh yang ditabraknya. Efek ini dapat terpicu kepada setiap musuh sekali setiap 0,5 detik.
·Saat berada dalam status ini, Movement Speed, kecepatan memanjat, dan kemampuan melompat Kirara akan meningkat. Stamina yang diperlukan untuk memanjat juga akan meningkat.
·Setelah durasinya berakhir atau skill ini dilancarkan sekali lagi, Kirara akan melancarkan Flipclaw Strike yang lebih kuat dari serangan Mode Tekan dan mengakibatkan Dendro DMG Area.
·Status Urgent Neko Parcel akan bertahan maksimum 10 detik. Skill akan memasuki cooldown setelah status ini berakhir. Semakin lama Kirara berada dalam status ini, maka semakin lama pula cooldown skill ini.
·Berlari atau menghentikan status memanjat selama status ini berlangsung akan langsung membatalkan status Urgent Neko Parcel.

talents.name: Secret Art: Surprise Dispatch
talents.description: Smash opponents with a Special Delivery Package used for punishing parcel thieves, dealing AoE Dendro DMG. After the Special Delivery Package explodes, it will split up into many Cat Grass Cardamoms that will explode either upon contact with opponents or after a period of time, dealing AoE Dendro DMG.
talents.descriptionId: Membanting Special Delivery Package untuk menghukum pencuri yang perlu diberi pelajaran dan mengakibatkan Dendro DMG Area. Setelah meledak, Special Delivery Package akan pecah menjadi banyak Cat Grass Cardamom yang akan meledak saat tersentuh oleh musuh atau setelah kurun waktu tertentu, dan mengakibatkan Dendro DMG Area.

passives.name: Bewitching, Betwitching Tails
passives.description: When Kirara is in the Urgent Neko Parcel state of Meow-teor Kick, each impact against an opponent will grant her a stack of Reinforced Packaging. This effect can be triggered once for each opponent hit every 0.5s. Max 3 stacks. When the Urgent Neko Parcel state ends, each stack of Reinforced Packaging will create 1 Shield of Safe Transport for Kirara. The shields that are created this way will have 20% of the DMG absorption that the Shield of Safe Transport produced by Meow-teor Kick would have. If Kirara is already protected by a Shield of Safe Transport created by Meow-teor Kick, its DMG absorption will stack with these shields and its duration will reset.
passives.descriptionId: Saat Kirara berada dalam status Urgent Neko Parcel dari skill Meow-teor Kick, Kirara akan mendapatkan satu lapis Reinforced Packaging setiap kali menabrak musuh. Efek ini dapat terpicu maksimum satu kali setiap 0,5 detik terhadap setiap musuh dan dapat ditumpuk hingga 3 lapis. Saat status Urgent Neko Parcel berakhir, setiap lapis Reinforced Packaging akan membentuk satu buah Perisai Shield of Safe Transport untuk Kirara. Perisai yang terbentuk dengan cara ini memiliki ketahanan DMG sebesar 20% dari Shield of Safe Transport yang terbentuk dari skill Meow-teor Kick. Jika Kirara sudah berada dalam perlindungan Perisai Shield of Safe Transport yang tercipta dari skill Meow-teor Kick, maka sisa ketahanan DMG Perisai akan ditumpuk menjadi satu dan durasinya akan diperbarui.

passives.name: Pupillary Variance
passives.description: Every 1,000 Max HP Kirara possesses will increase the DMG dealt by Meow-teor Kick by 0.4%, and the DMG dealt by Secret Art: Surprise Dispatch by 0.3%.
passives.descriptionId: Untuk setiap 1.000 poin Max HP Kirara, DMG yang diakibatkan Meow-teor Kick akan meningkat 0,4% dan DMG yang diakibatkan Secret Art: Surprise Dispatch akan meningkat 0,3%.

passives.name: Cat's Creeping Carriage
passives.description: When Kirara is in the party, animals who produce Fowl, Raw Meat, or Chilled Meat will not be startled when party members approach them.
passives.descriptionId: Saat Kirara berada dalam party, hewan yang dapat menghasilkan Fowl, Raw Meat, dan Chilled Meat tidak akan mudah terkejut saat didekati oleh anggota party sendiri.

constellations.name: Material Circulation
constellations.description: Every 8,000 Max HP Kirara possesses will cause her to create 1 extra Cat Grass Cardamom when she uses Secret Art: Surprise Dispatch. A maximum of 4 extra can be created this way.
constellations.descriptionId: Saat melancarkan Secret Art: Surprise Dispatch, Kirara akan menciptakan 1 buah Cat Grass Cardamom tambahan untuk setiap 8.000 Max HP Kirara. Cat Grass Cardamom tambahan yang bisa diciptakan dengan cara ini adalah maksimum 4 buah.

constellations.name: Perfectly Packaged
constellations.description:
When Kirara is in the Urgent Neko Parcel state of Meow-teor Kick, she will grant other party members she crashes into Critical Transport Shields.
The DMG absorption of Critical Transport Shield is 40% of the maximum absorption Meow-teor Kick's normal Shields of Safe Transport are capable of, and will absorb Dendro DMG with 250% effectiveness.
Critical Transport Shields last 12s and can be triggered once on each character every 10s.
constellations.descriptionId:
Saat Kirara berada dalam status Urgent Neko Parcel dari skill Meow-teor Kick, dia akan memberikan Perisai Critical Transport Shield kepada anggota party lain yang ditabraknya.
Ketahanan Perisai Critical Transport Shield adalah 40% dari batas maksimum ketahanan Perisai Shield of Safe Transport normal dari skill Meow-teor Kick, dan memiliki 250% pertahanan terhadap Dendro DMG.
Critical Transport Shield berlangsung selama 12 detik. Efek ini dapat terpicu maksimum sekali setiap 10 detik untuk setiap Karakter.

constellations.name: Universal Recognition
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Meow-teor Kick by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.descriptionId:
Meningkatkan 3 level Meow-teor Kick.
Maksimum: Lv. 15.

constellations.name: Steed of Skanda
constellations.description: After active character(s) protected by Shields of Safe Transport or Critical Transport Shields hit opponents with Normal, Charged, or Plunging Attacks, Kirara will perform a coordinated attack with them using Small Cat Grass Cardamoms, dealing 200% of her ATK as Dendro DMG. DMG dealt this way is considered Elemental Burst DMG. This effect can be triggered once every 3.8s. This CD is shared between all party members.
constellations.descriptionId: Setelah Karakter yang dilindungi Shield of Safe Transport atau Critical Transport Shield mengenai musuh dengan Normal Attack, Charged Attack, atau Plunging Attack, maka Kirara akan menggunakan Small Cat Grass Cardamom untuk melancarkan serangan terkoordinasi dan mengakibatkan Dendro DMG sebesar 200% ATK Kirara. DMG yang diakibatkan dengan cara ini akan dianggap sebagai DMG Elemental Burst. Efek ini dapat terpicu sekali setiap 3,8 detik dan waktu cooldown berlaku bagi seluruh anggota party.

constellations.name: A Thousand Miles in a Day
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Secret Art: Surprise Dispatch by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.descriptionId:
Meningkatkan 3 level Secret Art: Surprise Dispatch.
Maksimum: Lv. 15.

constellations.name: Countless Sights to See
constellations.description: All nearby party members gain a 12% All Elemental DMG Bonus for 15s after Kirara uses her Elemental Skill or Burst.
constellations.descriptionId: Setelah Kirara melancarkan Elemental Skill atau Elemental Burst, maka Elemental DMG Bonus untuk semua elemen dari seluruh anggota party di sekitarnya akan meningkat 12% selama 15 detik.

name: Kujou Sara
title: Crowfeather Kaburaya
description: A general of the Tenryou Commission. Bold, decisive, and skilled in battle.
descriptionId: Seorang jenderal di Tenryou Commission. Sifatnya berani, tegas, dan sangat pandai bertarung.

talents.name: Tengu Bowmanship
talents.description:
Normal Attack
Performs up to 5 consecutive shots with a bow.

Charged Attack
Performs a more precise Aimed Shot with increased DMG.
While aiming, crackling lightning will accumulate on the arrowhead. An arrow fully charged with the storm's might will deal Electro DMG.
When in the Crowfeather Cover state, a fully-charged arrow will leave a Crowfeather behind after it hits.

Plunging Attack
Fires off a shower of arrows in mid-air before falling and striking the ground, dealing AoE DMG upon impact.
talents.descriptionId:
Normal Attack
Melancarkan hingga 5 serangan berturut-turut menggunakan busur.

Charged Attack
Melancarkan sebuah Serangan Membidik yang lebih akurat untuk mengakibatkan DMG lebih besar.
Saat membidik, energi listrik akan berkumpul di ujung anak panah. Panah dengan listrik yang terkumpul penuh akan mengakibatkan Electro DMG saat mengenai musuh.
Saat berada dalam status Crowfeather Cover, anak panah dengan energi yang terkumpul penuh akan meninggalkan Crowfeather saat mengenai target.

Plunging Attack
Melancarkan hujan panah dari udara dan menerjang tanah dengan kecepatan tinggi, mengakibatkan DMG area saat mendarat.

talents.name: Tengu Stormcall
talents.description:
Retreats rapidly with the speed of a tengu, summoning the protection of the Crowfeather.
Gains Crowfeather Cover for 18s, and when Kujou Sara fires a fully-charged Aimed Shot, Crowfeather Cover will be consumed, and will leave a Crowfeather at the target location.
Crowfeathers will trigger Tengu Juurai: Ambush after a short time, dealing Electro DMG and granting the active character within its AoE an ATK Bonus based on Kujou Sara's Base ATK.

The ATK Bonuses from different Tengu Juurai will not stack, and their effects and duration will be determined by the last Tengu Juurai to take effect.
talents.descriptionId:
Mundur dengan kecepatan seperti tengu dan memanggil perlindungan dari Crowfeather.
Mendapatkan efek Crowfeather Cover selama 18 detik, dan jika Kujou Sara melancarkan Serangan Membidik yang terisi penuh, Crowfeather Cover akan terkonsumsi dan tembakan ini akan meninggalkan sebuah Crowfeather di lokasi target.
Crowfeather akan memicu Tengu Juurai: Ambush setelah beberapa saat, mengakibatkan Electro DMG pada musuh di dekatnya, dan memberikan Bonus ATK sebesar persentase dari Base ATK Kujou Sara pada Karakter aktif di sekitar.

Bonus ATK dari berbagai Tengu Juurai yang berbeda tidak bisa digabungkan. Efek dan durasi nya juga akan ditentukan oleh efek Tengu Juurai yang aktif terakhir.

talents.name: Subjugation: Koukou Sendou
talents.description:
Casts down Tengu Juurai: Titanbreaker, dealing AoE Electro DMG. Afterwards, Tengu Juurai: Titanbreaker spreads out into 4 consecutive bouts of Tengu Juurai: Stormcluster, dealing AoE Electro DMG.
Tengu Juurai: Titanbreaker and Tengu Juurai: Stormcluster can provide the active character within their AoE with the same ATK Bonus as given by the Elemental Skill, Tengu Stormcall.

The ATK Bonus provided by various kinds of Tengu Juurai will not stack, and their effects and duration will be determined by the last Tengu Juurai to take effect.
talents.descriptionId:
Menjatuhkan sebuah Tengu Juurai: Titanbreaker di lokasi target dan mengakibatkan Electro DMG Area. Setelah itu, Tengu Juurai: Titanbreaker ini akan berpencar menjadi 4 Tengu Juurai: Stormcluster secara beruntun dan mengakibatkan Electro DMG Area.
Tengu Juurai: Titanbreaker dan Tengu Juurai: Stormcluster akan memberikan Bonus ATK pada Karakter aktif yang ada di sekitar, sama seperti saat melancarkan Elemental Skill Tengu Stormcall.

Bonus ATK dari berbagai Tengu Juurai yang berbeda tidak bisa digabungkan. Efek dan durasi nya juga akan ditentukan oleh efek Tengu Juurai yang aktif terakhir.

passives.name: Immovable Will
passives.description: While in the Crowfeather Cover state provided by Tengu Stormcall, Aimed Shot charge times are decreased by 60%.
passives.descriptionId: Saat berada dalam kondisi Crowfeather Cover dari skill Tengu Stormcall, waktu charge Serangan Membidik akan berkurang 60%.

passives.name: Decorum
passives.description: When Tengu Juurai: Ambush hits opponents, Kujou Sara will restore 1.2 Energy to all party members for every 100% Energy Recharge she has. This effect can be triggered once every 3s.
passives.descriptionId: Saat Tengu Juurai: Ambush mengenai musuh, Kujou Sara akan memulihkan 1,2 Energy pada seluruh anggota party untuk setiap 100% Energy Recharge yang Sara miliki. Efek ini dapat terpicu setiap 3 detik.

passives.name: Land Survey
passives.description: When dispatched on an expedition in Inazuma, time consumed is reduced by 25%.
passives.descriptionId: Ketika dikirim untuk melakukan ekspedisi di Inazuma, waktu yang dibutuhkan berkurang 25%.

constellations.name: Crow's Eye
constellations.description:
When Tengu Juurai grants characters ATK Bonuses or hits opponents, the CD of Tengu Stormcall is decreased by 1s.
This effect can be triggered once every 3s.
constellations.descriptionId:
Saat Tengu Juurai memberikan Bonus ATK pada Karakter atau mengenai musuh, maka CD Tengu Stormcall akan berkurang 1 detik.
Efek ini dapat terpicu setiap 3 detik.

constellations.name: Dark Wings
constellations.description: Unleashing Tengu Stormcall will leave a weaker Crowfeather at Kujou Sara's original position that will deal 30% of its original DMG.
constellations.descriptionId: Melancarkan Tengu Stormcall akan menciptakan Crowfeather yang lebih lemah di posisi awal Kujou Sara dan mengakibatkan 30% dari DMG aslinya.

constellations.name: The War Within
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Subjugation: Koukou Sendou by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.descriptionId:
Meningkatkan 3 level Subjugation: Koukou Sendou.
Maksimum: Lv. 15.

constellations.name: Conclusive Proof
constellations.description: The number of Tengu Juurai: Stormcluster released by Subjugation: Koukou Sendou is increased to 6.
constellations.descriptionId: Jumlah Tengu Juurai: Stormcluster yang tercipta dari skill Subjugation: Koukou Sendou bertambah menjadi 6.

constellations.name: Spellsinger
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Tengu Stormcall by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.descriptionId:
Meningkatkan 3 level Tengu Stormcall.
Maksimum: Lv. 15.

constellations.name: Sin of Pride
constellations.description: The Electro DMG of characters who have had their ATK increased by Tengu Juurai has its CRIT DMG increased by 60%.
constellations.descriptionId: Saat Karakter mendapatkan Bonus ATK dari Tengu Juurai, maka CRIT DMG untuk Electro DMG milik Karakter tersebut akan meningkat 60%.

name: Kuki Shinobu
title: Mender of Tribulations
description: The capable and reliable Arataki Gang deputy leader. Please note: capable and reliable are not appellations for the "Arataki Gang," but for their deputy leader in specific.
descriptionId: Orang nomor dua di Geng Arataki yang hebat dan bisa diandalkan. Catatan: yang hebat dan bisa diandalkan itu si orang nomor duanya, bukan kelompoknya. Tolong jangan keliru.

talents.name: Shinobu's Shadowsword
talents.description:
Normal Attack
Performs up to 4 rapid strikes.

Charged Attack
Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to unleash 2 rapid sword strikes.

Plunging Attack
Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground below, damaging opponents along the path and dealing AoE DMG upon impact.
talents.descriptionId:
Normal Attack
Melancarkan hingga 4 serangan berturut-turut.

Charged Attack
Mengonsumsi sejumlah Stamina untuk melancarkan dua tebasan pedang.

Plunging Attack
Menerjang dari udara untuk menghantam tanah, menyerang musuh di jalur terjangan dan mengakibatkan DMG area saat mendarat.

talents.name: Sanctifying Ring
talents.description:
Creates a Grass Ring of Sanctification at the cost of part of her HP, dealing Electro DMG to nearby opponents.

Grass Ring of Sanctification
Follows your current active character around. Deals Electro DMG to nearby opponents every 1.5s and restores HP for active character(s) within the ring's AoE based on Kuki Shinobu's Max HP.

The HP consumption from using this skill can only bring her to 20% HP.
talents.descriptionId:
Menciptakan Grass Ring of Sanctification dengan mengorbankan sebagian dari HP-nya, mengakibatkan Electro DMG kepada musuh di sekitarnya.

Grass Ring of Sanctification
Mengikuti Karakter aktif. Mengakibatkan Electro DMG kepada musuh di sekitar setiap 1,5 detik dan memulihkan HP Karakter aktif di dalam Area efeknya berdasarkan Max HP Kuki Shinobu.

HP yang terkonsumsi akibat penggunaan skill ini akan mengurangi HP Shinobu sampai batas 20% maksimum.

talents.name: Gyoei Narukami Kariyama Rite
talents.description:
Stabs an evil-excoriating blade into the ground, creating a field that cleanses the area of all that is foul, dealing continuous Electro DMG to opponents within its AoE based on Shinobu's Max HP.
If Shinobu's HP is less than or equal to 50% when this skill is used, the field will last longer.
talents.descriptionId:
Menancapkan pedang pengusir roh jahat di tanah, dan membuat sebuah medan yang membersihkan area yang kotor, mengakibatkan Electro DMG secara berkelanjutan kepada musuh di dalam Area efeknya berdasarkan Max HP Kuki Shinobu.
Jika HP Shinobu 50% atau kurang saat skill ini digunakan, durasi medan ini akan lebih lama.

passives.name: Breaking Free
passives.description: When Shinobu's HP is not higher than 50%, her Healing Bonus is increased by 15%.
passives.descriptionId: Saat HP Shinobu tidak lebih dari 50%, maka bonus pemulihannya meningkat 15%.

passives.name: Heart's Repose
passives.description:
Sanctifying Ring's abilities will be boosted based on Shinobu's Elemental Mastery:
·Healing amount will be increased by 75% of Elemental Mastery.
·DMG dealt is increased by 25% of Elemental Mastery.

passives.name: Protracted Prayers
passives.description: Gains 25% more rewards when dispatched on an Inazuma Expedition for 20 hours.
passives.descriptionId: Ketika dikirim untuk melakukan ekspedisi di Inazuma selama 20 jam, hadiah yang didapatkan akan bertambah 25%.

constellations.name: To Cloister Compassion
constellations.description: Gyoei Narukami Kariyama Rite's AoE is increased by 50%.
constellations.descriptionId: Meningkatkan 50% area serangan Gyoei Narukami Kariyama Rite.

constellations.name: To Forsake Fortune
constellations.description: Grass Ring of Sanctification's duration is increased by 3s.
constellations.descriptionId: Meningkatkan 3 detik durasi Grass Ring of Santification

constellations.name: To Sequester Sorrow
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Sanctifying Ring by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.descriptionId:
Meningkatkan 3 level Sanctifying Ring.
Maksimum: Lv. 15.

constellations.name: To Sever Sealing
constellations.description:
When the Normal, Charged, or Plunging Attacks of the character affected by Shinobu's Grass Ring of Sanctification hit opponents, a Thundergrass Mark will land on the opponent's position and deal AoE Electro DMG based on 9.7% of Shinobu's Max HP.
This effect can occur once every 5s.
constellations.descriptionId:
Saat Normal, Charged, atau Plunging Attack dari Karakter yang terpengaruh oleh Grass Ring of Sanctification milik Shinobu memukul musuh, maka Thundergrass Mark akan muncul di posisi musuh dan mengakibatkan Electro DMG Area berdasarkan 9,7% Max HP Shinobu.
Efek ini dapat terpicu setiap 5 detik.

constellations.name: To Cease Courtesies
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Gyoei Narukami Kariyama Rite by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.descriptionId:
Meningkatkan 3 level Gyoei Narukami Kariyama Rite.
Maksimum: Lv. 15.

constellations.name: To Ward Weakness
constellations.description:
When Kuki Shinobu takes lethal DMG, this instance of DMG will not take her down. This effect will automatically trigger when her HP reaches 1 and will trigger once every 60s.
When Shinobu's HP drops below 25%, she will gain 150 Elemental Mastery for 15s. This effect will trigger once every 60s.
constellations.descriptionId:
Saat Kuki Shinobu menerima DMG mematikan, DMG tersebut tidak akan membuatnya gugur. Efek ini terpicu secara otomatis saat HP-nya mencapai 1 dan dapat terpicu setiap 60 detik.
Saat HP Shinobu turun sampai di bawah 25%, Shinobu akan mendapatkan 150 Elemental Mastery selama 15 detik. Efek ini terpicu setiap 60 detik.

name: Lan Yan
title: Spring Woven From Jade
description: A rattan weaver from Chenyu Vale. Clear-minded and well-tempered, she is as lively as a mountain spring.
descriptionId: Penganyam rotan dari Chenyu Vale. Memiliki pola pikir jernih dan emosi yang baik, tangkas seperti sumber mata air pegunungan.

talents.name: Black Pheasant Strides on Water
talents.description:
Normal Attack
Wields her Feathermoon Rings to perform up to 4 attacks, dealing Anemo DMG.

Charged Attack
Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to throw out a Feathermoon Ring, dealing Anemo DMG.

Plunging Attack
Gathers the power of Anemo and plunges towards the ground from mid-air, damaging all opponents in her path. Deals AoE Anemo DMG upon impact with the ground.
talents.descriptionId:
Normal Attack
Mengayunkan Feathermoon Ring, melancarkan hingga 4 serangan yang mengakibatkan Anemo DMG.

Charged Attack
Mengonsumsi sejumlah Stamina untuk melemparkan Feathermoon Ring yang digenggamnya, mengakibatkan Anemo DMG.

Plunging Attack
Mengumpulkan kekuatan Anemo, menerjang tanah, menyerang musuh di jalur terjangan dan mengakibatkan Anemo DMG area saat mendarat.

talents.name: Swallow-Wisp Pinion Dance
talents.description:
Summoning forth the Swallow-Wisp Shield, a secret art passed down across generations, Lan Yan dashes forward and, upon making contact with her target, will leap back into the air.
The Swallow-Wisp Shield's DMG absorption scales based on her ATK, and has a 250% absorption efficiency against Anemo DMG.
While in mid-air due to the effects of her Elemental Skill: Swallow-Wisp Pinion Dance, pressing her Elemental Skill again or pressing Normal Attack will cause Lan Yan to hurl her Feathermoon Rings at an opponent, and they will spin between nearby opponents twice upon hit, dealing Anemo DMG.
Holding the Skill will cause it to behave differently.

Hold
Enter Aiming Mode to adjust the dash direction.
talents.descriptionId:
Memanggil Swallow-Wisp Shield yang sudah diturunkan dari generasi ke generasi, lalu menerjang ke depan, dan melompat ke udara setelah menyentuh targetnya.
Penyerapan DMG Swallow-Wisp Shield dihitung berdasarkan ATK-nya, dan memiliki 250% pertahanan terhadap Anemo DMG.
Saat Lan Yan melompat ke udara karena Elemental Skill Swallow-Wisp Shield, menekan Elemental Skill atau Normal Attack akan membuatnya melemparkan Feathermoon Ring miliknya terhadap musuh, setelah mengenai musuh, akan berputar dua kali di antara musuh di sekitar, mengakibatkan Anemo DMG.
Saat ditahan, akan melancarkan serangan dengan cara yang berbeda.

Mode Tahan
Memasuki status Membidik untuk menyesuaikan arah terjangan.

talents.name: Lustrous Moonrise
talents.description: Lan Yan creates a Feathermoon Swallow Array, pulling in nearby opponents and objects and dealing multiple instances of AoE Anemo DMG.
talents.descriptionId: Lan Yan menghasilkan Feathermoon Swallow Array, menarik musuh dan objek di sekitarnya, dan mengakibatkan beberapa kali Anemo DMG Area.

passives.name: Four Sealing Divination Charms
passives.description:
When the dash from the Elemental Skill Swallow-Wisp Pinion Dance hits a target, if it interacts with Hydro/Pyro/Cryo/Electro, the Swallow-Wisp Shield will undergo Elemental Absorption, with the converted shield absorbing DMG from the corresponding element with 250% efficiency.
Additionally, if this use of Swallow-Wisp Pinion Dance causes the Swallow-Wisp Shield to undergo Elemental Absorption, the Feathermoon Rings that Lan Yan throws at her foes additionally deal Elemental DMG equal to 50% of the original in the corresponding Elemental Type. This DMG is considered Elemental Skill DMG.
passives.descriptionId:
Saat terjangan Elemental Skill Swallow-Wisp Pinion Dance mengenai target, jika berinteraksi dengan Hydro/Pyro/Cryo/Electro, Swallow-Wisp Shield akan mengalami konversi elemen, dan nilai dari Perisai setelah elemennya sudah dikonversi adalah 250% pertahanan terhadap Elemental DMG dengan tipe elemen yang sesuai.
Selain itu, jika Elemental Skill Swallow-Wisp Pinion Dance kali ini mengakibatkan konversi elemen pada Swallow-Wisp Shield, maka Feathermoon Ring yang Lan Yan lemparkan ke musuhnya akan mendapatkan 50% DMG tambahan berdasarkan tipe elemen yang sesuai. DMG ini dianggap sebagai DMG Elemental Skill.

passives.name: Skyfeather Evil-Subduing Charm
passives.description: The Elemental Skill Swallow-Wisp Pinion Dance and the Elemental Burst Lustrous Moonrise deal increased DMG equal to 309% and 774% of Lan Yan's Elemental Mastery respectively.
passives.descriptionId: DMG Elemental Skill Swallow-Wisp Pinion Dance dan Elemental Burst Lustrous Moonrise ditingkatkan sebesar 309% dan 774% dari Elemental Mastery Lan Yan.

passives.name: Thought and Intent, Like Silken Scent
passives.description:
When Lan Yan is in the party, your characters will not startle Crystalflies and certain other animals when getting near them.
Check the "Other" sub-category of the "Living Beings / Wildlife" section in the Archive for creatures this skill works on.
passives.descriptionId:
Saat Lan Yan berada di dalam party, Crystalfly dan beberapa binatang tertentu yang didekati Karakter dalam party tidak akan kaget dan kabur.
Silakan menuju bagian Arsip > Makhluk Hidup/Hewan Liar > Lainnya untuk mengecek objek-objek yang dapat dipengaruhi skill ini.

constellations.name: "As One Might Stride Betwixt the Clouds"
constellations.description:
After triggering the Elemental Absorption from the Ascension Talent "Four Sealing Divination Charms," this instance of Lan Yan's Elemental Skill Swallow-Wisp Pinion Dance will produce another Feathermoon Ring when they are thrown at opponents.
You must first unlock the Ascension Talent "Four Sealing Divination Charms."
constellations.descriptionId:
Setelah memicu konversi elemen dari Talenta Ascension "Four Sealing Divination Charms", Elemental Skill Swallow-Wisp Pinion Dance kali ini akan menghasilkan satu Feathermoon Ring lagi saat dilemparkan terhadap musuh.
Harus membuka Talenta Ascension "Four Sealing Divination Charms" terlebih dahulu.

constellations.name: "Dance Vestments Billow Like Rainbow Jade"
constellations.description: While the Swallow-Wisp Shield is active, when your active party member's Normal Attacks deal DMG, 40% of the Shield's DMG absorption will be restored, up to its original maximum absorption. This effect can occur once every 2s.
constellations.descriptionId: Ketika Swallow-Wisp Shield sedang aktif, maka saat Normal Attack dari Karakter aktif milikmu di dalam party menghasilkan DMG, maka DMG yang bisa diserap oleh Perisai akan dipulihkan 40%. Maksimum sampai kembali ke nilai awal yang bisa diserap Perisai. Efek ini dapat terpicu sekali setiap 2 detik.

constellations.name: "On White Wings Pierce Through Cloud and Fog"
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Swallow-Wisp Pinion Dance by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.descriptionId:
Meningkatkan 3 level Elemental Skill Swallow-Wisp Pinion Dance.
Maksimum: Lv. 15.

constellations.name: "With Drakefalcon's Blood-Pearls Adorned"
constellations.description: After Lan Yan uses her Elemental Burst Lustrous Moonrise, the Elemental Mastery of all nearby party members increases by 60 for 12s.
constellations.descriptionId: Selama 12 detik setelah melancarkan Elemental Burst Lustrous Moonrise, Elemental Mastery seluruh anggota party di sekitar meningkat 60 poin.

constellations.name: "Having Met You, My Heart is Gladdened"
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Lustrous Moonrise by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.descriptionId:
Meningkatkan 3 level Elemental Burst Lustrous Moonrise.
Maksimum: Lv. 15.

constellations.name: "Let Us Away on Sylphic Wing, the Silvered Ornaments to Ring"
constellations.description: Swallow-Wisp Pinion Dance gains 1 additional charge.
constellations.descriptionId: Menambahkan 1 charge Swallow-Wisp Pinion Dance.

name: Layla
title: Fantastical Evening Star
description: A Rtawahist student who specializes in Theoretical Astrology. Heavily prone to somnambulism and locked in a grinding war with sleep deprivation, the problem of restful slumber is a most troubling one to her.
descriptionId: Siswa Darshan Rtawahist yang mengambil spesialisasi Teori Astrologi. Sering tidur berjalan, kadang kala terus terjaga sampai sekian lama. Intinya, dia bermasalah untuk urusan tidur dan istirahat.

talents.name: Sword of the Radiant Path
talents.description:
Normal Attack
Performs up to 3 rapid strikes.

Charged Attack
Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to unleash 2 rapid sword strikes.

Plunging Attack
Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground below, damaging opponents along the path and dealing AoE DMG upon impact.
talents.descriptionId:
Normal Attack
Melancarkan hingga 3 serangan berturut-turut.

Charged Attack
Mengonsumsi sejumlah Stamina untuk melancarkan dua tebasan pedang.

Plunging Attack
Menerjang dari udara untuk menghantam tanah, menyerang musuh di jalur terjangan dan mengakibatkan DMG area saat mendarat.

talents.name: Nights of Formal Focus
talents.description:
Puts forth a shield known as the Curtain of Slumber, dealing AoE Cryo DMG.
The Curtain of Slumber's DMG Absorption is based on Layla's Max HP and absorbs Cryo DMG with 250% effectiveness. When the shield is deployed, Layla will have Cryo applied to her briefly.

Night Stars and Shooting Stars
While the Curtain of Slumber is active, it will create 1 Night Star that will be attached to it every 1.5s. When a character protected by this shield uses an Elemental Skill, 2 Night Stars will be created. Night Stars can be created once every 0.3s in this way. A maximum of 4 Night Stars can be accumulated at any one time.
Once the Curtain of Slumber has accumulated 4 Night Stars and there are opponents nearby, these Night Stars will transform into homing Shooting Stars that will be fired off in sequence, dealing Cryo DMG to any opponents hit.
If the Curtain of Slumber's duration ends or it is destroyed, the Night Stars will disappear. If they are already being fired off as Shooting Stars, these Shooting Stars will last until this wave of shots ends.

New Night Stars cannot be created until the previous wave of Shooting Stars has been fired completely.
talents.descriptionId:
Mengaktifkan Curtain of Slumber dan mengakibatkan Cryo DMG Area.
Curtain of Slumber dapat menahan DMG berdasarkan Max HP Layla, Perisai juga memiliki 250% pertahanan terhadap Cryo DMG. Saat mengaktifkan Perisai, akan memberikan efek Cryo sementara untuk Layla.

Night Star and Shooting Star
Selama Curtain of Slumber aktif, maka setiap 1,5 detik akan menghasilkan 1 buah Night Star yang melekat ke Perisai; Saat Karakter yang berada di dalam perlindungan Perisai melancarkan Elemental Skill, 2 buah Night Star akan dihasilkan. Night Star dapat dihasilkan dengan cara ini setiap 0,3 detik, sampai maksimal 4 buah Night Star.
Saat Night Star pada Curtain of Slumber mencapai 4 buah, dan jika ada musuh di sekitar, maka Night Star secara otomatis berubah menjadi Shooting Star yang bisa mengejar musuh, dan mengakibatkan Cryo DMG terhadap musuh yang terkena.
Saat durasi Curtain of Slumber berakhir atau Perisainya hancur, Night Star juga akan turut lenyap. Jika Night Star sudah berubah menjadi Shooting Star dan sudah diluncurkan, maka Shooting Star akan terus diluncurkan sampai habis.

Night Star yang baru tidak akan bisa dihasilkan sebelum Shooting Star yang lama habis.

talents.name: Dream of the Star-Stream Shaker
talents.description:
Unleashes a Celestial Dreamsphere that constantly fires Starlight Slugs at opponents within its AoE, dealing Cryo DMG.
When a Starlight Slug hits, it will generate 1 Night Star for nearby Curtains of Slumber. Each Curtain of Slumber can gain 1 Night Star this way every 0.5s.
talents.descriptionId:
Melancarkan Celestial Dreamsphere yang akan terus-menerus menembakkan Starlight Slug terhadap musuh dalam radiusnya, mengakibatkan Cryo DMG.
Setelah Starlight Slug mengenai sasaran, 1 buah Night Star untuk Curtain of Slumber akan dihasilkan. Night Star dapat dihasilkan dengan cara ini setiap 0,5 detik.

passives.name: Like Nascent Light
passives.description:
While the Curtain of Slumber is active, the Deep Sleep effect will activate each time the Curtain gains 1 Night Star:
·The Shield Strength of a character under the effect of the Curtain of Slumber increases by 6%.
·This effect can have a maximum of 4 stacks and persists until the Curtain of Slumber disappears.

passives.name: Sweet Slumber Undisturbed
passives.description: The DMG dealt by the Shooting Stars fired by Nights of Formal Focus is increased by 1.5% of Layla's Max HP.
passives.descriptionId: DMG yang diakibatkan oleh Shooting Star dari Nights of Formal Focus meningkat sebesar 1,5% dari Max HP Layla.

passives.name: Shadowy Dream-Signs
passives.description: When Layla crafts Character Talent Materials, she has a 10% chance to receive double the product.
passives.descriptionId: Saat membuat Material Talenta Karakter, memiliki 10% kemungkinan untuk mendapatkan hasil 2 kali lipat.

constellations.name: Fortress of Fantasy
constellations.description:
The Shield Absorption of the Curtain of Slumber generated by Nights of Formal Focus is increased by 20%.
Additionally, when unleashing Nights of Formal Focus, she will generate a shield for any nearby party members who are not being protected by a Curtain of Slumber. This shield will have 35% of the absorption of a Curtain of Slumber, will last for 12s, and will absorb Cryo DMG with 250% effectiveness.
constellations.descriptionId:
DMG yang bisa ditahan Curtain of Slumber dari Nights of Formal Focus meningkat 20%.
Selain itu, saat melancarkan Nights of Formal Focus, akan memberikan Perisai kepada seluruh Karakter yang tidak berada dalam perlindungan Perisai Curtain of Slumber, Perisai ini dapat menahan DMG sebesar 35% Perisai Curtain of Slumber, bertahan 12 detik, dan memiliki 250% pertahanan terhadap Cryo DMG.

constellations.name: Light's Remit
constellations.description: When Shooting Stars from Nights of Formal Focus strike opponents, they will each restore 1 Energy to Layla. Each Shooting Star can restore Energy to her in this manner once.
constellations.descriptionId: Saat Shooting Star dari Nights of Formal Focus mengenai musuh, akan memulihkan 1 poin Energy Layla. Setiap Shooting Star dapat memulihkan Energy Layla seperti ini sebanyak satu kali.

constellations.name: Secrets of the Night
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Nights of Formal Focus by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.descriptionId:
Meningkatkan 3 level Nights of Formal Focus.
Maksimum: Lv. 15.

constellations.name: Starry Illumination
constellations.description:
When Nights of Formal Focus starts to fire off Shooting Stars, it will grant all nearby party members the Dawn Star effect, causing their Normal and Charged Attack DMG to increase based on 5% of Layla's Max HP.
Dawn Star can last up to 3s and will be removed 0.05s after dealing Normal or Charged Attack DMG.
constellations.descriptionId:
Saat Nights of Formal Focus mulai menembakkan Shooting Star, akan memberikan efek Dawn Star terhadap seluruh anggota party di sekitar: DMG yang diakibatkan Normal Attack dan Charged Attack akan meningkat sebesar 5% Max HP Layla.
Efek Dawn Star bertahan selama 3 detik, dan akan hilang 0,05 detik setelah Normal Attack atau Charged Attack mengakibatkan DMG.

constellations.name: Stream of Consciousness
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Dream of the Star-Stream Shaker by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.descriptionId:
Meningkatkan 3 level Dream of the Star-Stream Shaker.
Maksimum: Lv. 15.

constellations.name: Radiant Soulfire
constellations.description:
Shooting Stars from Nights of Formal Focus deal 40% increased DMG, and Starlight Slugs from Dream of the Star-Stream Shaker deal 40% increased DMG.
Additionally, the interval between the creation of Night Stars via Nights of Formal Focus is decreased by 20%.
constellations.descriptionId:
DMG yang diakibatkan Shooting Star dari Nights of Formal Focus meningkat 40%, DMG Starlight Slug dari Dream of the Star-Stream Shaker meningkat 40%.
Selain itu, jeda Night Star yang dihasilkan oleh Nights of Formal Focus berkurang sebesar 20%.

name: Lisa
title: Witch of Purple Rose
description: The languid but knowledgeable Librarian of the Knights of Favonius, deemed by Sumeru Akademiya to be their most distinguished graduate in the past two centuries.
descriptionId: Pustakawan Knights of Favonius yang sangat malas namun berwawasan sangat luas. Sumeru Akademiya menyatakan Lisa sebagai lulusan paling berbakat dalam 2 abad terakhir.

talents.name: Lightning Touch
talents.description:
Normal Attack
Performs up to 4 lightning attacks that deal Electro DMG.

Charged Attack
Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to deal AoE Electro DMG after a short casting time.

Plunging Attack
Gathering the might of Electro, Lisa plunges towards the ground from mid-air, damaging all opponents in her path. Deals AoE Electro DMG upon impact with the ground.
talents.descriptionId:
Normal Attack
Melancarkan hingga 4 serangan listrik yang mengakibatkan Electro DMG.

Charged Attack
Mengonsumsi sejumlah Stamina untuk mengakibatkan Electro DMG Area setelah jeda singkat.

Plunging Attack
Mengumpulkan kekuatan Electro dan menerjang tanah, menyerang musuh di jalur terjangan dan mengakibatkan Electro DMG Area saat mendarat.

talents.name: Violet Arc
talents.description:
Channels the power of lightning to sweep bothersome matters away.

Press
Releases a homing Lightning Orb.
On hit, it deals Electro DMG and applies a stack of the Conductive status (max 3 stacks) to opponents in a small AoE.

Hold
After an extended casting time, calls down lightning from the heavens, dealing massive Electro DMG to all nearby opponents.
Deals great amounts of extra damage to opponents based on the number of Conductive stacks applied to them, and clears their Conductive status.
talents.descriptionId:
Menyalurkan kekuatan petir untuk menyapu bersih masalah yang merepotkan.

Mode Tekan
Melancarkan sebuah Lightning Orb yang mengejar musuh.
Saat mengenai musuh, Lightning Orb akan mengakibatkan Electro DMG dan memberikan satu lapis efek Conductive (maksimum 3 lapis) ke musuh di dalam sebuah area kecil.

Mode Tahan
Setelah tombol skill ditahan untuk beberapa saat, Lisa akan memanggil petir dari langit untuk mengakibatkan Electro DMG yang besar ke semua musuh di sekitar.
Akan mengakibatkan DMG tambahan yang besar kepada musuh berdasarkan jumlah lapisan efek Conductive yang dimiliki, kemudian menghapus efek ini.

talents.name: Lightning Rose
talents.description:
Summons a Lightning Rose that unleashes powerful lightning bolts, launching surrounding opponents and dealing Electro DMG.
The Lightning Rose will continuously emit lightning to knock back opponents and deal Electro DMG throughout the ability's duration.
talents.descriptionId:
Memanggil Lightning Rose yang melancarkan sambaran petir kuat dan menghempaskan musuh di sekitar dan mengakibatkan Electro DMG.
Selama durasinya berlangsung, Lightning Rose akan terus menyerang musuh di sekitar dengan petir dan mengakibatkan Electro DMG.

passives.name: Induced Aftershock
passives.description: Hits by Charged Attacks apply Violet Arc's Conductive status to opponents.
passives.descriptionId: Charged Attack yang mengenai musuh akan memberikan efek Conductive dari skill Violet Arc pada musuh.

passives.name: Static Electricity Field
passives.description: Opponents hit by Lightning Rose have their DEF decreased by 15% for 10s.
passives.descriptionId: Serangan Lightning Rose yang mengenai musuh akan mengurangi 15% DEF musuh tersebut selama 10 detik.

passives.name: General Pharmaceutics
passives.description: When Lisa crafts a potion, she has a 20% chance to refund a portion of the crafting materials used.
passives.descriptionId: Lisa memiliki 20% kemungkinan mendapatkan kembali sebagian material yang digunakan saat membuat potion.

constellations.name: Infinite Circuit
constellations.description:
Lisa regenerates 2 Energy for every opponent hit while holding Violet Arc.
A maximum of 10 Energy can be regenerated in this manner at any one time.
constellations.descriptionId:
Violet Arc dalam Mode Tahan akan memulihkan 2 Energy Lisa untuk setiap musuh yang terkena serangan.
Maksimum dapat memulihkan 10 Energy dengan cara ini setiap kalinya.

constellations.name: Electromagnetic Field
constellations.description:
Holding Violet Arc has the following effects:
·Increases DEF by 25%.
·Increases Lisa's resistance to interruption.
constellations.descriptionId:
Menahan tombol skill Violet Arc akan memberikan efek berikut:
·Meningkatkan 25% DEF.
·Meningkatkan ketahanan Lisa terhadap interupsi.

constellations.name: Resonant Thunder
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Lightning Rose by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.descriptionId:
Meningkatkan 3 level Lightning Rose.
Maksimum: Lv. 15.

constellations.name: Plasma Eruption
constellations.description: Lightning Rose now unleashes 1-3 lightning bolts when it attacks.
constellations.descriptionId: Lightning Rose akan melancarkan 1-3 sambaran petir saat menyerang.

constellations.name: Electrocute
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Violet Arc by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.descriptionId:
Meningkatkan 3 level Violet Arc.
Maksimum: Lv. 15.

constellations.name: Pulsating Witch
constellations.description:
When Lisa takes the field, she applies 3 stacks of Violet Arc's Conductive status onto nearby opponents.
This effect can only occur once every 5s.
constellations.descriptionId:
Saat berganti Karakter ke Lisa, Lisa akan memberikan 3 lapis efek Conductive dari skill Violet Arc ke musuh di sekitar.
Efek ini dapat terpicu sekali setiap 5 detik.

name: Lynette
title: Elegance in the Shadows
description: A magic assistant of few words, her emotions are as inscrutable as any cat's.
descriptionId: Asisten pesulap yang tidak banyak bicara. Emosinya sulit ditebak, persis seperti kucing.

talents.name: Rapid Ritesword
talents.description:
Normal Attack
Performs up to 4 rapid strikes.

Charged Attack
Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to unleash 2 rapid sword strikes.

Plunging Attack
Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground below, damaging opponents along the path and dealing AoE DMG upon impact.
talents.descriptionId:
Normal Attack
Melancarkan hingga 4 serangan berturut-turut.

Charged Attack
Mengonsumsi sejumlah Stamina untuk melancarkan dua tebasan pedang.

Plunging Attack
Menerjang dari udara untuk menghantam tanah, menyerang musuh di jalur terjangan dan mengakibatkan DMG area saat mendarat.

talents.name: Enigmatic Feint
talents.description:
Flicks her mantle and executes an Enigma Thrust, dealing Anemo DMG.
When the Enigma Thrust hits an opponent, it will restore Lynette's HP based on her Max HP, and in the 4s afterward, she will lose a certain amount of HP per second.
Based on whether you press or hold this ability, she will use Enigma Thrust differently.

Press
She swiftly uses an Enigma Thrust.

Hold
Lynette will enter a high-speed Pilfering Shadow state and apply Shadowsign to a nearby opponent. You can control her movement direction during this state, and you can end it prematurely by using this skill again.
When this high-speed state ends, Lynette will unleash her Enigma Thrust. If there is an opponent with Shadowsign applied to them nearby, Lynette will approach them in a flash before using Enigma Thrust.

A maximum of 1 opponent can have Shadowsign at any one time. When this opponent gets too far from Lynette, the Shadowsign will be canceled.

Arkhe: Ousia
At specific intervals, Lynette will unleash a Surging Blade when she uses Enigma Thrust, dealing Ousia-aligned Anemo DMG.
talents.descriptionId:
Lynette mengayunkan jubahnya dan melancarkan Enigma Thrust yang mengakibatkan Anemo DMG.
Saat Enigma Thrust mengenai musuh, serangan ini akan memulihkan HP Lynette berdasarkan Max HP-nya, dan dalam 4 detik selanjutnya, HP Lynette akan berkurang dalam jumlah tertentu setiap detiknya.
Lynette akan menggunakan Enigma Thrust dengan cara yang berbeda berdasarkan cara skill dilancarkan; Mode Tekan atau Mode Tahan.

Mode Tekan
Melancarkan Enigma Thrust dengan gesit.

Mode Tahan
Lynette memasuki status Pilfering Shadow yang membuatnya bergerak dengan cepat dan memberikan "Shadowsign" terhadap musuh di dekatnya. Dalam kondisi ini, kamu bisa mengontrol arah gerakannya dan kamu bisa menghentikannya jika menggunakan skill ini lagi.
Setelah status ini berakhir, Lynette akan melancarkan Enigma Thrust. Jika ada musuh yang memiliki Shadowsign di sekitarnya, maka Lynette akan mendekatinya secara cepat dan melancarkan Enigma Thrust.

Maksimum 1 musuh yang dapat terkena Shadowsign dalam satu waktu. Jika musuh ini berada terlalu jauh dari Lynette, Shadowsign akan terhapus.

Arkhe: Ousia
Setiap kurun waktu tertentu, Lynette akan melancarkan Surging Blade saat menggunakan Enigma Thrust dan mengakibatkan Ousia-aligned Anemo DMG.

talents.name: Magic Trick: Astonishing Shift
talents.description:
Lynette raises her mantle high, dealing AoE Anemo DMG, using skillful sleight of hand to make a giant Bogglecat Box appear!

Bogglecat Box
·Taunts nearby opponents, attracting their attacks.
·Deals Anemo DMG to nearby opponents at intervals.
·When the Bogglecat Box comes into contact with Hydro/Pyro/Cryo/Electro, it will gain the corresponding element and additionally fire Vivid Shots that will deal DMG from that element at intervals.
Elemental Absorption of this kind will only occur once during this ability's duration.
talents.descriptionId:
Lynette mengangkat mantelnya dengan tinggi dan mengakibatkan Anemo DMG Area, menggunakan cara yang mengejutkan untuk memunculkan Bogglecat Box!

Bogglecat Box
·Memprovokasi musuh di sekitar terus-menerus dan memancing serangan mereka.
·Mengakibatkan Anemo DMG terhadap musuh di sekitar secara berkala.
·Saat Bogglecat Box berhubungan dengan Hydro/Pyro/Cryo/Electro, akan mendapatkan tipe elemen yang sama dan menembakkan Vivid Shot yang mengakibatkan DMG elemen tersebut secara berkala.
Elemental Absorption hanya akan terjadi satu kali selama Skill ini berlangsung.

passives.name: Sophisticated Synergy
passives.description: Within 10s after using Magic Trick: Astonishing Shift, when there are 1/2/3/4 Elemental Types in the party, all party members' ATK will be increased by 8%/12%/16%/20% respectively.
passives.descriptionId: Setelah melancarkan Magic Trick: Astonishing Shift, ATK seluruh anggota party akan meningkat 8%/12%/16%/20% selama 10 detik jika di dalam party terdapat Karakter dengan 1/2/3/4 jenis elemen yang berbeda.

passives.name: Props Positively Prepped
passives.description: After the Bogglecat Box summoned by Magic Trick: Astonishing Shift performs Elemental Conversion, Lynette's Elemental Burst will deal 15% more DMG. This effect will persist until the Bogglecat Box's duration ends.
passives.descriptionId: Setelah Bogglecat Box yang tercipta dari Magic Trick: Astonishing Shift mengalami Elemental Absorption, DMG Elemental Burst Lynette akan meningkat 15%. Efek ini akan berlangsung hingga durasi Bogglecat Box berakhir.

passives.name: Loci-Based Mnemonics
passives.description: Shows the location of nearby Recovery Orbs on the minimap. The Aquatic Stamina and HP gained from touching Orbs will be increased by 25%.
passives.descriptionId: Memperlihatkan lokasi Recovery Orb di sekitar pada peta kecil. Pemulihan HP dan Aquatic Stamina saat menyentuh Recovery Orb meningkat 25%.

constellations.name: A Cold Blade Like a Shadow
constellations.description: When Enigmatic Feint's Enigma Thrust hits an opponent with Shadowsign, a vortex will be created at that opponent's position that will pull nearby opponents in.
constellations.descriptionId: Saat Enigma Thrust dari Enigmatic Feint mengenai musuh yang memiliki Shadowsign, pusaran angin akan tercipta di posisi musuh berada dan menarik musuh di sekitarnya.

constellations.name: Endless Mysteries
constellations.description: Whenever the Bogglecat Box summoned by Magic Trick: Astonishing Shift fires a Vivid Shot, it will fire an extra Vivid Shot.
constellations.descriptionId: Saat Bogglecat Box yang tercipta dari Magic Trick: Astonishing Shift menembakkan Vivid Shot, akan menembakkan satu Vivid Shot tambahan.

constellations.name: Cognition-Inverting Gaze
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Magic Trick: Astonishing Shift by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.descriptionId:
Meningkatkan 3 level Magic Trick: Astonishing Shift.
Maksimum: Lv. 15.

constellations.name: Tacit Coordination
constellations.description: Increases Enigmatic Feint's charges by 1.
constellations.descriptionId: Meningkatkan 1 charge Enigmatic Feint.

constellations.name: Obscuring Ambiguity
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Enigmatic Feint by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.descriptionId:
Meningkatkan 3 level Enigmatic Feint.
Maksimum: Lv. 15.

constellations.name: Watchful Eye
constellations.description: When Lynette uses Enigmatic Feint's Enigma Thrust, she will gain an Anemo Infusion and 20% Anemo DMG Bonus for 6s.
constellations.descriptionId: Saat Lynette melancarkan Enigma Thrust dari skill Enigmatic Feint, akan mendapatkan Anemo Infusion dan meningkatkan 20% Anemo DMG Bonus selama 6 detik.

name: Mika
title: Coordinates of Clear Frost
description: A young knight born to an ordinary family. He serves as a Front-Line Surveyor in his Company. He is a low-key and cautious character.
descriptionId: Seorang kesatria muda yang terlahir di keluarga biasa. Di dalam kelompok pasukannya, dia bertugas sebagai "petugas survei lapangan barisan depan". Dia adalah orang yang rendah hati dan selalu berwaspada.

talents.name: Spear of Favonius - Arrow's Passage
talents.description:
Normal Attack
Performs up to 5 consecutive strikes using his crossbow and spear.

Charged Attack
Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to lunge forward, dealing damage to opponents along the way.

Plunging Attack
Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground below, damaging opponents along the path and dealing AoE DMG upon impact.
talents.descriptionId:
Normal Attack
Melancarkan hingga 5 serangan berturut-turut dengan menggunakan kombinasi antara tombak dan busur silang.

Charged Attack
Mengonsumsi sejumlah Stamina untuk menerjang ke depan, mengakibatkan DMG pada musuh di jalurnya.

Plunging Attack
Menerjang dari udara untuk menghantam tanah, menyerang semua musuh di jalurnya dan mengakibatkan DMG Area saat mendarat.

talents.name: Starfrost Swirl
talents.description:
Mika uses his crossbow to attack, granting all nearby characters in your party Soulwind. When characters in the Soulwind state are on the field, their ATK SPD will be increased.
Will take effect in different ways if Tapped or Held.

Tap
Fires a Flowfrost Arrow that can pierce through opponents, dealing Cryo DMG to enemies it comes into contact with.

Hold
Goes into Aiming Mode, locking on to an opponent and firing a Rimestar Flare at them, dealing Cryo DMG. When the Rimestar Flare hits, it will rise before exploding, launching Rimestar Shards into a maximum of 3 other opponents, dealing Cryo DMG.
talents.descriptionId:
Mika menggunakan busur silangnya untuk menyerang musuh, dan memberikan status Soulwind pada Karakter aktif di sekitar. Saat Karakter dengan status Soulwind berada di medan pertempuran, ATK SPD Karakter ini akan meningkat.
Akan menghasilkan efek yang berbeda berdasarkan cara skill dilancarkan, yaitu ditekan atau ditahan.

Mode Tekan
Menembakkan satu Flowfrost Arrow yang bisa menembus musuh dan mengakibatkan Cryo DMG pada musuh yang terkena.

Mode Tahan
Memasuki Mode Membidik, mengunci satu musuh dan menembakkan Rimestar Flare terhadap musuh tersebut untuk mengakibatkan Cryo DMG. Setelah mengenai musuh, Rimestar Flare akan membumbung ke udara dan meledak, lalu akan meluncurkan Rimestar Shard kepada maksimum 3 musuh lainnya dan mengakibatkan Cryo DMG.

talents.name: Skyfeather Song
talents.description:
Derives the ability to spur his teammates on from the recited prayers of the knightly order, regenerating HP for all nearby party members. This healing is based on Mika's Max HP and will grant them the Eagleplume state.

Eagleplume
When the Normal Attacks of active characters affected by Eagleplume hit an opponent, Mika will help them regenerate HP based on his Max HP.
Characters affected by this state can only regenerate HP in this way once per short interval of time.
talents.descriptionId:
Mika membangkitkan semangat timnya dengan membacakan doa para kesatria. Mika akan memulihkan HP dan memberikan status Eagleplume kepada seluruh Karakter di sekitar. Jumlah pemulihan akan didasarkan pada Max HP Mika.

Eagleplume
Saat Normal Attack Karakter aktif yang berada dalam status Eagleplume mengenai musuh, Mika akan memulihkan HP Karakter ini dan jumlah pemulihannya akan didasarkan pada Max HP Mika.
Karakter yang berada dalam status ini hanya bisa memulihkan HP dengan cara ini satu kali setiap beberapa saat.

passives.name: Suppressive Barrage
passives.description:
Per the following circumstances, the Soulwind state caused by Starfrost Swirl will grant characters the Detector effect, increasing their Physical DMG by 10% when they are on the field.
·If the Flowfrost Arrow hits more than one opponent, each additional opponent hit will generate 1 Detector stack.
·When a Rimestar Shard hits an opponent, it will generate 1 Detector stack. Each Rimestar Shard can trigger the effect 1 time.

The Soulwind state can have a maximum of 3 Detector stacks, and if Starfrost Swirl is cast again during this duration, the pre-existing Soulwind state and all its Detector stacks will be cleared.
passives.descriptionId:
Dalam kondisi berikut ini, status Soulwind dari Starfrost Swirl akan memberikan efek Detector kepada Karakter di medan pertempuran, efek Detector akan meningkatkan 10% Physical DMG yang diakibatkan:
·Jika Flowfrost Arrow mengenai lebih dari satu musuh, Karakter mendapatkan 1 lapis efek Detector untuk setiap 1 musuh tambahan yang terkena;
·Satu lapis efek Detector akan tercipta saat Rimestar Shard mengenai musuh. Setiap Rimestar Shard hanya bisa memicu efek ini satu kali.

Jumlah maksimum efek Detector dari status Soulwind adalah 3 lapis. Jika Starfrost Swirl dilancarkan kembali selama durasinya masih berlangsung, maka status Soulwind dan seluruh lapisan Detector yang ada sebelumnya akan dihapus.

passives.name: Topographical Mapping
passives.description:
When an active character affected by both Skyfeather Song's Eagleplume and Starfrost Swirl's Soulwind at once scores a CRIT Hit with their attacks, Soulwind will grant them 1 stack of Detector from the Ascension Talent Suppressive Barrage. During a single instance of Soulwind, 1 Detector stack can be gained in this manner.
Additionally, the maximum number of stacks that can be gained through Soulwind alone is increased by 1.
You must first unlock the Ascension Talent "Suppressive Barrage."
passives.descriptionId:
Saat Karakter aktif berada dalam status Eagleplume dari Skyfeather Song dan status Soulwind dari Starfrost Swirl secara bersamaan, saat Karakter mengakibatkan Serangan CRIT, status Soulwind akan memberikan 1 lapis efek Detector dari Talenta Ascension "Suppressive Barrage". Jumlah maksimum efek Detector yang bisa diperoleh dengan cara ini adalah 1 lapis dalam durasi satu kali status Eagleplume.
Selain itu, jumlah maksimum efek Detector yang bisa diperoleh dari status Soulwind sendiri akan bertambah 1 lapis.
Harus membuka Talenta Ascension "Suppressive Barrage" terlebih dahulu.

passives.name: Demarcation
passives.description: Displays the location of nearby resources unique to Mondstadt on the mini-map.
passives.descriptionId: Memperlihatkan lokasi produk khas Mondstadt di sekitar pada peta kecil.

constellations.name: Factor Confluence
constellations.description: The Soulwind state of Starfrost Swirl can decrease the healing interval between instances caused by Skyfeather Song's Eagleplume state. This decrease percentage is equal to the ATK SPD increase provided by Soulwind.
constellations.descriptionId: Status Soulwind dari Starfrost Swirl akan mengurangi jeda pemulihan HP status Eagleplume dari Skyfeather Song. Persentase pengurangan ini setara dengan peningkatan ATK SPD yang diberikan Soulwind.

constellations.name: Companion's Ingress
constellations.description:
When Starfrost Swirl's Flowfrost Arrow first hits an opponent, or its Rimestar Flare hits an opponent, 1 Detector stack from the Ascension Talent "Suppressive Barrage" will be generated.
You must first unlock the Ascension Talent "Suppressive Barrage."
constellations.descriptionId:
Saat Flowfrost Arrow dari Starfrost Swirl mengenai musuh untuk pertama kalinya, atau saat Rimestar Flare mengenai musuh, akan menghasilkan 1 lapis efek Detector dari Talenta Ascension "Suppressive Barrage".
Harus membuka Talenta Ascension Suppressive Barrage lebih dulu.

constellations.name: Reconnaissance Experience
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Skyfeather Song by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.descriptionId:
Meningkatkan 3 level Skyfeather Song.
Maksimum: Lv. 15.

constellations.name: Sunfrost Encomium
constellations.description: When Mika's own Skyfeather Song's Eagleplume state heals party members, this will restore 3 Energy to Mika. This form of Energy restoration can occur 5 times during the Eagleplume state created by 1 use of Skyfeather Song.
constellations.descriptionId: Saat status Eagleplume dari Skyfeather Song milik Mika memulihkan HP Karakter di dalam party, maka akan memulihkan 3 poin Energy kepada Mika. Pemulihan Energy seperti ini bisa terjadi 5 kali selama durasi satu kali status Eagleplume (yang diciptakan oleh satu kali Skyfeather Song) berlangsung.

constellations.name: Signal Arrow
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Starfrost Swirl by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.descriptionId:
Meningkatkan 3 level Starfrost Swirl.
Maksimum: Lv. 15.

constellations.name: Companion's Counsel
constellations.description:
The maximum number of Detector stacks that Starfrost Swirl's Soulwind can gain is increased by 1. You must first unlock the Ascension Talent "Suppressive Barrage.".
Additionally, active characters affected by Soulwind will deal 60% more Physical CRIT DMG.
constellations.descriptionId:
Jumlah maksimum tumpukan efek Detector status Soulwind dari Starfrost Swirl bertambah 1 lapis.
Harus membuka Talenta Ascension Suppressive Barrage lebih dulu.
Selain itu, Physical CRIT DMG Karakter aktif yang berada dalam status Soulwind meningkat 60%.

name: Ningguang
title: Eclipsing Star
description: The Tianquan of the Liyue Qixing. Her wealth is unsurpassed in all of Teyvat.
descriptionId: Seorang "Tianquan" dari "Liyue Qixing", kekayaannya tidak tertandingi di seluruh Teyvat.

talents.name: Sparkling Scatter
talents.description:
Normal Attack
Shoots gems that deal Geo DMG.
Upon hit, this grants Ningguang 1 Star Jade.

Charged Attack
Consumes a certain amount of stamina to fire off a giant gem that deals Geo DMG.
If Ningguang has any Star Jades, unleashing a Charged Attack will cause the Star Jades to be fired at the enemy as well, dealing additional DMG.

Plunging Attack
Gathering the might of Geo, Ningguang plunges towards the ground from mid-air, damaging all opponents in her path. Deals AoE Geo DMG upon impact with the ground.
talents.descriptionId:
Normal Attack
Menembakkan batu permata yang mengakibatkan Geo DMG.
Saat mengenai musuh, akan memberikan 1 Star Jade kepada Ningguang.

Charged Attack
Mengonsumsi sejumlah Stamina untuk menembakkan batu permata raksasa yang mengakibatkan Geo DMG.
Jika Ningguang memiliki Star Jade, melancarkan Charged Attack juga akan menembakkan Star Jade ke musuh untuk mengakibatkan DMG tambahan.

Plunging Attack
Mengumpulkan kekuatan Geo dan menerjang tanah, menyerang musuh di jalur terjangan dan mengakibatkan Geo DMG Area saat mendarat.

talents.name: Jade Screen
talents.description:
Ningguang creates a Jade Screen out of gold, obsidian, and her great opulence, dealing AoE Geo DMG.

Jade Screen
·Blocks opponents' projectiles.
·Endurance scales based on Ningguang's Max HP.
