Jade Screen is considered a Geo Construct and can be used to block certain attacks, but cannot be climbed. Only one Jade Screen may exist at any one time.
talents.descriptionId:
Ningguang membentuk sebuah perisai Geo yang terbuat dari emas, obsidian, dan kekayaannya untuk mengakibatkan Geo DMG Area.

Jade Screen
·Menghalangi proyektil musuh.
·HP Jade Screen mewarisi Max HP Ningguang berdasarkan persentase tertentu.

Jade Screen dianggap sebagai sebuah Geo Construct dan dapat digunakan untuk menghalang beberapa jenis serangan, tapi tidak dapat dipanjat. Ningguang hanya dapat memiliki satu Jade Screen di satu waktu.

talents.name: Starshatter
talents.description:
Gathering a great number of gems, Ningguang scatters them all at once, sending homing projectiles at her opponents that deal massive Geo DMG.
If Starshatter is cast when a Jade Screen is nearby, the Jade Screen will fire additional gem projectiles at the same time.
talents.descriptionId:
Ningguang mengumpulkan batu permata di sekelilingnya dan menyebarkan semuanya sekaligus untuk menyerang musuh, mengakibatkan Geo DMG yang besar.
Jika Starshatter digunakan saat Jade Screen berada di dekatnya, Jade Screen juga akan menembakkan tambahan batu permata di saat bersamaan.

passives.name: Backup Plan
passives.description: When Ningguang is in possession of Star Jades, her Charged Attack does not consume Stamina.
passives.descriptionId: Charged Attack Ningguang tidak mengonsumsi Stamina saat Ningguang memiliki Star Jade.

passives.name: Strategic Reserve
passives.description: A character that passes through the Jade Screen will gain a 12% Geo DMG Bonus for 10s.
passives.descriptionId: Karakter yang melewati Jade Screen akan mendapatkan 12% Geo DMG Bonus selama 10 detik.

passives.name: Trove of Marvelous Treasures
passives.description: Displays the location of nearby ore veins used in forging on the mini-map.
passives.descriptionId: Memperlihatkan lokasi tambang ore untuk Forge di peta kecil.

constellations.name: Piercing Fragments
constellations.description: When a Normal Attack hits, it deals AoE DMG.
constellations.descriptionId: Saat Normal Attack mengenai musuh, mengakibatkan DMG Area.

constellations.name: Shock Effect
constellations.description:
When Jade Screen is shattered, its CD will reset.
Can occur once every 6s.
constellations.descriptionId:
Saat Jade Screen pecah, cooldown skill tersebut selesai.
Dapat terpicu sekali setiap 6 detik.

constellations.name: Majesty Be the Array of Stars
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Starshatter by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.descriptionId:
Meningkatkan 3 level Starshatter.
Maksimum: Lv. 15.

constellations.name: Exquisite be the Jade, Outshining All Beneath
constellations.description: Jade Screen increases nearby characters' Elemental RES by 10%.
constellations.descriptionId: Jade Screen meningkatkan Elemental RES karakter di sekitar sebesar 10%.

constellations.name: Invincible Be the Jade Screen
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Jade Screen by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.descriptionId:
Meningkatkan 3 level Jade Screen.
Maksimum: Lv. 15.

constellations.name: Grandeur Be the Seven Stars
constellations.description: When Starshatter is used, Ningguang gains 7 Star Jades.
constellations.descriptionId: Ningguang akan mendapatkan 7 Star Jade ketika melancarkan Starshatter.

name: Noelle
title: Chivalric Blossom
description: A maid who faithfully serves the Knights of Favonius. She dreams of joining their ranks someday.
descriptionId: Seorang pelayan yang bekerja di Knights of Favonius, memiliki impian untuk menjadi seorang Knight suatu hari kelak.

talents.name: Favonius Bladework - Maid
talents.description:
Normal Attack
Performs up to 4 consecutive strikes.

Charged Attack
Drains Stamina over time to perform continuous spinning attacks against all nearby opponents.
At the end of the sequence, performs a more powerful slash. 

Plunging Attack
Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground below, damaging opponents along the path and dealing AoE DMG upon impact.
talents.descriptionId:
Normal Attack
Melancarkan hingga 4 tebasan berturut-turut.

Charged Attack
Terus menguras Stamina untuk melancarkan serangan berputar yang mengakibatkan DMG ke musuh di sekitar.
Diakhiri dengan sebuah tebasan yang kuat.

Plunging Attack
Menerjang dari udara untuk menghantam tanah, menyerang musuh di jalur terjangan dan mengakibatkan DMG area saat mendarat.

talents.name: Breastplate
talents.description:
Summons protective stone armor, dealing Geo DMG to surrounding opponents and creating a shield. The shield's DMG Absorption scales based on Noelle's DEF.
The shield has the following properties:
·When Noelle's Normal and Charged Attacks hit a target, they have a certain chance to regenerate HP for all characters.
·Possesses 150% DMG Absorption efficiency against all Elemental and Physical DMG.

The amount of HP healed when regeneration is triggered scales based on Noelle's DEF.
talents.descriptionId:
Menciptakan zirah batu yang mengakibatkan Geo DMG pada musuh di sekitar dan membentuk Perisai. DMG yang ditahan Perisai berdasarkan DEF Noelle.
Perisainya memiliki ciri-ciri berikut:
·Saat Normal dan Charged Attack Noelle mengenai target, berkemungkinan memulihkan HP untuk semua karakter.
·Memiliki 150% Efisiensi Penahanan DMG terhadap semua Elemental dan Physical DMG.

Jumlah HP yang dipulihkan meningkat berdasarkan DEF Noelle.

talents.name: Sweeping Time
talents.description:
Gathering the strength of stone around her weapon, Noelle strikes the opponents surrounding her within a large AoE, dealing Geo DMG.
Afterwards, Noelle gains the following effects:
·Larger attack AoE.
·Converts attack DMG to Geo DMG that cannot be overridden by any other elemental infusion.
·Increased ATK that scales based on her DEF.
talents.descriptionId:
Mengumpulkan kekuatan Geo di sekitar senjatanya, Noelle menghantam musuh di sekitarnya dengan serangan dalam area besar, mengakibatkan Geo DMG.
Setelahnya, Noelle mendapatkan efek berikut:
·Serangan area yang lebih besar.
·Mengonversi serangan menjadi Geo DMG, konversi ini tidak bisa ditimpa oleh Elemental Infusion lainnya.
·Peningkatan ATK yang meningkat berdasarkan DEF dia.

passives.name: Devotion
passives.description:
When Noelle is in the party but not on the field, this ability triggers automatically when your active character's HP falls below 30%:
Creates a shield for your active character that lasts for 20s and absorbs DMG equal to 400% of Noelle's DEF.
The shield has a 150% DMG Absorption effectiveness against all Elemental and Physical DMG.
This effect can only occur once every 60s.
passives.descriptionId:
Saat Noelle berada dalam party, tetapi tidak sedang bertarung, skill ini akan terpicu secara otomatis ketika HP karakter yang sedang digunakan kurang dari 30%:
Karakter tersebut akan mendapatkan Perisai yang dapat menahan DMG sebesar 400% dari DEF Noelle selama 20 detik.
Perisai ini memiliki bonus 150% efektivitas Penahanan DMG untuk semua Elemental dan Physical DMG.
Efek ini dapat terpicu setiap 60 detik.

passives.name: Nice and Clean
passives.description:
Noelle will decrease the CD of Breastplate by 1s for every 4 Normal or Charged Attack hits she scores on opponents.
One hit may be counted every 0.1s.
passives.descriptionId:
Saat Normal Attack atau Charged Attack Noelle mengenai musuh 4 kali, CD skill Breastplate akan berkurang 1 detik.
Serangan Noelle dapat dihitung sebagai 1 kali setiap 0,1 detik.

passives.name: Maid's Knighthood
passives.description: When a Perfect Cooking is achieved on a DEF-boosting dish, Noelle has a 12% chance to obtain double the product.
passives.descriptionId: Saat masakan jenis pertahanan dimasak dengan sempurna, terdapat 12% kemungkinan mendapatkan hasil 2 kali lipat.

constellations.name: I Got Your Back
constellations.description: While Sweeping Time and Breastplate are both in effect, the chance of Breastplate's healing effects activating is increased to 100%.
constellations.descriptionId: Saat Sweeping Time dan Breastplate aktif bersamaan, serangan memiliki 100% persentase untuk memicu efek pemulihan.

constellations.name: Combat Maid
constellations.description: Decreases the Stamina Consumption of Noelle's Charged Attacks by 20% and increases her Charged Attack DMG by 15%.
constellations.descriptionId: Mengurangi 20% konsumsi stamina Charged Attack dan meningkatkan 15% DMG Charged Attack Noelle.

constellations.name: Invulnerable Maid
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Breastplate by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.descriptionId:
Meningkatkan 3 level Breastplate.
Maksimum: Lv. 15.

constellations.name: To Be Cleaned
constellations.description: When Breastplate's duration expires or it is destroyed by DMG, it will deal 400% of Noelle's ATK as Geo DMG to surrounding opponents.
constellations.descriptionId: Breastplate mengakibatkan Geo DMG sebesar 400% ATK ke musuh di sekitar saat hancur atau saat durasi selesai.

constellations.name: Favonius Sweeper Master
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Sweeping Time by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.descriptionId:
Meningkatkan 3 level Sweeping Time.
Maksimum: Lv. 15.

constellations.name: Must Be Spotless
constellations.description:
Sweeping Time increases Noelle's ATK by an additional 50% of her DEF.
Additionally, every opponent defeated during the skill's duration adds 1s to the duration, up to 10s.
constellations.descriptionId:
Sweeping Time meningkatkan ATK Noelle dengan tambahan 50% dari DEF Noelle.
Durasi skill meningkat 1 detik setiap mengalahkan musuh saat skill masih aktif, hingga 10 detik.

name: Ororon
title: Shadow of the Night-Wind
description: A young man from the Masters of the Night-Wind who instead lives in the wild alongside all manner of life.
descriptionId: Pemuda dari Penguasa Angin Malam yang hidup di alam liar bersama segala jenis makhluk lainnya.

talents.name: Spiritvessel Snapshot
talents.description:
Normal Attack
Performs up to 3 consecutive shots with a bow.

Charged Attack
Performs a more precise Aimed Shot with increased DMG.
While aiming, Electro energy will accumulate on the arrowhead. A fully charged arrow will deal Electro DMG.

Plunging Attack
Fires off a shower of arrows in mid-air before falling and striking the ground, dealing AoE DMG upon impact.
talents.descriptionId:
Normal Attack
Melancarkan hingga 3 serangan berturut-turut menggunakan busur.

Charged Attack
Mengerahkan sebuah Serangan Membidik yang lebih akurat untuk mengakibatkan DMG lebih besar.
Saat membidik, elemen Electro akan berkumpul di ujung anak panah. Panah dengan elemen Electro yang terkumpul penuh akan mengakibatkan Electro DMG.

Plunging Attack
Melancarkan hujan panah dari udara dan menerjang tanah dengan kecepatan tinggi, mengakibatkan DMG Area saat mendarat.

talents.name: Night's Sling
talents.description:
Ororon manifests an ancient mystical technique from the Masters of the Night-Wind as a Spirit Orb of midnight shade and throws it at his foe, dealing Nightsoul-aligned Electro DMG.
When other opponents are nearby, the Spirit Orb will bounce between them, dealing Nightsoul-aligned Electro DMG. Each time Night's Sling is used, each opponent can only be selected as a target once.
After 3 bounces, or if there are no eligible targets left, the Orb will disappear.
talents.descriptionId:
Ororon mewujudkan ilmu rahasia yang diwariskan oleh suku Penguasa Angin Malam menjadi Spirit Orb bayangan malam dan melemparkannya kepada musuh, mengakibatkan Nightsoul-aligned Electro DMG.
Saat ada musuh lainnya di sekitar, Spirit Orb akan memantul di antara musuh yang ada di sekitar, mengakibatkan Nightsoul-aligned Electro DMG. Setiap kali melancarkan Night's Sling, setiap musuh hanya bisa terpilih sebagai target sebanyak satu kali.
Spirit Orb akan menghilang setelah memantul sebanyak 3 kali atau saat tidak ada musuh di sekitar yang dapat dipilih sebagai target lagi.

talents.name: Dark Voices Echo
talents.description:
Ororon works an ancient ritual, dealing Nightsoul-aligned AoE Electro DMG, summoning forth a Supersonic Oculus.

Supersonic Oculus
·Continuously taunts nearby opponents and attracts attacks from them.
·Continuously rotates and fires off sonic waves that deal Nightsoul-aligned Electro DMG.
talents.descriptionId:
Ororon mempraktikkan sebuah upacara rahasia kuno untuk mengakibatkan Nightsoul-aligned Electro DMG Area dan memanggil sebuah "Supersonic Oculus".

Supersonic Oculus
·Terus menarik perhatian musuh di sekitar dan memancing musuh untuk menyerangnya.
·Terus berputar dan mengeluarkan gelombang suara yang mengakibatkan Nightsoul-aligned Electro DMG terhadap musuh di sekitar.

passives.name: Nightshade Synesthesia
passives.description:
After a nearby party member triggers Nightsoul Burst, Ororon will gain 40 Nightsoul points. Within 15s after using his Elemental Skill, when other party members' Hydro or Electro attacks hit opponents, Ororon will gain 5 Nightsoul points, an effect that can occur every 0.3s for a maximum of 10 times during this 15s duration.
Ororon can have a maximum of 80 Nightsoul points.

Also, when nearby opponents take Electro-Charged or Lunar-Charged reaction DMG or Nightsoul-aligned DMG dealt by other nearby characters, Ororon will consume 10 Nightsoul points (provided he has at least that amount), entering the Nightsoul's Blessing state and triggering the Hypersense effect: Deal Nightsoul-aligned Electro DMG based on 160% of Ororon's ATK to at most 4 nearby opponents. The aforementioned effect can trigger once every 1.8s.

Nightsoul's Blessing: Ororon
Ororon's Nightsoul's Blessing state lasts 6s.
passives.descriptionId:
Setelah Karakter dalam party di sekitar memicu Nightsoul Burst, Ororon akan mendapatkan 40 poin Nightsoul. Selama 15 detik setelah Ororon melancarkan Elemental Skill, saat serangan Karakter lain di dalam party dengan jenis elemen Hydro atau Electro mengenai musuh,maka Ororon akan mendapatkan 5 poin Nightsoul. Efek ini dapat terpicu sekali setiap 0,3 detik, dan dapat terpicu maksimum 10 kali selama durasi berlangsung.
Batas maksimum poin Nightsoul Ororon adalah 80 poin.

Selain itu, saat musuh di sekitar menerima DMG reaksi Electro-Charged atau Lunar-Charged atau saat Karakter lain di dalam party mengakibatkan Nightsoul-aligned DMG, jika Ororon memiliki setidaknya 10 poin Nightsoul, maka Ororon akan mengonsumsi 10 poin Nightsoul untuk memasuki status Nightsoul's Blessing dan memicu efek Hypersense: Mengakibatkan Nightsoul-aligned Electro DMG sebesar 160% ATK Ororon terhadap maksimum 4 musuh di sekitar. Efek di atas dapat terpicu sekali setiap 1,8 detik.

Nightsoul's Blessing: Ororon
Nightsoul's Blessing Ororon bertahan maksimum 6 detik.

passives.name: Aspect Catalyst
passives.description:
After the Elemental Skill Night's Sling's Spirit Orb hits an opponent, Ororon will gain the Aspect Sigil effect for 15s.

Aspect Sigil
When a nearby active party member hits an opponent with Normal, Charged, or Plunging Attacks, that character will restore 3 Energy. If Ororon is off-field, Ororon will also restore 3 Energy. This effect can trigger once every 1s, and can trigger 3 times per duration.
passives.descriptionId:
Setelah Spirit Orb dari Elemental Skill Night's Sling mengenai musuh, Ororon akan mendapatkan efek Aspect Sigil selama 15 detik.

Aspect Sigil
Setelah Normal Attack, Charged Attack, atau Plunging Attack Karakter aktif dalam party di sekitar mengenai musuh, efek ini juga akan memulihkan 3 poin Energy untuk Karakter ini. Jika Ororon ada di dalam party namun sedang tidak berada di medan pertempuran, akan memulihkan 3 poin Energy untuk Ororon. Efek di atas dapat terpicu sekali setiap 1 detik, dan dapat terpicu maksimum 3 kali selama durasi berlangsung.

passives.name: Night Realm's Gift: Flowing Fog, Spritely Shadows
passives.description:
While in an area with Phlogiston Mechanics within Natlan, he can use Nightsoul Transmission: Ororon. When the active character is currently in the air, the following will trigger when switching to Ororon: Ororon will leap up high. Nightsoul Transmission can be triggered once every 10s by your party.

Holding Aiming Mode will cause Ororon to enter the "Spiritspeaker" state, which will allow him to interact with "Nightspirit Graffiti" and "Nightspirit Sigils," extracting information and power from them. The rules for interacting with these objects follow the same rules as those governing Iktomisaurus interactions.

Additionally, holding the jump button will cause Ororon to consume 75 Stamina and leap. In areas within Natlan where Phlogiston mechanics are present, Ororon will prioritize consuming 5 Phlogiston to leap to a height higher still.
When in the air, Ororon can Hold his Normal Attack to consume Phlogiston or Stamina and enter Aiming Mode.
passives.descriptionId:
Saat ada area dengan Phlogiston Mechanic di Natlan, Ororon bisa melancarkan Nightsoul Transmission: Ororon. Saat Karakter aktif sedang berada di udara dan mengganti Karakter menjadi Ororon: Ororon akan melompat tinggi ke atas. Nightsoul Transmission party sendiri dapat terpicu sekali setiap 10 detik.

Saat menggunakan Mode Membidik, Ororon akan memasuki status Spiritspeaker. Dalam status ini, Ororon bisa berinteraksi dengan "Nightspirit Graffiti" dan "Nightspirit Sigil" untuk mengambil informasi dan kekuatan dari dalamnya. Peraturan interaksi dengan objek-objek ini sama dengan peraturan interaksi Iktomisaurus.

Selain itu, saat menahan tombol Melompat, Ororon akan mengonsumsi 75 poin Stamina untuk melompat tinggi ke atas. Saat ada area dengan Phlogiston Mechanic di Natlan, Ororon akan terlebih dulu mengonsumsi 5 poin Phlogiston untuk melompat ke ketinggian yang lebih tinggi lagi.
Saat sedang berada di udara, Ororon bisa menahan Normal Attack dan mengonsumsi Phlogiston atau Stamina untuk memasuki Mode Membidik.

passives.name: The Art of Skinchanging
passives.description:
Increases gliding SPD for your own party members by 15%.
Not stackable with Passive Talents that provide the exact same effects.
passives.descriptionId:
Meningkatkan 15% kecepatan meluncur Karakter dalam party sendiri.
Efek ini tidak dapat ditumpuk dengan Talenta Pasif lain dengan efek yang sama persis.

constellations.name: Trails Amidst the Forest Fog
constellations.description:
The Elemental Skill Night's Sling's Spirit Orb can bounce 2 additional times.
Additionally, after the Spirit Orb hits an opponent, it will apply the Nighttide effect to them for 12s. Opponents affected by Nighttide take 50% increased DMG from Hypersense triggered by the Ascension Talent, "Nightshade Synesthesia." You must first unlock the Ascension Talent "Nightshade Synesthesia."
constellations.descriptionId:
Spirit Orb dari Elemental Skill Night's Sling bisa memantul 2 kali lebih banyak.
Selain itu, setelah Spirit Orb mengenai musuh, akan menambahkan efek Nighttide terhadap musuh tersebut selama 12 detik. Musuh yang berada dalam pengaruh efek Nighttide akan menerima peningkatan 50% DMG yang diakibatkan oleh Hypersense dari Talenta Ascension "Nightshade Synesthesia". Harus membuka Talenta Ascension "Nightshade Synesthesia" terlebih dahulu.

constellations.name: King Bee of the Hidden Honeyed Wine
constellations.description:
After using his Elemental Burst, Dark Voices Echo, Ororon will obtain the Spiritual Supersense effect for 9s.

Spiritual Supersense
Gain 8% Electro DMG Bonus.
Additionally, during this time, every additional opponent hit by the Elemental Burst Dark Voices Echo or Supersonic Oculus will grant Ororon a further 8% Electro DMG Bonus. The maximum that can be gained this way is 32% Electro DMG Bonus.
constellations.descriptionId:
Setelah melancarkan Elemental Burst Dark Voices Echo, Ororon akan mendapatkan efek Spiritual Supersense selama 9 detik.

Spiritual Supersense
Mendapatkan 8% Electro DMG Bonus.
Selain itu, selama durasinya, setiap kali Elemental Burst Dark Voices Echo atau Supersonic Oculus mengenai satu musuh tambahan, akan memberikan Ororon 8% Electro DMG Bonus tambahan. Ororon bisa mendapatkan hingga maksimum 32% Electro DMG Bonus dengan cara ini.

constellations.name: Roosting Bat's Spiritcage
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Dark Voices Echo by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.descriptionId:
Meningkatkan 3 level Elemental Burst Dark Voices Echo.
Maksimum: Lv. 15.

constellations.name: As the Mysteries of the Night Wind
constellations.description:
The Supersonic Oculus summoned by the Elemental Burst Dark Voices Echo rotates 25% faster.
Additionally, Ororon will restore 8 Energy to himself after using Dark Voices Echo.
constellations.descriptionId:
Supersonic Oculus yang dipanggil oleh Elemental Burst Dark Voices Echo berputar 25% lebih cepat.
Selain itu, melancarkan Dark Voices Echo juga akan memulihkan 8 poin Energy Ororon.

constellations.name: A Gift For the Soul
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Night's Sling by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.descriptionId:
Meningkatkan 3 level Elemental Skill Night's Sling.
Maksimum: Lv. 15.

constellations.name: Ode to Deep Springs
constellations.description:
After triggering Hypersense through the Ascension Talent, Nightshade Synesthesia, your current active character's ATK is increased by 10% for 9s. Max 3 stacks, each stack is counted independently.
Additionally, when you use the Elemental Burst Dark Voices Echo, you will trigger one instance of an effect equivalent to Hypersense, dealing 200% of its original DMG.
You must first unlock the Ascension Talent "Nightshade Synesthesia."
constellations.descriptionId:
Setelah memicu Hypersense dari Talenta Ascension "Nightshade Synesthesia", ATK Karakter aktif dalam party sendiri akan meningkat 10% selama 9 detik. Efek ini dapat ditumpuk sampai 3 lapis dan durasi setiap lapisnya dihitung terpisah.
Selain itu, melancarkan Elemental Burst Dark Voices Echo akan memicu efek yang setara dengan Hypersense sebanyak satu kali dan mengakibatkan 200% DMG aslinya.
Harus membuka Talenta Ascension "Nightshade Synesthesia" terlebih dahulu.

name: Prune
title: Childlike Dreams Cherished
description: A diminutive Witch Hunter who has journeyed all the way from Nod-Krai with the singular purpose of rooting out a witch who, to hear her tell it, has committed every sin imaginable — including bullying little kids!
descriptionId: "Pemburu Penyihir" cilik. Dia menempuh perjalanan jauh dari Nod-Krai hanya untuk menaklukkan penyihir yang, menurutnya, gemar menindas yang lemah dan melakukan segala macam kejahatan.

talents.name: Badaboom! Hexbuster Hammer
talents.description:
Normal Attack
Performs up to 3 attacks by swinging the Banehunter Oathhammer, dealing Anemo DMG.

Charged Attack
Consumes a certain amount of Stamina and performs an upward hammer swing, dealing Anemo DMG to opponents in front.

Plunging Attack
Calling upon the power of Anemo, she plunges towards the ground from mid-air, damaging all opponents in her path. Deals AoE Anemo DMG upon impact with the ground.
talents.descriptionId:
Normal Attack
Mengayunkan Banehunter Oathhammer, melancarkan hingga 3 serangan dan mengakibatkan Anemo DMG.

Charged Attack
Mengonsumsi sejumlah Stamina, melakukan ayunan palu ke atas untuk mengakibatkan Anemo DMG terhadap musuh di depan.

Plunging Attack
Mengumpulkan kekuatan Anemo dan menerjang tanah, menyerang musuh di jalur terjangan dan mengakibatkan Anemo DMG Area saat mendarat.

talents.name: Ring-A-Ding-Ding! Hexhunter Chime
talents.description:
Determined to take down the "evil" witch and save her beloved Descartes, Prune unleashes the power of the wind! She strikes at the Witchlure Bell using her Banehunter Oathhammer, dealing Anemo DMG.
If Prune triggers a Swirl or Stellar Swirl reaction in the opponent with this attack, her Ring-A-Ding-Ding! Hexhunter Chime is changed to Clang Clang! Witch-tribution Comes! for the next 6s.

Clang Clang! Witch-tribution Comes!
Ensconces the **Banehunter Oathhammer** in the element involved in the earlier Swirl or Stellar Swirl reaction. After tapping to unleash, Prune will launch a midair kick at the Banehunter Oathhammer, dealing DMG to opponents in front of her of the corresponding elemental type.
talents.descriptionId:
Mengeluarkan kekuatan angin dengan tekad untuk mengalahkan sang penyihir "jahat" dan menyelamatkan Descartes! Prune menggunakan Banehunter Oathhammer untuk menghantam Witchlure Bell dan mengakibatkan Anemo DMG.
Jika Prune memicu reaksi Swirl atau Stellar Swirl terhadap musuh melalui serangan ini, maka Ring-A-Ding-Ding! Hexhunter Chime akan berubah menjadi Clang Clang! Witch-tribution Comes! selama 6 detik ke depan.

Clang Clang! Witch-tribution Comes!
Membungkus palu Prune dengan jenis elemen yang sebelumnya terlibat dalam reaksi Swirl atau Stellar Swirl, dan membuat **Banehunter Oathhammer** mengalami Elemental Conversion. Saat dilancarkan dengan Mode Tekan, Prune melompat dan menendang Banehunter Oathhammer ke depan, mengakibatkan Elemental DMG dengan jenis elemen yang sesuai terhadap musuh di depannya.

talents.name: The Bell Tolls! The Hunt Is On!
talents.description:
Prune gently swings the Witchlure Bell, dealing Anemo DMG to nearby opponents. After this, the Bell will enter the Hunter-Seeker mode.

Witchlure Bell: Hunter-Seeker
In this mode, the Witchlure Bell will follow the current active character, attacking surrounding opponents at intervals and dealing AoE Anemo DMG. This DMG is considered Elemental Burst DMG.
talents.descriptionId:
Prune mengayunkan Witchlure Bell dengan lembut, mengakibatkan Anemo DMG terhadap musuh di sekitar. Setelahnya, Witchlure Bell akan memasuki mode Hunter-Seeker.

Witchlure Bell: Hunter Seeker
Dalam mode ini, Witchlure Bell akan mengikuti Karakter aktif sambil menyerang musuh di sekitar secara berkala dan mengakibatkan Anemo DMG Area. DMG ini dianggap sebagai DMG Elemental Burst.

passives.name: Verdict and Punishment
passives.description: During the Elemental Burst **The Bell Tolls! The Hunt Is On!**, after the Witchlure Bell in Hunter-Seeker mode deals DMG to an opponent, if this DMG triggers Swirl or Stellar Swirl in an opponent, it will also summon a **Banehunter Oathhammer** that will deal 150% of Prune's ATK as DMG to them, with the DMG Type matching the Elemental Conversion from the Swirl or Stellar Swirl. This DMG is considered Elemental Burst DMG.
passives.descriptionId: Dalam Elemental Burst **The Bell Tolls! The Hunt is On!**, setelah Witchlure Bell dalam mode Hunter-Seeker mengakibatkan DMG terhadap musuh dan jika DMG tersebut memicu reaksi Swirl atau Stellar Swirl terhadap musuh, maka akan memanggil **Banehunter Oathhammer** yang telah mengalami Elemental Conversion berdasarkan reaksi Swirl atau Stellar Swirl kali ini di depan musuh dan menghantamnya, mengakibatkan Elemental DMG yang sesuai sebesar 150% ATK Prune. DMG ini dianggap sebagai DMG Elemental Burst.

passives.name: Tolling Synchronicity
passives.description: After Prune hits an opponent with the **Banehunter Oathhammer** that has undergone Elemental Conversion, other nearby party members will gain the Tolling Rally effect for 5s: When Normal, Charged, or Plunging Attacks, or Elemental Skills and Bursts deal DMG to opponents, that attack's DMG will be increased based on the portion of Prune's ATK in excess of 2,000 when they become affected by the Tolling Rally effect. Every excess ATK point increases that instance of DMG by 0.025%, up to a total of 50% max.
passives.descriptionId: Setelah Prune menggunakan **Banehunter Oathhammer** yang telah mengalami Elemental Conversion untuk mengenai musuh, anggota party lain di sekitar akan mendapatkan efek Tolling Rally yang berlangsung selama 5 detik: Saat Normal Attack, Charged Attack, Plunging Attack, Elemental Skill, atau Elemental Burst mengakibatkan DMG terhadap musuh, akan meningkatkan DMG yang diakibatkan oleh serangan tersebut berdasarkan ATK Prune saat mendapatkan efek Tolling Rally yang melebihi 2.000 poin. Setiap 1 poin ATK yang berlebih akan meningkatkan DMG yang diakibatkan oleh serangan tersebut sebesar 0,025%, hingga maksimum 50%.

passives.name: Tinker-Tink, Clank, and Bang!
passives.description: Has a 10% chance to get 1 regional Character Talent Material (base material excluded) when crafting. The rarity is the same as the resulting material.
passives.descriptionId: Memberikan 10% peluang untuk mendapatkan 1 tambahan Material Talenta acak yang sewilayah saat craft. Kelangkaannya sama dengan material yang dihasilkan.

constellations.name: With a Vow to Rescue, the Journey Begins
constellations.description: After the **Banehunter Oathhammer** that has undergone Elemental Conversion hits an opponent, Prune will regain 2 Energy. This effect can occur once every 1.8s.
constellations.descriptionId: Setelah serangan **Banehunter Oathhammer** yang telah melalui Elemental Conversion mengenai musuh, akan memulihkan 2 poin Energy untuk Prune. Efek ini dapat terpicu sekali setiap 1,8 detik.

constellations.name: Useful for Cleaning Messy Baggage, Elemental Powers Are Indeed
constellations.description:
During the Elemental Burst **The Bell Tolls! The Hunt Is On!**, when the Witchlure Bell is in Hunter-Seeker mode, Prune gains the Hunt the Witch effect: Prune's ATK increases by 10%, and when the Witchlure Bell and the **Banehunter Oathhammer** that has undergone Elemental Conversion hits an opponent, it further increases her ATK by 5%. Prune's ATK can be increased by up to 40% in this way.
The original instance of the above effect will be removed if "The Bell Tolls! The Hunt Is On!" is used again during this time.
constellations.descriptionId:
Selama Elemental Burst **The Bell Tolls! The Hunt is On!**, saat Witchlure Bell berada dalam mode Hunter-Seeker, Prune akan mendapatkan efek Hunt the Witch: ATK Prune meningkat 10%, saat Witchlure Bell dan **Banehunter Oathhammer** yang telah melalui Elemental Conversion mengenai musuh, ATK-nya akan meningkat 5% lagi. Peningkatan ATK maksimum yang bisa didapatkan melalui cara di atas adalah 40%.
Melancarkan The Bell Tolls! The Hunt is On! lagi selama efek di atas masih aktif akan menghapus efek terdahulu.

constellations.name: The Caravan Exits the Mountain Pass, the Scenery Once More Changed
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of **The Bell Tolls! The Hunt Is On!** by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.descriptionId:
Meningkatkan 3 level Elemental Burst **The Bell Tolls! The Hunt is On!**.
Maksimum: Lv. 15.

constellations.name: Looking Back Following the Wind, One's Shadow Still Halved
constellations.description: After the **Banehunter Oathhammer** that has undergone Elemental Conversion hits an opponent, it will ricochet and land on a nearby opponent, dealing 80% ATK as DMG of the corresponding Elemental Type.
constellations.descriptionId: Setelah **Banehunter Oathhammer** yang telah mengalami Elemental Conversion mengenai musuh, ia akan memantul lagi dan terjatuh di posisi musuh di sekitar, mengakibatkan Elemental DMG dengan jenis elemen yang sesuai sebesar 80% ATK terhadap musuh yang terkena.

constellations.name: 100 Defeats? No Problem, Tomorrow, We Go Again
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of **Ring-A-Ding-Ding! Hexhunter Chime** by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.descriptionId:
Meningkatkan 3 level Elemental Skill **Ring-A-Ding-Ding! Hexhunter Chime**.
Maksimum: Lv. 15.

constellations.name: And That's the Story! Share It With Your Friends!
constellations.description:
The duration of the Witchlure Bell's Hunter-Seeker mode from the Elemental Burst **The Bell Tolls! The Hunt Is On!** is extended by 4s.
Additionally, after party members affected by Tolling Rally trigger any Elemental Reaction, they will cause Prune and the other current active character(s) affected by Tolling Rally to gain 350 ATK for 5s.
constellations.descriptionId:
Durasi mode Hunter-Seeker Witchlure Bell milik Elemental Burst **The Bell Tolls! The Hunt is On!** diperpanjang 4 detik.
Selain itu, setelah Karakter dalam party yang terpengaruh oleh efek Tolling Rally memicu Reaksi Elemental apa pun pada musuh, ATK Prune dan Karakter aktif lain yang sedang berada di medan pertempuran yang memiliki efek Tolling Rally di sekitarnya meningkat 350 poin selama 5 detik.

name: Razor
title: Wolf Boy
description: A boy who lives among the wolves in Wolvendom of Mondstadt, away from human civilization. As agile as lightning.
descriptionId: Seorang anak laki-laki yang tinggal di daerah Mondstadt. Jauh dari peradaban manusia dan tinggal di kalangan antara serigala di Wolvendom. Firasatnya tajam, tubuhnya lincah bagai kilat.

talents.name: Steel Fang
talents.description:
Normal Attack
Performs up to 4 consecutive strikes.

Charged Attack
Drains Stamina over time to perform continuous spinning attacks against all nearby opponents.
At the end of the sequence, performs a more powerful slash. 

Plunging Attack
Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground below, damaging opponents along the path and dealing AoE DMG upon impact.
talents.descriptionId:
Normal Attack
Melancarkan hingga 4 tebasan berturut-turut.

Charged Attack
Terus menguras Stamina untuk melancarkan serangan berputar yang mengakibatkan DMG ke musuh di sekitar.
Diakhiri dengan sebuah tebasan yang kuat.

Plunging Attack
Menerjang dari udara untuk menghantam tanah, menyerang musuh di jalur terjangan dan mengakibatkan DMG area saat mendarat.

talents.name: Claw and Thunder
talents.description:
Hunts his prey using the techniques taught to him by his master and his lupical.

Press
Swings the Thunder Wolf Claw, dealing Electro DMG to opponents in front of Razor.
Upon striking an opponent, Razor will gain an Electro Sigil, which increases his Energy Recharge rate.
Razor can have up to 3 Electro Sigils simultaneously, and gaining a new Electro Sigil refreshes their duration.

Hold
Gathers Electro energy to unleash a lightning storm over a small AoE, causing massive Electro DMG, and clears all of Razor's Electro Sigils.
Each Electro Sigil cleared in this manner will be converted into Energy for Razor.
talents.descriptionId:
Memburu mangsanya dengan teknik yang diajarkan oleh keluarganya dan Lupical.

Tekan
Mengayunkan Thunder Wolf Claw, mengakibatkan Electro DMG ke musuh di depan Razor.
Saat mengenai musuh, Razor akan mendapatkan Electro Sigil yang meningkatkan kecepatan Energy Recharge.
Razor dapat memiliki paling banyak 3 Electro Sigil dalam waktu bersamaan, dan mendapatkan Electro Sigil baru akan memutar ulang durasi mereka.

Tahan
Mengumpulkan Electro Energy untuk mengerahkan badai petir dalam area kecil, mengakibatkan Electro DMG yang besar dan mengonsumsi seluruh Electro Sigil milik Razor.
Setiap Electro Sigil yang digunakan dengan cara ini akan dikonversi menjadi Energy untuk Razor.

talents.name: Lightning Fang
talents.description:
Summons the Wolf Within, which deals Electro DMG to all nearby opponents. This clears all of Razor's Electro Sigils, which will be converted into Elemental Energy for him.
The Wolf Within will fight alongside Razor for the skill's duration.

The Wolf Within
·Strikes alongside Razor's normal attacks, dealing Electro DMG.
·Raises Razor's ATK SPD and Electro RES.
·Causes Razor to be immune to DMG inflicted by the Electro-Charged status.
·Disables Razor's Charged Attacks.
·Increases Razor's resistance to interruption.

These effects end when Razor leaves the battlefield.
When Razor leaves the field, a maximum of 10 Energy will be returned to him based off the duration remaining on this skill.

passives.name: Awakening
passives.description:
Decreases Claw and Thunder's CD by 18%.
Using Lightning Fang resets the CD of Claw and Thunder.
passives.descriptionId:
Mengurangi 18% CD Claw and Thunder.
Melancarkan Lightning Fang akan menyelesaikan CD Claw and Thunder.

passives.name: Hunger
passives.description: When Razor's Energy is below 50%, increases Energy Recharge by 30%.
passives.descriptionId: Meningkatkan 30% Energy Recharge saat Energy Razor kurang dari 50%.

passives.name: Wolvensprint
passives.description:
Decreases sprinting Stamina consumption for your own party members by 20%.
Not stackable with Passive Talents that provide the exact same effects.
passives.descriptionId:
Mengurangi 20% konsumsi Stamina Karakter party sendiri saat berlari.
Efek ini tidak dapat ditumpuk dengan Talenta Pasif lain dengan efek yang sama persis.

constellations.name: Wolf's Instinct
constellations.description: Picking up an Elemental Orb or Particle increases Razor's DMG by 10% for 8s.
constellations.descriptionId: Saat mengambil Elemental Orb atau Particle, meningkatkan 10% DMG Razor selama 8 detik.

constellations.name: Suppression
constellations.description: Increases CRIT Rate against opponents with less than 30% HP by 10%.
constellations.descriptionId: Meningkatkan 10% CRIT Rate Razor terhadap musuh dengan HP kurang dari 30%.

constellations.name: Soul Companion
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Lightning Fang by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.descriptionId:
Meningkatkan 3 level Lightning Fang.
Maksimum: Lv. 15.

constellations.name: Bite
constellations.description: When casting Claw and Thunder (Press), opponents hit will have their DEF decreased by 15% for 7s.
constellations.descriptionId: Saat Claw and Thunder ditekan, DEF musuh yang terkena akan berkurang 15% selama 7 detik.

constellations.name: Sharpened Claws
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Claw and Thunder by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.descriptionId:
Meningkatkan 3 level Claw and Thunder.
Maksimum: Lv. 15.

constellations.name: Lupus Fulguris
constellations.description:
Every 10s, Razor's sword charges up, causing the next Normal Attack to release lightning that deals 100% of Razor's ATK as Electro DMG.
When Razor is not using Lightning Fang, a lightning strike on an opponent will grant Razor an Electro Sigil for Claw and Thunder.
constellations.descriptionId:
Setiap 10 detik, pedang Razor mengumpulkan kekuatan secara otomatis, membuat Normal Attack berikutnya melepaskan serangan listrik, mengakibatkan 100% dari ATK Razor sebagai Electro DMG.
Saat Razor tidak menggunakan Lightning Fang, sambaran petir pada musuh akan memberikan Razor sebuah Electro Sigil untuk Claw and Thunder.

name: Rosaria
title: Thorny Benevolence
description: A sister of the church, though you wouldn't know it if it weren't for her attire. Known for her sharp, cold words and manner, she often works alone.
descriptionId: Seorang suster yang selain dari pakaiannya, tidak terlihat seperti seorang suster sama sekali. Dikenal karena kata-katanya yang tajam dan dingin. Sering terlihat bekerja sendiri.

talents.name: Spear of the Church
talents.description:
Normal Attack
Performs up to 5 consecutive spear strikes.

Charged Attack
Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to lunge forward, dealing damage to opponents along the way.

Plunging Attack
Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground below, damaging opponents along the path and dealing AoE DMG upon impact.
talents.descriptionId:
Normal Attack
Melancarkan hingga 5 serangan berturut-turut menggunakan tombak.

Charged Attack
Mengonsumsi sejumlah Stamina untuk menerjang ke depan, mengakibatkan DMG pada musuh di jalurnya.

Plunging Attack
Menerjang dari udara untuk menghantam tanah, menyerang musuh di jalur terjangan dan mengakibatkan DMG area saat mendarat.

talents.name: Ravaging Confession
talents.description:
Rosaria swiftly shifts her position to appear behind her opponent, then stabs and slashes them with her polearm, dealing Cryo DMG.
This ability cannot be used to travel behind opponents of a larger build.
talents.descriptionId:
Rosaria bergerak dengan cepat, muncul di belakang musuh, lalu menusuk dan menebas dengan polearm, mengakibatkan Cryo DMG.
Talenta ini tidak dapat digunakan untuk bergerak ke belakang musuh yang bertubuh lebih besar.

talents.name: Rites of Termination
talents.description:
Rosaria's unique take on this prayer ritual: First, she swings her weapon to slash surrounding opponents; then, she summons a frigid Ice Lance that strikes the ground. Both actions deal Cryo DMG.
While active, the Ice Lance periodically releases a blast of cold air, dealing Cryo DMG to surrounding opponents.
talents.descriptionId:
Doa khas Rosaria. Setelah mengayunkan senjatanya untuk menebas musuh di sekitar, dia akan melancarkan Ice Lance yang menghantam tanah. Kedua aksi tersebut mengakibatkan Cryo DMG.
Saat Talenta ini aktif, Ice Lance akan mengeluarkan hawa dingin secara berkala, mengakibatkan Cryo DMG pada musuh di sekitar.

passives.name: Regina Probationum
passives.description: When Rosaria strikes an opponent from behind using Ravaging Confession, Rosaria's CRIT Rate increases by 12% for 5s.
passives.descriptionId: Saat Rosaria menyerang musuh dari belakang menggunakan Ravaging Confession, CRIT Rate Rosaria akan meningkat 12% selama 5 detik.

passives.name: Shadow Samaritan
passives.description:
Casting Rites of Termination increases CRIT Rate of all nearby party members (except Rosaria herself) by 15% of Rosaria's CRIT Rate for 10s.
CRIT Rate Bonus gained this way cannot exceed 15%.
passives.descriptionId:
Melancarkan Rites of Termination akan meningkatkan CRIT Rate seluruh anggota party di sekitar (tidak termasuk Rosaria sendiri) sebesar 15% dari CRIT Rate Rosaria selama 10 detik.
Bonus CRIT Rate yang didapat dari Talenta ini tidak dapat melebihi 15%.

passives.name: Night Walk
passives.description:
At night (18:00 – 06:00), your party members gain the Swift Stride effect: Movement SPD increased by 10%.
Does not take effect in Domains, Trounce Domains, or Spiral Abyss. Swift Stride does not stack.
passives.descriptionId:
Saat malam hari (18:00 - 06:00), anggota party sendiri mendapatkan efek Swift Stride: meningkatkan 10% Movement SPD.
Efek ini tidak aktif dalam Domain, Domain Trounce, atau Spiral Abyss. Efek Swift Stride tidak dapat ditumpuk.

constellations.name: Unholy Revelation
constellations.description: When Rosaria deals a CRIT Hit, her ATK SPD increases by 10% and her Normal Attack DMG increases by 10% for 4s.
constellations.descriptionId: Setelah Rosaria mengakibatkan serangan CRIT, ATK SPD dan DMG Normal Attack Rosaria meningkat 10% selama 4 detik.

constellations.name: Land Without Promise
constellations.description: The duration of the Ice Lance created by Rites of Termination is increased by 4s.
constellations.descriptionId: Durasi Ice Lance yang terbentuk dari Talenta Rites of Termination bertambah 4 detik.

constellations.name: The Wages of Sin
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Ravaging Confession by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.descriptionId:
Meningkatkan 3 level Ravaging Confession.
Maksimum: Lv. 15.

constellations.name: Painful Grace
constellations.description:
Ravaging Confession's CRIT Hits regenerate 5 Energy for Rosaria.
Can only be triggered once each time Ravaging Confession is cast.
constellations.descriptionId:
Serangan CRIT Ravaging Confession memulihkan 5 Energy Rosaria.
Hanya dapat terpicu setiap Ravaging Confession dilancarkan.

constellations.name: Last Rites
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Rites of Termination by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.descriptionId:
Meningkatkan 3 level Rites of Termination.
Maksimum: Lv. 15.

constellations.name: Divine Retribution
constellations.description: Rites of Termination's attack decreases opponents' Physical RES by 20% for 10s.
constellations.descriptionId: Serangan dari Rites of Termination dapat mengurangi 20% Physical RES musuh selama 10 detik.

name: Sayu
title: Mujina Ninja
description: A pint-sized ninja attached to the Shuumatsuban, who always seems sleep-deprived.
descriptionId: Ninja kecil anggota Shuumatsuban yang selalu terlihat kurang tidur.

talents.name: Shuumatsuban Ninja Blade
talents.description:
Normal Attack
Performs up to 4 consecutive strikes.

Charged Attack
Drains Stamina over time to perform continuous spinning attacks against all nearby opponents.
At the end of the sequence, performs a more powerful slash. 

Plunging Attack
Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground below, damaging opponents along the path and dealing AoE DMG upon impact.
talents.descriptionId:
Normal Attack
Melancarkan hingga 4 tebasan berturut-turut.

Charged Attack
Terus menguras Stamina untuk melancarkan serangan berputar yang mengakibatkan DMG ke musuh di sekitar.
Diakhiri dengan sebuah tebasan yang kuat.

Plunging Attack
Menerjang dari udara untuk menghantam tanah, menyerang musuh di jalur terjangan dan mengakibatkan DMG Area saat mendarat.

talents.name: Yoohoo Art: Fuuin Dash
talents.description:
The special technique of the Yoohoo Ninja Arts!
Sayu curls up into a rolling Fuufuu Windwheel and smashes into opponents at high speed, dealing Anemo DMG. When the duration ends, she unleashes a Fuufuu Whirlwind Kick, dealing AoE Anemo DMG.

Press
Enters the Fuufuu Windwheel state, rolling forward a short distance before using the Fuufuu Whirlwind Kick.

Hold
Rolls about continuously in the Fuufuu Windwheel state, increasing Sayu's resistance to interruption while within that state.
During this time, Sayu can control the direction of her roll, and can use the skill again to end her Windwheel state early and unleash a stronger version of the Fuufuu Whirlwind Kick.
The Hold version of this skill can trigger Elemental Absorption.

This skill has a maximum duration of 10s and enters CD once its effects end. The longer Sayu remains in her Windwheel state, the longer the CD.

Elemental Absorption
If Sayu comes into contact with Hydro/Pyro/Cryo/Electro while in her Windwheel state, she will deal additional elemental DMG of that type.
Elemental Absorption may only occur once per use of this skill.
talents.descriptionId:
Teknik spesial Ilmu Ninja Yoohoo yang menggunakan kecepatan angin untuk menyapu medan pertempuran.
Melingkar menjadi Fuufuu Windwheel dan menabrak musuh dengan kecepatan tinggi, mengakibatkan Anemo DMG, dan saat durasi skill berakhir, melancarkan Fuufuu Whirlwind Kick yang mengakibatkan Anemo DMG Area.

Tekan
Memasuki status Fuufuu Windwheel, dan berputar ke depan dengan jarak pendek, sebelum kemudian melancarkan serangan Fuufuu Whirlwind Kick.

Tahan
Memasuki status Fuufuu Windwheel dan berputar terus menerus seperti roda, yang meningkatkan ketahanan Sayu terhadap interupsi selama berputar.
Selama durasi, Sayu dapat mengontrol arah putaran dan dapat menggunakan skill ini sekali lagi untuk mengakhiri status Fuufuu Windwheel, yang mana akan melancarkan serangan Fuufuu Whirlwind Kick yang lebih kuat.
Dalam mode Tahan, skill ini dapat memicu Elemental Absorption.

Durasi skill maksimum adalah 10 detik, dan skill ini akan segera memasuki CD setelah efeknya berakhir. Semakin lama Sayu berada dalam status Fuufuu Windwheel, maka semakin lama durasi CD skill ini.

Elemental Absorption
Selama berada dalam status Fuufuu Windwheel, jika Sayu bersentuhan dengan Hydro/Pyro/Cryo/Electro, maka Sayu akan mengakibatkan DMG elemental tambahan yang sesuai dengan elemen tersebut.
Elemental Absorption hanya dapat terpicu sekali setiap kali skill digunakan.

talents.name: Yoohoo Art: Mujina Flurry
talents.description:
The other super special technique of the Yoohoo Ninja Arts! It summons a pair of helping hands for Sayu.
Deals Anemo DMG to nearby opponents and heals all nearby party members. The amount of HP restored is based on Sayu's ATK. This skill then summons a Muji-Muji Daruma.

Muji-Muji Daruma
At specific intervals, the Daruma will take one of several actions based on the situation around it:
·If the HP of nearby characters is above 70%, it will attack a nearby opponent, dealing Anemo DMG.
·If there are active characters with 70% or less HP nearby, it will heal the active character with the lowest percentage HP left. If there are no opponents nearby, it will heal active characters nearby even if they have 70% HP or more.
talents.descriptionId:
Teknik spesial lain dari Ilmu Ninja Yoohoo! Teknik ini dapat memanggil bala bantuan untuk Sayu.
Mengakibatkan Anemo DMG terhadap musuh di sekitar dan memulihkan HP seluruh anggota party di sekitar. Jumlah HP yang dipulihkan berdasar pada ATK Sayu. Skill ini kemudian akan memanggil sebuah Muji-Muji Daruma.

Muji-Muji Daruma
Muji-Muji Daruma akan melakukan salah satu tindakan berikut secara berkala berdasarkan situasi di sekitar:
·Jika semua Karakter di sekitar medan pertempuran memiliki HP lebih dari 70%, Daruma ini akan menyerang musuh di sekitar dan mengakibatkan Anemo DMG.
·Jika di sekitar medan pertempuran ada Karakter dengan HP lebih rendah atau sama dengan 70%, Daruma ini akan memulihkan Karakter yang persentase HP-nya paling rendah, jumlah pemulihan berdasar pada ATK Sayu. Jika tidak ada musuh di sekitar dan HP Karakter lebih tinggi dari 70%, maka Daruma tetap akan memulihkan HP Karakter.

passives.name: Someone More Capable
passives.description:
When Sayu triggers a Swirl or Stellar Swirl reaction while active, she heals all your characters and nearby allies for 300 HP. She will also heal an additional 1.2 HP for every point of Elemental Mastery she has.
This effect can be triggered once every 2s.
passives.descriptionId:
Saat Sayu berada di medan pertempuran dan memicu reaksi Swirl atau Stellar Swirl, Sayu akan memulihkan 300 HP untuk anggota party dan kawan yang ada di sekitar. Sayu juga akan memulihkan 1,2 HP tambahan untuk setiap poin Elemental Mastery yang dimiliki Sayu.
Efek ini hanya dapat terpicu setiap 2 detik.

passives.name: No Work Today!
passives.description:
The Muji-Muji Daruma created by Yoohoo Art: Mujina Flurry gains the following effects:
·When healing a character, it will also heal characters near that healed character for 20% the amount of HP.
·Increases the AoE of its attack against opponents.

passives.name: Yoohoo Art: Silencer's Secret
passives.description:
When Sayu is in the party, your characters will not startle Crystalflies and certain other animals when getting near them.
Check the "Other" sub-category of the "Living Beings / Wildlife" section in the Archive for creatures this skill works on.
passives.descriptionId:
Saat Sayu berada di dalam party, Crystalfly dan beberapa binatang tertentu yang didekati Karakter dalam party tidak akan kaget dan kabur.
Silakan menuju bagian Arsip > Makhluk Hidup/Hewan Liar > Lainnya untuk mengecek objek-objek yang dapat dipengaruhi skill ini.

constellations.name: Multi-Task no Jutsu
constellations.description: The Muji-Muji Daruma created by Yoohoo Art: Mujina Flurry will ignore HP limits and can simultaneously attack nearby opponents and heal characters.
constellations.descriptionId: Muji-Muji Daruma yang diciptakan oleh Yoohoo Art: Mujina Flurry akan mengabaikan batas HP dan bisa menyerang musuh terdekat serta memulihkan HP Karakter secara bersamaan.

constellations.name: Egress Prep
constellations.description:
Yoohoo Art: Fuuin Dash gains the following effects:
·DMG of Fuufuu Whirlwind Kick in Press Mode increased by 3.3%.
·Every 0.5s in the Fuufuu Windwheel state will increase the DMG of this Fuufuu Whirlwind Kick by 3.3%. The maximum DMG increase possible through this method is 66%.
constellations.descriptionId:
Yoohoo Art: Fuuin Dash mendapatkan efek berikut:
·DMG dari Mode Tekan Fuufuu Whirlwind Kick meningkat 3,3%.
·Saat Mode Tahan dikerahkan, dan berada dalam status FuuFuu Windwheel, DMG dari Fuufuu Whirlwind Kick kali tersebut meningkat 3,3% setiap 0,5 detik. DMG tambahan maksimum yang bisa didapat dari metode ini adalah 66%.

constellations.name: Eh, the Bunshin Can Handle It
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Yoohoo Art: Mujina Flurry by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.descriptionId:
Meningkatkan 3 level Yoohoo Art: Mujina Flurry.
Maksimum: Lv. 15.

constellations.name: Skiving: New and Improved
constellations.description:
Sayu recovers 1.2 Energy when she triggers a Swirl or Stellar Swirl reaction while on-field.
This effect occurs once every 2s.
constellations.descriptionId:
Sayu akan memulihkan 1,2 Energy-nya setiap kali ia memicu reaksi Swirl atau Stellar Swirl di medan pertempuran.
Dapat terpicu setiap 2 detik.

constellations.name: Speed Comes First
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Yoohoo Art: Fuuin Dash by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.descriptionId:
Meningkatkan 3 level Yoohoo Art: Fuuin Dash.
Maksimum: Lv. 15.

constellations.name: Sleep O'Clock
constellations.description:
The Muji-Muji Daruma created by Sayu's Yoohoo Art: Mujina Flurry will now also benefit from her Elemental Mastery. Each point of Sayu's Elemental Mastery will produce the following effects:
·Increases the damage dealt by the Muji-Muji Daruma's attacks by 0.2% ATK. A maximum DMG increase of 400% ATK can be gained via this method.
·Increases the HP restored by the Muji-Muji Daruma by 3. A maximum of 6,000 additional HP can be restored in this manner.
constellations.descriptionId:
ATK dan Pemulihan HP dari Muji-Muji Daruma yang diciptakan dengan Yoohoo Art: Mujina Flurry milik Sayu juga akan bertambah sesuai Elemental Mastery Sayu. Setiap poin Elemental Mastery yang dimiliki Sayu akan memberikan efek berikut:
·Muji-Muji Daruma mengakibatkan DMG tambahan sebesar 0,2% ATK. DMG tambahan maksimum yang dapat diperoleh dari metode ini adalah 400% ATK.
·Meningkatkan jumlah HP yang dipulihkan oleh Muji-Muji Daruma sebanyak 3 HP. Efek pemulihan tambahan yang dapat diperoleh dari metode ini adalah 6.000 HP.

name: Sethos
title: Wisdom's Measure
description: The Temple of Silence's heir. Burdened with secrets, he comes from the sands.
descriptionId: Penerus Temple of Silence yang menjaga rahasia dan berasal dari padang pasir.

talents.name: Royal Reed Archery
talents.description:
Normal Attack
Performs up to 3 consecutive shots with a bow.

Charged Attack
Performs a more precise Aimed Shot with increased DMG.
While aiming, the power of Electro will accumulate on the arrowhead before the arrow is fired. Has different effects based on how long the energy has been charged:
·Charge Level 1: Fires off an arrow carrying the power of lightning that deals Electro DMG.
·Charge Level 2: Fires off a Shadowpiercing Shot which can pierce enemies, dealing Electro DMG to enemies along its path. After the Shadowpiercing Shot is fully charged, Sethos cannot move around.

Plunging Attack
Fires off a shower of arrows in mid-air before falling and striking the ground, dealing AoE DMG upon impact.
talents.descriptionId:
Normal Attack
Melancarkan hingga 3 serangan berturut-turut dengan busur.

Charged Attack
Melancarkan sebuah Serangan Membidik yang lebih akurat untuk mengakibatkan DMG lebih besar.
Saat membidik, kekuatan Electro akan berkumpul di ujung anak panah. Memiliki efek yang berbeda tergantung dari lama serangannya ditahan:
·Charge Tahap 1: Menembakkan panah berisi elemen Electro dan mengakibatkan Electro DMG;
·Charge Tahap 2: Menembakkan sebuah Shadowpiercing Shot yang bisa menembus musuh dan mengakibatkan Electro DMG terhadap musuh yang dilalui sepanjang jalurnya. Setelah selesai melakukan Charge terhadap Shadowpiercing Shot, Sethos tidak akan bisa bergerak.

Plunging Attack
Melancarkan hujan panah dari udara dan menerjang tanah dengan kecepatan tinggi, mengakibatkan DMG area saat mendarat.

talents.name: Ancient Rite: The Thundering Sands
talents.description: Gathers the might of thunder, dealing AoE Electro DMG and quickly retreating. If this attack triggers Electro-Charged, Lunar-Charged, Superconduct, Stellar-Conduct, Overloaded, Quicken, Aggravate, Hyperbloom, or Electro Swirl reactions, Sethos recovers a certain amount of Elemental Energy.
talents.descriptionId: Mengumpulkan kekuatan petir dan mengakibatkan Electro DMG Area, lalu bergerak mundur dengan cepat. Jika serangan kali ini memicu reaksi Electro-Charged, Lunar-Charged, Superconduct, Stellar-Conduct, Overloaded, Quicken, Aggravate, Hyperbloom, atau Electro Swirl terhadap musuh, maka Sethos akan memulihkan sejumlah Energy.

talents.name: Secret Rite: Twilight Shadowpiercer
talents.description:
Perform a secret rite, entering the "Twilight Meditation" state, during which Sethos's Normal Attacks will be converted into enemy-piercing Dusk Bolts: Deal Electro DMG to opponents in its path, with DMG increased based on Sethos's Elemental Mastery.
Sethos cannot perform Aimed Shots while in this state.
DMG dealt by Dusk Bolts is considered Charged Attack DMG.
This effect will be canceled when Sethos leaves the field.
talents.descriptionId:
Melancarkan ritual rahasia dan memasuki status "Twilight Meditation". Selama masa ini, Normal Attack Sethos akan dikonversi menjadi Dusk Bolt yang bisa menembus musuh saat ditembakkan: Mengakibatkan Electro DMG terhadap musuh yang dilalui sepanjang jalurnya, dan meningkatkan DMG yang disebabkan berdasarkan Elemental Mastery Sethos.
Selama durasi skill ini, Sethos tidak akan melakukan Tembakan Membidik.
DMG yang diakibatkan Dusk Bolt akan dianggap sebagai DMG Charged Attack.
Efek akan dihapus saat Sethos meninggalkan medan pertempuran.

passives.name: Black Kite's Enigma
passives.description: When Aiming, the charging time is decreased by 0.285s based on each point of Sethos's current Elemental Energy. Charging time can be reduced to a minimum of 0.3s through this method and a maximum of 20 Energy can be tallied. If a Shadowpiercing Shot is fired, consume the tallied amount of Elemental Energy; if it is a Charge Level 1 shot, then consume 50% of the tallied amount of Elemental Energy.
passives.descriptionId: Saat dalam Mode Membidik, untuk setiap 1 poin Energy Sethos saat ini, waktu Charge akan berkurang 0,285 detik. Dengan cara ini, waktu Charge bisa dikurangi hingga mencapai 0,3 detik, dan maksimum 20 Energy yang bisa dihitung dengan cara ini; Saat menembak, jika yang ditembakkan adalah Shadowpiercing Shot, akan mengonsumsi Energy yang terhitung; Jika yang ditembakkan adalah tembakan Charge Level 1, akan mengonsumsi 50% Energy yang terhitung.

passives.name: The Sand King's Boon
passives.description:
Sethos gains the "Scorching Sandshade" effect, increasing the DMG dealt by Shadowpiercing Shots by 700% of Sethos's Elemental Mastery.
The Scorching Sandshade effect will be canceled when any of the following conditions are met:
· 5s after a Shadowpiercing Shot first hits an opponent.
· After 4 Shadowpiercing Shots strike opponents.

When a Shadowpiercing Shot affected by Scorching Sandshade first hits an opponent, Sethos will regain Scorching Sandshade after 15s.
passives.descriptionId:
Sethos mendapatkan efek "Scorching Sandshade", membuat nilai DMG Shadowpiercing Shot yang ditembakkan meningkat sebesar 700% Elemental Mastery Sethos.
Efek Scorching Sandshade akan dihapus setelah memenuhi salah satu kondisi berikut:
·Lima detik setelah Shadowpiercing Shot mengenai musuh untuk pertama kalinya;
·Setelah ada 4 Shadowpiercing Shot yang mengenai musuh.

Saat tembakan Shadowpiercing Shot dengan efek Scorching Sandshade pertama kali mengenai musuh, efek Scorching Sandshade bisa kembali diperoleh setelah 15 detik kemudian.

passives.name: Thoth's Revelation
passives.description: Displays the location of nearby resources unique to Sumeru on the mini-map.
passives.descriptionId: Memperlihatkan lokasi produk khas Sumeru di sekitar pada peta kecil.

constellations.name: Sealed Shrine's Spiritsong
constellations.description: The CRIT Rate of Shadowpiercing Shot is increased by 15%.
constellations.descriptionId: CRIT Rate Shadowpiercing Shot meningkat 15%.

constellations.name: Papyrus Scripture of Silent Secrets
constellations.description:
When any of the following conditions are met, Sethos gains a 15% Electro DMG Bonus for 10s that may stack twice, with each stack duration counted independently:
· Consuming Elemental Energy through Aimed Shots. You must first unlock the Ascension Talent "Black Kite's Enigma" to trigger this condition.
· Regaining Elemental Energy by triggering Elemental Reactions using Ancient Rite: The Thundering Sands.
· Using Secret Rite: Twilight Shadowpiercer.

constellations.name: Ode to the Moonrise Sage
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Normal Attack: Royal Reed Archery by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.descriptionId:
Meningkatkan 3 level Normal Attack: Royal Reed Archery.
Maksimum: Lv. 15.

constellations.name: Beneficent Plumage
constellations.description: When a Shadowpiercing Shot or Dusk Bolt strikes 2 or more opponents, all nearby party members gain 80 Elemental Mastery for 10s.
constellations.descriptionId: Saat Shadowpiercing Shot atau Dusk Bolt mengenai 2 musuh atau lebih, meningkatkan 80 poin Elemental Mastery seluruh anggota party di sekitar selama 10 detik.

constellations.name: Record of the Desolate God's Burning Sands
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Secret Rite: Twilight Shadowpiercer by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.descriptionId:
Meningkatkan 3 level Secret Rite: Twilight Shadowpiercer.
Maksimum: Lv. 15.

constellations.name: Pylon of the Sojourning Sun Temple
constellations.description: After Shadowpiercing Shot strikes an opponent, the Elemental Energy consumed by the Ascension Talent "Black Kite's Enigma" will be returned. This effect can be triggered up to once every 15s. You must first unlock the Ascension Talent "Black Kite's Enigma."
constellations.descriptionId: Setelah Shadowpiercing Shot mengenai musuh, Energy yang dikonsumsi oleh Talenta Ascension "Black Kite's Enigma" akan dikembalikan. Efek ini dapat terpicu setiap 15 detik. Harus membuka Talenta Ascension "Black Kite's Enigma" terlebih dahulu.

name: Shikanoin Heizou
title: Analytical Harmony
description: A young prodigy detective from the Tenryou Commission. His senses are sharp and his thoughts are clear.
descriptionId: Seorang detektif jenius dari Tenryou Commission. Mempunyai intuisi yang kuat dan pemikiran yang tajam.

talents.name: Fudou Style Martial Arts
talents.description:
Normal Attack
Performs up to 5 fisticuffs empowered by a mighty wind, dealing Anemo DMG.

Charged Attack
Consumes a certain amount of Stamina and performs a sweeping kick that deals Anemo DMG.

Plunging Attack
Calling upon the surging wind, Heizou plunges towards the ground from mid-air, damaging all opponents in his path. Deals AoE Anemo DMG upon impact with the ground.
talents.descriptionId:
Normal Attack
Melancarkan hingga 5 serangan tinju yang diperkuat oleh angin, mengakibatkan Anemo DMG.

Charged Attack
Mengonsumsi sejumlah Stamina untuk mengakibatkan tendangan yang mengakibatkan Anemo DMG.

Plunging Attack
Mengumpulkan kekuatan Anemo, Heizou menerjang tanah, menyerang musuh di jalur terjangan dan mengakibatkan Anemo DMG Area saat mendarat.

talents.name: Heartstopper Strike
talents.description:
Tap
Wields the swift winds to launch a Heartstopper Strike that deals Anemo DMG.

Hold
Charges energy to unleash an even stronger blow. He will obtain the Declension effect while charging, which will increase the power of the Heartstopper Strike. When the skill button is released or the skill finishes charging, he will strike forward, dealing Anemo DMG.

Declension
Increases the power of the next Heartstopper Strike. Max 4 stacks.
When you possess 4 Declension stacks, the Conviction effect will be produced, which will cause the next Heartstopper Strike to be even stronger and have a larger AoE.
talents.descriptionId:
Tekan
Menggunakan angin kencang untuk meluncurkan Heartstopper Strike yang mengakibatkan Anemo DMG.

Tahan
Mengisi energi untuk melepaskan pukulan yang lebih kuat. Heizou akan mendapatkan efek Declension saat sedang mengisi energi, efek tersebut akan meningkatkan kekuatan Heartstopper Strike. Saat tombol skill dilepaskan atau saat skill sudah selesai mengisi energi, Heizou akan maju menerjang ke depan dan mengakibatkan Anemo DMG.

Declension
Meningkatkan kekuatan Heartstopper Strike berikutnya. Maks. 4 lapis.
Saat mempunyai 4 lapis Declension, akan tercipta lapisan Conviction yang akan mengakibatkan Heartstopper Strike berikutnya menjadi lebih kuat lagi dan mempunyai Area efek yang lebih besar.

talents.name: Windmuster Kick
talents.description:
Leaps into the air and uses the Fudou Style Vacuum Slugger and kicks his opponent. The Vacuum Slugger will explode upon hit and create an Arresting Windtunnel that pulls in nearby objects and opponents, dealing AoE Anemo DMG.
When Vacuum Slugger hits opponents affected by Hydro/Pyro/Cryo/Electro, these opponents will be afflicted with Windmuster Iris. This Windmuster Iris will explode after a moment and dissipate, dealing AoE DMG of the corresponding aforementioned elemental type.
Vacuum Slugger can afflict a maximum of 4 opponents with the Windmuster Iris. A single opponent cannot be under the effect of Windmuster Irises of different elements at the same time.
talents.descriptionId:
Melompat ke udara dan menendang Fudou Style Vacuum Slugger ke arah lawan. Saat mengenai musuh, Fudou Style Vacuum Slugger akan menciptakan area berangin yang menarik objek dan musuh di sekitar, lalu mengakibatkan Anemo DMG Area.
Saat Vacuum Slugger mengenai musuh yang terkena efek Hydro/Pyro/Cryo/Electro, maka musuh tersebut akan terkena Windmuster Iris yang akan meledak setelah beberapa saat dan mengakibatkan DMG Area dari tipe elemen yang disebutkan sebelumnya.
Vacuum Slugger dapat memukul maks. 4 musuh dengan menggunakan Windmuster Iris. Musuh tidak bisa terpengaruh efek Windmuster Iris dari elemen berbeda dalam waktu yang bersamaan.

passives.name: Paradoxical Practice
passives.description: When Shikanoin Heizou activates a Swirl or Stellar Swirl reaction while on the field, he will gain 1 Declension stack for Heartstopper Strike. This effect can be triggered once every 0.1s.
passives.descriptionId: Saat Shikanoin Heizou mengaktifkan reaksi Swirl dan Stellar Swirl di medan pertempuran, dia akan mendapatkan 1 lapis Declension untuk Heartstopper Strike. Efek ini dapat terpicu sekali setiap 0,1 detik.

passives.name: Penetrative Reasoning
passives.description: After Shikanoin Heizou's Heartstopper Strike hits an opponent, increases all party members' (excluding Shikanoin Heizou) Elemental Mastery by 80 for 10s.
passives.descriptionId: Setelah Heartstopper Strike milik Shikanoin Heizou mengenai musuh, maka akan meningkatkan Elemental Mastery seluruh anggota party (tidak termasuk Shikanoin Heizou) sebesar 80 selama 10 detik.

passives.name: Pre-Existing Guilt
passives.description:
Decreases sprinting Stamina consumption for your own party members by 20%.
Not stackable with Passive Talents that provide the exact same effects.
passives.descriptionId:
Mengurangi 20% konsumsi Stamina Karakter party sendiri saat berlari.
Efek ini tidak dapat ditumpuk dengan Talenta Pasif lain dengan efek yang sama persis.

constellations.name: Named Juvenile Casebook
constellations.description: For 5s after Shikanoin Heizou takes the field, his Normal Attack SPD is increased by 15%. He also gains 1 Declension stack for Heartstopper Strike. This effect can be triggered once every 10s.
constellations.descriptionId: Selama 5 detik setelah Shikanoin Heizou memasuki medan tempur, Normal Attack SPD-nya akan meningkat 15%. Lalu akan mendapatkan 1 lapis efek Declension dari Heartstopper Strike. Efek dapat terpicu setiap 10 detik.

constellations.name: Investigative Collection
constellations.description: The pull effect of the Arresting Windtunnel created by Windmuster Kick is enhanced, and its duration is increased to 1s.
constellations.descriptionId: Efek tarikan dari Arresting Windtunnel yang diciptakan oleh Windmuster Kick menjadi semakin kuat dan durasinya bertambah menjadi 1 detik.

constellations.name: Esoteric Puzzle Book
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Heartstopper Strike by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.descriptionId:
Meningkatkan 3 level Heartstopper Strike.
Maksimum: Lv. 15.

constellations.name: Tome of Lies
constellations.description:
The first Windmuster Iris explosion in each Windmuster Kick will regenerate 9 Elemental Energy for Shikanoin Heizou. Every subsequent explosion in that Windmuster Kick will each regenerate an additional 1.5 Energy for Heizou.
One Windmuster Kick can regenerate a total of 13.5 Energy for Heizou in this manner.
constellations.descriptionId:
Ledakan Windmuster Iris pertama di setiap Windmuster Kick akan memulihkan 9 Elemental Energy Shikanoin Heizou. Setiap ledakan berikutnya dalam Windmuster Kick tersebut masing-masing akan memulihkan 1,5 Energy tambahan untuk Heizou.
Satu kali Windmuster Kick hanya dapat memulihkan maksimum hingga 13,5 Energy Heizou dengan cara ini.

constellations.name: Secret Archive
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Windmuster Kick by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.descriptionId:
Meningkatkan 3 level Windmuster Kick.
Maksimum: Lv. 15.

constellations.name: Curious Casefiles
constellations.description: Each Declension stack will increase the CRIT Rate of the Heartstopper Strike unleashed by 4%. When Heizou possesses Conviction, this Heartstopper Strike's CRIT DMG is increased by 32%.
constellations.descriptionId: Setiap lapis Declension akan meningkatkan CRIT Rate Heartstopper Strike yang dilancarkan sebesar 4%. Saat Heizou memiliki Conviction, maka akan meningkatkan 32% CRIT DMG dari Heartstoppper Strike.

name: Sucrose
title: Harmless Sweetie
description: An alchemist filled with curiosity about all things. She researches bio-alchemy.
descriptionId: Seorang alkemis dipenuhi dengan rasa ingin tahu tentang semua hal. Dia meneliti bio-alkimia.

talents.name: Wind Spirit Creation
talents.description:
Normal Attack
Performs up to 4 attacks using Wind Spirits, dealing Anemo DMG.

Charged Attack
Consumes a certain amount of Stamina and deals AoE Anemo DMG after a short casting time.

Plunging Attack
Calling upon the power of her Wind Spirits, Sucrose plunges towards the ground from mid-air, damaging all opponents in her path. Deals AoE Anemo DMG upon impact with the ground.
talents.descriptionId:
Normal Attack
Melancarkan hingga 4 serangan angin yang mengakibatkan Anemo DMG.

Charged Attack
Mengonsumsi sejumlah Stamina untuk mengakibatkan Anemo DMG area setelah jeda singkat.

Plunging Attack
Mengumpulkan kekuatan Anemo dan menerjang tanah, menyerang musuh di jalur terjangan dan mengakibatkan Anemo DMG area saat mendarat.

talents.name: Astable Anemohypostasis Creation - 6308
talents.description: Creates a small Wind Spirit that pulls opponents and objects towards its location, launches opponents within its AoE, and deals Anemo DMG.
talents.descriptionId: Menciptakan Wind Spirit kecil yang menarik musuh dan obyek ke lokasi Wind Spirit sebelum menghempas musuh di area tersebut; juga mengakibatkan Anemo DMG.

talents.name: Forbidden Creation - Isomer 75 / Type II
talents.description:
Sucrose hurls an unstable concoction that creates a Large Wind Spirit.
While it persists, the Large Wind Spirit will continuously pull in surrounding opponents and objects, launch nearby opponents, and deal Anemo DMG.

Elemental Absorption
If the Wind Spirit comes into contact with Hydro/Pyro/Cryo/Electro energy, it will deal additional elemental DMG of that type.
Elemental Absorption may only occur once per use.
talents.descriptionId:
Sucrose melemparkan sebuah ramuan yang menciptakan Wind Spirit besar.
Selama ramuan itu ada, Wind Spirit besar akan terus-menerus menarik musuh dan obyek yang ada di sekitar, menghasilkan Anemo DMG.

Elemental Absorption
Ketika Wind Spirit bersentuhan dengan elemen Hydro/Pyro/Cryo/Electro, maka akan mengakibatkan elemental DMG tambahan dari tipe tersebut.
Elemental Absorption hanya dapat muncul satu kali dalam sekali penggunaan.

passives.name: Catalyst Conversion
passives.description: When Sucrose triggers a Swirl or Stellar Swirl reaction, all characters in the party with the matching element (excluding Sucrose) have their Elemental Mastery increased by 50 for 8s.
passives.descriptionId: Ketika Sucrose memicu Swirl atau Stellar Swirl, akan meningkatkan Elemental Mastery anggota party dengan tipe elemen yang sama (tidak termasuk Sucrose sendiri) sebesar 50, berlangsung selama 8 detik.

passives.name: Mollis Favonius
passives.description: When Astable Anemohypostasis Creation - 6308 or Forbidden Creation - Isomer 75 / Type II hits an opponent, increases all party members' (excluding Sucrose) Elemental Mastery by an amount equal to 20% of Sucrose's Elemental Mastery for 8s.
passives.descriptionId: Ketika skill Astable Anemohypostasis Creation - 6308 atau Forbidden Creation - Isomer 75 / Type II mengenai musuh, akan meningkatkan Elemental Mastery seluruh anggota party (tidak termasuk Sucrose sendiri) sebanyak 20% dari Elemental Mastery Sucrose selama 8 detik.

passives.name: Astable Invention
passives.description: When Sucrose crafts Character and Weapon Enhancement Materials, she has a 10% chance to obtain double the product.
passives.descriptionId: Saat Sucrose membuat Material Penguatan Senjata dan Karakter, memiliki 10% kemungkinan untuk mendapatkan hasil 2 kali lipat.

constellations.name: Clustered Vacuum Field

talents.name: Blazing Blessing
talents.description:
Thoma vaults forward with his polearm and delivers a flame-filled flying kick that deals AoE Pyro DMG, while also summoning a defensive Blazing Barrier. At the moment of casting, Thoma's Elemental Skill applies Pyro to himself.
The DMG Absorption of the Blazing Barrier scales off Thoma's Max HP.
The Blazing Barrier has the following traits:
·Absorbs Pyro DMG 250% more effectively.
·When a new Blazing Barrier is obtained, the remaining DMG Absorption of an existing Blazing Barrier will stack and its duration will be refreshed.

The maximum DMG Absorption of the Blazing Barrier will not exceed a certain percentage of Thoma's Max HP.
talents.descriptionId:
Thoma menggunakan ujung tombaknya sebagai poros untuk menyalurkan apinya dan melakukan tendangan yang mengakibatkan Pyro DMG Area, kemudian menciptakan sebuah Blazing Barrier. Saat melancarkan Elemental Skill, Thoma akan terkena efek elemen Pyro selama sekejap.
DMG yang dapat ditahan oleh Barrier didasarkan pada Max HP Thoma.
Blazing Barrier mempunyai efek sebagai berikut:
·Menahan Pyro DMG 250% lebih efektif.
·Saat menciptakan Blazing Barrier baru, sisa DMG yang dapat ditahan oleh Blazing Barrier akan ditumpuk dan durasinya diperbarui.

DMG maksimum yang dapat ditahan oleh Barrier tidak akan melebihi persentase tertentu dari Max HP Thoma.

talents.name: Crimson Ooyoroi
talents.description:
Thoma spins his polearm, slicing at his foes with roaring flames that deal AoE Pyro DMG and weave themselves into a Scorching Ooyoroi.

Scorching Ooyoroi
While Scorching Ooyoroi is in effect, the active character's Normal Attacks will trigger Fiery Collapse, dealing AoE Pyro DMG and summoning a Blazing Barrier.
Fiery Collapse can be triggered once every 1s.

Except for the amount of DMG they can absorb, the Blazing Barriers created in this way are identical to those created by Thoma's Elemental Skill, Blazing Blessing:
·Absorbs Pyro DMG 250% more effectively.
·When a new Blazing Barrier is obtained, the remaining DMG Absorption of an existing Blazing Barrier will stack and its duration will be refreshed.

The maximum DMG Absorption of the Blazing Barrier will not exceed a certain percentage of Thoma's Max HP.

If Thoma falls, the effects of Scorching Ooyoroi will be cleared.
talents.descriptionId:
Thoma memutar tombaknya untuk menebas musuh-musuh di sekitar dengan api membara yang mengakibatkan Pyro DMG Area, kemudian menciptakan efek Scorching Ooyoroi.

Scorching Ooyoroi
Normal Attack dari Karakter aktif yang memiliki efek Scorching Ooyoroi akan memicu Fiery Collapse yang mengakibatkan Pyro DMG Area dan menciptakan Blazing Barrier.
Fiery Collapse dapat terpicu setiap 1 detik.

Blazing Barrier yang diciptakan dengan cara ini mempunyai karakteristik yang sama dengan yang terbuat dari Elemental Skill Thoma "Blazing Blessing", kecuali pada jumlah DMG yang dapat ditahan:
·Menahan Pyro DMG 250% lebih efektif.
·Saat menciptakan Blazing Barrier baru, sisa DMG yang dapat ditahan oleh Blazing Barrier akan ditumpuk dan durasinya diperbarui.

DMG maksimum yang dapat ditahan oleh Barrier tidak akan melebihi persentase tertentu dari Max HP Thoma.

Jika Thoma gugur, efek Scorching Ooyoroi akan hilang.

talents.name: Guhua Sword: Fatal Rainscreen
talents.description:
Xingqiu performs twin strikes with his sword, dealing Hydro DMG. At the same time, this ability creates the maximum number of Rain Swords, which will orbit your active character.
The Rain Swords have the following properties:
·When a character takes DMG, the Rain Sword will shatter, reducing the amount of DMG taken.
·Increases the character's resistance to interruption.

20% of Xingqiu's Hydro DMG Bonus will be converted to additional DMG Reduction for the Rain Swords.

The maximum amount of additional DMG Reduction that can be gained this way is 24%.
The initial maximum number of Rain Swords is 3.
Using this ability applies the Wet status onto the character.
talents.descriptionId:
Xingqiu mengayunkan pedangnya dua kali, mengakibatkan Hydro DMG terhadap musuh di hadapannya. Pada saat bersamaan, skill ini akan menciptakan Rain Sword dalam jumlah maksimum yang akan mengitari Karakter.
Rain Sword memiliki karakteristik berikut:
·Saat Karakter menerima DMG, Rain Sword akan hancur dan mengurangi DMG yang diterima;
·Meningkatkan ketahanan Karakter terhadap interupsi.
Sebanyak 20% dari Hydro DMG Bonus milik Xingqiu akan dikonversi menjadi DMG Reduction tambahan untuk Rain Sword.

Jumlah maksimum DMG Reduction tambahan yang bisa didapatkan dengan cara ini adalah 24%.
Jumlah maksimum Rain Sword di awal adalah 3.
Menggunakan skill ini akan mengenakan efek Wet pada Karakter.

·Jumlah Rain Sword akan terus berada dalam jumlah maksimum selama durasi skill.

talents.name: Sweeping Fervor
talents.description:
Xinyan brandishes her instrument, dealing Pyro DMG on nearby opponents, forming a shield made out of her audience's passion.
The shield's DMG Absorption scales based on Xinyan's DEF and on the number of opponents hit.
·Hitting 0–1 opponents grants Shield Level 1: Ad Lib.
·Hitting 2 opponents grants Shield Level 2: Lead-In.
·Hitting 3 or more opponents grants Shield Level 3: Rave, which will also deal intermittent Pyro DMG to nearby opponents.

The shield has the following special properties:
·When unleashed, it infuses Xinyan with Pyro.
·It has 250% DMG Absorption effectiveness against Pyro DMG.
talents.descriptionId:
Xinyan mengayunkan alat musiknya, mengakibatkan Pyro DMG terhadap semua musuh di dekatnya, dan membentuk sebuah Perisai yang terbuat dari hasrat para pendengarnya.
Jumlah DMG yang bisa ditahan Perisai didasarkan pada DEF Xinyan dan jumlah musuh yang terkena skill ini.
· Mengenai 0-1 musuh memberikan Perisai Level 1: Ad Lib.
· Mengenai 2 musuh memberikan Perisai Level 2: Lead-In.
· Mengenai 3 musuh memberikan Perisai Level 3: Rave, yang juga akan mengakibatkan Pyro DMG secara berkala terhadap semua musuh di dekatnya.

Perisai Xinyan memiliki sifat khusus berikut:
· Ketika dilancarkan, Perisai akan memberikan efek Pyro untuk Xinyan.
· Perisai dapat menahan Pyro DMG 250% lebih efektif.
