name: Yanfei
title: Wise Innocence
description: A well-known legal adviser active in Liyue Harbor. A brilliant young lady in whose veins runs the blood of an illuminated beast.
descriptionId: Seorang konsultan hukum yang terkenal di Liyue, di tubuh gadis muda ini juga mengalir darah Adeptus.

talents.name: Seal of Approval
talents.description:
Normal Attack
Shoots fireballs that deal up to three counts of Pyro DMG.
When Yanfei's Normal Attacks hit enemies, they will grant her a single Scarlet Seal. Yanfei may possess a maximum of 3 Scarlet Seals, and each time this effect is triggered, the duration of currently possessed Scarlet Seals will refresh.
Each Scarlet Seal will decrease Yanfei's Stamina consumption and will disappear when she leaves the field.

Charged Attack
Consumes Stamina and all Scarlet Seals before dealing AoE Pyro DMG to opponents after a short casting time.
This Charged Attack's AoE and DMG will increase according to the amount of Scarlet Seals consumed.

Plunging Attack
Gathering the power of Pyro, Yanfei plunges towards the ground from mid-air, damaging all opponents in her path. Deals AoE Pyro DMG upon impact with the ground.
talents.descriptionId:
Normal Attack
Melancarkan hingga 3 serangan bola api yang mengakibatkan Pyro DMG.
Ketika Normal Attack Yanfei mengenai musuh, Yanfei akan mendapatkan 1 Scarlet Seal. Scarlet Seal maksimum yang bisa dikumpulkan Yanfei adalah 3 buah. Setiap kali efek ini terpicu, durasi dari Scarlet Seal yang telah terkumpul akan diperbarui.
Setiap Scarlet Seal akan mengurangi konsumsi Stamina Yanfei dan akan menghilang jika Yanfei meninggalkan medan pertempuran.

Charged Attack
Mengonsumsi Stamina dan semua Scarlet Seal untuk mengakibatkan Pyro DMG Area setelah jeda singkat.
Area dan DMG dari Charged Attack ini akan meluas dan meningkat sesuai dengan jumlah Scarlet Seal yang dikonsumsi.

Plunging Attack
Mengumpulkan kekuatan Pyro dan menerjang tanah, menyerang musuh di jalur terjangan dan mengakibatkan Pyro DMG Area saat mendarat.

talents.name: Signed Edict
talents.description:
Summons blistering flames that deal AoE Pyro DMG.
Opponents hit by the flames will grant Yanfei the maximum number of Scarlet Seals.
talents.descriptionId:
Memanggil api yang mengakibatkan Pyro DMG Area.
Yanfei akan mendapatkan Scarlet Seal dalam jumlah maksimum saat Signed Edict mengenai musuh.

talents.name: Done Deal
talents.description:
Triggers a spray of intense flames that rush at nearby opponents, dealing AoE Pyro DMG, granting Yanfei the maximum number of Scarlet Seals, and applying Brilliance to her.

Brilliance
Has the following effects:
·Grants Yanfei a Scarlet Seal at fixed intervals.
·Increases the DMG dealt by her Charged Attacks.
The effects of Brilliance will end if Yanfei leaves the field or falls in battle.
talents.descriptionId:
Memicu semburan api dahsyat yang menyerbu musuh di sekitar dan mengakibatkan Pyro DMG Area, serta memberikan Scarlet Seal dalam jumlah maksimum dan efek Brilliance pada Yanfei.

Brilliance
Memiliki efek berikut:
·Memberikan Scarlet Seal pada Yanfei setiap beberapa saat.
·Meningkatkan DMG yang diakibatkan oleh Charged Attack.
·Efek Brilliance akan berakhir saat Yanfei meninggalkan medan pertempuran atau gugur.

passives.name: Proviso
passives.description: When Yanfei consumes Scarlet Seals by using a Charged Attack, each Scarlet Seal will increase Yanfei's Pyro DMG Bonus by 5%. This effect lasts for 6s. When a Charged Attack is used again during the effect's duration, it will dispel the previous effect.
passives.descriptionId: Saat Yanfei mengonsumsi Scarlet Seal dengan menggunakan Charged Attack, setiap Scarlet Seal akan meningkatkan 5% Bonus Pyro DMG Yanfei selama 6 detik. Jika Yanfei menggunakan Charged Attack sekali lagi selama durasi masih berlangsung, maka efek sebelumnya akan hilang.

passives.name: Blazing Eye
passives.description: When Yanfei's Charged Attack deals a CRIT Hit to opponents, she will deal an additional instance of AoE Pyro DMG equal to 80% of her ATK. This DMG counts as Charged Attack DMG.
passives.descriptionId: Saat Charged Attack Yanfei mengakibatkan CRIT pada musuh, Yanfei akan mengakibatkan Pyro DMG Area tambahan sebesar 80% ATK Yanfei. DMG ini terhitung sebagai DMG Charged Attack.

passives.name: Encyclopedic Expertise
passives.description: Displays the location of nearby resources unique to Liyue on the mini-map.
passives.descriptionId: Memperlihatkan lokasi produk khas Liyue di sekitar pada peta kecil.

constellations.name: The Law Knows No Kindness
constellations.description: When Yanfei uses her Charged Attack, each existing Scarlet Seal additionally reduces the stamina cost of this Charged Attack by 10% and increases resistance against interruption during its release.
constellations.descriptionId: Saat Yanfei melancarkan Charged Attack, setiap Scarlet Seal yang terkumpul akan mengurangi 10% konsumsi stamina Charged Attack dan meningkatkan ketahanan terhadap interupsi selama Charged Attack berlangsung.

constellations.name: Right of Final Interpretation
constellations.description: Increases Yanfei's Charged Attack CRIT Rate by 20% against enemies below 50% HP.
constellations.descriptionId: Meningkatkan 20% CRIT Rate Charged Attack Yanfei terhadap musuh dengan HP kurang dari 50%.

constellations.name: Samadhi Fire-Forged
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Signed Edict by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.descriptionId:
Meningkatkan 3 level Signed Edict.
Maksimum: Lv. 15.

constellations.name: Supreme Amnesty
constellations.description:
When Done Deal is used:
Creates a shield that absorbs up to 45% of Yanfei's Max HP for 15s.
This shield absorbs Pyro DMG 250% more effectively.
constellations.descriptionId:
Saat Done Deal digunakan:
Menciptakan Perisai yang dapat menahan DMG hingga 45% dari Max HP Yanfei selama 15 detik.
Perisai ini dapat menahan Pyro DMG 250% lebih efektif.

constellations.name: Abiding Affidavit
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Done Deal by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.descriptionId:
Meningkatkan 3 level Done Deal.
Maksimum: Lv. 15.

constellations.name: Extra Clause
constellations.description: Increases the maximum number of Scarlet Seals by 1.
constellations.descriptionId: Meningkatkan jumlah maksimum Scarlet Seal sebanyak 1.

name: Yaoyao
title: Burgeoning Grace
description: Streetward Rambler's youngest disciple. A gentle and caring "little adult."
descriptionId: Murid Streetward Rambler yang paling muda. Usianya masih kecil tapi sudah seperti orang dewasa, pribadinya lemah lembut dan penuh perhatian.

talents.name: Toss 'N' Turn Spear
talents.description:
Normal Attack
Performs up to 4 consecutive spear strikes.

Charged Attack
Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to lunge forward, dealing damage to opponents along the way.

Plunging Attack
Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground below, damaging opponents along the path and dealing AoE DMG upon impact.
talents.descriptionId:
Normal Attack
Melancarkan hingga 4 serangan tombak berturut-turut.

Charged Attack
Mengonsumsi sejumlah Stamina untuk menerjang ke depan, mengakibatkan DMG pada musuh di jalur terjangan.

Plunging Attack
Menerjang dari udara untuk menghantam tanah, menyerang musuh di jalur terjangan dan mengakibatkan DMG area saat mendarat.

talents.name: Raphanus Sky Cluster
talents.description:
Calls upon "Yuegui: Throwing Mode," a special device created by a certain adeptus to help Yaoyao solve her problems.
This skill will be used differently in Holding Mode.

Hold
Enters Aiming Mode to adjust the throw direction.

Yuegui: Throwing Mode
Throws out White Jade Radishes that will explode upon hitting characters or opponents, dealing Dendro DMG to opponents within a certain AoE, and healing characters within that same AoE based on Yaoyao's Max HP. If a radish does not hit either an opponent or a character, the radish will remain where it is and explode on contact with a character or opponent, or will explode after its duration expires.
Yuegui: Throwing Mode will choose its radish-throw targets.
·If all nearby characters have more than 70% HP remaining, then it will throw the radish at a nearby opponent.
·If nearby characters have 70% or less HP remaining, it will throw a radish at the character with the lowest HP percentage remaining. If no opponents exist nearby, Yuegui will also throw White Jade Radishes at characters if they all have more than 70% HP and less than 100% HP remaining. Otherwise, it will throw radishes into the area at random.

A maximum of 2 instances of Yuegui: Throwing Mode can exist at any one time.
talents.descriptionId:
Memanggil mekanisme khusus buatan Adeptus, "Yuegui: Throwing Mode" untuk datang dan membantu Yaoyao mengatasi segala kerisauannya.
Saat ditahan, akan melancarkan serangan dengan cara yang berbeda.

Mode Tahan
Memasuki Mode Membidik untuk menyesuaikan arah melempar.

Yuegui: Throwing Mode
Melemparkan White Jade Radish yang akan meledak saat mengenai Karakter atau musuh dan mengakibatkan Dendro DMG kepada musuh di dalam radius tertentu dan memulihkan HP Karakter dalam radius yang sama tersebut berdasarkan Max HP Yaoyao; Jika tidak mengenai musuh atau Karakter, White Jade Radish akan tetap berada di posisi awal dan akan meledak saat menyentuh Karakter atau musuh, atau setelah durasinya berakhir.
Yuegui: Throwing Mode akan memilih target pelemparan White Jade Radish berdasarkan situasi di sekitarnya:
·Saat HP Karakter di sekitar berada di atas 70%, akan dilemparkan kepada satu musuh di sekitar;
·Saat ada Karakter dengan HP di bawah atau sama dengan 70%, maka akan dilemparkan kepada Karakter dengan persentase HP paling rendah. Jika tidak ada musuh di sekitar, maka akan tetap dilemparkan kepada Karakter meskipun HP Karakter berada di atas 70% dan di bawah 100%. Jika tidak, maka akan dilemparkan ke tempat acak di sekitar.

Hanya bisa ada 2 Yuegui: Throwing Mode di saat yang sama.

talents.name: Moonjade Descent
talents.description:
At the enjoinment of a certain adeptus, Yuegui's full potential can be unleashed in an emergency, dealing Dendro DMG to nearby opponents and entering an (in some sense) unsurpassed Adeptal Legacy state.

Adeptal Legacy
·White Jade Radishes generated will be changed to heal and deal DMG according to this skill. Explosions will heal all nearby party members, and the Dendro DMG that they deal will be viewed as Elemental Burst DMG instead.
·Summons "Yuegui: Jumping Mode" at intervals until their limit has been reached. The behavior of this version of Yuegui is the same as that of "Yuegui: Throwing Mode" in the Elemental Skill, Raphanus Sky Cluster. A maximum of 3 Yuegui: Jumping Mode can exist at any one time.
·Yaoyao's Movement SPD is increased by 15%.
·Yaoyao's Dendro RES will be increased.

The Adeptal Legacy state will end once Yaoyao is off-field, and all remaining Yuegui: Jumping Mode will be cleared once this state ends.

passives.name: Starscatter
passives.description: While affected by the Adeptal Legacy state caused by Moonjade Descent, Yaoyao will constantly throw White Jade Radishes at nearby opponents when she is sprinting, jumping, or running. She can throw 1 White Jade Radish this way once every 0.6s.
passives.descriptionId: Saat berada dalam status Adeptal Legacy dari Moonjade Descent, setiap kali Yaoyao berlari, melompat, atau berlari kecil, Yaoyao akan terus-menerus melemparkan White Jade Radish ke musuh di sekitarnya. White Jade Radish yang bisa dilemparkan dengan cara ini adalah 1 buah setiap 0,6 detik.

passives.name: In Others' Shoes
passives.description: When White Jade Radishes explode, active characters within their AoE will regain HP every 1s based on 0.8% of Yaoyao's Max HP. This effect lasts 5s.
passives.descriptionId: Saat White Jade Radish meledak, Karakter aktif yang berada di dalam area efek serangan akan memulihkan HP setiap 1 detik sekali. Jumlah pemulihan setara dengan 0,8% Max HP Yaoyao, berlangsung selama 5 detik.

passives.name: Tailing on Tiptoes
passives.description:
When Yaoyao is in the party, your characters will not startle Crystalflies and certain other animals when getting near them.
Check the "Other" sub-category of the "Living Beings / Wildlife" section in the Archive for creatures this skill works on.
passives.descriptionId:
Saat Yaoyao berada di dalam party, Crystalfly dan beberapa binatang tertentu yang didekati Karakter dalam party tidak akan kaget dan kabur.
Silakan menuju bagian Arsip > Makhluk Hidup/Hewan Liar > Lainnya untuk mengecek objek-objek yang dapat dipengaruhi skill ini.

constellations.name: Adeptus' Tutelage
constellations.description: When White Jade Radishes explode, active characters within their AoE will gain 15% Dendro DMG Bonus for 8s and have 15 Stamina restored to them. This form of Stamina Restoration can only be triggered every 5s.
constellations.descriptionId: Saat White Jade Radish meledak, Karakter aktif yang berada di efek serangan area akan menerima 15% Dendro DMG Bonus selama 8 detik dan akan memulihkan 15 Stamina. Pemulihan Stamina yang bisa didapatkan dengan cara ini adalah sekali setiap 5 detik.

constellations.name: Innocent
constellations.description: While affected by the Adeptal Legacy state caused by Moonjade Descent, if White Jade Radish explosions hit opponents, 3 Energy will be restored to Yaoyao. This form of Energy regeneration can occur once every 0.8s.
constellations.descriptionId: Saat berada dalam status Adeptal Legacy dari Moonjade Descent, jika DMG ledakan White Jade Radish mengenai musuh, maka Yaoyao akan memulihkan 3 poin Energy. Pemulihan Energy yang bisa didapatkan dengan cara ini adalah sekali setiap 0,8 detik.

constellations.name: Loyal and Kind
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Raphanus Sky Cluster by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.descriptionId:
Meningkatkan 3 level Raphanus Sky Cluster.
Maksimum: Lv. 15.

constellations.name: Winsome
constellations.description: After using Raphanus Sky Cluster or Moonjade Descent, Yaoyao's Elemental Mastery will be increased based on 0.3% of her Max HP for 8s. The maximum Elemental Mastery she can gain this way is 120.
constellations.descriptionId: Setelah melancarkan Raphanus Sky Cluster atau Moonjade Descent, Elemental Mastery Yaoyao akan meningkat berdasarkan 0,3% Max HP-nya selama 8 detik. Peningkatan Elemental Mastery yang bisa didapatkan dengan cara ini adalah maksimum 120 poin.

constellations.name: Compassionate
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Moonjade Descent by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.descriptionId:
Meningkatkan 3 level Moonjade Descent.
Maksimum: Lv. 15.

constellations.name: Beneficent
constellations.description:
For every 2 White Jade Radishes Yuegui: Throwing Mode throws out, the next throw will also release a Mega Radish that will have a larger AoE than the standard White Jade Radish and have the following effects upon exploding:
·Deals AoE Dendro DMG based on 75% of Yaoyao's ATK.
·Restores HP for the active character based on 7.5% of Yaoyao's Max HP.

Every Yuegui: Throwing Mode can throw out a maximum of 2 Mega Radishes.
constellations.descriptionId:
Untuk setiap 2 White Jade Radish yang dilemparkan Yuegui: Throwing Mode, maka pada lemparan berikutnya (lemparan ketiga), akan melemparkan satu White Jade Radish dan satu Mega Radish tambahan. Dibandingkan dengan White Jade Radish, efek serangan area Mega Radish saat meledak akan lebih luas, dan akan menghasilkan efek sebagai berikut saat meledak:
·Mengakibatkan Dendro DMG Area sebesar 75% ATK Yaoyao.
·Memulihkan HP Karakter aktif sebesar 7,5% Max HP Yaoyao.

Satu Yuegui: Throwing Mode bisa melemparkan maksimum 2 Mega Radish.

name: Yun Jin
title: Stage Lucida
description: A renowned Liyue opera singer who is skilled in both playwriting and singing. Her style is one-of-a-kind, exquisite and delicate, much like the person herself.
descriptionId: Seorang penyanyi opera Liyue yang mahir bernyanyi dan pintar menulis sandiwara. Gayanya lain dari yang lain — elegan dan lembut, persis seperti karakternya.
cvJapanese: 小岩井ことり & Yang Yang

talents.name: Cloud-Grazing Strike
talents.description:
Normal Attack
Performs up to 5 consecutive spear strikes.

Charged Attack
Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to lunge forward, dealing damage to opponents along the way.

Plunging Attack
Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground below, damaging opponents along the path and dealing AoE DMG upon impact.
talents.descriptionId:
Normal Attack
Melancarkan hingga 5 serangan berturut-turut menggunakan tombak.

Charged Attack
Mengonsumsi sejumlah Stamina untuk menerjang ke depan, mengakibatkan DMG pada musuh di jalurnya.

Plunging Attack
Menerjang dari udara untuk menghantam tanah, menyerang musuh di jalur terjangan dan mengakibatkan DMG area saat mendarat.

talents.name: Opening Flourish
talents.description:
Ms. Yun may just be acting out fights on stage, but her skills with the spear are real enough to defend against her foes.

Press
Flourishes her polearm in a cloud-grasping stance, dealing Geo DMG.

Hold
Takes up the Opening Flourish stance and charges up, forming a shield. DMG Absorption is based on Yun Jin's Max HP and has 150% effectiveness against all Elemental DMG and Physical DMG. The shield lasts until she finishes unleashing her Elemental Skill.
When the skill is released, when its duration ends, or when the shield breaks, Yun Jin will unleash the charged energy as an attack, dealing Geo DMG.
Based on the time spent charging, it will either unleash an attack at Charge Level 1 or Level 2.
talents.descriptionId:
Yun Jin dapat menggunakan kuda-kuda bela dirinya untuk melawan para musuh.

Mode Tekan
Memutar tombak dengan kuda-kuda pembelah awan dan mengakibatkan Geo DMG.

Mode Tahan
Memasang kuda-kuda Opening Flourish dan melakukan charge untuk menciptakan sebuah Perisai. Jumlah DMG yang dapat ditahan Perisai didasarkan pada Max HP Yun Jin dan memiliki 150% efek penahanan terhadap semua Elemental DMG dan Physical DMG. Perisai akan berakhir saat Elemental Skill selesai dilancarkan.
Saat melancarkan skill dengan melepas tombol, durasinya berakhir, atau Perisainya hancur, Yun Jin akan menyerang dengan ayunan tombaknya dan melepaskan energi yang tersimpan untuk mengakibatkan Geo DMG.
Yun Jin akan melancarkan serangan Charge Tahap 1 atau Charge Tahap 2 berdasarkan durasi charge-nya.

talents.name: Cliffbreaker's Banner
talents.description:
Deals AoE Geo DMG and grants all nearby party members a Flying Cloud Flag Formation.

Flying Cloud Flag Formation
When Normal Attack DMG is dealt to opponents, Bonus DMG will be dealt based on Yun Jin's current DEF.

The effects of this skill will be cleared after a set duration or after being triggered a specific number of times.
When one Normal Attack hits multiple opponents, the effect is triggered multiple times according to the number of opponents hit. The number of times that the effect is triggered is counted independently for each member of the party with Flying Cloud Flag Formation.
talents.descriptionId:
Mengakibatkan Geo DMG Area dan memberikan efek Flying Cloud Flag Formation kepada seluruh anggota party di sekitar.

Flying Cloud Flag Formation
Saat mengakibatkan DMG kepada musuh dengan Normal Attack, DMG yang diakibatkan akan meningkat sesuai dengan DEF Yun Jin sendiri saat ini.

Efek Flying Cloud Flag Formation akan hilang setelah durasinya berakhir atau lapisannya terkonsumsi dalam jumlah tertentu.
Saat satu Normal Attack mengenai beberapa musuh secara bersamaan, jumlah lapisan Flying Cloud Flag Formation yang dikonsumsi akan disesuaikan dengan jumlah musuh yang terkena serangan. Efek dan jumlah lapisan Flying Cloud Flag Formation untuk setiap Karakter dalam party akan dihitung secara terpisah.

passives.name: True to Oneself
passives.description: Using Opening Flourish at the precise moment when Yun Jin is attacked will unleash its Level 2 Charged (Hold) form.
passives.descriptionId: Menggunakan Opening Flourish tepat saat Yun Jin terkena serangan akan melancarkan bentuk Charge Tahap 2 (Mode Tahan)-nya.

passives.name: Breaking Conventions
passives.description: The Normal Attack DMG Bonus granted by Flying Cloud Flag Formation is further increased by 2.5%/5%/7.5%/11.5% of Yun Jin's DEF when the party contains characters of 1/2/3/4 Elemental Types, respectively.
passives.descriptionId: Bonus DMG Normal Attack dari Flying Cloud Flag Formation akan meningkat lagi sebesar 2,5%/5%/7,5%/11,5% dari DEF Yun Jin saat party berisi Karakter dengan 1/2/3/4 jenis elemen berbeda.

passives.name: Light Nourishment
passives.description: When Perfect Cooking is achieved on Food with Adventure-related effects, there is a 12% chance to obtain double the product.
passives.descriptionId: Saat masakan jenis petualangan dimasak dengan sempurna, terdapat 12% kemungkinan mendapatkan hasil 2 kali lipat.

constellations.name: Thespian Gallop
constellations.description: Opening Flourish's CD is decreased by 18%.
constellations.descriptionId: Mengurangi 18% CD Opening Flourish.

constellations.name: Myriad Mise-En-Scène
constellations.description: After Cliffbreaker's Banner is unleashed, all nearby party members' Normal Attack DMG is increased by 15% for 12s.
constellations.descriptionId: Setelah melancarkan Cliffbreaker's Banner, DMG Normal Attack seluruh anggota party di sekitar meningkat 15% selama 12 detik.

constellations.name: Seafaring General
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Cliffbreaker's Banner by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.descriptionId:
Meningkatkan 3 level Cliffbreaker's Banner.
Maksimum: Lv. 15.

constellations.name: Flower and a Fighter
constellations.description: When Yun Jin triggers Crystallize or Lunar-Crystallize reactions, her DEF is increased by 20% for 12s.
constellations.descriptionId: Setelah Yun Jin memicu reaksi Crystallize atau Lunar-Crystallize, DEF-nya akan meningkat 20% selama 12 detik.

constellations.name: Famed Throughout the Land
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Opening Flourish by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.descriptionId:
Meningkatkan 3 level Opening Flourish.
Maksimum: Lv. 15.

constellations.name: Decorous Harmony
constellations.description: Characters under the effects of the Flying Cloud Flag Formation have their Normal ATK SPD increased by 12%.
constellations.descriptionId: Meningkatkan 12% Normal ATK SPD Karakter yang berada dalam status Flying Cloud Flag Formation.
